text: Down and left, the dancer lowers the right hand while the left arm folds and the left knee straightens. The right hand swings right as the right arm opens, then both hands rise and move right with the left arm tucked in. Both hands descend before the left arm reaches down and left, followed by the right hand moving left as the right elbow lengthens. The right hand rises through a right-to-left sweep that curls inward, then drops again as the left arm extends downward. The right arm unfolds and carries the right hand up and left, ending with both hands climbing.

As the right hand moves left, the left hand rises right and both arms curl inward. The right hand drops and returns right while the left arm lengthens downward, then both hands climb as the right knee softens and the elbows fold further. The right hand sweeps left and down into a release while the left hand curls upward over a straightening knee. Both arms open as the left knee bends, then the right hand rises right and the right knee lengthens before the hands descend with the left elbow tucked; the right hand continues right and both knees straighten as the left hand lifts. The hands reverse outward, the right hand rising while the left hand drops and extends, then sweep back in toward each other with the left knee bending as the right hand lowers and its arm opens. The right knee straightens beneath an upward-right sweep of the right hand while the left hand moves left and down, then both arms extend before the right hand curls upward again.

As the right arm folds, the dancer sends both hands right and lowers them. The left knee softens while the right hand rises into a tighter curl and the left arm extends upward; the left knee then straightens as the right hand descends farther left. Both hands sweep left and climb, the right elbow tucking before it reverses right and the left hand follows that direction. The right hand drops and its arm lengthens as the left hand continues right, then returns left and curls up while the left hand lifts and sweeps left. The right arm opens again as both hands descend, then the hands separate sideways and the right arm curls upward to the right.

As the right hand rises, the dancer lowers and lengthens the left arm, then raises both hands before sweeping the right hand left and folding its elbow while the left hand drops right. The right hand reverses right as the left hand curls upward, then drops left and tucks further while the raised left arm opens downward. Both arms extend through a shared leftward sweep and return right, with the right hand lowering and the left hand rising before descending. The right arm reaches farther right and folds inward as the left hand lifts left; the left hand returns right and drops, while the right hand travels left and climbs into a deeper curl. The left hand continues down-right as the right hand sweeps right and drops.

As the right arm extends upward and left, the dancer lifts the left hand and folds it, then opens both arms into a shared rightward sweep. The right hand climbs farther while the left hand curls up-left, then both descend with lengthening arms as the hands separate right and left. Both hands rise again, the left hand moving right before reversing left over a bending knee, while the right arm tucks left and its knee softens further. The right hand sweeps down-right and back left as the left hand drops and opens, then both rise with the right elbow folding and its knee straightening. The hands shift right and descend together before the right arm extends left and curls back up toward the right, ending with both arms lengthening.

A rising, folding arm sweep begins as the dancer sends the right hand right and lowers it into a tuck while the left hand moves left, then lifts and drops again with both elbows opening. The right hand continues right and curls upward as the left hand rises and folds, before the left arm reaches down and left; the right hand drops and sweeps left with an opening elbow, then returns right and climbs into another curl as the left knee bends and straightens beneath the right hand. The right arm extends down and left while the left arm reaches right and upward, then the knees soften in succession beneath a shared leftward sweep that reverses right, the right hand lifting and lowering through a bend and release of the left knee as the left arm folds up and down. Both hands sweep left as the left knee bends and the right hand dips, then the right hand rises right while the left elbow opens and both knees lengthen before the right arm folds back down and left and the left knee softens. The left hand drops as the right hand sweeps right and rises, then both arms open and descend while the right hand returns left; the left knee bends as the right hand reverses right and curls up, followed by the right arm gathering upward and sweeping right over another bend of the left knee.

A descending hand sweep begins as the right arm lengthens down and left, then folds upward while the left arm curls up and right. The right arm opens left and lowers into a further extension, followed by the left arm reaching farther right. The left hand reverses left as both arms gather inward; the right elbow releases before the right hand climbs right and curls back in. Both hands descend, the right hand moving left, then rise with the right arm extending and folding again.

A rising arm exchange begins with the dancer lifting the right hand, then sending both hands left and lowering them as the left knee straightens. The right hand returns right while the left arm folds upward, the right knee softening, before both arms lengthen downward and the left hand reverses left into a curl. The right hand lifts and tucks as the right knee bends, then extends farther up and right while the left elbow opens and both knees sink. The left arm curls higher as the right arm folds, then reaches down and left while the right hand rises and drops; the left knee straightens and the left hand continues lower as the right knee also extends. The right arm curls upward while the left hand rises, moves right and folds back left against the right hand's descent to the left.

The right knee bends as the dancer lowers and folds both arms, then the right leg straightens while the left arm lengthens down-left. The right hand above the bent right knee lifts left into a curl as the right knee softens further and the left arm tucks upward; both hands rise before the left hand reaches right and drops, joined by the right hand's descent. The left arm extends left as the right hand sweeps left, then both hands climb with the left elbow folding. The right arm curls right while the left hand moves left and rises into a deeper fold, then the right arm releases downward. Both hands descend, the left hand sweeping right as the right knee bends; they lift again, with the left arm extending left. The right hand lowers as the right knee straightens, then the left hand drops right while the right hand reaches up-left, followed by the left hand rising right.

In opposition, the dancer sends the right hand left and the left hand right while the left-moving right arm curls upward; the right knee softens as the right hand continues up-left. The left knee bends while both arms fold down-right, then the left knee straightens as the hands rise and separate into opposing directions. The initially left-moving right hand drops right as the right knee lengthens, then rises with an extending elbow before both hands descend and the knees bend in succession. The right hand sweeps left as the left arm curls upward, and the hands climb together with a shared fold of the elbows. Both hands lower, the left arm reaching down-right and opening while the right arm extends farther down-left. The right hand finishes by curling upward to the right.

Upward, the right hand curls as the left hand rises and both knees bend, then the left arm folds left while the right hand lowers and opens. Both hands sweep right with a renewed tuck on the right side and another knee bend, then separate left and right before returning left together as the left knee straightens and the left arm lengthens downward. The right knee bends again beneath a rising leftward reach that opens into a rightward extension, while the left hand drops and the left knee softens; the raised arm curls back left and up as the left knee straightens. The right hand descends and reaches right as the left knee extends, then returns left and rises with a tighter fold while the left arm gathers upward and right. The left arm continues left and down as the right elbow opens and both hands move left, ending with a deeper curl of the left arm.

The right arm folds upward and moves right. The left hand rises left, then drops into a curl as the right arm returns left; both arms lengthen downward before lifting again, with the left elbow drawing in. The hands separate sideways, the right hand moving left and the left hand right, then descend together as the elbows tuck. They reverse inward, the right hand rising while the left hand dips and curls back up. The right arm opens and lowers toward the right as the left knee softens.

A knee bend accompanies the dancer's initial arm exchange: the right hand rises while the left hand travels left and down, then both hands sweep right as the right hand dips. The hands separate sideways with the right hand lifting into a fold and the left hand dropping, before the left hand returns left. Both arms lengthen downward as the knee straightens, then the hands rise, the right hand shifting right and curling while the left hand moves left and the right knee softens again. The right hand drops left as the left arm opens, then folds upward to the right while the left arm extends farther down and right. The right hand climbs into another tuck as the right knee bends and releases, then lowers while the left hand continues right and curls upward. The right knee sinks again beneath the descending right arm as the right hand sweeps left, and the left arm lengthens downward.

The right knee straightens as the dancer curls the right hand upward and sweeps it right, then lowers the right arm while the left hand rises. The right hand swings left and back up-right into a fold before dropping again with an opening elbow, while the left arm tucks down-left and lengthens. Both hands climb as the right knee extends farther and the right arm gathers in; the hands sweep right, then the left hand dips and rebounds left. The right arm opens downward and returns right against the left hand's leftward descent, then both lift with the right hand curling inward as the right knee softens. The left hand continues down-left while the right arm opens and lowers through another bend of the right knee, finishing with the hands moving right together.

The right hand sweeps left and curls upward. Both hands climb, the left arm extending as the right knee straightens and the left knee softens; the left arm folds and carries the left hand right while the right knee releases. The right-moving hand dips and rebounds left as the left hand lifts into a curl, then lowers again while the right hand rises and the knees trade bends and extensions. The right hand climbs as the right knee lengthens and the left knee deepens, followed by both hands lowering with the right arm opening; they separate sideways and rise together, the right hand sweeping left before both descend and the left arm reaches out. The right arm curls up and left while the left arm folds, then opens downward as the right hand drops and extends right. That rightward-reaching arm tucks into a lift and unfolds back down as the left knee bends and releases.

A low, leftward sweep begins as the dancer straightens the left knee and softens the right knee, then extends both arms before folding them back into a shared rightward reach. The hands separate left and right, rise with lengthening elbows, and reverse directions again. Both arms tuck, the left hand moving right while the right hand lowers, opens, and follows right. The right hand returns left and folds upward as the left hand continues right and curls higher; the right knee bends while the left arm reaches down and right over a bend of its own knee, then lifts as the left knee straightens and its elbow draws inward. The right hand continues right and climbs while the left hand drops, opens, then rises and folds again as the right knee lengthens further.

The dancer raises the arms to trade height. The right hand lowers into a reach, then curls up and left while the left arm opens downward; the raised right hand dips and extends right as the left arm lifts left, before both arms climb with folded elbows and sweep right. Both hands descend, the right hand moving left into an opening elbow, then both rise together as the left hand swings left and back right. The left hand drops into an extension while the right arm tucks and lowers, the right knee softening before both hands reverse right and the tucked right arm opens down and left; the left knee bends as the left hand rises and curls. Both knees straighten as the hands return left, the right arm folding upward while the left arm lengthens downward. The left hand sweeps right and back left as the right arm opens down, and the left knee continues extending.

The right knee straightens as the dancer sends the right hand right and lowers both hands, the left arm folding while the left knee softens. The right arm opens downward and lengthens further as the left knee releases, then curls up toward the right and returns left with a deeper fold. Both knees bend again as the right hand continues upward and left in a tighter tuck. The left knee straightens while the right knee bends farther, and the left hand drops into an extension before returning right and lifting. The right hand moves right and down as the right knee releases, followed by the left hand rising to the right; the right knee bends once more before both legs extend.

The right knee bends and straightens beneath the right hand descending, while the left arm curls up to the left. The left hand moves right and lowers as the right arm opens downward, then the hands trade lateral directions with the left folding upward and the right extending down. The left arm reaches farther right and rises before dropping, while the right arm tucks higher and sweeps left. The right arm unfolds into a lift as the left hand continues down and right.

A side-to-side arm sweep begins with the right hand moving right as the left hand drops and follows, then returns left while both rise, the right arm curling before both hands shift right. The left arm opens downward and curls back up as the right hand lowers; the left hand sweeps left, rises and folds into a shared rightward reach that softens at the right knee. Both arms extend down and separate sideways, then reverse toward each other as the knees straighten in succession and the hands lift, the left hand folding left while the right hand returns right. The rightward-reaching arm tucks and lengthens again, then the hands move apart and climb before reversing inward as the left arm curls upward and the right knee bends. The left arm reaches farther right and falls while the right hand lifts left and the right knee extends.

The knees soften in succession as the dancer folds the right arm, lifts and extends the right hand left while the left knee bends; the right hand drops and curls right into a renewed lift. The hands trade height twice more as the left arm lengthens and folds, with both knees softening again before the right hand lowers. The left arm opens downward and reverses up-left as the right arm tucks, then rises while the left hand moves right and the right hand drops. Both arms draw inward as the hands sweep down-left, the left knee bending and releasing beneath a rising hand that continues left. The right hand lifts into a deeper fold while the left arm extends upward, ending with the right knee bending further.

The knees join later in a succession of arm-and-knee exchanges: the dancer folds the right arm as the right knee bends, then extends it left while the left hand sweeps right and curls upward. The left-moving hand rises and falls into a tuck as both hands sweep left and the left knee softens; both arms lengthen as the left hand drops, then curl upward while the bent right knee straightens. Both hands move right and descend with opening elbows as the right knee bends again, then reverse left and rise into tighter folds before descending once more. The right knee releases, the hands continue left and separate with the left elbow extending, then climb together as the right knee softens and the left hand moves right. The left knee straightens as both hands lower and open, the right hand continuing left while the left arm curls up and right and the right knee sinks further. The left arm reaches down-left as the left knee bends and its hand lifts right, then both hands sweep right and the left hand climbs farther.

A rising-and-falling arm figure begins with the right hand lifting left into a fold, while the left arm extends downward and the right knee softens. The right arm opens as the left hand reaches right, then curls back up and left before dropping and unfolding again. The right hand rises farther into a tuck as the left knee bends, then both hands sweep down and right with lengthening elbows before returning left, the right arm curling upward. The left hand dips and rebounds as the right knee straightens, then both arms gather inward while the left knee softens again. The right hand lowers and releases as the right knee bends further, and the left arm folds toward the right while the right elbow draws in once more.

The dancer lowers and lengthens the right arm, then curls it upward as both hands move right and the left arm folds. The raised right hand reverses left while the left elbow opens and the left hand drops, then both hands descend and sweep right before the left arm tucks again. The right arm reaches left as the right knee straightens, followed by the left hand lifting left and curling inward over a bending left knee; the right arm extends down while the left hand drops right, and the left leg lengthens as the right knee softens. Both arms fold downward, then the right hand swings right and rises with a deeper curl as the right knee bends farther and the left arm opens. The left knee bends further while the raised right hand returns left and both elbows tighten, then the left hand lowers and the hands separate right and left as the legs straighten in succession. Both arms extend down and sweep right, the left hand rising before the hands reverse left and the right arm curls upward.

The right arm reaches right and folds down while the left arm extends downward, then both arms sweep left before the left arm curls upward and both hands rise. The right arm lengthens farther left as the right knee softens, then the arms trade height, the left hand descending right while the right hand lifts and drops into a tuck as the right knee straightens. Both hands continue left with the left arm opening, then separate sideways as the right elbow bends and both lower; the left knee softens while the left arm curls up and left. The right hand rises and sweeps right, followed by the left hand, whose arm opens into another lift as the right arm folds and lowers. The left hand continues right and descends into an extension while the right arm lengthening reaches left, and both knees bend as the right hand returns left. The hands reverse sideways together, the right hand curling upward and the left hand lifting left, before the right arm opens into a shared descent.

To begin, the dancer extends the right arm down and right while the left hand rises left, then lowers both as the left hand reverses right. The right arm folds into a leftward lift while the left arm reaches farther left, then lengthens downward before curling upward again. The right knee softens as the left hand sweeps right, drops and returns left; the right hand continues left, opens and refolds while the left hand climbs right with a deeper bend of the right knee beneath it. The right hand lifts and tucks as the right knee straightens, then both hands descend with the left arm extending. Both hands rise together, the right arm reaching out and the left elbow folding, before the hands separate left and right and lower into open arms.

To begin, the dancer lifts the right hand and carries it right as both arms extend, then lowers the right hand while the left hand rises and folds inward. The right hand continues right and curls upward, followed by the left arm folding and lifting left. Both hands move left and descend before the right arm opens and the right hand returns right, then the left arm extends right and drops as the right hand reaches farther right. That rightward reach reverses left and lengthens into a lift, accompanied by the left hand moving up and right with an opening elbow.

The right knee softens as the left hand sweeps left and drops, then reverses right while the right arm curls upward. The left hand returns left and rises into a fold as the right hand climbs farther. Both arms lengthen downward before the left arm lifts back left, followed by the right hand lifting right; both then descend with opening elbows and sweep left. The hands reverse right, the left hand curling upward before dropping, then the right arm folds up and left while the left arm reaches down and right. The right hand continues higher, then lowers as the left hand curls upward again.

The right hand rises and moves left. The left arm lengthens down, then folds upward and reaches right as the right hand drops and tucks inward. The left hand lowers while the right hand lifts and opens, then returns left and down with another bend of the elbow. The right hand rises into a tighter curl as the left hand sweeps up and left, then both hands descend before the right hand climbs again. The left hand dips right and back left as its elbow folds, while the raised right hand reverses right and extends downward.

As the right arm curls upward, the dancer folds the left arm and lifts the left hand left, then straightens both knees. The left knee bends as the right hand reaches right and lowers into a tuck, followed by the left hand rising with an opening elbow. Both hands sweep left while the right arm extends and the left knee straightens, before the right hand drops and both arms fold into another leftward reach. The right hand rises again as the left hand sweeps down and left, then reverses right and up while the left knee softens and the right arm lengthens downward. The left knee releases as the right arm curls upward and the left arm reaches right, then the bent left leg deepens while the right hand swings left and back right, folding lower as the left hand moves left.

The dancer lifts the right hand upward. The left arm folds, then both hands descend and lengthen as the right knee bends and straightens; the left hand sweeps right while the right hand moves left, both elbows opening before the hands reverse sideways. The right arm curls up-left as the right knee softens, then extends down-right while the left hand rises and tucks in. The left knee straightens as the right hand returns left and climbs with a fold, then opens downward alongside the left hand's descent. Both arms gather inward, the left hand rising as the right arm reaches up-left, followed by the left elbow releasing. The right hand drops farther left while the left arm extends downward, then the right hand swings right as the left hand moves left.

The right arm reaches down and right. The dancer raises both hands, folding the right arm while the left arm extends farther left. Both hands descend as the right arm opens left, then rise with the right hand returning right and curling inward. The left arm tucks left and climbs higher as the right knee bends, before both elbows release and the hands sweep left together.

The right hand sweeps right and down. The left hand joins the rightward sweep, then both arms curl upward as the right knee softens. The left arm opens while the right arm lowers, extends, and rebounds up with the right knee bending further before straightening. Both hands descend as the left knee sinks and the right arm folds, then the left knee bends and releases beneath a shared lift of both arms. The hands separate left and right, lower, and reverse their directions with the right arm opening and the left arm folding. They rise again, the right hand moving right as the right knee straightens, then both elbows tuck inward and the right knee bends once more.

The arms move in opposition: the right hand travels left as the left hand curls right, then both hands sweep left and rise with folded elbows. The left arm releases downward while the right arm tucks more deeply, then both hands reverse right as the left arm folds and the right knee bends. The dancer straightens the right knee as the right hand curls up-left, then opens into a rightward lift while the left hand drops and lengthens; the right arm tightens through another left-to-right return and descends. Both knees soften as the hands separate, the right hand moving right and the left hand left, before the left hand rises rightward and the right arm reaches down-left over a bend of the right knee. The hands exchange directions once more, the left hand returning up-right as the right knee straightens and the left knee softens, then the left arm extends farther right while the right arm continues left.

The right knee straightens as the dancer folds the left arm downward and sweeps both hands left, then sends them right with the right hand rising. The left arm reaches higher to the right while the right hand continues right and opens, followed by a shared leftward sweep and the right arm curling upward. The right arm lifts farther left before extending down, while the left hand moves right and rises. The left hand traces right-left-right as the right knee softens, then both hands descend with the right arm lengthening; the left hand reverses left as the right knee bends further. The left knee also softens beneath a rightward hand sweep, and the left hand continues left.

The dancer curls both arms upward. The right hand sweeps left and opens as the left knee straightens, then the left arm folds right while the right hand lowers and lengthens farther left; both hands reverse inward before the left hand drops with an extending elbow. The right hand rises into a tuck while the left knee bends, then they separate right and left as the left knee straightens and the left arm folds higher. Both elbows open as the right hand returns left, then the left hand moves up-right over another bend of the left knee and a softening of the right knee. The left hand drops left while the right hand continues left and lowers, followed by a lift and return of the right hand to the right as the left knee straightens.

The right hand travels right as the left knee straightens, then both hands sweep left and the right arm folds before the right hand reverses right and rises against the left hand's descent. The right arm tucks farther while the left arm curls upward; both hands move right, then the right arm lifts and opens as the left arm drops, folds again, and sweeps left while the right hand continues right. Both hands climb with the right arm curling inward, then the left hand lowers and reaches left as the right hand returns right. The left arm folds upward, followed by the right hand lifting into a tighter bend while the left hand moves left and descends; the left knee softens as both arms release downward. The right hand sweeps left and curls upward as the left arm lengthens, then returns right and down while the left knee bends and the left hand rises.

While the right arm lengthens downward, the left arm curls upward and right, then opens as the right hand reaches left. The left arm folds down and left while the right elbow tucks and both hands descend; the right arm then extends as the right knee straightens. Both hands rise, the right arm curling inward before the hands sweep left and the left arm opens into a drop. The right hand swings right and back left with a bend and release of the right knee, while the left arm lengthens farther left. The right knee softens again as the left hand continues left and both elbows draw in.

The right knee softens and straightens as the dancer curls both arms upward, then lowers them while the right knee bends again. The right arm folds higher as the left hand swings right and back left, the right knee straightening before the right arm drops. The left hand rises with a tighter elbow tuck while the right arm extends downward, and the left arm opens into a down-left sweep. The right hand climbs right and curls inward as the sweeping left arm reaches farther left, then both descend, the right hand returning left. Both elbows draw in more deeply as the hands rise again.

The knees soften in succession as the dancer lifts the right hand and lengthens both arms, then lowers and extends the right hand farther while the left hand folds and rises. The hands sweep left together, with the right arm curling upward and the left arm folding before opening; the knees straighten in sequence as the right hand drops left and the left hand curls up-right. The left arm tucks lower, opens into a rightward reach, and reverses left as the left knee bends and the right leg straightens; the right knee softens before both extend again while the right hand lifts and moves right. Both arms fold as the right knee bends, the right hand drops left, and the left hand follows left into a tighter curl. The right hand returns up-right with its elbow drawing inward while the left knee sinks again, then the left arm unfolds and lowers as the right hand continues down-left and the right knee releases.

As the right arm curls upward, the dancer lifts and folds the left hand rightward while the right knee beneath the rising arm bends, straightens, and softens again. Both arms open downward as the right knee deepens its bend, then the hands sweep left with the left arm lengthening while the right knee releases. The right arm reaches up-right as the left knee straightens and both knees soften in succession; the raised right hand returns left into a tuck before the knees straighten together. The right hand reverses right while the left arm opens and lowers, then the knees exchange their bend and release in succession, followed by the elbows folding. Both knees sink again and the hands rise, the right hand moving left and the left hand moving right, before the left arm extends downward as the right leg straightens. The lowered left hand continues down-right and lengthens while the right hand climbs, and both knees bend as the rising right hand moves left.

The right hand travels left. The left arm opens downward, then curls upward as the right hand reverses right and lowers with its elbow tucked; the left hand continues rising while the right hand sweeps left, rises and returns right. The hands separate sideways, the right hand moving left and the left hand moving right, before both curl upward and reverse their lateral paths. They sweep down and open apart again, the left hand continuing right while the right arm folds and drops, then extends left as the left hand lifts and returns left. The right hand climbs right into a bend while the left arm reaches down and left, then both rise, the left arm opening before both elbows fold and the right hand descends. The left hand swings right and back left into an extension as the right elbow tucks farther, then they exchange height, with the left hand rising and falling again. Both hands move left, the right hand climbing and the left hand dropping.

An alternating arm sweep begins with the left hand rising left while the right hand reaches right, then the left hand curls upward as the right arm climbs and folds. Both hands descend before the right hand lifts and both arms lengthen, continuing down and apart to the left and right respectively. The hands rise together, then the right hand lowers and sweeps left into a fold as the left hand curls higher and shifts left; both lift again, the right elbow opening before the left tucks more deeply. Both arms extend downward, then the elbows curl inward as the hands separate left and right. The right hand rises, drops and rebounds up as both elbows release, then both hands lower and the right hand travels left.

A folding-and-opening arm figure begins with both arms extending and the dancer lifting the right hand, then dropping it as the right knee straightens. The left arm folds while the lowered right hand moves right, then both rise, the left arm opening before curling again as the left knee softens. The right hand climbs farther left into a tuck while the left arm reaches down-right and lengthens; the hands reverse sideways, the right arm extending as the right knee bends deeper. The right hand dips and rises into a fold while the left arm drops, opens, and sweeps left as the left knee straightens, then curls upward. The right arm reaches down-left and returns up-right as the left arm folds downward, then both hands lower, the right elbow opening before the right hand moves left and both arms curl inward.

In opposition, the dancer lowers the right hand while curling the left hand upward, then lifts and extends the right arm. Both hands rise, with the right hand sweeping left as the right knee bends and the left hand drops; both elbows fold before the right hand returns right and rises alongside the left. The left hand moves left while the right arm opens downward, then curls back up and left as the left knee softens. Both hands descend and sweep right, the left arm extending before they lift again, then separate sideways and fall once more. The left hand climbs left as the left arm lengthens, then joins the right hand in a low sweep to the right.

The dancer repeats a paired arm-and-leg action: the right knee bends as both hands sweep right, the right hand returning left and curling upward while the right leg straightens; the left hand lifts with an extending elbow and reverses left. The left knee softens beneath its descending arm, then extends as both elbows tuck and the hands climb right before the left hand lowers. Both knees lengthen as the right hand drops and its arm opens, then both hands sweep left and rise into folded arms, the left knee bending as the right leg straightens further. The hands reverse right and descend, the left arm opening before both gather back left, the right hand lowering farther as its knee softens. Both elbows extend and the hands lift right, with the left knee straightening before both legs lengthen and the hands fall, the left hand continuing right. The right hand sweeps left and returns right as the left arm curls upward to the right, then the left hand rises again before both lower and the right elbow folds.

The right hand drops and sweeps right while the left hand curls upward, then both hands rise before the right hand opens. The left hand drops as the right hand folds farther right, and both hands descend before the right hand reaches left and lifts against the left hand's continued drop. The left hand swings right, then reverses left as the right hand extends down and returns left; the right hand opens while the left hand climbs right into a curl. Both arms gather inward as the left hand reverses left and descends, then the right hand moves right while the left hand lengthens downward. The hands separate sideways again, the left hand continuing to reach farther left and lower.

The right knee straightens as the dancer lowers the right hand rightward and lengthens both arms, then lifts the right hand left while the left arm folds and the left hand drops. The left arm reaches down-right as the right knee softens, then tucks upward while the left hand moves right and rises into a curl. Both hands descend with open elbows before the right hand curls up-left, followed by the left hand lifting and extending as the right hand falls. The left hand sweeps down-right and returns left against the right hand's rightward reach, then both rise with the left elbow folding. The right arm extends farther right and lowers while the left arm curls downward.

As the right arm lengthens, the dancer lifts the left hand rightward and folds it into a leftward return, then lowers both hands with extending elbows. The left knee bends as the right arm curls up-right, followed by the left hand rising rightward and the right knee softening while the right arm opens downward. Both knees straighten as the left hand continues down-right and the right elbow tucks, then the right hand reaches left and rises with a bent elbow before dropping again as the left knee extends. The left arm curls upward and left while the right hand lifts rightward and draws inward, then the left arm opens into a descending sweep to the right. The right hand drops left and lengthens as the left arm folds back toward the left.

The dancer raises the right hand. The left arm folds upward, then both hands sweep left and lower into open arms. Both hands return right as the right knee straightens, then the right arm curls up and left while the left hand rises leftward; the knees soften in succession before the hands reverse right and descend, the left elbow opening and the left knee lengthening. The right arm reaches down-right as the left hand drops left, then curls up-left while the left knee bends and the right knee sinks further. The right hand lowers left as the left arm opens downward, then the left bent knee releases while the right knee softens and the left hand moves right.

As the right hand rises, the dancer sends it right and curls the right arm in, while the left knee straightens. The raised right hand returns left as the left knee softens and the right knee bends; both knees lengthen before the right knee sinks again and the hands sweep left with a deeper fold on the rising side. Both knees bend and release in succession as the right hand reverses right and descends, then the left hand lowers and moves right while the bent leg straightens and the descending arm extends left and down. Both arms tuck as the left hand continues right and the lower hand lifts farther left, followed by a rightward sweep of the lifted hand over another knee bend and release. The right knee bends again beneath a rightward reach, then straightens as the left arm folds upward and both hands return left with the reaching arm curling higher.

A rising arm exchange begins with the dancer curling the right hand up and right while the left arm folds, then lifting both hands as the right elbow opens. Both hands descend and sweep left before the left hand curls upward; the right hand follows with a folded lift, then both arms extend down and right as the knees soften in succession. The hands rise again, the right hand reaching farther right, before they fall leftward and both elbows tuck. A low rightward sweep carries the left arm open, followed by the right arm extending down and right, then both folding as the left knee bends and the left hand returns left. The left arm releases downward while the right arm continues right and rises, accompanied by a bend and release of the right knee.

As the right arm curls upward and the left arm reaches right, the dancer lifts the left hand left while the right hand moves right. The right arm folds down and left as the left arm tucks up and left, then both descend into lengthening arms with the left arm sweeping right and returning left. Both hands rise again, the right arm extending left while the left hand moves right, before the right arm curls down and the right knee straightens. The right hand sweeps left and back right as the left arm opens downward, then both sweep left and return right while the left hand rises. The left arm curls up and left as the left knee bends, then releases downward while the right knee softens; both hands continue left, the right arm curling upward and dropping while the left arm rises.

The right knee straightens as the dancer lowers and lengthens the right arm left, then lifts it into a fold while the left hand moves right. The right hand sweeps down-right and reaches farther out as the left arm curls upward; both hands descend, the right hand returning left and the right knee softening before both arms extend. The right knee bends again as the hands reverse sideways and rise, the left elbow folding, then opens beneath another reversal toward the left. Both arms lengthen and descend as the left knee straightens, then curl upward while the right knee bends and the right hand sweeps right. The hands lower with extending elbows, the right hand continuing right as the left arm folds, then reverses left. Both hands rise and sweep left, with the left arm tucking farther in.

As the right arm curls upward, the dancer separates the hands left and right and lengthens the right arm before both arms rise, the left arm folding inward. The right hand swings left then right while the left hand drops left, opens, and returns right into a fold. Both arms tuck as the right hand rises and the left hand lowers, then they sweep left and reopen toward the right with the left elbow curling again. The right arm extends downward and carries the right hand right against the left hand's continuing leftward reach. The right knee bends as the left arm folds farther down, then straightens while the left hand reverses left into an extended drop.

The right arm reaches left while the left arm curls upward, then both arms sweep right with the left arm opening. The right hand drops and lengthens as the left arm reverses left and lowers, then they exchange sideways directions again before curling upward. The right knee bends as the right arm reaches down and right, while the left arm folds and lifts; the right leg straightens and softens again as the lower arm opens left and both hands descend. Both elbows tuck through a shared rightward sweep and rise, then the left arm releases downward while the right arm curls higher and sweeps left. The left knee bends as the right leg extends, the raised arm opens downward, and that knee straightens.

The right knee straightens as the dancer lifts and lengthens the right arm, then carries the left hand left while the right arm folds right. The left hand curls upward toward the right and drops into an extension, followed by a rise of the right hand as both knees soften; the left arm tucks again before its hand travels right and back left while the right arm descends. Both hands move left with the left arm opening, then the right hand rises as the right knee extends and bends again; the left arm curls up and down, opens right and folds upward once more as the left knee straightens. The left arm reaches farther right while the right hand lowers and moves left, both elbows drawing in before the left hand reverses left and climbs. Both hands sweep left and down, the right arm extending as the left elbow opens and the left knee bends; the right hand then returns right and folds as the bent left knee straightens and the right knee softens.

The dancer performs a rising leftward arm sweep: the left hand curls up toward the left as both knees soften in succession, then the left hand swings right and down while the right hand moves left. The left arm folds through a left-to-right reversal, lengthens upward to the left and drops back right as the right knee straightens; the left hand rises and tucks again before returning left with another bend of the right knee. Both hands descend as the right knee releases, then the left arm extends down while the right hand lifts into a curl and the right knee bends. The right hand drops and opens as the right knee straightens, then returns up and left against the left hand's rightward extension. The right hand continues left and higher with a tighter fold as the left arm reaches farther right and down.

The right hand rises and sweeps left. The left hand follows as the right arm lengthens downward, then both hands climb with folded elbows before the right hand drops and the right knee softens. The hands separate right and left, the left arm curling upward and back right while the right arm reaches down to the right; the left arm opens and lowers, followed by the right hand dropping and folding inward. The right hand lifts with a bend of the right knee, then descends as the right leg straightens and the elbow releases, while the left hand curls up and left. Both arms gather inward and rise, the left hand continuing left as the right hand moves right, then both descend with extended elbows and reverse sideways again.

As the right knee straightens, the dancer lowers and lengthens the right arm while the left hand rises left; both hands then sweep right and the right knee sinks. The left arm curls up and left as the right knee bends farther, while the right hand drops, opens and rises again. The left arm reaches down and right before lifting back left into a fold as the right arm lengthens downward. The left hand climbs farther right with an opening elbow, while the right hand moves left and drops. Both hands descend, the right hand sweeping right before curling upward as the knees bend in succession. The left arm extends down and left while the right arm returns left and tucks more deeply.

The right knee softens as the dancer lowers and extends the right hand, then bends both knees while the left arm reaches up-right and the right arm curls back left. The left arm lengthens farther as the left knee straightens and the right knee softens; the hands separate right and left before the right bent knee releases, with the rightward hand continuing down and extending. Both hands climb and sweep left, one elbow folding as the other knee lengthens again, then the folded arm opens downward while its knee sinks deeper. The other arm tucks into a rising leftward reach as the lower hand returns right and the same knee bends further, then straightens beneath an extension of the raised arm. That extended hand reverses right and drops as its corresponding knee releases, while the other hand rises.

The dancer moves leftward. The right hand sweeps as the dancer lifts and folds both arms, then opens them into a shared descent. The hands separate left and right while the left arm curls upward again. Both elbows draw in as the right hand drops, then they unfold as the right hand rises; the left arm continues climbing with its elbow tucked before the right hand lowers and both arms lengthen. The left hand swings down-left and back up-right against the right hand's rightward motion, then extends farther right as the right knee straightens. The left hand dips, rebounds upward with a curling elbow, and finishes by sweeping left and lowering.

The arms exchange height twice: the dancer sends the right hand right while the left hand moves left, then reverses their sideways paths as both hands descend and the left arm folds. Both rise with the right elbow curling in and the left extending, before they sweep left, reverse right and return left together, the right arm opening as its hand lifts. That lifted right hand travels farther right and drops, followed by the left hand lowering. The right arm extends upward to finish.

The right hand lowers and sweeps left. The left hand moves right as both knees soften in succession, then the right hand reverses right and rises while the right knee straightens and the left knee bends again; both hands climb with folded elbows as the left knee extends once more. The left arm reaches right and lengthens upward before tucking back toward the left, while the right arm opens down to the right and the left hand descends into a deeper fold. Both hands reverse left and rise, the right arm curling higher as the left opens downward. The left hand returns up and right with an extending elbow, followed by the right hand sweeping right and lowering into an open arm.

In unison, the dancer lifts and lowers both hands. The right hand reverses upward while the left hand travels right, then both hands descend before rising again. The right arm curls toward the left as the right knee bends and straightens, then extends down and right while the left elbow tucks; the right knee softens and releases beneath a further rightward reach and downward release of the right hand. The right hand rises with another bend and release of the right knee, then folds into a lower rightward sweep as the left leg lengthens and the right knee bends. Both hands rise in succession as the right knee straightens and the left knee softens.

A rising, leftward arm exchange begins with the left hand lifting and folding as the right hand lowers; both then sweep right, the left arm opening before they descend. The left hand curls upward again while the right hand reaches up-left, then both arms tuck and lower into a shared rightward sweep, the right elbow releasing as the right hand climbs back left. Both hands rise with folded elbows and reverse left, the left arm extending downward as the right arm opens, then the left arm reverses right while the right arm returns left and folds. The left arm extends down-right and curls upward as the right hand lifts left, continuing higher and farther left before both arms lengthen downward and the left hand swings right. Both elbows fold as the hands climb, the left hand returning left while the right hand drops and opens right; the left arm releases down-right and finishes with another tucked lift.

The right hand sweeps left and rises. The left arm folds inward, then reaches right as the raised right hand drops and both elbows open; the left arm tucks again before both hands descend, the right hand returning right while the left knee softens and the left arm lengthens downward. The left knee straightens as both arms curl upward, with the right hand continuing right before reversing left and dropping into an extension while the left elbow folds farther. Both hands sweep right, the right arm drawing in before opening again as the left hand returns left, then the right arm folds down and left against a rising rightward reach of the left arm. The left hand drops and reverses left while the right hand lifts right, then both return right and descend before the right arm curls up and left over a bend of the right knee. The right hand continues left and lowers as the left knee bends deeper, while the left hand swings left and back right, opens, and drops.

To begin, the dancer sends the right hand right and down with a bent elbow while the left hand travels left, then lowers and lengthens the right arm as the right knee straightens. The left knee bends as the right hand sweeps left, both elbows fold and the hands rise before the hands separate sideways, the right hand continuing left and the left hand returning right. Both arms open downward as the right knee softens, then they curl upward and sweep left before the right arm extends farther left and the left hand descends. The left elbow tucks again as the right arm lengthens down and right, followed by a drop and extension of the left arm; both hands rise and move left, the left arm folding as the right elbow opens. The right hand drops and curls back up toward the right while the left hand rises and moves right, then reverses left as the right side lengthens and the left knee straightens and bends again.

As the right hand rises, the dancer sends it left and curls the right arm higher while the left knee straightens. The right hand reverses right, opens its elbow and lowers before both hands climb again. The right hand sweeps left with a tighter fold as the left hand continues upward and tucks in, then both descend and lengthen into an exchange of left-right hand paths, accompanied by another bend in the left knee beneath the initially raised right hand. Both arms curl upward and sweep left as the left knee releases, then the right hand drops and extends down-right while the left hand rises. The right hand returns left and lifts as the left hand folds downward, followed by a rightward reach from the right arm and a renewed rise of the left hand.

The right hand moves right as the dancer folds the left arm, then lowers and lengthens the left arm while the right arm opens. The hands sweep left and rise, with the right hand curling inward before both elbows fold and their heights exchange. The right hand drops through a right-to-left sweep as the left hand continues left, then reverses right while the left hand rises; the right arm reaches down and left and returns right as the left arm tucks. The left hand lifts farther right, followed by the right hand rising, then curls left and up as the right arm extends. Both arms open and descend, the right arm moving right while the left arm continues downward to the right.

The right hand dips and curls right. The left hand sweeps left as the right knee softens, then both hands rise before the left hand returns right and drops with a tucked elbow. The left arm opens down-left while the left knee straightens and the right hand climbs right; the right arm folds up-right and releases as the left arm tucks left and descends. Both hands sweep left and rise with folding elbows, then lengthen downward toward the right. The right hand lowers into a curl while the left hand reaches left and rises, then lifts farther as the right hand continues right and drops. Both arms open and descend, the right hand returning left as the left hand curls upward and moves right.

As the left arm folds and the right arm opens, the dancer lowers the left hand right while the right hand rises left. The left arm lengthens farther right as the right arm curls upward to the right, then both hands descend, the left hand moving left before lifting again. Both arms open, with the right hand continuing right; the left elbow tucks as the left hand drops and the right arm curls up to the left. The left arm extends left and rises while the right hand dips and rebounds into a fold, then the raised arm gathers inward and drops. The right hand sweeps down-left, curls upward, and returns right as the left arm opens downward and the right arm releases.

The dancer begins with the left arm folding left while the right hand rises, then straightens both knees as the left hand moves right and down into an open reach. The hands separate sideways before the left hand returns left and curls upward as the right knee softens and the right hand drops; both knees straighten in succession while the right arm extends left and folds back up-right. The left hand lowers and lengthens as the right arm tucks, then sweeps left and climbs again against the right arm's downward extension, finishing with a deepening curl of the left elbow. Both arms fold and rise together as the right hand moves right, then the left hand reverses right and falls while the right knee bends; the right hand lowers and opens as the bent leg releases. The left arm tucks farther and rises as the right knee softens again, while the right hand descends left; the left hand continues climbing as the right leg straightens and the left elbow draws tighter.

The dancer lowers both hands. The right arm folds and extends downward as the left hand drops, then the right arm curls left before both rise and the left elbow tucks. The right hand sweeps right and back left into a fold while the left hand reaches up and right; both arms lengthen as the right hand lifts. The right hand returns right and drops with its elbow folding while the left arm opens downward, then both curl upward and sweep left. The right arm releases down and right as the left arm rises and folds farther, followed by another lift of the right hand and a deeper tuck of the left elbow. Both hands lower, the right arm extending while the left arm curls upward again.

To begin, the dancer lowers and lengthens the right arm while the left arm folds leftward, then raises the right hand as the left arm opens. The right hand sweeps right and down with a deeper extension while the left elbow tucks again. Both hands rise as the newly bent left arm releases and the right arm curls higher; the right hand drops, then reverses left as the left arm returns right and both elbows fold inward. The left arm extends while the right hand dips, then lifts leftward against the left arm's rightward reach. The right hand continues upward before descending and curling inward.

A leftward hand sweep begins as the left arm folds and the right knee softens, followed by the right knee straightening while the left knee bends and releases. The initial left hand rises into a longer reach left as the left knee extends and the right arm opens downward, then both knees soften while the hands separate right and left and climb. The arms lengthen and descend together, with the left-moving hand returning right as the right knee straightens. Both hands rise again, the left arm curling inward while the right arm tucks; the right knee bends as the left arm reaches up-right, then opens down-left over another bend of the right knee. The right arm lifts through an extension and folding, then drops and curls upward once more as the left knee sinks farther and the left arm gathers in.

The right knee softens as the left hand lowers and the right arm folds right. The right arm opens left while the left arm rises and lengthens, then the right knee straightens as the left hand sweeps down-left. The right hand curls upward as the right knee bends again; both arms gather inward and descend toward the right before the hands separate sideways and the right side lifts into a tighter fold. The right arm reverses left and extends downward as the left elbow draws in, then both hands sweep right while the right arm returns left and the right knee releases. The left hand rises and falls with an opening elbow, followed by another rise from the right hand.

The right hand sweeps left. The left arm folds as the right arm curls upward, then both arms lengthen downward while their hands separate right and left; the right hand lifts and returns down-left with a bend. The left hand drops farther left as its knee straightens, then both hands rise, the left arm tucking and sweeping right before opening back left while the right arm extends downward. The right hand continues down-left and curls upward as the left hand climbs right and folds, then the right elbow releases and its hand reaches down-right. Both arms curl upward, the right hand continuing right before they extend down and reverse sideways, the left hand returning left. The hands sweep left together, then the left hand rises and moves right as the right hand returns right.

A rising, lengthening arm exchange begins as the right hand travels right and the left hand curls up-right, then both arms extend while the hands climb and reverse inward. The dancer lowers both hands into folded elbows, then sends them apart, left and right, before lifting them again with the same inward curling motion. The hands sweep left together as their elbows open, then return right and descend into another fold. Both arms reach upward once more, the right hand moving left before the left hand follows that direction and they lower with extended elbows. The hands separate horizontally, the left hand returning left as both rise and the right arm folds.

The dancer raises the right hand. The right arm opens left and drops as the left hand lowers, then the hands reverse sideways and lift with both elbows tucked before the hands descend again. Both arms lengthen into a shared rightward sweep, then curl upward as the knees soften in succession. The hands lower together, then separate sideways as the knees straighten; the right hand lifts again while the left arm extends farther right. The right arm curls higher as the right knee bends and releases, while the left elbow folds and reopens, the left hand moving right. The right hand drops as the right knee softens and the right arm tucks, while the left knee bends and straightens and the left hand sweeps left.

The right hand rises right while the left hand lowers and curls, then both hands sweep left. The right arm folds upward as the right knee bends, while the left arm extends downward and the left knee straightens; both hands move right and the left arm tucks. The left arm opens down-left and reverses right with a bend in the left knee, while the right hand rises and moves left into a curl. Both hands descend, the left elbow opening as the left knee softens, before the left hand sweeps right and returns left with a tighter fold. The right hand drops right and lengthens as the left arm lifts left, then the right knee straightens and the right hand rises right.

As the right arm folds inward, the dancer lifts both hands and carries them left, then lowers the right hand while opening the right arm farther left. The left hand climbs right as the lowered right arm curls upward again, then both arms lengthen downward, with the right hand moving right. The left knee straightens and softens as the hands rise together, the right arm curling into a lift while the left extends. The dancer bends the left knee again and lowers the hands, sending the right hand right and the left hand down-right before lifting both hands into an opposing sideways sweep, with the left arm tucking and the left knee extending. Both hands descend as the left arm opens, then climb back toward the right, the left elbow drawing in before the right hand returns left.

The dancer lifts both hands. The right arm curls inward as the left knee straightens and the left hand drops left, then the right hand lowers while the left hand rises right and bends. The right hand reaches up-right as the left elbow opens; the left arm folds down-left, extends farther down-left, and reverses upward toward the right. The left arm tucks and descends right as the right arm lengthens, then both elbows bend with the right hand lifting right before returning left and down. Both arms open downward, the right hand moving right as the left knee softens.

The right hand sweeps right as the left arm folds and lifts, then both hands rise before the right hand reverses left. The right arm opens downward while the left arm curls higher to the right; the right hand returns up-right and the left hand drops into an extension. Both arms tuck as their hands descend, then the right hand moves left and down with an opening elbow while the left arm extends upward. The left arm reaches farther right, curls back left and lowers as the right hand rises into a fold and the right arm lengthens again.

The right knee softens as the dancer lowers both hands and lengthens the arms, then lifts them into opposing sideways reaches while the right knee straightens. Both elbows fold and descend as the left knee bends, with the right hand moving left and the left hand right; the left knee releases as the hands rise and separate again, the right arm curling left before opening down. The hands reverse inward and sweep upward together, the right hand returning left as the right knee extends; both arms tuck, then the right hand drops and unfolds while the left hand continues rising. The left hand swings left, curls up and opens back right, while the right hand moves left and rises into a bend as the left leg lengthens. The right hand returns right and folds down as the left elbow releases, then both hands climb with the right arm extending and the left knee bending.

The dancer extends the right arm. The left hand lowers and sweeps left as the right arm curls up and right, then opens downward while the left arm folds upward; both hands climb, with the right hand moving left. The right arm tucks and releases as the left elbow bends and both hands sweep right, then the right hand drops while the left continues right and curls inward. Both hands return left, the right elbow folding as the left opens, then reverse right with the right arm lengthening before both elbows draw in. The hands separate left and right, the left dropping into a deeper curl as the right hand rises and the left knee softens, then both elbows open and their hands descend together.

The right knee straightens, then the left knee straightens. The right hand sweeps left as the left hand rises right, and both arms curl inward. Then the hands reverse sideways while the right knee softens. The right hand climbs and folds while the left arm opens downward, and the left knee lengthens. Then the right hand drops through an opening elbow and a bend of the left knee. The left knee straightens again as the left hand lifts left, followed by a rising rightward sweep from the right arm over a right knee extension. The right hand lowers and curls back left as the right knee bends, while the left hand drops and extends farther down. Both hands climb, the right arm folding right before both sweep left and descend with extending elbows. Then both hands separate right and left as the left knee straightens and the right hand rises again. The right hand travels left and up while the left hand moves right. Then they exchange sideways directions as the left arm reaches up and opens and the right knee bends. Both hands return left, the left arm folding down and reopening as the left knee lengthens. The left knee bends while the right hand lifts right, followed by the left hand rising left and curling in. The hands trade directions once more as the left knee straightens, the left elbow opens, and the right arm extends upward.

At the outset, the right hand rises and sweeps left as the right arm folds, while the left hand moves right and both knees soften in succession. The right arm releases down toward the right before curling upward again as the left knee straightens and the right hand drops left; both hands descend, then the right arm extends as the left knee bends and the left hand lifts into a fold. Both hands rise with the left arm opening, then drop and separate right and left, the right elbow tucking as the right knee straightens. The hands climb together as the right knee bends, then lower and reverse sideways, the left arm lengthening downward as the right knee straightens again. The left arm curls up to the left and releases down toward a rightward sweep, joined by the right hand moving right, before both arms fold and lift together. The hands return left as the right arm opens, then descend with both elbows drawing inward.

As the right hand rises, the dancer lowers the left hand, then folds both arms before lifting the left hand. The right arm opens and drops while the left arm curls upward, then both hands move left with the left elbow tucking. The left hand rebounds up and right as the right arm lengthens downward and sweeps right. Both elbows extend, the right hand continuing right before the right knee bends; the left hand lifts left as the right knee straightens and the right arm folds. The left hand descends rightward and returns left into a curl while the right arm reaches down and right over a bending knee, then both arms open.

The right hand sweeps left and down. The dancer lifts the left hand, extends both arms and lowers them, then carries the right hand right as the left arm reaches up-right. The left hand folds downward while the right arm lengthens and lifts; the left hand drops farther right as its elbow opens, then curls upward to the left. The left hand reverses right with a tighter tuck while the right arm extends higher, before the left arm opens and lowers. Both hands shift right and rise, the left hand continuing upward with a bent elbow.

In unison, the dancer lowers and lengthens both arms, then sends the right hand left while the left hand drops right. The hands separate in height as the left arm curls upward and the left knee softens, before both hands reverse sideways and descend. The left knee straightens as both elbows draw inward, then the hands sweep right with the right arm opening and the left arm curling higher. The left hand continues up-right while the right hand extends down-left, then both hands fall and shift left. The right arm tucks as the left hand climbs right into a fold, and the right arm follows up-right.

The right knee softens as the dancer sends the right hand right and curls the left hand upward, then reverses both left with the left arm folding deeper. The left arm extends down while the curled left arm lifts right, then opens downward; the right knee straightens as the hands sweep right and the left arm lengthens further. Both arms tuck as the left hand drops and the right knee bends, then the tucked right arm reaches left and down before curling back right over a softened right knee. The left arm folds into an upward-right reach as the right knee straightens and the right hand rises left. The left arm extends down-left while the right hand lowers and the right arm lengthens; the right knee beneath the descending right hand bends again as the left knee also softens.

At the outset, the right arm folds and carries its hand right while the left arm reaches left. The left arm lifts as the right hand drops left and extends back right, then lowers again with a curl. Both hands reverse sideways and rise, the left arm lengthening before folding down. They sweep apart, the right hand left and the left hand right, then exchange directions as the left hand climbs; the left arm opens while the right arm tucks. Both hands descend and return left, the left arm extending farther as the right elbow releases.

As the right hand rises, the dancer extends both arms and lowers the left hand rightward. The right arm folds back left while the left hand climbs right, then sweeps down-left as the left arm lengthens and the right elbow opens. The hands separate sideways, reverse inward with bent elbows, and descend into opposing reaches before reversing outward again. Both arms curl upward, then spread apart once more. The right arm that initially rose lowers and tucks farther as the left hand moves right.

To begin, the dancer lowers both hands as the right arm opens and the left arm folds, then reverses their paths with the left hand rising and curling inward. The right hand lifts leftward as its knee straightens, while the raised left arm reaches down and right; the right elbow tucks and releases, followed by the lower left hand extending upward. Both arms gather inward before the initially lifted right hand drops, its left counterpart moves right, and that lowered left arm lengthens upward. The right hand curls down and left as the raised left hand travels right, then reversals unfold: the left-moving left arm opens up and left while the right arm tucks into a descending rightward sweep, before both rise and the right arm extends leftward. The hands separate right and left, the left-moving left hand dropping as the right hand rises and curls in.

The right knee softens as the dancer lowers and lengthens the right arm while the left hand moves right, then raises both hands. The right hand continues right with a deeper elbow bend before returning left into a tuck. The right arm opens downward as the right knee straightens and the left knee bends; the left hand travels right and lowers while the right arm curls upward and moves right. The right hand returns down-left as the left knee releases and the left hand follows left.

The right knee bends as the right hand lowers and the right arm folds left, while the left knee straightens beneath a rightward reach. The right hand rises with a tighter curl as both knees soften, then sweeps down and right before lengthening upward alongside the left hand; both knees extend as the hands separate left and right, the left arm folding through a dip and lift. The hands reverse sideways, the right hand lowering and opening into a left-right sweep while the left hand drops and reaches farther right over another bend-and-release of the right knee. The right hand climbs as the right knee straightens and the right elbow tucks, then swings right and back left while the left hand lifts over another bend of the right knee. The left arm curls higher and opens right before returning left, accompanied by a softening and straightening of the right knee and a downward release of the right hand. The right hand continues left as both knees bend again, the left knee extending while the right knee releases, then both elbows fold and the hands rise as the right knee bends once more.

The right arm folds upward. The left hand lowers, then both hands rise as the right arm tucks and the right elbow releases; the hands sweep right before the right arm curls left and the left hand drops into an extension. The right hand rises while the left hand folds and lifts, then the right elbow opens and both hands descend, the left hand moving left as the left arm lengthens and the left knee straightens. Both hands climb, the right arm folding and the left arm extending, before the right hand drops and reaches farther right as the left elbow tucks and the left knee softens. The right arm curls upward while the left hand rises left and extends, the left knee straightening as the right hand continues up-right and the left hand returns down-left. The right elbow opens through a dip and lift as the right knee bends, while the left arm curls left, lowers, and lengthens with a deeper bend of the left knee. The right knee straightens as the right arm reaches right and folds back left, accompanied by another deepening knee bend on the left side.

As the right hand rises leftward, the dancer lifts the left hand toward the right and lengthens both arms. Both hands descend, the right arm folding before they sweep right with the left curling upward and the right opening. The left hand reverses left as the right knee softens, then drops while the right arm extends and lowers. The right hand moves right and curls up as the right knee straightens; both hands climb, the left elbow tucks, and the knees alternate bending and releasing through a descending reach. The arms fold as the right knee bends again and the left hand sweeps left.

The right knee softens as the left hand lowers and both sweep left, then the right knee straightens while the left arm curls upward. The right hand climbs right with a fold, followed by the left arm opening downward to the right before curling up again; the left arm then folds down and extends back up while the right arm tucks higher. Both hands rise and separate left and right as the left knee bends and releases, then the left arm lengthens through an upward-left sweep and a downward-right return. The left hand lifts into a deeper reach as the right elbow opens, then drops while the right knee straightens; both hands sweep left and climb with folded elbows before the left hand returns right and opens downward. The arms extend downward in succession as the knees soften, then the right knee straightens and the right arm lengthens farther left.

In opposition, the dancer curls the right arm upward while the left arm reaches down and right; the raised right hand then swings left and opens. The descending left hand sweeps left as the right arm lowers and tucks, then both arms fold with the left-moving hand rising before extending down and right. That left hand lifts again into a curl while the right elbow opens, then returns left as the right knee straightens and the left arm folds farther right. Both hands lower, the left hand moving right while the right hand continues left and the right knee softens; the rightward left hand then rises and reverses left as the bent right leg extends. The right hand travels right and up into a tighter fold while the left hand drops and lengthens.

The arms join in a rising sweep. The dancer sends the right hand right while the left hand moves left and the left knee softens, then both hands descend and the arms lengthen as the left knee straightens. Both knees bend in succession beneath another shared lift, then the right arm curls upward to the left and releases down as the right knee sinks further. The left arm folds through a descending rightward reach while the right hand travels left and lowers with an extended elbow; both hands continue downward before the right arm tucks up to the right and both knees soften again. The right hand drops farther as the left knee straightens and the left arm reaches down-left, while the right knee bends and releases beneath a fold of the right arm. The hands separate left and right, the right elbow opening as the right knee bends once more, and the left arm curls upward.

The right arm extends left. The left hand travels left as the right knee softens, then both arms fold inward before the hands reverse right and lower with opening elbows, the right knee releasing beneath the left arm's descent. Both hands lift and separate left and right, the right arm curling while the left knee bends again; the hands drop and reverse their lateral directions as the left knee straightens. The right hand returns up and right, the left knee extending further, while the left arm folds and carries its hand right into a rising curl. Both hands climb, the right continuing right and the left reversing left with a deeper tuck, then the right arm lengthens farther before both descend.

The dancer lengthens the right arm. The left hand lowers and swings right, left, then right as the right arm curls upward; both hands rise before the right arm opens and the right hand moves left. The left hand drops and travels left while the right hand climbs farther left, folds back down to the right, then rises again with a deeper curl as the left hand lifts. Both arms tuck, and the left hand continues right while the right arm descends left and extends. The hands separate sideways, the right arm drawing inward as the left hand reaches right, before the left hand returns left and the right arm lifts into another fold.

The right knee straightens as the dancer lifts both hands, the right arm curling inward while the left arm extends down-left. The right hand climbs farther and shifts right as the right knee lengthens again, then lowers into a tuck while the left hand continues left and down. Both arms open as the left hand drops further, then rise together with bent elbows before sweeping left. The hands reverse right, the right arm extending higher while the left arm gathers in, before both descend and separate right and left. The left hand rises into another fold as the right hand lifts and opens; the right arm then lengthens farther upward.

The right hand drops as the left hand rises, then both hands sweep left and the right arm lengthens downward. The hands reverse right while the right arm curls upward and the left arm extends; the left hand continues rising as the right knee bends and releases beneath another reach, then both arms tuck and the left hand moves left. Both elbows open and the knees soften in succession before the hands climb, the right hand drifting right as the right knee straightens and the left knee folds down and right. The right knee sinks further while the right arm reaches up and left and the left arm extends upward, followed by a deeper bend on the left side as the right hand lowers. Both hands descend with opening elbows, then separate sideways as the right knee releases and the left knee softens, ending with the left hand returning right.

The dancer curls the right arm upward and right.
