The right hand drops as the left arm lifts left, then the right arm rises again while the left knee straightens and the right forearm folds into a rightward lift. The left hand reverses left as both knees soften and the left elbow opens; the right arm lengthens down while the left knee straightens, then the hands separate left and right with the left hand rising. Both arms curl upward, the right hand reaching farther left before returning right as the right knee bends deeper and the left arm extends downward. The right knee straightens as the left hand sweeps up-left and the right arm tucks into a right-to-left return.

The knees lengthen in succession as the dancer lowers the left hand left and folds the left arm, then raises both hands with the right elbow tucked before they descend together. The left arm opens right and rises while the right knee bends and the right hand climbs into a fold; the right arm curls back down-left as the right knee softens and the left hand drops right. The right knee straightens beneath an upward reach of the left arm, which then sweeps left and down while the right arm extends up-right and the right knee deepens again. Both elbows tuck as the left hand climbs and the right hand moves left, then the hands separate sideways and lower before the left arm opens down-left and the right arm reaches right and up. The left hand reverses right with a folded elbow while the right arm draws inward and returns left, then both hands lift and the left arm lengthens as the left knee straightens. The hands separate once more, the left hand descending right and folding while the right hand continues left and rises.

The right hand moves left and the left hand moves right. The dancer reverses them, lifting both hands as the right arm folds, then extends downward while the left knee bends and releases beneath a further lowering reach. Both arms curl upward, the right hand continuing left before they open again; the left hand descends and sweeps right with a bend of the left knee, then returns left and curls up as the left leg straightens. The right hand lifts farther left into a fold while the left hand drops, swings right and tucks back in, then both hands rise and move left as the knees soften and release together. The left arm lengthens down to the right, followed by the right hand's descent and extension, and finishes with another bend and release of the left knee.

The right arm folds upward. The left hand rises as both knees soften, then the right arm opens right while the left knee straightens and the left arm extends down-right; the left hand drops and reaches farther right as the left knee bends again. Both hands lift with lengthening arms and reverse sideways, the left hand left and the right hand right, before descending and reversing again. The left knee bends deeper while the left hand curls up-left and the right hand rises rightward into a fold. The left hand lowers right as the left arm opens, then returns left and up-left with another tuck while the right hand drops left; both hands finish by sweeping right.

The dancer alternates the arms' height: the right hand rises as the left arm curls, then both climb with folding elbows. The hands sweep left and descend together before the left hand reverses right and climbs farther while the right hand returns right. The right arm tucks and drops as the left arm folds left, then both extend upward; the right hand moves right and lowers into a curl while the left arm opens. Both elbows gather again as the right hand lifts and the right knee softens, then the right hand travels left and down while the left arm reaches right and extends downward. The left arm lengthens and sweeps right, followed by the right hand rising right with a bent elbow.

The right arm folds down-left. The left hand reaches left and lengthens downward, then both hands sweep right while the right arm curls upward and the left elbow tucks. The right knee straightens as the left knee bends and the left hand rises, then both hands descend into extending arms before the left arm curls up-right. The right hand lowers and swings left as the left arm opens down-left; the right knee softens beneath a lift of the right hand, which then falls into a tighter fold while the left arm curls up-right and the left knee lengthens. Both hands lower with the right elbow opening, then rise as the right knee bends and releases; the left arm extends down-left while the right hand sweeps right and descends with the right arm folding inward.

The dancer folds the right arm. The right hand drops and extends left, then rises into a tighter curl as the left hand lifts left and the right knee straightens. The right arm lowers through a lengthening reach while the left hand climbs farther left; both knees soften as the right hand returns right and tucks. Both hands descend with their arms opening, the left knee straightening before the elbows fold again and the hands sweep right together. The hands reverse left and rise as the arms lengthen, then return right, the left hand lifting higher and both knees bending in succession.

The dancer sends the right hand left. The left arm reaches right, then both arms sweep right and rise with curled elbows as the right knee bends; the right hand returns left while the left arm extends farther right. The right knee straightens as the hands reverse apart and lower, the right hand returning right before the left elbow folds inward. The knees soften in succession as the right arm lengthens and the left hand moves left and rises, then the right arm curls upward while the right knee straightens and the left knee bends further. Both arms open into a descending reach, the right arm drawing back up as the right knee straightening deepens and the right knee softens again. The right hand drops right while the left hand lifts left, and the left knee releases as the right hand rises.

The right hand sweeps left and down. The dancer opens both arms, then lifts the right hand while the left hand curls upward, before lowering and extending the left arm. Both hands move right as the right arm folds and rises, then the hands separate sideways with the left arm lengthening; both lower as the left arm tucks, then the right hand reaches up and left against the left hand's rightward sweep. The left hand climbs left with a bent elbow, while the right hand dips right and returns up-left through an opening and refolding of the right arm. The right hand drops and rises again as the left hand moves right and down with an extending elbow. The right arm reaches farther left and lowers while the left hand continues right, then folds upward as the right hand shifts right and the left arm draws inward.

The right knee straightens as the dancer folds the right arm and lowers the right hand right, then extends both arms with the left hand moving left. The right hand continues right while the left elbow opens farther; the right hand rises before dropping into a curl. Both hands sweep left as the knees bend, then rise and separate right and left with the right arm lengthening. The left knee softens further as the left hand drops and rebounds, followed by another lift and fall of the right hand and a deeper knee bend. The right arm reaches down-left as the left hand travels right and the knees release, then the hands exchange sideways directions and the left arm curls upward.

As the right hand sweeps left and down, the dancer straightens the right knee and opens both arms, then lifts the right hand right as the left arm curls upward. The right hand returns left into a fold while the left arm lowers; both knees soften, then the left arm lengthens downward and both hands shift right as the knees straighten. Both arms tuck and rise with another bend of the left knee, then extend as the left knee releases and the right hand drops left. The right arm folds into a lift to the right as the right knee bends, then both hands lower and separate right and left before the right arm opens upward and the right knee straightens. The left hand rises leftward while the right hand descends and moves right, then the hands reverse sideways as both elbows gather and the left knee softens. The right hand drops into an extension while the left knee straightens and the left arm reaches farther left.

In opposition, the right hand moves left as the left hand rises right and folds in, then both hands descend before the left arm reverses right and curls upward while the right knee straightens. The left arm opens downward and left as the right knee lengthens further, then folds up-right against a tucked leftward return; both hands drop as the right knee bends and the left straightens. Both arms tuck upward, the right hand sweeping left while the left hand travels right and the left knee softens again, before the hands separate horizontally and the elbows release. The hands lower and reverse sideways, the right hand curling up-right over a bending knee and the left hand reaching left as the left leg straightens; both knees then extend as the left hand rises with a bent elbow and returns left. The right hand dips and lifts while the left hand sweeps right and down, the left knee bending and releasing twice as it folds, rises, and opens back left over another bend of the right knee. The right arm lowers and reaches right as the right knee straightens, while the left hand descends right and the bent knee releases.

A knee bend joins the dancer's arm phrase: the right hand sweeps left as the left arm lengthens downward, then both hands lower and the hands separate right and left. The right arm folds and rises before opening back down toward the right, while the left arm curls upward and drops leftward. Both arms gather into a rising reach, with the right hand reversing right as the left knee bends and straightens; the hands descend and separate again, the left arm extending downward. The right hand continues down and left as the right knee softens, while the left arm tucks and lowers. The right knee straightens as the right hand reaches up-right and the left arm lengthens upward, then both knees extend in succession beneath a final shared downward curl.

In unison, the hands sweep left and rise, the right arm lengthening while the left arm folds. The left hand reverses right as the right arm curls upward to the right, then both arms open and lower with the left hand returning left. Both hands lift again, the right hand moving left before they separate right and left; the left arm tucks as the right knee softens, then extends while the right knee straightens. The right arm reaches down and left, then curls up as the left hand rises and moves left, with both knees bending in succession. The left hand dips and rebounds into a tighter fold while the right arm climbs farther left and opens.

Upward, the dancer lifts both hands into folds, then lowers and lengthens the right arm while the left arm rises farther. The right hand curls left and up as the right knee softens, then reaches right and down while the right knee straightens and the left arm opens upward. Both arms fold as the hands sweep left, the right arm rising and returning right while the left arm drops and extends; the knees bend in succession as the right hand curls back up. The right arm tucks through a right-left-right figure while the left knee straightens, then the left hand reaches up-right with the left knee bending before both hands return left and the left arm lengthens downward. The left hand continues right and down through an opening and curling motion, then reverses left and rises as the right knee bends and the right arm extends. The left hand falls right while the right arm gathers upward, and both hands move left with the right arm continuing higher.

A leftward arm sweep begins the phrase: the left hand moves left as both arms lengthen, then the left hand curls upward while the right hand rises and the right elbow folds. The left arm opens right as the right hand descends and the right knee softens; the right arm reaches farther down before curling up again. The right hand continues right with a deeper tuck while the left hand lifts, then the left hand extends back left and drops as the right knee bends further. Both hands rise with folding elbows, the left arm reaching right before returning left and opening downward, while the right arm lowers into an extension and sweeps left. The right hand continues left as the left hand climbs right, then the left hand reverses left and curls higher while the right arm draws inward toward the right.

The right hand rises rightward while the left hand lowers and moves left, both arms lengthening. The right arm curls down-left as the right knee straightens, then both hands climb while the left arm tucks inward before separating left and right. Both elbows open and the hands descend, the right hand continuing left while the left hand reverses right and folds. The left hand drops farther and reaches left, then lifts as both knees soften and the right arm extends downward; the right hand swings right and returns left into a tighter curl. The left hand continues downward as the left knee bends deeper and the left arm opens, followed by the right hand dropping and the right knee straightening while the left knee softens again.

In opposition, the dancer folds the left arm left and lowers it while the right arm extends down and right, then reverses the right hand up-left as both arms lengthen and lower. The hands separate right and left before returning toward each other, with the leftward-moving arm curling upward and both elbows tucking as that hand sweeps right and down. The right arm reaches left and curls up, then both hands rise and sweep right, the left elbow opening before both arms fold downward. The left hand returns left and up-right while the right hand dips and rebounds upward; the left arm lengthens farther right as the right arm tucks into a descending leftward reach. Both hands lift again, the left arm folding as the right arm opens, then the hands drop with the left hand moving right and the right hand reversing left as the right elbow bends.

The dancer lifts and folds the right arm. Both hands descend, the left arm extending left before curling upward and right, while the right knee bends and straightens as the right hand moves right and rises into a fold. The raised hand sweeps left and down, then both arms open and lower as the right knee softens again; the left hand swings right and returns left while the right knee releases and bends once more. The right arm curls upward and left, followed by the left hand lifting rightward with a deeper tuck, then opens as the right arm lowers and reaches right. Both arms lengthen downward as the knees straighten in succession, then the right hand sweeps left while the left hand rises and curls toward the right. The left arm extends downward and back left, ending its phrase as both knees soften beneath lowering hands.

At the outset, the dancer folds the right arm downward and left while the left arm extends right and lowers. The right hand rises as both arms lengthen and the right knee straightens, then the right arm tucks again and the right knee bends while the left hand sweeps left and curls upward. Both hands climb with folded elbows, the left arm continuing left before the right arm opens down and left; the hands reverse sideways as the left knee softens and the right knee straightens. The right arm reaches farther left and up, then drops while the left arm curls upward and both knees bend in succession. The right knee straightening precedes the left leg extending and the left arm opening downward, then the right knee bends again as the left hand continues left and both arms fold.

The dancer lifts the right hand. The right arm folds and drops as the left hand rises, then both hands sweep left with the left arm curling in; the right hand lifts right while the left hand reaches down-right. Both hands return left together, the right hand dropping and opening before the left hand lowers and the left knee softens. Both hands climb, the left arm lengthening upward-left as the right arm curls downward, then the right hand returns right and both hands descend. The right arm opens and folds again as the left arm tucks, carries the left hand left, and extends back right.

To begin, the dancer folds the right arm upward while the left hand lowers and extends right, then sweeps both hands left as the bent elbow opens. The left hand returns up and right into a curl, while the right hand drops farther left with its arm lengthening. The curled left arm continues right and tucks further as the right hand rises, then both hands sweep left and the tucked left hand climbs higher. The left hand reverses right while the right hand moves left, and the rightward-reaching left arm curls upward before opening downward again. Both hands descend as the right arm folds and its knee straightens, then that folded right arm reaches down and right.

The right knee bends as the dancer curls the right arm upward and left, then straightens as the right hand continues up-left and opens. The left hand rises right while the right hand lowers and extends farther left; both arms fold as the hands separate sideways, then sweep down-right with the left elbow opening before reversing left together. Both hands lift into tighter folds, the left hand continuing left as the right hand returns right and drops, then the left hand rises again while the right knee lengthens. The left hand moves right and descends, followed by the right hand curling higher to the right as the bent knee softens. The right hand returns left while the left arm extends down-left and the left knee bends further; the right elbow opens as the lower hand climbs right, then both hands drop, the left hand sweeping left. The right knee straightens and the right hand lifts while the left hand reaches right, then the lifted hand travels left as the other knee bends and releases beneath a shared downward curl.

As the right hand sweeps left and rises into a curl, the left arm folds up-left, then opens down-right as both hands descend. The right hand reverses right while the left knee straightens and the left arm lengthens upward; the left knee bends as the left hand curls left and up over another straightening of the right leg, before both hands lower and the left knee releases. Both arms open as the right hand reaches left and the right knee softens, then both elbows tuck and lift with renewed bending of the right knee while the left hand moves right. The right arm extends as the right knee straightens, then curls upward again over a deeper bend before lowering into an opening reach. The left knee sinks farther while the right arm curls upward and the left hand drops left, then the right hand swings right as both knees straighten in succession.

The arms move in opposition: the right hand drops as the right knee straightens, then both hands lift while the right knee bends again. The left arm reaches left and down as the right hand follows downward with an extending elbow; the left knee softens before both knees straighten and the right arm curls upward. The left hand sweeps right and rises as the left knee bends, then lowers and moves left with a deeper tuck while the right hand climbs and extends farther left. The right hand reverses right as the left knee releases and the right knee bends, followed by another lift of the right hand against the left hand's descent. The right arm lengthens down and right while the left hand continues dropping and opens its elbow.

An alternating arm sweep begins as the dancer sends the right hand right and down, then left into a curl while the left hand lowers and extends. The right hand climbs back right and opens, then drops and tucks again as the left hand lifts; both arms lengthen before the right hand returns left and rises. Both hands move right and climb with folded elbows, then the right hand dips and rebounds upward as the right knee straightens. The right hand descends right and curls in, followed by the left hand dropping and folding as the left knee bends. Both hands rise together as the right knee softens, then descend and reach apart to the right and left respectively. The right arm folds and lifts again as the left hand continues left and lowers.

The right arm reaches up and right. The left hand sweeps left, rises, and returns right as the right arm folds downward; both arms open before the hands reverse inward, the right arm continuing down while the left lifts and lengthens. The left hand lowers and extends farther right as the right knee bends, then both hands rise with the right curling left and the left sweeping right and down. The right knee straightens while the left hand reverses left and curls upward, followed by a rightward reach of the right hand and another bend of the right knee. Both hands descend, the left arm opening and returning left while the right tucks right, then reverses left as the left knee softens. The right hand dips left, rises right, and falls again while the left reaches right and lowers; both elbows fold as their hands sweep left, ending with the right hand rising.

The right hand drops and lengthens. The left hand sweeps left, folds and rises as the right arm curls upward; both hands move right before the left arm opens down and the right arm tucks into a lift. The right hand continues down-right as the left arm reaches farther up-left, then reverses down-right while the left arm lengthens. Both hands rise with folded elbows and sweep left, the left hand dipping before returning up-left as the right arm extends and the right knee softens. The right hand reverses right and curls higher while the left arm opens, then lowers and extends left as the right knee straightens and the left hand moves right. The right arm gathers up-right and releases downward again while the left elbow folds, its hand drops and opens, and the right hand continues right and down.

As the right arm folds upward and right, the dancer sends the left hand left, then lowers both hands with the right arm opening as the right knee straightens. The hands separate sideways and rise into tucked elbows, then reverse inward and descend as the right knee bends again and both arms extend. Both hands lift leftward with the left elbow drawing in, then drop as the right arm reaches farther down; the right knee releases while the left hand swings right, dips left and returns right into a fold. The right arm curls upward and left as the left arm opens downward, then both lengthen before the right hand drops and the left hand sweeps left into another bend. Both arms curl upward, the right hand returning right as the left elbow extends and the knees soften. The right hand falls left as the left knee straightens, followed by the left hand lowering right; the right arm folds back up and right as the right knee releases.

The dancer straightens the right knee. The left hand sweeps left and down as the raised right arm folds left, then both hands descend toward the right with lengthening elbows. The right arm curls upward while the left hand reaches left, opens, and rises right before tucking back in; the right knee softens as the lifted right arm extends downward. That bent right knee straightens as the left arm curls up and left, followed by the right hand rising and reaching right. Both arms open and lower as the left leg bends and releases, then the left hand lifts while the right hand moves left and the right knee straightens. The lifted left hand returns right as the right arm curls upward and the initial right knee bends.

The dancer lengthens the right arm downward. The left hand travels left and rises as the right arm curls upward, then both hands sweep right before the left hand reverses left and drops into an extension. The right hand lifts into a fold while the left hand moves right and tucks, then the right arm opens down to the left as the right knee softens and the right hand returns right. The left arm reaches down and right while the right knee straightens; both hands rise with folded elbows, and the left knee bends as the arms open and descend together. The right hand moves right while the left hand continues down and extends left, then curls up and right as the left knee bends and releases. Both arms lengthen downward, the right hand shifting left before the left hand follows right with a renewed fold.

As the right arm folds and the right hand drops left, the dancer straightens the right knee. The right folded arm lifts right as the left hand rises, then both arms lengthen and descend, with the left hand drifting left. The right hand continues down and left while the left hand curls upward and returns right, followed by a downward release of the right arm. Both hands rise again, the left arm tucking in farther before opening into a lift to the right. The right arm folds as the right hand climbs, then extends back down and left.

An alternating arm sweep begins with the right hand rising left and the left hand lifting right and folding inward as both knees soften; the right hand dips and returns up-left while the left knee straightens. The hands exchange height again, the left arm curling upward before both descend, then rise as the right knee bends deeper and the right hand sweeps left and down into a fold. The right arm releases right and climbs as both legs straighten, while the left hand lowers and tucks left, followed by a dip of the climbing right arm and another bend in the right knee. The tucked left arm extends downward as the right leg lengthens, then the right hand reaches right and rises while the left arm curls and the left knee softens. Both hands descend, the right arm opening as the bent right knee straightens and the left hand continues down-left.

The right hand climbs and sweeps right. The left hand reaches up-left as the right hand continues right, then folds while the left arm tucks down-right and the right hand opens farther right. Both hands descend, the left hand moving left and curling upward as the right arm lengthens, before both lower and separate sideways with the left elbow opening. The right hand lifts and curls inward toward the right as its knee straightens, while the left arm extends left; the raised arm then releases downward and sweeps left. The descending hand reverses right with a bend in its knee, while the opposite hand rises left and curls inward.

The dancer folds the left arm downward. The right hand drops and sweeps left as the folded left arm lifts right, then both hands lower while the right arm curls up-right and the right knee straightens. The left hand continues down-left into a reach as the left knee bends and releases, while the right hand moves right and rises with a lengthening elbow; the left arm extends higher as the left knee softens again. Both knees bend and release beneath a shared rightward sweep of the hands, with the right arm curling upward and the left hand lifting before dropping as the left knee sinks once more. The right arm reaches left and down through another bend-and-release of the right knee while the left hand rises, then lowers right as the right knee straightens again. The left arm opens and sweeps left, joined by the right hand moving left, before both hands descend.

The dancer lifts the right hand and lowers it left while lengthening the right arm. At the same time, the left hand rises right. The right hand reverses right and folds upward while the left knee bends. The right hand then returns left and down with a deeper tuck while the left leg straightens. Both hands descend; the right arm extends farther left as the left arm reaches right. Both hands then rise together and separate again, the right hand moving left and the left hand moving right. The left arm curls up and left while the right arm lowers and lengthens. Both hands drop before the left arm opens into another lift. The right arm folds upward to finish.

In opposition, the dancer sends the right hand right while the left hand lowers left, then reverses the right hand left and lifts both hands. The left hand continues down-right as the right arm folds and the left knee softens, before the descending left hand rises and the folded right elbow opens. The softened left knee bends farther while the right leg straightens, the right hand moves right and drops into a fold, and the left hand returns left. The left hand lifts again as the right hand swings left and the bent left knee sinks deeper.

The right arm moves right and the left arm moves left. The right arm curls upward while the right knee bends. Both hands return toward each other. The right arm opens downward before both knees straighten and the elbows fold again. The left hand rises and returns right while the right knee softens and the right hand lifts into a tighter curl. The right hand sweeps down-left as the left knee lengthens and the left arm tucks, then reverses up-right with a bend of the right knee and an opening elbow. The right knee straightens beneath another rising curl and a leftward sweep, while the left hand drops right and the bent leg releases farther. The raised hand descends as the right knee softens once more and the left hand continues right.

The right arm curls upward and opens, then drops while the left hand rises into a fold. The right arm reaches farther down and right as the left hand sweeps left and lengthens downward; both hands climb with bent elbows before the left hand reverses right and drops. Both arms open and lower, the left hand returning left against the right hand's rightward sweep, then curl upward as the right knee beneath the right hand softens. The right hand continues right and folds down while the left elbow tucks; the right knee straightens and bends again as the left hand lowers and the right arm lengthens. The left hand rises and falls with an unfolding elbow, then moves right as the right hand lifts and extends over another bend of the right knee. Both hands reverse sideways, the right hand continuing up while the left hand moves left, and the right knee straightens as the right arm lengthens farther.

At the outset, the dancer sends the right hand left and down as the right arm folds inward, while the left hand lowers right; both knees soften in succession. The right arm rises, then opens left before curling back up toward the right, while the left knee straightens and bends again beneath a descending hand that sweeps left. The left arm continues upward and reaches right as the right arm lengthens downward, its knee extending farther; the hands reverse sideways, the reaching hand dropping and opening farther left while the opposite arm curls up and right. Both arms draw inward with the lower hand climbing left, then the raised hand descends and swings left as the other lifts and folds again. The lower hand reverses right and drops while the other continues rising left, finishing with both hands moving left as the latter arm releases.

As the right arm lengthens right and the left hand drops left, the dancer lifts the right hand higher. Both hands sweep left, then reverse right with the right arm opening and the left elbow bending; the right knee softens as the hands descend and the right arm tucks. The left knee bends beneath a downward-right reach while the right hand rises left and curls in, then both elbows fold and the right hand lowers before returning right. The right knee straightens as the right arm opens down-left, while the left arm extends left and the bent left knee releases; the left hand sweeps right and back left before both hands climb, the right elbow folding. The hands separate left and right as the right knee lengthens farther and the left arm reaches up-right, then the left hand returns left with its elbow curling inward.

Upward, the dancer curls the right arm while the left arm folds left, then lowers the right hand as both elbows open. The hands separate right and left, the left arm reaching farther before folding down and reversing right. The left hand climbs again as both arms lengthen, then returns left while the right hand rises right and tucks inward. Both arms curl upward, with the right hand continuing higher, before the left arm opens downward and the right elbow releases. The left arm gathers back up and reaches right, followed by a rightward extension of the right arm, which then folds and lifts.

To begin, the dancer sends the right hand right and down while the left hand rises left, then brings the right hand back left. The left hand continues upward as the right knee softens and the right hand drops farther left. The right knee straightens as both hands move left and climb, with the left knee bending before the left hand reverses right. Both knees lengthen in succession as the hands separate again, the right hand lifting right while the left hand travels left and drops.

The right knee straightens. The left hand lowers and sweeps right as the right arm extends, then both hands rise with folded elbows and reverse sideways, the left hand continuing up-left while the right hand drops and opens. The right knee lengthens again as the right arm curls upward and the left hand follows up-right; the right knee softens as both hands descend and the left arm tucks in, then the right knee straightens and the right arm reaches down-left before both hands lift and sweep right into folded arms. Both hands lower and separate left and right as the right arm opens, then rise and fold together while the left knee bends and releases beneath a shared leftward sweep that ends with the right arm opening downward. The right hand returns up-right as the left hand curls higher, then the left knee straightens while the right hand falls and rebounds, followed by the left hand rising as the right knee softens and the right hand sweeps down-left. The left hand lifts farther as the right elbow folds and both hands move right, finishing with the right hand dropping.

The right knee straightens as the left hand curls upward and right, then both arms open and the left hand drops before the right arm lifts into a fold. The dancer softens the bent knee while the hands separate left and right, the right arm extending down as the knee straightens again. Both knees bend in succession beneath another shared lift, then release as the hands sweep left, the right arm lengthening before both tuck downward. The hands separate right and left with the left arm opening, then reverse inward and rise with both elbows folding; the right arm reaches right as the left lowers, then curls up and left while the right knee bends. The right knee straightens and bends once more beneath an extension of the right arm, whose hand sweeps right and back left before lowering and curling upward alongside the left hand's rise.

As the right hand curls upward, the dancer lowers and lengthens the left arm while both knees soften in succession. The right arm releases down as the left knee straightens, then rises and extends farther right with another knee bend before sinking into a fold as the left knee lengthens again. The right hand returns left while the left hand reaches right, then the right arm tucks higher and drops as the left hand rises. Both hands sweep left and climb, the right arm extending as the left knee bends; they descend and separate right and left, then reverse their sideways paths and rise together with the left arm curling inward. The right arm folds again and carries its hand left while the left hand continues left and both elbows open, finishing with the right hand moving right.

Leftward, the dancer sends the right hand while the left arm folds down, then opens as the right knee straightens and the left hand rises right; both arms curl downward before the left hand returns left. The left knee lengthens as the hands separate sideways, the right hand climbing right while the left hand reaches up-left into a fold. Both hands descend and sweep right with extending elbows, then the left arm tucks left as the right arm curls upward and the right knee softens. The tucked left hand lowers and reaches right while the raised right hand climbs farther right and lengthens, followed by another bend of the right knee and an extension as the left arm folds left and down. The descending right arm opens right while the left-reaching arm lifts and tightens its elbow, then both hands rise as the knees soften in succession.

The right knee straightens as the dancer lowers both hands, then lifts them into a curling rightward reach and softening of the right knee. The left hand moves left and down while the right arm folds back toward the left; the left elbow tucks, its hand rises left, then drops as the knees exchange their bend. Both arms lengthen downward, then the right hand sweeps left and up with an extending elbow as the left knee straightens. The right hand returns right and down while the left hand curls upward, then both descend with opening elbows. The right hand moves left as the left hand rises and falls again, before the left hand lifts and travels right while the right hand reverses left and climbs higher.

In opposition, the right hand reaches right as the left hand lowers and lengthens, then the left hand curls upward while the right arm folds down. The left hand sweeps left and opens downward, joined by a descending reach of the right arm before the right arm tucks in. Both hands lift with bent elbows, the right arm opening rightward while the left hand reaches left, then both sweep right as the left knee straightens. The left hand drops and returns left into a curl while the left knee bends and releases; the right hand rises with an extending elbow, then dips right and lifts again as the left knee softens once more.

The right knee softens as the dancer lowers the right hand and extends both arms apart, the left hand moving right. The hands rise together with bent elbows and continue separating left and right before dropping in succession. Both arms lengthen farther apart, then curl upward and separate again. The right hand above the softened knee moves left while the left arm folds more tightly; both hands descend, then sweep right into extended arms. The left hand rises through a fold and opens again as the knee straightens.

Upward, the dancer curls the right arm into a rightward reach while the left hand moves left and the right knee softens. The right reaching hand reverses left as the right bent leg straightens and the left arm lengthens down, then both hands rise with the right knee bending again and both elbows folding. Both knees deepen their bends as the arms open and lower, then the left knee releases before both knees straighten and the hands sweep left, the right elbow tucking as the left hand drops. The right arm reaches up-right while the left curls upward; the raised right arm folds back left, opens downward, and repeats the lift and curl. The left hand descends through a fold and extends as the right hand rises, then sweeps left and climbs farther while the right arm reaches higher and curls in. The left arm tightens and lowers as the right knee softens, then opens to finish with another bend of the right knee.

A repeating arm phrase begins with the right hand moving left as the left hand lowers and extends, then both hands rise before the left hand returns right. The hands separate left and right, descend, and reverse their sideways paths before lifting again. The right arm curls inward while the left arm folds upward to the right, then the right arm opens as both hands descend and spread apart once more. The dancer lifts the left hand toward the right and lengthens it farther while the right elbow tucks; the left hand then reverses left.

Upward, the right hand curls into a rising rightward sweep as the left arm lengthens downward. The right arm opens and returns left while the left hand travels right and both elbows tuck; the hands then separate left and right before reversing inward with the left arm extending and the right hand curling again. Both arms lengthen downward as the left hand moves right, then fold upward in succession and release back down. The right hand sweeps left and climbs, its elbow gathering inward as the left arm reaches up and right; the right hand reverses right and drops while the left arm tucks farther. Both hands return left and rise through another extension of the left arm, which folds again as the right arm continues higher and left.

A knee straightens midway through the opening phrase as the dancer lowers and lengthens both arms, then raises the left hand while the right arm extends farther down. The right hand sweeps right and curls upward, followed by the left hand rising with a bent elbow; both hands climb as the right knee softens and the right arm opens, before the hands descend and separate into a rightward reach and a leftward lift. Both knees bend as the right hand rises and folds back left against the left hand's downward rightward sweep, then the right knee releases while the left arm lengthens left and the right arm reaches right and up. The right arm curls inward as the left arm drops, both knees straighten, and the right hand lowers while the left hand moves left. The left knee bends beneath a rightward arm extension, then the left hand rises as the left knee releases and the right arm folds upward to the left.

In opposition, the right arm curls upward while the left arm reaches down, then the right hand drops and sweeps left as the left arm folds upward. The dancer extends the right arm right while the left arm opens downward and rebounds up-left, then carries the right hand left and back right as its elbow tucks and both hands descend. Both arms lengthen, the right hand continuing right before returning left and folding into a rise as the left knee straightens; that same right hand reverses right while the left arm reaches farther down-left. The knees soften in succession beneath the right hand's continued climb, which then lowers and opens through a rightward sweep while the left hand moves left. The right knee bends further as the left hand rises right and falls left with an extending elbow, while the right arm curls up-right and the left arm opens again.

The right knee softens as the dancer lifts and folds the right arm while the left hand drops and its elbow opens, then reverses inward. The right hand sweeps left into an extension while the left arm curls upward to the right and lowers, both arms tucking before the hands rise and separate sideways. Both arms open as the knees straighten in succession; the hands lower and reverse their sideways paths, with the right arm curling upward as the left knee bends and releases beneath a further leftward reach. The right hand continues left while the left arm lengthens downward and the left knee softens again, followed by another bend of the right knee and an extension of the left. The right arm folds higher as the left hand reaches farther down and left, then the hands trade height and sideways direction, the right hand dropping while the left rises. Both arms gather inward as the right hand moves right and the left sweeps left, ending with a low, extended reach of the left hand.

The right hand moves right and curls upward. The left arm opens as the right hand returns left, then folds down while the left knee bends and the left hand continues left; both hands rise and reverse sideways before the left leg straightens and the arms lengthen downward. The left knee softens again as the left hand lifts and sweeps left into a curl, followed by the right hand climbing toward the right and folding over a bend of the left knee. Both arms extend down and open as the left knee releases, then the hands climb with the left elbow drawing in, before the right arm reaches left and curls upward and the left arm drops and extends. Both hands sweep right as the right knee bends and straightens, then lower with the elbows tucked before rising again; the right hand reverses left and both descend, opening as the left knee sinks and straightens. The right hand curls up to the right over another knee bend, then reaches left and lowers as the left leg lengthens and the right knee softening, while the left hand rises right.

As the right arm curls upward, the dancer straightens the right knee and carries the right hand right with a lengthening elbow. The left hand follows right while the raised right arm opens farther, then both hands sweep left as the right arm rises and folds and the left hand returns right with a tuck. Both arms draw inward again, the left hand lowering before lifting back to the right as the right arm drops; the left knee softens while the left arm extends down and left. The left knee straightens as the right arm curls up and right and the left arm reaches higher, then both elbows fold and the hands descend. The right hand sweeps left and rises into another curl, accompanied by the left arm's upward reach; the knees exchange a bend and release as the right hand returns right and the left knee straightens.

The right knee straightens as the dancer lengthens the right arm and lowers the right hand left, then bends the right knee while the left hand drops right. The right leg releases as both hands rise, the right arm opening into a leftward sweep and the left arm reaching right before descending. Both arms fold and lower, with the left hand continuing down and outward; the right elbow opens again as the left knee straightens. The right hand curls upward to the right while the left hand rises left, then drops left into a tighter fold as the left arm extends downward. The right arm opens farther left, then folds back up toward the right as the left hand lifts and both elbows tuck.

The dancer raises the right hand. The left arm curls upward and right as the right knee bends, then both hands descend with lengthening arms; the right hand moves left while the left hand continues right and tucks higher, before both elbows open and the left knee straightens. Both knees soften as the hands rise, then the left knee bends again and the left arm folds left while the right arm curls up-right. The right knee extends beneath a rightward opening of the right arm, followed by the left knee sinking as the left arm reaches down-left and the right hand drops. That lower hand lifts and sweeps right into a fold as the left knee releases, then returns left and down while the right hand rises rightward. The left knee bends once more as the right arm opens downward and the right knee softens, finishing with the right hand moving right and the right knee releasing.

At the outset, the dancer sends the right hand right with a curled elbow while the left hand moves left, then both hands sweep left as the right arm extends. The hands reverse right and descend, the right arm lengthening farther before curling upward again. The left hand follows up and right into a tighter fold as the right arm continues rising and opens out. Both arms extend downward, then lift together with another bend of the right elbow. The right hand drops once more while the left hand rises and tucks, the right arm moving left and folding in.

As both hands descend and sweep left, the dancer lengthens the right arm and lowers the right hand farther before the left hand rises and curls inward. The right hand lifts right while the left hand continues upward and moves right, then folds back left as the left knee straightens. Both hands climb again, the left arm extending while the right arm curls left; the hands separate sideways, with the left hand descending and the right hand lifting farther. The left hand sweeps left and climbs into a tuck as the right hand reaches right, then reverses right with an unfolding elbow while the right arm opens downward. The right arm gathers upward and returns left as the right knee softens and the left knee bends, then lengthens again.

The left hand drops leftward as the right hand travels right and rises into a curl, then both hands lift with the left arm folding before it opens. The left hand descends as the right knee bends, then rises again while the right knee straightens; both hands sweep left, the right elbow tucking as the right knee softens once more. Both arms lengthen downward as the left knee bends and releases, then the right hand moves right while the left hand rises leftward and folds in. The right knee extends as the right hand curls upward, followed by the left hand lifting and tucking through a right-left-right reversal. Both hands climb, the right arm opening as the right knee bends, while the left knee sinks deeper and the right hand continues right.

The dancer lifts the right hand upward. The right arm folds as the left knee bends, then opens while both hands sweep left and the left arm lengthens downward. The right hand continues left and down before both elbows curl inward, with the right arm reaching farther in. Both arms open, the left hand rising while the right hand sweeps right and descends, then returns left as the left hand lowers and extends. The right arm reaches upward again while the left knee softens, then the right hand drops and the left knee straightens as the left arm curls up to the left.

A side-to-side arm exchange begins as the dancer sends the right hand right and lifts the left hand upward, then reverses their lateral paths with both hands descending. The left hand swings left and back right while the right hand rises leftward; both arms curl upward before the right hand drops right and opens. The left hand reaches up-left, folds downward, then lengthens as the right hand moves left and curls higher. The right hand returns right while the left arm extends farther down-right and sweeps left, ending with both elbows tucked.

The right hand reaches right. The dancer lifts the left hand toward the right, then both hands descend and reverse left as the right arm lengthens. Both arms curl upward and sweep right with the right hand leading higher. They lower together, opening as the left hand continues right. The right arm curls up again while the left extends downward.

As the right arm folds, the dancer lowers and extends it while the left hand climbs right, then sends the left arm left and down into a curl. The right hand reaches left before returning right as the left arm opens downward; both arms lengthen and the hands rise, with the right arm folding back left. The right arm releases again while the left elbow tucks, and the left hand drops through an inward-and-outward reach as the right hand moves right and both elbows open. Both hands sweep left, the left arm curling upward before extending right and dropping while the right arm rises. The left hand continues right, then falls left as the right arm curls higher.

To begin, the dancer folds the right arm and raises the right hand while the left knee straightens; the right hand climbs farther as the right knee softens. The right arm extends left and descends before both hands sweep left and the left knee bends more deeply. The left knee releases as the right hand rises and the left elbow tucks, then the hands separate right and left with another bend of the right knee. The hands reverse sideways as the right knee straightens, followed by a deeper bend and release of the left knee while the hands continue moving apart. The right knee softens again as the left arm curls upward to the right and the right hand lowers, then both knees lengthen while the right hand lifts right and the left hand returns left.

As the right arm curls upward and the left arm reaches right, the dancer sweeps both hands left and lowers them. The right hand swings right then back left while the left knee softens and the left hand lifts right; the right knee bends as the left hand drops left and the left knee straightens. The right arm lengthens downward while the left hand climbs, then the right hand reverses right and rises with a tucked elbow. The left arm folds left, extends down and right, and tucks again as the right knee releases and the left knee bends. Both hands move right with the left arm curling upward, then return left with the right arm reaching out.

The right hand rises with a folding elbow. The dancer lowers the right hand and straightens the right knee as the left arm curls upward, then extends the left arm downward while the right knee softens and both hands sweep right. The right hand drops left into a deeper fold as the right knee bends further and the left arm tucks higher; the left knee sinks before both knees release and the right hand lifts leftward over another bend of the right knee. The left arm reaches down-right and folds back up-left while the right hand moves right and lowers, then the left hand sweeps down-right as the right knee straightens. Both hands rise with tucked elbows, the right hand continuing left while the left hand shifts right; the right knee lengthens further as the hands descend and the left arm opens. The left hand returns left and curls upward while the right arm extends down-right, and the right knee bends again.

As the right hand moves left and the left hand moves right, both arms curl upward. Then the right arm opens down while the left hand returns left and drops. The right arm extends farther before both hands rise, the left hand sweeping right as the right knee bends and the left arm folds downward. Both knees soften in succession beneath a shared leftward reach, then straighten as the right arm curls higher; the right knee bends again and releases while the raised left arm lengthens and both hands climb. The left arm folds through a rightward sweep and a leftward return, with the right arm tucking as the right knee softens, before both hands descend and open. The hands separate right and left as the right leg straightens, then the left arm curls upward and swings right while the right arm rises and falls; the right knee extends once more as the left hand lowers.

In opposition, the dancer curls the right arm up and right while the left hand sweeps left, then extends the right arm down-left as the left knee straightens. The left hand reverses right while the left knee bends, and both hands rise before the left arm folds leftward over a deeper bend of the left knee. The right hand continues right and down with an opening elbow as the left knee releases, while the right knee softens again and the right hand moves right. Both knees lengthen beneath another upward curl of the right arm, which then reaches left and down as the left hand rises and the left knee bends. The hands exchange height and sweep left, the left hand rising as the right knee softens; they separate right and left before the left hand drops and both arms open. The right knee releases as the hands reverse sideways again, and both knees bend in succession while the elbows tuck inward.

As the right hand rises, the dancer sends it right with a lengthening arm and opens both knees in succession. The right hand drops while the left knee bends and releases, then sweeps left as the right knee softens again; the right hand lifts toward the right and curls inward before lowering and returning left as the right knee sinks once more. Both arms fold as the hands descend, then sweep right and rise into extensions, the right arm bending back down and left while the left hand reverses left and its knee deepens. The right arm reaches farther left and upward, then lowers and tucks as the left hand continues left and rises. Both knees bend in succession beneath another lift of the right hand, which extends right as the left arm folds and lowers; the knees straighten together, and the left hand moves left while the right arm tightens. The bent leg lengthens and its hand drops as the opposite knee softens, then both hands sweep left and the hands reverse right before their heights diverge and the knee beneath the higher hand straightens.

The right knee softens beneath the right arm that curls up-right, then the right arm lowers and opens as the left hand rises right. The right arm folds again while the left knee straightens, bends, and releases; the right hand drops left and lengthens before both hands sweep right. Both arms tuck as the left knee extends further, then the left hand returns left and the left knee straightens while the right elbow opens. The right hand lifts right as the right knee softens, then both hands descend with the right elbow extending and the left arm curling back up-left. The left hand reverses right as the right knee straightens and the left knee bends, followed by a low return to the left.

The right knee softens as the dancer folds the left arm and lifts the left hand left, then lowers the left hand while the left arm releases. The right arm extends downward, curls upward to the right, and opens again as both hands rise with another bend of the right knee. Both hands sweep left, the right arm curling up before dropping and unfolding; the left hand climbs and falls into a tuck as the right knee straightens and the left knee softens. The tucked left hand moves right and down while the right hand sweeps left and rises into a fold over a deeper left knee bend. The lower left hand continues right and lifts as the right arm lengthens downward, then the lifted left hand returns left and descends with the right arm opening.

The right hand sweeps left. The left arm reaches up and right, then drops while the right hand climbs and curls in; both hands rise as the left knee straightens and the left arm folds into a rightward sweep. The left arm opens back left as the left knee bends, then returns right with a deeper curl while the right knee softens and the right hand lifts. The right knee extends and releases as the left hand travels left, both arms lengthening before the right hand lowers and both sweep right, the left arm folding. The left arm opens upward and returns left as the right hand climbs right, the right knee bending before both hands descend and the right arm tucks.

In opposition, the dancer lowers the right hand while lifting the left hand, then sends the right arm left and down as both elbows fold. The hands sweep right together before the left hand drops, its arm extending. The left hand continues down and left while the right knee bends, then the right arm curls upward and carries the right hand right. Both arms lengthen as the left hand climbs farther and the right arm sweeps right.

The right knee softens as the left hand lowers and the right arm folds, then the right knee straightens while both hands sweep left, the left arm opening and the right arm curling upward. The right arm extends right as the right knee bends, then returns left while the right knee releases; the left hand rises left with a folding elbow before both arms lengthen downward. The hands separate left and right, the left arm lifting into a tuck as the right knee straightens, then both elbows draw inward as the left hand reverses right and the right hand moves left. Both knees soften as the right arm opens, the left hand continues left and both arms rise before their hands reverse sideways. The hands descend together, then the right hand swings left and curls upward while the left knee bends further and the left hand lifts right. The left leg straightens as the left hand drops and opens, then the right knee softens again while the right hand climbs left with a tucked elbow and the right knee releases.

The dancer sends the right hand left and the left hand right. Both arms lengthen, then fold as the hands exchange lateral directions; the right arm reaches down and right while the left arm lowers and opens. The right arm curls upward, drops, and extends again as the left arm folds up and left, then both hands sweep right with the left elbow opening before the right arm tucks upward and both hands return left. The right hand dips right and rises into a curl as the left knee straightens, then reverses left and down while the left knee softens; the left hand climbs left and opens as the right knee bends, followed by a lift of the left hand over a deeper bend and release of the right knee. The right knee straightens as the right hand drops, then both knees bend in succession while the hands rise and the left arm folds; the right hand sweeps left and down as the left arm opens and the left knee releases. The right leg straightens further while the right arm curls upward and the left hand follows up and right.

To begin, the dancer lowers the right hand into an opening arm and sends both hands right. The left arm curls upward as the right hand lifts left, then extends down while the left arm folds higher. Both arms tuck as the left arm reaches right and drops, joined by the right hand's downward sweep; they reverse inward and rise before the right hand opens down-left and the left arm curls back up-right. The left hand continues right with a tighter fold, then drops and lengthens as the right hand moves left and its elbow releases. The right arm curls up-right while the left hand reaches farther right, then both return left, the right hand rising into a deeper fold as the left hand lowers.

In opposition, the dancer lifts the left hand left and the right hand right before reversing them, folding both elbows as the right knee bends. The hands separate again, the left arm extending farther left while the right arm reaches down and right; the right knee straightens as the right hand rises and curls inward. Both arms open downward, then the left hand swings right and returns left as the left knee softens and the right arm folds upward and left over a bend of the left knee. The left hand descends while the right hand continues rising, then both sweep left as the right arm lengthens and the left elbow tucks, ending with the left hand moving right and the right hand climbing.

The right knee softens as the dancer sends the right hand left and down, then curls it upward while the left arm folds. That raised right hand swings right and drops as the right knee straightens, followed by the left hand sinking leftward. The right knee bends again as the right hand moves right and climbs, with the left arm opening upward; both hands descend, the right hand moving left before rising into a fold as the right knee releases. The left hand reaches up and right while the right hand sweeps right and lowers, then both return left with bent elbows and the left hand drops. The right arm opens as the left arm curls higher, then both lift with the left elbow extending before the right hand sweeps right and both lower. The left arm folds once more and carries the left hand right while the right hand rises, ending with an extension of the bent arm.

The dancer lowers and extends the right arm. The left hand rises as both knees soften, then the left hand sweeps right while the right elbow folds and the right knee straightens. The raised left arm curls higher and left over a deeper bend of the right knee, then returns right as the right knee releases and the left knee softens; both arms tuck upward before the right hand reverses right and drops with an opening elbow. The left arm reaches down and left while the right knee bends farther, then both hands rise as the right leg lengthens and the left arm folds. Both arms extend downward, sweep left, and curl upward again as the right knee sinks farther. The right knee straightens while the left arm opens and the right hand drops, then both elbows fold as the left hand moves right and the right knee releases further.

A rightward hand sweep begins with the left arm folding and both hands lowering, then rising as the right knee straightens; the right arm extends left while the left arm curls down-right and the right knee softens. Both arms lengthen downward, then the right hand rises right against the left hand's leftward reach as the left knee straightens. The right arm opens into a descending left-right sweep while the left arm curls up-left, the left knee bending again before releasing. Both elbows tuck as the hands climb and the right knee bends, then the hands shift right and the right arm reaches upward. The left hand follows up-right with an extending elbow, then both lower and swing left as their knees soften. The left arm curls upward while the right knee straightens and the right hand continues left.

The right knee softens as the dancer sends the right hand right and the left hand left, then raises both hands into bent elbows. The hands reverse sideways, the left arm lengthening before curling down-right while the right arm drops and folds leftward. The right knee bends farther as the right elbow opens, then straightens while the right hand rises with a tucking elbow. Both arms lengthen downward, the right knee softening again beneath the right hand's leftward sweep and another fold of the right elbow; the left knee bends as the left hand moves right. The right knee extends while the right hand continues left, curls upward, and returns right as the left arm draws in, with the left knee straightening before bending once more.

To begin, the dancer sends the left hand left and down with an opening elbow while the right arm curls upward. The hands exchange height as the right hand drops, then both sweep right and rise into folded arms before reversing left, with the left hand sinking and the right hand continuing upward. Both hands descend, the right hand moving right before returning left; the left hand follows left as the right knee bends and releases, then both arms lengthen downward. The left hand swings right and back left through a rising curl, followed by the right hand lifting right with a bent elbow and returning left and down as the left knee softens. The left hand lowers and extends farther left, then lifts with another right knee bend while the right hand reaches up-right and folds back left. The left hand returns right as the right arm opens downward, ending with the left knee straightening and the right knee bending again.

The right hand sweeps left and up. The dancer lowers the left hand, then sends it right as both hands rise and sweep right with the left arm folding; the right arm curls upward before both hands descend, the left continuing right. Both arms lengthen as the right hand returns left and the left rises, then the right elbow bends while the raised left hand moves right and drops with its arm extended. The right hand climbs right into a tuck while the left lowers farther right and opens, followed by another lift of the right hand. The right hand reaches down and left as the left arm folds upward, then they trade height twice: the right hand lifts and drops while the left hand climbs and falls, before the right hand rises again.

The dancer lengthens the right arm downward. The left hand rises while the right hand sweeps left and up, then both hands descend as the right knee bends and the right arm opens; the left knee softens before the left arm curls upward and the right elbow folds. Both hands continue down and right with extending arms as the knees straighten, then rise again, the right arm curling before the left hand drops and the left elbow opens. The right arm reaches farther right while the left arm extends left and the left hand lifts, followed by a fold of the left arm and another reach on the rightward side. The hands reverse their sideways sweep, the right arm opening as the left hand lowers, before both return right and the left arm tucks.

The dancer folds the right arm inward. The right hand rises and moves right as the left knee straightens, then returns left while the left arm curls upward; both hands climb before the right hand drops and lengthens as the left knee softens. Both arms open downward, the left hand sweeping left as the left knee extends, then the left hand lifts back right with a bent elbow while the right knee bends again. The left hand continues rising and moving right as the right knee releases and the right arm reaches down and left, folding back up over another right knee bend. The right arm opens farther left while the left hand climbs into a tighter curl, then both descend as the right elbow tucks and the left hand swings left.

The dancer begins an alternating arm sweep by sending the right hand left, folding the right arm, and lifting both hands. Then, the dancer lowers both hands while extending the left arm. The right hand rises with a curling elbow and drops back down as the left knee bends. Then, the right hand reverses right and curls upward while the right knee softens. The right hand travels left and climbs again as the left arm lengthens, then returns right into a fold before descending over a straightening left leg. The left arm reaches left as the right hand rises with an opening elbow and the right knee bends, followed by the left hand lifting and curling inward. Both hands shift left, the left arm tucking farther while the right arm extends; the left arm then opens as the right hand lowers and the right knee straightens.

The right hand rises right. The dancer curls the left arm upward and left, then extends it down as the right arm lengthens downward; the right hand reverses right and folds upward while the left knee softens and straightens beneath the descending right hand. Both arms open into a rising reach, the left hand moving left as the right knee bends and the right hand drops; the right arm tucks down-left before both hands sweep right and lift with another bend of the right knee. Both elbows draw inward as the knees straighten and the right hand lowers, then the hands reverse left and rise with extending arms before the right hand returns right and both elbows fold again. The right hand continues right and up as the left knee straightens and the left elbow releases downward, then the right knee bends and extends as both hands descend and the left knee softens. The right hand reaches right and rises as the left arm opens, then curls left while the left knee bends further; the right hand drops and sweeps right with an unfolding elbow as the bent left knee straightens.

The dancer lowers the left hand. The right arm folds and lifts as the left hand moves left, then both elbows open before the right hand drops right and curls upward again while the left arm lengthens farther left. Both hands rise, the right arm folding, then descend with the right hand sweeping left and the left hand continuing down-right as the right elbow releases. The left hand sweeps left and returns right, curling upward while the right hand rises rightward, then opens and falls left; the right arm tucks through a shared leftward sweep before extending back right. Both arms lengthen downward, then the right hand reverses left and climbs while the left arm continues down-left, and the right arm folds into a final lift to the right.

The dancer lifts and lowers the right hand in succession. The right arm lengthens downward while the left arm curls upward, then the right arm reverses up and right as both knees soften and the left knee straightens before bending again. The right hand sweeps left and down as the left knee releases and the right knee extends, then rises with a bend of the left knee while the left arm opens right and the left knee straightens. Both arms fold as the right hand drops and moves left; the left hand lifts through a leftward sweep, then descends as the hands exchange height and the right arm extends. The right knee bends farther while the left knee softens and the left arm lengthens into a rightward lift, ending with the right arm reaching higher and the right knee straightening.

The dancer moves leftward and down, carrying the left hand while the right arm lengthens and the right knee softens; the descending left arm opens, then curls as the right knee straightens. The hands separate left and right with a bend of the left knee, then reverse sideways as both arms fold and the knees exchange their bend and extension. Both knees sink in succession beneath another lateral reversal and lowering of the hands, then straighten as the arms open and rise together. Another bend-and-release exchange of the knees accompanies a rightward sweep of the left hand and an opening of the left arm, followed by a downward reach of the right hand and a shared leftward return. The right hand lifts as the right knee bends and releases, then falls alongside the left hand while the left knee sinks again and the right knee straightens; both hands move right before the right arm curls upward and the left hand lowers with a bent elbow.

In opposition, the dancer sends the right hand right and the left hand left, then folds both arms as the left hand reverses right. The right arm lengthens upward while the left arm drops into a deeper curl, before the hands trade height again and the right hand returns left with a tighter tuck. Both hands descend as the elbows open, then the right hand sweeps right and curls upward against the left hand's continuing drop. The left arm extends down and left while the right knee straightens, followed by the right hand lowering and reaching right as the left knee also lengthens. The right hand lifts right and folds back left while the left hand rises, then both knees soften in succession as the right hand lowers and the left hand moves right.

The right hand drops. The dancer lengthens the left arm and raises the left hand while the right hand moves right, then sweeps both hands left as the left elbow folds. Both arms extend farther apart, the left hand dropping before returning right with a bend of the left arm. The left hand curls upward and left while the right hand lifts, then lowers as the left arm opens and the left knee straightens. The right hand rises again and swings right with a bent elbow while the left hand dips and climbs, ending with a tighter fold on the left side.

To begin, the dancer lowers the right hand rightward as the right knee bends and straightens, while the left arm curls up-left; the right knee then softens again beneath a rising leftward reach. The left hand sweeps down-right and back up-left as both knees lengthen, followed by an opening of the right arm toward the right and a further extension of the right knee. Both arms fold and carry their hands upward and left, with the right knee bending before both hands descend into extended reaches. The hands separate sideways and rise again, the right arm curling through a right-to-left reversal as the right knee softens and the left knee straightens, then opens and returns right with another bend of the right knee. The right knee releases as the hands climb together and the right elbow tucks; both knees lengthening, the right hand continues right while the left hand drops and moves right.

The right knee straightens as the dancer lifts the left hand left and folds the left arm, then raises the right hand into a curl before both hands sweep right. The left arm reaches upward as the right knee bends and releases, while the left knee softens and straightens beneath a rising right elbow; both hands descend with the left arm lengthening as the right knee bends again. The left hand curls up and left while the right hand drops, the right knee straightening and bending once more before the right hand rises with an extending arm. Both hands climb, the left hand moving right, then lower as the right hand swings left and back right with a bent elbow. The left arm tucks left and rises over a softened right knee as the right hand moves right, then the left arm opens downward while the right hand lifts and returns left.

To begin, the dancer folds both arms and lifts the hands, carrying them right with the right knee straightening then bending as the left hand lowers. The left arm extends left while the right arm continues upward and right; the left knee bends farther before the hands exchange height and reverse sideways, the right hand dropping as the right knee softens again. Both knees straighten as the hands rise and separate left and right, then lower with a bend in the left knee and a tuck of the left arm. The right hand reverses right while the left arm opens downward, and the left knee straightens as both hands lift with the right arm curling inward. The right knee bends beneath another shared descent, then lengthens as the right hand reaches right and both hands rise, the left arm folding before extending down-left over a bend in the left knee. The right arm curls up-right as the right knee straightens and the left hand moves right, then both arms unfold into a final lift.

The right knee bends as the left hand rises, curls left, and drops while the right arm folds upward. The left hand travels right with a deeper elbow tuck as the right arm opens down-right, then both arms lengthen before the right arm returns up-left. Both hands descend as the right knee straightens and the left hand moves right; the right arm curls upward and sweeps left into an extension while the left arm reaches higher. The right knee softens as the right hand continues down-right and the left hand rises, then straightens again beneath another lift of the right hand. Both arms fold downward, the left hand traveling right as the right knee extends further and the right arm opens; the hands climb together with the left elbow tucked before descending in succession.

The right arm lowers while the left arm rises and folds left as the right knee straightens; the right arm then lifts right with a bent elbow. The right hand reverses left while the left hand climbs and sweeps left, the knees softening in succession before the right hand drops and the left arm reaches up-right over a lengthening knee. The hands separate left and right as the left knee bends and releases beneath another rising curl, then both arms unfold and the right hand sweeps left and down. Both elbows tuck as the left hand continues left, then the right hand rises right while the left hand descends and extends right. The right arm curls upward again as the left arm folds, opens into a lift, and returns left and down while the right hand moves right.

The right hand drops and sweeps right. The dancer softens the right knee beneath that arm, then straightens it while the left arm extends down and left. The left arm folds as the right knee bends, and the right hand rises before both arms lengthen downward. The right hand returns right as the left hand moves left and the left knee straightens, then both hands lift with the right elbow curling inward.

The dancer lengthens the right arm downward. The right hand reaches right as the left arm rises, then both arms lower and separate left and right, the left arm curling inward before both hands lift. The left arm opens toward the left while the right hand moves right and drops into a fold; both arms tuck again as the hands rise and reverse their sideways directions. Both hands descend with opening elbows, then the right arm sweeps right as the left arm curls upward and returns down and left. The right arm folds through a leftward reach and a shared lift, then lowers into an extension before rising again as the left hand travels right and descends.

To begin, the dancer lowers and lengthens the right arm as the left hand rises left, then lifts the right hand right into a fold while the left arm extends down.
