The right arm opens downward as the left knee bends and releases, and both hands sweep left with the left arm curling upward; the right knee softens as the left hand returns right and drops with an extended arm, then both arms tuck and rise before the left hand shifts left and the right follows. Both knees bend beneath a shared descent of the hands, then straighten as the hands climb and separate left and right, the right arm folding and opening through its dip and lift. The left arm curls upward while the right continues left and down, then reaches higher as the left sweeps right and descends into a tighter fold. The hands exchange sideways directions, the left lifting and returning left as the right lowers, and they reverse again, with the right rising while the left sinks farther left.

The arms trade height: the right hand rises while the left hand lowers, then the right arm folds and both hands sweep right as the left arm lengthens. The left knee softens and straightens beneath a curling lift of the left hand, which travels left and down into an extended reach before both hands descend and reverse right with folded elbows. The left knee bends again as the left arm extends upward, then both hands rise and sweep left, the left elbow tucking while the left knee straightens and the right hand returns right. Both hands climb farther, the right arm curling as the left arm opens, before the left arm lowers and lengthens while the right arm reaches left. The left arm curls up to the right as the left knee bends and straightens, then the right hand drops and folds leftward while the left arm extends farther right.

At the outset, the right hand sweeps left and rises as the left knee straightens, then both hands descend and reverse right with a folding elbow. The left arm curls upward before both hands lift and the elbows open; the right hand moves left while the left hand drops and the left knee bends. The left knee straightens as the left hand reaches right and down, then both knees soften beneath a shared leftward reach and the arms lengthen downward. Both hands return right, the right arm curling upward as the right knee straightens and the left knee folds, before both hands sweep left and the left arm reverses right into an extension. The right hand lifts right while the left knee bends and releases beneath its descending, tucked hand; the right arm extends left and drops as the right knee softens, and both hands move left with another bend of the left knee.

To begin, the dancer lowers the right hand while extending the left arm left and down, then curls both arms upward as the right knee softens. The hands separate right and left, the left elbow opening and folding again before both arms lengthen downward. The right hand rises leftward and returns right with a tighter fold, then both hands descend as the right knee bends deeper; the left arm extends right while the right arm reaches farther right and both elbows open. The right knee straightens as the left hand drops and the right arm curls up-left, then both arms unfold into a shared descent. The right arm tucks and releases upward while the left hand swings left and back right, curling inward as the right knee softens and both hands rise before descending again. Both elbows lengthen once more as the right hand moves left and the right knee straightens.

The knees soften in succession as the dancer lengthens the right arm right, then curls it upward while the left hand moves left. The right arm opens down and sweeps left before both hands rise, the left arm folding and releasing. Both arms tuck and lower toward the right, then sweep left with renewed lengthening. The hands return right and climb, the right arm curling as the left knee bends and straightens; the left knee softens again while the right arm reaches higher and farther right. The left knee bends once more as the left hand rises and extends, then the hands reverse left with both elbows drawing inward.

The dancer extends both arms downward. The right hand moves left while the left hand curls upward, then the left arm opens and drops as the right arm folds higher; both hands sweep right, the left elbow tucking before the right hand rises and returns left. The hands separate left and right, the right hand lowering with a bent elbow while the left hand lifts, reaches farther right, and drops into an extension. Both hands climb, then the left hand moves left and down as the right hand curls and lowers; the left hand reverses right while the right hand sweeps left and up. The left arm lengthens leftward as the right hand climbs, then the hands exchange sideways directions, the left hand rising while the right hand drops.

A leftward arm sweep begins as the dancer curls the left hand up and right, then releases it down and back left while the right hand lowers into a fold. The left hand rises as the left knee bends and the right knee straightens, then both hands lift, the right hand moving right before returning left and dropping with an opening elbow. The left arm tucks as the left knee softens further, then the hands separate sideways, the left hand rising while the right hand moves right and lifts; the left knee straightens as both elbows draw inward. The right hand drops into another fold while the left hand continues right and climbs, then both lower and the left hand reaches left as the left knee lengthens farther. The right arm extends upward and returns left, followed by the left hand reaching up and right; the right hand rises again as the left hand folds downward and reverses left. The right elbow opens and closes once more while the left hand travels left and down.

The right hand sweeps left and upward. The left hand follows that direction as both arms lengthen, then the right arm curls right before dropping with an opening elbow. Both hands lower, the left hand sweeping left while the right hand continues right, and the right knee straightens as the right hand reverses left. The left hand moves right as the right hand lifts, then both rise with bent elbows before the right hand dips and extends down. The left arm folds upward to the right while the right arm reaches farther right and climbs, ending with the raised hand lowering into a curl.

A side-to-side hand exchange begins with the right hand moving right and the left hand moving left as both arms lengthen. The right arm folds while the left arm curls upward, then both hands sweep right before the right hand drops into an extension and the left hand returns left. Both elbows tuck as the right hand rises, then the hands separate left and right with the right arm opening and the left arm folding. The right elbow bends and releases again as the right hand climbs, while the left hand lowers; both hands move left and curl inward before the right hand descends and the left hand rises. The left hand sweeps right and back left as the right hand continues upward, and the right arm reaches farther down while the left arm extends rightward.

At the outset, the dancer lowers the right hand while the left arm folds upward, then both hands sweep right and the right arm curls up as the right knee straightens. The left arm extends down-left over a bend in the right knee, while the left knee softens and the right hand travels left. Both arms gather upward and the knees straighten before the hands separate sideways, the right hand returning right as the left arm opens and drops; the left hand rises again while the right elbow tucks. The left hand sweeps left and descends with an extending elbow as the right knee bends and the right hand lifts into a fold, then the left arm curls upward. The left knee lengthens as the left hand returns right and down, joined by the right hand's downward extension; the left arm reaches left while the right hand moves right and curls back left.

The right knee bends and releases as the dancer lowers and curls the right hand right, then sends both hands down and apart. The left hand moves left while the right leg straightens and the right arm reaches up-right; the left arm opens downward. The right hand continues upward as the left arm folds and rises, then returns left with an extending elbow while the left hand drops. Both arms lengthen farther, the hands separating left and right before they descend together. The left hand sweeps right as the right hand moves left and rises, ending with a fold of the right arm.

The dancer lifts the right hand. The left hand rises as the left arm folds, then both hands sweep right with the left arm opening before the left hand lowers and both elbows tuck. The right hand returns left while the left hand drops farther; both knees soften in succession, then straighten as the left hand rises. The hands separate left and right with the right arm lengthening downward, then reverse sideways as both arms curl upward. The right knee bends and releases while the left hand sweeps left and down, followed by a bend of the left knee as the right hand continues left and the bent leg straightens again.

To begin, the dancer lowers the right hand while the right knee softens, then lifts the right hand and extends both arms as the left knee bends and straightens; the right knee releases before the hands rise again. The right arm curls down to the right as the left hand drops and the left knee sinks, then rebounds left into a tighter fold while the right knee straightens. The right knee bends and releases beneath a rising, lengthening left arm, which dips as the right arm also lowers, before curling upward. The right knee deepens as both hands sweep right and climb, then opens while the right arm folds higher and the right knee straightens; both hands descend, the left arm extending downward as the left knee softens. Both hands rise again, the right hand moving right before the left hand sweeps left and both lower.

The arms move in opposition: the right hand rises while the left arm lengthens down, then both descend as the right hand sweeps left and back right. The left knee bends as the right hand curls upward and the left hand moves right; the left knee straightens while both hands drop and the right arm opens. Both knees soften again as the left hand lifts and reaches right, then the right hand follows right and both elbows fold before the hands lower and the knees release. The right hand climbs while the left arm extends down and left, then both rise with bent elbows before the left hand drops and both knees bend again. The left hand returns right into a curl as the left knee straightens, then both hands sweep left and lower, the right elbow opening as the left knee softens once more.

The right knee straightens as the dancer curls both hands upward, then opens them into a leftward sweep and lowers them. The left hand reverses right while the right arm folds and lifts again, followed by the left hand rising and curling. Both arms lengthen downward before the right hand sweeps right and rises with its elbow tucked, then reverses left as the left hand drops and moves right. The right hand climbs farther left while the left hand extends down to the left, and both elbows open. The right arm reaches right and folds back inward as the left hand lifts and returns right.

The right hand rises as the dancer curls the right arm and carries it right, while the left hand lifts left. The right hand returns down to the left and lengthens as the left hand drops; both hands then reverse sideways, with the left arm tucking inward. The hands climb together, the right hand moving right and the left hand continuing left before both descend. The right arm folds again as the right knee softens, while the left hand moves left and lowers into a deeper curl. The left curled hand swings right and up, opens, then drops and reverses left as the right arm reaches upward and right.

To begin, the dancer extends the right arm right and raises it while the left hand moves left; both elbows fold as the hands rise and separate horizontally. The right hand drops and travels left with a deeper curl, while the left hand opens downward before both arms tuck again and the right hand returns right. The left hand rises into a bend as the right hand lowers, then the left hand sweeps left and down while the right hand curls higher and releases left. The left arm gathers upward to the right, then lengthens back left and down. Both hands descend, the left elbow opening as the right hand curls upward, before the right hand reaches farther up and left.

The right hand sweeps left and down. The left hand rises, then the right arm reaches right as the right knee straightens and the left hand returns left and up. Both arms curl upward, the right hand reversing right before extending down as the right knee softens. The right hand lifts into a fold while the left arm tucks left, then both hands descend and open as the right knee lengthens. The left hand continues left and drops while the right hand travels right, then both lift with tucked elbows as the right knee bends again.

The right knee straightens as the dancer lengthens the right arm downward, then folds it back up and left while the left hand rises right. The right hand sweeps down-right and curls upward again, followed by the left arm reaching up-left before both hands descend into open elbows. Both arms lift with bent elbows and sweep left, then the right hand drops as the right knee softens and the left hand lowers right; the knees straighten in succession while the left hand climbs and extends farther right. The left hand reverses left with a tucked elbow as the right arm reaches up-left, then both sweep right before the right hand lowers and the left hand lifts left into a fold over a softened right knee. The right knee bends again beneath an upward reach, and both hands return left as the left arm opens and the left knee straightens.

The right knee straightens as the left hand moves left and rises into a curl. The right arm folds downward, then both hands sweep right while the right arm opens and the right knee bends. The left arm lengthens down-left as the right knee straightens and softens again, followed by a deeper bend of the right knee and another extension of the left arm. The right knee continues to lengthen as the left arm curls upward and sweeps right, then opens back down-left while the right hand drops. The dancer lifts the left-moving hand once more, drawing it inward.

An alternating arm sweep begins with the dancer lifting the right hand right while the left hand reaches left and down, then lowering the right hand as the right knee straightens. Both hands return right before the right arm curls upward, followed by the left arm folding up and left as the right knee bends again. The hands separate right and left, both elbows drawing inward, then reverse sideways and descend as the right knee releases and the hands continue apart. Another exchange of directions unfolds with both arms opening, the right hand returning right while the left elbow folds; the right knee softens as both hands lower and the arms lengthen, ending with a leftward reach from the left hand and a renewed rightward lift from the right arm.

The right knee softens as the dancer lowers the right hand, then straightens while the left arm extends down and left. The right arm lengthens farther down and right before both hands rise with the elbows folding inward. Both hands sweep left, then descend with opening elbows and return right as the right knee bends and the left arm tucks more deeply. The right knee releases while the left arm reaches farther right and upward, then reverses left as the right hand continues climbing.

Upward, the dancer raises both hands with folding arms. The right arm releases down while the left arm reaches farther upward and right, then the left arm curls back down and left as the right hand rises and tucks. The right hand lowers into an extension while the left arm continues left and climbs, before both arms gather inward. Both hands sweep right and rise, then separate left and right with the left arm opening. The hands descend as the left arm lengthens farther left and the right arm folds; the left knee straightens and the left arm reaches up again.

The right knee softens as the dancer curls the right arm upward and left, then straightens the right knee while the left hand rises right. The right arm extends down-left as the left knee bends, then both hands sweep right before the left hand returns left into a fold and the left knee releases. The right arm reaches up-right as the right knee lengthens further; the left hand follows right with an opening elbow before both arms tuck and the left hand drops. Both hands reverse left, the right arm extending upward and folding again while the left knee softens. The left knee straightens as the right hand moves right and lowers, then the left hand dips right and curls upward. The left hand lifts left as the right arm opens downward, followed by another rise of the right hand.

The right knee softens as the dancer curls the right arm upward and right, then lowers it while the left hand travels left. The lowered right arm opens left, folds again, and rises into an extended reach as the left hand moves right. The rising right hand returns down-left and lengthens farther while the left hand drops left and tucks; the right knee straightens as the hands exchange directions and descend, with the newly reaching left arm opening. Both arms curl upward, the right hand sweeping left and the left hand right, before they release downward and reverse sideways. The right knee bends again as the right hand climbs right into a fold, while the left hand shifts left.

The right hand dips left and rises as the left hand climbs right, then the hands reverse their lateral paths and descend while the left arm curls and lengthens. The right hand sweeps up-left and folds back down-right, with the left hand following right before the right arm opens again. Both arms extend downward as the right knee bends, then the left hand reverses left and both lift into bent elbows while the right knee releases and the left leg straightens. The left hand returns right as the right hand drops, then both rise with the right arm lengthening farther; the left elbow tucks while the right arm lowers, opens and lifts again. The right hand moves right as the left hand extends, and the dancer sends the right hand down-left and farther down with a deeper fold before both hands sweep right.

An alternating arm figure begins with the right hand lifting left and the left hand curling upward, then both hands sweep right as the right hand lowers and the left hand drops left. The right arm folds while the left arm reaches left and down, followed by a leftward lift of the right arm and a rightward return of the left hand. Both hands descend, the right hand continuing right as its elbow opens, then it rises again. The left arm extends downward while the right hand moves left, before both arms fold and the left hand climbs. The left arm opens, then curls inward as the right hand rises and falls; the left arm lifts farther before releasing.

An alternating arm sweep begins with both hands moving right. The right arm curls as the left hand drops and reverses left. The right arm lowers and opens while the left knee bends and straightens beneath the right rising elbow. The left knee then bends again as the right leg lengthens and the right hand sweeps left. The left-moving arm folds downward while the right arm reaches up-right. The left hand rises before extending left and down as the left knee softens. Both knees bend in succession while the hands move right. The right knee releases as the left hand returns left and curls upward. The left knee straightens as both hands climb right. The right arm draws inward before the left hand drops and the right arm follows downward.

In opposition, the dancer extends the left arm left while the right arm reaches right and rises, then lowers the left hand as the right arm folds. The left hand moves right into a curl while the right arm opens downward, followed by the left hand lifting left as the right knee straightens. The left hand continues up-left and lengthens over a bending right knee, then both hands drop with the right arm folding and extending; the bent right leg releases as the left hand sweeps right and returns left. The left hand curls upward while the right knee softens and straightens again beneath a continuing lift of the right hand. Both arms open and the knees bend in succession before the right knee extends and the right arm tucks.

Downward, the dancer carries the right hand while the left hand rises, then lowers both hands as the right arm curls upward and opens down again. The left hand sweeps right and climbs, followed by the right hand moving left and rising into a fold; both descend before the left hand reaches left and the right hand returns right. Both arms curl upward and spread apart, then the right hand reverses left as the left hand drops and extends, followed by another lift and fall of the right hand. The left arm folds up and down twice while the right hand tucks higher and opens downward, then reaches left and rises into a bend as the left arm continues its descent. The right arm curls farther up and left while the left arm extends right, and the right hand dips before both rise, the right hand continuing left into a deeper fold.

In unison, both arms reach left and down. The dancer lengthens both elbows as the hands separate right and left, then folds both elbows upward while the right knee softens and straightens beneath the right hand. The right hand reverses left into a deeper curl as the right knee bends again, then returns right and unfolds while the left knee sinks; the left arm tucks farther before opening as the left knee releases. Both hands sweep left and rise, the left elbow folding and releasing as the left knee extends once more, then both arms draw inward with the right hand moving right and both knees softening together. The hands climb in succession, the left arm lengthening as both knees straighten, before the right hand drops and curls right over another bend of the right knee. The left hand lifts farther as the left knee sinks and the right arm reaches up-left, followed by a lift of the left hand over another release of the left knee.

As the right arm curls upward, the dancer raises and folds the left arm, then extends both arms apart to left and right before lowering them together. The right hand reverses left as both hands climb and the knees straighten in succession; the left knee bends while the left hand continues left and the left knee sinks further. The right hand dips and rebounds as the left arm opens downward and the left knee straightens, then both hands descend with the elbows tucked and the left knee deepening before it releases. Both arms lengthen upward as the left knee softens and the right knee straightens again, then the right hand reaches down and right while the left hand sweeps left and rises with a deeper bend of the left knee. The right arm tucks and lowers farther as the right knee bends, while the left hand swings right and back left and the left knee releases. The right arm reaches right as the right knee straightens and the left hand drops, then returns left while the left knee deepens and the left arm folds downward.

The arms work in opposition: the right hand sweeps left and curls upward while the left hand rises rightward, then the right hand drops left as the right knee straightens. The left arm reaches down-left and lengthens farther, while the right arm lifts right with an opening elbow and the left knee softens; both hands reverse right as the left knee bends. Both knees extend as the right arm folds downward, then the left hand dips left before rising right over a bending knee while the right arm curls up-left. The right knee lengthens as the right arm opens downward, then both knees sink while the left hand lowers left and the right arm moves right. Both elbows tuck as the hands sweep left, the left hand rising and the right hand descending before reversing right; the left arm opens upward over a straightening knee as the right arm curls higher and the right knee extends. The left hand falls rightward while the right hand continues rising rightward, the right knee bending again as the left arm unfolds.

The right hand reaches left. The left hand sweeps left and rises as the right arm folds, then the hands reverse right while the right arm opens and lowers; both elbows tuck as the left hand drops. Both hands continue down with bent arms before the right hand sweeps left and the left hand returns right, curling upward as the right arm lengthens. The left arm extends farther up and right while the right arm curls upward and left, then both descend into deeper folds. The right arm opens and lifts again as the left arm curls higher to the left and both elbows tighten.

To begin, the right arm folds while the left hand rises and moves left over a bending right knee; the right arm opens downward as the right knee straightens. The left hand drops and returns right with an opening elbow while the right hand curls up-right, then both sweep left into deeper bends before the left hand reverses right. The hands separate again, the right arm extending upward-left and the left arm folding down-left as the left knee softens. Both arms lengthen downward, the left hand continuing left before they reverse sideways and rise, the left hand returning right as both elbows tuck. They separate once more, the right hand moving right while the left hand sweeps left and lowers into a deeper fold. The left arm releases farther left, then returns right with another bend and release as the right hand continues right.

In unison, the arms lengthen and sweep right as one knee bends and straightens; the right arm curls upward before both hands descend into a leftward reach. The left hand rises while the right hand sweeps right, then both climb with folded elbows, the right hand reaching higher and farther right. Both arms extend downward and separate right and left, then curl upward again as the knees soften in succession. The right hand moves left while its knee straightens, followed by the left knee extending; both arms open downward and the right hand reverses right as that leg lengthens further. Both hands lift with bent elbows and move right, the right arm opening before lowering as the left arm curls back left. The left hand continues down and left while the right knee softens beneath a continuing leftward reach, then the right arm folds and both hands rise with the left arm tucked inward.

To begin, the dancer folds the right arm down-left and opens it upward as the left hand drops right; both hands sweep left before the right hand returns right and both elbows tuck. The hands separate right and left with a rising curl of the left hand, then reverse their sideways paths and lower as both arms lengthen, ending with the right hand reaching farther right. Both hands rise and sweep left, the right elbow folding while the left hand descends; they then separate again, the right hand continuing left and opening as the left hand curls upward. The left arm extends downward and reaches left alongside the right hand's leftward dip, then reverses its own path right before returning left as the right elbow folds. The right hand lowers right and lengthens farther, then rises right while the left hand continues left.

The right hand travels right, curls upward, and returns left while the left knee bends and straightens; the left arm reaches right and down while the right arm folds farther up and left. The right hand continues right and curls upward as the left arm opens right, then both arms descend into lengthened arms before the left arm sweeps left and rises with a tucked elbow. The left arm extends right and down again as the right hand drops and the left knee softens, then the left knee bends while the right arm folds up and left and the right hand moves left and lifts. Both knees deepen their bends beneath another shared rise, the right hand moving right and the left hand moving left, before the knees straighten and the hands lower, the right hand continuing left as the left arm tucks. The hands sweep right together, the left arm opening downward while the right hand curls up and right; both elbows then fold as the left hand climbs and the right arm lowers.

The arms move in opposition: the left hand rises left while the right hand curls upward and right, then the right arm folds up-right as the left hand drops. The raised hands reverse sideways and descend, both elbows opening before the left arm curls upward and the right hand reaches farther left and up. The right reaching arm tucks as the left curled arm lengthens down-left; both sweep right, the right tucked arm rising and opening while the left hand continues down-right. Both arms fold again, with the left hand lowering as the right knee straightens, then the right hand sweeps left and down into an extension while the left elbow opens. The right hand lifts, bends, and returns left with another curl as the right knee softens, while the left hand moves right.

The knees remain soft as the dancer folds the right arm upward and carries the right hand left, then extends both arms downward and rightward. Both hands sweep left and rise with lengthening elbows before curling down toward the right as the right knee straightens and the left knee bends. The right hand lifts again while the left knee extends and the left arm opens left and up; the right elbow tucks as the right knee straightens, then both hands descend, the left hand reversing right. The right arm reaches up and right as the right knee bends, then the left arm folds rightward and rises while the right hand lowers and the knees trade bend and extension. The left knee sinks farther as the left hand drops and the right arm curls upward, then both knees soften while the raised hand sweeps left and returns right over a renewed knee extension.

A low, shared rightward sweep begins as the dancer folds the left arm and lengthens the right arm, then lifts both hands leftward with the left arm opening. The right arm curls down-right while the left hand drops, extends right, and returns left with a fold. Both hands rise into an elbow tuck, the right hand moving left before they reverse sideways and descend, the left arm opening. The left hand sweeps up-left and back down-right against the right arm's continuing rightward extension, then rises again while the right arm draws inward. The right hand continues right and lowers as the left arm reaches farther up-right, and the right knee straightens.

In opposition, the right hand sweeps right and curls upward while the left arm folds and lifts left, then lowers and opens. The right arm reverses left as the left arm reaches up-right, both elbows tucking before the left arm returns down-left and the left knee bends and releases. Both hands rise with folded arms, the right hand moving left, before the right elbow opens and the right hand drops while the left knee softens again. The right hand reverses right and rises, joined by the left hand lifting left as the left knee straightens; the right arm lengthens downward while the left arm tucks right and falls, then the knees exchange a bend and release. The left arm reaches up-right as the right hand moves left and rises, the right elbow opening before both hands descend into longer arms. The left hand continues right and upward while the right hand returns left, curls upward and extends back down-right.

As the right hand drops, the dancer curls the left hand upward and right, then extends the left hand back left while the right arm folds. The left hand lifts farther before reversing down-right and lengthening as the right knee bends; both hands sweep left and descend, with the right arm reaching out and the bent right knee straightening. Both arms curl upward as the right knee softens, then open downward, the right hand sweeping right before both rise again. The right knee straightens and bends once more as the left leg lengthens, then both knees soften and release in succession while the right arm folds and the right hand lowers. The right hand travels left, the left hand follows left and curls up-right, and both descend before the left hand reaches left and the right arm extends upward.

The arms work in opposition as the dancer sends the right hand right and down while the left hand reaches left, then lifts and curls right against the right hand's return left. The left arm opens downward, folds back up and drops again as the right knee straightens and bends; the hands sweep right together before the left arm rises and the right knee softens further. Both hands descend into extending elbows as the right knee releases, then the hands reverse inward with the left arm curling upward and the right elbow folding. The left arm opens downward as the right knee bends, while the right hand returns right, curls upward and descends. The right arm tucks farther as the right knee straightens, then both hands sweep left and climb into lengthened arms while the right knee softens again.

To begin, the dancer lowers and lengthens the right arm while the left hand travels right and down; the right knee straightens as the right hand reverses left. Both arms fold downward, with the left elbow opening then tucking again, before the left hand rises into a shared curl. The hands sweep left and climb together, then exchange directions: the right hand moves right as the left hand continues left and both descend. The right arm extends farther left and rises, followed by the left hand lifting into a fold; both then lower and open, the right hand returning right. The left hand sweeps up-left and curls inward while the right arm reaches left, then folds back toward the right.

To begin, the dancer curls the right arm upward and left while the left arm extends down-left; the right hand then drops as the right knee bends. Both hands sweep right, the left arm folding before reaching back left and rising alongside the right hand. The left arm opens downward as the right hand continues up-right, then the right knee softens beneath another curling lift of the right hand. The left arm folds right as both hands descend and separate, then the right hand returns right into a bend while the left knee straightens. The left hand rises as the right knee releases, then both arms lengthen and descend toward the left.

The right arm folds inward and carries the right hand right while the left arm reaches left, then both hands descend as the right arm opens. The left hand returns right while the right arm rises into a curl, followed by the left arm lifting and folding toward the left. Both hands lower and sweep right as the right arm lengthens; they rise again, the left elbow opening before tucking back in as the left hand drops and the right arm moves left. The hands reverse right, the right arm climbing into a fold while the left arm extends downward, then both descend and open as the right arm reverses left. The left arm curls upward and releases, joined by the right hand rising through an extension and a renewed tuck.

The dancer lengthens the right arm upward while the right knee softens, then curls both hands up. The left hand travels left and drops with a deeper fold as the left knee bends. Then the right arm reaches right and rises into a tuck while the left arm opens downward as the left knee straightens. The hands separate left and right, then descend and reverse their sideways paths while the right knee bends further and the left hand curls upward. The right hand continues down-left as both knees soften, then sweeps right and returns left into an extension as the left knee straightens and the left arm folds back left. The right knee releases and bends again beneath a rising rightward reach, joined by the left arm curling up-right as the left knee lengthens. The right arm folds farther right while the left hand reverses left, then the right knee straightens as both hands lower.

The right knee straightens as the left hand sweeps left and down with a folding arm, then both hands rise. The dancer lifts the left hand toward the right, lowers it into an extension, and repeats this rising-and-falling motion twice while the right hand climbs. Both hands sweep left, the left arm curling upward before lowering and opening; the right hand drops right and folds back left. The left hand curls up and right, then descends as the right knee softens, while the right arm lengthens downward and returns right. The right arm tucks through another lift and fall to the left, and the left hand rises with a tighter elbow fold as the bent knee releases.

The right knee softens as the dancer curls the right arm upward, then lengthens it down and right while the left hand rises left; the left knee straightens as the right hand moves left. Both arms gather inward with the hands rising before the right hand reverses right, the right knee bends deeper, and both arms extend downward. The right hand returns left as both knees soften, then the left hand lifts left into a curl while the right hand rises right over a bending knee, followed by the left hand descending right and the right arm opening. The right knee releases and bends again beneath another lift of the left hand to the right, which then folds downward as the right arm tucks left and rises; the left arm opens up and right while the right knee straightens, and the right elbow releases before both hands lower. The hands separate sideways as the right knee extends and the right arm lengthens, then the right hand reverses left and rises while the left knee bends and the left hand dips and rebounds.

The dancer begins a rightward hand sweep with the right arm curling upward, then lowers the right hand left as the left arm folds up and right. The right arm extends down and right while the left arm continues its rising reach, then both arms open into a shared descent. Both hands reverse left and climb as the elbows gather in, before the left hand sweeps right and down with its knee straightening and the right elbow opening. The left arm reaches up and right again, lengthens downward, then curls back left and rises as the right hand lifts and moves right. The left hand returns right while the right hand drops left and tucks inward.

The arms move in opposition: the dancer sends the right hand left and up while the left hand lowers, then reverses their paths as both hands rise, the right hand continuing left before returning right. The right arm folds downward and opens again, then curls back up to the left as the left arm tucks down and moves right. Both hands descend with opening elbows, the right hand shifting right and folding upward while the left hand curls higher, then extends farther right. The right arm opens downward as the left hand climbs, then the right elbow bends and the right hand swings left while the left arm lengthens. The right arm reaches farther left and rises as the left hand drops and sweeps left.

As both hands descend and the dancer lengthens the right arm, the left hand sweeps right while the right hand continues left and drops farther. The left arm curls upward and returns left with an opening elbow as the right arm reaches up and right, then the hands reverse outward before the right hand folds back down-left. Both arms tuck into a shared leftward sweep, the right hand rising as the left hand descends. The left hand reverses right and lifts while the right hand dips and rebounds, then both hands move right and the left arm draws inward. Both hands climb together and separate sideways, ending with the right hand moving left and the left arm extending.

The arms move in opposition as the right hand curls upward and left while the left hand drops rightward, then the raised right arm opens downward to the right before both hands climb. The dancer sweeps the initially lowered left hand left as its knee straightens, then brings it right while the opposite right arm extends down to the left and that knee bends again. The lower right arm folds as the bent knee releases and softens, then both knees lengthen while the tucked left hand moves right and down and the opposite right hand climbs left. The lower left hand lifts leftward as both knees bend, the opposite right arm opening rightward, before the knees extend in succession; the lifted right arm tucks and lowers as the other left elbow draws inward. Both hands rise with a shared rightward sweep, then the initially raised right arm reaches down and back left as its opposite left hand continues right and down.

The dancer lowers and lengthens the right arm as the left hand rises leftward, then lifts both hands with the right arm curling inward. Both arms open and descend, the left hand sweeping right before folding upward; the right hand follows up and tucks while the left knee bends and straightens beneath a renewed reach downward. The right arm opens down and right as the left knee softens, then curls upward while the left hand moves right and rises. The left knee releases as the right arm extends down-left and folds back up, then the right hand reaches right and descends while the left hand continues its leftward sweep. Both hands lift again, the right arm drawing in before extending downward alongside the left hand's descent.

The right knee softens as the dancer sends both hands right and lifts them, then extends the right arm left while the left arm lengthens downward. The raised right hand returns up-right as the right knee straightens, with the left hand curling upward; the bent right knee sinks farther while the arms separate left and right and the right arm opens. The left hand drops and folds as the left knee bends and releases beneath a rising right hand, then the left arm reaches down-left as the right knee softens again. Both hands sweep left with extending elbows, then reverse right as the right knee lengthens and the right arm curls up-left before opening downward and sweeping left again. The left hand lowers left and tucks as the left knee bends, followed by the right hand moving left and dropping while the left hand rises. The right knee releases into a deeper bend as the left arm extends right and the left knee straightens, then both hands return left with the right elbow folding.

The right hand lowers and sweeps left. The dancer sends the left hand right, then both hands return left as the right arm folds upward and the left knee softens beneath a descending right elbow. The raised right arm opens downward while the left hand lifts and lengthens, followed by the lowered right arm reaching up and right as the left knee bends. Both hands descend with folding elbows, then the right hand lifts and curls while the left hand moves right and down; the lifted left arm releases farther right and drops as the left knee straightens. The left hand returns left with another tuck, then rises and unfolds as the right knee bends.

The arms separate in opposing directions, the left hand moves left and the right hand moves right, before the right arm curls upward. The right hand sweeps left and drops into an extension as both hands reverse outward again. The dancer repeats this outward reach, a shared rise and folding inward, then a drop with renewed extension of the right arm. The left hand rises while the right hand continues down and reaches farther left; the raised left hand then moves right and tucks inward. The right hand sweeps left as the left arm opens downward, followed by another fold on the left side and a rightward sweep of the right hand.

The dancer lifts the right hand. The left arm lengthens and lowers, then curls upward as the raised right hand drops and the right knee bends. The left hand sweeps left while the right hand rises right, both arms opening before the right hand returns left and both knees straighten. The hands separate left and right as the right hand climbs with a bent elbow, then the left arm folds downward and the left knee softens. The left arm reaches right again and lowers farther, finishing with both knees extended and the right hand moving left.

The right knee softens as the dancer lowers and lengthens the right arm, then sends both hands left while the right knee straightens. The left hand rises, sweeps right and drops with a fold, while the right hand reverses right and the right knee bends again. Both knees release as the hands separate left and right and lower; the left hand returns left with an opening elbow before both arms curl upward. The right hand drops, swings right and back left, then extends down and right as the left hand rises and moves right with a bend of the left knee. Both arms tuck into another lift, then the right hand descends and the left hand reaches farther right.

The right arm and left arm oppose each other: the right hand moves right as the left knee bends and straightens, then both hands descend with the left arm folding. The right hand continues left as the left knee softens and the right elbow tucks; both knees straighten before the right hand rises and both elbows open. The right hand sweeps down and right while the left hand climbs, then the left arm folds into a lift as the right hand swings left and back right with an opening elbow. Both arms lengthen downward, then the right hand returns right and curls upward as the left arm draws in. The dancer repeats the rising fold of the right arm with a bend and release of the left knee, then lowers both hands, extending the right arm while the left knee softens.

The right hand drops and reaches right. The dancer lowers the left hand into a fold, then raises both arms as the right knee straightens and the left arm opens left; both hands descend, the right arm lengthening farther. Both arms curl upward, then open and sweep right before lowering together, the right hand reversing left as the right knee softens. The right hand returns right while the left hand rises and folds, then dips and curls back up as the left knee bends and straightens. The right hand climbs left with a tucked elbow, sweeps down and right, and descends farther as the left hand moves left.

As the right hand sweeps right and down, the dancer lowers the left hand, then reverses both left while folding the right arm. The right arm opens into a rightward sweep as the left knee straightens, then curls back left with a bend of the right knee before releasing downward and lengthening. The hands separate left and right and descend, the right hand returning right over a deepening left knee bend; both arms tuck as the right knee softens, then the right arm reaches up and right while the left arm draws in and the left knee releases. The right hand drops and sweeps left, folds upward, then returns right as the left arm opens down and left and the left knee bends again. The right arm extends left and rises, then folds back right as the right knee sinks farther and the left arm curls upward. Both hands lower, the right arm opening while the left arm tucks further and the left knee straightens.

Downward, the right hand sinks as the left arm folds and lifts, then both arms lengthen and lower. The dancer raises them again, with the right elbow drawing inward before opening into a leftward sweep while the left arm curls upward to the right. Both hands descend and continue left as the elbows tuck, then rise together and separate left and right, the left arm reaching out. The right side repeats a lowering curl and lift, then folds down again; the left hand traces a rising-left-down-right path as its knee softens. Both hands climb with bent elbows, and the right hand moves farther right before the arms extend downward.

As the left arm curls upward, the dancer folds the right arm and lifts its hand leftward. The right knee bends while the left lengthens, then both knees soften as the hands sweep right and the left elbow tucks. Both arms open, the left hand lowering before both elbows fold again. The right hand rises and drops while the left moves left and up into a deeper curl, then sweeps right and down with an extending elbow. That arm reaches back left as the other hand continues downward and the left knee bends.

A leftward arm sweep begins as the dancer folds the left arm and raises the left hand, then opens both arms and lifts the right hand. The left arm curls down-right as the right arm reaches left, then the left arm reverses left and extends upward before folding back right and lowering into a deeper tuck while the right hand continues left. The left hand rises through another fold and release, then drops and returns right as both elbows open and the right hand sweeps up-left. The right arm curls downward as the left hand lifts left, then the left hand reaches down-right while the right arm travels right and lowers. Both hands rise again, with the left arm drawing inward and the right arm extending farther right.

The dancer raises both hands. The left arm folds leftward as the right knee bends and releases, then the left hand drops with an opening elbow while the right hand curls up and left; the left hand reverses right as the right knee softens and the right hand lowers into a longer reach. Both arms tuck as the right hand sweeps left and back right, the left hand continuing down-right before extending left again; the knees straighten in succession as the left arm lengthens upward and the right knee bends once more. The hands separate sideways, the left hand climbing left as the right hand moves right, then reverse sideways and descend together, the right arm folding through its sweep. Both elbows draw inward as the left leg extends, the left hand continuing upward and left before dropping into a tighter curl. The left hand rises again while the right hand travels left, opens and lowers, then both sweep right as the left arm folds and the right hand lifts into another bend.

The right hand drops as the dancer folds both arms and lifts them together, carrying the right hand right before the left hand curls left. Both elbows open and the hands lower, then the left arm gathers upward and sweeps right while the right arm continues down-left with its elbow folding. The left hand returns left and drops into an extended reach as the right arm lengthens downward; both hands sweep right before the right arm reverses left and rises. The left hand dips left and climbs back right, joined by the right hand moving right as it lowers and extends. Both hands descend, the right hand continuing left while the left hand curls up-right, then opens downward.

To begin, the dancer lowers the right hand as the right arm extends and the left knee bends, then lifts both hands with the left knee straightening before reversing their directions. The right arm curls upward to the right while the left arm reaches left, then opens down and folds back up toward the right as the left knee softens again; both hands rise and sweep left before the right hand drops and the knees lengthen in succession. The left hand returns right and rises into a curl while the right hand climbs left, then they trade heights as the right knee bends and the left arm tucks further left. The left knee straightens as the right arm extends down and left, then both hands lift, the right elbow folding and the left hand returning right. Both arms open downward, the left hand drifting left as the right elbow draws in, and finish by rising with bent elbows and separating sideways.

As the right arm curls upward and right, the dancer straightens the left knee and extends the left hand left. The right arm reaches farther up and right while the left arm folds downward, then the left arm opens as the left knee bends and releases and the right arm tucks. The hands separate left and right with another curl of the right arm, then both descend as the left elbow lengthens and the knees soften in succession. Both arms extend through a shared leftward sweep before the elbows fold and the hands rise, the left hand now dropping right against the right arm's leftward motion. The left hand returns left as the left knee straightens and the right knee softens, followed by an extension of the right arm and a bend of the left knee.

A paired hand sweep begins with the left arm curling left and the right arm extending right, then both arms lengthen as the hands reverse sideways. The left hand rises into a fold while the right knee straightens, the right hand continuing down-right; the right knee bends and releases again as the left arm opens downward and sweeps right. The right arm curls up-left against the left hand's leftward lift, then extends down-right as the left knee softens and the left arm gathers higher; the right hand reverses upward-left before dropping into an extension. Both hands descend as the left leg straightens and the left knee bends again, followed by the right knee releasing and the left hand returning right. The left elbow folds as the left knee straightens and the right hand lifts right, then the left hand dips and rises while the right arm lengthens left and down.

At the outset, the dancer lifts the right hand and lengthens both arms as the left hand rises, then lowers the right arm while the left arm curls left. The left hand returns right and climbs with its elbow folded, joined by the right arm reaching higher and extending. Both hands descend into open elbows, then the right arm folds upward and left while the left arm tucks and rises, continuing left before both arms lengthen downward. The left arm extends farther as the right hand rises again, followed by a lift of the left hand and a renewed opening of the right arm.

The dancer lengthens the right arm downward. The right hand curls right while the left hand reaches left, then the right hand reverses down-right as both elbows open and the left arm folds back toward the right. The right hand drops farther and tucks as the left knee bends and releases, followed by another bend of the left knee while the right arm rises left and the left hand moves right. The knees alternate bending and straightening beneath a shared leftward sweep, with the right hand descending and its elbow opening before curling again. The left hand lifts as the right arm extends right, then both hands rise and reverse sideways, the left elbow folding before the arms lower together. Both hands return left with the right elbow tucked, then sweep right into a lift and finish with the left arm curling upward.

As the right arm folds and the left hand moves left, the dancer lifts the right hand right while the left knee bends. Both knees sink further as the hands sweep down and left, then the right knee straightens while the right hand rises right and the left knee releases; both hands reverse right with the right hand dropping and the left hand curling upward. The right hand returns left as the right knee softens and the left arm opens downward, then rises into a bend of the left knee before both hands climb and separate right and left. The left knee releases as the hands descend, then the left knee bends and straightens beneath another rise while the right arm extends and curls again. The right knee softens as the left hand lowers and sweeps left, then both hands drop with the left knee straightening before the right hand reverses right and both arms lengthen downward.

An alternating arm sweep begins with the right hand rising right and the left hand moving left as both elbows bend, then the right arm opens while the left arm curls higher. The hands exchange directions, the right arm folding into a descent as the left arm tucks farther up-left and both knees soften. The right hand rises again while the left knee bends deeper and straightens, followed by the right knee bending and releasing as the left arm extends downward. Both hands descend as the left knee lengthens and the right arm opens; the right hand then lifts right while the left arm folds upward and moves right over another bend of the left knee. The left arm curls down-left as the right hand drops and sweeps left, and both arms open before the hands reverse right and rise together.

The dancer performs a paired arm sweep: the right hand rises right as the left knee bends, then both hands descend and sweep left with the left knee releasing. The right arm curls upward while the left arm extends down, and both knees soften before the right hand drops and the left arm tucks. The left hand rises as the left knee straightens, then the right hand lifts and reaches right while the left arm opens and the left knee lengthens. The right hand lowers and folds back right as the left arm draws inward, then rises with an extending elbow before both arms curl again. The left knee bends beneath a leftward hand sweep, then releases as the right hand drops and the left knee softens once more.

The right knee softens as the dancer lowers and lengthens the left arm toward the right, then raises both hands with the right elbow folding. The left hand curls back left while the right arm extends farther right, then the elbows trade a fold and release before the right arm tucks again and its hand drops left. The right arm opens and rises into another curl as the left hand lifts and reverses right; both arms lengthen downward, then the left hand sweeps left and up as the right arm folds upward to the right. The right hand returns left and drops while the left arm curls down-right and opens, then reaches up-left as the left knee bends and the right arm lengthens farther down. The right knee sinks through an opening rightward reach and renewed tuck, while the left hand rises right into a fold.

The dancer begins an alternating arm weave by extending the right arm right, lowering it, and drawing both hands inward while the left hand moves left. The right hand continues right and rises before curling left, joined by the left hand's lift; the left knee straightens as the right arm opens down and right. Both hands descend with extending elbows, then sweep left together and rise into folds, the left hand reversing right before both lower again. The right arm curls higher and releases back down as the left arm tucks upward and opens downward, followed by another bend of the right elbow and a renewed extension of the left arm. Both hands climb, the right arm lengthening farther right before dropping and folding as the left hand reverses left.

In opposition, the left hand moves left and the right hand moves right. The right-moving arm curls upward as the left knee softens, then both hands descend with the right arm opening while the bent leg straightens and the right hand continues left. Both arms tuck into a rising sweep, the left hand reversing right before lengthening downward; the right hand follows down and left as the right knee bends, then returns right as the left knee straightens and the right hand releases. The right hand lifts left while the left arm reaches up-right, then lowers through another bend and release of the left knee and a tucked return left. The right hand climbs again as the left arm extends, before both hands sweep right and the right hand drops.

The dancer lengthens the right arm downward. The left hand moves left and rises into a curl while the right arm reaches farther down, then the right arm lifts as the left arm descends. The left hand curls right and drops, joined by the right hand moving right into an upward reach. Both arms open before the left hand folds back left; the right knee bends as the left elbow tucks further and the left hand lowers. The left hand rises again and extends outward, finishing with the right hand sweeping left.

At the outset, the dancer lowers the right hand while bending the right knee and extending the left arm rightward, then lifts the right hand as both arms open. The hands separate left and right with a bend of the left knee, then the right hand returns left as the left knee straightens and the left arm tucks. The right arm curls upward while the left arm reaches down-right, then opens downward as the right hand drops left; the left knee bends and releases beneath another lift of the right hand. Both arms fold into a shared rise toward the right before opening again, and the left hand dips left as the right knee softens. The right hand moves right and back left while the right knee lengthens, then the left hand rises rightward through an extension and renewed curl.

The knees join a later knee-bend after the dancer lowers both hands, the left arm folding left while the right arm extends right and rises. The left hand curls upward as the right elbow tucks and the right knee softens, then both hands sweep right with the left arm lengthening and dropping before curling back left against the right hand's rising reach. Both arms open downward, then the left hand sweeps right and curls up as the right knee bends and straightens; the left hand returns left and drops with an opening right elbow. The right arm gathers upward and extends right while the left hand lifts, curls right and falls, then both arms unfold into a shared rise as the left hand reverses left and the right hand continues right. The left hand dips and rebounds upward while the right hand lowers, then both sweep right as the knees soften in succession; the rebounding left arm tucks farther and carries the left hand higher before both hands descend and reverse left.

The dancer folds the right arm as the left hand moves left and down, then lowers both hands before lifting them again. The right arm extends right and dips while the left tucks, its hand dropping and sweeping left before reaching right. Both arms lengthen as the right hand returns left and climbs into a curl; the left hand rises and reverses left. The right arm opens downward and sweeps right as the left folds down and left, then lifts right with another extension while the lower hand rises right and curls back left. The left curled hand drops as the right arm tucks right and lifts, then the right hand rises left and continues climbing.

The right hand rises, folds, and returns left as the left arm lengthens downward; the right hand drops while the left arm curls upward. The right hand moves right and lifts into a tighter tuck as the left knee bends, then lowers with an opening elbow and a softening knee. The right hand sweeps left and curls up again as the right knee straightens and the left arm reaches down-right. The right knee bends and releases beneath a folded lift of the right hand, which then opens and falls left as both knees soften in succession. Both arms gather inward and rise, the right hand moving right before reversing left against the left hand's rightward sweep.

The right knee softens as the left hand drops left and curls upward, then both hands lower with the left arm extending right before they rise again. The left arm folds farther left and down while the right knee bends deeper; the right arm tucks, lowers right, and opens as the right knee straightens. Both hands sweep left, the right arm climbing and returning right while the left arm reaches higher to the left, then both descend into bent elbows. The left knee lengthens as the right hand rises left and the left hand curls upward, followed by a dip and lift of the left hand. The right knee softens again as the right arm extends downward and left, then the left arm folds down to the right and releases as the right knee straightens and the right hand returns up-right.

As the right knee bends, the dancer softens the left knee and sweeps both hands left with a curling right arm. The right knee straightens while the right arm opens and both hands rise right, then the right knee drops again as the left hand reverses left and down. The left hand swings left and back right while the right elbow folds; the left knee beneath the folded right arm extends as the right hand continues right. The right arm opens and curls upward, then returns left as the right knee bends and releases. Both arms tuck inward, the right knee sinking farther before the right hand rises right and the left arm reaches down-left.

To begin, the dancer folds the right arm upward and sweeps the right hand left, then straightens the right arm as the left knee bends and the left hand rises. The left knee softens again while the right hand moves right and both arms curl higher, before the right arm drops and extends as the left leg lengthens. Both hands sweep left, the right arm opening and the left knee straightening; they reverse right with the right elbow tucking, then the left hand returns left into a fold as the left knee bends. The right arm reaches up-right and opens over a deeper bend of the left knee while the left hand drops and curls back toward the right. The right hand lowers, swings left and reverses right as the left knee sinks farther, while the left hand continues right and down with an extending arm.

As the right hand sweeps left, the dancer lowers and opens the right arm while the left arm drops, then extends the left arm into a rightward reach. The left hand returns left as both arms fold upward, the right hand moving right before both descend and open. The right hand rebounds up-left into a curl while the left arm tucks and lifts, then lowers left as the right knee softens. Both hands continue down-left, the right arm lengthening while the left arm folds higher and moves right over a bend of the right knee. The left arm reaches farther right before lowering and extending again, accompanied by another deepening of the bent right knee and an inward curl of the right arm.

The dancer lengthens the right arm downward as the left hand rises, then both hands sweep left before the right hand curls up and right. Both hands descend with folding elbows, reverse left, and rise again as the arms extend. The right hand moves right while the left hand continues left, then the right arm tucks upward. The right arm reaches back left as the left arm lowers and extends right, before the right hand drops and folds. The right elbow opens again as the left arm curls upward and the right hand sweeps right.

The dancer begins with the right hand moving left as the left arm folds and the left knee straightens, then the right hand curls upward while the left arm reaches down-right. The left arm opens downward as the right knee bends, followed by a lengthening of the right knee and an extension of the left arm toward the right. The right arm tucks and lifts as the right knee softens again, while the left hand reverses left and rises into a fold; both knees straighten in succession. The right hand swings right and drops with a deepening curl as the right knee bends, then returns left and sinks further before extending back to the right. Both arms open, with the left hand lifting and falling while the right arm continues rising and reaching farther right.

The arms open and rise, the right hand moving right while the left hand travels left. The right arm curls upward before both hands descend, then the right hand sweeps left as the right knee bends and the left hand reverses right. Both hands climb again, the right knee straightening beneath the sweeping right hand as it opens downward, then the right knee bends once more beneath a renewed lift. The right hand swings right and drops while the left hand lowers and reaches left; both elbows lengthen as the hands reverse sideways and the right knee softens further. The left hand moves right, the right hand returns left, and the left arm folds inward.

A leftward hand sweep begins as the left arm folds and the right arm reaches right, then both hands rise, the right hand curling back left while the left hand extends. The left hand climbs farther right as the right hand opens downward, then drops left with its elbow tucked while the right hand reaches up to the right. The right hand sweeps down-left before both arms fold and lower, the left hand returning right. Both hands climb, the left hand curling inward and sweeping left as the right hand extends, then the right hand rises farther left while the left hand drops and reaches right. The left hand lifts into a fold and returns left alongside the right hand's upward reach, before descending together with an opening elbow.

As the right hand rises and moves right, the dancer bends the right knee then the left knee, then lowers the right arm into a fold while the left hand drops left and the left knee straightens. The right arm reaches up and right as the right knee extends farther; the left elbow tucks and lifts before both hands sweep left and the left arm opens. Both arms curl inward as the hands descend, then separate sideways with the right moving right and the left moving left, before reversing their lateral paths. The right hand climbs, swings left and back right while the left drops, then both lower as the right arm lengthens; they reverse direction again, with the left hand lifting before dropping through a right-to-left sweep. The left hand continues down and left, curls upward and right, then reverses left and rises again as the right hand lifts.

The dancer lowers both hands. The right arm extends down and left, then curls upward as the left hand lifts right; the left hand returns left while the right knee straightens, and both elbows tuck before the right hand drops right and both hands rise. The right hand sweeps left and descends as the right knee bends, while the left elbow opens and the right arm folds more tightly. The hands separate left and right, the right hand rising as the left knee softens; the right arm extends right before folding back left over a deeper bend of the left knee. The right arm lengthens downward and right as the left knee releases, then curls up and left against the left hand's leftward reach. Both hands descend and sweep right with bent elbows, then reverse left as the right hand rises and both arms extend.

The dancer sends both hands right. The left hand drops and curls back left while the right arm folds upward, then the left hand extends down and returns right into a rising fold as the right hand lowers and opens. The left arm lengthens downward while the right hand reaches up-right; the left hand rises and sweeps left, then both hands descend before reversing their lateral paths with the left hand curling upward. The right hand lifts and falls into an extended reach, followed by the left hand climbing left, folding, and lowering as its knee straightens. That same left hand reverses right with an opening elbow while the right hand continues down-right and tucks inward.

The right knee softens as the dancer sends the left hand left and curls the right arm upward, then straightens the right knee while both arms lengthen downward and sweep right. The left arm folds upward as the left knee bends, followed by a lift of the left hand into a tighter curl; both hands reverse left, the bent leg extending as the right arm opens. Both hands climb again with folded elbows before the left hand drops, then both sweep right and rise again. The right arm reaches farther right and climbs as the right knee straightens, then returns left and tucks inward while the left elbow extends. The left hand dips and rises once more while the right arm continues right and upward.

The dancer raises the right hand. The left arm curls upward, then both hands descend as the right knee softens and the left arm opens; both arms tuck again while the right knee straightens and the left knee bends. Both elbows release as the left knee extends, the right hand drops left and the left hand climbs right with a deeper fold, before the hands rise apart and the right arm curls back down-right over a renewed bend of the right knee. The left arm gathers left while the right hand lifts right, then they trade height and reverse sideways as the left knee lengthens and the right knee bends and releases. The right arm reaches up-left and folds over another right knee bend, then opens down-right as the left hand lowers and the left arm tightens. The left knee sinks farther while the right arm draws inward and rises right, then straightens as the left hand moves left and the raised elbow releases.

The right knee straightens as the dancer curls the right hand upward and left, then drops it right while the left arm folds and lifts left. The right hand rises again into a tighter curl as the right knee lengthens further; the left hand moves right while the right hand reverses left and lowers. Both hands sweep right as the arms open, then reverse left with the right hand climbing. The right hand returns right and down as the left arm extends farther left, then both hands move right while the right knee softens.

As the left arm folds and the right arm extends, the dancer sweeps both hands left and down. The right arm curls upward, then opens into a rightward reach while the left arm lifts left and lengthens; both hands descend as the right elbow tucks. The arms separate sideways and rise with another bend in the right elbow, then sweep back toward each other and lower, the right hand moving left. Both elbows open as the right hand continues down and left, followed by the left hand dropping and the left knee straightening. The left arm reaches right while the right elbow folds and the right-reaching hand lowers.

The right hand travels right as the dancer bends and straightens the right knee, then lifts both hands while the left arm opens and curls back in. The right arm extends down-left, reverses right into a fold, and returns left as the left knee softens; the left arm tucks farther left before lengthening as the left knee straightens. The right arm curls upward and right, releases downward, and sweeps left with another fold, while the left hand rises left over a bending right knee and the right knee sinks. The left arm lowers into an extension as the right knee releases, while the right hand continues left and drops into a deeper fold. Both arms curl upward, then open as the right hand moves right.

A rising arm exchange begins with the dancer lifting the left hand left and folding the left arm while the right hand rises right, then the right hand opens downward as the left hand climbs. The right arm curls upward again and extends right while the left arm tucks left; both hands descend and separate into opposing reaches before rising, the right hand curling as the left hand drops. The left hand swings right and back left while the right arm lifts, then the hands reverse sideways and the right arm opens. Both hands lower as the right knee bends and the arms fold, then the right knee straightens while both arms extend through a rightward sweep and lift, the left elbow gathering inward. The hands return left and down with lengthening arms as the right knee softens again, then rise with both elbows drawing in before sweeping right and lowering together.

Downward, the right hand descends as the dancer straightens the right knee and lengthens the right arm, while the left hand drops right; both knees soften in succession. The arms open, the left hand rises and moves left before curling down, then both hands sweep left as the right knee extends and the elbows fold again. The right knee bends as the left arm reaches right and lowers, then both knees sink beneath a lift of the right hand, which reverses left and drops while the left knee straightens. Both hands move right with folding elbows, then rise as the right arm opens and the left hand continues right; the right hand returns left into another tuck. The right knee softens and extends again as the left hand drops left and curls upward, followed by the right hand lifting left and the bent arm drawing higher and farther left. The right hand swings right and back left, then both arms lower as their elbows open.

As the right hand sweeps left and down, the left arm folds inward, then both hands rise, the right hand continuing left while the left hand curls right. Both arms extend downward and open, then the right hand swings right and back left before both lift and tuck in toward the right. The right arm lengthens down and left as the left knee straightens, then curls upward while the left hand rises and the right knee bends. The right knee releases beneath a leftward descent of the right hand, which opens while the left arm draws inward and lowers. The right hand reverses right and curls up over a softening right knee, then returns left and drops into an extension as the right knee straightens again.

The right knee straightens after the dancer curls the left hand right and down, then both arms lengthen downward as the right hand sweeps left and the right knee bends. The hands rise with the left elbow folding, the right arm extending and returning left while the right knee releases; the left arm reaches right and lowers as the right hand tucks inward. Both knees soften and the hands climb, the rightward-moving arm opening before the left hand drops and the knees straighten in succession. The lower hand folds upward as its knee bends again, then both hands move left and descend with the right arm reaching farther left and down. The right knee straightens as the left arm rises, then the right hand lifts and curls right while the right knee bends and releases beneath a further rise and fall of the left hand.

As the right knee bends and straightens, the dancer folds both arms upward toward the right, then lowers them as the right knee softens again. The left arm reaches up-left while the right arm curls farther up-right over a deeper bend of the right knee; the left-reaching hand reverses right as the knees alternate bending and straightening. Both hands sweep left with bent elbows before reversing right, then rise as the knees trade another bend and extension. The initial hand sweeps left and down while the opposite hand climbs right, then both move left as the latter drops and its corresponding knee straightens. The lower arm lengthens into a leftward return and tucks back right as its knee bends, while the other hand rises over a deeper knee bend. The tucked arm opens downward while the opposite knee straightens, and the other hand continues left and down.

The right hand dips leftward, then rises and reverses right as the left arm lengthens. The right hand returns left while the left knee softens, and both hands descend with the right arm extending farther. The right arm curls upward as the left knee bends deeper and the right knee straightens, then opens into a shared lift that ends with the right hand dropping and the left arm folding. The left knee releases beneath a rightward sweep of the left hand, which continues rising while the right hand lifts leftward; the left arm opens downward, then both arms fold as the right hand lowers. Both hands climb again, the left hand reaching right before reversing left, while the right knee bends and the left leg straightens. The hands separate sideways, the right arm curling upward as the left knee bends and releases beneath its descending hand.

As the right hand sweeps right, the dancer sends both hands down and left with folding elbows, then curls them upward before lowering the right hand into an extension. The left hand rises and drops while the right hand continues left and climbs with a tighter elbow fold. Both hands reverse right as the left arm descends and opens, then the right arm lengthens downward while the left hand returns left.
