The left arm curls up and reaches right as the right hand lifts left, then both arms extend downward before the right hand reverses right. The left hand swings left and curls upward against the right hand's downward reach, then both sweep right with the right elbow opening as the left arm folds back left.

As the left arm folds and lowers, the dancer raises the right hand into a curl. While the left hand moves right, the right hand continues upward, then both arms open as the left hand lifts. The right hand reaches farther right and down, then both hands reverse left while the left elbow folds. Both arms lengthen again as the right hand climbs through an extension and tuck. The right arm opens once more before curling inward and sweeping right.

The dancer lifts the left hand. The left arm extends as the right knee softens, then both hands lower and sweep right before the right hand reverses left with a bent elbow. The left arm lengthens downward while the right knee straightens, then curls up to the right as the right knee bends again. Both hands descend and move left, the left arm opening before curling back up and right over another right knee extension; the right hand rises and falls while the left arm continues right. The right hand returns left and curls upward as the left arm opens down, then the left knee bends and straightens beneath a renewed lift of the right hand.

The right hand moves left. The left hand follows as the right arm extends downward, then both hands rise and reverse right while the right knee straightens and the right arm curls inward. Both hands descend into longer arms, then lift again with the elbows folding, before lowering once more as the knees soften in succession. The hands climb apart, the right arm reaching farther left while the left arm lengthens upward; both elbows tuck as the hands sweep left, then open and descend together. The left knee bends again as the left hand reaches down-right and the right arm folds, then reverses left with a further extension of the right arm and a deeper bend in the left knee. The right hand returns right and lowers as the right knee straightens, while the left hand rises and sweeps left into a curl.

The right knee straightens as the dancer lifts and folds both arms, then the right knee softens while lowering the left hand toward the left and opening the left arm. The right hand rises into a curl as the right leg lengthens again and the left hand sweeps right, then the right hand drops left with an extension before both hands return right, the left arm folding and releasing downward. Both knees bend as the hands reverse left and the right arm curls upward, then the legs straighten in succession while the right arm opens down and left and the left arm tucks. The left hand rises as the right arm continues left and the left knee bends, followed by another lift of the left hand while the right arm lengthens farther left and the left knee softens. The left knee straightens beneath a downward-left sweep of the left arm, which then opens as the right hand returns right and the right leg extends; the left hand follows right and both rise, the right elbow folding as the right knee bends.

The arms move in opposite directions: the right hand moves right and down while the left hand sweeps left. Then the right hand curls upward as the left hand extends. Both hands return left, with the right hand opening, before the right hand lowers into a fold and the left hand continues left, tucking farther. The left arm lengthens down as the right hand returns right and both elbows draw inward. The right arm opens upward, folds again, and reaches right once more while the left hand rises into a curl. The left hand climbs farther and unfolds, then the right hand lifts as its elbow releases and both hands descend.

As the left arm folds leftward and the right arm lengthens right, the dancer raises both hands, then lowers them into a shared leftward sweep. The left arm curls higher while the right arm extends, and both hands reverse right as the raised elbow opens and the right knee softens. The right knee straightens as the hands drop with the right arm tucked; the left hand moves left while the right hand reverses right and rises, followed by the lowered hand lifting through a rightward curl. Both arms lengthen downward before the right arm gathers leftward, then both hands rise and separate sideways as the right arm opens and the left arm tucks. The left hand drops and returns right with an unfolding elbow while the right hand lifts leftward and extends.

The right knee softens as the dancer lifts both hands, then the right arm lengthens while the left hand lowers and the left leg bends. The right arm folds farther right as the left leg straightens, then drops left into an extension; the left hand rises right before descending left into a curl. Both hands climb with the right arm folding inward, then separate sideways and descend as the right arm opens and the left arm tucks further. The right hand reaches right and up while the left hand sweeps left and down, then both arms fold and lower toward the right. The right elbow releases as the left hand continues right and curls upward, followed by a lift of the right hand and another bend of the left knee.

To begin, the dancer sends the right hand right and raises it with a fold, then curls the left hand upward before both hands descend. The right arm opens left as the left arm reaches right, then rises again while the left elbow bends; the raised arm extends and lowers as its knee straightens and the left arm lengthens downward. Both arms tuck through a rightward sweep, then reverse left with the right elbow opening, before the right hand climbs right and folds back left against the left hand's rightward reach. Both elbows draw inward as the hands separate sideways and rise, then the right arm opens down-left while the left arm extends right. The right hand moves right as its knee softens and the left elbow releases, then returns left into another fold as the bent knee straightens.

As the right hand moves right, the dancer lifts both hands and sends them left, bending the left arm while the right knee softens. The right hand climbs farther left as the right knee straightens and bends again, then the left arm curls upward to the right while the left knee extends and the left hand lowers. The right elbow opens as the left knee bends, then the raised hand reverses left and both arms fold. The right knee straightens as the right hand rises and tucks, while the left arm lengthens down and right; the raised hand sweeps right before descending with an opening elbow as the right knee deepens into a bend.

In opposition, the dancer curls the right arm up and right while the left arm extends left, then reverses the right hand down and left as the right knee straightens. The left hand lowers, folds back right, and rises into a longer reach over another bend and release of the right knee; both hands descend as the arms open, with the right moving left and the left curling up toward the right. The right arm gathers upward and right as the right knee bends, then releases while the left arm tucks further right and lifts over a bend in the left knee. Both hands drop before the right reaches left and the left curls up and left, ending with the right elbow folding as the left knee softens.

In opposition, the dancer curls the right arm upward while the left arm lowers and opens, then raises the left arm into a fold as both hands sweep left. The left hand drops into a longer reach while the right arm extends downward; both hands reverse right as the left elbow tucks and the right hand lifts. The right hand returns left and down with its arm lengthening while the left arm continues left and rises into a tighter bend. Both hands climb again, the right arm curling inward before both hands shift right and descend. The right hand sweeps left and up into a deeper fold, then returns right as the left arm extends left.

The dancer separates the hands left and right. The right hand reverses right as both arms lengthen, then curls upward while the left hand returns left and the left knee bends; the raised right arm opens again as the left knee straightens. Both hands lower and sweep right with a bend in the right knee, then the right hand rises while the left hand drops left and extends as the right knee straightens farther. The right arm folds down and right before opening upward as the left knee softens, then both hands reverse left and descend with the right elbow tucking. The left hand lifts right into a curl while the right arm reaches right and up, then the knees exchange bend and extension as both elbows draw inward and the hands rise together.

The dancer performs alternating knee bends with the right hand rising as the left hand drops, then softens the bent knee and lowers both hands while the right arm extends. The left hand swings left and back right as the left knee straightens, then folds upward toward the left while the right hand moves right and the right knee bends again. The left arm reaches down-right as the right knee lengthens and the right hand lifts right, followed by the right arm curling up-left. The right hand dips and rises farther left while the left hand tucks downward; the knee beneath the right arm bends as both hands descend and open, then the right arm curls upward again as the right knee releases. Both hands rise, the left hand moving left before dropping and extending right as the right hand falls and travels left; the left knee softens while the left arm opens and the right elbow folds.

The dancer lifts the right hand rightward. The left arm reaches right and lowers, then curls upward while the right hand drops left. Both hands sweep left as the left arm opens downward, and the right hand rises before both arms tuck and the hands move right. The left hand climbs as the right elbow releases, then the left curls down-left while the right extends right; both elbows fold again and the right hand rises with the left hand. The right arm lengthens down-left as the left arm continues left and the left knee softens, then the left arm reverses right and curls upward while the left knee bends further.

The right knee straightens as the dancer curls the left arm upward and left, then extends it down while the right hand sweeps right and up with a fold. The left hand rises again as the left arm opens and the right hand reaches down to the left, both hands lowering before the right hand lifts and both arms curl inward. Both hands rise with the left arm lengthening, then sweep left as the left arm tucks and the right hand drops; they return right and separate downward, the left hand curling farther while the right hand folds upward. The right hand reverses left and drops into an extension as the left arm reaches farther, then both hands descend and spread apart. Both knees bend in succession beneath a renewed lift of the right hand, which dips and rises again as the left hand moves right and the bent knees straighten in sequence.

The right hand rises and folds inward as the dancer straightens the left knee, then carries the right arm left while both knees soften. The right hand lowers and extends as the left knee releases, and both arms lengthen before the right hand drops farther left. The right hand reverses right as the left knee bends again, and both hands climb with folded elbows, the left arm opening. The right hand travels left and down while the left knee releases, then curls upward and sweeps right as the left hand lifts and both arms extend. Both hands descend, the right arm folding through a leftward sweep and rebounding up to the right while the left knee softens. The right arm tucks farther inward as the left knee straightens, and both knees release while the left hand rises left and the right hand reaches right.

As the right arm folds upward, the dancer lifts the left hand and lengthens the left elbow while the right knee bends. The left hand moves left as both knees straighten and the left arm curls higher; the right hand follows left with a folding elbow before returning right. Both hands sweep left, the left hand descending into an extension as the right hand reverses right and rises with the right knee straightening. The right arm reaches farther up and right as the right knee softens, then lowers and returns left while the left hand lifts.

The right hand sweeps left and down as the left arm lengthens, then the right hand reverses right into a curl while the left arm rises. The right arm continues upward before opening toward the left, followed by the left arm extending farther left. Both hands lower, the right hand reversing right and tucking while the left hand lifts, opens and curls back left. The left hand descends as both arms unfold, then the left knee softens and the left elbow folds again.

The right hand sweeps left. The left hand follows, then rises as the right arm folds and the right hand climbs right, before both hands descend with the left arm lengthening. Both arms curl upward, the right moving left and the left moving right, then reverse sideways and lower. The right hand returns left while the left arm extends up-left; both elbows open as their hands separate again, the left dropping and the right rising. The right hand swings right and back left while the left hand continues downward and the left arm folds.

As the right hand rises, the dancer sweeps it left and down, then extends the right arm back up to the right while the left hand moves right. The right arm folds inward as both hands descend, then opens toward the left before curling again. Both hands climb as the left elbow tucks; the right hand continues left while the left hand swings right and back left, with the left knee softening and straightening beneath a dip of the left hand. The right hand drops farther left into an extension as the left hand curls upward, then both arms gather upward. The right arm reaches right while the left hand lifts and falls, and the right hand dips and rebounds left before returning right.

The right hand curls up-right while the left hand lifts left, then both hands descend and reverse sideways as the left arm folds. The hands sweep left and rise with both elbows drawing inward, before the right hand returns right and the left hand drops into an extension. The left arm reaches farther down-left and reverses right, joined by the right hand moving right. Both hands lower as one knee bends and straightens beneath a continuing downward reach, then the right hand moves left. The left hand rises with a curling elbow while the right hand continues left.

The right hand moves right while the left hand rises left and lengthens. The right arm curls upward as the left hand drops, then both arms sweep left with the right hand lowering. Both arms open into a rightward sweep before the right hand returns left and folds down alongside the left hand's descent. The left elbow extends farther, then tucks again as the right hand reaches right and lowers; the right hand continues right with a folded arm before rising and unfolding. The left hand also rises, curls inward, and follows right as the right arm lengthens downward.

As the right knee straightens, the dancer softens the left knee and raises both hands, then lowers them into an opening rightward sweep with the left knee extending. The left arm curls upward while the right hand drops, then sweeps left as the left hand continues climbing. Both knees bend and release in succession beneath another lift of the right hand, followed by a deeper bend and extension of the left knee as the left hand lowers and reaches right. The left hand returns left as both knees soften again, the right hand lifts and the left knee straightens. The right hand climbs farther while the left hand continues left, then the arms fold and reverse sideways, ending with the right hand rising again as the right knee extends.

The knees join a later knee bend after one hand lowers and sweeps left. That hand rises while the other arm folds, then both sweep right as the opposite knee softens and the hands descend. Both arms lengthen downward before lifting together, with the original hand returning left as the other curls upward. The curled arm reaches down and opens right, then folds up and back left while the other elbow bends and releases; the original hand rises again. That hand continues left as the opposite arm extends farther right, then reverses right with its own elbow opening.

The right hand sweeps left and down. The dancer raises the left hand, folds it inward as the right arm curls upward, then carries the left hand right while the right elbow opens and the right knee straightens. Both hands lower as the hands separate left and right, the right arm extending over a softening right knee before both knees straighten and the arms gather in. The right knee bends again beneath a rightward sweep of the left hand, which then drops and lengthens while the right hand rises; the right leg releases as the rising right hand moves left and both arms fold. The legs alternate bending and straightening through another lift and drop of the left arm, whose hand travels right, before the right hand lowers, the right knee softens and the right hand swings left. The right leg straightens as the left-moving right hand rises, then bends again beneath an upward curl of the left hand.

The dancer performs a contrasting arm exchange: the right hand rises while the left arm folds, lowers and opens as the left knee bends, then both hands descend and lengthen before the right hand moves right. The right hand sweeps left and climbs into a tuck as the left knee straightens, while the left elbow curls upward; both arms open downward, the left hand moving right before the right hand reverses left. Both hands rise again, the left arm drawing inward as the left knee softens, then the hands lower and separate rightward and leftward, with the right arm folding as the left knee extends. The left hand returns up-left into a deeper curl while the right hand reaches down-right and opens over another bend in the left knee; both hands sweep right and climb as the left knee straightens and the left elbow draws inward. The left arm continues curling higher while the right hand opens left, then the right hand drops and both elbows fold as the left hand sweeps left.

Both hands sweep right as the arms lengthen, then curl upward and left before opening downward. The hands return right and fold higher while the right knee bends; they then separate left and right, rise, and reverse directions as the right knee straightens. Both arms tuck downward and sweep left, the left hand lifting back right into an extension as the left knee softens; the right hand climbs left and curls down-right as the right knee releases. The right hand continues right and opens into a lift while the left hand folds down-left, then rises as the left knee straightens and the raised arm tucks left. The left hand lifts right and drops through a fold as the left knee extends, then reaches up-right while the right arm lowers and lengthens. The right hand rises left as the right knee beneath it bends, then returns right and curls upward as the same right knee straightens again.

The right knee straightens as the dancer lifts the left hand leftward and lengthens the left arm, then extends the right arm down-left while the right knee bends and releases again. Both hands sweep right with the initial left arm opening, before the right arm curls upward and returns down-left as both knees soften and the hands reverse left together. The left arm reaches up-right while the right arm folds downward and the right knee straightens; the raised left hand reverses left into a curl as the left knee bends. The curled left hand rises through an extension and a renewed tuck while the right knee deepens its bend, then the hands separate right and left with the initial left elbow opening. The right arm curls higher and moves left as the right knee releases, while the left hand lowers and swings right before returning left. The left hand rises, dips left, and sweeps right as the right arm opens and lifts farther right.

In opposition, the dancer sweeps the right hand left and down while the left arm lengthens upward; both hands then descend as the right arm curls inward. The right arm reaches right and up before folding again, while the left hand moves right and rises with an opening elbow. Both arms draw in and lower, the right hand returning left as the left arm extends. The left hand lifts and tucks while the right hand opens downward, then both elbows release into a descending reach. The right hand reverses right and curls upward as the right knee straightens, while the left hand drops left and the left knee softens.

The right knee straightens as the left arm curls left and rises, followed by the left hand lifting and folding into a rightward reach. The left hand drops toward the right while the right arm lowers and opens, then both arms curl upward with the right arm moving left. The hands sweep down and right, then separate left and right before reversing sideways and rising again, the left elbow tucked and the right extended. Both hands descend and spread apart once more, with the left arm lengthening.

As the right hand drops left, the dancer lowers the left hand, then raises both hands with the right elbow folding before extending. The left arm lengthens down and right while the right arm curls upward, followed by a bend in the left knee and another lift of the left hand as the right hand travels right. The left knee straightens and the left arm opens downward while the right arm extends farther right and rises; the knees soften together, and the hands reverse sideways as the right elbow tucks. Both arms reach upward and apart, then fold inward as the right knee bends deeper and the left hand sweeps right and down. The right knee releases and the right hand climbs into an extension while the left arm curls upward.

The right hand travels right and curls upward. The left arm opens down and left as the right hand drops, then both hands sweep left with the left hand folding and the left knee bending before straightening; the right hand reverses right and rises while the right knee softens and the left hand continues left. Both arms lengthen downward and separate right and left, then fold upward with a shared leftward reversal as the right knee bends and releases and the left leg straightens. The hands descend and spread again, the right hand curling up and left while the left hand tucks right; they reverse directions with the right arm opening downward and the left arm folding higher. The left hand rises into a deeper curl as the right hand sweeps left and back right, then both elbows release and the hands fall apart, the left-moving arm extending farther left and upward while the right arm lifts and folds.

The right hand rises into a curl while the left hand drops and lengthens, then the right arm opens downward as the right knee softens. The left hand sweeps left and curls upward before both hands climb, with the right arm folding and both knees bending more deeply; the right arm then extends down as the left knee straightens. The left hand drops and reaches right as the left knee bends again, while the right hand travels right, lowers and tucks, then returns left and up as both arms fold. The right hand descends farther while the left hand rises and opens, followed by a rightward sweep of the left hand and another bend in the left knee. Both hands lift as the left elbow folds and the left knee straightens, then they separate left and right while the right arm reaches down. The hands return left together, the left hand lowering as the left knee sinks and the right arm lengthens, ending with a bend in the right knee.

The dancer curls both arms upward. The hands separate left and right; the right arm lengthens as the left knee softens, then both arms sweep down and left with a fold before reversing right as the bent left knee releases. The arms unfold downward and sweep left again; the left hand rises while the right arm extends farther and the right knee straightens. The right arm curls right as the left knee bends, then both hands descend and the elbows open. Both hands lift toward the right; the left elbow folds before the right arm reaches up and left. The left arm returns right and opens as the left knee straightens, then both arms lower into tighter tucks and rise again. The left hand sweeps left and drops as the left knee bends and releases, while the right arm curls right and the right knee sinks before straightening. Both hands climb as the left knee softens and the right hand continues right. The hands descend and separate left and down-right; the left arm opens as the left knee releases and the right arm tucks higher.

The dancer lowers and lengthens the right arm, then curls the left arm upward as both hands sweep left. The right hand rises with its elbow folding, then drops while the left hand lifts farther right; both arms open before the left hand descends into a tuck. The right elbow bends again as the right hand reaches up-right and the left hand moves down-left, then the right arm opens downward and the left knee softens. The right arm curls up-right as the left knee straightens, followed by an extension of the left arm. The right knee softens beneath another lift of the right hand, then straightens as both elbows fold and the right hand falls left. Both knees bend in succession, the right knee extending as the left knee sinks deeper, while the right arm continues to curl upward and the right leg lengthens further.

A side-to-side arm exchange begins with the right hand rising leftward as the left hand moves right, then the right arm lengthens down and curls back up while the left arm folds lower. The right hand sweeps right and drops as the left elbow opens, before both hands lift, the right hand moving left and curling downward again while the left arm tucks left. The right hand rises rightward over a bending right knee, then returns left and down with the right arm opening as the left hand descends and the left knee softens; the left hand reverses right and rises into a fold. The knees trade bends as the right hand lifts left and the left hand drops right, then both arms extend through another bend of the right knee and a release of the left knee. The left knee straightens as the left arm reaches up and left, followed by the right hand lifting leftward and folding while the left arm rises and curls right. The right hand drops and opens as the left knee bends, then the right knee sinks while the left arm lengthens and lowers and the left leg extends.

An alternating arm sweep begins with the dancer lifting and folding the right hand while the left hand moves left, then reversing their lateral directions as both hands descend. The initially lifted right arm opens down-right, followed by the left hand sweeping right and curling upward. That raised left arm lengthens downward while its opposite right arm continues right and drops, then both elbows fold as the right hand returns left and the left hand rises and travels farther right. The rightward left hand lowers as the right hand climbs, and both arms extend before the right hand swings left and back right while the left arm reaches farther upward. The left hand reverses left as the right arm curls upward, then both hands rise, the left hand moving right and returning left into a fold while the right arm extends.

To begin, the dancer curls the right arm upward and extends it down as the left hand drops right. The left hand returns left while the right knee bends, then both hands rise with folded arms before the right knee straightens and the hands separate sideways. The right arm lengthens downward as the left elbow tucks, then reaches right while the left hand lifts and the right knee softens further. The right knee releases as the right hand rises, and the left arm folds up-right before opening downward while the right arm curls upward again. Both knees bend in succession as the left hand moves right and the right hand reaches down-left; the right knee straightens as the left leg releases and the leftward-moving hand curls up-left over a renewed bend of the left knee.

The right knee softens as the dancer sends both hands left, then lifts the right hand into a curl while the left arm extends right and folds inward. The folded right hand rises farther before reversing right and dropping as the right arm opens, while the left arm tucks and lowers. Both arms lengthen downward, the right hand continuing right and then folding upward before opening again. The right hand sweeps left as the left arm curls up and releases, then the right arm gathers in once more.

The dancer makes a low rightward sweep with the right arm while the left arm folds, then lifts and opens the left arm before curling it back down as the right hand reverses left. The left arm tucks farther as the right knee softens, then both hands descend toward the right with lengthening arms. Both knees bend in succession beneath rising elbows; the right knee straightens as the right arm opens downward, while the left hand sweeps left and drops into a fold. Both hands continue left, the right arm extending while the left arm curls upward, then the hands return right as the left elbow releases and the left knee bends. The right arm reaches up-right as the left knee extends and the left hand lowers; both hands sweep left, the left arm lifting and folding, before the right hand rises and the left hand drops right with an opening elbow.

The dancer lifts the left hand left. The left arm curls inward and reverses right as the right hand rises left, then both hands descend with the left elbow opening before they separate sideways again. The left hand returns left while the right hand curls up-right and falls back left; the right arm lengthens down-left as the left hand climbs. Both hands lift and sweep right, then the right hand drops while the left hand lowers and folds before rising right and tucking farther in. The right hand follows upward to the right as the left hand drops, then both hands move left with the right elbow folding.

The dancer lengthens the right arm. Both knees soften in succession; the left knee straightens as the right hand curls up and left, then both arms open and that raised right hand returns right while the left knee bends again. The left hand lowers and sweeps right as the right hand reaches down-left; the right knee bends farther while the left hand continues right, then reverses left into a curl as the bent right knee straightens. That curled right hand rises while the left arm extends down-right, then both hands descend and separate right and left with a renewed fold of the left elbow. The right knee softens and straightens beneath another upward sweep right and back left, accompanied by the left knee's bend and release and a lowering of the left hand. The left hand reaches right as the left knee bends, while the right arm curls upward to the right and the right knee sinks again.

In unison, the dancer lifts both hands. The right arm folds while the left arm extends, then the right hand drops left and both hands sweep right as the right knee straightens. The left hand curls upward, sweeps left and back right with a deeper tuck, then lowers as the left knee softens and the right hand rises again. Both hands climb into bent arms as the right knee lengthens, then descend with further extension before the hands reverse sideways and rise once more. The left knee bends while the right hand dips left and rebounds; both arms open downward, then lift together with the left knee straightening.

In unison, both arms lower and sweep left as one knee straightens, then both hands rise and separate right and left with folding elbows. The right hand drops while the left arm extends upward; the right hand rebounds into a tuck as the left elbow folds and the left hand dips, followed by another lift of the left hand. Both hands descend and the left arm opens, then they reverse sideways before curling upward as the knees bend and straighten in succession. The left arm unfolds and drops while the right hand climbs, then curls farther up and left as the right hand rises and its knee bends. That bent knee straightens while the right hand sweeps down and right and the left arm opens downward. The dancer lifts the right hand again and sends it left and down, then repeats the opening and lowering of the left arm before raising it once more.

The right knee bends and releases as the right hand drops, then curls upward while the left arm folds leftward. The right hand lowers into an extension to the right as the right knee straightens, then reverses left and rises with a tighter tuck. The right arm opens farther left and down before curling back up and right, accompanied by another bend of the right knee; both hands lift, the right hand continuing right as the left arm lengthens downward. The right hand returns left and descends while the left hand moves right, then the right hand curls upward again. The left arm extends left as the right knee softens and the right hand reaches right, before both arms fold and lower, the left hand returning right. Both knees straighten as the right arm opens down to the left and the left arm tucks into a final lift.

The dancer performs a rising arm exchange: the right hand climbs right, then both arms lengthen downward as the left knee softens and the left hand sweeps left. The right knee bends while the left hand rises, curls left and drops into an extension. Both hands sweep right with the left arm folding upward, then return left as the knees straighten and the right elbow opens; the hands rise again before the left knee bends and the left hand lowers. The right hand reaches down-right while the left arm folds and moves right, then rises with a bend in the left knee and an opening of the right arm. Both hands descend as the knees straighten, then the right arm tucks upward to the right while the left arm lifts, extends left and returns right. The hands drop together as the left elbow bends and the right hand shifts left.

At the outset, the dancer sends the left hand left and down while the right hand rises right, then sweeps both hands left with the left arm curling upward as the right arm extends. The left hand reverses right into a fold while the right hand continues left, then lowers and opens. The left hand moves left and up before returning right and folding as the right elbow tucks inward. Both hands sweep left, the left hand lowering while the right arm extends, then reverse right and rise, the left arm lengthening before folding again. The hands separate left and right, then both arms curl upward, finishing with the right hand reaching farther right and extending.

The dancer sweeps the right hand left. The left arm curls upward as the right hand returns right and the right knee softens, then both hands descend while the right knee straightens; the left arm extends before both hands rise with another bend in the left knee. The right hand lowers into a tighter fold as the knees trade their bends, then both arms lengthen and the hands sweep left. The right hand climbs and reaches farther left while the left knee straightens and the left arm tucks downward, followed by another bend in the left knee and an upward curl of the right arm. The left arm opens as the left knee releases, then both knees soften again while the right hand descends left and the left hand moves right; the right elbow folds, the left hand rises, and the right hand rebounds up and right.

The right knee straightens as the dancer lifts the left hand leftward, then extends both arms and softens the right knee while the left hand rises. The hands separate right and left, then descend as the knees lengthen; the right arm curls up-left while the left arm folds upward and moves right. Both hands lower with opening elbows, then rise again as the right knee bends and straightens and the left hand swings right before returning left. The right hand drops and tucks farther inward as the right knee sinks deeper, while the left hand sweeps left, down and back right. The left hand continues right and rises through an extension into a fold, finishing with the right hand moving left.

The dancer lifts the right hand. The left knee softens as the left hand moves right and the right arm extends left, then both hands descend with the left arm opening and folding again. The right hand climbs and sweeps right while the left hand travels left, then returns right as the right knee bends; both elbows open before the left arm curls upward. Both hands lower and the right arm reaches farther right over a deeper bend of the right knee, then rises left into a tuck as the left knee straightens and the left hand lifts right. The left arm lengthens down-right as the right hand descends and the bent knee releases, then both arms fold while the left knee softening again sends the left hand up-left and the right hand right.

The dancer raises both hands. The right arm curls upward and sweeps left while the left arm opens down, then both arms lengthen as the right hand descends; the left hand travels right before both return left with bent elbows and the right hand lifts again. The left hand drops into an extension while the right arm reaches farther up and right, then folds back left as the left arm rises and opens right. Both hands descend, the left hand curling upward and left before reversing right and lowering alongside the right hand's rise. The left hand returns left and folds higher while the right elbow tucks, then both sweep right with the left arm opening and the right arm dropping into a deeper fold. The right hand rebounds upward and left into another reach as the left arm continues right and down.

The dancer raises the right hand. The right arm folds inward while the left hand drops and moves left, then the right hand sweeps right and descends as the right knee softens; both hands return left and rise, with the left arm curling inward. Both arms extend downward, the right hand continuing left as the left knee bends and releases, then the right knee sinks further while the hands reverse toward the right and rise again. The right arm folds and reaches farther right as the right knee straightens, while the left knee softens and both hands descend. The hands separate left and right, the right arm opening into a lift as the left elbow tucks and the left knee bends deeper; the hands then sweep left together and lower before the left knee releases.

As the right hand moves right, the dancer folds the right arm and lowers it, then raises both hands before lowering them again with a deeper curl. The left hand sweeps left and rises as the right knee straightens, then the right hand follows left into another fold while the left arm opens downward. The left arm extends farther down as the right arm tucks, then the hands separate right and left, the left hand dropping and opening before returning right and rising into a fold against the right arm's descent and extension. Both arms lengthen as the right hand drops, then the left arm curls upward while the right hand continues down and the right knee softens; the left hand reaches left and releases downward. The hands rise together, the right arm folding as the left elbow opens, then descend with the right arm extending before lifting once more.

The dancer extends the right arm right. The left hand moves left and rises as the right arm folds, then both arms lengthen before the right arm curls upward while the left knee straightens and the left hand reverses left. Both hands descend with folding elbows, sweep right, then lift into a shared leftward return; the right knee bends as the right arm opens and the right hand drops. The right hand reverses right and curls upward as the left arm reaches down and left, then the left knee straightens while the left hand lifts and the right knee softens again. The raised right arm draws farther inward as the left hand climbs right, followed by the lowered left arm lifting left, and finishes with both hands descending toward the right.

In opposition, the right hand curls up-right and the left hand rises left, then both arms lengthen as the left hand lowers. The right arm folds again while the left hand sweeps down-left and back right with a bend of the left knee. The left knee straightens as the hands separate, the right hand moving left and extending downward while the left hand rises rightward. The left hand returns left and drops as the right hand continues down-left and opens; the right hand reverses right and curls upward before dropping again. Both knees soften as the right hand moves right, then the left knee releases while the right hand lifts leftward and extends.

The dancer lengthens the left arm down and left. The left hand returns right and curls upward as the right arm reaches left, then both arms extend downward and sweep left while the left knee straightens. The right arm folds up to the right and opens back left while the left arm tucks upward; the hands separate, the left hand reaching right and lowering as the left knee bends, before both arms open into a rising, inward sweep. Both knees soften and the hands reverse outward, then the elbows draw in and the hands climb with another bend of the right knee. Both hands descend, the left hand returning right as the left knee releases; the right knee straightens while the right hand moves right and curls up, joined by the left arm's upward fold. The left hand sweeps left as both knees sink and the left elbow opens, followed by a lift and inward curl of the right arm over its bending knee.

To begin, the right hand sweeps left and down while the left hand curls upward; the right arm folds and lifts as the left elbow opens. Both hands descend with folding elbows, then the right arm reaches right and up while the left knee bends and straightens beneath a shared lift. The hands separate left and right, lower and reverse inward before the left hand rises into a curl. Both arms open downward, then sweep right and rise together as the left knee softens again. The left knee straightens and both hands descend into folded arms, then the hands return left with the right elbow opening.

The right knee softens, then the left knee softens beneath two opposing hand sweeps: the right arm reaches right while the left arm lowers left and lengthens, then both arms curl as the left arm returns right and the left knee straightens. The right hand rises and opens down toward the right as the left knee bends again; the right hand lifts into a tuck and drops left while the left arm continues right and curls higher, the right knee releasing before bending once more. The hands reverse sideways with the right arm extending downward and folding upward again, while the left knee softens and straightens beneath a further leftward reach and release of the left arm. Both arms lengthen downward as both knees bend, then the right hand climbs and folds while the left arm reaches farther left and down, the left knee straightening. The hands continue apart as the right elbow opens and the left arm curls upward and right, followed by the right hand lifting into a tighter fold.

As the right hand rises, the dancer folds the right arm rightward and lengthens it back left. The left hand curls upward while the right arm tucks further, then both arms descend as the left elbow opens. Both arms gather in toward the right, and the right hand lifts before both hands rise again. The right arm releases downward, then folds back up as the left hand drops and reaches farther right. The right hand lowers once more while the left hand continues extending right.

The right hand rises as the left hand lifts left. The dancer lengthens both arms, then lowers and folds the right hand while the left hand opens right; the hands separate left and right before the left arm curls upward and the right hand drops. Both hands sweep right, the right hand rising as its arm opens, then return left with the right hand folding and the left hand extending downward. The right arm lengthens again, followed by the left elbow opening and the right hand dropping as its knee bends; the left hand lowers, then the right hand moves right into a fold. The left arm tucks and reaches down-left as the right hand extends downward, and both hands continue left with the left hand lifting while the knees bend in succession. The right hand sweeps right and returns left as the left knee straightens, then the left arm folds and lowers while the right hand rises and both elbows curl inward.

To begin, the dancer lowers the right hand while extending the left arm leftward and lifting it. The left hand sweeps right as the right knee softens, then both hands descend and the left arm folds back left. The left arm opens upward into a rightward reach, followed by the right hand rising toward the right. Both arms lengthen downward, then curl upward again, with the right hand moving left. The right hand drops open, rises folded, then falls and extends rightward as the left arm reaches down to the right.

In opposition, the dancer extends the right arm right while the left arm reaches left, then brings both hands back toward their original sides. The right hand lowers and lengthens as the right knee straightens, then curls upward while the left hand drops; the left knee bends as the rising right hand sweeps left and the left arm opens downward. The lower left hand rises into a fold as the bent left knee releases, while the right hand continues down and right with an extending elbow. Both arms reach farther apart before reversing inward, and the right hand lifts as the left hand curls up and left. The hands separate again, the right hand moving left and the left hand moving right, then reverse sideways as the right arm folds and both hands descend.

The right hand rises rightward and curls inward. The dancer sweeps both hands left, the left arm folding before extending down as the right hand drops; they reverse right, the right elbow opening while the left arm folds again. The right hand climbs as the left arm returns left with an unfolding arm, then the raised right arm opens downward and both sweep right before curling upward together. Both arms lengthen into a leftward descent, then rise with folded elbows as the right hand returns right; the left arm follows right and opens downward while the right hand lowers and reaches farther right. Both hands climb left, the right hand folding and continuing left before reversing right as the left arm moves right, and they lower with the left arm opening.

The dancer performs alternating arm lifts and drops: the right hand lowers as the right knee softens, then rises while the left hand curls upward and the left leg straightens. The right hand moves right as both knees bend, then returns left with a deeper fold while the left knee extends and the left hand dips. Both hands climb as the left leg lengthens further, the right arm opening before the left arm curls and continues rising. The right knee bends and releases as the raised arm tucks, followed by the left knee sinking; the hands separate left and right, the left hand descending into an extension. The right arm curls upward while the left arm folds and lifts leftward, then opens as the right knee bends again. The right elbow draws tighter while the left arm reaches down and right and the left knee straightens.

The dancer curls the right arm upward. The left hand rises and folds, then both arms extend left as the right knee lengthens; the right knee bends while the left arm tucks right and the left knee straightens. The right hand sweeps up and right, then drops left into a deeper fold before lifting again as the right knee softens. Both hands shift right with the left arm opening downward and the right elbow curling tighter. The right hand returns left as the left knee bends, then reverses right while the left leg straightens; the left arm extends left as the right knee releases. The left hand continues left and rises into a fold while the right hand moves right and lowers.

The left knee softens beneath a leftward left hand sweep, then the right arm extends left and curls back right as the left knee bends further. The left hand continues left while the right hand lowers and opens; both arms lengthen before the left arm folds upward and both hands move right. The right hand lifts and falls, then both arms gather inward as the left hand climbs again and the right hand curls up-right. The left arm extends downward while the right arm tucks higher, then opens down-left as the left arm reaches right. Both hands rise with bent elbows, then the left hand sweeps left and the right hand drops into an extension.

The arms move in opposition: the right arm reaches right and curls upward as the left arm drops, then both hands lower before the right arm opens left and the left hand lifts right. The right-moving hand dips and returns up-left while the left arm folds and sweeps down-right, its knee straightening as that hand reverses left. Both arms lengthen downward, then curl upward as the same knee bends; the left arm extends again while the bent knee releases. The hands separate left and right with another shared rise, the right-moving arm folding into a descent, before both return left and descend, the right arm opening while the left tucks. The right hand climbs left as the left elbow releases, then both sweep right and drop with the right arm lengthening and the left folding inward.

The arms rise together, the right arm folding rightward and the left arm folding leftward before both hands descend. The right arm curls upward as the right knee straightens and bends again, then reaches down-left while the left hand drops and the left knee softens; the right hand reverses right and rises into a fold as the right knee extends and the left leg lengthens. The right arm opens and lowers while the left arm tucks and lifts leftward, then both elbows gather inward as the hands separate right and left and the left hand descends. The right arm curls up-right, then opens back left as the left knee straightens; the right hand climbs farther while the left arm folds rightward and the left knee extends. Both hands move right as the left elbow releases and the right arm tucks, then the left hand sweeps left and rises through a curl while the right arm unfolds downward.

The right knee bends as the dancer curls the left arm upward and sweeps its hand left, then both hands rise while the right knee straightens. The left arm tucks farther left as the right hand descends and the left knee bends; the right arm folds rightward before both hands lift with lengthening elbows, then sweep left as the right knee softens again. Both knees extend in succession while the left arm opens downward and the right elbow curls, followed by a fold of the descending right arm as the right knee bends and releases beneath another bend and release of the left knee. The left hand rises with an extending elbow as the right knee softens, then drops and sweeps right while the right hand lowers and the left knee bends further; the left hand reverses left as the left knee sinks and the right arm reaches down-right. The hands continue separating left and right as both knees straighten, then reverse inward with the left arm curling upward and the right hand lifting. Both arms open, the left hand falls left while the right hand climbs and moves right, and the left knee bends once more.

The right knee straightens while the dancer lowers and lengthens the right arm, then lifts the right hand right as the left arm extends down. The right hand returns left and folds in as the right knee softens and the left knee bends, before both knees straighten and the right arm reaches right again. Both hands sweep left and descend with folding elbows, then the right arm curls upward to the right and releases downward while the left knee sinks. The right hand travels right as the right knee bends farther, then reverses left and drops into a tighter fold. The right knee straightens as the left arm tucks and lowers left, and both hands continue left with the right arm curling higher.

As the right knee straightens, the dancer sends both hands left and lowers them, then lifts the left hand while the right knee bends and releases again. Both arms open as the left knee softens and the right hand drops right; the knees trade bends before both knees lengthen and the left hand rises rightward. The hands sweep left together as the left arm curls, then the right knee bends while the curled arm extends down-left and both hands return right with the lower hand dropping farther. The right knee straightens as its hand reverses left, then the left knee bends beneath a downward-right curl and release of the lower arm. The lower arm tucks and carries its hand up-left, opening into a lift as the right hand returns right.

The right knee softens as the dancer sends the left hand left and down, then both hands rise with the right arm folding rightward while the right knee releases. The left arm tucks downward as the left knee straightens, then the right hand drops left and extends before returning up-right; the left knee bends again as the right hand moves left. The left arm reaches down-left as the knees trade bend and release, then curls upward while the right knee sinks and the right hand rises rightward into a fold. Both arms open and descend with alternating knee pulses, the right knee releasing and the left knee bending as their hands separate right and left. The hands lift and reverse sideways, the left elbow tucking as the left knee bends again; they fall with the right hand continuing left and both elbows opening.

The arms rise together. The right hand continues left as the left hand curls inward and lifts farther. The right arm opens while the left hand drops right, then both return left with the left arm lengthening. The left hand reverses right as the left knee softens, followed by the right knee bending while the left arm folds upward and sweeps left, down and back right into an extension. The left leg straightens beneath a rising leftward right hand, which then lowers and tucks before reaching right; the right arm opens again as the left knee bends and releases and the right elbow folds. The right hand climbs as the left leg extends, then drops through another bend and release of the left knee while the right arm reaches right and the right knee softens.

At the outset, the dancer curls the right arm up and right as the right knee straightens, then lowers the right hand into a fold while the left arm reaches right and drops. The right arm opens left, then returns right with a bend of the right knee as the left hand rises. The left hand travels right and descends into an extension while the right knee releases and the right arm folds; the left hand lifts right before both lower. The newly extended left arm reaches farther right and tucks back in as the right knee softens and the right hand climbs right, then lengthens downward. The left hand rises again, and the arms sweep left together before both hands descend, the right arm opening.

The right knee bends and releases as the dancer lengthens both arms downward, then curls them upward with a rightward hand sweep. Both hands descend and separate sideways, the left hand moving left and the right hand moving right, while the right knee sinks again beneath the right arm's rising curl and the left knee folds into another lift. The right arm extends down-left as the left hand dips and returns right, before the right arm draws up-right and the left hand reverses left. Both hands lower and continue apart, the right hand moving right and the left hand moving left, then rise with the left hand returning right as the right knee softens and the left arm tucks; both knees straighten in succession. The left arm reaches farther right and down as the right hand moves left, then the descending right hand reverses up-left and curls inward.

The right knee straightens as the dancer lifts the right hand rightward, then bends the right knee while the left arm reaches up and left into a fold. The left arm opens down and left, the right hand rising before both return right with the right elbow tucking. The hands reverse left, the right hand lowering into an extension while the left hand climbs, then both sweep right with the right hand dropping farther. Both arms lengthen as the right hand continues downward and sweeps left, then rises and returns right while the left hand dips left. The left arm opens upward as the right arm folds and descends.

As the right arm folds, the dancer lifts and carries the right hand right, then lowers both hands while extending the right arm left. The left arm curls upward as the right knee softens, then reaches down toward the right before both elbows tuck and the left hand rises again. The right hand sweeps left and back right while the left hand drops into an extension, and the knees straighten in succession as the right hand reverses left. Both hands climb with the leftward arm folding and the right elbow opening, then the folded arm extends as the left hand travels right and descends. The descending arm lengthens farther downward and sweeps left, finishing with a bend at the knee beneath it.

In unison, the dancer sends both hands right. The knee beneath the arm that reaches left softens as that hand returns left and curls upward; both knees bend before the opposite leg straightens. Both hands descend with the leftward-reaching arm extending farther left, then rise together as the other knee bends and releases again. That leg lengthens while the leftward arm folds and drops, its knee straightening before the same hand reverses up and right into a tighter curl. The other arm tucks as the initial knee sinks, then opens and lifts alongside the curled hand.

In unison, the dancer lowers and lengthens both arms. The right hand curls upward and left while the left hand moves right and rises with a bent elbow. Then the right arm opens as the right knee softens and the left hand reverses left and drops. The right knee straightens as the left hand lifts into a curl, then bends again while the right hand sweeps right and back left. Both hands descend, the right hand reaching farther left before the knees exchange bend and extension. The right hand returns up to the right as the right knee sinks and the left leg lengthens, then folds downward while the left knee bends and straightens beneath a further drop of the right hand. The left hand curls upward as the left knee extends, while the right arm lengthens down to the right and then folds back up to the left. The left hand reaches right once more as the right knee straightens and the left knee bends, ending with the left arm opening farther right.

A side-to-side arm exchange begins with the right hand curling up and left as the left hand reaches down-right, then both reverse sideways and rise into folded elbows. The left arm lengthens downward while the right hand continues left, lowers and opens rightward; the left knee straightens as the left arm tucks upward and moves left. Both hands sweep right, the left arm extending and falling before curling back left, while the right hand lifts and drops, its elbow opening and folding again. The right arm curls upward, sweeps right and descends as the left knee softens and the right knee bends and releases; the right hand rises leftward as the left hand climbs right. The left hand reverses left, then the right hand travels right and up as the left knee extends.

The arms trade height: the right hand rises and moves left as the right arm lengthens, while the left hand drops and opens. The right hand climbs farther before descending left into a fold, then reverses right with an extension as the left knee straightens. The right arm curls up again as the left hand lifts and folds, then lowers through a release and renewed tuck while the left hand descends left and the right knee bends. Both knees soften in succession as the hands reverse sideways, the lower arm opening downward and its knee straightening. The dancer extends both arms, sweeping the hands right as the left leg lengthens, then raises the lower hand left and curls it back right.

At the outset, the right hand rises while the left hand moves right and curls upward. The right hand continues climbing as the right arm folds more tightly, then drops before lifting again with a further inward tuck. The left arm opens downward as the right hand swings left and down, then curls up and returns right while the left knee softens. The right arm lifts farther as the left hand sinks and sweeps left, followed by another extension of the right arm. The left hand rebounds up and right as both arms lengthen and the left knee bends deeper, ending with the hands separated left and right.

The right hand moves right. The dancer lifts the left arm, then both hands rise with the left arm folding left as the left knee softens; the right hand curls upward and returns left before dropping while the left arm extends downward. Both arms open, the left hand sweeping right and back left as the knees straighten in succession, then the right hand climbs right into a fold while the left arm lowers and tucks. The right arm lengthens down-right as the left knee bends, then reverses up-left and unfolds farther while the right knee deepens; both hands descend as the left arm opens and the right knee straightens. The left arm curls upward over a softened knee while the right hand rises left into a bend, then the curled hand drops and opens as the left hand reaches right and the right hand lifts again.

As the right hand lowers, the dancer raises the left hand and folds both arms inward, then carries them right before reversing left as the left arm opens. Both hands descend with lengthening elbows, then the right hand reaches right and curls upward while the left hand moves right and rises into a tighter fold. The right arm extends down-right, followed by the left hand lowering as the left knee softens; both sweep left, the left hand lifting as the left knee straightens and the right elbow tucks. The left arm folds further while the right hand returns right and rises, then the right arm drops and opens into another lift as the left hand lowers and extends left. The leftward-reaching hand descends while the right arm curls upward and sweeps left, ending with the lower arm extending and the raised hand returning right.

As the right arm extends downward and the left hand moves right, both arms fold inward. The dancer opens the right arm toward the right while the left knee bends, then curls the right arm back left as the left knee straightens. Both hands sweep left with folding elbows before the right arm extends down and the left arm drops; the knees soften in succession as the right hand returns right. The right hand lifts and curls through a leftward reach, the right knee lengthening, then reverses right into a deeper tuck while the left hand rises. The left hand descends as the right knee softens, then the right hand travels left and up while the left hand continues down and right.

As the right hand lowers, the dancer folds the right arm while the left hand rises left and curls inward. The right arm opens into a rightward sweep as the right knee softens, then lifts while the left hand reverses right. Both hands descend, the right hand sweeping left and opening before returning right as the left arm extends downward. The right hand climbs farther right with an extended reach while the left hand moves left and curls upward; both elbows fold as the right hand drops. The hands separate right and left, then reverse sideways as the right arm lengthens through a rising sweep right and back left.

To begin, the dancer curls the right arm upward as the left hand moves left and rises, then lowers both arms while the right elbow opens and the right knee straightens. The hands sweep right, the right arm curling before dropping as both knees bend; the left hand lifts left and returns right as both knees extend. The right hand sweeps left and climbs with a folding elbow while the left knee softens, then drops as the left knee straightens and the left arm curls up to the left. Both hands reverse right with the right elbow tucked and the left knee bending, then descend into an opening of both arms as the knees lengthen. The right arm reaches down-left while the left hand continues right and lowers with an opening elbow, followed by the right hand moving right.

As the right hand rises and sweeps left, the left arm extends downward. The right hand drops right while the left knee straightens and the left hand lifts left into a curl. Both hands reverse sideways, the right hand moving up-left as the left hand descends, then the left hand curls upward and reaches down-right with an opening elbow. The right arm folds down-left, opens back right, then lowers farther right as the right knee lengthens; both elbows tuck before the right hand reverses left and rises. The right hand continues left and lifts again as the left hand moves right, then both hands descend.

The right knee softens as the dancer lowers and lengthens the right arm, then curls the right arm upward while the right leg straightens. The left hand sinks into a fold and lifts left with the right hand, whose elbow opens before both arms tuck inward. Both hands descend and sweep right, the left arm extending as the left knee bends and releases; the right arm reaches down and right, folds back up-left, then opens and drops again. The right hand climbs right and reverses left into a curl as the left knee softens and the left arm extends downward. The right arm opens down-right while the left hand lifts left, then both rise and the left arm lengthens farther.

The arms trade height as the dancer bends and straightens the right knee, then folds the left arm while the initially lowered right hand lifts left and tucks. The folded left arm releases downward as both knees soften and the right leg extends; the hands move right with a renewed curl on the right side, then the left arm opens down and rises left while the right knee beneath it bends further. That raised left hand lowers and swings right, then both hands rise as the right knee straightens and the left leg lengthens before folding again; the hands descend and separate left and right, the right-moving arm opening. Both knees bend as the left-moving arm curls upward and the right hand sweeps left and back right, then the legs release and the hands lower, the right hand continuing right while the left knee softens and its left arm reaches down. The reaching left hand lifts and falls into an extension as the left knee straightens, while the right hand moves left and rises, then drops as the right knee bends again.

The right knee straightens as the dancer curls both arms upward and lifts the right hand toward the right. The right arm extends while the left arm reaches left, then the right arm reverses right and rises into a fold as the left knee lengthens. The folded right arm sweeps left, opens and drops before curling back up to the right against the left hand's leftward descent. Both hands lower and move left, with the right knee beneath the initially raised right arm softening as the right arm unfolds. The right knee straightens again as the left hand moves right and the left knee bends.

A rising and falling arm figure begins with the dancer bending both elbows, lowering the left hand left while the right hand moves right. The left arm opens and the left knee straightens as the right hand drops, then the right hand curls upward again while the left arm folds left. Both hands descend with the left arm extending, then rise together as the left arm lengthens farther and the right arm tucks. The right arm opens left while the left hand moves right, then both lower and reverse sideways before lifting with bent elbows. The left arm extends downward as the right knee straightens, followed by a further drop of the right hand.

As the right knee straightens, the dancer lowers and lengthens the right hand rightward while the left arm folds upward. The right hand reverses left as the left arm opens downward, then both arms curl upward in succession, the right hand shifting right. Both hands descend with the elbows extending before they rise again; the left hand travels left, and the right hand follows that direction. The leftward-reaching left arm curls higher and releases as the right arm lifts and folds, ending with both hands moving left and the right elbow tucking.

At the outset, the right hand sweeps left and down as the right arm folds, while the left hand reaches right; both knees then soften in succession. The hands rise and sweep right with folding elbows before descending as the arms open, the right knee straightening as the right hand reverses left and both hands climb again. Both arms tuck and lower into a leftward sweep, then the right hand returns right and rises as the right knee bends further and the right elbow opens, followed by the left hand lifting and curling as the left knee straightens. The left hand swings left and back right while the right hand drops left, then both rise as the right arm lengthens. The hands separate, the left hand continuing right while the right hand lowers and moves right, then returns left as the left hand climbs farther right and folds.

As the right arm lengthens upward, the dancer folds the left arm and carries both hands right, then lowers the right hand while the left arm climbs. Both arms curl as their hands reverse left, then sweep right with the right hand dipping before rising again. The left hand climbs and extends left while the right hand continues right and down; both arms fold, the right hand reverses left, and the left hand lifts while the right hand drops. The left arm reaches right and curls upward as the right arm tucks, then both hands descend and the left hand returns left while the right hand travels right.

As the right knee straightens, the dancer lowers the left hand and folds the left arm while the right arm curls upward. The rising right arm extends down toward the right as the left arm reaches left and lengthens, then both elbows open before their hands reverse sideways and the right knee beneath the initially raised right arm softens. The right hand climbs and returns left with a folded elbow while the left hand drops, then sweeps right and rises into a curl as the right knee bends further. Both knees deepen their bend as the left hand swings left and back right, then reverses left again while the right hand lifts rightward. The left arm tucks farther as the right knee straightens and the left hand continues left, ending with the left arm reaching right.

The right arm and left arm oppose each other. The dancer raises the right hand while the left arm curls right and lowers, then extends left and upward as the left hand drops; both elbows open before the right hand reverses right and tucks while the left arm folds left. Both hands descend and return right with lengthening elbows, then the left hand climbs and the right hand drops, both arms drawing inward as the right hand returns left and the left knee bends and releases. The hands separate right and left, the left hand rising into a curl while the right elbow opens, then both reverse sideways and fold again before the right hand dips right and rises back left as the right knee softens. The right hand climbs farther left while the left knee straightens and the left arm lengthens downward; the right hand moves right and drops as the left hand continues down-right, then curls left and up while the right elbow folds. The right hand swings right and returns left against the left hand's leftward sweep, then both rise with bent elbows and move right as the left knee bends, ending with the right hand dropping and opening left.

The right arm curls up and left while the left hand drops, then both rise before the hands separate right and left. The left arm extends down-left as the right knee softens, then the left hand curls up-right while the right arm lowers into a longer reach. Both arms lengthen downward and separate left and right, with the right knee bending further and the left arm folding upward. The left folded arm releases down-left as the right knee straightens, while the right arm reaches right and rises; the right hand returns right with a deeper tuck and opens as the left arm draws inward. Both hands descend, the left arm extending left before folding again while the right arm lifts, then both move right with the right elbow tightening.

In opposition, the dancer lowers the right hand left while the left arm curls up and right, then extends down as the right hand rises. The hands separate sideways, the right arm opening downward before both sweep left and fold upward. The right arm reaches out again as the left knee softens, then the right hand dips and rebounds into a tucked lift while the left hand travels right and drops. Both arms open, the right hand returning left and higher as the left hand follows that side, then folds upward while the right arm extends down and right. The right arm lengthens again and sweeps left as the left hand lifts rightward.

The right knee straightens as the dancer curls the left arm upward and the right hand rises rightward, then opens that raised left arm into a drop while the right elbow tucks. The initially raised left hand continues down toward the right as the left knee bends, softens the right knee, and the arms lengthen downward; both knees straighten before the hands separate left and right, with the right hand lifting as the right knee bends again. The hands sweep up and left together, then return right with the left knee bending and straightening and both elbows drawing in. Both hands descend, the right arm opening as the right knee softens, then rise together before curling back left and descending again. The right knee bends as the right arm extends rightward and drops, joined by the left hand's rightward sweep; the right leg straightens as both hands lift and sweep left, then the left knee softens beneath a shared downward rightward reach and rising curl. The right hand returns left as the left arm unfolds, dips rightward, and lifts with the right hand into another rightward extension.

As the right knee straightens, the dancer lowers and lengthens both arms, then sends the hands apart with a rightward reach on the right side and a leftward extension on the left. Both knees bend as the hands sweep down and left, then reverse sideways before lifting together, the left arm curling upward while its knee straightens and the right arm folds. The curled left hand sweeps right and down as the right knee bends and its arm opens; that right knee releases and re-bends beneath a leftward lift, then straightens as the raised left arm tucks. The tucked left hand drops toward the right as the right knee softens, then extends farther right and curls upward as its own right knee bends and straightens. The right hand lowers while the raised left arm continues opening right, then both rise as the right leg lengthens and the right-reaching hand returns left into a fold. The right knee bends again while the folded left arm lifts, and both legs straighten as that left hand drops and the right knee releases further.

At the outset, the dancer curls the right arm up-right while the left hand rises and moves left, then both descend as the right arm extends and both knees bend. The hands sweep right together before reversing left as the arms open, the left knee straightening and the left hand returning right while the right hand drops farther. The left knee bends again as the left hand sweeps down-left and curls upward against the right hand's rightward rise; the right knee softens while the left arm extends downward. The left arm folds back up-right as the right knee straightens, then both hands move right and descend with the right elbow opening, before the left hand returns left and the right knee bends. Both hands lift as the right arm tucks and the left knee releases, then the hands separate sideways and reverse inward with the right hand climbing into a tighter curl.

The right knee straightens and softens again as the dancer raises the left hand into a fold, then extends both arms downward while the right hand moves right. The left arm curls upward toward the right before opening down and left as the right knee lengthens; the right hand rises and returns left while the right knee bends, then both hands climb and sweep left with the left arm folding. The hands separate sideways as the left knee straightens, then reverse inward with the left leg bending and the left arm extending down; the hands exchange height as the bent knee releases and the right hand reaches up-left. Both arms tuck as the left hand lowers, then the right hand dips and rebounds while the left arm folds farther and drops. The left hand lifts through an extension and renewed curl as the right hand sweeps right, followed by another bend of the right knee and a further rise of the left hand with its arm opening.

The left knee straightens beneath a curling leftward left hand, then softens as the right arm folds and both hands descend. The dancer extends the right arm right while the left hand reaches left, then bends both knees in succession as the right hand drops farther right and the left hand rises. Both arms open toward the left before the left elbow folds; the right hand climbs left while the left hand returns right and lowers. The left arm lengthens downward and sweeps left as the left knee bends, then reverses right with another knee bend and extension while the right hand rises and tucks. The hands separate left and right, then reverse inward and down as the left elbow releases and both knees soften.

The right hand sweeps left and rises. The dancer lowers both hands, then lifts the left hand rightward while the right arm folds farther right. The right arm releases downward as the left arm curls up and left, then the left hand continues down and left before rising again with a tuck. Both hands descend and spread sideways, the right arm lengthening downward as the left arm curls upward. The left arm extends right and drops while the right hand reaches left, then they trade height and reverse their sideways paths, finishing with the right arm tucked and lowered.

The right hand sweeps left and down while the left hand rises rightward, both elbows folding before the right arm opens. The hands reverse sideways as the left elbow tucks, then the right hand climbs while the left hand drops and lengthens; the left hand continues up-left as both elbows open. The left hand lowers into a bend and reaches right while the right arm folds and lifts rightward, then the left hand curls upward as the right hand reverses left. Both arms extend downward, the right hand shifting left while the left hand moves right.

In opposition, the dancer curls the right arm upward and left while the left hand moves right and rises with a bend. The right arm opens downward as both hands sweep left, then returns up-right into another fold while the left arm lengthens.
