Both arms draw inward and rise before separating sideways, the right hand reversing right and the left hand moving left as the right knee softens. The right knee straightens while the left leg extends; both arms unfold downward and separate again, the right arm continuing right and the left arm sweeping left. The right arm folds upward as the left arm tucks left, then both hands descend with the left arm opening before the right hand returns left and its elbow releases.

The dancer folds both arms. The right hand curls right and rises while the left hand moves left, then drops as the right arm opens and the right knee straightens; the hands reverse horizontally before the right arm tucks again and the right knee lengthens farther. The left arm extends down and left as the right hand lifts right, then both sweep left with the right hand climbing into a tighter fold while the left arm reaches farther down. Both arms open, the left hand continuing downward as the right hand returns right, then reverses left and up against the left arm's curling lift. The left hand swings right and drops as the left knee softens, while the right arm lengthens downward and the right knee bends; both hands return left, the left one lifting and folding. The right hand rises right and opens as the right leg straightens, while the right arm tucks back left over a deeper bend of the right knee, then releases upward and right.

The dancer raises the right hand while the left hand travels right, then lowers both hands into a leftward sweep with folding elbows. The right arm curls upward and opens as the left hand rises; the right knee straightens before the left hand drops and both arms lengthen. The right elbow folds again while the left hand descends, then both sweep right and climb as the left arm extends. Both hands lower, the left sweeping left and reopening its elbow while the right arm tucks, then the right hand continues down toward the left. The right hand rebounds upward with an extending arm while the left lowers and reaches farther left.

In unison, the dancer lifts both hands, then extends the right arm left while the left hand moves right. The right hand continues upward and reaches farther left as the left knee softens; the left knee then straightens while the right hand drops and the left hand rises. The left knee bends again as the right hand curls upward, and both hands sweep left before the left arm lengthens downward and the left hand tucks further inward. The right arm opens into a rising reach to the right as the left hand descends, followed by another lift of the left hand while the left knee beneath it bends and releases. Both hands sweep right together, and the right arm folds back toward the left.

As the right hand sweeps left, the dancer raises the left arm, then lowers both hands and sends them right with opening elbows. Both arms curl upward, the right hand reversing left while the left hand continues climbing. The right hand drops as the right knee straightens and the left knee bends; both hands sweep left before the right elbow opens and the left hand rises again. The knees soften in succession as the left arm extends down and left, followed by the right hand descending and both elbows folding. With the left knee releasing, the hands separate right and left, then reverse sideways as the right arm curls up-right and the left arm extends downward.

The right hand travels right. The left hand follows as the right arm folds, then both hands descend and reverse left with the right elbow opening before rising into a shared curl. Both arms unfold, the right hand returning right while the left elbow tucks and the left knee softens; the right arm bends again as the left hand lowers. The right hand drops farther left while the left hand sweeps up-left and back down-right with an opening elbow. Both hands rise, the right hand moving right as the left hand returns left, and the left knee straightens while the left elbow gathers inward.

An alternating arm sweep begins with the dancer opening the left arm left while the right arm folds, then lifting both hands as the left arm curls and returns right. Both hands descend, the right arm extending down-left before folding back up-right and dropping again as the left hand rises left into a tuck. The hands separate left and right, the right hand rising while the left arm lengthens downward; they reverse sideways as the left elbow bends and its hand climbs right. The left hand lowers and extends farther right while the right hand continues right, opens downward, and sweeps left. The left hand lifts and falls once more, then rises again as the right hand descends farther left.

A rising leftward arm sweep begins as the dancer curls the left hand upward and carries it left while the right arm folds down and right, then opens downward. The left arm extends up and left while the right hand reaches right, before both rise with a renewed tuck on the left side. The left arm lengthens as the left knee straightens, then curls into a rightward lift while the right hand continues right; both hands descend as the left knee bends and releases again. Both arms fold through another shared lift, then separate right and left as the knees soften in succession, followed by an opening of the arms and another bend of the right knee. The hands climb again, the left arm extending while the right hand curls farther inward.

In opposition, the right hand sweeps left and the left hand sweeps right as both arms lengthen; the left hand then returns left while the right hand rises. The rising right arm folds inward and continues upward as the left arm curls higher and farther left, then both hands descend into open reaches. The initially raised right hand lifts again with a tucked elbow, while the left hand travels left and down before reversing right and curling upward. The left hand continues upward and left as the right hand drops, then both lower, the right hand folding before both elbows extend. The dancer repeats this alternating lift-and-drop pattern, finishing with the right arm curled upward while the left hand falls.

In unison, both arms rise and reach left, then separate: the right hand sweeps right and the left hand extends left. Both elbows fold as the hands descend, then the right arm opens again while the left arm tucks higher and continues upward. The left arm lengthens farther left and lowers, while the right elbow folds deeper and the right hand travels right. The right arm curls up to the right, followed by the left arm drawing inward as the left knee bends and straightens; both hands then drop before the left hand sweeps left and both elbows open. The left-moving hand lifts and returns right with a tucked elbow, while the right arm folds down to the left and rises back right over another bending knee. The left arm extends farther right and drops as the left knee straightens, then folds upward to the left before releasing downward.

The dancer sends the right hand right. The right arm folds and lowers while the left arm rises left, then both hands sweep right as the right arm opens upward; the left arm tucks and the right knee bends before both elbows release. The left arm curls down-left, then lengthens and rises again as the right hand moves left and the right knee straightens. Both hands climb into tucked arms, separate right and left, then lower with the left arm opening and the right elbow releasing. The hands continue downward as the right arm gathers inward, followed by the left hand lifting into a fold and returning right. The right hand sweeps left and up as the right arm releases, then returns right and drops into another bend.

A rising arm figure begins with both hands moving left, the right arm curling upward and the left arm folding. The right hand climbs farther while the left arm lengthens downward, then both sweep right before the left arm tucks and its hand rises as the right hand drops. The right hand returns left into a deeper fold while the left hand continues down-right; the right arm then opens downward alongside the left hand. Both arms gather inward and lift, the left hand traveling right, before the left hand descends and its elbow releases. The right arm curls upward once more as the left hand moves left.

The right hand moves right. The left arm folds and releases as the right arm lengthens downward, then both hands rise with the left arm curling while the right knee bends and straightens; the right arm extends farther before its hand lowers and the left hand drops leftward. Both arms open as the left hand rises and falls, then the right arm lifts and curls in while the left knee softens beneath a further drop of the left hand. The left hand swings left and back right into an extension as the right knee bends, then sinks again while the right arm tucks leftward and the bent knee straightens. Both knees soften in succession as the right hand rises, the right knee straightening while the left hand sweeps up-right and curls inward. The right hand reaches left and down as the right knee bends, while the left hand continues climbing to the right and the left knee extends.

The right knee softens as the dancer lowers both hands, then lifts them into a rightward sweep with the right arm extending before both elbows fold. The left hand rises while the right hand drops and moves left, followed by the left hand lowering and sweeping left as the right knee bends further. Both arms lengthen downward, the right hand continuing left and then returning up-right while the left elbow folds; the right hand reverses down-left as the left knee straightens and the left arm reaches out. The right knee bends beneath another descent of both hands, with the left arm curling inward, while the right arm extends down-right. The left hand sweeps left and rises as the left knee softens again, then both hands lower with the right arm folding and the left arm opening.

As the right hand drops, the dancer curls the left arm upward and left, then lowers both hands with the left arm extending before lifting it again. The right hand continues down while the left hand reaches right, then folds downward as the right knee softens; the left arm lengthens before both hands rise and the right knee straightens. Both elbows tuck, the right arm reaching farther while the left hand moves right and descends, then reverses left as the right arm opens and sweeps right. The right knee bends and releases beneath a folded lift of the right hand, which then extends right and drops as the left hand rises into a deeper curl. The right arm folds higher while the left elbow opens, then both hands sweep right, the right hand lowering before they reverse left and climb together. The right hand finishes by dropping back to the right.

As the right arm folds, the dancer lowers and lengthens the left arm, then sends both hands right. The right hand rises while the left hand curls upward to the left; the right hand reverses left as the right arm extends. The right hand drops and reaches farther left before lifting again, while the left arm opens downward and moves left. The right arm lengthens further as the left hand continues down and left.

A descending hand sweep begins as the dancer extends the right arm downward, then curls it upward and right while the left knee softens. The newly lifted right arm opens left and drops as the left knee straightens; both hands continue down and left before the right arm curls upward again and the left arm lengthens down to the right. Both knees bend in succession as the hands reverse right and descend, with the right arm opening and the left elbow tucking. The tucked left arm rises and reaches left over a straightening knee, then lowers as both knees soften and the right hand moves right. Both arms gather inward and lift, then open into a left-right hand exchange as the knees lengthen; the left arm curls upward and returns left, followed by the right hand rising and moving right as the right knee bends.

To begin, the dancer curls the right hand upward and right, then opens both arms as the right hand drops left; the left arm folds down to the left while the right hand climbs right. Both hands sweep right, the right arm extending downward before returning left with a curl and opening again. The left hand rises and folds while the right arm lengthens farther right, then both tuck and descend as the right knee softens. The left arm reaches right and lifts as the left knee straightens, while the right knee bends further and releases beneath a rising, folding right hand. The right hand travels right and down with an extension, while the left hand sweeps left and up.

To begin, the dancer lifts both hands, the right hand moving right and the left hand moving left, before lowering them as the left arm lengthens. Both arms curl upward again, the right hand continuing right while the left knee straightens and the left hand shifts right. The right hand reverses left as the left hand rises farther, then drops with a deeper tuck and moves right while the left hand climbs and folds back left. Both hands sweep left and descend into extended arms, the left hand returning right before both rise and fold in. The right arm reaches left and down while the left arm curls higher, then opens downward as the left arm tightens again.

In opposition, the right hand travels right and the left hand travels left as both arms lengthen. The left arm curls upward and returns right, then drops into an extension while the right arm reaches down-left. The left hand rises again with a fold and sweeps left, joined by the right hand reaching up-left before both hands descend and the left hand returns right. Both arms open downward, then lift into folds as the right hand reverses right and the left hand moves left. The left elbow releases, its hand lowers and extends farther left, and the right arm opens down-right before curling upward to finish.

As the right arm lengthens downward, the dancer curls the left arm up and right, then lowers the left arm while the right hand continues down. The right arm folds farther as the right knee bends and straightens, while the left arm tucks and lifts right; both hands rise before the right hand drops left and the left hand extends right. The right arm reaches up and left as the left knee softens, then both hands sweep right and descend with the right elbow opening; the knees exchange bend and release while the left arm curls upward and the right arm continues left and down. Both elbows fold as the right hand rises and the left hand drops, then the right hand sweeps right and back left while the left hand travels right and down into an extension. The left arm curls back left and up alongside the right arm as the left knee lengthens, followed by a rightward reach of the right hand and another bend of the left knee. The left hand returns left and curls upward as the right arm opens, then the left knee releases and the hands separate sideways.

To begin, the dancer folds the right arm and lowers its hand rightward while the left arm extends down-left. Both hands sweep left, then reverse toward the right as the right hand rises; the left knee straightens and both arms curl upward before the right hand drops. The left arm opens and tucks again while the right arm curls up-right, then the hands separate left and right as the left knee lengthens and the right arm extends downward. The right hand returns left and rises with a bend of the right knee, while the left elbow opens and the left knee softens, then the raised left arm folds as the left knee straightens. That folded left hand moves right and descends as the right arm continues down-left, then the descending right arm reaches farther right and down while the left arm lifts into an extension.

A rising, inward sweep begins with the right arm folding as the left hand moves left and both knees soften; the left knee straightens before the sweeping right arm opens downward. The right arm curls upward again as the left knee bends and releases, then reaches right and drops while the left hand lifts leftward over a deeper bend in the left knee. The left hand continues right and folds back up-left as the right arm sweeps down-right and the right knee sinks farther. Both hands rise, the right arm tucking leftward and opening as the right knee extends, then the left knee lengthens beneath a final lift of the right hand.

The dancer lengthens the right arm. The left hand rises and sweeps right as the right hand drops left, then both hands sweep right and curl upward while the right knee straightens; the left hand continues right before the hands separate sideways and lower into extending arms. Both knees bend as the right hand lifts right and the left hand drops left, followed by another rightward sweep of the right hand and a deeper bend of the right knee. The left arm reaches up-right as the right knee straightens, then both hands climb and sweep left with opening elbows; the right arm curls down-right as the left arm follows down-right and tucks in. The left hand returns up-left while the right hand moves up-left and extends, then the left hand folds downward to the right as the right hand reverses right and rises. The left arm opens and rises while the right arm curls farther right, and both hands continue rightward with the left elbow drawing in again.

At the outset, the dancer lengthens the right arm down and right while the left hand rises left, then both elbows fold as the hands reverse sideways. The left arm opens into a rightward sweep, its knee straightening, while the right elbow curls inward; the rightward-moving left hand lifts and tucks further as the right knee extends and the left knee bends. Both hands drop and separate, the left hand moving left as the right arm lengthens down and right, followed by the left hand continuing downward. The hands rise in succession, the left arm opening and the right arm curling upward, before the left hand falls left and the right hand moves right. The left arm folds higher and sweeps right against the right hand's leftward descent, then drops with an opening elbow as the right arm tightens and lifts again.

At the outset, the right arm curls upward and moves left as the right knee bends, then the right arm lowers while the right knee straightens. The left arm folds and lifts toward the right before releasing down, while the left knee softens again. The right hand rises and curls as both knees extend, then both arms reach left, with the left arm opening downward. The left hand sweeps up-right into a fold while the right arm tucks farther left, and the right knee lengthens again.

As the right hand lowers, the dancer lengthens both arms and sends the right hand left while the left arm folds, then opens downward. The right hand sweeps up-right, tucks, and drops as the left hand curls upward and reaches back down-left; the right hand continues down-left while the left hand rises into a deeper fold. Both hands move right with the right arm reaching down, then the left knee bends and straightens as the right hand lifts and falls into a longer reach. The left hand climbs rightward while the right elbow draws inward and the right hand moves left. Both arms lower and extend before the right hand returns right and the left hand rises leftward, ending with the right knee bending.

The knees soften in succession as the dancer lowers and extends the right arm, then sends both hands left while the right knee straightens and the left hand rises. The right hand lifts into a fold as the right knee bends again, and the left arm curls down-left before opening back right; the right arm reaches down-right and returns up-left against the left hand's rising rightward sweep. Both arms extend as the right hand drops, then lift and descend together with the right elbow tucked and the left knee bending. The right arm opens upward while the left hand continues down-left and lengthens, then folds and rises toward the right. The left hand lowers farther right as the right arm curls and the right knee softens, then swings left and up while the left hand moves right and tucks inward.

In opposition, the right hand sweeps left while the left arm curls upward and right, then the right hand reverses up-left as the left knee beneath the moving arm straightens. Both hands descend and lengthen as the left knee bends again, then curl upward toward the right before the right hand drops and opens while the left knee softens. The right hand rises left with a tucked elbow as the left arm extends down-right, then both arms climb into folded arms and separate sideways; the left arm reaches farther down-right as the left knee bends. The right hand returns up-left with a deeper tuck, followed by the left hand lifting and falling as the left arm unfolds, before both arms curl upward and sweep right. The dancer repeats the rising, opening, and descending motion with alternating elbows, ending with the right hand reaching up-right and the left hand curling downward.

As the right hand rises, the dancer sends the left hand right and curls it upward, then extends both arms and lowers the hands before reversing their lateral paths. Both elbows fold as the right hand climbs left and the left hand moves right, then the left arm opens while the right hand returns right and its elbow releases. The left hand swings left and back right into a rising curl, then reverses left as the right arm tucks higher; both descend with the right arm reaching out. The hands move apart, the right hand continuing right while the left hand sweeps left, curls upward and drops into an extension. Both hands climb again, the left arm folding as its hand moves right, before the right hand lowers and opens and the left hand descends left.

A rising, inward arm sweep begins as the dancer curls both hands left and lifts them, then carries them right while the right knee softens. The left hand descends and opens into a farther reach as the right knee straightens; the right hand lowers, reaches right and folds back left while the right knee bends again. Both arms lengthen downward as the right knee releases, then the left hand swings left and curls upward against the right hand's rightward extension. The right arm opens down-left before folding higher and dropping into another extension, with the left hand continuing right and tucking as the left knee bends. The hands reverse sideways together, the right arm curling up-right while the left drops and opens; they trade height once more, the right hand descending left as the left rises and the left knee straightens.

An alternating rising sweep begins with the right hand climbing left and the left hand curling right, then lowering as both arms lengthen; the right hand continues up and left before dropping while the left arm folds upward. The hands separate left and right, the right arm extending down-right as the right knee softens, while the left hand curls higher and left; the right hand reverses left as the left hand returns right and down, both elbows opening. Both knees bend beneath another exchange of height, the right hand lifting left while the left hand drops, then rising into a fold as the left knee straightens and the right arm tucks. The right hand lowers right and opens, followed by the left hand sinking into an extended reach; the right arm curls upward as the left knee bends, then the left elbow folds and the left hand rises while the right hand drops and lengthens. The left knee straightens as the right hand lifts right and folds again, then descends left over a bend in the right knee while the left arm opens downward and the right hand curls up and left. The left knee softens and the left hand moves left and up as the right leg extends, before the right knee releases and the left hand drops over another bend of the right knee.

As the right hand sweeps left and down, the dancer curls the right arm while the left hand rises right; the right hand then climbs as the right knee bends. The left arm opens downward and curls back up as both knees soften, then reaches farther right with a deepening bend of the left leg. The hands separate sideways, the right arm lengthening higher before folding as the left hand lowers, then both rise into a shared rightward sweep. The left arm tucks and drops as both legs straighten, followed by another curling lift and release of the right hand. The left hand continues downward and extends while the right hand moves left and folds inward.

The dancer performs a side-to-side arm exchange: the right hand sweeps right and rises into a fold, then returns left as the left elbow bends. The right arm opens down and left while the left hand moves right; both knees soften before the left knee straightens. The hands reverse toward each other, the right arm curling up and right before reaching back left and descending with an opening elbow. Both hands rise and sweep right, the right hand lifting farther before folding back left and lowering into a longer reach as the left knee extends. The left hand continues right and curls upward while the right hand drops, then both sweep left with the left arm tucking in and the right elbow opening.

To begin, the dancer folds the right arm and lowers both hands left, lengthening the right hand's reach before lifting it back right as the left knee softens. The right arm tucks into a descending leftward sweep while the left hand rises right, then extends downward as the left knee bends further. Both hands rise, the right hand moving right and curling upward against the left hand's leftward descent; the right hand drops as the left knee straightens. The left knee softens again beneath another lift of the right hand, whose elbow opens while the left arm curls up-right and the left knee deepens. The right arm reaches farther right as the left knee releases, then folds down-left while the left knee bends. The left hand sweeps left and down with an opening elbow, then reverses right and lifts into a curl as the right knee straightens and the left knee bends again.

In opposition, the dancer lowers the right hand while curling the left hand upward. The right arm extends and rises as the right knee straightens, then curls again and drops while the left hand continues climbing. Both hands sweep left and rise with folding elbows before the right hand reverses right; both arms open downward, then tuck again and separate sideways as the right arm reaches higher and the left arm lengthens down. The left hand swings right and back left while the right hand descends, followed by another lift and drop of the left arm. The right arm curls up and left as the left arm folds, then opens downward, finishes by lowering and extending farther, and returns left.

To begin, the dancer folds the right arm and carries both hands left, lifting them before extending the right arm. The left hand continues left as the right hand rises and opens farther, then drops while the left elbow bends and the left hand sweeps up-right. Both arms lengthen downward, then curl upward again with a rightward sweep of the left hand. The right hand reverses left into a deeper fold while the left hand drops and tucks; both return right, the right arm opening and lowering. The left hand climbs left as the right hand extends farther right, then both elbows draw inward before the right hand lowers and the left arm opens downward.

The dancer opens the left arm left while the right hand rises right and curls inward. Then both hands descend as the left arm extends farther left. The right arm lengthens down-left before folding again and lifting back right as the left hand continues its leftward reach. The right arm opens downward and returns left into a fold while the left hand reaches right and climbs. Both hands rise together, the right arm continuing left and opening as the left arm extends farther right and higher.

In opposition, the dancer lifts and folds the right arm while the left arm extends down; the right hand travels right as the left hand reverses left. Both hands climb, the right arm opening before curling again toward the left while the left knee bends and the left hand returns right. The right arm lowers and lengthens as the left knee straightens, then both knees soften in succession with the left hand dropping left and the left arm folding. The right hand rises as both arms tuck and the knees deepen their bend, then both hands descend with the left elbow extending and the right knee straightening. The hands continue lowering and separate left and right before the right hand climbs, opens and sweeps left as the right knee straightens farther.

In opposition, the dancer lowers the right hand while the left arm lengthens leftward, then raises both hands with the right arm curling inward. The left arm folds right as the right arm extends down and right, followed by a lift of the right hand into another fold. The left arm opens downward and returns up to the right as the right hand rises, drops and curls left. Both hands move right, the left arm tucking and rising before opening again. The right hand lifts leftward and curls inward as the left hand drops and reaches back right.

As the left arm folds and lifts left, the dancer straightens the right knee and softens the left knee, then lowers and extends the left hand right while the right arm drops left. The right knee lengthens again as the right hand climbs left and curls inward; the left hand rises left, tucks, and returns right as the right knee bends and the right hand reverses right. The right knee releases while both arms open and descend, the left hand continuing right before both sweep left and curl upward. The left hand dips and rebounds right as the right knee bends, then both hands rise with the left arm extending and both knees straightening. Both hands lower and separate left and right as the right knee softens and the left hand curls up, then the right arm folds right and drops while the left arm reaches down-right and opens. The right hand returns left and curls upward as the left arm folds left, finishes rising, and both hands lift before sweeping right together.

The left knee bends and releases beneath a leftward left hand sweep, then the right knee softens as both arms open and the hands separate. The left arm curls right while the right arm reaches down-left, then the right hand rises and folds inward over a deeper bend of the right knee. The right hand drops farther as the right knee straightens, then both arms extend again and the left hand climbs. The right arm reaches up-right with a lengthening elbow, then folds downward as the left arm tucks and lowers.

To begin, the dancer folds the right arm downward and extends it left as the left hand rises right, then reverses the right arm right and curls upward while the left hand drops and lengthens. The left hand climbs farther and sweeps left into a deeper tuck, while the right hand reaches right, dips and lifts back left into a fold; both hands return right before the right arm opens and the left arm curls higher. The arms trade height again, the right arm extending upward and the left arm folding down-left, then the left hand returns right into an extension as the right arm opens and falls. Both hands lift with tucked elbows and move left, then reverse right as the right arm lengthens downward and the left arm releases down-left. The right arm continues left and folds while the left elbow tightens and its hand lowers, then they separate horizontally with the left hand moving right.

The right arm drops as it lengthens, while the left arm rises, extends and lowers; the right hand then curls upward to the right. Both arms fold into a leftward sweep, the right hand rising before both hands return right with the right hand lifting farther. The left arm tucks further as its hand rises, then both sweep left and descend, the right elbow opening while the left arm folds inward again. Both hands lift toward the right, the right hand extending before dropping left as the left hand continues right and opens. The hands reverse left and rise together, the right hand curling inward while the left arm lengthens.

As the right arm folds, the dancer lifts the right hand and sends it right while the left hand moves left, then opens both arms with the hands separating sideways. The right hand dips as both knees soften and the left hand reverses right; the lowered right arm reaches up-left and lengthens while the left knee straightens and the raised left hand continues right. Both knees bend again as the right hand drops right and the left hand curls upward to the left, then the right knee releases before the left knee straightens beneath a descent of the right hand. The left arm extends down-right as the right knee bends and the right hand rises right, then both knees lengthen while the hands sweep left and the right arm folds downward. The left hand continues left as the right arm opens, then the hands separate right and left while the right knee softens and the left knee bends and releases; both hands lower and reverse sideways as the left knee sinks again.

As the right arm folds and the left arm lengthens down-left, the dancer lowers the right hand farther left while the left arm rises. The left hand moves right as the right knee bends, then both hands descend with the left arm curling inward. The right knee releases as the left hand sweeps left and back right, joined by the right arm folding left; the right knee softens again before the left hand lifts and the arms open apart, right to the left and left to the right. Both hands sweep right and climb as the knees straighten, then separate left and right, tucking the right arm while the left knee bends and straightens again. The left knee repeats its bend and release beneath a descending, lengthening right hand, which then curls upward as the right knee sinks once more. The left hand continues climbing and opens outward while the right arm extends higher toward the right.

Down and right, the right hand lowers while the left hand curls upward to the left. The right arm folds as the right knee straightens, then reaches left and drops with an opening elbow while the left hand continues climbing. The right hand reverses right and rises into a curl as the left knee bends; both hands descend before the left leg lengthens and the left hand sweeps left. The left hand lifts rightward while the right knee softens and the right hand moves right, then the left arm tucks left and down as the right knee extends farther. The right hand rises rightward with a folded elbow and the right knee straightening, while the left arm opens and drops.

Upward, the dancer lifts both hands, then carries the left hand left as it curls inward. The right hand follows left and folds into a shared descent. The left hand returns right while the right arm opens down and left; the returning left hand rises with a deeper tuck before unfolding downward. The left arm lengthens upward again as the right hand reaches right, then both hands lower. The left arm curls up once more, followed by the right hand lifting as its elbow bends.

A sweeping lateral exchange begins as the dancer opens the right arm downward and carries it right, then folds it left while the left hand rises left. The right arm lengthens right as the left knee bends and the left hand drops; both hands return left with the right arm curling upward before they descend together. The left arm extends right and folds back up-left while the right arm reaches right and lowers, then reverses left into a tuck as the left hand moves right. Both arms open and sweep left, the right hand rising while the left hand lowers, before the left hand dips and rebounds right. The right arm curls upward, sweeps right and releases down-left as the left hand follows right and climbs; the right arm then folds upward and extends left again.

Upward, the dancer lifts the right hand while the left arm folds and lowers, then both hands move right as the right arm curls higher and the left knee straightens. The right hand returns left and drops into a deeper tuck while the left elbow opens and the left knee bends; both hands rise again as the left knee extends, then the hands separate right and left with the right arm lengthening downward. Both arms fold as the hands sweep right and descend, then the right arm opens before curling back in while the left arm reaches left and up. The left arm draws inward as the right hand rises right, then drops left while the right arm folds and the right hand follows down-left. Both elbows tighten as the left hand swings right, and the right hand lifts right against it before returning left and dropping with an opening elbow.

The dancer lifts the right hand. The left arm folds and lowers, then both hands descend as the right arm opens; both sweep left before the right arm curls upward and both hands reverse right. The right arm tightens its reach up-right while the left hand rises with a lengthening elbow. Both arms unfold, the left hand continuing right as the right hand climbs farther. The right hand drops and moves left into a fold while the left arm curls higher and travels right, then opens downward. The left hand rises again as the right arm extends down-left and reverses right.

A rising arm exchange begins with the right hand curling up and right, the left hand following as both elbows fold and the left hand drops; the right arm releases while the left hand rises. The right hand moves left and curls upward before reaching right again, while the left hand folds down and left then opens back up toward the right. Both hands descend as their arms lengthen, then the left hand swings left and returns right through a folded-down lift and release while the right hand tucks higher. The left hand drops farther and sweeps left, opening into a rightward rise as the right hand lowers and extends; the left hand reverses left and rises again while the right hand follows that direction. The right arm curls upward, dips and lifts once more, then folds again as its hand moves right and the left arm tucks inward.

As the right hand reaches right, the dancer lifts and lengthens the left arm while the right knee straightens, then lowers both hands with the left arm folding. The right hand curls upward as the right knee bends, followed by the left hand rising and tucking into a leftward sweep before dropping and extending; the left hand returns right as the left knee softens further. Both hands descend, the left arm unfolding left while the right arm folds up and right over a bending right knee, then opens downward as the right knee straightens and the left hand rises. The right arm curls up and left while the left hand continues down and right, then both lower, the left elbow tucking before the left hand reverses left and the right arm opens into a rising reach right. The right hand drops as the right knee straightens farther, while the left arm extends down and left; the left arm curls up again as the right knee softens.

The right knee straightens as the dancer curls the left arm upward and extends it left, then bends the right knee while the right hand rises left and both arms fold. The left hand drops right with its elbow opening, while the right arm lengthens downward and sweeps left into another curl. The curled left arm lifts toward the right, lowers and opens as the right knee softens, while the right arm extends down to the left. The left arm tucks again and the right knee bends deeper, sending the right hand left with a folded elbow before both hands rise and the left arm releases. Both hands descend and sweep left as the knees straighten, then the left arm curls upward and returns right with an extension.

At the outset, the right arm curls upward and left while the left hand rises right, then the raised hands separate sideways as the right arm opens. The left arm folds right and drops, followed by a downward-left sweep of the right hand and another tuck of the left arm. Both hands climb and separate again, the left continuing right before both elbows open. The right hand moves right as its knee bends and straightens, then both arms fold and rise before the right hand returns left into a deeper curl. The left hand lifts farther right with an opening elbow, then both descend, the right arm extending as its knee softens.

In unison, the dancer lowers and extends both arms, then lifts them into folded elbows as the right knee bends. The left hand travels left while the right knee straightens, and the hands descend with the right arm opening, before both rise again and the right knee softens once more. Both arms lengthen downward as the left knee bends, then lift together while the right knee releases; the right hand moves right and curls down as the left hand drops farther. The left hand continues right and rises into a tighter fold over another bend of the left knee, then sweeps left while the right arm tucks and the right knee straightens. Both hands lower, the right arm opens, and they separate sideways as the left arm extends.

As the right arm curls upward, the dancer raises and folds the left arm toward the right. The right hand moves right and lowers as the left hand drops left, then both hands reverse sideways and rise with bent elbows. The right hand sweeps left and down into an extended reach while the left hand continues right; the left arm opens farther and rises before curling back in as the right elbow folds. The left hand travels left and reaches upward, while the right arm extends downward to finish.

To the right, the right hand rises while the left hand extends left and curls upward, then both hands lower as the right knee softens. The right hand sweeps left as the right leg straightens and the left knee bends, before the hands separate again and the left knee releases; both knees then soften as the right hand climbs and the left arm tucks upward. The right arm opens while the right leg straightens, then both arms fold into a shared lift that continues with the right hand moving left and the right knee bending, before the left knee straightens and both hands descend with the right elbow opening. Both arms curl upward once more, the right hand sweeping right as the left knee lengthens, then they drop and extend as the left knee bends and releases again. The right hand swings left and back right while the right knee straightens, then drops farther right as the right knee softens and the left hand moves left; the right knee releases as both hands rise, with the right arm folding and reopening and the left elbow tucked. The hands reverse sideways, the right knee bending while the left straightens, and the left hand dips before returning right and upward.

The dancer lowers both hands. The right hand sweeps left and rises while the left arm lengthens down, then both arms fold as the right hand returns right and drops into an opening reach. The left knee bends as the right arm curls up-right, then the right hand sinks and extends left while the right knee softens beneath a further extension of the left arm. Both knees straighten as the left arm folds up-left and the right hand rises; the hands separate horizontally, then the right arm opens downward before curling up-right and the left arm follows up-left with its elbow tucked. The hands sweep apart again as the right knee bends and the left leg extends, followed by another bend of the right knee and a lowering of the left hand.

The dancer performs alternating arm curls with the right knee straightening twice while the left knee bends, then raises both hands, the right hand rightward and the left hand left, before extending the right arm downward. The left hand sweeps up-right as the left knee softens and straightens, while the right knee lengthens; the extended right arm then folds down-left and reaches farther as the left knee bends again. Both arms curl upward in succession and open into a shared descent, the right hand moving left while the left arm extends right and folds again as the left knee straightens. The right hand rises into a tighter tuck over another left knee bend, then drops right and lengthens as the left hand lowers left and the left knee releases. The left arm extends further left while the right arm curls upward and travels right, finishing with the bent left leg lengthening beneath its descending hand.

The arms move in opposition: the dancer lowers the right hand while the left hand curls upward and left, then the right arm reaches right as the left arm rises farther. The right arm folds upward and left before both hands descend, with the left elbow tightening; they then separate into a rising rightward reach with the right hand and an extending leftward lift with the left hand. Both hands sweep left and climb, the right arm curling inward while the left arm opens. The left arm returns right and tucks as the right arm rises, then lowers with an extended elbow; both hands sweep left again, the right arm folding as the left arm lengthens. The right arm lifts and opens while the left knee softens, then drops rightward as the left hand continues down and the left knee straightens.

The dancer performs a rising-and-falling arm exchange: the right hand sweeps left and up as the left hand moves right, with the left knee straightening before both hands descend. The right hand continues left and rises while the left hand returns left; both knees soften in succession, then the right hand lowers into an extended reach and reverses right as the left knee straightens. The left hand lifts again and folds inward while the right arm curls upward, then both sweep left and descend. Both arms open downward, the right hand reaching farther left before folding back up to the right as the left knee bends; the left hand drops and extends while the right hand rises into a tighter curl. The right hand lifts and tucks, its knee bending before releasing, then both hands rise as the left arm opens and its knee softens. The right arm lengthens downward while the left hand reaches right and higher, followed by another bend of the right knee and an extension of the left one.

The arms work in opposition: the right hand rises and moves right as the left hand drops, then both hands climb with the left elbow folding. The right hand swings left while the left hand reaches right and opens; the right arm curls up and left, then lengthens down and right as the right knee straightens. The right hand reverses left and rises while the left arm folds into a rightward lift and the right knee softens again. Both hands descend as the knees bend deeper, the left arm opening before curling back up and left. With the knees extending together, the right hand lowers and sweeps right, then returns left as the left arm tucks.

A descending arm exchange begins as the left hand lowers and lengthens left while the right hand curls upward, the right knee straightening. The left hand reverses right as both arms open, then both hands rise and the hands separate sideways, the right hand returning left. Both elbows fold as the left hand dips left and rebounds up, joined by the right hand's lift; the left knee softens before the right leg bends and releases beneath an extending rightward reach. The left arm opens downward as the left knee lengthens, then curls back up and left while the right hand drops and sweeps right over a bending knee. The left hand climbs farther right as the left knee straightens, and the right hand lifts with another bend of the left knee.

In opposition, the dancer sends the left hand left and down while the right hand rises rightward over a softening right knee, then lowers the right arm as the right knee straightens. The left arm curls upward and extends back down toward the right while the right hand continues right, folds upward, and reverses left. Both hands sweep left with the right arm opening downward, then the left hand reaches right and rises as both arms tuck. The right hand lifts through a rightward extension and leftward return while the left hand lowers and opens farther right. The right arm curls up to the right again, followed by the left hand lifting into a fold.

The right hand sweeps left and down. The left hand follows downward as both elbows fold, then the right arm rises and opens right while the left arm extends down-right; the right arm curls back toward the left as the left arm lengthens further and the left knee straightens. Both hands lower with the left arm opening, then reverse sideways, the right elbow folding and the right hand lifting right before returning left over a bend of the left knee. The left hand dips and lifts leftward as both arms lengthen, then drops farther left while the right arm curls upward and moves right; the left arm continues down-right as the right arm folds left and lowers over a softening right knee. The lowered right hand reverses up-left and extends into a shared rightward sweep as the right knee bends deeper, then returns left while the left hand lifts over another left knee bend and reaches right. The raised left hand drops left and folds as the right arm climbs right and tucks, before both descend, the right arm extending right while the left elbow opens.

The arms move in opposition as the right hand rises, curls left and drops into an extension, while the left hand folds downward to the right. The left hand sweeps left and returns up-right into a curl before opening down-left, then reaches farther left and back up-right with the left knee straightening. The left hand dips and rebounds into a rising tuck, then lowers through another rightward reach and lift before extending left. Both hands continue left with lengthening arms, then the right arm curls upward as the left arm folds and the left knee bends. The right arm opens down-left while the left hand lifts right and extends, ending with the left knee softening further.

The knees join in succession: the right knee softens as the right arm folds and the left hand sweeps left, then both knees bend before the lowered right arm opens right and rises as the left knee straightens. The raised left hand curls down-right while the right knee bends, releases and bends again beneath a leftward right arm fold; both hands climb with that folding right elbow opening, then the left knee extends and its left hand reverses right as the right arm tucks again. The hands separate left and right with a bend and release of the left knee, then return toward each other, the right arm lengthening downward while the left elbow curls higher. Both hands sweep right as the left arm opens and its right knee bends, then the hands reverse inward and rise together, the left elbow gathering as the right knee sinks and its right arm folds. That folded right arm lowers and opens into a leftward reach while the left hand descends with an extending elbow and its right knee straightens, finishing with both arms lengthening.

The dancer lengthens the right arm downward. The left hand rises and falls as the right hand sweeps right, then both arms climb before the left arm returns left and drops; the arms extend apart, with the right hand sweeping right and down as the right knee bends. Both hands rise as the right knee straightens, then descend into a shared leftward reach while the elbows fold. The left arm lengthens upward again as the right knee softens and the right hand curls up and right; the left hand continues higher and reaches farther out as the right knee extends, while the right arm lowers and opens. The right hand climbs with an inward elbow as the left arm folds, then both hands sweep left while the right knee sinks further. The left arm opens as the right hand descends right, then reverses left and lifts as the right knee straightens and the right elbow tucks.

The right arm moves right as the left knee bends, while the left arm moves left. Then the right arm extends down while the left arm lifts left and curls. The right hand rises into a fold over a straightening left knee as the left hand drops, before both hands descend with lengthening elbows. The hands separate right and left, the left arm curling upward while the right hand continues right. Both knees bend as the left arm opens downward, and the right hand shifts left while the left hand sweeps up and right. The right arm reaches farther left before folding back right and dropping over a deeper left knee bend, then returns left as the left leg straightens.

The right knee softens as the dancer sends both hands right, then curls the right arm above the right knee upward and left while the left arm rises into a fold; both arms extend downward before reversing sideways. The left hand climbs right over another bend of the right knee, followed by the right arm lifting left as the right knee straightens and the left knee bends deeper. Both hands descend, the right arm reaching right while the left arm curls upward to the left and the left knee lengthens, then the hands separate again with the left elbow opening as the right knee bends further. The hands rise together as the right arm folds and the left arm tucks, then they sweep left and descend, the left arm extending right and lowering farther while the right arm opens. Both knees soften as the hands return right and climb, the right hand dipping left before rising again while the right knee straightens.

The right knee softens as the dancer curls the right hand up and right, then opens the right arm down while the left hand lifts left into a fold. The hands sweep right together with the right arm extending downward, then return left and descend before reversing right; the right arm lengthens and drops while the left hand returns left and curls upward. Both knees bend in succession as the right arm reaches right and lowers over a straightening knee, then both arms tuck and rise while the left knee sinks farther and its hand moves right. The right knee releases beneath a dip of the right arm, which extends down as the left hand travels left and curls up, then the right hand climbs right and folds. The right knee bends again as the left arm opens left, the right hand dropping right over another knee release while the left hand curls up to the right and lowers. The right arm rises and folds as the left knee straightens, followed by a lift and extension of the right arm.

The dancer lengthens the right arm downward. The left hand follows down and left as both knees bend, then the right hand rises right and curls back left while the right knee straightens; both hands lower as the right knee softens again. Both arms extend into a rightward sweep, then rise with folded elbows before descending together as the right knee straightens and the left bends. The right arm reaches up-left as the right knee bends again, while the left hand drops and moves left; both hands return right as the left knee straightens, then the right knee softens beneath a rising, curled left arm. With the right knee bending and releasing, both hands lower and separate left and right, the left elbow opening as the left knee sinks further. The left arm folds upward against the right hand's rightward descent, then returns left with an extending elbow as the right hand lifts and tucks. The right knee bends again while the left arm curls higher and the right hand continues right.

The dancer sends the right hand left. The left arm lengthens downward and sweeps right, then folds as both hands rise; the right hand curls up-left while the left hand opens down-left. Both arms draw inward and lift as the knees straighten in succession, then the right hand lowers into an extended reach to the right while the left knee bends and releases beneath a rising, folded arm. The left knee softens again as the left arm opens down-left and the right knee bends, followed by a further descent of the lower arm. The right hand lifts and moves right against the left hand's leftward sweep, then both hands climb as the left arm tucks and the right knee straightens.

A right knee bend accompanies the right hand's upward curl and the left hand's rightward sweep as the dancer straightens the right knee. The raised right arm extends down to the left while the left arm folds upward, then opens downward as the right arm tucks up-right and the right knee lengthens further. The right knee bends again beneath another leftward rise of the left hand and a rightward lift of the right hand, whose arm curls before releasing downward; both knees soften as the arms fold and the hands exchange height, the right hand continuing left. The right knee straightens while the left leg lengthens and the left hand drops, then both knees bend and release in succession as the left hand sweeps left and back right with an opening elbow. Both legs extend once more as the right hand rises and the left hand lowers.

To begin, the dancer sends the right hand right and down while the left arm folds, then lowers both hands and opens the left arm as the right knee straightens. Both arms lengthen, the left hand sweeping left before returning right and curling upward; the right arm rises with a bend at the left knee and tucks farther in. The left hand drops as the right knee bends, then both arms open downward before the left hand curls up and the right follows into a fold. The right hand sweeps right and back left, followed by the left moving left as both elbows release and both knees soften. Both hands descend, the right sweeping right while the left reverses left and both arms extend over a deeper knee bend. The right arm curls upward as the left knee releases, then the hands separate right and left, rise together, and reverse inward toward each other.

The right knee bends as the dancer folds the right arm upward and left, while the left hand sweeps right and down. The right side opens downward as the left hand returns left and rises into a curl, then both hands sweep right before the right arm tucks higher and the right knee straightens. The right hand drops through an extension, curls up, and falls again as the left hand reaches right; the left arm extends farther right while the right elbow opens. The left hand dips and rebounds with a tighter fold as the right hand travels left and curls upward, then lowers and unfolds while the left arm tucks farther. Both hands continue left with the right hand dropping and extending as the left hand lifts.

The dancer sends both hands right. The right arm curls upward while the left hand lowers, then the right hand returns left and drops into an extension as the right knee bends; both knees straighten before the left hand lifts left and both arms fold. The right hand rises right with a deeper tuck as the left elbow opens, then both hands sweep down and left with the right arm lengthening and the left arm folding. The right arm reaches farther left while the left arm folds and releases, then the right hand reverses up-right as the left hand moves left and curls higher, before both descend and the right hand sweeps left. Both arms gather inward and rise again, followed by another shared downward reach. The hands climb once more with the left arm curling, then both lower, the right hand moving right while the left hand extends left and both elbows open.

As the right hand curls up and left, the dancer lifts the left hand toward the right, then lowers both hands. The right arm continues left while the left elbow folds, and the left knee softens before the left hand reverses right. The left knee straightens as the left arm extends and drops, then bends again beneath a shared upward reach, with the right hand moving left. Both arms tuck into a descent, the left hand returning right as the left knee lengthens; the right arm opens downward and swings left. The left hand follows left as the right knee bends, then both elbows draw in and the hands rise together.

The right knee softens as the dancer sends the right hand right and the left hand left, then straightens the right knee while both hands lower and the left arm folds. The left arm releases left as the right knee bends and the left knee extends; the hands separate again, the right hand lifting while the left hand drops and curls upward to the right over a deeper bend of the left knee. The left knee straightens and the left arm opens downward as the right hand swings left, then returns right with another tuck and release while the left knee sinks farther. Both arms curl upward and sweep left, the right elbow opening before both hands descend into extended arms, the right hand moving right and the left hand returning left. The right hand sweeps up-left and back down-right as the left knee bends and the left arm reaches up-left over another extension of the left leg, followed by the right knee bending beneath a final lift of the right hand.

The dancer folds the right arm upward. Both knees straighten as the hands sweep left, with the left arm reaching up and right before both elbows open and the right hand drops. The arms curl again as the left hand rises and the right elbow releases; the left knee softens while the hands descend into lengthened arms and reverse their sideways paths. Both hands lift with folding elbows, then separate right and left before the right hand returns right and curls higher. The right arm opens down-left as the left arm reaches up-right, then tucks and lifts back toward the right while the left knee bends and straightens. The left hand dips and rebounds left into a curl as the right arm extends down-left, ending with the bent knee releasing farther.

At the outset, the dancer extends the right arm down and right while the left hand rises left into a curl, then sweeps the left curled hand right as the left lower arm folds. The hands descend together before the left hand reaches left, then rise with the left elbow opening as the right arm tucks and the right knee softens. Both hands sweep left and lengthen downward, then reverse right as the right arm rises and the left elbow bends. The left hand returns left while the right arm curls upward and both knees bend, followed by another rightward extension of the left hand. The right hand lowers as the left arm folds back up and left, then the hands trade height again while the right elbow opens and the right knee straightens. The left hand drops left with a bent elbow as the right hand lifts right, and the right knee beneath the lower hand releases further.

The right knee bends as the dancer lifts and curls the left arm right, then sends the right hand right and upward with a fold while the bent leg straightens. The hands separate left and right, the right hand rising into a tighter curl before both arms open downward. The left arm reaches up again and drops as the right knee softens; the right hand sweeps left and returns right while the lowered hand rises, then moves left. Both hands climb with lengthening arms, the right hand reversing right and both descending as the left arm folds back right. The left arm opens down and right while the right hand lifts left, then curls upward before the hands exchange directions: the lifted hand moves right and drops into an extension, while the other reaches left and lowers.

To begin, the dancer folds both arms and lowers the hands. The left hand moves left while the right hand travels right, then both sweep right with the left arm curling upward. The left hand returns left as the right hand lifts into a fold and follows left; the left knee bends and straightens while the right knee softens and the left lower arm opens. The right arm reaches up-right as the left hand climbs left, then reverses left into a tighter curl over a bend-and-release of the left knee, while the right knee extends. The right hand drops farther left and lengthens as the left arm folds down-right, then the left hand rises and sweeps left while the right hand returns right.

As the right knee softens, the dancer raises and folds the right arm while the left hand drops, then lowers both hands with a further tuck of the rising right arm. The left knee bends as the left hand sweeps left and climbs, joined by the right hand moving right, before both descend into lengthened arms. The right hand returns right while the left arm curls upward and both knees soften, then the hands separate right and left and climb with folding elbows as the left knee straightens. Both knees bend again beneath a dip and renewed lift of the right hand, which moves right while the left hand reaches left and rises; the right knee extends as the left leg deepens its bend and releases. The left hand swings right, dips, and returns left as the right hand lifts and falls, then the right arm curls higher while the left elbow opens and the left hand rises.

The right arm reaches right and drops. The left hand follows left and down, then both hands return right as the right arm curls upward and the left knee straightens; the left hand swings left while the right hand climbs right. Both hands sweep left, the right arm opening before folding down and reopening as the right knee bends, while the left hand continues left and drops into a tuck. The right hand reverses right and rises through an extension and renewed fold as the right knee softens further and the left knee releases; the right hand then returns left and down with a deeper curl. Both knees bend in succession as the right hand lifts and falls again, finishing with both knees releasing and the right hand reaching right.

The right arm folds as the dancer lifts both hands, then extends it downward and left while the left hand moves right. The right arm curls upward and releases again as the left hand drops left, then rises with a deeper fold before opening down and left; the right arm tucks up and reaches back right as the left arm lowers. Both hands rise, the right hand curling farther left while the left elbow bends, then opens into a rightward lift as the right hand descends. The right arm lengthens up and left, then folds through a shared rightward sweep, followed by a leftward return. Both hands lower and separate sideways, the right hand moving right and the left hand left, then rise with bent elbows before the right hand returns left and both arms open. The left hand shifts right and climbs as the right hand continues left and curls upward, finishing with both hands lifting.

The dancer folds the left arm upward and left while the right hand rises, then lowers both hands before reversing their directions. The left hand curls up to the right as the right arm extends downward, then opens down-left and lengthens farther while the right arm tucks into a rising leftward reach. Both hands descend, the right moving right as its knee straightens; they rise together with the left arm folding inward. That folded left arm sweeps left and down, opens, and reverses right while the right arm reaches up-right, before both hands lower and the left returns left. The arms lift again with the elbows tucked, then extend apart, the left reaching left and the right reaching right.

In opposition, the dancer sends the right hand left while the left hand rises right, then lifts the right arm as the right knee bends and straightens and the left arm folds downward. Both hands descend, the left arm opening before both elbows curl upward; the left knee softens as the right hand moves left and the arms release, then the hands separate sideways with the left arm tucking again. The right hand continues down and left as the left hand lowers and extends, then reverses right while the left hand swings left and curls up. The left curled hand drops and opens as the right hand sweeps left and rises, then both arms climb with the left elbow folding. The left hand returns right as the right knee bends, followed by another bend of the left knee and a lift of the right hand with a deeper fold in the right arm.

As the right arm curls upward, the dancer lowers the left hand and folds the left elbow too. The right hand moves right while the left arm extends down, then both elbows open as the left hand sweeps left. Both hands rise with bent elbows, then descend as the arms lengthen and the right hand reaches farther right. The right hand continues right while the left arm curls up and back left, before the right hand drops and the right knee bends. The left hand returns left as the right arm opens downward, then the knees straighten in succession while the left hand rises.

The knees join a later sweep: the dancer raises the right hand, then sends both hands right and down as the left knee bends and releases and the right arm curls upward. The right knee softens while the left arm folds left, then opens right as the left knee straightens; the right hand returns left and rises into a tighter fold. The left hand climbs right with an extended elbow while the right hand drops and sweeps right, followed by the left hand moving right and curling inward. Both arms gather higher toward the left, the right hand dropping as the right knee bends, before the arms unfold downward and the knees straighten in succession. The right arm tucks again while the left hand rises right, then both hands lift and separate left and right as the left elbow lengthens and the left knee bends.

The dancer sweeps the right hand right and down, folding the right arm as the left arm extends left and rises. The right hand reverses up-left into a tuck while the left knee bends; both hands then descend and sweep right, the right hand curling higher as the left knee softens again. The right hand reaches back left with an opening elbow, then drops and returns right as both knees straighten in succession and the left hand follows right. The right arm curls upward as the left knee bends, then extends down-left while the left arm folds up-right over a deeper bend of the left knee. The right hand lifts left and lowers as the left arm opens downward, then both rise before the right hand moves right and drops while the left hand returns left.

The right knee straightens as the left hand curls up and right, then lowers while the right hand rises left. The left arm folds down and right before both hands lift, the right hand reaching right while the left hand curls left. Both elbows draw inward as their hands drop; the rightward-reaching hand returns left while the right knee softens, then the left hand climbs left as the right leg lengthens and the right arm opens downward. The left arm tucks farther left as the lowered hand reverses right, and the right hand sweeps down-left with an extending elbow. The dancer curls the left arm upward, then sends both hands right and back left, folding the right elbow before lowering it.

As the left hand travels left and the right hand travels right, the dancer curls the right arm upward, then reverses both hands inward and lifts them as the right elbow opens. The left hand drops while the right knee bends and the right hand continues down-left; the right hand swings up-right, back down-left, and rises again as the right knee straightens and the left hand lifts farther left. Both elbows tuck through another leftward sweep of the left hand, followed by a rightward curl of the right arm and a drop of the left arm. The left arm opens downward, then folds back up-right as the right hand lowers, before the hands reverse their lateral directions.

A rising-and-falling arm exchange begins with the right hand lifting left and curling inward while the left hand reaches right, then both lower into extended arms. The dancer reverses the hands left and right before lifting both, folding the left arm, and lowering them again as the right knee softens. Both hands rise, the left elbow tucking as the right knee bends, then fall into opening arms before the right leg straightens and the hands sweep right. The left hand returns left and curls upward over a bending right knee, then drops while the left knee extends and the right hand lowers leftward. The left arm lifts through another bend and release of the right knee, while the right hand rises right and folds inward. The left arm opens downward as the right hand sweeps left and down, ending with the right knee extending and the right hand moving right.

The right knee straightens as the dancer extends the left arm left and lifts the right hand right, then bends the right knee while both hands descend. The left hand curls up-left as the right knee softens, then opens down-right while the right arm reaches left; both knees extend as the hands sweep right and the right arm folds upward. The left arm tucks up-left and releases down as the right knee bends again, while the right hand sweeps left and lowers into a longer reach. Both hands rise and move right with lengthening arms, the right knee straightening as the left hand returns left. The right knee bends and releases beneath a shared leftward dip, then the left arm reaches right while the right elbow folds and the left hand rises. The left hand climbs farther as the right knee deepens, then both arms curl in toward the right before extending downward together.

As the left arm folds left and the right hand rises right, the dancer straightens the left knee beneath the folded hand. The right arm curls inward while the left arm extends downward, then both hands sweep left with the left arm tucking as the right knee bends. The right knee releases while the right arm opens down-left; the left arm folds upward and reaches right as the left knee softens, then both arms lengthen and descend with a renewed bend in the left knee. Both knees straighten as the right-reaching arm gathers up-left, followed by the left hand rising into a fold. The arms open and lower with a final straightening of the right knee, then both curl upward and return left before lowering together.

The dancer performs alternating arm lifts: the right hand rises and folds rightward while the left hand climbs left, then both lower as the right knee straightens. The left knee extends too as the left hand reverses up-right into a curl, then both hands climb again, the right hand moving left before sweeping down-right with an opening elbow. Both knees lengthen as the left hand drops left and the right hand curls upward; the hands separate sideways, the right hand returning down-left while the left hand rises leftward. The right arm extends as the right knee softens, then both arms fold through a shared rightward sweep, the right hand lowering while the left hand tucks further and moves left. The right hand rebounds up-right with another knee bend, then returns down-left as the right knee straightens and the left leg lengthens.

At the outset, the dancer sends the right hand right and the left hand left as both arms lengthen. The right arm curls upward while the left arm lowers and folds, then the left arm reaches farther down before both hands descend and sweep left. Both arms tuck inward, the right hand rising while the left hand dips again; the right hand then extends downward alongside the left hand's lift. The right hand reverses up and right into a fold as the right knee straightens, then both hands lower and the right arm opens while the left arm continues left.

As the right hand rises, the dancer folds both arms and lifts the left hand leftward, then lowers both hands while the right elbow opens. The left arm curls up-right as the right knee straightens and the right hand moves right, followed by a bend of the right knee and an opening of the left arm toward the right. The right arm reaches upward-left over another right knee bend while the left hand rises and drops; the right hand returns right and down as the left knee extends, then both hands sweep left before the right elbow tucks and both knees soften. Both arms lengthen into a shared rise, with the right hand moving right and the left knee straightening as the left hand falls. The right knee bends again beneath a fold of the right arm, then both legs extend as the left hand lifts and the right hand rises leftward, ending with a deeper bend in the right knee.

The right hand moves right. The dancer lifts both hands, then carries them left and down with lengthening arms before folding the left arm as the right hand rises again. The right hand returns right and drops while the left hand continues upward into a tighter curl. The left hand lowers, then sweeps right and rises alongside the right hand. Both hands descend together, and the right hand reaches left.

At the outset, the right hand reaches right and rises while the left arm lengthens left. The right arm folds as the left hand climbs farther left, then both elbows open into a shared descent, with the hands continuing to separate sideways. Both arms curl upward and sweep toward each other before releasing down, the right hand shifting left as the left elbow tucks again. The left arm opens and sweeps left while the right arm lifts right, then both rise, the left hand returning right as the right arm folds back left. The hands descend and reverse their sideways directions once more, the right arm extending through the motion.

The right hand moves right. The dancer raises both hands, then lowers them into folded elbows as the left arm opens left and the left knee straightens; the right hand shifts left before both arms lengthen and the left hand climbs. Both hands rise again with bent elbows, then descend as the right arm curls right and the left arm reaches left; the right elbow extends while the left arm folds back up toward the right. The right hand drops as the left arm travels left, then rises right and returns left with an opening elbow while the left arm tucks in. Both hands lower, the left arm sweeping left and extending before reversing right, as the right hand lifts rightward and the right knee bends, then the left hand joins the lift. The right arm folds down-right as the right knee straightens and the left knee softens, then both arms open and the hands climb.

The arms move in opposition: the right hand curls up and left while the left hand drops, folds, and travels right. The raised right arm opens downward as both hands sweep left, then the right arm reverses right into a curl while the left arm extends farther down. Both elbows tuck and their hands rise, with the right hand continuing right before returning left; the left elbow opens and its hand lowers as the right arm lengthens. The left hand moves right and rises into another fold, then joins the right hand's leftward sweep as the left knee softens and straightens again. The right hand lifts and falls while its elbow bends, then both arms unfold and the hands separate left and right.

As the right arm curls upward, the dancer lowers and folds the left arm toward the right. The right hand drops as the right knee softens, then both arms open and the right knee straightens before the hands separate left and right with another bend of the right knee. Both elbows tuck as the left hand rises and shifts left, followed by a lift of the right hand; the knees straighten in succession while the right hand returns right and drops into an extension. The left arm reaches right and lifts as the left knee bends and releases, then sweeps down and left through another knee pulse while the right arm curls up and right. The left knee bends again beneath an unfolding rightward reach, followed by the right hand sweeping left and down as the reaching arm folds upward. Both arms open, the right hand lowers and swings right while the left arm curls upward to the left, ending with the right arm drawing back left and folding as the right knee lengthens.
