In opposition, the right arm folds and lowers while the left arm reaches left and drops, then the right hand rises as the left arm extends right. The right arm lengthens downward while the left arm curls upward, then both hands move left with the left elbow tucking farther before it opens again. Both arms fold and lift toward the right, then descend with opening elbows as the dancer separates their directions: the right hand sweeps left and back right, the left hand drops left, and the right hand lifts once more. The right hand moves right and curls down while the left arm extends downward; the left hand returns left, then rises into a longer reach as the right arm folds and lifts. The left hand descends right while the right arm continues upward and opens, ending with another drop of the left hand.

To begin, the dancer lengthens the right arm left and down while the left hand sweeps right, then raises the right hand as the left knee straightens. The hands separate left and right, the left arm curling upward before both sweep back toward the right and descend with opening elbows; the right knee softens as the left hand returns left. Both knees bend and release beneath a rising reach of the right arm, whose hand continues left while the left hand drops right and the bent left knee straightens again. The right hand reverses right and lowers into an extension as the left arm folds upward, then the left hand lifts while the right hand returns left and both elbows open. The right hand curls rightward and descends while the left arm tucks farther inward.

As the right arm folds and the left knee straightens, the dancer lowers the right hand left while the left hand reaches right and curls upward. The right arm lengthens downward as the left arm opens right, then reverses left with a fold before extending down again. The left hand rises and sweeps left while the right arm tucks and lifts right; both hands then descend, the left hand curling inward. The right hand continues right as the left hand travels left and down, then both reverse sideways, the left hand curling upward to the right while the right hand moves left. The left arm opens into another descent as the right arm draws farther inward and the right knee bends.

To begin, the dancer folds the right arm and lowers the right hand left while the left arm reaches right, then extends both hands apart. The right elbow releases as the right knee softens, and the left hand curls up-left while the right hand sweeps down-right and both arms lengthen; the right knee straightens as the right hand rises, with the left hand continuing left. Both arms tuck upward and sweep right, the right arm dropping before reopening into a shared lift and a renewed fold. The right hand lowers again as the left arm reaches right, opens downward and curls back up-left, while the right elbow tightens and the right hand rises. The right knee bends and straightens beneath an unfolding reach left, joined by the left arm extending down-left and the left hand climbing farther left. Both hands descend, the left arm opening as the left knee bends and the left hand reverses right, then the right hand rises into a fold while the left hand continues down-right.

Upward, the dancer raises the right hand and folds the right arm while the left hand reaches right and upward; the right arm extends before both hands descend, the right hand moving left as the left hand curls upward. The left hand sweeps down-right and opens, then rises left with a deeper fold as the right arm tucks and carries the right hand right. Both arms lengthen downward and separate sideways, the right hand curling up-left before both elbows draw in. The right hand drops into an extended reach as the left hand lifts and opens left, then reverses right while the right hand returns right and folds. The right hand continues right and lengthens, dipping farther as the left hand moves right again and the right elbow releases further.

The dancer lifts and folds both arms. The right hand swings left, then right as its elbow opens and the left arm lengthens upward; both hands descend while the right knee softens. The left hand curls up and left as the right knee straightens, followed by the right hand rising with a tighter bend. Both hands sweep right and lower before the right arm tucks again, its knee bending and releasing as the left hand returns left. The right hand reverses left and rises, while the left arm folds upward; the knees soften in succession as the hands separate right and left. Both arms extend downward, then the right hand climbs left with an opening elbow as its knee straightens and the left hand rises right.

A rising, folded arm phrase begins as the dancer lowers the left hand and lifts the right hand toward the right, then sweeps both hands left while the right hand descends and the right knee bends. The left hand drops and returns right while the right knee straightens, followed by another bend of the right knee as the right hand continues down and left. Both hands rise while the right arm extends, then the left hand reverses right and drops as the right knee softens; both arms curl upward before the left hand reaches left and the right hand opens downward. The right knee bends again as the left hand lifts into a fold and sweeps left, then rises farther with an extension while the right hand moves right. The left arm tucks and descends while the right arm curls up and right, then both hands lower, the left hand moving left and the right knee straightening.

A rising arm sweep begins as the dancer lifts the left hand leftward and curls it higher, then carries both hands right while the right arm folds in. The left hand returns left as the left knee softens, then drops while the left knee straightens; both arms open downward before the left hand sweeps right and climbs into a fold. The left arm extends upward again, briefly tucks and opens, then lowers into another curl. Both hands move left, the right arm lengthening and dropping farther as the left arm rises, then both reverse right and climb with bent elbows. The left hand continues right while the right arm swings left and descends, both arms opening as the left knee bends.

The right arm reaches left and curls upward as the right knee softens, then lengthens down while the left hand rises; both hands move right, the left arm folding as the left knee bends deeper. The right hand lifts left and returns down-right with a release, while the left arm extends downward and both knees straighten before the right arm tucks again. Both hands climb with folded elbows, then lower and separate sideways as the right knee bends; they rise once more with the right knee extending, before both arms curl and sweep left. The right elbow opens while the left arm continues upward and right, then the right arm folds higher and returns right as the left arm drops and lengthens. The right arm releases downward and right, followed by the left hand, whose arm reaches out as the left knee straightens; both hands lift with the left arm folding, then descend as the left elbow opens and both knees bend.

An alternating lift-and-drop exchange begins as the right arm curls upward, the left hand rising and folding, before both descend and the right hand sweeps left. The left knee softens while the right arm reaches right and up, then reverses left and drops into a fold; that knee bends further as the left hand lowers and the left arm extends. Both knees straighten as the hands reverse sideways and rise with lengthening arms, then the right hand continues left against the left's rightward sweep. Both elbows tuck through a shared descent, the right hand moving right while the left returns left, then the arms open and lower together. The left arm folds once more as both hands sweep right and climb, finishing with the right elbow drawing in.

As the right arm curls upward and the left arm extends down, the dancer sends both hands right. The right hand dips and rebounds while the left arm folds, then opens again as both sweep left. The right hand drops and reverses right while the left elbow tucks, then the left knee softens as the right hand returns left. Both arms lengthen downward before the right arm rises with a tighter fold; the left arm follows up and left, then drops as the right arm travels farther left. The left arm curls up and right while the right arm extends right and lowers, followed by another rise of the left hand.

The dancer lifts the right hand. The right arm curls left and down while the left arm reaches right, then both arms sweep left with the right arm lengthening as the right knee bends and releases. Both hands rise and the arms fold, then the right hand drops left into an extension before curling upward again as the right knee softens; the left knee bends and straightens beneath a further lift of the right hand. The right hand lowers through an opening and renewed tuck as the right knee deepens, then rises again while the left hand dips and rebounds; the right knee releases as the left hand travels left and down. The right arm extends farther down and left while the left elbow folds and opens, then the left hand returns right into a curl as the left knee bends. Both knees release in succession and the left arm opens downward.

While the right hand moves right and the left hand moves left, both arms fold and lower, then reverse their sideways directions as the left knee straightens. The left arm extends upward while the right arm curls higher to the right; the extended arm drops, sweeps left, and folds back up and right as the right knee bends. The right hand rises farther and reverses left with a deeper tuck as the bent knee lengthens, then opens down and right before curling upward again over a renewed bend of the right knee. Both hands sweep left and descend, the right arm reaching out as the right knee softens and the left knee straightens, then the right hand returns right and rises with its arm folding. The left hand lifts right over a bending knee and drops into an extension, followed by the right arm opening downward and sweeping left.

The dancer sweeps the right hand right. The left arm extends down and left while the right arm reaches left, then both hands rise as the right arm folds inward. The right hand drops toward the right while the left arm lengthens downward, then both lift with the left hand moving right before curling in. Both hands descend into extended arms, the right arm sweeping left. The left arm curls upward and carries its hand right as the right hand rises.

The right knee bends and releases as the dancer folds both arms, lifting the left hand while the right hand drops. The right arm curls upward and sweeps left as the right knee softens, then extends down while the right knee straightens; the left hand reverses right with a deeper tuck. Both hands rise and separate, the left hand moving right into a fold as the right elbow opens, then both descend before the left hand returns left. The right arm lengthens right and lifts while the left hand continues left and lowers, then curls up to the right and back left as the right arm gathers upward and both knees soften. The left arm extends down and left as the right hand rises farther, then the knees straighten in succession and the left hand curls up to finish.

As the right arm lengthens downward, the dancer sends the left hand right and curls it upward, then opens both arms while the right hand rises. The hands sweep left with both elbows bending, the right arm reaching down and back up as the left lowers into an extension. The left arm folds again while the right arm reaches right and drops; the left hand lifts, opens and returns left as the right hand swings right and down, then both rise before the left tucks left. Both hands descend, the right elbow opening and its knee straightening before the hands separate right and left and curl upward. The right hand reverses right and drops into a shared descent as the left continues lowering.

A low arm sweep and knee bend opens the phrase: the right hand lowers and moves left as the right knee softens, then both arms curl upward while the right knee straightens and the left hand continues left. The right hand drops right with an extending elbow as the right knee bends again, then both hands rise, the left arm reaching left before folding back down-right. The hands separate left and right as the right knee straightens, then climb together, the right arm lengthening while the left arm folds and descends into a deeper bend; the right knee sinks as the right hand reaches farther right. Both knees soften beneath another lift of the right hand, which curls while the left knee straightens; the left hand swings left and rises before returning right as the left knee releases and the right arm extends down-left. The right knee bends again beneath a final upward reach, while the left arm folds and the left knee softens further.

As the right arm folds upward and left, the dancer softens the right knee while the left hand sweeps right. The right arm opens and drops as the left elbow tucks, then both hands sweep left and rise with lengthening arms. Both arms curl as the hands separate left and right, then the right hand reverses right and rises while the left hand continues right. The left arm reaches down and left, then lifts into a fold as the right hand dips and rebounds upward. The right hand traces left and back right while the left arm climbs farther and extends.

An alternating arm exchange begins as the dancer raises both hands, lengthening the right arm before both elbows fold and the hands lower. The left hand sweeps right and curls upward while the right arm opens, then rises into a tuck as the left hand drops and its elbow releases. Both hands climb with folded arms, sweep left, and descend, the right hand returning right before both elbows open and the right hand rises again. The left arm curls upward and carries its hand right as the right arm reaches down and left; both hands rise, the left elbow folding before opening and dropping into another curl as the right hand returns right. The right arm lengthens downward while the left hand continues right and lowers, finishing with a tucked elbow.

The dancer makes a paired hand sweep: the right arm curls right as the left arm reaches down and left, then both arms lengthen while the hands reverse inward, the right hand rising. The left hand drops with the left arm folding before the right arm lifts right again; both arms open and descend, then fold as the hands return left. Both elbows release once more as the hands rise, the right arm moving right while the left arm continues left. The left knee straightens as the hands separate and lower, the right arm extending farther. The left knee softens again as the right hand reverses left and rises into a tighter curl.

The right knee straightens as the dancer lowers and lengthens both arms, then lifts the left hand into a fold while the right hand drops right. The left arm opens down-left as the right arm curls upward, then they trade height with both elbows drawing inward and the right knee bending and releasing beneath another rise of the left hand. Both hands sweep left and descend, the right arm opening before both fold; the left hand reverses right and rises into an extension as the right arm tucks again. The left knee softens while the left arm folds down-right and the right hand sweeps left, then both hands lift and return toward the right as the left knee straightens. The right hand dips left and rebounds up-right, joined by the left hand's rising reach to the right; both lower, the right elbow opening and then folding again.

In unison, the dancer lowers and extends both arms before the right hand rises into a curl while the left hand sweeps left. The right arm reaches right as the right knee straightens, then returns left with an opening elbow while the left arm folds upward. Both hands climb, the left hand moving left as the right knee softens; the hands descend together, the right knee releases and bends again, and the elbows fold inward before the left hand reverses right. The left knee lengthens as the left arm opens downward and the right hand curls up, then both sweep left and lower with extending elbows before lifting back right together. The left arm tucks and drops as the right hand curls higher, then reaches down-left while the left hand continues right and the left knee straightens. The right hand returns right and rises with a deeper bend of the right knee, followed by the left arm curling upward to the right and the right hand lowering into another extension.

At the outset, the right knee straightens as the right arm folds and rises left, then both hands descend while the right arm extends. The left hand lifts right into a curl as the bent right knee softens, then both arms tuck and sweep left before lowering with opening elbows; the right knee releases again. Both hands rise, the right hand moving right and the left hand left, before their heights reverse and both arms lengthen. The left hand returns right and drops while the right hand lowers farther left, the right knee bending as the left arm curls upward. The bent right knee releases beneath another upward-left reach of the right arm, which opens while the left hand moves right. The right hand descends into a fold as the right knee softens again, while the left arm tucks left and down.

The right knee softens as the left hand sweeps right and rises, then both hands descend before the right arm reaches up to the left. The left hand follows left with a folded elbow while the raised right hand drops; the bent right knee straightens as the left arm extends down and left and the left knee bends. The descending left arm curls upward and swings right, joined by the right hand as the left knee releases, before the left arm tucks down to the left while the right arm opens. The left knee bends again as the hands separate right and left, with the right hand lowering; the left arm folds down and left while the right arm extends right, then reverses left as the right knee straightens and the right elbow opens. Both arms lengthen downward, the left hand continuing left as the right knee softens.

In opposition, the right hand rises while the left hand moves right and the right knee straightens; both hands climb as the left knee softens. The left hand drops and rebounds upward with a bend of the right knee, then sweeps left as the right leg extends again. The right hand follows left while both knees lengthen and the right arm curls up and back right. Both hands lower, the right hand sweeping left and the left hand right, before the left hand reverses left and both rise as the right knee bends. The hands separate sideways and descend, then the right arm reaches right while the left arm curls upward.

The right hand sweeps left and up. The left hand curls rightward as the right arm folds, then the right hand reverses right while the left elbow opens and refolds; both hands lower before the right arm tucks and carries the right hand back left. Both arms lengthen downward and sweep right, then fold upward as the right knee softens and the left knee bends and straightens in succession. The hands separate left and right with extending elbows, descend, and return toward each other as the knees deepen their bend. Both elbows curl as the legs straighten, the right hand rising and moving right before dropping into a reach while the left hand continues right. The right hand lifts again, folds, and lowers as the right knee bends further, then returns right and rises through an unfolding elbow.

The right knee softens as the dancer folds the right arm rightward and lowers the left hand left, then both hands rise with the left arm extending. The hands separate sideways and descend, the left arm curling upward again before opening downward as the right knee straightens; the right arm reaches up-left and reverses down-right while the left knee bends deeper. Both knees lengthen as the hands reverse inward, the left arm rising into a tighter fold and both elbows drawing inward before the left arm opens back down-left. The left knee softens beneath another shared lift, followed by a curl and drop of the left arm while the right hand travels right and rises. The right hand returns left as both knees bend, then its elbow releases before both hands sweep right and climb together.

As the right knee straightens, the dancer lengthens the left arm left while the right hand lifts left and both knees bend. The left arm curls upward as the right knee releases, then the right hand rises right while the left arm descends left; both hands lower before the right arm folds left and the left arm reaches up-right over a bending knee. The right hand returns right as the bent knee straightens and the left arm extends down-left, then both knees soften with the right arm opening downward. The right knee releases as the left arm gathers up-right, followed by the right hand rising and both arms extending. The left hand climbs farther while the right arm tucks and lowers toward the left, then opens into a shared lift.

The right knee softens as the dancer curls the right arm upward, then straightens the right knee while both hands sweep left. The left hand drops and returns right with a folding elbow, joined by the raised right arm curling inward. Both hands rise as the left knee bends, then the right hand travels right while the left arm opens and lowers; the bent left knee straightens as both hands descend. The right arm lengthens down-left while the left hand lifts left, and the right knee extends further as the right arm folds up-right. The right arm opens again and both hands lower, ending with the right hand moving left as the left hand continues right.

The right arm drops and curls while the left arm rises. Then the right arm extends down-right while the left elbow tucks. The right hand sweeps left as both knees straighten, and the left arm lengthens downward before both hands rise with bent elbows. Both knees soften as the left arm reaches right and returns left, then the hands climb and separate left and right with the left arm folding inward. The hands descend together, the right arm extending as the right knee bends and releases, while the left hand moves left and both elbows open. The right hand shifts right as the left knee deepens its bend and the right leg straightens again.

To begin, the dancer folds the right arm and lowers the right hand right while the left arm curls upward and left. The right arm reaches farther down-right as the left knee softens, then both hands climb before the right hand moves left and drops against the left hand's rightward sweep. The left hand rises into a fold, followed by the left arm curling upward as the right knee straightens. Both arms extend downward, then rise together with the left hand continuing right. The right hand falls left while the left hand returns left, curls down and opens back up as the right knee bends and straightens.

The right knee bends and releases as the dancer folds the right arm upward, then opens both elbows while the right hand drops left. The right knee softens again beneath a rightward curling left hand and an opening rightward arm, while the right hand rises into a tuck and returns down to the right. Both hands descend, the rightward-reaching arm lengthening before its hand curls upward, and the left knee bends as the raised hand moves right and down with a deeper fold. The left knee straightens while the lowered hand sweeps left and the left arm reaches up to the right; the sweeping hand reverses right and descends as the extended arm lowers and curls inward. The left curled arm continues down and left through another bend of the left knee, while the right knee straightening accompanies the right hand's downward-left sweep. The descending arm draws farther inward as the knees soften in succession, then releases downward while the right arm extends right and the right knee straightens.

In unison, the dancer lifts both hands and sends them left, then lowers and lengthens the right arm while the left arm curls right. The right hand reverses right and rises as the right knee straightens, before both hands descend; the left hand returns left into a curl while the right arm folds higher and moves left. Both elbows open as the raised hand sweeps right and drops, then the right hand climbs right with a deeper tuck and the right knee extends further. The left hand rises and shifts right, followed by the right hand's upward sweep to the left, before both descend. The right arm reaches farther left and down as the left elbow opens.

As the left arm folds left and the right arm extends right, the dancer lengthens the right arm upward before lowering both hands. The left hand drops farther while the right hand moves left, then both hands sweep right as the left knee softens and the right elbow tucks. Both hands return left and rise, the right arm opening into a rightward reach as the left knee straightens. The right hand climbs higher while the left hand descends and swings right-left with another knee bend. The right hand returns left as the left arm curls up-right, then reverses left and opens while the right hand lifts again.

As the right arm folds upward, the left hand drops and reaches right while the right hand sweeps left. The left arm curls up and back left as the right knee bends, then both hands descend before the left hand rises again and the right knee straightens. Both arms extend down as the right knee softens and the right hand moves right; the right knee then lengthens while the left hand returns left and lifts into a fold. The dancer opens both elbows as the right hand lowers, the right knee straightens, and the right hand continues left while the left arm extends downward. The left arm lengthens farther and the right knee softens again.

As the right arm curls upward and reaches right, the dancer straightens the left knee and lowers the left hand into a fold. The right hand dips left as the left hand climbs right and both arms open, then the left hand rises while the right hand sweeps down-left before reversing right. The right arm lengthens farther and curls back up-right, followed by the left hand moving right and rising with a tuck. The left hand continues right and down as the right hand extends downward, then returns left and upward into a longer reach while the right arm folds. Both hands lift, the left hand opening as the right hand curls right; the left hand drops and swings left before rising again, while the right hand travels left.

The right knee straightens as the dancer extends the left arm leftward, then the right knee softens while both hands sweep right and rise. The left arm curls and continues right before opening into a shared leftward return; the right hand lowers and the right knee bends deeper as the left arm folds upward. The right knee straightens beneath a further lift and curl of the left arm, which then opens down and left while the right arm tucks higher. The right hand rises with a lengthening elbow as the left knee softens, then both hands sweep left and descend. The left hand reverses right while the right hand moves left, then the raised hand returns right as the left knee bends and the left elbow opens.

As the right hand drops, the dancer folds both elbows and sends the left hand left, then lowers the left hand while the right arm opens down-left. The right knee bends as the left hand curls upward, followed by the right hand lifting left into a tuck. Both arms lengthen downward, the hands separating right and left before returning toward each other. The right hand climbs right with an extending elbow while the left hand lifts left into a fold, then the right arm curls upward again.

As the right hand sweeps left and down, the dancer folds both arms, then extends them upward before reversing their lateral paths. The right arm tucks again as the left arm drops and curls rightward, while the left hand returns left with an opening elbow. Both hands rise and sweep right as the knee beneath the right arm softens, then descend together, that knee straightening as the left arm lengthens downward. The knees alternate bending and extending beneath each hand while the left arm reaches up-left and the right arm tucks; both hands lower and return right, the left elbow folding before the hands rise again. The right knee bends as its arm curls higher, followed by the left knee sinking beneath a further lift of the left hand; the bent knee releases as the curled arm opens and descends. Both knees soften as the right hand rises and the left hand travels left, then the right knee straightens while the left leg deepens its bend and the raised hand swings right.

As the right hand sweeps right and down, the dancer lowers the left hand toward the left. Both hands rise, the left hand reversing right and curling inward before the hands descend and separate again. The right hand reaches left and curls upward while the left hand travels right and tucks; both then lower into open arms, with the left hand returning left. The hands climb as both elbows fold, then the right hand moves right while the left hand drops and extends. The left hand curls upward, sweeps left and opens downward, joined by the right hand's descent and its own return to the right.

As the right arm folds down and left, the dancer sends the left hand right with a bent elbow, then lowers both hands. The right hand returns up and right while the left knee bends, straightens and softens again beneath a lowering, lengthening arm that sweeps left and back right. The right hand drops as the left arm opens left and rises, followed by the right arm curling upward to the right; the left knee bends before the right hand reaches up and left and the left hand follows left. Both knees sink in succession as the arms tuck and the right hand moves right, then the knees straighten while the right hand lowers and the left knee extends farther. The left arm draws in toward the right as the left knee softens and the right knee straightens further, ending with both hands moving right.

At the opening, the dancer folds the left arm while the right hand rises right and drops left into a curl. The left hand lifts as the right knee bends, then both hands sweep right, the right arm opening before lowering and tucking back in as the right knee straightens. Both arms lengthen upward, the left hand continuing right while the right hand moves left, before they descend and the left hand reaches farther right. The right arm curls up and left, followed by the left hand rising right into a bend; both lower and open toward the left as the knees soften, then lift again with the left arm extending. Both hands return right, the right arm folding downward as the right knee straightens, before the hands rise together and the left elbow draws inward.

The right knee softens beneath the rising right hand that curls right, then lowers and extends as the left hand travels left. The right arm folds up-left and opens again while the left arm curls upward; both hands descend, the right arm reaching left before reversing right. The right hand lifts into a fold as the right knee straightens, then drops and lengthens farther right while the left arm rises with a tucked elbow. The dancer repeats the lifting curl-and-release figure with the right hand, then sweeps it right, down and left with an extended arm as the left knee bends and releases. Both hands rise, the right hand folding leftward while the left hand moves right and descends, then the right hand dips and rebounds into another curl.

The right knee softens as the dancer lowers and extends the left arm left, then bends the right elbow while the left hand drops right. The hands separate right and left with the left-moving arm curling upward, before both return left and the left arm opens down. The right hand swings right and back left as the right knee straightens, then rises and folds while the left hand curls up right; the raised arm reaches down right and tucks again. Both arms open, the left hand lifting left and dropping into a bend while the right hand moves right, then returns left as the left arm lengthens downward. The right arm folds up right and releases down as the left hand reverses left and curls upward, then the lower hand sweeps left and climbs into another fold while the left arm extends down.

The right hand rises and sweeps left. The left hand moves right and down, then both hands descend as the right knee softens; the right hand continues left while the left hand curls upward and returns left. Both hands rise and separate, the left hand moving right as the left knee bends further, then they lower and reverse sideways before lifting again with the left knee straightening. The left arm tucks left and opens right as the left hand descends and the right hand curls up-right, then lowers into a tighter fold while the right hand lifts farther. The left arm extends left and down before reversing right as the right arm reaches up-left, then folds back left while the right hand drops.

At the outset, the dancer folds the right arm while the left arm reaches left and down, then lifts both hands as the right hand continues right. Both arms lengthen downward, sweep left together, and curl upward again. The right knee bends as the right hand rises farther right and opens into a descent, while the left hand drops and the right knee straightens. The right hand rebounds upward and left against the left hand's rightward reach, with the right knee softening before both knees extend. The right arm curls higher, then drops while the left knee bends and releases beneath the left hand rising; both hands lift and the left hand sweeps left.

At the opening, the right arm curls upward while the left hand sweeps left and rises, then both arms lengthen as the left hand reverses right. The left elbow folds, and the right hand continues right before reversing left and lowering with an extending arm. The right arm reaches farther left, then curls upward as the right knee softens and the left hand drops; the right arm opens again and lowers while the left arm tucks. Both hands sweep right and rise, the right arm folding as the left extends, before the hands descend together and the right arm lengthens. The left hand lifts and returns left while the right hand sinks, then both climb into a shared curl, the left arm finishing with a rightward reach.

An alternating arm sweep begins as the dancer lifts the right hand rightward and lengthens the left arm, then carries both arms left while the right knee straightens. The right hand drops farther left and curls upward as the left knee bends and the left hand moves right; the right arm opens downward before both hands rise again. Both arms fold and descend into a shared leftward sweep, then the right hand rises and returns right as the right knee softens and the left elbow tightens further. The left knee straightens as the right hand lowers rightward, while the left hand reaches left and rises with a bent elbow; the right knee then extends. The left hand drops and continues left, opening its elbow, before the right hand shifts right and down as the left hand rises rightward.

The right knee straightens as the dancer lowers and extends both arms, then sends the right hand right while the left hand drops left over a bend and release of the left knee. The right arm curls upward toward the left as the left hand rises rightward and the left knee softens; both elbows open before the left arm folds down-left and the right hand reverses right. Both hands descend into bent elbows, the right hand curling up-right before extending downward and left as the left knee bends and releases; the left arm reaches down-right while the right hand tucks again and sweeps right. The right knee lengthens as the hands separate left and right with opening elbows, then the right hand rises while the left arm folds down and left, followed by a deeper bend in the right knee and another lift of the right hand. The right elbow opens as the left hand moves right and both knees soften, then the left arm draws inward toward the left while the right hand descends and the right knee straightens. The left hand continues left over another bend and release in the left knee, ending with an extension of the right arm.

Downward, the dancer softens both knees and lowers the right hand while the left arm folds and the left knee bends farther. The descending right hand sweeps left as the folded left arm reaches right, then both hands rise with the left elbow opening before the left hand returns left and the right arm curls upward. The hands separate left and right as the right arm lengthens, then both descend and sweep back toward each other; the left arm folds and releases as the right hand lifts rightward. Both hands climb again, the left arm curling higher before the right hand drops left while the left hand sweeps right and down. The left hand rises into a fold as the right hand moves left, then the left arm opens downward while the right arm curls upward and swings right.

The right hand curls upward. The dancer sweeps both hands left, folding the left arm as the right arm opens and the left knee straightens, then returns the right hand right into a fold while the left elbow tucks further. Both arms lengthen as the right knee softens and the left knee bends, then they sweep left with the hands dropping and the right knee bending deeper. The hands reverse right as the knees straighten, the left hand rising into an extension while the right arm curls higher, then both descend as the right knee bends again. The left hand reaches up-left and folds inward as the left knee straightens; the right hand rises left and tucks more deeply before sweeping down-right alongside the left hand's downward extension. The right hand climbs right into a tighter fold while the left arm curls upward, and both finish lifting.

As the right knee straightens, the dancer lowers and lengthens the left arm leftward, then raises the left hand into a curl while the right arm folds upward. The left hand sweeps right as the right knee beneath it softens and both arms open downward. The left hand returns left with a deeper extension while the right arm curls up and right, the right knee releases, and the right hand follows right. The hands separate left and right as the right elbow tucks, then the left hand drops left with an extending arm and the right knee bends again; both hands rise as the right knee releases and the right elbow opens. The right hand moves left and curls inward over a bending right knee while the left hand lifts right, then the right arm extends down to the right and both hands descend as the right knee straightens. The left arm lengthens farther left and lowers while the right hand rises, ending with the left hand moving right and the right hand continuing left.

A rising and falling arm exchange begins with the right hand lifting left, then both arms lengthening downward as the left hand moves right. The right hand curls upward while the left knee straightens and the left hand rises; the right knee bends as the curled arm extends right and down, then both hands sweep left before the left hand lifts and the right hand curls upward again. Both knees soften as the hands descend and the left arm tucks; the right hand moves right and the right knee releases, followed by a bend of the left knee and an extension of the right. The left hand rises as the left knee straightens, while the right hand lowers into a fold and the left arm opens down-left; the bent left knee releases as the right arm reaches right and lifts, then the left hand climbs while the right hand drops and the right knee softens again. The right arm curls up-left and the left hand follows left, then the right arm descends as the right knee lengthens and the left elbow folds. The right knee bends once more as the left hand lowers.

To begin, the dancer folds the right arm while the left hand travels right, then lowers and lengthens the left arm. The right hand moves left as both arms open downward, with the left knee bending beneath its further-reaching left hand. That bent left knee straightens as the right hand rises and sweeps right; the left arm curls up and left while the right arm extends down and right, then reverses left. Both hands descend and sweep right, the left arm opening and the right arm tucking, before they return left and rise together with the left elbow drawing inward. The left hand continues left and down as the right hand reaches farther right and drops, then curls upward while the left arm opens downward again.

The right hand rises leftward. The dancer folds the left arm down and right, then opens it as the right hand moves right and its elbow tucks again. The left arm curls up-left while the right hand sweeps left and drops into a longer reach; the right hand follows left and climbs as both elbows draw in. The hands separate right and left before reversing inward, with the right arm folding downward, opening right and curling back up. The left arm extends right, then returns left as the right arm reaches farther up-right. Both hands descend, the left hand moving right and lengthening while the right hand folds.

As the right arm reaches down and left, the dancer lowers the left hand, then curls the right arm upward while the right knee bends and straightens. The left hand sweeps left as the curled right arm continues right, both hands dropping before the right arm reverses left and tucks into a rising lift. The left hand swings right and back left as the lifted right arm extends downward, then the left hand rises again while the extended right arm curls up and right. Both elbows open and the knees soften in succession, with the right-moving left hand continuing upward; the right knee straightens as the raised left hand reverses left, followed by the right hand.

The dancer lifts the right hand. The left hand rises and falls as the right arm folds, then sweeps left with an opening elbow before both hands descend and the right arm tucks again. Both hands rise with the left arm curling, then separate right and left, the left hand lengthening downward while the right hand returns left and curls upward. The right curled hand drops and extends as the left arm opens, and the left hand rises left; the right arm folds up-right while the left arm reaches farther left and curls inward. Both hands sweep right as the right arm opens and the right knee softens, then the left arm folds down-left and the right arm tucks back left before releasing.

As the right hand moves left, the dancer straightens the right knee, then the left knee. The left arm folds and lowers, then releases as the left knee bends and the left hand travels left before curling upward and right while the right arm extends downward. The right arm opens into a sustained climb toward the right, then reverses left as the right knee straightens and the left knee softens. Both hands descend with the right elbow folding, then the left hand sweeps left and up while the left knee lengthens further. The right arm tucks more deeply as the right knee sinks again, and the right hand rises while the left hand continues left.

To begin, the dancer lifts the left hand left and curls it upward as the right arm folds, then sends both hands right with the left hand lowering and opening its arm. The right hand rises and returns left while the left hand reaches right and drops; both arms lengthen before the hands sweep down and left and curl upward together. The hands reverse right and descend into open arms, then the left hand sweeps left and back right while the right hand moves left, folds, and lowers. Both elbows draw inward as the hands climb, then separate sideways and lower with the right arm extending. The left hand returns left and rises with a tighter elbow while the right hand curls upward again.

The right knee softens as the dancer sends both hands left and lowers them, then opens the left arm while the right arm curls upward. The right knee straightens as the lowered right hand rises into a fold; both knees lengthen before the left knee bends and releases beneath an upward sweep right of the right hand. Both hands descend and return left, the left arm folding and reopening as the right knee softens and straightens. The right hand lifts with a curling elbow while the left arm reaches right and down, then the hands exchange height, the lower hand dropping farther as the right knee extends again. The left hand sweeps left and down while the right arm tucks, opens and re-folds toward the right.

To begin, the dancer lifts the right hand rightward into a curl while the left arm folds and the right knee softens, then lowers both hands with the initial elbow opening before the right hand rises leftward. The left hand climbs as the right knee straightens, then both arms gather upward and sweep right before descending together. Both knees bend in succession, and the right hand curls up and left as the left knee deepens its bend; the hands reverse left and right before the right arm lengthens downward and the left knee releases. The left knee bends again as the left hand returns left, then extends while the right hand rises left and the left arm folds upward, followed by another release of the right knee. The left arm opens down to the right and the left knee straightens as the right hand continues left and down; the left knee then bends while the right knee sinks farther and the right hand reverses right. The left leg releases as the left hand drops and the left knee bends once more, ending with the right hand moving left and the left hand sweeping right.

As the dancer lengthens the right arm down-right and folds it, the left hand rises rightward into a curl while the right hand continues downward. The left hand drops as both arms open, then they separate left and right with another shared descent before folding again. Both hands sweep left, the right hand rising and tucking further as the left elbow extends, before the left arm lifts and curls back right. The right hand lowers and reaches right while the left hand continues upward, then the left arm folds through a lift and release. The right arm opens down-left as its knee softens, while the left hand returns left and rises into a curl.

As the right hand sweeps left, the dancer lifts both hands and folds both arms, then opens the left arm into a rising rightward reach while the right arm curls higher. Both hands return left with lengthening elbows as the right knee straightens, then the right hand lowers before the left hand drops farther and its arm tucks. The right arm extends upward alongside the left's raised elbow, then both descend and fold as the right hand sweeps right; the left arm releases downward while the right hand rises again. The right hand reverses left as the left arm reaches up-right, then returns right and down while the left arm folds left and lowers. The right hand lifts and dips once more, opening into a final rise as the left arm extends downward.

Rightward, the dancer carries the right hand while the left hand travels left and down. The right-moving arm curls up-left as the left arm folds down-right, then both hands sweep left before the left hand rises and reverses right with a deeper tuck. Both arms lengthen downward, the right hand continuing to descend before curling upward again. The left hand reaches farther right as the right arm opens, then both return left and lower, the left hand folding in while the right hand extends. The right hand continues left and curls upward alongside the left rising arm.

As the left arm folds upward and left, the dancer softens both knees and extends the right arm downward. The left hand sweeps right, rises into a tighter tuck, then returns left as both knees straighten and the right elbow draws inward. Both arms lengthen and lower, with the left hand continuing left before the hands separate right and left; the left arm curls up and left while the right arm reaches right and rises. The right arm opens down-right as the left hand lowers and the left knee bends, then the left knee straightens beneath an upward curling reach to the left. The left hand lifts right and folds back left while the right arm drops right, then both hands descend with the left arm extending.

At the outset, the dancer lifts the right hand and lowers the left hand, then sweeps both hands left as the right arm lengthens down and the left knee straightens. The left hand continues left while the right arm curls upward, then returns right with an opening elbow as the left knee bends; both hands descend and sweep right before the left knee extends again. The left knee softens as the left hand rises and falls with a tucked elbow, while the right hand reaches up-left and reverses right into a fold. The left hand moves right and curls upward as the left knee bends and releases, then the right hand travels right and down with an extending elbow while the right hand drops right. Both hands climb and separate sideways, the right arm curling before the left knee softens and the left hand reverses left and down.

A side-to-side arm exchange begins as the dancer opens the right arm rightward, then curls it up-left while the left hand rises left; both arms lengthen and lower toward the right. The hands sweep left together before the right hand reverses right and climbs with a fold, while the left hand moves down-left into an extension. Both hands return right as the raised right elbow tucks farther and the right hand drops, then the left arm curls upward before opening downward. The initially raised right arm folds higher to the left, followed by the left hand lifting left as both elbows draw inward. The left hand descends, extends right, and returns left while the right arm continues curling upward.

The dancer curls the right arm upward. Both hands sweep left, the left hand rising as its elbow folds, then the right hand lifts and both arms lengthen before descending and sweeping right. The left arm gathers in while the right arm reaches up-left and back right; both elbows tuck and release as the left hand rises left, followed by the right hand curling upward. Both arms fold again and descend toward the right, with the right hand continuing right and the left elbow opening. The left hand reverses left and lowers as the right arm extends downward, then curls upward while the left hand moves right.

The dancer lengthens the right arm rightward. The left hand moves left as the right knee straightens, then both hands rise and reverse their sideways directions, the right hand continuing right while the left arm curls down-right. Both arms fold downward with a right-to-left sweep, then open and rise into another reversal of direction; the right hand returns right before both lower and tuck. The right hand lifts again toward the right as the left knee bends and releases beneath its own extending elbow, while the left hand sweeps left and rises. The knees alternate bending and straightening as the right hand drops right and rebounds upward, followed by the left hand lifting toward the right.

The right knee softens as the dancer sends the left hand left and down, then lifts it into a curl while the right arm extends downward. The left arm continues upward and opens as the right knee straightens, then folds again before both hands rise. The left hand reaches right while the right hand climbs and curls inward, and the right knee bends further as the left hand drops left and the raised arm tucks tighter. The right arm releases downward, then sweeps right and curls back up as the right knee lengthens; both hands continue right and descend with an opening elbow. The left arm gathers upward as the right knee bends, then the right hand rises and sweeps left while the left arm extends down. The left knee softens and straightens as the right hand returns right and lowers, joined by the left hand's descent.

The dancer lengthens both arms. The right hand drops and the left hand reaches right as the right knee bends, then the left arm curls upward while the right hand lowers and extends; the left arm opens left and down, the right knee straightens, and the hands exchange height before the left elbow folds. Both knees soften in succession as the left hand rises, swings left and returns right into a tuck, then drops with the right arm curling up-right; the right knee releases while the left hand climbs farther. The right hand lowers and moves right as both arms extend, then the left hand lifts and sweeps left with a bend of the left knee, followed by the right arm folding down-right. The left arm opens upward as the bent left knee straightens and the right hand continues right, then the elbows reverse their tucks and release before the left hand lowers. Both hands shift right, the right arm extending downward while the left arm curls up-left and the right knee softens.

The right arm curls upward as the left arm reaches left, then the right arm opens down and right while the left hand climbs farther. The right hand reverses left and folds as the right knee softens, while the left arm extends downward and right; the right arm lifts again as the right knee straightens. The right arm lengthens downward and sweeps left as the left hand rises, with both knees bending and releasing in succession. The hands separate left and right, the left-moving arm curling upward before reaching back down and right, while the right elbow tucks and the right knee softens. The right arm opens down and left as the left hand rises into a fold, then both knees bend while the right arm continues left and down and the left arm drops right. The left arm curls up and releases downward as the right knee deepens and the right hand moves right, finishing with another lift of the left arm.

The right knee straightens as the dancer lowers both hands, then sends the right hand right while the left hand curls upward and folds down-left. The right hand rises and lengthens left before folding downward, followed by the left arm curling up-right as the right knee softens. The left hand drops right and opens while the right hand climbs left; both arms extend and descend into a shared leftward sweep. The left arm curls up-right and releases downward as the right hand reaches up-left, then folds higher while the left hand lifts right with a tuck. Both hands sweep right and lower as the elbows open, then reverse left with renewed height in the right hand.

To begin, the dancer lowers both hands and straightens the right knee while the right hand sweeps left and reverses right with a folding arm. The left knee bends as the left arm opens down-left, then the hands separate sideways, the right arm curling upward before reversing left and dropping into an extension. Both knees soften as the left hand rises leftward, then the right hand moves right and both knees straighten before the raised arm curls back right and lowers over another bend of the left knee. The left knee releases as the lower hand tucks left and the right hand lifts right, then the tucked arm lengthens right and the left hand drops into an opening arm. The right hand returns up-left and folds as the left knee bends again, then both hands rise and sweep left with the right arm extending before returning right and the left elbow drawing inward.

As the right arm curls upward and right, the dancer lowers the left hand left into a fold, then lifts both hands with an opening elbow. The initially raised right hand drops right as its knee softens, while the left hand continues left and down before both arms lengthen. The left hand reverses right and rises into a curl as the right arm extends downward, then reaches back left while the right arm folds up and left. Both hands sweep right and descend as the knees bend, followed by another lift of the right hand while the left hand returns left and its knee straightens. The right arm opens into a leftward reach that drops and returns right, joined by the left hand as the left knee bends; the left arm curls up and left, then releases into a descent to the right.

The arms trade height as the right hand rises, folds inward, and returns down-right while the left hand drops left; both then rise with the right arm opening and the left arm curling upward and right. The left hand sweeps left and lowers into an extension as the right hand curls up-left, then the hands exchange heights twice before the right hand releases down-right. The right arm tucks downward as the left arm reaches up-left, and both sweep right with the left elbow drawing in; they return left and open, the left hand descending as the right arm lengthens again. Both hands lift leftward with bent elbows, then separate right and left as the left arm extends and its knee softens; they climb farther before lowering together, the left arm folding back toward the left. The knees straighten in succession beneath a shared rightward sweep, followed by the left hand dropping and opening as both hands move left.

As the right arm folds, the dancer lowers the left hand right and extends it, then raises both hands with the right arm opening. The right hand drops left while the left hand continues upward; both sweep right as the right arm curls and the right knee bends, then both elbows tuck farther before the right hand returns left and both descend. The left arm reaches down-right and lengthens as the right hand rises, then folds downward while the left hand climbs left. Both arms open through a drop and rise, the right hand moving right as its elbow bends and the left hand falls rightward. The right arm gathers up-left while the left hand sweeps left, opens downward and swings back right, then both hands climb with the right elbow tightening further.

The right knee straightens as the dancer curls the right arm upward and right, then opens it downward while the left hand lifts into a fold; both hands sweep left before the right arm drops and the left arm rises with its elbow tucked. The right hand travels right and back left as the right knee bends, then both arms lengthen and their hands climb left before the left hand returns right and the knees straighten in succession. Both arms curl down and open toward the right, the right hand rising as the left knee softens beneath another lift of the left hand and its elbow folds. The right hand reaches right with an extended arm while the left hand drops left and tucks further, then both hands return right as the right knee bends and releases and the left hand climbs with a deeper elbow fold. The left hand swings left as its elbow opens, then lowers while the right arm curls up and right and the left knee bends; the right hand follows left as the left arm lengthens downward and both elbows release.

A repeated arm exchange begins with the right hand curling up and right while the left hand rises left into a fold, then lowers as both arms open. The raised left hand drops right before both arms sweep left and climb with bent elbows, the right hand continuing upward. Both hands descend and reverse right, the right elbow tucking before the right hand returns left and down while the left hand extends farther right. The left hand curls up and right as the right hand sweeps left and rises into a fold; the left hand continues right and opens downward, then both hands return left with the left arm lengthening further. The right hand curls higher and swings right while the left hand rises left into another fold, then drops and unfolds as the right arm opens and lowers.

The right arm curls up and left. The left hand rises right as the right arm opens, then both arms descend and sweep left before the right arm reverses right with a deeper fold. Both arms lengthen downward, then rise again, the right arm sweeping left while the left arm curls down-right. The right hand returns up-right as the left elbow releases, and the hands separate horizontally before descending together into folded elbows. They reverse their sideways directions once more, then the left hand lifts and drops while the right arm opens upward, followed by a shared lift and another release of the left elbow.

The right hand rises while the left hand drops, then both arms descend and lengthen before the right hand climbs right. The arms separate left and right, fold upward, then reverse sideways while the right hand opens down and both elbows tuck again. Both hands climb into folds and exchange lateral directions once more, with the right hand dipping before returning up and left as the left hand sweeps right. The left hand extends downward, curls upward to the left, then reaches farther left before lowering and reopening. The right hand rises into a bend and falls, ending with the right knee straightening.

The right hand moves right and the left hand rises left. Then both hands descend as the right hand curls upward again. The hands separate right and left before reversing sideways. At the same time, the left knee straightens and the right arm tucks into a low sweep right and back left. Both arms lengthen downward, the left hand continuing left as the right knee bends and straightens beneath an upward curl of the right hand. The right hand drops and extends while the left arm sweeps right, then returns left as the left knee softens and both knees straighten in succession. The right hand lifts, folds and descends, while the left arm reaches farther left.

The right hand rises. The left arm curls upward, then both hands descend and separate left and right with lengthening elbows before the right hand reverses left and folds. The left knee bends as the right hand drops, then straightens while both arms tuck and lift toward the right. Both knees soften in succession beneath the hands, which lower and open; the right arm extends farther down and left while the left arm curls up and reaches right. The left leg lengthens as the right arm tucks and releases downward, joined by the left hand sinking into a fold. The hands rise together, the right arm opening before both elbows bend again.

The dancer performs a leftward arm sweep after the left knee straightens: the left hand lowers, folds inward and swings right, then returns left as the right hand rises. The left hand climbs left while the right hand continues upward and right, with both arms lengthening before the right hand drops. Both hands reverse inward and rise, the left arm folding before sweeping down and right alongside the right hand. The right hand reaches up and left as the left hand moves right and curls inward, followed by a lift and return of the left hand. The left arm draws farther in as the right hand drops and opens left, ending with both hands descending.

As the right hand moves right, the dancer folds the left arm and straightens the right knee, then lowers and lengthens the left arm while the right elbow opens. The right hand drops and sweeps left as the left hand curls upward, then both hands rise with the left hand moving right before it descends. Both arms tuck and lower, then open outward; the right hand swings right and back left as the left arm folds again. The right arm curls up and left while the left hand rises right, followed by a renewed downward sweep of the right hand to the right and the left hand descending left. The right knee softens beneath a final upward reach of the right hand, which then extends farther right.

The right knee straightens as the dancer extends the right arm right and the left arm left, then lowers both hands before lifting them. The arms fold and separate sideways, the right arm reaching down-right while the left arm curls up-left over a bending knee; both sweep right with that knee releasing, then reverse left as the opposite knee bends and the leading hand returns right. The hands climb and exchange lateral directions, the left arm curling upward over a bent knee before that knee straightens and its arm opens down-left, while the right arm reaches right and rises into an extension. Both hands move right as the opposite arm tucks, then the leading hand drops left and unfolds; the tucked arm sweeps down-left, opens, and reverses right over a bend and release of its knee. That hand climbs through another knee pulse as the other travels right and down, then lowers left while the raised arm curls farther upward.

The dancer lifts the left hand toward the left. The right arm curls upward and right as both hands rise, then the left arm lengthens downward while the right elbow opens. Both arms fold and descend together before the left hand sweeps right with an extension of the left arm. The right hand follows right and rises into a longer reach as the left hand drops farther down.

At the outset, the right knee softens while the left knee straightens, and the dancer lifts the right hand into a rightward reach before lowering it left as the right knee extends. The left arm curls up and right, then both hands rise with the right elbow drawing inward; the left hand returns down-left and lengthens as the left knee bends, while the right hand reaches farther right. Both hands descend as the left knee straightens, then the right arm folds upward to the left as the left knee softens again and the left hand lifts. The right hand drops right and opens as the left arm tucks higher and the left knee extends, then both arms curl up toward the right while the right knee bends. The left hand lowers and opens as the left knee straightens and the right arm releases downward, ending with the left hand reaching left.

The right knee straightens as the dancer folds both arms and lowers both hands, then lifts them together into a leftward sweep. The right arm opens downward while the left hand continues right and rises with a deeper elbow bend. The left hand drops and curls back up-left as the right hand moves right and the right knee softens. Both hands sweep left before the right arm extends down-right; the left hand descends and opens, then the right hand reverses left as the right knee bends further. The left hand continues left and reaches down-right, ending with the right hand moving left and the right knee extending.

The right hand lowers as the left hand rises and extends right, then the right hand climbs left into a curl while the left arm folds and drops. The right hand moves right and opens, followed by the left arm lengthening downward. The right hand continues right and tucks in as the left arm lifts rightward, then returns left and curls upward while the left arm extends down and left. Both hands sweep right as the left arm folds, reverses left and releases downward.

At the outset, the right hand moves right as the left arm lengthens downward and the right knee softens, then both hands sweep left and climb with elbows folding. The hands reverse right, the right hand rising farther while the left hand drops and its arm opens, before the right knee straightens and the left hand continues down. The right hand reverses left as the left arm curls upward, then both arms extend through another shared rightward sweep; the right hand climbs while the left hand sinks. Both hands descend and return left, the right hand curling in as the left hand extends. The hands rise again, the right hand moving right before they separate left and right and drop together.

The right knee bends as the dancer lowers the right hand and extends the right arm left, then lifts both hands while the left knee straightens and the right arm curls back right. The right knee softens again as the left hand drops, both arms lengthen downward, and the hands separate left and right before curling upward; the right hand returns right while the left hand reaches left. Both knees straighten as the right hand lowers and the right arm opens, followed by a rise of the left hand with a bent elbow. The right arm folds and lifts while the left hand sweeps left, drops into an extension, and rises right; both hands climb as the left arm tucks and the right hand moves left. The right hand continues left while the left hand descends right, then both arms extend and their hands lower.

A rising, folding arm phrase begins with the right hand moving left and curling upward as the left hand follows left in a tighter fold. The right arm extends down while the left arm lifts, then both sweep right and rise with bent elbows before the left arm lowers. Both hands return left, the left arm lengthening downward, then reversing right and folding upward. The left arm opens again and tucks back down toward the left as the left knee softens, while the right hand continues right and curls upward. The right arm extends farther left before both hands climb into folds, the right knee bending further as the right hand moves right.

The right hand sweeps right. The left hand follows right as the right arm drops and opens, then curls upward while the left hand moves left and lowers; both knees bend in succession before the hands reverse sideways, the left lifting rightward and the right returning left with a deeper fold. Both hands climb toward the right, the right arm lengthening and the left knee softening, then descend as the right reaches farther right and its knee straightens. The left hand returns left and rises with a tucked elbow while the right curls up and right, followed by another lift of the left hand as the right knee bends. The hands separate left and right before descending together, the right extending into a rising rightward reach and the left moving left as both knees soften and the arms unfold. Both hands sweep left and rise, the left curling inward as the right continues higher, then separate again, the right traveling right while the left reverses right and descends.

To begin, the dancer lowers the right hand right and sends both hands left, then lifts them as the right arm curls back right and the left arm lengthens. The left knee straightens while the right hand drops left and the right arm opens, followed by the left hand descending and folding as the left knee softens. Both hands rise, with the right arm curling inward and the left arm extending, before the hands separate right and left and lower over a bend of the right knee. The hands reverse sideways and climb, the right arm opening as the right knee straightens, while the left arm folds and the left knee bends; they sweep left together, then the right hand rises and returns right. Both knees soften as the arms lengthen downward, then the left knee straightens and both hands lift rightward before lowering again as the left leg extends further.

The dancer raises the right hand. The right hand drops and sweeps left as the left knee straightens, then both hands rise with the left arm curling in; the right hand reverses right while its elbow opens and the left hand tucks farther. The right hand climbs as the right knee bends, then the left hand curls higher and travels right before lowering over a straightening leg, while the right arm folds down and returns left. The left hand rises again as the left knee softens, then drops right into an extended reach while the right hand moves up-left and both knees lengthen. The right hand lowers and swings right as the left arm folds upward and left over a bending knee, then returns left and drops with the left knee straightening while the right hand continues left and curls up-right.

An alternating arm weave begins as the dancer bends the right knee and lowers the right hand left, then lengthens the right knee while the left hand curls up-right. The right hand reverses right as the left arm opens down-left, followed by the left arm unfolding downward; both hands sweep left before the left hand returns right and the right hand climbs into a fold. Both arms open and descend, the left hand continuing left as the right knee softens and the right elbow tucks; the left knee bends beneath a curling left hand, then straightens as the left arm releases downward. The right arm folds farther inward as the right knee lengthens again and the left hand rises right with a bent elbow. The right knee bends as the right hand drops left, then both knees soften while the left arm extends down-left and the right hand reverses right. The lower arm curls upward as the left knee straightens, and the right knee follows with another bend and release.

A repeated knee bend accompanies the dancer's alternating arm sweep: the right hand drops and curls left, then rises as the left elbow folds and the left hand continues upward. The right knee softens while the right arm reaches down-right and the left knee bends; both hands rise with lengthening arms before the right hand returns left and the knees straighten. The right hand dips into a fold and rebounds upward as the left hand sweeps up-left, both elbows tucking and their knees bending in succession. Both hands descend with extended arms, then sweep right and curl upward as the right knee releases; the left knee bends again while the raised hands separate left and right, the right arm opening and the left elbow drawing inward. The hands reverse sideways as the left knee straightens, then lower with another knee bend before returning toward each other, the left hand moving right and the right hand moving left as the legs lengthen. The right arm folds downward and opens left while the left hand drops farther right, then the right hand rises into a tighter curl as the left knee sinks and the left hand reverses left.

The right hand sweeps left and down. The dancer curls the left arm upward while the right arm lengthens farther downward, then lifts the left hand as both elbows open. The right hand rises with a bend, drops and extends again, while the left hand continues up-left and its elbow folds. The left hand descends, opens and lifts once more as the right hand lowers and reaches right; both arms extend before the left hand reverses left and curls upward, joined by the right arm's rise into a bend. The hands separate right and left, then return toward each other, the left hand climbing higher as the right arm folds and lifts.

To begin, the dancer raises both hands and carries them right, then lowers the left hand into a leftward sweep before both hands return right. The right arm curls upward and left while the left hand drops, then the left hand lifts as the right arm moves right; both arms open downward, the left hand continuing right before folding back up. Both hands sweep left and descend, the left arm lengthening farther while the right arm tucks, then the right arm reaches down toward the right. The right arm folds up again as the left hand rises left with an opening elbow, and both hands climb before separating, the left hand continuing left while the right hand reverses right. The rising right hand returns left as the left arm curls higher, then both hands shift right before the left arm drops into an extension.

As the right arm curls upward, the dancer lifts the left hand left and folds the left arm. The right hand sweeps right while the left hand drops left and opens, then both hands descend as their arms lengthen. Both hands rise again with renewed folds before the right hand lowers and extends. The left hand lifts and opens into a rightward sweep, then reverses left as its elbow bends.

At the outset, the left hand sweeps left as the right hand moves right, then both hands rise and reverse sideways. The right arm curls inward while the left arm extends down and right, and the bent right elbow opens before both hands descend. Both arms gather upward, then release into a shared downward sweep with the left hand reaching farther right. The right hand continues right and drops while the right knee bends; the lower left hand returns left and rises as the right knee straightens, then the left hand reverses right and folds inward. Both knees soften again beneath another shared descent, ending with the left hand moving left.

The dancer raises both hands. The left hand curls left while the right hand continues upward as the left arm folds farther. The left arm opens downward while the right arm lengthens rightward. Then they trade height and direction with a bend of the left knee and an extension of the right knee. The left hand moves right as the left arm tucks and the right arm reaches down. Both knees soften in succession as the hands sweep left and climb with lengthening arms. Then the right knee straightens before both knees bend again and the hands descend toward the right. The left arm curls upward while the right hand drops. Then both hands rise with the left elbow opening before the left hand swings left and returns right into a deeper fold. The left arm extends down-left, curls up-right, and releases as the right hand lowers. The right knee bends and straightens beneath a final lift of the left hand.

The dancer lowers and lengthens the right arm as the left arm curls upward, then reverses their heights with a leftward sweep of the right hand and an extension of the left arm. The hands separate right and left while both knees bend in succession, then the arms fold and reverse their sideways paths as the right knee straightens. The left knee softens as the hands lift and the left arm opens, followed by another bend-and-straighten of the left leg beneath a downward-left reach of the right arm. Both hands sweep right and rise with folded elbows as the left knee bends and releases; they reverse left before descending and lengthening, the right hand returning right. The right hand dips again as the left arm folds and rises, then both sweep left and climb, the left arm extending before reversing right and lowering. Both hands continue left and descend with opening elbows, finishing with the right arm reaching farther left.

At the outset, the dancer raises the right hand and lowers the left hand. Both hands sweep left as the left arm folds upward and the right arm lengthens down; the right hand then returns right while the left arm drops and opens. The right arm curls upward again as both hands continue right, then the right knee straightens while the left elbow tucks and both hands descend, the right hand curling farther before opening back up. The right hand moves left and rises with a tighter fold while the left hand continues downward and left, then reverses right. The left hand climbs as the right hand drops, and the left elbow draws inward once more.

The dancer lengthens the right arm downward. The left hand rises as the right arm curls upward, then both arms open into a leftward sweep with the left hand dropping; the right elbow folds and releases before the right hand climbs again. Both hands climb and reverse right, the right hand curling and lowering while the left hand opens and drops, then they separate left and right with the rightward hand lifting. The left arm gathers down-right before extending back left, while the right hand moves left, rises, then falls right and curls upward again. Both arms draw inward as the right hand sweeps left and descends, then the left hand follows left and lowers with an opening elbow. The right hand returns right and up as the right knee softens, while the left hand continues left and tucks farther in.

At the outset, the dancer lengthens the right arm downward while the left arm folds left and lifts, then the left arm reverses right as the right knee softens.
