The right hand returns left with a deeper extension, while the left arm opens farther up and left; the right knee straightens as the left hand rises right. The left hand sweeps down and back left while the left knee bends, then the right arm curls upward as the left leg releases. The hands separate sideways, both elbows folding, before the left hand drops and opens and the right knee sinks again. The hands reverse their lateral paths, the right arm curling higher and moving right while the left arm reaches left and descends, then both arms extend into another exchange of height. The dancer brings the hands closer, lifting the left hand and lowering the right hand, then reverses them with the rising hand moving left and the lower hand continuing down.

The dancer lengthens the right arm downward as the left hand moves right, then reverses the left hand left and lifts both hands. The left elbow folds while the right knee bends and straightens, before both hands sweep right and the left arm lowers. The left arm extends through a leftward return as the right hand rises and falls, then curls upward while the left hand continues down-right and the right knee softens. The left arm opens left as the right knee straightens, then both hands descend with the left elbow drawing inward; the right arm follows left as the bent right knee sinks further. Both hands rise, the right elbow tucking farther while the left knee bends again, before they sweep right and lower together.

A rising-and-falling arm weave begins with both arms lengthening, the right hand moving left as the left hand climbs and folds, then the left folded arm releases down while the right hand lifts. The hands separate right and left, reverse their directions, and rise together, the right elbow curling before both hands descend and open out. Both hands climb again, the right hand folding left as the left knee softens, then lower into an extension while the left knee straightens. The left arm curls upward over a further bend of the left knee, while the right hand drops and swings left. Both hands sweep right, the left arm opening downward as the left knee bends deeper, then the right hand rises before both elbows tuck.

The right knee softens as the dancer sends the right hand left and lowers both hands, then lifts them while the right knee straightens. The left arm reaches right and down before curling upward, joined by the right hand rising into a fold; the right knee bends as the right hand moves right and the left hand continues climbing left. Both arms lengthen downward, the right hand returning left while the left hand reverses right, then the right hand curls upward as the left hand drops and extends. The left arm opens while the right hand sweeps left and rises with a tuck, then the left hand follows left and descends into an extension. The right hand swings right and down, then returns left as the left arm folds and carries the right hand right.

The dancer sweeps the right hand left and down with a bent elbow, then reverses right as the arm opens. The right hand drops farther while the left knee softens, then returns left into a curl as the left hand rises. The right arm lowers and extends while the left hand climbs farther right, the left knee straightening before both knees soften and the hands reverse sideways. Both arms tuck as the right knee lengthens again; the right arm releases down and right while the left arm folds back up and left over a bend of the right knee. The hands separate right and left, then reverse their lateral paths as the right hand lifts and the left elbow opens.

As the right hand sweeps left and down, the dancer straightens the right knee then the left knee while the left arm folds and lowers. The right hand reverses right as the right knee bends, then drops and returns left against the left hand's rightward sweep; the right leg lengthens while the left arm curls upward and back left over the left knee extension. Both hands climb with the left elbow tucking farther, then separate left and right as the left knee softens and the right arm draws inward. The right arm reaches right and rises while the left hand dips, swings left, and lifts again over a deeper bend of the left knee. The right hand sweeps left as the right knee straightens and the left arm extends downward.

Upward, the dancer folds the right arm and carries the right hand right while the left arm lengthens upward. The raised left hand returns left and drops as its elbow opens, then curls back up toward the right. Both hands lift farther, the curled right arm continuing right while the left elbow extends and the left hand shifts left. The right-moving hand lowers as the left arm folds and the left knee beneath it straightens, then both arms open before that lower right hand rises again. The left knee bends once more as the raised left arm tucks left and both hands descend.

The dancer sends the right hand left and up. The left arm reaches right and down as the left knee straightens, then both hands sweep right with the left arm curling upward while the right knee lengthens. Both hands descend, the right arm extending as the right knee bends; the right hand sweeps left and curls upward again while the left knee softens beneath a rising left hand. The raised left arm opens and lowers, its knee straightening as the right hand drops left and the right knee bends and releases. Both knees soften in succession as the hands lift and separate, the right hand moving right and the left hand continuing left.

The dancer sends the right hand left. The right arm folds and rises, then both hands descend as the left arm extends; the right hand swings right and down while the left elbow bends, before the hands reverse sideways and climb together. The left hand moves left and curls inward as both arms lengthen downward and the right hand follows left. Both hands rise again, the right arm folding while the left reaches right and lowers; the right elbow opens as the right hand continues right and descends. The left arm tucks as the left hand drops, then reaches farther right while the right hand reverses left.

The right knee softens as the dancer lowers and lengthens the right hand, then curls it upward while the left hand drops. The right arm reaches farther left and down, followed by the left hand moving left as both knees straighten. Both hands rise with folded elbows, then the right hand sweeps right while the left hand moves left and drops. The left arm extends downward as the right hand lowers and the right knee bends again.

As the left hand lowers and the right hand rises, the dancer straightens both knees and sends the right hand right into an extension. The left arm curls upward while the right arm continues right and drops; the hands then sweep left together, the right arm folding as the left knee bends and the right leg lengthens. The left bent leg releases as both arms open and the hands separate left and right, then both elbows tuck before the right-moving hand returns left and climbs while the left hand reaches right. Both arms unfold and the hands descend, with the right-reaching arm curling upward again. The left hand lifts farther and swings left while the right hand travels right, then lowers as the left elbow folds.

The right hand moves right and down. The left arm curls upward as the right hand continues right, then both hands rise before the left hand drops and the left arm extends left. The right hand follows left while the left arm rises again, then returns right with a fold; the right knee softens as the left hand descends and the folded left arm opens downward to the left. Both hands climb, the right hand curling inward while the left arm reaches farther left, before the hands separate right and left. The left arm folds and sweeps right as the right arm rises and the right knee bends, then the raised right arm tucks and lowers while the left arm lengthens leftward.

The arms exchange height as the dancer curls the right hand upward and opens it, then lowers it while the left hand rises; both hands sweep left before the lower arm lengthens and lifts. The left arm folds right and down as the right hand tucks into a rightward sweep, then both hands climb and move left, the right hand releasing into a drop that curls again as the left elbow draws in. The left hand moves right and extends downward while the right arm reaches right, then both sweep left with the left hand rising and folding back right as its knee bends. Both hands descend, the right arm extending left before reversing right and curling up over a bend of the left knee, then lowering farther right and opening as that knee straightens. The left knee softens beneath another rise of the right hand and an extension of its arm, then both knees straighten as the right hand drops and both arms gather inward.

The right hand drops as the right knee bends, then rises while the left arm curls upward and left; both knees straighten as the left hand descends and folds. The right hand lowers with an extending elbow, followed by the left arm lengthening rightward as the right hand lifts left and both knees soften in succession. Both hands sweep left, the left arm opening downward while the right arm curls up-right and both knees straighten in succession. The right arm tucks further as the right knee extends, then reverses down-left while the left hand drops and folds; the left arm opens before both hands rise and sweep right. The left hand continues right with a deeper curl as the left knee lengthens, then returns left and rises with a bent elbow.

The dancer lengthens the right arm downward. The left hand sweeps right and rises as the right hand shifts left, then both arms curl upward before the right hand moves right and the left hand reaches down to the right. Both elbows open as the hands descend, with the right hand returning left while the left hand swings left and back right; the left arm folds into a rising sweep left and rebounds right. The right hand continues left as the right knee straightens and bends again, while the left hand curls higher to the left. The right arm reaches up and right before tucking, as the left arm extends downward and the right knee softens once more.

In opposition, the dancer lowers and extends the right arm while the left hand rises; the right hand moves right as the right knee straightens. The left arm curls left and down before opening right into a lift, joined by the right arm rising and folding left as the left leg lengthens. Both hands descend with extending elbows, then the right arm tucks left while the left hand reverses right and the knees soften in succession. The hands climb and separate, the right arm curling further as the left knee bends deeper. The right hand lowers and sweeps left while the left hand lifts, then both arms fold as their knees bend and release again. The right arm reaches up-right while the left arm drops and opens, and the right hand returns left.

A knee bend joins the dancer's opening arm exchange: the right hand rises while the left hand moves right and down, then both arms lengthen as the right hand dips left. The hands sweep right with the left hand folding upward, then reverse left as the right hand drops and the right knee softens; the left hand returns right and lowers into an extension. Both hands climb and sweep right as the left arm folds, then the right hand reaches farther right and descends through a release while the left arm opens downward. Both hands rise again as the knees straighten, with the left hand moving right and lowering before both elbows curl inward and the right hand climbs. The left arm extends down-left as the right hand sweeps right and curls upward, followed by another leftward reach and descent of the left hand.

The right knee softens as the dancer lengthens the left arm left, then straightens the right knee while the right hand drops and opens right and the left arm curls upward. The left hand continues up-left into a fold as the right knee bends and releases; the right hand reaches down-right before both hands rise, with the left elbow tucking farther and the right elbow opening as the knees exchange bends and release. Both hands descend, the left arm extending left while the right arm folds upward and sweeps left, followed by a bend of the right knee. The hands separate sideways and rise as the right knee straightens, then reverse their lateral paths with the left arm curling downward and the right arm extending. The left hand lifts back right and falls while the right hand reaches left and lowers, the right knee bending before the left knee softens. The right arm draws inward toward the right as the right knee straightens and the left hand rises leftward.

The right knee bends as the dancer extends the left arm left, then straightens and softens again beneath a rising hand that curls left. The right arm folds right while the raised hand climbs farther left and the right knee lengthens; the left elbow releases and both hands descend before the right knee bends and the extended arm tucks into another lift. The right knee straightens as the right arm opens right and the left hand rises with a deeper fold, then the bent knee softens again while the left arm curls downward and the left knee extends. The left hand reaches up-left against the descending hand, then drops right as the left knee bends and the left arm opens upward-right, followed by the lower hand curling up-left. Both knees soften in succession as the hands move apart, the left hand continuing right and down while the right hand sweeps left and lowers. The left knee straightens before both bend again beneath a final rise of the lowered hand.

The right knee straightens as the dancer lowers and lengthens the left arm, then sends the right hand down-right into a curl while the left hand reaches right. Both hands rise and fold as the left knee bends, then the left hand drops left with its elbow opening before both arms tuck and sweep right. The hands descend again as the knees soften in succession; the left hand curls up-left while the right arm opens downward. Both elbows gather inward and lift, then the hands separate left and right with the left arm extending. The left hand rises farther while the right hand drops and sweeps right, then both lower as the right arm opens and the left knee straightens.

The dancer raises both hands. The left arm curls left and upward while the right arm reaches right, then the left hand returns right as the right elbow folds and the right hand drops left. Both arms lengthen downward before the left hand sweeps left and rises with a tighter fold; the right hand travels right and lifts through an opening elbow. The right hand swings left and back right as the left arm extends down, then the left arm climbs left with a deeper curl while the right hand drops and both sweep right. The right hand reverses left as the left hand moves right and tucks further inward, followed by the right hand rising left into a bend. The left hand lowers, both arms open, and the left hand continues left and down before the right hand shifts right.

The right hand rises and curls left while the left hand moves right. Then both hands descend and sweep right as the left knee softens. The right hand climbs into a fold while the left hand reaches down-left, then lifts left into a tuck as the left knee straightens and the left elbow opens. Both hands reverse right and lower as the left knee bends again. The right arm curls upward while the left hand extends down-left and the left knee lengthens. The right arm unfolds right before folding back left as the left knee deepens, while the left hand swings left and rises with an opening elbow. The right arm opens downward and sweeps left as the left hand drops, then reverses right and curls upward against the left hand's return to the left.

The right knee straightens as the dancer lifts both hands. The right hand curls right and back left while the left hand drops and rises into a fold. The left arm opens right as the right hand lowers, then the right knee softens and the right hand curls up-left. Both arms lengthen downward before the right hand returns right, folds upward, and falls again. The right hand swings left and rebounds up-right as the left knee bends and straightens, then drops and sweeps left with another extension. The left hand follows left, opens downward, and rises while the right hand moves right.

As both hands sweep left, the dancer lifts the right arm while the left hand reaches down and right, then opens both elbows and lowers the right hand farther. Both hands reverse right as the left arm folds and the left knee straightens; the left hand rises and tucks further before extending down-left over a bend of the right knee, which releases as the left arm lengthens and the right hand curls upward. The right hand continues up-left into a fold while the left arm reaches right and down over another bend-and-release of the right knee, then returns left and rises as the right knee softens again and the left arm extends. Both hands lift, with the right hand moving right and opening as the right knee straightens, while the left hand drops and the left knee bends; they reverse sideways, the right hand lowering over a softened right knee before reaching up-right and folding again. The left hand curls up-left as the right elbow tightens, then opens downward through a release of the left knee and a renewed bend of the right; the hands exchange sideways directions and return inward, the right arm lengthening while the left knee straightens.

A low, leftward sweep begins as the dancer folds the left arm and lowers both hands toward the left, then opens the left hand into a rightward lift. The right hand rises while the lifted left arm curls down and right, followed by the right arm folding downward. The right arm reaches left and lengthens as the left hand moves right, then drops with the right hand before reversing right and curling upward. Both hands continue right as the right arm unfolds, then the left hand returns left and curls up while the right hand sinks. The right hand rises left, then drops and sweeps right as the left hand follows right and lifts into a fold. The left arm opens downward, its knee straightening, while the right arm curls upward.

To begin, the dancer lifts the right hand and folds both arms left, then sends the left hand right and down as the left elbow opens. The right arm reaches up-right with a lengthening elbow while the left hand reverses left. Both hands descend, then the right hand arcs up-left and curls inward before extending downward toward the right. The right hand sweeps up-left and back right as the left knee bends and straightens, followed by another upward curl and descent to the right. The left knee softens again beneath a final lift of the left hand, which drops left and tucks as the right knee straightens and the right hand rises.

The right hand lowers left while the left hand curls upward and right. Then both hands rise before the left hand opens down to the left. The right hand swings right as both elbows bend, then the left hand drops and the left knee straightens while the right hand rises left; the left knee softens as the right arm tucks further and the right knee extends. The right hand moves right and down with a deeper elbow fold while the left hand reaches right and lengthens. Both arms lengthen into a downward reach, then the hands reverse left, the right hand rising as the left knee bends and releases. The right hand drops again and curls upward while the left arm folds farther left, and the left knee sinks once more as the right hand continues left and down.

A rising, contrasting arm exchange begins with the dancer folding the right hand upward and left while the left hand moves right and curls inward. The right hand drops and sweeps right as the left arm opens, then rises into a tighter fold and returns left. Both hands descend and move left as the knees soften in succession, then the right arm lengthens down and right before curling upward again. The right hand lowers once more, followed by the left hand dropping as both arms open.

Leftward, the left hand travels as both arms lengthen and the right hand rises; the left hand then drops while the right elbow folds. Both hands sweep right, the left arm curling upward and the right knee bending before straightening, then the right hand follows up to the left with a deeper tuck. The left hand moves left and descends, followed by the right hand dropping as both elbows open. The right hand returns right and curls upward while the left knee bends and straightens beneath an extending arm, and the hands separate left and right before the right hand reverses left and lifts farther. Both arms fold, then extend again as the right-moving hand dips and rebounds higher.

The right hand rises and reaches right, then drops while the left arm curls upward and the right knee bends. The left arm folds as the right hand continues climbing, then both arms lengthen and sweep left before reversing right, with the right hand lowering. The right hand rises again while the left arm opens downward, then the hands separate left and right and descend as the right knee softens. Both arms tuck inward and lift, the left arm continuing to curl higher as the right leg straightens. The hands reverse apart, the right hand dipping before rising again, while the left knee bends and releases and the left hand shifts farther right.

The arms join in a shared sweep right, then rise and separate left as the dancer lengthens the right arm while the left arm curls and the left knee softens. The right arm continues right before dropping with an opening elbow as the left hand lowers, then folds back left and up while the right knee straightens. Both hands climb as the knees bend in succession, then both elbows tuck inward as the knees release; the right hand reaches right and down while the left arm opens, dips, and curls upward to the left. The right knee bends again as both hands lift, the right hand continuing left and extending before both arms fold and descend with the left knee straightening. The right arm reaches up-right against the left arm's tucked leftward descent, then both hands lower as the right knee bends and the left arm opens; the hands reverse sideways, the right arm folding while the left arm rises.

The dancer curls both arms upward and carries the hands right, then one knee straightens. The dancer lowers the hands as the other knee softens. The right hand reverses left while the right arm lengthens, and both hands rise with the right elbow folding before they sweep right; the left arm tucks more deeply as the right arm extends down, then lifts again. Both knees bend in succession as the hands separate left and right, the right arm curling higher while the left arm opens downward. The raised right hand sweeps left and down into a fold, then returns right as the left knee bends further; the lower left arm reaches farther down before both hands climb and the right elbow releases. The left arm folds down and left as the hands descend together, then opens right over a deeper knee bend, while the right hand returns left and rises into an extension. Both arms curl as the knees straighten, then the hands lower and separate again, the right hand moving right while the left hand returns left.

The right hand drops, then both hands rise and sweep left as the dancer lengthens the right arm. The left knee softens while the right hand lowers again; the right knee bends further as the left hand climbs right and both arms curl upward, then the hands separate right and left with a release of the right arm. Both knees straighten as the hands descend, the left hand moving right and the right hand moving left, before the knees bend in succession and the arms gather into opposing curls. The right knee extends as the left arm reaches right, then the left leg straightens while the right hand dips and rises. The left arm folds and opens downward, the right hand drops, and both hands reverse sideways before the left hand lifts and returns down-right with another knee bend. The left hand travels left, its arm lengthening as the right knee releases and the left knee softening, then continues down-left.

At the outset, the dancer folds the right arm down and right as the right knee softens, then extends the right hand back left while the left arm reaches up-right. The right hand curls upward and drops as the left knee bends and straightens; both hands sweep right, then return left with the right elbow opening and the left hand lowering. Both arms gather inward as the knees soften, the right hand rising into a tighter fold before they reverse right and descend. The left knee releases while the right arm lengthens downward and the left arm tucks farther left; the knees exchange bends and releases, with the right leg straightening first, then the left knee extending as the left hand rises into a curl and the right arm opens. The right knee bends as the right hand drops left, then both legs lengthen while the left hand moves right and lowers.

The right hand sweeps left. The left hand reaches right, then returns left as both arms fold and the hands rise, before the right arm releases downward while the left arm lifts farther. Both hands descend and sweep right, the right arm lengthening as the left arm folds and the left knee softens; the right hand climbs again while the left elbow opens. The left arm curls higher and carries the left hand left as the left knee straightens, then drops into a deeper tuck. The left hand returns up to the right with another bend of the left knee, while the right hand continues left and lowers.

As the right hand lowers and the left hand rises, the dancer extends the right arm left and lifts it again. The left hand travels left and drops while the right hand curls up and right, then the right arm folds down as the left arm opens left. Both hands sweep right, the left arm extending while the right arm reaches back left. The right hand descends into a fold and returns right as the left hand continues upward and left with an opening elbow.

At the outset, the dancer raises both hands, sending the left hand left and the right hand right before lowering them; the right knee bends as the right hand curls upward again. The left arm reaches down and left while the right knee straightens, then both hands sweep right and rise with the left arm folding. Both elbows open as the left hand descends and the right knee softens, followed by a leftward curl of the left hand and another bend in the right leg. The left arm lowers and extends as the right knee releases, then rises while the right hand lifts left, both elbows tucking. Both hands drop and separate, the left hand moving right and the right hand moving left, before the right arm lengthens downward.

A rising rightward arm sweep begins with the right knee straightening and the left knee extending, followed by the left hand moving right as both arms fold. The right knee softens while the right hand continues right and down; the left knee bends and releases as the left hand curls up-right, then the right hand drops left with a deeper tuck before reaching right. Both hands rise as their knees lengthen, then lower together, the left hand returning left into a curl while the right hand opens. The hands climb again with the left arm tucked and the right knee bending, then descend into a reach on the right side as that knee extends and the left arm opens. The left hand sweeps left and upward while the right knee bends farther, and both hands rise before separating right and left with the elbows drawing inward. The hands lower as the right knee straightens and the left knee bends, then the left arm reaches down-right while the right hand lifts left and its knee extends further.

To begin, the dancer curls the right arm upward and left while the left hand moves right, then lowers both hands with opening elbows. The left hand sweeps left as the right arm rises into a fold and the left knee softens; the hands separate right and left before the right arm extends down, the left knee straightening. The left hand continues left and drops while the right elbow bends farther, then opens and lifts as the left arm curls up toward the right. The left hand swings left and down while the right arm reaches right, then folds back left over a bending left knee as the right hand rises. Both arms extend downward and sweep right, then the right arm returns left as the left knee straightens; the left hand climbs left and tucks while the right arm curls up and right. The left arm lengthens downward and reverses right as the right arm lowers, and both hands finish moving right.

The right knee softens as the dancer lifts and extends the right arm, then straightens the right leg while both hands descend. The left arm reaches right and up before both hands climb, the left arm folding leftward as the right arm extends right. Both arms lengthen downward, with the right hand sweeping left, then reversing right into a curl while the left hand continues down and right. The right hand drops and returns left as the left knee bends, then folds upward alongside the left arm's rise. The left hand sweeps left and lowers into an extension while the right hand travels right, both arms opening farther.

The right knee bends as the dancer folds the left arm and lifts the right hand left, then lengthens the right arm while the right knee straightens. The right hand curls right as the right knee softens again; both knees extend while the left hand rises and reaches left into a fold. Both hands drop and reverse sideways, the right hand sweeping right before reversing left as the left knee bends and releases. The arms lift and tuck together, then open downward as the left knee bends once more.

The dancer sends the right hand right. The left arm curls upward and reaches left, then the right hand rises as the left knee bends and straightens beneath a dip and lift of the left elbow. The left hand reverses right with an opening elbow while the right arm folds downward and sweeps left. The right knee softens and straightens as both hands climb, the left arm curling before reaching down-right and lengthening; the right hand follows down-right with an extending arm. The right leg straightens again as the left hand lifts into a tighter fold, then lowers and opens farther right while the right hand travels left. Both hands rise, the right one moving right before dropping as the left arm folds more deeply.

The right hand rises, then both hands move right as the left arm curls upward and the right elbow folds, before the hands sweep left with the right arm opening. Both arms lengthen into a rising rightward reach, then the right hand drops and returns left while the left arm curls higher and the left knee straightens. The right arm tucks down-left as the left arm opens downward, then the right arm reaches up-right against the left arm's leftward curl; both arms descend with the left elbow extending. Both hands rise and separate sideways as the right arm folds, then fall with the right arm reaching open while the left hand lifts into a tighter fold. The hands reverse sideways again, the left hand moving right while the right arm extends up-left, before both descend and the right hand sweeps right.

The dancer lowers and lengthens the right arm. Both hands rise as the left knee bends, then both arms curl left and descend while the left knee straightens and the right knee softens; the hands continue down and right, the right elbow opening before the left knee releases. The arms fold again as the left knee bends, the right hand dropping farther left and reopening while the left hand sweeps right and down; both knees straighten as the hands reverse left, with the left elbow tucking and the right knee bending beneath a lift. The right arm opens and folds again as the left hand rises, both sweep right and descend into extended elbows, then the right knee bends and the left hand reverses left. Both hands climb, the left arm folding left before reaching right and lowering, while the right arm curls up and right over a bend and release of the right knee; the left arm reaches up-right as the right hand returns left and extends downward. Both knees soften as the left hand drops and the right arm lengthens down-left, then the left knee straightens while the right knee deepens its bend and the right hand rises right.

A rising arm exchange begins with the right hand moving right and curling upward as the left hand rises left, then both hands sweep right before the left hand folds down and left. The right elbow opens downward while the left hand reaches up-right, followed by a leftward extension of the right arm and a renewed tuck of the left hand. The right hand climbs farther left into a tighter fold as the left knee bends, then reverses right and opens while the left leg straightens. Both hands descend, the right arm lengthening before both elbows gather inward and the left hand rises again.

As the right arm curls up and right, the left hand rises left with a bent elbow, then the right hand drops while the left hand sweeps down-right. The hands reverse sideways as the left arm opens; both lift, then sweep left together, the right arm folding while the left arm extends and lowers. The right arm tucks farther as the left hand returns right and curls upward. Both hands climb, the right hand continuing right while the left hand swings left and back right over a straightening knee, then the arms lengthen as the right hand lowers.

The right hand climbs. The dancer raises the left hand, then lowers both while the right arm folds and opens; the left arm curls upward as the right hand sweeps left and back right. Both hands descend and lengthen, the right moving left before returning right as the left rises into a tighter fold and both arms extend again. The right arm gathers up toward the left while the left hand drops, then both elbows open and the right arm tucks again. The left arm curls upward, extends down, and folds once more.

The right knee softens as the dancer lifts both hands. The right arm curls and continues upward while the left hand moves left. The right hand reverses right as the right knee straightens and the left knee bends, then returns left with a deeper fold before both arms extend downward. The left hand sweeps right as the left knee releases and the right knee lengthens. The right hand rises and curls toward the right while the left hand moves left, then both descend. The right hand continues down-right as the left arm opens and lifts, followed by the right arm lengthening upward. The right hand returns left and folds as the left hand drops and the left elbow tucks inward.

As the right arm curls up-right, the dancer sends the left hand left and folds it upward, then extends both arms into a rising rightward sweep before lowering them. The hands reverse left and rise together with bent elbows, then separate sideways as the left arm lengthens down-left and the right arm tucks higher; both descend while the left hand returns right. The right hand moves right as the left rises left, then both lift with the right elbow folding; the left arm curls farther left before opening downward and sweeping right, while the right continues right and drops. Both arms extend as the right hand climbs left, then they lower and sweep right with the right arm reaching farther. The right hand lifts again, dips left and rebounds upward, then folds right as the left hand rises.

As the right arm folds and the right hand rises right, the left arm sweeps down-left with a curling elbow. The dancer lengthens both arms downward, then sends the right hand left and up into a tuck while the left hand reaches right. Both hands descend as the left knee straightens and the right knee softens, followed by a leftward lift of the right arm and a rightward extension of the left arm. The right knee bends further while the left knee releases and the left hand climbs left; the right arm opens as the left arm curls upward. The hands separate sideways, then reverse inward before the right arm rises and the left arm lowers with an extending elbow.

A rising, folding arm exchange begins with the right hand moving right as the left hand curls upward; both descend, the right arm lengthening while the left tucks higher. The right hand reverses left and rises into a fold as the right knee softens, then sweeps right and back left while the right knee straightens and the left hand lowers. Both hands lift, the left moving left as the knees bend in succession and the left elbow opens; the right arm folds right while the left drops and both knees extend, then the left hand swings right and back up-left as the right reaches down-right. The left arm opens downward as the right curls up-left, then returns up-right while the right reaches farther left and drops. The left hand lowers and moves left as the right rises, then extends right again while the left knee bends and the right arm folds downward.

As the right hand moves left, the dancer lifts both hands and sends them right, with the left arm curling inward. The right hand drops while the left arm opens down-left, then the hands separate again as the right hand rises left and the right knee bends; the left hand continues left as the right knee straightens and the right arm folds. The right elbow releases while the left arm tucks farther left, and the right hand lowers as the left knee bends; both arms lengthen before the left hand reverses right and the right arm curls upward. Both knees soften as the right arm extends downward and the right hand sweeps left, then both hands rise and the left hand moves right while the right knee releases and the left leg straightens. The hands descend together as the right leg bends, followed by a lift of both hands with the right knee straightening and the left arm extending.

To begin, the dancer sends the right hand left and lowers it as the left hand moves right. The right arm curls upward while the left arm folds down and right; both hands sweep left before the left arm reverses right and the right arm opens downward. The left arm tucks farther down and left, then returns right as the left knee straightens and the right knee softens. The left hand rises with a deeper fold while the right elbow lengthens and the right hand climbs right. The right hand continues left and up into a tighter curl, then falls as the left hand moves left and drops.

The dancer performs a paired arm exchange: the right hand lowers left and curls upward as the left hand drops, then the right hand returns right while the left hand rises left with a lengthening elbow. The left arm folds down toward the right as the right hand curls up-left, then both reach out before the left hand tucks into a rising leftward sweep. Both hands descend, the left hand continuing left and opening while the right hand swings right and back left; they reverse sideways again and climb with tucked elbows, then the left hand returns right and its knee straightens as the right hand lowers. The left hand travels left and down with an extended arm while the right hand reaches right, then reverses right and curls upward against the left hand's leftward return. Both arms open downward, the left hand sweeping right before folding back left as the right hand extends right and rises with its elbow drawing in. The left knee softens while the right arm lengthens and lifts.

The right knee softens beneath an upward sweep of the right hand toward the right and down into a fold, while the left arm reaches up-left; the right knee straightens as the folded right hand rises left and the left hand climbs. The arms lengthen downward, then reverse sideways with the right arm folding up-right and the left arm curling up-left, before both hands descend and the left arm opens. Both hands rise, the right arm tucking rightward as the left arm extends left, then both curl upward again. The left arm releases down-left while the right arm folds farther right, then both hands climb as the right knee bends and the left arm gathers inward. With the right knee extending, the right hand curls higher to the right while the left hand continues climbing left and tucks further inward.

A knee pulse punctuates the opening: the right hand reaches left while the left hand rises, then the right arm lengthens down and sweeps right as the left knee softens and the left hand climbs. The right arm curls up and drops again as the left knee straightens and bends once more; both hands climb before the right arm opens downward and the left knee releases, then the right hand curls up and returns right as the left knee bends. Both knees soften in succession while the hands descend and the left arm folds upward, then the right knee straightens as the right hand lifts left and the left arm opens down and right with a bend of the left knee. The right arm tucks higher while the left knee releases and the left hand rises into a fold; the right hand extends right and both lower before the left knee sinks and the left arm reaches up and left. With the right knee bending, both hands rise and sweep left, the right arm curling farther before releasing downward as the left hand descends. The right hand continues left, lengthens and dips, then curls upward while the left knee bends and releases beneath a rising elbow.

Leftward, the left hand travels as the right hand rises and folds, then the left-moving arm lengthens while the right arm opens right. The right knee straightens as both hands sweep right, the raised right arm curling downward and the right knee softening, before the lower left arm extends and the hands return left with the right-knee side rising. Both arms fold as the right side continues upward-left, the left knee bending before the left hand drops and unfolds and the raised right arm tucks farther; the right knee releases as the lower left hand lifts right and curls inward. The higher right hand dips right and rises again while the left hand continues down-right and the bent right knee straightens. The hands separate left and right as the left arm lengthens and the left knee bends, then the left arm curls up-left while the right hand lifts left and the right knee releases. The curled left hand returns down-right as the right hand lowers, then rises and folds toward the left before extending farther left.

The dancer lengthens the right arm rightward. The right hand reverses left while the left hand reaches right and curls inward, then both hands descend as the left knee bends and straightens; the right arm opens farther right before both hands rise and the arms fold. The hands sweep left together, the right hand descending into an extension while the left hand tucks and lowers, then both return right with the left arm opening upward and the right knee bending. The hands separate sideways, the left arm folding down-left as the right knee softens, then the right hand drops left and rises while the left knee straightens and the left arm opens downward. Both hands climb with bent elbows, the right hand returning left before they lower and the left arm extends. The right hand sweeps right and rises with a deeper elbow curl, then returns left as the left arm lifts and the right knee bends.

The dancer lowers and lengthens the right arm as the left hand sweeps left, then both rise before the right hand drops right into a curl. The left arm extends down-left while the curled right arm opens downward; both hands return left, the right hand climbing as the right knee softens. The arms fold and sweep right together, then separate again, the right hand rising right while the left hand lifts left and returns right. Both elbows tuck through another shared leftward sweep, then open as the right hand descends. The right arm curls upward while the left hand drops left, then returns up-right and folds back down-left as the right arm reaches down-left.

As the right hand rises left, the dancer folds the left arm and lifts the left hand right, then lowers both hands while opening the left elbow. The right hand swings right as the left hand continues right and down with a bent elbow, before both reverse left and curl upward. The right arm lengthens downward as the left hand sweeps right and opens, then the right hand returns left while the left knee softens and the left arm folds up-left. The right elbow tucks farther and both hands descend, then separate right and left as the right arm extends. The left hand curls upward and moves right, then drops open as the right hand reverses left and folds.

The arms move in opposition: the right hand rises and folds inward as the left hand extends down, then both sweep left. The right arm opens downward while the left arm curls upward; the left hand rebounds up-left into a bend as the right arm reaches right. The left hand returns right with its elbow tucked, while the right hand drops left and reverses right. The right hand climbs through an extension and a fold, then lengthens farther right as the left arm releases.

In opposition, the dancer sends the right hand right and the left hand left, then lifts the right hand while lowering and extending the left arm. The right arm folds as the right knee softens, both hands sweep left and the right knee straightens before the left hand rises and the left knee bends again. Both arms lengthen as the left knee releases and the right hand continues left; the left hand drops and the left knee straightens, followed by the right knee extending. The right arm curls upward toward the right while the left arm reaches left, then the right arm opens downward as the right knee bends and releases. The left arm folds and lowers while the right hand moves right, then the left arm reaches up-right with a softened right knee before reversing left and dropping as the right knee straightens.

To begin, the dancer folds the right arm and lowers the left hand rightward before opening both arms downward. The hands separate sideways as the left knee bends, then sweep left together and return right with a curl in the right arm. The left arm extends while the right curled arm opens and the left knee straightens, followed by a bend of the right knee and a rise of both hands with the right arm tucking again. The right knee releases farther as the left hand moves left and drops; the right hand rises, swings left and down, then returns right into an extended lift while the left hand continues left. The right hand dips and rebounds right as the left knee bends, softens and straightens beneath another descent of the right hand. Both knees lengthen as the right hand lifts and the left hand curls upward to the left.

As the right hand curls upward, the dancer straightens the right knee and raises the left hand into a fold. The left hand travels left while the right arm tucks down and left, then both hands sweep right as the right arm opens and the left elbow releases. Both arms gather inward toward the left, then extend apart with the right hand descending; the left hand reaches farther left before reversing right and curling upward as the left knee bends. The right hand rises through an opening and closing elbow, then lowers while the left hand climbs farther right and extends. The left arm folds back left and drops as the left knee softens, then lengthens upward again while the right arm lifts and both knees straighten in succession.

The right hand moves right as the dancer straightens the left knee and lifts both hands, then lowers them while the left knee bends. The right arm curls upward over a deeper bend of the right knee, then opens and drops as the left knee straightens; both knees soften again before the left leg lengthens. The left arm reaches left and down while the right hand rises, the right knee extending, then folds down as the right knee bends. Both arms open into a rising sweep toward the right, the right arm curling as the right knee extends, then tucks lower while the left hand returns left and the left knee softens. The right hand sweeps up-left with an opening elbow, followed by the left hand lifting left and curling inward as the left knee bends and the right knee straightens.

The right knee softens as the dancer sends the right hand right and up, folding the right arm while the left hand rises left. The folded right arm reaches farther right as both hands climb, then the right arm lowers while the left hand continues left and down. The lowered right arm tucks and the right hand moves left before both hands sweep right, the right arm opening downward and returning left into a fold. The right hand drops again while the left arm extends down and left. Both hands rise once more, the left hand continuing left as the right hand returns right.

At the outset, the dancer raises the right hand as the left arm extends left and lowers, then sweeps both hands right with the right elbow opening. The hands reverse left and descend, the right elbow folding before the left arm lengthens into a final lift. Both hands sweep right again as the right arm curls upward, then return left while the right hand drops. The arms separate sideways—the right hand continuing left, the left hand moving right—and rise together, the left hand curling inward.

The right arm reaches down and right, curls upward as the left hand rises left, then lowers again. The right hand sweeps left and up while the left hand drops and extends right; both arms lengthen as the right hand descends and the left hand returns left. The right hand reverses right and folds into a rising leftward reach, joined by the left arm curling upward. Both hands sweep right and lower, the right arm extending farther before returning left and climbing with another fold; the left arm opens as the left knee straightens, then both hands reverse right and descend. The right elbow tucks further while the left hand lifts, dips and rises again as the right arm continues lowering.

As the right hand lowers left, the dancer bends both knees and lifts the left hand right into a fold. Both arms extend downward before the right arm curls upward and sweeps right while the left knee straightens; the left arm opens as the left knee lengthens again. The hands separate left and right, then descend with the left elbow tucking, before the right hand returns right as both knees soften and the right arm folds upward. Both arms open through another bend and release of the knees, then sweep down-left and rise together as the knees straighten, ending with the right hand returning right and the left arm folding. The right hand dips left, reverses up-right, and sinks farther right while the left hand rises and reaches left, accompanied by a softening knee and an opening of the right arm. The right arm curls back up-left as the left arm extends right, then both lower, the right hand finishing right.

As the right hand sweeps right and down, the dancer curls the left arm upward to the left. The descending right hand continues right while the left arm reaches farther left, then both arms lengthen before the right hand returns up-left and folds inward. The right hand drops again as the left arm rises and sweeps right, followed by another shared descent with the left arm tucking in. The right arm opens downward while the left arm curls higher and swings left, then the left arm releases into a sustained lift toward the right. The right hand extends right and down before returning left as the left arm moves right and drops, finishing with both hands descending.

The dancer lifts the left hand leftward. The right arm curls upward, then opens as both hands rise and the left hand moves right; the right elbow folds again before the right hand drops and extends down to the left. The right hand returns up to the right while the left hand lowers and lengthens, then curls upward with a softened knee beneath it. The right hand continues right as the left hand drops farther, then both arms open downward, the right hand lifting back left while the left arm tucks and rises again. Both hands sweep left with bent elbows, then descend as the knees straighten in succession; the left hand finishes by curling up to the left while the right arm reaches right.

At the outset, the dancer sends the right hand right and down as both arms lengthen, then raises the right hand while the left hand reaches left. The left hand drops and reverses right, joined by the right hand moving left. Both hands climb into folded elbows, with the right arm opening outward before the left arm curls inward. The hands separate sideways again, the right arm extending farther left while the left arm folds more tightly.

The dancer lengthens the right arm. The left hand moves right as the right hand continues left and down, then both hands rise, the left arm folding before opening. Both hands sweep left, descend with the left arm reaching farther, then separate into a rightward and leftward return while the left arm curls inward. The left arm lifts and opens as the left hand reverses right, then rises again and tucks in.

As the right hand sweeps left and rises, the dancer sends the left hand right, lengthens both arms downward, then curls the right arm upward to the right while the left knee straightens. The right arm opens again as the left knee bends, then folds and rises left before extending farther left with the left knee releasing; the left hand lowers and swings right as the bent knee sinks again. Both hands descend, the right arm opening and the left tucking as the left knee softens further, then sweep left with the right arm folding and the left hand lifting into an extension. The lifted left hand drops and returns right as the right arm reaches down-left, then reverses right and up with a bend of the right knee. The right hand continues right and descends while the left hand lowers left, then both rise and sweep left with opening elbows as the knees straighten in succession. The right elbow tucks as the hands return right, the left knee bends and the left arm folds; the right hand rises with a deeper curl while the bent knee releases and the right leg straightens.

To begin, the dancer folds the right arm upward and releases it down-left while the left hand moves right. The right arm curls higher as the right knee straightens, then both hands sweep right and descend with the right arm opening; the left hand reverses left before rising into a fold. Both arms lengthen downward, the right hand moving right as the left hand returns right and climbs. The left hand continues up-right before folding back down-left, while the right hand lifts into a curl and moves left alongside it. The right hand reverses right and drops as the left arm extends upward, ending with both hands traveling right.

As the dancer lengthens the right arm downward, the left hand rises right and folds inward. The right hand sweeps left and climbs into a curl while the left elbow opens; both hands then descend as the arms extend, with the right hand continuing left. Both elbows tuck and lift, the right hand moving right before reversing left against the left hand's rightward sweep, then opening downward. The right arm curls upward again as the left hand reaches right and drops; the right hand follows right and descends into an extension while the left hand continues right. The right hand swings left and up through a bend, then returns right and drops as the right knee straightens and the left elbow extends.

At the outset, the dancer lowers the left hand and extends the left arm left while the right hand rises right; the left hand then climbs as both elbows fold and the hands separate. Both arms lengthen downward before the right hand sweeps up and left into a curl. The left arm folds upward to the right, then opens and drops while the curled right hand returns right and down; the left hand reverses left as both elbows tuck. The left hand continues left and rises with an opening elbow, followed by the right hand lifting into a bend as the left arm reaches farther left. The right hand lowers and extends, then the left hand curls up and right.

The dancer lowers the left hand, extends the left arm left, and lengthens the right knee. Then the dancer raises both hands while the left arm folds back right and the right elbow curls inward. The raised left hand drops left and opens as the knees trade bends and straighten. Then the right hand lifts farther left while the left arm tucks and rebounds upward into an extension. Both elbows draw in and release again as the right hand descends, then rises into a fold while the left hand continues downward and left. The right knee bends and releases as the hands separate left and right, the left hand lifting before lowering and curling inward; the right hand returns left and up as the right knee softens. The left arm reaches right and folds back toward the left while the right hand moves right and lowers, ending with both elbows tucked and the left hand continuing left.

The right hand sweeps left and down. The dancer sends the left hand right as the right arm curls upward, then reverses both hands right while the left knee bends and releases; the right arm folds farther left and drops into an extension as the left knee softens. Both arms gather upward, the left hand shifting left as the knees straighten and the left arm opens, before the right hand returns right and tucks in. The right hand rises left as the left knee lengthens, then curls back right over a bending left knee while the left arm extends downward and moves left; the hands separate sideways as the bent left knee releases and the left arm folds upward. The right hand descends and the left knee straightens as the left arm continues up and right with a deeper fold, then the descending right hand lifts left into a curl while the left arm lowers and opens over a softened left knee. The raised right hand sweeps right and drops as the left arm curls higher over a further bend of the left knee, then both elbows open while the left hand returns left and the right knee straightens.

As the right arm folds upward and the left arm lengthens, the dancer lowers and opens the right arm while the right knee bends, then straightens. The left hand rises as the right knee softens again and the right hand descends rightward. Both hands sweep left, the left arm tucking before the right arm curls up and returns right with a bend in the right knee; the tucked left arm follows right as the right knee extends. The left knee bends again while both hands drop, the right hand reversing left into a fold as the left knee straightens. The left knee bends once more beneath another shared lift, then the right arm reaches down and right while the left arm curls upward and left.

The dancer lowers both hands. The right hand sweeps left and rises while the left arm extends, then both arms curl upward with the left hand moving right. Both elbows open; the right hand continues up and left while the left hand drops and lengthens. The right hand reverses down and right into a fold. The right hand rebounds upward and right into an extension while the left hand reaches farther down, then the right hand curls back left and up while the left elbow bends. Both hands descend; the left hand sweeps left before reversing right as the left arm opens.

A rising and descending arm exchange begins as the left hand lifts left and the right hand rises right, then the left hand returns right while the right arm extends down-left. The left hand drops as the left knee softens, followed by the right hand lowering; both arms lengthen before the hands sweep left, with the right arm curling upward as the right knee bends further. Both elbows open, the left hand sweeping right and dropping while the right hand moves right and down, then reversing left into a tuck as the left arm folds up-left. The right hand lowers and reaches right, while the left hand continues up-left and opens. The right arm curls upward and left, then descends farther left as the left hand rises again.

A shared upward reach opens the phrase: the right hand lifts as the left hand curls left, then both hands descend and sweep right before reversing left. The left arm lengthens downward while the right arm folds higher, and the left hand continues down-left; both hands return right with the right arm extending. The right hand drops and rebounds into a lift, followed by the left hand rising as the left knee bends. Both hands descend again, the right hand moving right while the left hand shifts left, and the left knee straightens.

The right hand lowers and the right knee straightens while the left arm folds upward and left. The right hand follows left and curls up as the left hand descends. Both arms lengthen downward, then the right hand rises right while the left hand climbs left and back right, both elbows opening before their hands fall. The right hand sweeps left as both arms tuck upward, then drops left into an extension while the left hand lifts and reverses right. Both hands rise again, the right arm curling inward as the left knee bends; the hands separate left and right before the right arm opens and the left knee softens. The left hand dips left as the right arm extends down and right, then both lift while the left knee straightens and the left elbow folds.

As the dancer lifts both hands, the left arm curls left and down while the right arm reaches right; the right hand reverses right as the right knee bends and straightens. The left hand returns left and lowers into a fold as the left knee softens, then the left arm extends right and up before both hands sweep left with opening elbows. Both hands descend, the right hand moving right and back left while the right knee lengthens; the left knee also straightens as the left hand rises again. The right arm curls upward and right, then opens downward as the right knee sinks, while the left arm folds up-left and the right hand follows left and down into another tuck. The left hand drops, then sweeps right as the right hand moves right and rises into an extension. The left arm curls upward while the right arm continues rising, and the left hand returns left as the left knee softens.

A shared leftward sweep begins as the left arm folds and the right arm extends, both hands rising before the right arm curls back right. The left hand sweeps left and down while the right arm reaches right and drops; the left arm tucks and lifts again as the right arm opens left. Both hands climb with lengthening elbows, then reverse sideways and descend into folds, the left hand moving right as the right hand continues left. The left arm releases downward while the right arm curls higher and returns right, then both hands rise with the right arm opening. The left hand lowers left into a deeper fold as the right arm extends upward and the right knee bends. The right knee straightens beneath a drop of the right arm, while the left hand sweeps right and rises into a curl.

The right knee straightens as the dancer raises the left hand and extends both arms, then folds them inward while the left hand moves right. The right arm opens downward and curls back up-left as the left elbow tightens further; the right arm lengthens again before the right hand drops and the right knee softens. The left hand rises right with a deeper tuck as the right knee bends and the right arm reaches down-left. Both hands descend, the right arm opening leftward as the left arm curls upward and the right knee releases. The left hand sweeps right and lowers into an extended reach while the right arm continues left and down.

As the right arm extends right and the left hand rises, the dancer folds the right arm upward, then opens it downward while the left hand continues climbing. The right arm tucks left and descends as the left knee straightens, then both hands sweep right before the right arm lifts and reaches down again. The right arm curls up and left while the left hand rises and lengthens; the right hand drops and opens right as the left elbow bends, then reverses left and folds upward while the left arm lowers into an extension. The left arm curls upward and left as the right hand moves right and folds, then the right arm releases down and right while the left arm sweeps left and down with an opening elbow. The hands separate horizontally once more as the left arm lengthens further.

An opposing arm sweep begins with the right hand moving right and the left hand moving left, both rising before the right hand returns left. The left hand reverses right and drops as the right knee straightens, while the right arm folds downward. Both hands move right, then the right hand curls upward as the left knee softens. The right arm opens and its hand climbs farther right while the bent knee releases.

To begin, the dancer lengthens the right arm while the left arm folds rightward and lowers; both hands descend as the left arm opens and reverses left. The right hand follows left with a lengthening elbow before returning right, then rises while the left arm curls up and right. Both hands sweep left, the right arm opening into a lift before folding again, while the left arm tucks farther and moves right. The hands separate sideways, the right hand continuing down-right and the left hand moving left, then reverse their lateral directions and rise together as both elbows draw in.

The right hand drops leftward as the dancer bends both knees, then sweeps it right and back left with a curling elbow while the left knee sinks farther. The right arm rises and reaches right as the left knee straightens, while the left hand lowers and lengthens; the right arm tucks and reverses left before opening again. Both hands climb, the right hand moving right while the left hand sweeps left and down, then both arms fold and descend, the right hand returning right. The hands separate left and right and rise as their elbows open, then drop into another shared fold. Both hands sweep left, the right hand lowering while the left hand curls upward and returns right, before they rise and reverse sideways in succession.

A rising rightward sweep begins with the right arm extending as both hands move right, then the right arm curls upward while the left hand climbs left. The right arm drops and reaches farther right as the right knee straightens; the left hand lowers and folds before both elbows tuck and the left hand rises left. Both arms open downward, the right hand returning right and lifting as the knees lengthen in succession. The right hand continues up-right with an opening elbow while the left knee straightens and the left hand rises left; both hands descend and the right arm folds back left. The left hand lifts right as the left arm reaches down and extends right, then the left hand drops into a curl while the right hand sweeps left.

The right hand moves left and rises, curling inward while the left arm folds. Then both hands descend and separate sideways. The right hand sweeps right while the left arm climbs into a tighter fold and moves left. Both hands reverse inward before the right hand drops and the left knee straightens. Both arms extend downward as the knees bend and release, with the right hand returning right and the left arm sweeping left. The right arm tucks through another lift and drop while the right knee softens and releases twice, then opens as the right knee bends again and the left hand moves right and down. The right knee lengthens once more as the right hand continues right and drops, the left arm extending farther left and upward.

The right knee softens as the dancer curls both hands upward, then lowers them and opens the arms into a shared leftward reach. Both hands rise again; the right arm folds while the left arm lengthens and the right knee straightens, before they descend together. The hands sweep right with both elbows tucked, then climb as the knees bend in succession; the right hand returns left and drops through an opening arm while the left hand continues upward and right. The right hand lifts back right as the right knee bends further and releases, then sweeps left and down while the left arm extends downward; the left arm folds and rises once more. The right knee repeats its bend and release as the left hand lifts, drops, and curls upward again, joined by the right arm's rising fold. Both hands move right and descend, the left elbow opening before the left arm tucks and the right knee bends.

The right hand rises. The left hand lifts rightward as the left arm folds, then returns left and lowers while the right hand climbs farther; both elbows open and the left hand sweeps up-right. Both arms tuck and descend, the right hand reaching left before both sweep right and rise with deeper bends. The right hand continues upward as the right knee straightens, then falls into an extension while the left arm opens downward and the left knee softens. The left hand reverses left and curls back up-right as the right hand rises and reaches farther right, then both hands drop with opening elbows and the right hand moves left.

The arms exchange their height: the right hand rises and moves right, then drops as the left hand curls up toward the left. The left arm reaches right while the right hand continues left, then returns left and folds upward as the left hand descends and tucks right. Both hands climb with elbows drawing in, the right hand moving left before reversing right as the left hand lowers and extends. The left arm lengthens farther down and left while the right hand rises; both arms curl again, the right elbow releasing before folding once more. The right arm opens downward as the left arm reaches right, then curls upward.

The right hand rises and falls while the left hand moves left, then both arms climb as the right arm lengthens. The hands separate right and left before descending, with the right arm curling inward. The right arm reaches farther up and left as the left arm lowers into a deeper fold. Both arms tuck again as the left hand drops, and the hands sweep apart before reversing inward, the right arm drawing in more tightly.

The arms move in opposition: the right hand travels left and curls upward while the left hand drops, then both rise with the right hand extending right. The dancer folds the left arm down and left as the left knee softens, then opens that arm rightward before curling it up and left again while the right arm lengthens down and left. Both hands sweep right, the left hand lowering as the left knee bends deeper, then reverse left with rising elbows and a bend of the right knee. The left arm tucks rightward as both knees straighten and the right hand rises; the tucked arm extends downward and left while the right hand sweeps left and down, then both knees soften before the right arm reaches up and right. The lower arm curls up-right as the raised hand moves left and the left knee straightens, then they exchange sideways directions and descend into folded elbows. The lower hand reverses right while the opposite arm opens up-left and its knee extends, then both hands lift and separate sideways as that knee bends again.

The right knee bends as the dancer lowers and extends the right arm right, then sends both hands left while the right leg straightens and the left knee softens. The right hand lifts right into a curl as the left arm reaches up-left and the left knee releases; the right arm opens down-left before both hands rise, the right elbow tucking and the right knee bending again. The right arm curls upward while the left arm sweeps right and lowers, then opens back left as the right knee sinks further. Both arms lengthen downward with the left hand continuing left, then the right hand reverses right as the knees straighten in succession and the left elbow folds. The right elbow opens and refolds as the left hand rises, then lowers into an extension while the right arm curls higher and continues left.

The right knee softens as the dancer lifts both hands, the right hand curling inward and moving right while the left hand drops. The right hand reverses left and lengthens downward as the left arm folds and the left knee straightens. The left hand sweeps right and back left through a bend and release of the left knee, then reaches down-right while the right arm climbs rightward into a fold. Both arms tuck and lower, with the right hand continuing left and opening before reversing right as the left hand rises. The left hand returns left and lowers alongside the right hand, which curls upward to finish.

A side-to-side arm exchange begins with the dancer bending the right knee and sending the right hand left, then lifting both hands as the right knee straightens and the left hand drops; the right hand returns right while the left arm curls upward. Both hands rise again, the right arm lengthening before folding back down and left as the left hand reverses right. The right arm reaches right while the left knee bends and releases and the left hand sweeps left, then both arms curl upward before extending downward into a shared rightward sweep. The left knee bends and straightens beneath another shared lift and leftward reach, then softens again as the hands descend and separate left and right. Both arms open upward, the right hand moving right and the left hand left before the hands lower in opposition; the left hand continues left as the right arm extends.

The right arm reaches right while the left arm folds, then both arms lift as the right arm returns left and curls higher; they separate again with the left hand rising farther. The right arm opens downward as the right knee bends, then both hands sweep right before the right arm rises and the right leg straightens. Both arms lengthen down and left, then fold upward as the knees soften in succession; the right hand swings right and back left while the left hand travels right and drops. Both knees extend as the hands descend, then the right knee bends while the left arm tucks and lifts left over a softening knee, followed by the right knee straightening and the right hand curling up-right. The right hand returns left and drops as the right knee sinks again and the left arm extends downward, ending with the left arm folding and the right knee releasing.

The right knee softens as the dancer curls the right arm upward and right, then lowers both hands while the right knee straightens and the left arm lengthens. The right hand moves left and rises with a deeper fold as the left knee bends; the left hand lifts right and drops into an extended reach while the right hand continues left and down. Both arms curl upward, the right hand moving right as the right knee bends, before the right arm opens downward and the left knee sinks farther. The right arm reaches up-left over a straightening right knee, then folds as the left hand moves right and down; the right hand descends right with an opening elbow and the left hand follows right and down. The left knee bends as both hands sweep left and the elbows tuck, then both knees soften in succession while the right arm extends downward and the left arm curls upward.

The left knee softens beneath the left hand, which rises and curls while the right arm lengthens down and right. The left arm opens downward as the left knee straightens and the right knee bends, then both hands sweep right and climb before the right arm folds leftward against the left arm's extension. The right arm reaches up and left again as the left knee sinks farther, followed by another upward curl and a shared lift of the hands with the left knee releasing. The left arm tucks and lowers while the right hand moves right, then extends into a leftward rise as the left hand descends. Both hands continue left, the right hand folding and dropping while the left hand opens higher.

The right knee straightens as the dancer folds both arms and lifts the right hand, then lowers the right arm while the left arm extends left. The leftward-moving left hand drops and reaches farther out as the right knee bends; the right arm curls upward and sweeps left before opening down and right. The lower right hand continues right as the left arm rises with a bend of the left knee, then both hands sweep left and the raised left arm tucks downward while the bent left knee releases and the right hand climbs. The tucked left arm extends right and returns up-left, the left knee softening before straightening as both hands rise, the right arm curling left. Both knees deepen in succession while the arms open and lower, the right hand moving right. The hands reverse outward, the right arm folding as the right knee releases, then the left arm lengthens and carries the left hand left.

To begin, the dancer folds the right arm right and lowers it into a deeper tuck while the left hand moves left. The right arm opens downward and reaches farther right as the right knee straightens, then both hands rise with the right arm curling inward. Both hands sweep left as the left knee softens, followed by another leftward reach of the right arm. The right arm curls upward and drops again before reaching right and reopening. The left hand rises as the right knee beneath the curled right arm bends and releases, and both hands descend, the left hand continuing left while the right hand moves right.

In opposition, the dancer lowers the right hand while the left arm curls upward and left, then both hands rise with the left arm drawing farther inward. The right arm folds into a leftward sweep before releasing downward, while the initially lowered right hand dips right and returns up-left as the right knee softens. Both hands climb with the leftward-moving arm extending, then descend together as the right knee straightens. The left arm tucks again while the right arm curls higher; the tucked left hand reaches down-right as the right knee bends and releases, followed by the right hand dropping left and folding back in. The lower right hand reverses right and lifts, joined by the rising left hand, before the raised left arm lengthens and the right hand draws left into a curl.

The right knee straightens as the left hand sweeps left and down, then curls up toward the right while the right arm folds upward. The raised hands separate sideways and descend, the left hand returning right as the right knee bends and the right arm extends downward. Both arms lengthen into a shared lift before the left hand drops left and the right knee softens further; the left knee also bends as the right hand rises again and the left elbow tucks. Both knees straighten as the left arm opens down and right, then the right knee bends beneath a curling lift of the left hand. The left knee bends again as both arms gather higher and sweep left, followed by the right knee extending and the right arm opening downward.

The arms exchange height: the dancer lowers the left hand while the right hand curls upward and moves right, then raises both hands as the left arm folds and the left knee softens. The right hand drops into an extended reach, followed by the left hand's descent as the right knee bends farther and the left arm tucks. Both hands sweep left, the left arm lengthening as the left knee straightens, before they rise with the right arm folding and the right knee extending; the left elbow releases and re-bends as the hands descend, separate left and right, and the right knee softens again.
