The left arm reaches down-left while the right arm opens rightward and the right knee straightens, then the left hand rises right and the right hand curls back left as the right knee bends. Both hands fall and sweep right, the right elbow opening as the left arm extends, then the hands lift together with the left elbow tucking before the right arm folds inward.

The dancer lifts the right hand. Both hands rise and separate, the left hand moving left as the left arm curls inward; the right hand continues up-left while the left knee straightens. The left hand swings right and back left, then both arms open as the right knee softens and the right hand lowers. The left arm folds down-right while the right hand moves right and rises, followed by the left hand lifting right before curling left and down. The right hand reverses left as the right knee bends farther, then returns right with a tucked elbow while the left hand rises right and opens.

To begin, the dancer lengthens the right arm downward while the left hand moves left, then brings the right hand right and up as the left knee straightens. The left hand returns left and drops into a fold while the right arm extends down; both hands sweep right and climb, the right hand continuing upward before its elbow opens and both hands descend. The right hand reverses left and rises into a curl while the left hand reaches farther left and lowers, then they exchange directions with the right arm dropping and opening and the left hand folding back right. Both hands lift as the left arm tucks further right and the right hand reaches left, then the left hand returns left into a deeper bend while the right arm lengthens downward. The right arm curls upward toward the right as the left hand lowers, opens and rises, then the right elbow releases and its hand drops while the left hand sweeps left and down with an extended arm. The right arm folds again as the left hand lifts into a tuck and moves right.

In opposition, the right hand travels left while the left hand moves right and rises into a curl, then both arms lengthen as the hands descend. The right hand sweeps up-right and curls inward, joined by the left arm drawing tighter as its hand rises left. Both hands lower and open, the right arm sweeping left before they climb again. The left hand reverses right and drops with a deeper tuck, while the right arm folds and lifts; it then extends down-left as the left elbow opens and the right knee softens. The right hand climbs again as the left lowers and lengthens, followed by the right arm reaching right and upward while the left hand rises and curls left.

The dancer lowers and extends the right arm, then the right knee straightens. The dancer lifts both hands while the right arm curls upward and the left arm folds. The right hand sweeps right and down while the left arm reaches left and the left knee bends. Both elbows draw inward, then open as the right knee softens further and the left hand returns right. The right hand rises through a fold and extension while the left arm tucks farther left, then reverses right and lengthens as the left knee straightens. The left hand climbs again with another curl while the right knee softens, then drops as the right hand rises and extends and the left knee releases. The right arm folds and lowers toward the right, joined by the left hand, before opening into a final lift.

The dancer folds the left arm and sweeps the right hand left. The left hand continues left as the right knee straightens, then returns right while the right arm curls upward to the right. The right arm lengthens downward, the right knee softens, and both hands sweep left with the right elbow opening farther. The hands reverse right as the right forearm folds, then rise together before descending into a deeper curl of the right arm. Both hands return left as the knees bend in succession, then lift again with the left elbow tucking.

As the right hand moves right, the dancer curls the right arm upward and brings it back left. The left arm folds up to the right while the raised right hand continues climbing. Both hands rise farther as the right arm opens into a leftward sweep, with the left elbow releasing before both arms curl again.

The right knee bends and straightens as the dancer curls the left arm upward and left, then opens it down while the right hand moves right. The left arm folds up and left again as the right hand reaches down and right, both elbows tightening before the right hand reverses left and rises into a tuck. Both hands sweep right, the left arm opening downward while the right elbow extends, then the left hand returns left and both arms gather inward. The hands separate right and left with the left arm extending downward, followed by a lift of the left hand through an opening and renewed fold. The right hand travels right as the left elbow releases, then both hands descend while the left arm lengthens farther and its hand sweeps right.

The dancer folds the right arm upward. The left hand follows up and left with a curl, then returns right and down as its elbow opens. Both hands rise, the right hand moving left while the left hand curls farther before dropping into an extension. The left arm sweeps left, tucks again, and lengthens downward toward the right.

The right knee softens as the dancer raises both hands, the right arm curling right and the left arm folding left; the right leg releases while the left-moving hand continues upward. Both knees lengthen as the hands sweep apart and descend, then the left knee bends beneath a rightward reach of the right arm that curls upward while the left hand rises with an extending elbow. The right hand drops and travels left as the right knee straightens, while the left arm reaches up and left and the left knee softens before both arms fold downward. The left knee releases into a bend as the hands spread right and left and rise together, the left arm tucking farther while the right arm extends. The left hand lowers and opens as the left knee straightens again, and both hands sweep right before the right arm folds and the right knee softens.

As the right arm curls up and left, the dancer straightens the left knee, then lengthens the right hand down and right before folding it upward. The right arm opens downward and returns up to the right while the left hand rises farther, the left knee bending as both elbows tuck. The right hand lowers into a reach and sweeps left, then climbs and reverses right as the left knee softens; the left hand drops as the bent left knee extends. Both hands descend, the left arm reaching right and opening before lifting as the right arm folds and the left knee bends again. The right elbow tightens farther while the left arm reaches left and descends, then both hands lower and sweep right with the left arm lengthening. The left knee straightens as the right hand continues right and lifts, then drops again while the left arm folds.

The arms separate left and right as the dancer folds the right arm, then both arms rise and sweep inward before the right hand descends and lengthens. The right hand reaches right while the left hand curls upward, the left knee straightening as the right arm extends further. The left hand drops and opens into a leftward reach while the right elbow tucks, and the knees soften in succession beneath another lift of the right arm. Both arms fold downward, the right hand moving left and opening as the left knee releases. The hands separate once more, with the right arm curling up while the left hand continues left.

A rising arm exchange begins with the dancer curling the right hand upward while the left hand lowers, then sending both hands left before the left arm folds up and right. The left knee straightens as the hands reverse right and the right arm opens downward, followed by the left hand dropping into a tuck as the left knee softens. Both arms lengthen upward, the left hand continuing right while the left knee bends further and the right knee extends; the hands then descend into folded elbows as the left knee straightens and the right knee bends. The hands sweep left together, the left arm opening upward while the right elbow draws inward, before they separate right and left and rise again. The right hand drops into an extension as the right knee straightens, then curls back up to the left while the left arm folds upward and moves right. The right arm releases down and right as the left hand descends into a deeper fold, finishing with the right hand moving farther right.

The right hand moves right and rises. The dancer sends the left hand left as the rising right arm folds, then lowers that folded right hand while its left counterpart climbs right and opens. The lower right hand continues down and left before both arms lengthen upward, with the rightward-moving left hand continuing farther right. Both hands descend together, the left arm folding and the rightward hand returning left. That right hand rises again while the opposite left hand lowers and extends.

At the outset, the dancer raises the right hand while the left arm folds and lowers, then extends as the right arm curls left and the left arm opens right. The hands reverse sideways with the left arm folding, then sweep together left and return right before both rise and separate again, the right hand continuing upward. The right hand swings left and back right while the left arm drops and lengthens, then they trade height and directions once more as the left arm reaches farther down and right. Both arms curl into a shared lift, then open as the right arm lowers; the left hand sweeps left and reverses right as both elbows fold inward. Both hands sink and extend downward while the right knee straightens, then the right arm tucks and the left hand rises before both sweep left and the right arm opens.

To begin, the dancer folds the right arm upward and left while the left hand drops right, then reverses both hands left with lengthening elbows. The right hand lifts as the right knee bends and straightens and the left knee softens, then both arms extend downward before curling upward and separating right and left; the right hand sweeps left again as the knees exchange bend and release. Both hands lower, the left arm reaching right, then rise into folded elbows as the right knee bends and releases and the left leg straightens; the hands sweep left together before the left hand drops right and the right hand returns right with an opening elbow. The left knee softens as the right hand descends, then the left knee straightens while the right hand rises left and curls inward. Both knees bend in succession as the left hand lowers and the right arm reaches down and right, ending with a deepening bend in the right knee.

As the right arm lengthens and the left arm curls upward, the dancer lowers the right hand while the left elbow opens and folds again. The right arm tucks and rises as the right knee softens, then both hands sweep left, the left elbow drawing in before the right arm extends down-right. The right hand returns up-left into a curl while the left arm reaches right and drops; both knees bend further as the hands reverse sideways and the arms open, with the right knee straightening. The right hand travels down-left against the left hand's rightward reach, then reverses right and down as both elbows fold, the left hand returning left. Both arms extend and descend before lifting together, with the left hand moving right. The right arm opens farther while the left arm tucks and carries its hand left, ending with both hands rising.

The right hand rises right as the left knee straightens, then both arms lengthen and descend while the right hand reverses left. The left knee softens as the left hand curls upward and swings right, joined by the right hand's rise and rightward extension; the left knee releases as both hands climb and the right hand returns left. Both elbows draw inward over another bend and release of the left knee, then the right hand drops while the left hand reaches right and down before curling back up. The right hand lifts into a fold as the left hand moves left, then the right arm opens and lowers right while the left-moving arm tucks farther and carries its hand right. The right hand reverses up-left and descends right with a deeper elbow bend, then the left hand rises and falls again as the right knee extends.

A descending reach and return carries the dancer's arms through a shared rightward sweep, the hands lowering before the right hand reverses left as the right knee bends. The left arm lengthens down and right while the right knee straightens and the right hand continues left; the left knee then softens as both hands rise, the right hand moving right and the right knee extending. Both knees bend again as the hands separate left and right and descend, then the right knee straightens while the right arm opens downward and the left hand sweeps left and back right with a bending elbow. The hands climb together, the right hand curling inward before the left hand follows, then both lower and spread apart with the right arm opening. The right hand rises into a fold as the left hand curls upward, and both elbows tuck while the right hand returns right and drops.

At the opening, the right hand sweeps right and down as the left knee straightens and the left arm folds, then both hands rise with the left arm extending left before dropping and tucking again. The left arm reaches right and down while the right arm lengthens and lifts, then curls downward as the left hand reverses left; the right hand follows left and rises into a tighter fold. Both arms open and lower, the right hand sweeping right as the left arm bends upward and returns left; the knees soften in succession, then the right arm curls up-right and drops while the left elbow opens and folds again. The right arm extends right and down alongside another downward reach of the left hand, then both lift and sweep left as the left arm unfolds and the left knee straightens. The hands descend together, the right arm folding through a rightward reversal and returning left as the right knee softens, then both rise with the left arm tucked before the right hand lowers and both elbows open.

As the right hand rises, the dancer sends the left hand left and down with a lengthening arm, then lifts both hands into folded arms. The right arm reaches right as the left arm drops, opens and returns right before curling upward again. Both hands sweep left and descend with extended elbows, then reverse right as the left knee softens; the left hand returns left while the right hand moves farther right. The right elbow folds as the right knee bends and releases, followed by another bend-and-release of the left knee and an extension of the right arm. The left hand lowers and curls inward as the left knee sinks further.

As the right arm curls inward, the dancer lowers and extends both arms before lifting the left hand left and folding it back right. The right hand rises right as the left knee bends, then both hands drop while the left knee straightens and the left arm opens; the right knee softens and the right hand lifts as the left hand moves right. The hands trade height with another bend of the right knee, then lower and separate sideways as the right knee releases and the right arm folds upward. The left knee bends again while the raised arm lengthens down, and both knees sink before the left hand rises over a straightening knee and drops into an extension. The hands move right together, the right elbow tucking as the right knee bends, while the left hand lifts over a further bend of the left knee and curls inward.

The right hand curls upward and moves left, then drops as the left arm extends right; both elbows open before the right hand reverses up-left. The right hand continues left and down while the left arm lengthens farther right, then both arms fold as the left hand climbs again. Both hands sweep right and descend with opening elbows, followed by a renewed curl of the right arm and a lift of the left arm. The hands separate left and right, then reverse inward, the left elbow tucking as the right hand rises. The right hand drops while the left hand lifts, both moving left and folding further.

To begin, the dancer folds both arms and lifts the hands, sending the left hand left while the right hand reaches right. The right arm curls up-left as the left arm lowers and opens; the left hand continues down-right before rising into a tighter fold. Both hands sweep left, the left arm dropping and opening while the right hand climbs and tucks, then returns down-right with an extension. The left arm reaches up-left as the right arm folds and rises, followed by a downward curl of the left hand. The left arm lengthens again, then both hands descend with the right arm extending farther.

As the right hand rises and the left hand moves right, the dancer curls both arms upward and right. Both hands descend, then the right arm opens into a lift while the left knee bends and straightens beneath its own rising reach. The right hand drops left as the left arm folds down and left, then reverses right with an opening elbow while the right arm extends upward. The left hand climbs farther as the right knee softens and the right arm tucks; the right hand sweeps left and back right while the left arm reaches right and lengthens. The right knee bends deeper and releases as the left hand lowers and the left arm reaches farther right.

The arms move apart, the right hand reaching right and the left hand reaching left as both rise. The hands reverse inward with a bend in the knee beneath the initially right-moving arm, then separate again as the right arm extends upward. The left arm curls higher while the right arm opens downward, then both descend, the left hand moving right before reversing left alongside the right hand's return to the right. Both arms lengthen as the right hand rises; it then lowers and moves left while the left arm folds upward. The left hand continues left as the left arm tucks farther inward and the right arm opens down, ending with the left hand dropping into another curl.

The right hand sweeps right and rises while the left arm curls upward. Then the right hand returns left while the left arm opens down. The right hand drops farther left with an extended elbow as the left hand reverses right, then folds into a lift while the right arm curls upward. Both hands descend as their elbows open and the right hand moves right, followed by the left hand rising into a tighter fold. The left hand sweeps left and down with its arm lengthening, while the right hand lowers and extends right. The right hand continues right and climbs with a bend of the knee beneath it, before both hands sweep left and the right arm opens downward.

The right hand rises rightward. The dancer folds the left arm, then lifts both hands leftward with lengthening elbows before lowering them and opening the left arm as the right returns right. The left arm curls up to the right while the right reaches down-left, then both sweep right and rise, the right folding into a reversal leftward as the left opens downward. Both arms tuck through another leftward lift, then separate left and right, the right elbow extending and its hand dropping as the left rises and curls. The right hand rebounds up-right and drops again while the left climbs leftward with an opening elbow. The left hand continues upward and left as the right curls higher, finishing with the left arm folded.

As the right hand rises left, the dancer folds the right arm while the left hand curls up and right, then straightens both knees as the hands reverse sideways. Both arms lengthen downward before the right hand lifts right and the left hand reaches left; the right knee softens as the right arm tucks and the left hand rises farther right. The right elbow opens while the left arm folds down and left, followed by a leftward curl of the right hand and another bend of the right knee. The right arm extends down and right as the left hand lowers, then both sweep left with the left elbow opening. The right hand lifts into a fold while the left hand continues left and climbs with the left arm tucked; the hands separate right and left as the right knee straightens and the left arm lengthens downward.

As the right hand rises, the dancer sends both hands right and lowers them, then lifts the left hand into a fold while the right arm curls upward and left. The left arm opens down-left as the right knee bends, then tucks into another up-right reach over a straightening right knee while the right hand moves left. Both hands descend and sweep right as the knees soften in succession, then the right arm reaches upward and left while the right knee lengthens; the right hand returns right over another bend-and-straighten of the right knee. The right arm folds down-left as the right knee sinks, then opens while the left arm tucks and the left knee releases. The right hand sweeps left and down as the right knee extends, followed by the left hand moving left and curling upward over a bend of the left knee; the left arm then draws inward and rises before the bent left knee straightens.

At the outset, the dancer lowers both hands as the right arm lengthens. The left hand sweeps right and curls upward while the right arm folds left, then both arms extend and the hands descend. The left hand travels right and rises into a tuck while the right hand moves left; the left arm opens and drops back left as the right elbow folds. The right hand lifts into an extension before returning down-right and folding, while the left hand continues right and descends with a longer reach.

The arms work in opposition: the right hand curls upward while the left hand drops, then both descend and the left arm lengthens as the right knee softens. The lowered right arm folds left and rises while the left hand moves right, and the bent right knee straightens before bending again beneath a drop of the right hand. The right hand reverses right as the left knee straightens and the left hand climbs left; the rightward-moving arm opens, lifts and tucks, while the raised left hand descends. Both hands sweep left with the tucked right arm climbing farther, then the hands exchange height as the right arm releases and the left hand rises. The higher left hand continues up and left while the right hand reaches right, its knee extending, before both hands fall and the rightward-reaching arm gathers inward.

As the left hand sweeps left and down, the dancer folds the left arm while the right hand moves right and rises. The left arm lengthens farther left, then both hands climb, with the right arm curling in as the right knee straightens. The right hand drops and extends left before returning up-right into a tighter tuck, while the left arm opens and the left knee bends. The left arm reaches left again and lifts as the left knee softens, while the right knee releases; the right hand returns right and curls higher as the right knee straightens and the left hand moves left. Both hands descend, the rightward-reaching arm extending farther before both sweep left and rise with lengthening elbows. The left arm folds back right while the right arm lowers and tucks, finishing with a rightward release of the right elbow.

As the right hand moves left and the left hand moves right, both rise, then reverse sideways with the left arm curling inward. The right hand lifts farther left as the right arm folds, while the left hand lowers and opens before rising again. Both hands descend, the right hand reaching left, before they lift together and the left hand sweeps left. The right arm tucks and lowers alongside the left arm's drop, then extends right while the left elbow bends and releases; the right hand curls upward as the left hand rises, and both elbows fold. The hands sweep left and down, the right hand extending farther before both arms lengthen, then climb in succession, with the right arm folding as the left arm reaches higher. The right arm drops and unfolds while the left arm continues rising, and the right hand returns left as the left arm draws inward.

The right hand sweeps left and up as the left knee straightens, while the left hand rises right; both knees soften before the hands separate left and right and the right arm lengthens down. The right hand climbs farther left into a curl as the left knee bends deeper, then the right knee straightens and both arms extend downward before the right hand reverses right and the left hand reaches left. Both hands rise, the left hand folding down-left as the left knee softens, then the right hand drops and curls back up-right while the left hand lifts and extends. The left hand returns left and lowers over a bend in the left knee, then curls upward again as the right hand moves right and folds. The right arm opens and lowers while the left knee releases and the left arm tucks further, then the hands trade height and directions: the right hand moves left and curls upward while the left hand sweeps right.

The arms work in opposition: the right hand sweeps left and back right as the right knee straightens, then drops while the left hand moves left and both rise with the elbows folding. The hands reverse sideways, the right hand returning down-left as the right knee bends and the left arm extends downward; the left hand continues left before lifting over a deeper right knee bend and reaching right as the right leg lengthens. The right hand returns left and curls upward while the left arm tucks and rises, then both hands descend, the right hand moving right as the right elbow opens and the left knee softens. The right hand lifts farther and falls left against the left hand's rightward sweep, followed by another lift and drop as the left knee straightens and the left hand travels left. Both arms fold into a shared leftward reach and descend, with the left knee bending as the right hand rebounds upward and the left hand shifts right.

The knees soften in succession as the dancer sends the right hand down and left, then lifts it rightward with both arms lengthening while the left knee bends. Both hands sweep left as the right knee straightens and the right arm folds, then descend into a rightward return that softens both knees before the right arm opens and lowers. The left arm curls upward toward the right while the right knee bends again; the hands separate left and right as the right knee extends, then the left arm drops and both arms tuck through another shared bend of the knees. The right knee straightening accompanies a rightward lift of the right hand and a rise of the left arm, which then folds left over a deeper knee bend as the right arm reaches down and left. Both hands move left, the right arm curling upward while the left hand sinks and the left knee straightens, then the hands reverse right and descend with the right elbow opening and the left arm extending farther.

The right hand rises. The dancer folds the left arm, then sends the right hand left and down as both elbows open, followed by another curl on the right side. Both hands climb into bent arms, then lower while the left arm lengthens and the right hand returns right. The hands sweep left with a deeper tuck on the left side, then reverse right as the left elbow opens and the right arm draws inward again. The left hand climbs left and drops while the right hand moves left; both then rise as the left arm extends.

The dancer folds the left arm. The right hand travels right and lifts as the left hand lowers, then both arms lengthen into a leftward sweep while the hands rise together. The left arm tucks again and continues left as the left knee straightens, while the right hand curls upward toward the right. The right hand drops farther right before both arms extend downward, ending with the left hand moving right.

As the right arm lengthens downward, the dancer folds the left arm upward and left, then extends the left arm down as the right knee straightens. The left hand rises while the right hand sweeps right, then both arms curl inward before the left arm opens again. Both hands descend into tucks, the right arm continuing left, then rise with the right arm extending farther left. The left arm curls higher, its hand swings right and drops as both elbows open; the rightward-moving hand lifts once more.

The right hand climbs leftward as the dancer softens both knees, then extends the right arm right while the left arm rises and the left knee straightens. The right arm folds upward as the right knee bends again; both hands lower and separate, the right hand sweeping left while the left hand drops farther. The right knee straightens beneath a rightward extension of the right arm, which then curls upward before opening back left as the left hand lifts and folds. The left hand continues climbing and reaches right as the right hand moves down-left and the right knee deepens into a bend, followed by the left knee sinking. Both elbows tuck as the hands rise, then the right hand shifts right while the left hand travels left.

The right knee softens as the dancer lowers and lengthens the left arm, then bends the right elbow while the right hand sweeps right. The right knee straightens as both hands rise and the right hand reverses left, then drops into a deeper tuck. The left hand continues down and left with its elbow opening before lifting alongside the right hand. The right hand swings right and back left as both arms fold downward, then the left hand rises while the right knee bends further.

To begin, the dancer raises the right hand and extends the right arm left while the left hand reaches up-right, then reverses both hands right as the right arm folds downward and opens. The left arm curls upward and releases as the right hand returns left, then the left hand swings down-left before both arms lengthen through a rising lift with the left hand returning right. Both hands descend, the left elbow folding and opening as the left hand sweeps left and back right; the right hand follows right and rises into a curl while the left knee straightens. The right hand drops, folds more tightly, then moves left and lifts again as the left arm opens and the left knee bends. The right arm tucks farther while the left hand lowers, then both knees soften and the hands separate right and left, the left arm extending upward before the left knee straightens and the left hand returns right. The right arm opens downward while the left arm curls and continues rising, ending with the right hand moving right.

In opposition, the right hand rises and the left hand lowers as both arms lengthen. The right arm folds leftward while the left hand moves right, then both hands descend, the right arm opening as the right knee softens and the left hand sweeps left. Both hands climb with the right knee straightening, the right arm curling inward and continuing upward before dropping as the left hand reverses right and down. The right hand lifts again while the left hand returns left and both elbows tuck, then the right hand travels right and drops. The left arm extends as the left knee bends and releases; the left hand sweeps left before returning right, joined by the right hand in a shared rise.

As the right arm reaches left and down, the left arm curls upward and right, then drops while the right hand reverses right. The right hand climbs left as the left knee bends and releases beneath a curling left hand that rises left, before both elbows open and the knees soften together. Both hands descend and separate left and right, with the right elbow folding as the right knee straightens; the left knee lengthens while the right knee bends again. The right hand returns right and drops as the left arm lifts left, then lowers into a deeper fold while the left knee extends farther. The right knee softens once more as the left arm opens downward and the bent-knee hand rises.

As the right arm lengthens downward, the dancer curls the left arm upward and left, then reverses the right hand right as the right arm folds. The left arm extends down and right while the folded right hand returns left, then both arms tuck and the right hand rises. The left hand reaches farther right before dropping and curling back up toward the left. Both hands climb, with the right hand moving left as the left arm opens; the left arm lowers and sweeps left, right, and back left into a fold. The right hand continues left and descends into an extension while the left elbow releases.

The right hand rises leftward as the dancer lengthens both arms, then the right arm curls up-right while the left hand reaches left and down. The right arm opens downward to the right, followed by a drop of the left hand; both elbows fold as the hands return left, the right arm rising and extending before both hands descend. Both hands sweep right with the right elbow opening, then the left hand lifts and curls leftward while the right arm folds upward. The left hand drops as the left knee softens, then the right arm extends down-left while the left arm curls upward and releases into a low rightward reach. The left hand returns left as the right arm draws inward and rises, then both hands sweep right while the left arm lengthens and lowers.

In opposition, the dancer lowers the right hand while the left hand rises, then lifts and sweeps left with the left arm lengthening before both hands descend. The right hand returns right as both arms fold, then the right knee softens and straightens beneath a shared rightward sweep of the hands. The right knee bends again as both elbows tuck and the hands drop, followed by another extension of the right knee. Both arms open downward and the knees sink in succession, after which the right hand rises and moves right while the left hand travels left. The left arm curls upward as the right knee bends, then extends down and opens while the right hand climbs farther right; the bent right knee releases and both hands lower together.

The right hand sweeps left and upward while the left hand curls up to the right, then both hands descend. The right arm lengthens while the left elbow opens. The right hand swings right and back left into a fold as the left hand rises and tucks. They trade height before reversing sideways again, with the right hand dropping and extending and the left hand rising farther right. Both arms open downward, the right hand continuing left, then the left arm curls up and left while the right arm folds. The left arm extends down and returns up to the left, joined by the right hand moving left and lowering through an opening elbow. Both hands rise, then separate right and left with folded arms, before the right hand dips and rebounds upward alongside the left.

The arms move in opposition: the right hand travels right as the left hand drops, then the right hand reverses left and rises while the left hand folds upward. The raised right hand dips and rebounds as both elbows open, with the left arm curling and lifting before the right knee straightens and the left elbow tucks. The right hand returns down-right into a deeper fold while the left hand lowers, then the right hand curls upward again as the left knee softens; the left arm reaches up-left and extends farther left. Both hands descend with opening elbows, the right hand sweeping right while the left hand moves left, then both rise with folded arms. The left hand swings right and back left as the right knee bends further and both elbows release, followed by a downward sweep of the left hand toward the right and another bend of the left knee.

The right arm curls upward and right. The left arm reaches left and lengthens as the right hand continues right, then both arms fold and sweep left together. The right arm opens while the left elbow tucks, and the hands separate with the left continuing left and the right dropping right; the left arm gathers in again as the right extends down and right. The right hand lifts, folds, and drops farther right while the left rises and opens into a shared descent. Both arms curl upward, then the right arm lengthens before returning into a fold.

The arms move in opposition: the right hand sweeps left as the right knee straightens, while the left hand drops and moves right, then both knees soften before the right arm curls upward and the left knee extends. The raised right hand continues right and rises with a folded elbow as the right knee bends again, then both hands descend and the left arm opens while the right arm tucks. Both hands sweep left, the tucked right arm lengthening downward as the right knee sinks farther and the left leg straightens; the right knee releases before both hands lift and reverse right, the tucked right elbow drawing inward as the left knee bends. The curled right arm reaches down-right while the left arm extends, then folds upward as the right knee lengthens and the left hand lowers; the left arm curls up-left as the left knee softens. The left knee straightens beneath a rising reach, followed by the right knee extending and the right hand dropping left with an opening elbow.

At the outset, the dancer folds the right arm as the right knee softens and both hands move right, then reverses left with a deeper curl and lift while the left hand drops. The right leg straightens beneath the rising right elbow, which opens downward as the right hand sweeps right and the left knee bends; the hands separate again, the right arm extending while the left knee releases. Both knees soften as the left hand lifts and the right arm curls upward, then they lengthen in succession while the raised hand drops and the left arm extends farther down. The descending left hand continues left and down as the right arm reaches up to the right, then folds back left before lowering. The left hand rises into an extension as the right knee bends and releases, followed by the left knee bending and straightening while the right hand moves right and the lifted hand lowers.

The right hand rises and falls. The dancer sends both hands right, the left hand lifting as the right knee straightens; the right arm curls upward while the left arm extends down. Both hands return left and lower, then the right arm reaches out before the left elbow folds and the hands rise again. The right arm tucks into a leftward sweep as the left hand descends, then opens downward alongside the left hand, which continues low to the left. The left arm curls upward, sweeps right, and drops into an extension.

In opposition, the right arm reaches left while the left arm curls upward, then both hands descend as the right arm folds and the left hand moves right. The right hand reverses left, lifts into an extension, and returns right as the right knee straightens; both arms tuck, lower, and open before curling again toward the right. The right hand dips farther down, then rises into a deeper fold as the left arm lengthens downward. The right arm extends left and lowers while the left arm tucks higher, then they trade height and reach, with the right hand returning up-right and the left hand dropping left as both elbows open. The right arm curls down-left and releases, then folds upward to the right as the left arm continues lowering; both hands sink and separate left and right, the left elbow extending before the hands rise together and reverse inward. The left hand sweeps right and down as the right arm reaches left and down, then curls upward.

To begin, the dancer folds both arms and lowers the hands in opposing directions. The right hand moves right, then reverses left as its elbow opens, then curls upward while the left arm tucks and lifts. Both hands sweep left, the right arm reaching higher before folding back down and continuing left; the left arm extends downward and returns right. The left hand rises again with a deeper bend, then both hands descend and separate sideways as one knee softens, finishing with the right hand moving right.

An alternating arm reach begins with the right hand moving left and the left hand moving right, both arms lengthening before the hands reverse sideways and descend. The right knee bends as the right arm folds upward, then opens while the right hand continues left; the left arm curls up and right and releases downward as the right knee straightens. Both knees soften as the left hand moves left and its elbow tucks again, then the right hand rises right and returns down-left while the left arm reaches up-right over a deeper bend of the left knee. The left arm folds down-left and extends as the left knee releases, then curls up-right while the right hand lifts right and the left hand drops left; the right knee bends as the left arm lowers and unfolds. The left hand returns right and curls upward while the right arm opens left and the right knee sinks farther; the left hand drops, the left knee straightens, and the right arm folds left as the right knee softens again.

A rising, folding arm sweep begins as the dancer lowers the left hand while the right arm curls upward and left; the left hand then rises right into a fold before both arms lengthen. The hands separate sideways with the left hand continuing right and the right hand moving left, then reverse their lateral directions as both elbows tuck, lift and open. Both arms curl again, the left hand rising right while the right hand moves left, then extend downward and rise once more. The right arm folds down and opens back up as its hand shifts right, joined by the left hand moving right and dropping; both elbows then bend and release as the hands sweep left. The left arm gathers upward to the right, followed by the right hand rising, curling and releasing toward the right, then lowering with its elbow opening. The left hand drops and returns left as the right hand lifts, folds and descends.

As the right arm curls upward and the left hand rises, both hands sweep left with the right elbow opening, then reverse right as the right arm folds again. The left arm lengthens while the raised right hand drops, and the hands separate left and right before reversing their sideways paths. Both hands lower and gather inward, then rise toward the right as the arms unfold; the right hand continues right while the left hand moves left and down. The hands descend farther apart, the right elbow tucking and the right knee softening, before both arms curl upward. They open into a final shared rightward sweep as the left knee bends more deeply.

Upward, the dancer curls the right arm while the left hand sweeps left and rises; both knees soften as the right hand reverses right and drops. The left knee straightens while the right arm opens upward and the left knee bends again, followed by the right knee softening. Both hands sweep left and descend, the right arm lengthening farther before curling up to the right as the left hand continues down and the right knee extends. The right hand returns left with an opening elbow and a bending knee, then lowers farther left as the right knee straightens and the left arm reaches right. The right arm folds upward once more while the left arm tucks, and both knees bend in succession.

As the right knee straightens, the dancer sends the right hand left and down into a curl while the left arm lengthens downward; the straightened right leg softens as the right hand lifts right and the left knee bends. The left arm reaches higher and opens while the right arm folds upward, then both hands sweep right with the left elbow extending before reversing left and lowering together. The right arm curls upward again as the left arm tucks, then the right arm drops and opens right while the left arm folds farther and moves left. Both arms gather inward as the left hand rises, then they spread apart with the left hand continuing up and left; the right hand lowers as the right knee bends and releases, and both elbows extend before the left hand returns right and the right arm climbs left into a fold. The left hand descends right while the right arm continues left, then both arms lengthen and their hands climb as the right knee beneath the descending left hand straightens.

At the outset, the dancer lowers the right hand while the left hand reaches right and down with a lengthening elbow. The right arm curls up to the right as the right knee straightens and both hands rise, then the right hand dips left into a deeper fold before lifting again. Both arms extend downward and sweep right, the left hand moving farther right and upward as the right elbow tucks; the left hand reverses left into a curl while the right hand continues down-right. The right arm opens right and descends as the left arm folds and rises, then the right hand lifts left and returns down-right into another extension. The right hand rises left and folds back down-right while the left arm lengthens, then both hands descend as the left arm reaches out.

As the right arm curls upward, the dancer folds the left arm and lifts the left hand rightward, then opens the right elbow before both hands descend and the left hand sweeps left. The left knee bends as the left-moving hand rises and the right knee softens; both knees straighten in succession while the arms lengthen apart and the left hand drops left. Both knees bend again beneath a rising rightward reach of the left hand, which then reverses down-left as the right arm extends downward and both legs straighten. The hands separate, the right hand continuing left while the left hand moves right and rises into a curl; the right knee bends as the right hand climbs and the left hand lowers, then both knees straighten and the hands reverse sideways. The left leg lengthens while the right knee softens and the right hand sweeps right, then both hands lower and the left knee bends as the left hand returns left.

The dancer performs alternating arm curls with a knee that softens on the right-hand side. The left hand rises as its knee bends, while the other hand moves right and both elbows tuck; the right hand then sweeps down-left as its knee straightens and its arm opens. The hands exchange height as the right knee softens and the left extends farther upward, then the right hand drops while the left sweeps left and rises again. Both knees lengthen as the left hand reverses right and the right arm folds downward, followed by another bend of the left knee and a lift of the right hand. With the right hand moving right and both arms drawing inward, the right knee releases into a deeper bend as the left knee also softens. The left elbow tucks farther while the right knee straightens again.

As the right knee straightens, the dancer folds both arms and lifts the hands apart, left hand left and right hand right. The right hand drops and curls upward again while the left arm opens, then the right hand swings left and reverses down-right as the right knee bends. The right knee straightens beneath a rightward rise and another bend, while the left elbow folds and releases; the rising arm tucks farther before opening into a descent. Both hands sweep left with folding elbows, then rebound upward and separate right and left as the knees soften. The right-moving hand returns left, rises and extends while the left knee straightens and the left hand lowers into a curl; the extended arm reaches farther left, then rises as the right knee straightens. The right hand swings right, back left and down-right, lengthening through the final reach as the left hand lifts.

At the opening, the dancer curls the right arm upward and right as the left knee straightens; both hands descend, the left arm folding left while the left knee bends again. The left hand rises and opens toward the right before lowering over another bend of the left knee, then returns up-left as the left knee releases and the right hand sweeps left with a deeper tuck. Both hands drop, the right hand moving right while the left knee softens and straightens beneath an extension of the left arm, then the left knee bends as the hands climb and the right knee lengthens. The hands separate left and right as the knees trade softening and straightening, with the right arm opening and the left knee sinking further. The right hand lifts over a deeper left knee bend while the left hand moves right, then reverses left as the left knee straightens and the right hand rises farther right. Both arms curl inward as the right knee releases and bends again, before the left hand drops and extends left over another release of the left knee.

In unison, the hands sweep left. The right arm curls as both hands descend, then they separate: the right arm moves right while the left arm opens left. The right hand rises into a fold while the left arm continues right and lowers. Then both arms lengthen as the right hand moves left. The right hand dips and climbs again with a tighter tuck, while the left arm folds and sweeps left. The left arm opens farther upward, then curls down and right alongside the right hand's descent. Both hands rise into bent elbows. The left hand continues left before dropping and extending as the right hand lifts right. The right hand returns left, opens downward, and curls back up to the right.

In unison, the dancer lifts both hands while the right arm curls and both knees straighten, then sends the hands left while the right arm lengthens and the left hand rises. The right hand climbs farther left and opens into a shared rightward sweep before dropping with the left hand; both elbows fold and the right hand returns left as the left knee softens and the arms open again. Both hands rise and reverse right, the right elbow tucking before both arms extend and descend, then sweep left and curl upward as the knees bend in succession. The hands climb once more as the right knee releases, then separate right and left respectively with both arms opening, followed by another bend of the right knee and a rise of both hands. The right hand moves right and folds downward while the left hand sweeps left and down; the right knee straightens as both hands return right and the left knee extends, then the right hand curls up and left against the left hand's downward reach. The right knee bends as the right hand drops, while the left hand lifts left and returns right; the right knee straightens, the left arm opens, and the right arm curls upward.

The right knee softens as the dancer curls the right arm upward and releases it down, then carries the right hand right while the left arm folds upward. The raised right hand returns left and drops with an opening elbow as the left arm continues up and left; both knees straighten before the right hand climbs right into a fold. Both hands sweep left and descend, the left knee bending as the hands separate right and left with lengthening arms, then rise together as the left knee straightens. The right hand lowers into a tighter curl while the left hand moves right and lifts, then returns left with an opening arm as the right knee bends again. The right arm extends downward and right, the left arm opens higher to the right, and both hands move right while the left knee straightens farther.

As the right hand moves right, the dancer lowers both hands and separates them left and right, then folds the left arm while the right arm extends downward. Both hands sweep left with the left arm reaching down, then reverse right as the right arm curls upward; the left arm bends and rises before opening into a return to the left. The right hand lifts and drops toward the right as the left arm lengthens and the left knee softens, then the right hand rises again. That raised right arm tucks and carries its hand left, followed by the left hand moving left as well.

The dancer lowers both hands. The right hand sweeps left and rises, then returns right as the left arm extends down to the right; the raised right arm lengthens while the left knee softens. The raised right hand falls as the left knee straightens, then both hands lift and move left before the right hand drops and the left hand folds downward. The lower left hand reverses right with an opening elbow while the right hand rises, then the left knee beneath the rising right arm bends as the right hand sweeps left. The left knee straightens as the left hand climbs right, then the left knee extends further and both elbows draw inward. The hands separate sideways, the right hand left and the left hand right, before the right hand returns right and curls upward as the left knee bends.

The right hand moves right and down. The dancer sends the left hand left, folds both arms, and lowers them before opening the arms apart as the right hand sweeps left and the right knee softens; the left arm curls upward while the right hand rises with a bend of the left knee, then extends right. The left arm tucks downward as the knees straighten in succession, followed by the left knee, while the right arm opens left and the left arm reaches right and up. Both hands descend, the right hand curling inward, then the left arm lengthens into another lift as the right knee bends and releases; the hands separate left and right and lower with folded elbows. The left knee sinks again while the right knee straightens, then the left arm opens toward the left and returns right as the left knee bends further and the right hand drops left with an extended elbow.

As the right knee straightens and the left arm folds, the dancer lifts the right hand leftward with a lengthening elbow, then reverses both hands right as the right arm curls down and opens. The left arm tucks while the right arm extends farther right, then both hands rise before the left arm reaches left and both elbows fold again. The left knee softens as the right hand moves right and drops into an opening reach; the left knee bends further while the right hand rises left, then both knees extend and the right hand returns right. The left knee bends once more as the hands separate sideways, then the left knee straightens while the right arm folds downward and the right knee releases. Both arms gather inward, the right hand moving left and the left arm climbing, then the hands separate again with the left arm extending right and the right hand dropping as the left knee bends and straightens.

The right hand rises right. The dancer lowers and extends the left arm, then sends both hands left with the right arm opening downward as the left knee softens. The left elbow folds while the right knee straightens and the right hand climbs; the left arm curls upward to the right before dropping left, followed by a lowering of the right hand. The arms exchange height twice, the lower one lengthening and returning up-left while the other dips, opens, and lifts again. Both hands sweep left, the right arm folding and reversing right as the left arm reaches down-right, then both return left with the right elbow tightening. The left hand rises as the right hand descends, followed by the left arm curling left and lifting farther.

At the outset, the dancer folds both arms and lowers both hands, then sends the left hand left while the right hand rises into a deeper curl. The right hand climbs farther before sweeping right and down as its elbow opens, followed by the left arm lengthening downward. Both elbows tuck again as the hands separate, the right hand moving right and the left hand moving left, with the left hand lowering. The hands exchange lateral directions once more as the left arm reaches out and curls back upward. The left hand sweeps left and down, then continues left while the right arm extends.

The right knee softens beneath a fold of the right arm as the left hand moves right and both hands descend. Then the right knee straightens while the right arm releases left and the left arm curls upward. The newly raised left hand swings down-left and back up-right as the right knee bends again and the right arm tucks higher. The left hand then drops while the left knee straightens and the right hand lowers into an opening reach left. Both knees soften as the right arm folds and the right hand sweeps right, then rises before returning left with a deeper curl while the left hand travels right and lifts. The lifted left hand dips left and rebounds upward as the right hand extends right, then both sweep left and lower, the left arm folding before reaching up-right. The right hand returns right and curls upward while the left knee bends and the left arm lengthens down-left. The right knee sinks farther as the right hand rises and the right hand moves left, finishing with both arms opening downward.

The arms move apart and rise together. The right hand sweeps right and curls upward as the left hand drops, then both lower with the right arm opening before both hands return left, the left arm folding and lifting. The right hand rises while the left hand continues left and down; both elbows tuck and the hands climb before the right hand travels right and the left hand returns left. The left arm extends downward as the right elbow opens, then both hands sweep right and curl upward, the right hand moving left. Both arms release into a descending reach, followed by another lift and fold of the right arm and an extension of the left arm. The hands descend again, the left hand sweeping left as the left knee straightens and the left arm lengthens.

A repeated arm exchange begins with the right hand lowering into a curl while the left hand rises right and folds, then the right hand reaches down-left as the left arm opens. Both hands sweep left, the right arm lengthening before the left arm curls upward; the left hand returns right as the right arm folds up-left, both elbows opening again. The arms reverse their lateral directions and exchange height, the left hand dropping as the right arm curls up-right, then extending downward. The right arm tucks through another leftward reach and unfolds back right, joined by the left hand moving right and folding inward. The left hand drops left while the right elbow extends, then reverses right and lifts with a further curl.

To the left, the right hand lowers and lengthens while the left hand moves right with a folding arm. The dancer curls the right arm upward and right as the right knee bends and releases; the left arm opens down-left, then folds into a lift to the right. The left hand sweeps left and drops before rising again with an extension, while the right hand reverses right and climbs into another fold. Both hands descend, then the right hand moves left and both arms tuck inward as the knees soften. The left hand continues left and rises while the right hand lifts higher with a lengthening elbow.

As the left hand rises left and the right hand lifts right, the dancer lowers both hands and straightens the left knee. The right knee softens as the right hand reverses right and the left arm curls upward; both knees extend before the lower hand drops into a fold. The rightward-moving right arm opens down and back left while the left arm curls up and right over another bend of the left knee, then both arms lengthen as the right knee straightens and the right hand lowers. The left hand rises right into a fold, then falls as both knees soften and the left elbow releases; the right hand rises right and tucks, while the left knee straightens again. Both hands sweep left, the left arm opening as the right hand lowers and the right knee extends, then the left hand dips before both rise together with the left elbow folding.

The dancer folds the right arm. The right hand drops and extends left as the left knee straightens, then curls upward while the left hand rises; the left knee softens before the left hand sweeps right and both descend, the right arm opening as the left knee bends further. The hands sweep left together, the left elbow folding as the left knee lengthens, before the right knee releases and the arms separate right and left with the left elbow extending. Both knees bend again as the hands climb, then the right knee straightens while the left arm curls upward and the left knee lengthens. The hands reverse sideways and lower, the left arm opening left as the right knee bends; both rise, the left hand continuing left before reversing right and down as the left knee releases and the right hand climbs farther left. The left arm tucks into a final downward sweep as the right hand lowers and the left knee bends again.

The right knee softens as the left hand moves left and lowers into an extension, while the right arm reaches right and rises. The left hand curls upward and sweeps left with the right knee bending further, then drops as the right knee straightens; the right arm opens downward while the left arm tucks farther. The hands sweep right together, the left arm lifting before both descend and lengthen, then reverse left as the right knee bends and straightens beneath a rising left elbow. The left arm curls higher and opens downward while the right arm lifts, folds and releases, and the left knee straightens. The dancer brings the left hand right and down, bends the right knee as the right arm extends, then lowers the right hand and sends it right while the right knee straightens again.

The right hand rises. The left arm curls upward and right, then the right hand climbs farther as the right knee straightens; both hands sweep left before the left arm unfolds downward and the right hand folds higher to the right. The left arm reaches up-right with a lengthening elbow while the right hand drops, then both climb and extend as the left knee softens and the hands separate left and right. Both arms gather inward and descend, the right knee straightening as the left hand sweeps right and back left against the right hand's leftward reach. The right hand lifts right and returns down-left as the right knee bends and the left arm extends, then they trade height again with the right hand rising into a fold and the left arm reaching right and climbing. The left arm reverses left and drops with an opening elbow while the right hand curls up-right, then both rise as the left arm folds and the right hand returns left.

As the right arm lengthens left and the left arm curls upward, the dancer raises the left hand rightward and folds it into a shared leftward sweep. The right arm tucks as both hands descend and reverse right, then opens downward before lifting left with the left hand. The left hand reverses right as both arms fold and the left knee bends, while the right arm extends down to the left and the bent leg straightens. Both hands rise and the knees soften in succession; the right arm reaches up-right and the left arm opens downward as the legs lengthen. The right hand drops left while the left knee bends and straightens beneath a rising curl, then the lower hand lifts left with a tighter elbow and releases downward as the left arm returns left. The right arm extends right and rises again while the right knee softens and the right hand continues left.

A leftward arm sweep begins as the dancer curls the right hand right and lowers it, then reverses both hands left while the left arm lengthens and the left knee bends. The left hand sweeps up-right, folds back down-left and opens into a lift toward the right as the right knee straightens; the right hand rises before both descend, the right hand moving right. The left arm reaches left, then lifts and tucks as the right hand rises and both knees bend in succession, with the right hand sweeping right and the left hand returning left. Both arms curl upward, the left hand continuing left while the right hand reaches right, then drops as the right knee softens again. The left hand returns right and climbs while the right arm extends downward.

A low, alternating lateral sweep begins as the dancer lifts the right hand right while the left arm folds and moves left; both hands descend before the right arm opens and curls upward. Both arms extend downward, then the left hand sweeps right and back left as the right hand reaches up-right and both elbows fold. The right hand rises left and drops into an extended reach as the right knee bends, then returns up-right while the left arm curls higher. Both knees soften as the left hand travels right and down with an opening elbow, while the right hand reverses left. The left hand climbs farther right as the right knee releases and the right hand sinks, then both hands rise again.

The right hand moves left as the dancer lowers and extends the right arm, then lifts it into a fold while the left elbow bends. The right hand reverses right and opens before curling back left and down alongside the left hand's descent. Both arms lengthen downward, with the left hand sweeping left before returning right as the left knee softens. The left hand sweeps left again and rises into a bend while the right arm tucks higher, then both hands climb as the right bent elbow releases. The right arm folds farther inward as both hands descend, and the right knee straightens while the left elbow draws in.

The right hand rises. The dancer lowers and lengthens the left arm, then sends both hands left before lifting the right hand into a curl while the left drops and extends right. Both arms open downward as the left knee straightens, then the hands reverse toward opposite sides, the right hand rising and folding while the left moves up and left with its elbow tucked. The left hand continues left and down through an extension and renewed fold as the right knee bends, then both hands climb with the left arm opening. The right hand drops right while the left rises left, and the right knee softens further as the left hand descends rightward and both elbows extend. The left knee straightening accompanies the right hand's lift and the left hand's upward-left return.

As the right hand rises leftward, the dancer lowers the left hand, then lifts both while the right hand continues right. The left hand curls upward and returns down-left as the right arm folds and its hand dips; both hands climb again before the left arm extends and drops into a shared leftward sweep, with the right arm opening. The right hand rises while the left hand moves right, then both descend with the right elbow bending and the left arm lengthening. The left arm curls upward as the right hand lifts leftward and tucks, followed by a rightward descent of the left hand. The right arm opens downward as the left hand rises and its knee straightens, then the left arm reaches left while the right arm lengthens farther down.

In opposition, the dancer lifts the right hand right and the left hand left, extending both arms as the right knee bends. The left hand reverses right while the left arm folds down, then both hands drop and sweep left before rising apart, the right hand returning right. The right arm curls down-left while the left arm reaches farther left, then both sweep right with the left arm lengthening as the left knee softens. The left arm lifts and tucks into a descending leftward reach as the right knee straightens; both hands return right and rise, the left arm folding before both elbows open. The right knee bends again as the left hand sweeps left, lowers and rises, ending with the right knee releasing.

The right knee softens as the dancer lifts and lengthens the left arm, then straightens the right knee while both hands move left and the left hand climbs. The right hand drops as the left arm folds right and lowers, with the right knee bending again before both hands sweep right and rise. The right knee releases while the left hand curls down-left, then the left hand moves left and tucks as the right knee bends and straightens; the right arm opens upward while the left arm reaches right and up, followed by the right hand lifting left and folding back right. Both arms curl inward as the knees exchange a bend and release, then the hands separate left and right, the right hand dropping as the right knee softens and both arms extend downward. The right hand reverses left as the left knee straightens, then returns right while the left arm folds left and rises, ending with an extension of the bent right knee and a further lift of the right hand.

The right knee straightens as the dancer sends the right hand right and the left hand left, then lowers both hands with lengthening arms. The left arm folds back toward the right while the right arm continues right and the right knee softens; both hands rise, the right hand curling inward as the right leg extends again. The right arm reaches down and left over a bend in the right knee while the left arm curls upward and the right hand moves right, then returns left into a fold. Both hands climb and shift left before the right arm drops into an extension and the left arm rises again. The left knee bends as the right arm curls up and left and the left hand lifts farther left, then the left hand sweeps right and descends.

The right hand reaches left. The left hand sweeps right as both knees straighten, then the right arm folds upward and right while the left knee softens; the right arm opens as the left knee bends again. The right hand lowers and tucks while the left hand drops, both knees lengthen, and the left hand returns left with a curling elbow. Both hands rise and sweep right before the right arm extends down, the left hand sinks left, and the right knee bends. The right knee releases as the left arm reaches farther down-left, then the left hand lifts into a fold. The left hand rebounds up-right while the right hand shifts left and curls higher, ending with a bend in the right knee.

The right knee bends and releases as the dancer lowers the right hand, then extends both arms left and upward while the left knee straightens. Both hands sweep right, the right hand dropping as the right arm folds, before they reverse left with the right elbow opening and the left hand rising; both knees soften as the hands return right, the left arm curling and descending while the right arm lengthens downward. The right hand rises as the left knee bends farther and the left arm tucks; both hands move right, the left arm climbing and opening as the left knee releases, then reversing left into a deeper fold while the right hand lifts and returns right. The left arm reaches up-right and drops back left while the right arm curls upward and moves right, then opens downward as the right knee softens and both hands sweep left with the lower arm extending. The hands separate right and left, the right hand rising into a fold and returning left as the right knee straightens and the right elbow opens, while the left arm tucks rightward and drops. The right hand climbs again, curls inward and sweeps right as the left arm lengthens, ending with both hands continuing right.

The right knee straightens as the dancer folds the right arm and lifts the right hand, then extends the left arm left while the right hand moves right. The left arm tucks and releases as the left hand lowers into a curl, then both hands rise before the right hand sweeps right and curls upward again. The right hand continues up and right with the right arm lengthening while the left hand drops, then the right hand reverses left and rises as the right knee softens; both arms open before the left hand returns down and right. The right knee straightens while both hands descend, the left hand moving left, then the hands separate again and rise, the left arm folding before the right knee bends once more. Both hands lower with the left arm opening, followed by another lift of the left hand and a bend of the left knee as the right arm gathers inward.

As the right arm folds, the dancer lowers and lengthens the right hand left, then lifts it into a tighter curl while the left hand travels right. The right arm opens down-left as the left knee bends, then both hands descend before the left arm reaches up-right; the right hand follows upward and right with an extending elbow. Both arms fold downward, the right hand sweeping left as the left hand curls up-right and back left over a bending knee, then rises farther right and opens while the right arm tucks again. The right hand climbs and extends left as the right knee straightens, then both knees soften while the left arm reaches up-left and folds inward. The right knee releases beneath a descending leftward sweep of the right hand, which continues low and left as the left hand drops and the right knee bends once more.

The right hand sweeps left and upward. The left hand follows, then both lower as the right arm opens; they sweep right with the left hand rising into a curl while the right arm folds and the right knee softens. The hands reverse left together, then separate again, the right hand dropping into an extension as the left knee bends and the left arm reaches down-right before returning left. Both hands rise, the right elbow tucking as the left arm lengthens, then the hands separate right and left before the right arm lowers and opens and the left arm curls up-right. The right hand rises and falls as the left elbow extends, then both hands lift, the left arm folding before opening downward while the right hand moves right and down. The left hand climbs farther as the right knee straightens, and both hands continue right.

The right arm curls upward, then opens down and right while the left hand rises left. The left hand sweeps down to the right while the right knee bends, then reverses left as the left arm curls up and releases downward. Both hands descend, the right elbow tucks again, and the hands separate right and left. Both arms lengthen, the right hand rising before dropping and returning right against the left hand's leftward sweep, which ends in a curl as the right knee softens. The right hand drops and opens while the left knee bends and straightens beneath another upward-left reach. Both elbows fold and release as the knees soften, then the right hand rises and extends right while the left hand lifts left and lowers. The left hand dips left and rebounds upward with an opening elbow, while the right knee bends and the right hand shifts right, then both hands descend as the right knee straightens. The right knee lengthens as the right hand reaches farther left, then the left hand lifts and returns left with a bent elbow while the right hand folds and lowers.

A rising, sweeping arm figure begins as the dancer lifts the left hand left and the right hand right, then folds both arms while the right hand reverses right. The left knee straightens as the right arm opens down-left, followed by the right hand dropping and extending. Both hands sweep right, the left arm curling upward before lengthening into a shared descent; the right arm then reaches up-right as the right knee softens. The left hand continues right and rises while the right elbow folds and the left knee straightens, then both knees bend as the right hand lowers and extends right and the left hand drops. The left hand returns left as the knees straighten in succession, while the right arm curls upward and right.

As the left arm folds and the right hand rises, the dancer lowers the left arm left while the right knee straightens. The right hand climbs as the right knee bends and releases again; both hands descend with a rightward sweep of the right arm, then the right arm reaches up-left before folding down-right as the right knee softens. The left arm curls upward, followed by the left hand lifting left as the right knee bends deeper and the left knee extends. Both arms lengthen downward, the right hand moving right as the right knee releases and the left arm opens farther. The left hand lifts left while the right arm sweeps right and curls upward, then they separate left and right with the right arm extending and the left elbow opening. The hands drop and reverse their lateral directions, and the right arm folds as the right knee straightens before both knees soften.

As the right arm lengthens and its hand drops, the dancer carries it right and up into a fold while the left arm reaches left, then lowers and extends as both hands descend. The right arm opens left and lifts with another bend, followed by the left hand rising into a curl. Both arms tuck again and release downward before the left hand moves right and folds upward; the right arm bends, opens down and left, then curls up and right as the left arm reaches higher to the right. The hands lower together, the left elbow folding while the right arm extends farther left. The right knee softens as the left-moving hand climbs into a tighter curl and the right elbow bends more deeply, then the right knee straightens as the hands separate left and right with the left arm extending.

As the right hand sweeps left, the dancer straightens the left knee and extends both arms, then lowers the right hand farther while the right arm folds. The left hand rises rightward into a curl as the right hand returns right, then climbs higher with its elbow tucking further before opening downward. The right arm reaches left while the left hand moves right and lifts, then reverses left and curls upward as the left arm folds down. Both hands sweep right, the left arm releasing downward and lengthening while the right elbow opens. The left hand continues down to the right as the right hand drops, finishing with another fold of the right arm.

The dancer lifts the left hand leftward, then sends it right and back left while the right arm curls upward. The left arm folds higher as both hands move left, then the right arm opens before both arms gather inward and descend together. Both hands sweep right, the right arm rising with a tighter tuck as the left arm lengthens downward; they reverse left, the right arm descending and unfolding. The left hand returns right and rises against the right arm's leftward reach, then both sweep left and descend as the right elbow curls and the left hand reverses right. Both arms draw inward and lift together, continuing right with the right hand climbing higher.

One knee straightens as the dancer lowers and lengthens both arms, then folds the left hand while the right arm extends right. The left hand rises and opens as the right hand curls upward, then the left hand drops with a renewed tuck while the right hand reaches down and left. Both hands sweep right with lengthening arms, reverse left together, and climb into bent elbows before returning right, the right hand lifting farther. The right hand sweeps left again as both arms fold and descend, then the right hand opens into a final lift to the right while the left hand rises.

As the right arm curls upward, the dancer raises and folds the left hand, then sends both hands right with the right arm lengthening. The left knee straightens as the left hand climbs left into a tighter curl and the left leg extends further, before both elbows open and the right hand lowers right. The left arm tucks again while the right hand rises, then both descend, the right hand reaching left as the left knee bends. Both arms curl upward with the left knee releasing and the left hand moving left; the right hand follows left before dropping and extending right as the knees soften in succession. The right elbow draws in while the left hand rises, dips and curls back up to the right, finishing with a bend of the right knee.

To begin, the dancer lowers and lengthens the right arm while folding the left arm leftward. The left hand sweeps right as both hands descend and the left arm opens, then curls upward to the left before releasing downward.
