The left hand moves right and tucks again as the right knee softens and the right arm folds up-left. The rising right hand continues left and reaches higher before returning right with an opening elbow, then drops and curls back left. The right hand repeats a lift-right descent-left sweep twice more, finishing with a low reach right.

The right hand drops left. The dancer lifts the left hand right and lowers it as the right knee straightens, then curls both elbows while the right hand rises and the left hand moves left. Both hands descend with opening arms, the right hand sweeping left and back right into a shared lift, followed by the left hand rising and tucking as the left knee bends. The left arm extends downward as the right hand drops left and the right knee lengthens, then the left hand reverses left and curls upward. The right arm folds as both hands sweep right, its elbow releases and the left hand dips before rising again.

The right hand reaches right and lowers. The left hand moves left while the right arm folds, then both hands rise as the right arm opens and the left arm curls inward; the right arm sweeps right and returns left. Both arms tuck as the right hand drops farther right and the left hand descends into an extension, before the right hand rises with a lengthening elbow. The right hand falls again while the left arm curls upward and carries the left hand right, then the left hand swings left and rises into a bend. The right arm opens downward, joins the left arm in folding, and lifts once more.

The right knee softens as the dancer lowers and extends both arms, then raises the left hand while the right hand travels right and down. The left arm curls upward and sweeps right before dropping and opening, joined by the right hand moving left and down. Both hands climb with bent elbows, the left hand continuing left and folding inward while the right opens downward. The right arm reaches up and left as the left extends farther left, then folds again while the right hand drops. Both hands continue lowering, with the left arm tucking further and the right extending toward the right.

As the right knee bends and straightens, the dancer folds both arms, lifting the right hand rightward while the left hand climbs left. The right arm lengthens downward as the right knee softens and the left hand drops left; the left arm tucks and moves right before opening into a shared lift. The left hand returns left as the right arm continues upward, then lowers and curls while the left elbow draws inward. Both hands sweep right with folded arms, the right hand climbing and opening as the left hand descends; the left hand reverses left as the right arm curls again. Both hands rise once more, the left hand moving right while the right hand shifts left.

The right hand reaches right and down. The dancer curls the left arm upward, then lowers it as the right hand moves left and rises with a fold; both elbows open before the left hand climbs again and the right hand returns right. Both arms tuck inward as the left hand dips, then the left hand rises while the right hand sweeps left and drops into an extended reach. The left arm lengthens downward, folds back up, and carries the left hand left as the right hand rises with a tucked elbow. The right hand continues left and down while the left hand curls higher, then the left hand lifts and the right hand follows upward into a shared descent. The right hand drops left as the left hand swings right and curls upward, then both rise with the left elbow folding and the left hand returning left.

A rising-and-falling arm exchange begins with the right hand moving left as the left arm lengthens and the right knee straightens; both hands descend, then sweep right before lifting and returning left. The right hand curls up and down twice, joined by the left hand's downward extension, while the left knee softens and the left arm folds. The right arm opens upward and the left arm reaches higher to the right, then both elbows bend and their hands drop before the left hand sweeps left and rises again. Both arms extend and lower, the right hand moving right as the left hand returns left, before they curl upward and separate right and left. The left arm tucks farther and moves right while the right hand lifts and drops into an extended reach to the right.

At the outset, the dancer curls the right arm upward and right while the left hand sweeps left, then both lower as the left arm opens and the left knee softens. Both hands reverse sideways, the right arm extending down before curling up again; the left knee straightens as the left arm folds downward, and the right hand rises right over a bending right knee. The hands sweep left, the right arm lengthening down before both hands return right with the left elbow tucking, then rise together as the right knee bends and releases and the right hand drops left into a fold. Both arms draw inward as the knees soften, then the left hand climbs right while the right hand continues left and down; the knees straighten in succession as the hands separate and the right arm extends farther. The right hand reverses right and lifts while the left hand moves left and up, then both descend with opening elbows and their hands separate again as the left knee bends.

The right hand sweeps right and up while the left hand rises left. Then both hands reverse sideways and descend into lengthened arms. The right hand climbs again while the left hand extends farther down, followed by a deeper drop of the left hand and another upward reach from the right hand. The right hand sweeps left and curls in as the left hand drops right, then returns right and opens downward while the left hand lifts and tucks. Both hands swing left and descend before the right arm reaches right and rises. The left hand climbs left as the right arm folds, then both sweep right and rise before the right arm drops and opens left alongside the left hand's descent. Both hands continue left and climb, the left hand curling before lowering as the right hand moves right and down. The left arm releases while the right hand tucks, then both lift with the left elbow opening as the left knee bends.

The dancer sweeps the right hand right. The left arm folds down and right while the right hand returns left, then both hands reverse left and rise with the left arm curling higher. The left arm opens as both hands continue left and descend, then the left arm reverses right with a bend before returning left into a tuck. The right arm curls upward while the left elbow opens and the left knee softens; the right arm releases downward and extends farther as the left knee straightens and the right hand rises. The right hand drops, lengthens further, and moves right while the left hand travels left.

The right hand sweeps left and down. The dancer lifts both hands, then lowers the left hand while the right arm extends right and curls back in as the left arm opens. The left arm folds upward and releases downward, followed by the right hand rising and falling with an unfolding elbow. The right arm tucks again as the left arm reaches higher and farther right, then drops with a deeper fold before lengthening. Both hands rise into bent elbows, the right hand continuing right and climbing alongside the left hand, which also moves right.

Upward, the right hand rises with a bent elbow while the left arm folds and lifts, then both hands lower. The right hand sweeps left as the right knee straightens and the left arm extends upward, before both hands climb again; the left knee bends and releases as the arms lengthen and descend together. The right hand moves right while the left hand continues down and the left knee softens, then the left hand reverses left as the right knee bends and the hands rise, the left hand sweeping right. Both hands drop and the elbows open, followed by another lift as the left knee straightens. The left hand returns left and lowers into a deeper fold while the right arm curls upward, then both extend downward.

Lowering both hands, the dancer sends the right hand right and the left hand left while lengthening the right arm; both knees straighten before the left hand drops farther. The right hand reverses left as the right knee bends and then extends, while the left elbow folds and opens and the left knee softens. The hands exchange directions again, with the right hand rising into a curl as the right knee straightens, while the left arm tucks left and the right knee bends and releases beneath an opening arm. The hands climb together as the left knee bends, then the left hand returns right while the right arm folds and the right knee sinks; the left arm curls upward as the left knee releases. The raised hand sweeps left and down, opens over a softened knee, and rises again as its knee extends and the opposite arm draws inward.

As the right hand curls up-right, the dancer opens the left arm and lowers it, then repeats the curling lift with the right hand while the left elbow folds, releases and tucks again. The left hand rises into a fold as the right hand extends down-left, then reverses right into another tucked lift while the left arm lengthens downward. Both hands sweep left and descend, then reverse right as the arms open; the right hand lifts again and returns left while the left elbow bends. The left arm carries its hand left, down and back right into a longer reach before curling upward and extending once more, accompanied by the right hand's descending sweep left and the right hand's rightward descent. The right arm folds and lowers as the left hand swings right, then both rise together while the right elbow opens and the left hand returns left.

The right hand travels left and curls upward. The dancer lengthens the left arm down and right, then lifts it as the right hand lowers; both hands sweep right before the left hand drops and returns left. The left arm extends downward while the right elbow folds, the right hand rises and reaches farther right, and the left hand follows right with a curling lift. The right hand descends and opens, followed by the left hand dropping into an extension; the left arm tucks and releases again as both hands move right, then the right hand reverses left and lowers. The right hand climbs while the left arm curls up and left, then the left arm opens right as the right hand continues left and descends.

The right hand travels right and folds back left, followed by the left hand moving right. The right arm lengthens as both hands rise, then lowers with a deeper tuck while the left arm curls upward. Both arms extend downward, the right hand sweeping left and the left hand following that direction.

One knee bends and straightens as the dancer folds both arms, lowering one hand before both hands rise and separate right and left. The left-moving arm opens downward while the other hand lifts leftward into a curl, then the lowered hand rises as its opposite continues left and down with an extending elbow. Both hands descend, the curled arm lengthening farther as the other arm reaches left, then they reverse sideways and climb together. That raised hand drops left while the other moves right, and the left-moving arm tucks as its knee softens.

The right hand curls upward and right as the left knee straightens, then drops while the right hand returns left into a fold; the left arm opens down-left as the left knee softens. Both arms lengthen downward with the right hand continuing left, before the hands rise and separate sideways, the right hand curling up-right as the left knee bends deeper and the left hand lowers through an extension. The right arm unfolds and drops as both knees straighten, then both hands sweep left and climb with the left arm folding; they reverse right as the left knee softens and the right leg lengthens. The hands descend and swing left together as the left leg extends, then both rise and return right with the right knee bending and straightening again. The right hand dips and rebounds upward while the left hand climbs farther right and folds, followed by a bend of the left knee and another lift of the right hand. The right hand drops and sweeps right as the left knee extends, then curls up-right while the left hand continues rising and travels left.

A low sweep of opposing arm reaches begins with the left hand dropping left while the right hand lowers and extends right; the right knee beneath the left-moving hand bends, then straightens as the left hand rises. Both hands reverse sideways, the left hand curling left and up before returning down-right against the right hand's rising leftward reach, which continues upward. The left hand folds higher and tucks farther in as both knees soften, then drops while the right hand swings right and back left. The bent knees release in succession as the left arm lengthens downward and the right knee sinks again; the lower hand sweeps right and climbs while the right hand returns left. The raised arm curls into a further lift as its knee softens, then opens downward and right alongside the other hand's descent.

The knees join a leg-and-arm phrase: the dancer bends the right knee as both hands sweep left, then straightens the right knee while the left hand moves right and the right hand returns left. The hands reverse sideways as the knees exchange their bend, then the right hand curls upward and both arms draw inward before the right hand drops. Both arms open downward, with the right hand moving right, then rise as the left knee bends; the right hand lifts again while the left arm reaches farther right. The left hand sweeps up-left as the left knee softens, then drops and reverses right, joined by the right hand, whose right knee bends and releases. The left arm folds left as the left knee lengthens, while the right hand continues right and rises.

As the right arm lengthens downward, the dancer raises the left hand left and folds it back right, then lowers both hands into a shared extension. The right hand sweeps left as the right knee straightens, then both arms curl upward before the left hand drops left and the right hand moves right. The left hand rises while the right elbow opens and tucks again, followed by another lift of the left arm as the left knee softens. The right arm reaches down and left, then extends upward as the right knee releases and the left arm curls higher; the right hand returns right while the left arm opens and falls, with both knees bending and releasing in succession. The right knee sinks as the left arm folds, then straightens again while the right hand travels left and up; the left knee bends and releases as the right hand lowers and sweeps right.

The dancer lowers the right hand. The left arm extends down-left as the right hand rises, then both hands sweep right before the left hand reverses left and curls upward while the right hand returns left. Both arms lengthen downward, the right hand reaching right as the left knee softens; the right hand then lifts into a fold while the left arm sweeps right and rises. The left arm opens down-right as the left knee straightens, then curls upward while the left knee bends again; the right hand drops and extends as the left arm tucks more tightly. The left knee straightens beneath a rising right hand that lengthens, while the left arm curls up-right and then opens downward; the right hand reaches left and falls as the left elbow folds again.

The knees straighten as the right hand sweeps right and down with a folding arm, then both hands move left, the left hand lifting into an extension while the right arm opens. The left hand reverses right as the right knee softens and the right arm folds and drops; both hands continue right before the right arm reaches up-left and the right knee bends further. The left arm curls upward and right while the right knee sinks farther, then the left hand returns left and the right knee straightens. The left arm lengthens downward and swings right before curling back left and rising as the right knee bends again. The right hand rises into a tuck, followed by the left hand climbing as the right knee extends. Both hands descend, the left hand moving left and opening while the right arm folds more tightly.

In opposition, the dancer lifts the right hand while lowering and extending the left hand toward the left. The raised right arm curls upward as the lower left arm folds, then both hands sweep right and descend, with the curled right arm opening. The initial right hand returns left into a fold while the left arm reaches up-left and tucks; the right hand rises before both arms lengthen downward. The right hand sweeps right as the left hand moves left, then the right hand reverses right and lifts against the left hand's rising leftward reach. Both hands return left, the right arm folding downward as the left arm opens higher, then the left hand extends farther down.

The right knee straightens as the dancer folds the right arm and lifts the right hand left, then extends the right arm down while the left hand moves right. The hands reverse inward, the right arm curling upward as both knees bend. The right arm reaches farther up-left before lowering and opening, followed by the left hand dropping into a fold. The left hand swings right and back left as the right hand rises, with the left knee extending; the hands separate again, the right hand moving right while the left arm lengthens downward. Both hands lift and sweep left, the left elbow drawing in, before the right hand returns right and both lower, the left arm releasing open.

As the right knee bends, the dancer lowers both hands and carries them left with the left arm folding, then sends them right into a shared rise. The right hand drops while the right arm curls farther, then rises again as the left hand moves left. The right knee straightens beneath a continuing leftward reach of the right arm, which folds as the left arm lengthens; both knees soften before the right straightens again and the left arm opens downward. Both knees bend and release in succession while the left hand reaches up and left, then the right knee sinks beneath another upward curl of the right arm. The right hand sweeps right and down with an extended elbow as the left knee straightens and the left arm tucks inward.

The dancer lengthens the left arm leftward as the right knee straightens and the right hand moves right, then lowers the left arm while the right arm reaches right and up; the left hand sweeps down-left before both arms rise. The hands exchange left and right as the right knee softens and the raised left arm folds, then the left arm reverses right and tucks farther while the right elbow opens. The tucked left arm lifts and extends over a deeper right knee bend, then drops and curls back right as the right arm lengthens upward and the bent right knee releases. Both arms open into another shared lift, with the left hand continuing right and higher, then folding back left over a softening right knee as the right hand lowers and extends. The left hand rises farther right while the right hand sweeps right, down and left, then the knees exchange their bend-and-release pattern twice as the right arm curls up-right and the left hand drops left, finally extending over another knee bend.

The right hand rises. The dancer lifts the left arm and carries it right, then opens both elbows as the right hand continues upward and sweeps left. Both hands descend, with the right-moving arm curling into a renewed lift while the left hand reaches farther down to the left. The right hand drops and extends as the left hand swings right, then returns left and up into a fold while the right arm tucks and moves right. The hands separate again, the left hand continuing left as the right hand climbs right.

At the outset, the dancer lowers the right hand and extends both arms, then lifts both arms as the right knee straightens. The left hand drops and curls rightward while the right arm folds upward and left, followed by a leftward rise of the left hand into a tuck. Both hands descend and reach right, the right arm opening before the left elbow folds again. The right hand sweeps up-left and down-right as the left knee bends, then the right hand reverses left with the left knee softening while the left arm reaches right. Both hands climb and sweep left, the left knee extending as the right elbow folds; the hands separate right and left before the right hand drops.

Leftward, the dancer carries both hands with the left arm folding and the right arm lengthening; the left hand rises as the left knee softens. The right hand climbs while the left arm opens down to the left, then curls upward again as the left knee bends further. The left arm extends farther up-left while the right knee straightens, then folds back down-right as the right hand lowers and the right knee releases. The right arm tucks through a right-to-left sweep that reverses right, joined by the left hand curling inward as the left knee straightens. Both arms draw in farther, the right hand continuing left before the left hand reaches left and down, then returns right and rises into a fold.

The right hand sweeps right and down. The left hand reaches left, then returns right as the right arm folds upward toward the left; both hands rise and reverse outward before the right arm tucks more tightly and lowers. The right hand curls up to the right as the left knee straightens, the left hand drops and swings left while the right knee softens, then rises again with an unfolding elbow. The right hand descends farther right as the left hand travels left and up, both knees lengthen in succession, and the left arm opens downward and extends left over a renewed bend of the right knee. The right arm curls up to join the left arm's lift, then both elbows open as their hands separate sideways; the left hand dips and rebounds while the right hand lowers into a fold. Both arms curl inward, the right hand rising as the left knee bends and the left hand moves right, before both descend and the right hand reverses left.

The arms exchange height: the right hand rises left while the left hand lowers right. The left arm lengthens and lifts left, followed by the right hand reaching up-right. Both hands sweep right; the right arm curls upward before reversing left as the left hand drops and opens. They return left together: the right arm drops and unfolds while the left arm folds again. The dancer finishes by lifting the right hand rightward into a fold and extending it down as the left hand rises.

As both hands descend, the dancer lowers the right arm into a fold and carries it right while the left hand continues down. The folded right arm lifts toward the left as the left elbow bends more deeply, then the hands sweep left before the lifted right hand drops and the left hand curls upward. Both arms tuck through another exchange of height, the right hand moving right and rising into a bend while the left hand travels left and down. The rightward-moving right hand climbs again as the left hand extends, then sweeps left and curls back down while the left hand rises. The curling right arm reaches farther left and lengthens downward, followed by a drop of the left hand.

The dancer curls the right arm upward. The left hand rises, folds, and drops while the right hand lowers and the right knee softens; both arms then open as the right knee straightens, with the left hand continuing downward. The right hand climbs into a bend and sinks left as the left arm curls up and right, then the hands separate left and right before reversing sideways and rising together. Both arms fold into a shared drop, then the right hand sweeps right and curls upward while the left hand travels left and lifts with an opening elbow; both descend and lengthen before the right arm tucks again and carries the right hand higher. The right hand continues right as the left knee bends and the left arm reaches left and down, then the raised hand reverses left and drops with a lengthening arm while the lower hand moves right.

The dancer folds the right arm through a rightward lift, leftward descent, and return to the right as the left hand moves left. Both hands rise with the right hand curling in, then the left hand follows up before the right hand lowers and extends left while the left hand folds down to the right. The right arm curls upward again as the left hand opens down and left, then both reach higher with the left elbow tucking. The left arm lowers farther left while the right hand reaches down and right; both elbows open and the hands reverse inward before the left hand lifts right and the right hand rises left into a tighter fold. The right hand drops and unfolds while the left hand sweeps left and down, then curls upward.

The right knee softens and straightens as the dancer lowers the left hand and extends the left arm left, then carries both hands right with another bend of the right knee. The right hand returns left while the left arm folds and lifts, the right knee lengthening before bending again; the left knee also bends as the lifted left hand dips and rebounds into a leftward extension. The right knee straightens beneath an upward reach of the right arm, which then curls back down and right while the reaching left hand drops left and reverses right, opening before folding again. The left knee bends further as both arms tuck and sweep left, the lower right hand rising, then both elbows release and the knees lengthen in succession. The lower right hand climbs right with a brief fold and renewed extension, then falls into a deeper curl while the left hand sweeps left and up with a tighter elbow. The lowered right arm opens right and lifts once more.

The dancer separates the hands: the right arm curls upward and right as the left knee bends, then the right hand drops and opens while the left arm lifts left. The left arm folds downward and sweeps right over a softened right knee, returning left as the right leg straightens; both arms lengthen before the right hand reverses right and rises into another curl. The left knee bends again beneath a descending right hand that reaches left and opens, while the right elbow tucks and the right knee extends. The right arm curls upward to the right over another bend of the right knee, then falls and releases as the left hand moves right and up with an opening elbow. Both knees straighten in succession while the rightward-reaching left arm folds down and left, and the right hand drops before rising with a bent elbow.

The right knee softens as the dancer lowers and extends the left arm right, then opens and lifts the left hand left while the right hand curls upward; the left hand continues down and left before both arms fold and descend. Both knees bend further as the hands separate right and left and rise, the right arm opening and lowering into a shared rightward sweep while the left arm folds higher over its straightening right knee and returns left. The lower hand rises with an extending elbow as the other drops, and the knee beneath the rising hand bends again while the other leg lengthens; the raised arm tucks, sweeps left and down, then opens back right. That knee straightens as the opposite hand reaches up-right and the other arm curls up-left, followed by another lift of the opposite hand with a folding elbow and a deeper bend in the initial knee. Both arms open downward and separate right and right, then return left with the opposite arm tucked, and the initial knee straightens while its hand curls upward. The initial hand dips and extends right as the other climbs left, then both rise with the initial arm folded and the other opening.

To begin, the dancer folds the right arm as the right knee straightens and both hands move right, then lowers the right hand while the left hand curls up-left. The right arm opens into a rising leftward sweep as the left knee bends, then reverses down-right into a fold while the left hand drops and both knees soften. Both hands return left with the left hand lifting, then descend again as the right knee extends and the left arm tucks. The right hand rises and sweeps right against the left arm's continued descent, before the right arm lengthens downward. Both hands continue right with a deeper dip of the left arm, then climb together as the left knee bends and the right arm curls.

The right hand rises left. The left hand follows left as the right arm lengthens downward and the left arm curls upward, then both hands descend before the right arm tucks up and right and the left arm opens down and left. The right arm sweeps down-left as the right knee straightens, then reaches up-right while the left elbow folds and releases; the right arm curls again as the left hand drops and rebounds, with the left hand continuing right. Both arms open downward, the right hand returning left before they fold and rise, then spread apart as the right knee softens and both elbows release into a descending reach. The right hand returns left while the left hand travels right, then the right arm folds and drops as the left arm curls up and left over a bent knee. The right elbow opens and refolds while the right knee bends further and the left hand lifts, then both knees extend and the right arm releases leftward.

The dancer lifts both hands. The right arm folds as the right hand travels right, then extends down while the left hand climbs left; the right arm curls up and opens again, followed by the left hand dropping and rising into a reach. The right arm tucks left as the left arm folds upward, then both hands lift before the left arm lengthens down and right and the right arm drops into an extension. Both arms curl upward as the right knee straightens, then the right hand moves left while the left elbow releases downward and the left knee softens; the right arm opens down and left as the left knee bends farther and the left hand rises into a fold. The right hand climbs into a tighter tuck as the right knee straightens and the left hand sweeps left, then the hands exchange height with the right hand folding higher and the left hand lowering. The right arm reaches down and left while the left knee lengthens and the left hand moves right, then both elbows draw inward as the right hand rises and the left knee softens.

To begin, the dancer folds the right arm while the left hand drops right and curls upward, then both hands sweep left as the right arm opens. The left knee softens as the left arm reaches down-right and the right elbow tucks, followed by a rightward lift of the right hand and an extension of the left leg as the left hand rises. Both knees bend in succession while the hands descend, the left arm lengthening as the left knee releases; the right arm opens downward before curling back up and left over another left knee bend. The curled left hand dips and rebounds into an extension as the right knee straightens and the left knee bends again. The rebounding left arm folds more deeply and moves right as the right hand lowers over its bending right knee, then returns left and extends farther left while the right arm tucks and lifts. The right arm continues reaching left as the left hand travels right and rises with a deeper curl.

The right hand rises with a folding elbow. The dancer sends the right hand left as the left hand lifts, then lowers both hands while lengthening the right arm and drawing the left knee farther in. The right hand curls upward to the right, followed by the left hand reaching right, before the right arm opens down-left and the left hand returns left with its elbow tucked. The left hand drops and sweeps right as the right arm reaches up-right, then both hands descend and the right arm folds back left while the left hand extends right. Both arms open and the hands rise, the right hand continuing left as the left hand moves right; they lower and reverse sideways, the right hand returning right and curling upward. The left hand follows upward and left into a fold as the right hand returns left and tucks further.

The right knee straightens as the dancer curls both hands up, then lowers them into a reach to the right, the right arm opening while the left arm tucks. The left hand lifts left as the left knee bends and releases, followed by the right knee softening; both arms curl upward before the left hand returns down-right and extends. The right arm reaches up-left as the right knee lengthens, then folds back down-right and opens again while the right hand rises left, the right knee bending and releasing. Both knees soften as the hands separate sideways and lower, then the right hand climbs into a curl while the left knee straightens and the right hand reverses right. The left knee bends again as the right arm opens downward, and the right hand moves left into a fold while the left hand sweeps right.

The arms exchange height in a rising-and-falling gesture: the right hand lowers while the left hand rises, then both hands move right with the right arm extending and curling back up. The left arm reaches farther right as the right knee straightens, then the left arm folds downward while the right hand climbs left and the right knee softens. The right hand drops again as the left arm opens and lifts left, the right knee lengthening before both hands descend and the right arm curls upward. Both arms tuck as the knees bend further, then the hands sweep right, the right arm opening down and the left arm folding higher. The left knee extends as the left hand moves left, while the right arm reaches right; the right knee beneath it bends and releases, then both arms draw inward and lift as the left knee softens and straightens.

At the outset, the right hand rises while the left hand travels left and curls upward. The right arm folds right, then opens as the left hand drops and extends right before reversing left into a fold. The left folded hand lowers again while the right hand reaches down to the right. Both hands lift, the rightward-reaching arm curling farther before they descend together.

At the outset, the dancer extends the right arm right and down while the left hand rises left. The hands reverse inward as the right arm curls upward, then both sweep right and lower with the right arm opening before it folds back left. The right arm lifts into a longer reach as the left hand climbs right and returns left, then they separate right and left with the left hand rising and curling before reversing again. Both arms lengthen downward, then the hands climb apart, the right arm folding left while the left hand moves right. The right hand continues its path as the left arm tucks left, then reverses right alongside it.

The right knee straightens as the dancer folds the right arm and sends the right hand left, while the left hand sweeps right. The right arm releases downward and opens toward the right before curling back left; both hands rise and sweep left together. Both arms lengthen downward as the left knee bends and the right knee softens, then the right hand returns right and curls upward while the left arm rises into a fold. The right hand climbs farther as the right knee straightens, then lowers with an opening elbow while the left arm extends down and left. Both hands continue left, the left hand lifting as the left knee bends, then descending into a longer reach while the right arm tucks again.

As the right arm curls upward, the dancer raises the left hand, then sweeps both hands left and down, folding the left elbow before opening both arms. The hands continue left as the right knee bends and the left hand reverses right; the right arm lengthens farther downward while the right knee straightens, then both hands lift with a deeper curl of the left arm and a bend of the right knee. Both hands descend and sweep right with extended elbows, then rise into folded arms as the right leg straightens and the left knee softens. The hands drop, the right arm opens, and both sweep left with the left elbow tucked; the right hand returns right as the left hand rises left, then folds down and moves left again while the left knee bends. The hands separate sideways and climb with bent elbows, the right hand reversing right as the left knee straightens and the right knee sinks further. The right hand lowers and extends through another left-to-right reversal while the left hand lifts rightward, then both hands move right and the left knee releases.

To begin, the dancer curls the right arm upward while the left hand rises rightward and the left knee straightens. The right hand drops left as the left arm climbs farther right, then both arms open before the hands reverse sideways and descend, the left arm folding as the left knee bends. The left arm reaches right again while the right elbow opens; the left knee releases and both hands lift, the right hand moving left into a curl as the left arm lengthens downward. Both knees soften as the right arm extends down and left, then both hands sweep right with the left elbow tucking and the right hand rising before the hands return left. The left hand lowers, opens and curls upward once more as the left knee bends deeper, then both knees straighten while the hands separate left and right and the right arm draws inward.

The right hand curls upward while the left hand drops. Both hands rise and sweep right as the left hand lengthens. The right arm folds into a leftward return. Both hands descend and reverse right; the right arm extends as the left hand tucks in. Both hands lift; the left hand opens toward the right while the right hand curls downward. The hands separate left and right, then return together left and lower. The left hand reverses right as the left arm unfolds, then rises again with an extending elbow while the right hand lifts and falls. The right arm continues left and down, finishing by curling back up.

At the outset, the dancer folds the right arm while lowering and extending the left arm toward the right. The right arm opens left as the right knee bends, then curls upward and releases again. The right hand rises once more with a tighter tuck before sweeping down-left as the left hand lifts and extends right. The right arm draws inward again while the right knee straightens, then lengthens downward as the right knee softens. The left hand reaches farther right, then both hands sweep left together.

As the right hand rises left, the dancer bends the left knee and opens both arms, carrying the rising right hand right as the left knee straightens. The hands sweep left together, then descend into a deeper fold on the right arm's side while the left knee softens further; the left arm extends and curls upward to the right as the bent left knee releases. Both hands climb, the right arm lengthening before both elbows tuck, then they separate right and left and lower as the knees soften in succession. The right hand continues left while the left hand travels right and rises, then the right arm reaches up-right and folds back down-left as both knees straighten and the left hand drops. The hands trade sideways directions twice, with the right arm opening and closing between them while the left elbow briefly lengthens, then both knees bend as the right hand moves right and the left hand drops left. The right knee releases as both hands sweep left and rise, the left elbow extending before curling again over another bend of that same right knee.

As the right arm curls upward, the dancer sweeps both hands right, then lowers them and lifts again, folding the left arm. The right hand reverses left as the right knee straightens and the left knee bends; both elbows draw inward before the knees exchange their bend and extension, with the right hand sinking farther as the left hand drops. Both hands sweep right while the left knee softens, then the left hand rises into a curl and returns left as the right hand climbs and folds. The right arm reaches up-right while the left hand drops and moves right, then opens left and rises as the left knee bends; the right hand dips and rebounds before both arms fold and lift, the right elbow releasing. Both hands descend as the left knee extends, then climb with the right arm lengthening while the left arm tucks and both knees soften. The right knee straightens beneath another rising curl, and the left hand travels left.

A sweeping arm exchange begins as the dancer lowers the right hand, then curls both hands upward, carrying them right before folding the left arm down-left. The right arm extends down-left and reaches up-right while the left arm tucks into a rising rightward sweep, then returns left as the right arm drops left and curls up-right again. Both arms lengthen downward, then fold toward the right; the left knee bends as the left arm opens and the right hand rises with an extending elbow, followed by another bend in the left knee. The right hand descends and moves left while the left arm draws inward and climbs, then the right hand lifts and both hands shift right. The right knee softens beneath a folded hand that sweeps left and back right, accompanied by a bend in the left knee; the left hand follows left as the right leg straightens and the right hand rises, then the left hand returns right and up with the left knee bending further.

To begin, the dancer lifts both hands rightward as the right knee straightens and the left arm curls upward. Both hands sweep left, the left arm opening before folding again as the right hand returns right; the left knee bends while the left folded arm rises and tucks farther. The right hand dips left and rebounds right with a deeper curl as the right knee lengthens, then drops into an extension while the right knee softens and the left arm opens down-right. The right hand reverses up-left with a bend of the right knee, then returns right and down as the right leg straightens; the left hand sweeps left and lowers through another right knee bend and release. The left hand continues left and up against the right hand's rightward rise, then both reverse sideways and descend with elbows opening, the right arm extending farther as the right knee bends.

An alternating arm sweep begins as the right hand drops, rises, and folds into a rightward reach while the left hand lowers and extends left. The right arm opens down to the left, then curls upward and sweeps right as the left arm lifts left; both elbows tuck before the right-moving hand returns left and descends with an opening elbow. Both hands rise again, the returning hand drifting farther left and curling inward, while the left hand continues right and folds. That rightward hand dips and rebounds into a higher reach as the left arm opens down and left, then both arms draw inward as the hands separate left and right. The left-moving hand climbs with its elbow folding while the right hand descends, and the climbing arm releases downward.

The dancer lifts the right hand. The left arm curls upward as the right knee bends and both hands descend, with the left elbow opening before the left hand rises again and the right leg lengthens. Both arms tuck into a shared leftward sweep, then the right arm extends downward while the left opens and lowers; the right knee softens further as the right hand climbs and both elbows fold. The right arm releases right while the left continues down, then the lower hand reverses left and both rise, curling inward before the right hand drops and unfolds. The left hand reaches farther left as the right hand follows in that direction, both lowering with extended arms.

A rising-and-falling arm exchange begins as the right hand climbs left and the left hand curls upward, then both descend, the left hand moving right. The right hand reverses right and rises into a fold while the left arm extends left; both hands lower and the right hand sweeps left as the right knee softens, before the hands climb again with the left elbow tucked. The arms open downward, the right hand continuing left while the left elbow draws inward, then both lift and lengthen as the right knee straightens. The hands separate right and left, rise with folded elbows, then reverse sideways as the right knee bends and releases. Both arms curl upward and sweep left, then descend with the elbows opening. The right hand returns right while the left hand continues down-left and folds, finishing with an upward lift of the right arm.

A rising arm sweep begins with the left hand lifting left while the right hand moves right, then both descend as the left hand reverses right and the right hand curls upward. Both hands climb again, the right hand continuing up-left before dropping and folding into a renewed lift that opens outward; the left arm tucks left as the right knee straightens, then both arms lengthen downward. The left arm curls upward to the right while the right arm rises and folds, and the right knee softens as both hands reverse inward, the right elbow opening before the right hand drops and the right knee bends further. The right hand sweeps down-right and back left as the left hand rises, then both lower with the left elbow drawing in and the right knee extending, before the right arm reaches right and both hands return left. The left hand lifts while the right hand continues left and both elbows open, then they separate right and left with another bend of the right knee and descending hands. The right knee straightens as the left hand climbs, followed by the left knee extending and the left arm reaching farther left.

An alternating arm weave begins with both hands rising and the dancer's left knee straightening as the hands separate right and left. The left hand lowers while the right hand moves left and folds, then the lowered left hand reaches right and up as the folded right arm opens downward. The hands reverse sideways again, the right hand dropping as the right knee softens, before the right hand swings left and returns right while the left hand lifts and reverses left. The right arm curls upward as the left hand falls, then extends down and right against the left hand's rise and leftward reach. The left arm lengthens lower while the right arm tucks and rises, then releases downward as the left knee bends and straightens. The right hand sweeps left and curls upward before returning right, while the left arm extends farther down and left.

To begin, the dancer extends the right arm rightward while the left arm lowers, then folds the right arm upward as both hands move left. The right knee beneath the folded right hand softens and releases as the right hand drops and opens again, followed by the left arm extending down-left; the left hand then lifts through a rightward curl and returns left. The right knee bends farther as the left hand rises and the right arm unfolds downward, with the left arm lengthening down-left before both elbows fold. The right knee straightens as the hands separate left and right, then the right knee sinks again while both arms open and lift, followed by another release of the right leg. Both hands sweep right and descend with the elbows tucking, then rise again, the left hand moving left and both arms opening as the right knee straightens. The left hand continues left and climbs into a fold while the right hand descends through an extended reach and the right knee softens, before both arms curl upward and the right hand moves right.

A repeated arm-and-leg exchange begins with the dancer straightening the right knee as the left hand sweeps right and down, then folding both arms while the right knee bends and releases. The left arm tucks higher as the right arm reaches up and left, followed by a lift of the left hand; the hands separate sideways and descend as the right knee beneath the left arm lengthens further. The left arm curls upward and drops right into an extension while the right hand rises and folds, then both arms rise before the right arm sweeps left and opens downward. Both arms gather in toward the right as the left knee softens, then the left hand lowers and extends while the left knee straightens. The right hand rises, reaches farther right and falls as the right knee bends again, ending with another lift of the left hand.

In unison, the dancer lifts both hands and extends the left arm left while the right hand drops right; the raised left arm folds down and left as the right knee straightens. The hands sweep right and rise with bent elbows, then separate left and right as the right knee softens and the right arm tucks downward before the hands reverse sideways again. Both arms lengthen as the knees straighten and the right hand moves left and lowers, then both hands descend into a shared leftward reach while the right knee bends again. The hands lift as the knees extend in succession, and the right arm curls down and right while the left arm opens; the bent right knee softens once more beneath a rising, folding left arm. The hands continue apart, the left arm curling upward before both lower, the right elbow opening and the left knee straightening. The right hand sweeps left as the right knee lengthens, then rises right while the left arm reaches up and left over a bend of that same left knee.

A side-to-side arm exchange begins as the dancer raises both hands and curls them inward, then sends the right hand right while the left hand drops left; both elbows open before the right hand reverses left. The left hand lifts and extends right, joined by the right hand, which rises again. Both arms tuck as the right hand returns right and down, then lengthen into a shared lift and another descent. The left elbow folds once more as the left hand sweeps left and back right with a renewed upward curl.

The right hand sweeps left. The left hand rises as the right knee straightens, then the right arm extends downward and right while the left arm reaches higher to the left. The right hand returns up and left with a lengthening elbow, while the left arm folds down toward the right and the right arm tucks more tightly. Both hands climb into a shared reach that separates sideways, then the right arm curls left while the left arm drops and opens. The left hand lifts and swings right, joined by the right hand moving right before they separate again, the right hand dropping and curling upward as the left hand lowers.

The right hand rises into a curl. The dancer lowers the left hand, folds the left arm and lifts it right as both elbows release and the right hand drops left; the hands reverse sideways before the right hand returns right. The right arm lengthens downward while the left hand swings left and back right, then both rise with bent elbows and separate sideways. Both arms open, the left hand continuing up-right before returning down-left, while the right hand dips left and curls upward to join the left elbow's tuck. The right hand reverses right as the right knee bends and straightens, then sweeps left and down into an extension while the left arm opens and carries the left hand left.

To begin, the dancer lowers the right hand into a fold while extending the left arm down-left, then raises both hands and sweeps the right hand right as the right knee straightens. The left hand reverses left into a curl while the raised right hand drops left, followed by the left hand lifting and opening right over a softening right knee. Both hands descend with the right arm lengthening further left, then rise and separate again, the left hand continuing up-right as the left knee bends deeper. The left knee straightens while the right hand curls upward and moves right over another bend of the left knee; the left hand rises farther left as the knees exchange bends. The right hand drops left and rebounds upward while the left arm folds and lifts toward the right, then both hands lower, the right hand returning right as the right leg extends and the right hand curls up again.

The right knee softens as the left arm folds and sweeps left, while the right hand drops right and rises into a fold. The left arm reaches down-left, then lengthens upward to the right as the right hand lifts left and both elbows tuck; the hands reverse toward each other before descending. Both arms open, the left hand continuing left and the right hand right, then the right-moving arm curls upward while the left elbow gathers inward and its hand climbs. The raised arm extends downward and folds back up as the other continues right with a deeper curl, then both elbows open and their hands lower in succession. The right knee bends farther as the left arm reaches up-right and both hands sweep left, with the left knee sinking before that reaching hand returns right and its knee straightens.

The right arm curls upward and left. The left hand drops, folds inward, then rises as both hands move right. The right arm lowers and opens while the left arm extends downward, then reverses left and climbs into a tuck. The left arm lengthens farther up and left before dropping right with the right hand, which lifts again. Both descend as the left arm unfolds, then they reverse sideways and rise together.

The right hand rises rightward into a fold. The left arm lengthens downward as the right hand drops and opens, then both arms curl upward and the left hand reaches left. Both hands sweep right with opening elbows before reversing left; the right hand lowers as the left arm extends. The dancer repeats the rightward sweep with folded arms, then carries the right hand left while the left arm tucks and lifts. The left hand continues left and down as the right knee bends, followed by the left arm drawing farther in.

As the right hand lowers and the left hand curls upward, the dancer extends the right arm right, then sends both hands left with a fold of the left arm. The left knee straightens as the left arm opens downward, while the right hand continues left; the right knee then softens as the right hand rises and curls right. The left hand lifts and tucks farther inward, while the right arm reaches down and right and the right knee bends more deeply before straightening. Both arms lengthen through another leftward reach of the right hand, then both knees soften as the right hand returns right and the left hand drops. The knees straighten in succession as the right hand reverses left and rises, then curls right while the left hand lifts.

One knee softens after the dancer lifts and lengthens both arms, with the right hand traveling right as the left arm curls inward. The left hand rises farther while the right arm drops, then swings left as the right arm returns right and folds into a higher reach. The right hand continues upward and left while the left arm extends down-right, both hands lowering before the left arm sweeps left and the right hand returns right. The hands separate left and right as the knee beneath the left-moving hand bends further, then the left hand reverses right while the right arm climbs left and opens. Both hands sweep right and descend, the right arm folding into a tighter curl before both elbows release again.

To begin, the dancer lowers both hands and sends them right, with the right arm lengthening before folding as the left hand returns left. Both hands rise and sweep left as the arms open, then descend into a shared rightward reach that curls upward again. The right hand moves left while the left hand dips and rebounds, followed by the right arm lowering and opening into a rightward sweep. The right hand folds back left and rises with the right knee straightening, while the left arm tucks farther left; both hands descend, then the right hand swings right and climbs as the left arm extends. The left hand continues down and right while the right arm reaches left, then both hands return right and lower.

The dancer raises both hands. The right arm folds as the left hand climbs right, then both hands descend and sweep left while the left knee softens; both elbows tuck as the left hand rises again and the left knee straightens. The hands separate right and left with a deeper fold of the left elbow, then exchange sideways directions as the left arm lengthens. The right knee bends while the right hand moves up-right, then the hands reverse outward and climb into tighter folds before descending left together and returning right with opening arms. The left hand rises left and curls upward again as the right arm extends left, then both hands lift with the right elbow folding and both knees bending. The left arm reaches farther left before lowering and opening as the right knee straightens, then both legs extend beneath a rightward sweep of the hands.

In unison, the dancer lifts both hands toward the right. The arms lengthen apart as the left hand lowers and the right hand rises farther, then sweep left together before reversing right, with the left arm curling upward. The left arm opens downward while the right arm folds left and climbs, followed by a deeper tuck and descent of the left arm. The right hand drops and curls back up to the right as the right knee bends, while the left arm reaches down to the right and extends. Both knees soften as the right arm gathers inward and the right hand sweeps left, then reverses right with another bend in the right knee.

The dancer lengthens the right arm downward. Both hands sweep right, the left hand rising as the right knee bends and straightens; the right hand reverses left while both elbows curl inward and the right knee softens again. The left hand drops and extends farther left as the right elbow opens, then curls upward with another bend of the right knee while the right arm folds left and rises. The right knee releases as both arms open, the right hand sweeping down-right and the left hand moving left with a renewed tuck before returning right. The right arm lengthens farther right, then folds back left against the left hand's rightward reach as both knees soften in succession. The left hand sweeps left and rises into an extended finish while the right elbow briefly opens and refolds.

Leftward and upward, the dancer carries the left hand while folding the right arm, then opens both arms as the left hand returns right. The right hand sweeps left, rises with a curl, and reverses right as the right knee bends; the left arm extends downward before both hands move left, the right knee straightening as the right arm tucks. Both hands climb, the left elbow drawing in and opening again as the right hand drops right, then they descend together before the left arm curls upward and the right arm folds and rises. The left hand moves left as the right arm opens downward, then curls up to the right while the right arm tucks; it returns down-left as the right hand lifts. Both arms lengthen and sweep left, the left hand dropping while the right hand rises farther.

As the left hand rises leftward and the right hand moves right, the dancer lengthens the left arm. The right hand curls upward while the left knee bends, then both hands descend as the left knee straightens and the right arm opens. Both arms fold and lift as the left knee softens again, then the left hand reaches left before the right hand sweeps right and drops with an opening elbow. The hands rise together, the left arm folding inward as the left knee extends, then both descend and tuck into a tighter curl before the left hand returns up-left. The left hand drops as the right hand lifts, then both sweep right with the right arm drawing inward; the left knee bends as both hands lower and the right arm extends left. The left hand rises, swings left and back right as the right arm folds, then climbs higher while the right knee softens beneath a leftward descent of the right hand.

An alternating arm sweep begins with the right hand reaching right and the left hand reaching left, then both hands curl upward as the left knee straightens. The hands exchange directions again, the right hand lowering while the left arm opens and folds as the left knee bends and releases; the right arm extends downward before both hands rise. The right hand sweeps left and curls upward while the left hand moves right, then both hands descend into open arms before the left hand rises and tucks as the right hand reaches farther left and lowers. Both elbows draw inward as the hands climb, the right hand continuing left and opening while the left hand swings right, left and back right. The right arm lengthens as the left hand lifts leftward and returns right, then drops and curls in while the right hand rises.

The right arm rises as the left knee bends, then the right arm drops and sweeps right while the left knee straightens and the left arm curls upward. The right arm extends down-right as the left hand lowers and the left knee softens again; both hands sweep left, the left arm lengthening and lifting before the right arm rises. Both hands climb with tucked elbows, the right hand moving right and opening while the left hand continues left, then the right hand drops. The left knee bends and releases as the left hand moves right and curls upward; the right knee softens while the left hand reverses left and the right arm folds down-left. The right knee straightens as the right hand returns right and rises into a tighter curl, while the left arm opens down-right and lifts with another bend of the left knee.

The right knee softens as the dancer lifts both hands, then the right knee straightens and bends again while the left hand lowers and sweeps left. The left arm extends and folds as the right hand rises and moves right, then both hands descend before the right hand returns left. Both hands rise and separate sideways, the right hand right and the left hand left, then lower into bent elbows. The left hand climbs as the right knee straightens, and both hands sweep left before reversing right. The left hand drops with a lengthening elbow while the right hand rises and curls inward.

The left knee straightens and softens beneath the dancer's leftward left hand sweep, as both hands descend and the left arm extends. The right hand moves right while the right knee lengthens, then both arms curl upward and the left hand continues left. Both knees bend as the right arm opens and the left arm folds further; the left knee releases while the right knee tucks deeper. The raised hands separate sideways with the left hand moving right, then descend together as both elbows unfold. The right hand reverses right against the left hand's continued leftward sweep, while the left knee bends and the right knee straightens.

The right hand curls upward and moves right as the dancer lengthens both arms, then lowers the right hand while the left hand sweeps left. The right arm folds back up and left before opening downward and continuing left, while the left hand drops. Both hands rise with tucked elbows, then descend into a shared reach to the left. The dancer lifts the left hand again and sends it right as the right arm extends farther down.

The right hand rises and curls inward. The dancer straightens the left knee, then bends it again as the right arm opens downward, followed by a bend and release of the right knee while the left hand curls up and right. The left arm folds upward and extends down toward the left as its knee softens, while the right arm reaches farther right; both hands rise with that right elbow tucking, then sweep left as the bent knee straightens. Both arms lengthen downward before curling upward, the left hand continuing left and down into an extension as the right knee bends. The lowered hand returns right while the right arm folds left, then opens downward as its knee straightens; the left arm curls up to the right while the opposite knee bends and its hand lifts. Both hands descend with folded elbows, the left moving right as its knee releases and the right hand shifts left.

The right knee softens as the dancer lifts both hands and sweeps them left, then lengthens the right arm into a rightward reach while the left hand drops. The right hand continues right and rises with its elbow tucked, then folds further into a leftward return as the left arm extends upward; the left hand follows left before curling up toward the right. Both arms open and the hands separate right and left, the left hand rising as the right knee bends and straightens and the right hand lowers. The right knee softens again beneath another left-right sweep of the raised arm and a downward extension of the other, followed by a tighter leftward fold and renewed rightward reach. The right knee straightens as the right arm tucks, while the left arm opens downward; the right arm then releases down and right as the left hand curls back left.

The dancer lifts the left hand leftward. The right arm reaches up and right, then the left hand moves right into a fold as the right arm lowers and lengthens. Both hands sweep left; the left hand drops while the right hand rises, then both reverse right with the left elbow opening and the right hand descending. The left arm curls upward to the right as the right knee softens and the right hand continues down and right, before both hands lower and the left arm extends left. The left hand returns right and folds upward while the right arm travels left and rises, then both sweep right as the left hand drops and opens.

As the right hand moves right and the left hand moves left, the dancer lowers both hands, then lifts them with a curling fold on the right side. The right arm opens down-left as the left knee bends, then the left hand drops while the right knee softens; the right arm tucks up-right against the left arm's extension down-left. Both knees straighten as the right hand returns down-left, followed by an opening of the left arm and another bend and release beneath the left hand. The right hand rises right over a softening knee while the left arm folds upward to the left, then the right arm extends downward and both hands sweep left. The left hand lifts and continues left while the right arm lengthens farther left.

The right hand curls upward. The dancer lowers and extends the left arm, then lifts both hands as the right hand folds more deeply and the right knee softens; the left arm tucks left while the right hand reaches right. Both elbows open and the left hand rises, followed by the right hand, before they descend together into bent arms. The right arm lengthens as the left hand lifts and both sweep right, then the right arm drops with a deeper fold while the left hand curls higher and moves left. The left arm opens down-left, rebounds up-right, and tucks as the right elbow tightens and both hands return left. The left hand drops and extends through another bend and release of the right knee, then climbs as the right hand curls upward and right, ending with both hands moving left.

The right knee straightens as the dancer curls the right hand up and left, then lengthens the right arm downward while the left hand rises. The left hand moves right as the left knee softens and both arms fold; both hands climb, the left hand continuing right before the knees exchange tension. The right arm reaches down and left over another bend in the right knee, while the left hand curls upward and returns left. Both hands rise with folded elbows as the left knee extends, then separate right and left and descend. The right hand sweeps left and back right over a bend in the right knee, ending with the left arm tucked higher.

Downward, the right hand moves right and folds as the left arm lengthens downward. The left hand reverses left while the right hand rises, then the right hand travels left as the left arm drops farther. Both hands sweep right, with the right hand curling upward and the left arm extending before returning left and folding back down. The right hand climbs again while the left arm continues lowering and reaches right, finishing with another curl of the rising right arm.

The dancer lowers and opens both arms. The right hand sweeps right as the right knee bends, then the left arm reaches left while the right knee straightens; the right arm curls upward, followed by the left hand rising into a fold as the right knee softens again. The right arm opens downward while the left arm extends down to the left, and the right knee lengthens before bending again as the right hand rises into a tuck and the left hand moves right. Both hands lower, the right hand continuing left while the left arm extends, before the right hand lifts and folds and the left knee bends. The hands separate left and right, the right arm opening downward as the left elbow tightens and the left knee straightens, then both elbows draw in and both knees extend. The right hand reverses right while the left hand rises into another bend, followed by an extension of the right arm and knee and a drop of the left hand.

In opposition, the dancer sweeps the right hand right and down while the left hand rises, then lowers the left hand as the left knee straightens and the right arm folds. The right hand climbs farther left as the left knee bends, then both hands descend and the arms open before the right hand reverses right. Both elbows tuck and lift as the right knee softens, then the hands separate left and right with another deepening fold of the right arm. The left-moving hand drops into an extension while the right hand curls higher and continues right, then the left arm lifts left and folds as the right hand opens downward. The right arm lengthens once more as the left hand moves right.

In opposition, the dancer extends the right arm right while the left arm folds upward and left, then opens the left arm as the right hand lowers and the right knee straightens. The left hand continues up-left as the right arm lengthens farther left, then reverses right with a bend of the right knee beneath it before returning left and extending downward. Both hands sweep right with the right knee bending, then both arms curl inward as the left knee softens; the right knee straightens while the left hand drops and the left knee bends further. The hands separate left and right, then reverse their sideways directions as the left arm reaches down-right and the right hand rises, ending with both elbows tucked inward.

The right arm sweeps upward to the left, then opens down-right while the left arm folds and carries its hand right. The right arm tucks upward while the left arm extends left, both hands rising before the left arm curls back right and the right arm lowers into an extension. The right hand reaches farther left and lifts while the left knee bends and straightens beneath a renewed fold-and-release of the left arm; both hands descend, the right arm lengthening right as the left knee softens. Both arms draw inward, lifting toward the left with the left hand higher before the right arm opens downward. The hands separate sideways and rise together, the left elbow folding as both knees bend, then descend with the right arm tucked.

As the right arm lengthens downward, the dancer folds the left arm and carries the left hand right, then lowers both hands with a further extension of the right arm. The left knee straightens as the left hand sweeps left and back right; both hands rise, the left elbow tucking before both arms open again. The right hand continues upward while the left hand drops and extends, then both sweep left, the right arm curling before both elbows fold and descend. The right arm reaches down to the right as the left arm opens and rises, then the left hand moves left and curls inward while the right hand climbs left into a tuck. Both hands lower as the left elbow releases, then the right hand lifts and moves right while the left hand continues downward and right.

A low, outward hand sweep begins with the right hand moving left and the left hand moving right as both knees bend in succession; the right arm curls upward while the left knee straightens. The hands separate sideways and climb, then reverse their directions as the right arm opens, both arms fold and descend. The right hand returns left as both knees soften, its elbow tucking before both hands rise, spread apart and lower again. Both elbows extend through another knee bend, then the right hand lifts and reaches right while the left arm folds downward. The right arm lengthens farther right and descends as the right knee straightens and the left leg softens, then rises left against the left hand's continuing rightward reach.

An alternating arm sweep begins as the dancer lifts the right hand right and lengthens the right arm, then lowers the right hand while the left hand rises left and folds inward. The right hand climbs left into a curl while the left hand drops right, opens, and returns left; both hands descend, the right hand tucking farther before both arms extend upward. The hands separate sideways and reverse toward each other, the left arm folding down and reopening as the right hand curls up-right and the left hand continues right. Both hands lower, the right hand opening left and then rising into a fold while the left arm extends down and left, before the right arm releases downward.

A rising arm exchange begins as the dancer lifts the left hand left and lengthens the right hand, then lowers both hands rightward while the right arm curls inward. The left arm folds as the right knee straightens, then the hands reverse left and descend before the left hand reaches down and back right and the right hand curls upward. The raised right hand swings right and returns left as both arms tuck, with the left hand also moving left; both knees soften as the hands drop and separate sideways, then rise with the left arm opening and the right knee extending. The left hand sweeps right and up while the right hand drops left, then both lower and reverse sideways as the right knee bends again. The right hand rises into a fold and sweeps right and down while the left arm opens and lifts toward the right, finishing with the bent right knee sinking farther.

At the outset, the right arm curls upward and right while the left arm extends down and left. The right hand lowers as the right knee softens, then reaches farther right and rises again before returning left and dropping with an opening elbow. The right hand sweeps up-right and back left while the left knee bends and straightens beneath a downward extension, then both hands rise and separate sideways. Both arms curl and descend as the left knee bends again, followed by another lift and fall of the right hand while the right leg lengthens. The right arm folds higher to the right as the left hand drops and the left knee straightens, then the hands exchange height and sweep left together with bent elbows before the right arm lifts again. The left hand returns right and rises as both arms open and the left knee bends; both knees sink, then the right knee straightens and the left knee sinks further before both legs release into extension.

As the right arm folds and lowers, the dancer carries both hands left over a bending left knee, then lifts the right hand while straightening the left knee and opening the left elbow. The left hand rises as the right arm curls down, then the left knee bends and releases while the raised left hand dips and rebounds into an extension. Both knees soften as the hands separate left and right, the rightward-reaching arm lengthening upward before both arms fold and lift toward the right with a deeper bend of the left knee. The hands reverse inward and rise through another left knee release, then the right arm opens left while the left elbow tucks; both hands lower and sweep right as the knees extend again. Both arms curl upward with the left hand continuing right, then descend and open as the left hand reverses left, accompanied by a bend and release of the left knee.

At the outset, the dancer folds the right arm and raises the right hand rightward as the left hand climbs left; both elbows open before the hands reverse sideways and descend. The hands sweep right together, then exchange directions again with the right arm curling upward as the left arm drops. The right hand continues right while the left arm reaches up and left, then both arms tuck into a shared leftward sweep that rises. Both arms lengthen downward, the right hand returning right as the left knee straightens and the left elbow opens. With another bend of the right knee, the dancer curls the right hand up and left against the left hand's rightward extension, then releases both arms downward.

In opposition, the dancer curls the left arm upward and left while the right arm folds down and right, then both arms lengthen as the left hand reverses right and drops. The right arm extends left, rises and tucks into a rightward sweep before lowering again, while the left hand climbs right and returns left with its elbow folding. The left arm opens upward and right as the right arm curls up and left, then both hands descend with the elbows gathering in; the hands separate left and right as the right arm extends. Both arms lift, the left hand reversing right while the right arm curls farther left, then they separate again as the right arm opens downward and the right knee straightens. The left hand drops left while the right hand swings right and down, then returns left with an inward elbow fold and another release as the bent knee softens and straightens again.

The dancer lowers both hands. The right arm reaches right as the left knee straightens, then the right hand rises while the left hand curls upward and the left knee bends; both elbows fold before the right hand swings left and down. Both arms lengthen downward as the knees soften, then they sweep right and climb into tighter folds, followed by a leftward return with the left knee bending further. The right hand dips right and rebounds up-right as the left knee releases, while the left arm curls down-left; both hands descend and the left knee straightens as the left arm opens. The left arm folds right over a bend of the right knee, then lifts and extends left as the right leg releases and the right hand drops. The left hand curls up-right over another right knee bend, and the right elbow tucks farther left as the left knee straightens again.

The right knee bends as the dancer curls the right arm upward, then straightens the right knee while the left hand rises left and the right hand follows left. The left arm extends down-right as the left knee softens, then folds up-left; the right arm tucks farther and lifts before both hands sweep right. The right hand lowers as the left hand drops and lengthens, then they reverse left together with the left arm curling upward. Both hands return right, the right hand lifting while the left hand lowers and the left arm opens, then folds again. The left hand climbs as the right knee bends and straightens beneath a downward-left reach of the right arm, which curls higher while the left arm lengthens downward.

Both arms curl upward. The right hand drops and extends right as the right knee straightens, while the left arm lengthens down; the right hand then rises and curls left as the left knee bends and the left hand lowers. The hands sweep right with opening elbows, the right descending while the left rises, then reverse left and exchange height as both arms fold. Both hands return right and drop, the left elbow releasing before the right curls up and reaches left; the left hand lifts into a tuck, followed by the right rising farther left and extending.
