The left arm opens downward while the right folds and lowers toward the right, then both reach higher, the left curling inward. The right hand continues right as both elbows tuck and the left knee softens, then the right hand climbs and the right knee bends while the left sweeps left and down.

The dancer sends the right hand right. The left arm curls upward, then extends down and left as the right hand continues right; both arms lengthen before the right hand returns left and folds downward while the left arm lifts and tucks. The hands separate horizontally with the left hand continuing right and the right arm reaching down and opening, then reverse sideways as the left hand rises. Both elbows fold and the hands sweep right, the right hand dipping before climbing again while the left hand lowers into an extension. The right arm opens left, then curls upward alongside the left hand's rising motion.

The right knee bends and straightens beneath the right arm, which curls, lowers, then rises as the left hand moves right. The right hand drops while the left hand continues right and curls upward, followed by another lift and fall of the right arm into a tuck. The right arm opens downward as the left knee softens, the right hand moving left before both hands rise and the left knee releases; the left arm lengthens down to the right. Both hands descend with folding elbows, the right hand moving right, then climb as the left arm extends farther right. The right elbow opens and refolds while the left hand sweeps left and up into a deeper tuck.

A shared downward reach begins with the right hand traveling left, followed by the left hand. The right arm folds up and right while the left arm curls upward and both knees soften. Both hands sweep left as the right arm opens downward; the knees straighten before the left knee bends again and the left arm tucks upward. The right hand rises with a tighter curl as the right knee lengthens, then both hands descend and the left elbow draws inward. The right knee bends as the right hand lifts right and the left hand lowers, before the right knee releases and both arms extend downward.

The right knee softens as the dancer lowers and extends both arms, then the right hand lifts left while the left hand drops right, with the right knee straightening. The hands reverse inward and descend, the left arm lengthening as the left knee bends and releases; the right hand continues down-left. Both arms curl upward before lowering into an extension, then rise again as the right hand sweeps right and folds back left, the left elbow tucking farther. The left hand drops right while the right arm opens downward, and the hands reverse their lateral directions before lifting together with bent elbows. The left arm reaches higher to the left while the right hand swings right, then both climb farther as the left hand reverses right.

The dancer lifts the left hand leftward. The left arm opens and lowers, followed by the right arm as both hands move right, before the left arm curls up-right while the right elbow folds. Both hands climb toward the left with the left arm lengthening, then descend together as the elbows open and the right hand reverses right. The left hand rises and sweeps down-left, joined by the right hand moving left; the left knee bends as the left arm reaches farther down and left and the right knee straightens. The right hand moves right as the left hand lifts into a curl, then the left hand returns left and down with an opening elbow while the right knee softens again.

At the outset, the right arm folds and releases while the left hand sweeps left, then both rise, with the left arm curling as the left knee softens. The left knee straightens as both hands descend, then the right knee bends while the left arm lengthens right and lowers; the right arm tucks into a rising leftward reach that extends farther before both hands fall and separate, the right hand moving right and the left hand continuing left. The right hand curls upward as the left hand rises right, then drops with an opening elbow while the left arm gathers left and lowers. Both hands sweep left and descend as the right knee bends, then the right arm curls upward before both hands reverse right, the left arm folding and lifting. The right arm reaches up-right while the left hand continues right and opens, followed by another lift of the right hand as the right knee lengthens and the left hand descends.

The right knee softens as the left hand drops left and the left arm folds, then both hands sweep right with the left arm opening. The left knee bends as the right hand lowers and the right knee straightens; the bent right knee releases while the right hand lifts right into a curl and both knees soften again. The left arm opens and descends as the right arm rises, then curls upward and sweeps left while the right hand moves right. Both arms lengthen downward, then the left-moving hand reverses right and curls upward over a straightening knee while the right hand reaches right and down. The rising hand drops and extends left before folding back up as the left knee bends and the left hand lowers, then both knees release and the left hand returns left.

The right hand travels right and rises. The left arm lengthens left as the right hand lowers, then both hands sweep right and the right knee softens while the arms fold; the left hand drops and opens before both arms extend upward. The left knee bends and releases beneath another lift of the left hand, which then curls left and down as the right knee sinks and the right hand continues right. The left arm reaches up and left as the right hand folds downward, then reverses right while the right knee straightens and the left knee softens; both hands descend into lengthened arms, followed by the right knee straightening as the left knee deepens and both hands rise. The right hand moves right as the right knee bends again, then sweeps left and back right while the right leg releases; the left knee sinks further as the right arm tucks and lifts, with the left hand moving right. The right arm extends upward and returns left as the left hand rises and the left knee straightens, ending with a curl of the right arm and another bend of the left knee.

The right arm drops and sweeps right while the left arm rises, then both arms descend with the right arm extending. The left arm reaches farther upward and right while the right arm curls up-left, then the left arm returns down-right before both hands lower and the left arm reverses left. The right arm lengthens downward and lifts again as the left arm folds and carries its hand right; the left arm opens into a rising rightward sweep while the right arm tucks back left. Both hands sink, then the left arm curls up-left and releases into a descent while the right arm lifts and extends. The left hand continues lowering as the right arm folds and moves left, then the lowered left arm also curls inward.

The right knee softens as the dancer lowers and extends the right arm left, while the left hand sweeps right and down. The left hand reverses up and right with a curling elbow, then both hands rise and the knees straighten in succession. Both arms fold before opening downward, with the left knee bending again. The right hand lifts into a tuck and returns left and down as the right knee releases, while the left arm curls upward and the left knee bends once more.

The knees soften in succession as the right arm curls upward, then the hands separate left and right while the left hand rises. The right hand sweeps left and back right with a folded elbow, its knee straightening as the left hand lifts and drops, opens and tucks again. The bent knee deepens as the raised arm extends downward, then both legs lengthen beneath another leftward curling lift of that hand. The same hand swings right and down while the other moves left and lowers into an opening arm, followed by a bend and release of the opposite knee. Both arms gather inward and rise before separating right and left, then descend with extended elbows as the latter knee bends again.

The right knee straightens as the dancer lowers and lengthens the right arm, then lifts it left while the left hand moves right and rises into a fold. The right arm continues upward as the right knee softens, then drops right before both hands climb again with the right knee extending; the right hand sweeps left and returns right as both arms curl higher. The right hand dips left and rebounds up-right against the left hand's leftward reach, then swings down-left and back up-right as the left arm folds downward. Both arms open as the left hand descends and the right arm travels farther right, then curls upward before sweeping left and dropping into an extension. The left hand climbs left while the right arm tucks, opens and lifts toward the right, ending with the right hand continuing upward and to the left.

An alternating arm weave begins with the right hand rising left and folding as the left hand reaches right, then both hands descend and reverse sideways while the right hand lengthens. The left knee softens as the left hand continues right and down; the right hand curls higher and swings left, then drops and opens while the left hand lifts left over a deeper bend of the left knee. The left knee straightens as the hands separate left and right, the left hand curling upward and returning left, joined by the right hand as both elbows tuck and the left knee bends again. The hands reverse apart, then the right hand dips and rises into a longer reach before sweeping left and back right over another left knee extension. Both hands lower and sweep left with lengthening arms as the left knee deepens, then return right and rise as the left knee straightens and the hands separate again.

As the right arm lengthens upward and the left arm folds, the dancer lifts both hands leftward, then reverses their sideways paths with the right hand dropping as the right knee straightens. The left hand continues left and curls while the right knee bends, then extends as the left hand rises and the right hand lowers; both hands sweep right before the right arm reaches up and back left, followed by a lift of the left arm. The right arm opens downward while the left arm tucks and drops, then both arms lengthen and climb left as the right knee softens again. Both elbows fold as the right knee straightens, and the hands move right before the left arm opens into a descending sweep left and back right, with the right knee bending once more. The hands rise in succession as the right elbow draws inward, then descend with the left arm extending and both knees softening. The right knee straightens while both hands sweep left and curl upward, then the right hand lowers and the left knee lengthens as the right arm unfolds and lifts again.

The dancer straightens the right knee. The right hand curls upward and right while the left hand rises left into a fold, then both hands sweep left as the right arm opens downward and the left arm tucks higher. The right hand returns right and climbs with its elbow folding, while the left hand travels right, lowers, and extends before reversing left. The left arm releases down and left as the right knee bends, then both arms curl upward before the right hand descends and lengthens; the right knee straightens as the left hand drops and the hands separate left and right, the left hand returning left and lifting with an opening elbow. Both hands rise as the right arm reaches farther right, then the hands reverse sideways and descend. The left arm curls up and left against the right hand's continued rightward reach, followed by another shared lift and a rightward sweep of both hands.

The dancer lowers and lengthens the right arm. The left hand moves right and down as the right arm folds upward, then both hands rise with the right arm curling farther in while the left knee softens and straightens. Both hands descend, the right arm opening before sweeping left and rising again, joined by a lift of the left hand and arm. The left arm draws inward as the right hand reaches left, then curls back right and down while the left arm rises and extends left; the right hand lifts and sweeps left as the left elbow folds, then drops and opens while the right arm gathers downward and moves right. The hands reverse sideways, the left-moving arm drawing in and lifting as the right arm tucks and continues right, then both descend and unfold before separating again. The dancer raises the right arm that just opened into a fold and carries it right while the left hand continues right and lowers, followed by another descent of the right arm.

Up and right, the dancer folds the left arm while the right arm reaches left, then lowers both hands as the right hand reverses right and curls upward. The left arm opens right and drops as the right elbow tucks more tightly; the right hand continues down and left into a fold while the left arm extends left. Both arms lengthen downward, the right hand reversing right before curling up and returning left. The left hand lifts with a bent elbow as the right arm rises, and both sweep left through an unfolding left arm. The right hand climbs farther left and curls in while the left hand lowers, then both descend, the right arm opening and the left arm folding.

As the right hand moves right, the dancer raises both hands and lengthens the left arm leftward. The right arm folds back left, then opens downward while the left arm curls upward to the right. The right hand reverses right as the right knee bends and straightens; the left arm extends farther up and right before descending. The right elbow tucks as both hands lower, and the left hand continues right.

A rising, inward-and-outward arm exchange begins with the left hand climbing left while the right hand reaches right; both arms fold and descend as the right knee bends and the right hand moves right. The right arm opens downward while the left hand sweeps left and curls upward, then returns right as the right elbow folds and the bent right knee straightens. Both hands rise and separate sideways, the left arm lengthening before curling back toward the left, then opening as the right hand continues down to the right. The right knee softens again beneath a further descent of the right hand, which reverses left as the left arm tucks and lifts and the bent right leg extends. The tucked left hand drops while the right hand moves right and rises, then the lowered right hand returns up to the right as the left elbow releases.

To begin, the dancer sends the left hand left and down with a folding left elbow while the right arm lengthens downward, then raises both hands. The left arm reaches right as the left knee straightens, while the right hand drops farther right; the left arm curls upward before unfolding back down and left. The left hand continues left as the right knee softens, then returns up-right and folds while the right arm opens. The right knee bends further as the left arm tucks higher, followed by another lift of the left hand and a deeper extension of the right leg. Both hands descend, the left arm opening into a leftward sweep and the right knee bending again.

As both hands move right, the dancer lifts the right arm and curls it inward while the left hand lowers. The right hand drops farther before rising again as the left arm extends upward, then the right arm folds down and sweeps left into a lengthening reach. The right hand returns right with a curling elbow while the left hand rises, dips, and lifts back up. Both arms open as the hands climb together, then the right hand lowers and reverses left while the left hand continues upward and extends.

The arms move in opposition: the right hand travels right while the left hand sweeps left and rises, then both hands climb as the rightward-reaching right arm folds. The folded right arm opens into a downward-right sweep while the left hand returns right and curls upward, followed by another descent of the extended right arm. The right arm reaches up-left and back down-right as the right knee straightens and the left arm lengthens, then the left hand continues right before both hands rise. The right knee softens beneath the rising folded right arm while that arm extends down-left and the left hand shifts right; the bent right leg releases as both hands lift again. The dancer repeats the leftward curl and rightward extension of the right arm, lowering it while the left knee bends and the left hand moves left.

At the outset, the right arm folds upward and sweeps right before lowering and opening into a leftward reach as the right knee softens. The left hand rises while the right reaching arm curls up and left, then both descend and lengthen before the left hand reverses right and the left arm tucks downward. Both hands sweep left as the right arm opens, then rise together with the left elbow extending; the right knee bends farther while the right hand continues left. The arms separate right and left, the left hand lifting and folding inward before the right arm lowers, then both climb and the right knee straightens as the left hand reverses left. The right knee bends again beneath another shared descent, then straightens as both hands sweep right, lift and return left with the left elbow drawing in. Both knees soften as the right arm reaches right and down, followed by the left hand dropping; the hands reverse right, the right hand curls up and returns left while the left arm extends downward, then the right hand lowers and opens.

The right hand sweeps right and rises. Both arms fold as the left knee bends, then both hands descend and the elbows open before they sweep left, the right arm curling upward again. The left hand drops and tucks as the left knee straightens, while the right hand swings right and down into an extension and returns left; both hands rise with the left elbow opening. The dancer lengthens the right arm farther left, then folds it downward as the left hand lifts and curls in, followed by a bend of the left knee. The left hand descends through another fold and release while the right hand reaches right, then the left hand curls up and left as the left knee softens further. Both hands lower, the right hand continuing left while the left hand moves right and the left knee straightens; the right hand rises, then falls again.

The dancer lengthens the right arm. The left hand drops, then sweeps left and rises as the right arm folds; that raised left hand continues upward while the folded right arm extends down-left. Both hands descend, the right hand sweeping right before reversing left as the left arm curls upward. The right hand lifts into a fold and moves right while the curled left arm releases downward and carries its hand farther down-right. That lower left hand swings left and back right as the right arm opens downward and its hand follows right.

The right arm reaches left while the left arm folds downward, then the left hand swings right and back left as the right arm curls up toward the right. The right arm releases down and extends right again, followed by the left hand dropping farther right. Both hands sweep left before the left arm opens upward and the right arm tucks into a lift; the lifted right hand returns right with another fold and extension. The right hand drops as both arms lengthen, then sweeps left while the left arm rises and the right knee softens. The raised left hand continues climbing and travels right as the right arm curls up and right, finishing with the left hand lowering and extending farther.

An opening-and-folding arm exchange begins with the right hand rising while the left hand drops and lengthens; the right arm folds, then both sweep left as the left hand climbs. The hands reverse right, the right arm curling farther upward before dropping and opening into a shared leftward return. The right hand lifts right again while the left hand rises left, then both descend and separate right and left with folded elbows, finishing with the right arm extending downward. The right hand reaches up-left, drops back down-right and curls as the right knee bends and straightens, then opens left while the left knee softens beneath another curling lift of the right hand. Both hands climb and sweep left, the left arm folding before they return right, with the right knee releasing as the right hand lowers and the left knee sinks. The right hand sweeps left and rises while the left hand moves right, then both move left and descend as the right knee bends and the left leg extends.

At the outset, the dancer raises the right hand while the left arm folds left and down, then both hands sweep left as the right arm lengthens and the right knee softens. The left knee bends deeper before straightening as the left arm reaches right and up and returns left; the right knee releases, then bends again beneath a rising fold of the right arm. Both knees soften in succession as the left hand curls upward and left and the right arm opens downward, followed by another bend and release of the right knee. The left hand rises with an extending elbow while the right knee sinks once more; both arms gather inward as the right hand lifts, then both lower into open reaches. The left leg straightens and bends again beneath another leftward lift of the left arm, while the right hand moves right and down as the right knee softens and the right arm lengthens.

The right knee softens as the dancer curls the right arm upward and right, then lowers the right hand into a leftward sweep while both arms lengthen. The left hand lifts right and returns down-left over a deeper bend of the right knee, while the right arm folds up-right and the left arm opens farther down-left. The left arm tucks through a right-to-left return and rises as the right knee straightens; the right hand follows left with an opening elbow and descends while the left arm curls higher, the right knee bending again before the hands trade height. The right knee releases as the right hand sweeps right and the left hand lowers, then the right arm extends and drops while the left hand continues left and down. The right knee bends as the right hand rises and travels left, then straightens as both hands descend with the left arm extending. The right hand lifts left and reverses right while the left arm reaches right, then both knees soften in succession beneath descending hands, the right hand continuing right as the left arm lengthens farther.

The arms move in opposition: the dancer sends the left hand left and raises it as the right arm folds, then lifts both hands before lowering them. The rightward-reaching right arm lengthens while the left hand moves left and the right knee softens, followed by the raised left arm extending downward. That descending left hand swings right and back left, opening into a lift while the right arm curls upward; the right knee bends further as the lifted left hand continues left and rises with its elbow tucked. Both hands climb, the rightward-moving right arm drawing inward and sweeping down-right, before the left hand reverses right. The lowered right arm releases left and down while the left arm reaches up-left, then both return right.

The right knee softens beneath a lowering right hand, then straightens as the right arm folds and releases downward; the left hand lifts with an extending elbow while the right arm curls again. The left hand sweeps down-left as the left knee bends and the right hand rises leftward, then both hands return right and descend, the right arm opening before curling upward and dropping as the right knee lengthens. The left hand rises with a deeper tuck and sweeps left while the right arm extends up-left; both knees bend as the left arm lowers, then straighten while the left hand reverses right and climbs. The right knee softens again beneath a downward curl of the right arm, then both knees extend as the arms open and the left hand drops left. Both hands rise into folded arms and sweep right, with the left knee bending and releasing as the right hand returns left and both elbows draw inward. The hands lower with the left arm lengthening, then the right hand reaches right while the left hand rises and folds.

The right knee straightens as the dancer lifts the right hand and sweeps both hands left, then lowers them while the left hand returns right. The right hand reverses right and climbs as the left arm extends upward, before both arms fold and the right hand drops. The left arm lengthens downward while the right hand reaches left and rises, then the left hand returns up-left as the right knee bends; both hands sweep right and descend as the right knee straightens. Both hands lift again, with the right arm folding and the left arm extending, then they separate sideways as the left knee softens. The left knee straightens and bends again while the right arm opens left and the left hand swings right and back left.

The dancer folds the right arm as the left knee softens and the left hand rises, then both hands descend while the left knee straightens and the right leg lengthens. The right arm curls up and right as the left knee bends and releases; the left arm tucks left and down before opening. The right hand drops into a deeper fold while the left hand rises, sweeps left and returns right into a tighter curl. The right hand climbs farther left and opens as the left arm extends upward to the right, then lowers and bends while the raised left hand sinks left. The left arm reaches left and lengthens over a bending knee as the right hand lifts and tucks, then the reaching left hand reverses right.

The right knee bends as the dancer curls the left arm upward and sends both hands right, then extends the left arm while the right arm folds. The right hand drops left and lengthens as the left arm climbs farther right and the right knee straightens. Both arms gather inward as the left hand returns left and down; the right elbow opens before both hands sweep right, with the right arm curling again and the left hand rising. The left hand reverses left and lowers, followed by the right hand dropping into a fold as the right knee bends and releases. The right hand lifts right while the left hand continues right and curls higher, then the left arm draws back left as the left knee straightens.

The knees soften in succession as the dancer sends the left hand left and raises it into a curl while the right arm reaches right. The curled left hand returns right, then folds down-left before the right knee straightens and the right hand lowers; both hands sweep left and rise with the right hand continuing upward. The arms open apart as the right hand falls, then both descend and tuck inward as the left knee bends further. Both hands climb again and separate, the right arm extending right before returning left into another fold, then lowering as the right knee lengthens and the left arm reaches up-right. The lowered right arm curls upward while the left hand continues right and rises, then opens down-left as the right elbow releases and the right hand moves right.

The right hand sweeps right and down. The left arm lengthens as the right arm folds, then reaches up-left before both hands drop and return right with the left arm curling inward. Both hands rise into folded arms, the left arm moving left while the right arm travels right and back left; they descend and separate again, the left hand continuing left as the right knee straightens and the right hand moves right. The right knee bends and releases beneath a shared upward reach, followed by another bend and release as both hands sweep left and lower. Both elbows tuck through another lift and descent, then open and reverse right, the right hand sinking farther as the right knee softens.

An alternating arm sweep begins as the dancer curls the left hand up-left while the right hand reaches down-right, then both elbows open and lower. The hands reverse sideways with the left arm folding again, before the left hand drops left into an extended reach and rebounds upward with a tighter curl as the right hand continues right. The left hand swings right and down, its elbow opening, while the right arm extends down-left; the right hand returns right and folds back left as the left hand lifts right and opens. Both arms lengthen downward, the left hand reversing left while the right hand moves right, then the left arm gathers upward and sweeps right alongside the right hand's rise. The left hand climbs farther while the right hand drops left and tucks, then both descend with opening elbows.

The arms separate right and left. The dancer sends the right hand down and left, then raises it into a curl as the left arm folds, before both hands return right and the right hand drops. The right hand continues downward while the left arm curls up and left, followed by the right arm folding upward; the left hand lifts farther as the right knee softens and the right arm opens. The left arm lengthens, drops and rebounds while the right arm reaches farther left, then the right hand moves right as the left arm rises. The left hand travels left and returns right, with the right hand continuing right and curling upward.

The right hand travels right and rises while the left arm curls upward, then both descend and lengthen. The right hand moves right while the left arm reaches left, lowers its elbow, and returns up-left into a fold. The left folded arm sweeps right and down before rising again as the right knee softens; the right hand climbs farther and extends left while the left arm tucks downward. The left hand moves right with an opening elbow as the right hand continues left and its knee straightens, then the right hand lifts while the left arm drops. Both hands sweep left and descend, the right hand folding into a tighter curl as the left arm releases.

At the opening, the dancer curls the left arm left and down while the right hand rises, then carries both hands right as the right arm folds back left. The left hand drops and lengthens while the right hand climbs farther left; both arms tuck, the left hand lifting as the right hand descends, before they separate right and left and exchange height with another fold of the right arm. Both arms extend upward and sweep left, the left hand dropping as the right hand returns right and opens into a shared descent, followed by the left arm reaching right. The left hand climbs while the right hand folds right, then the left arm lowers and extends left as the right hand continues right and lifts. The left hand moves right again and rises against the right hand's leftward descent.

The right knee straightens as the dancer lowers and lengthens the right arm into a leftward reach, then sends the left hand left while both arms fold. The right arm opens downward again as the right knee bends, followed by the left knee sinking and the left hand moving right with an opening elbow. Both hands sweep left as the knees release, then the left knee bends while the right arm curls upward. The left knee straightens and the hands separate left and right before the left knee softens once more. The right knee lengthens farther as the right hand continues right and rises, while the left arm reaches up and left.

The dancer lowers the right hand into a curling lift to the right, then lengthens the right arm back left as both hands descend. The left arm folds upward and extends down toward the left while the right hand rises into another tuck, then opens farther right as the left knee softens. Both hands lower and sweep left, with the left arm gathering inward before releasing as the left knee straightens. The right hand curls up to the right over a bending knee while the left hand continues left, then reverses left and down as the left hand lifts rightward. Both arms gather upward, the right hand moving right and the left hand returning left, before the right elbow releases and both hands fall as the left leg bends more deeply.

As the right hand sweeps left and rises, the left hand moves right over a bending knee, then both hands descend before the right arm curls upward. The left hand travels left and drops as its knee straightens, while the raised right arm reaches farther up and right. Both arms lengthen downward, the left hand reversing right, before they fold upward again with the right hand returning left. The right arm opens down and right while the left arm tucks into a higher lift, then both elbows draw in as the right hand reverses left. Both hands descend with the right elbow extending, before that hand returns right and the left arm curls upward.

An opening-and-folding arm exchange begins with the left hand moving left as the right hand rises, then both hands descend and separate right and left while their arms unfold. The right hand reverses left and climbs as its knee straightens, followed by the left hand reaching left and rising as its own knee extends. Both hands sweep right and down before the right hand curls upward, then the left arm folds into a leftward lift as its knee bends and releases. The right arm opens downward and sweeps right while the left hand drops and swings left; the right-moving hand returns left as its knee softens, then both knees lengthen. The left hand continues left and rises while the right hand moves right, then the raised arm tucks farther inward as the opposite hand lowers.

In opposition, the right hand drops while the left hand rises left and curls inward, then the right arm lifts as both elbows fold. The initially raised left hand reverses right and lengthens down while the right knee straightens, the left hand continuing right before the right elbow tucks and the descending right hand lifts. Both arms open downward and sweep left as the right knee bends and straightens, followed by another bend-and-release of the right knee while the hands reverse right and the right arm reaches upward. The right knee softens beneath a folded, rising leftward reach, then both arms lengthen as the hands climb; the right knee releases while the left hand swings right and back left, its elbow opening. The right hand lowers with an extending arm as the right knee bends again, then both knees straighten while the left arm curls up-right and the lower right hand continues down and left.

The right knee softens as the dancer lifts both hands and sends them left, then the right knee straightens while the left arm extends right and down and the right hand drops. The left arm curls upward to the right and opens again as the right knee bends farther; the right hand rises leftward with a folded elbow while the left arm continues right and lowers. Both knees lengthen as the arms release, then the right hand dips right and climbs into a tighter fold while the left arm sweeps left and tucks. The right arm opens downward, the left arm follows down, and the right knee straightens as the left leg softens beneath a renewed lift of the right hand. The right hand descends and reaches right as the left arm curls upward, then reverses left while the right knee releases and the left knee sinks beneath another rise.

The right knee softens as the dancer lowers and folds both arms, then the right hand lifts left while the left hand rises right; the hands reverse sideways and descend with lengthening elbows. The right arm curls upward, opens down to the left, and tucks again while the left knee bends and straightens beneath a rising elbow. The right hand climbs right, reaches back left, then drops as the left arm extends and the right knee bends. Both knees soften as the hands sweep right and rise, the right arm curling in and the left knee bending deeper before the right hand returns left and extends downward while the left leg straightens. The left hand reverses right and curls upward as the right knee lengthens, then both hands descend with the left elbow opening.

As the right hand rises, the dancer straightens the left knee and sends both hands rightward. The right arm curls upward while the left arm folds downward, then the right hand lowers left as the left hand returns up and left into a tighter tuck. Both arms lengthen with the left hand descending, then the right hand rises and reaches farther left before folding down and sweeping right. The right hand climbs again as the left elbow opens, then both descend and sweep left, the right arm extending. The left hand continues down-left before curling upward, joined by the right hand reaching higher to the left as its own elbow bends.

In opposition, the right arm reaches right and up while the left hand lifts left; both elbows then fold as the hands descend. The right hand sweeps left with an opening elbow, then reverses right and curls upward as the right knee softens, followed by the left arm folding and lifting to the right. Both arms extend down, the left hand shifting right before curling up again, while the right knee bends and straightens beneath a leftward sweep of the right hand. The left arm tucks farther as both hands lower and lengthen, then rises again into a deeper fold while the right hand continues left. The left arm draws inward and lifts left as the right hand climbs right, then both hands reverse sideways and rise, with the left hand descending before both elbows open.

The right knee straightens, then the left knee straightens. The right arm curls upward while the left hand sweeps left and down, then the right elbow opens as both hands descend. Both arms lengthen and fold again before lifting together, with the right hand continuing right; the left knee softens as the left hand lowers and extends. The right arm tucks downward and opens farther left while the left knee bends and releases beneath the rising left arm, then the right knee sinks as the left hand drops and the left knee bends again. The right hand reverses right while the left knee straightens and the left arm folds upward, followed by another bend of the right knee and an extension of the raised left arm as the left knee softens. The right knee releases as the left hand drops, then bends again beneath the right arm's rise, while the left arm curls upward and right.

At the outset, the right hand moves left and down as the right knee straightens, while the left arm extends downward; both hands then rise and separate left and right. The left arm folds and lowers through a bend and release of the left knee, followed by the right arm curling upward over another bend-and-release of the right knee. Both hands sweep left and descend, the left arm lengthening before they return right, with the right hand dropping farther and the right knee softening again. The left hand climbs left as the right knee bends more deeply and the right hand rises, then that raised right hand sweeps right and down while the left hand drops and swings left into an extension. The left knee bends as the left hand returns right and curls upward, finishing with a deeper tuck and continued lift.

As the right arm folds inward, the dancer lifts both hands leftward, then lowers and extends the right arm while the left arm curls upward. The right hand reaches right as the right knee straightens, followed by the left hand moving right and folding down; the right arm tucks as both knees soften, then both arms open into a lift with the right arm curling again. Both hands descend, the left elbow drawing in, before they rise and separate right and left with lengthening elbows. That separation reverses as the right-moving arm curls downward and the left-moving arm opens, then drops left and folds back up rightward over a bending knee. The left arm extends down-right as the bent knee straightens and the right arm opens farther right; the left hand continues lowering before both hands sweep left.

At the outset, the right arm curls upward while the left arm reaches right and lowers; the right hand continues up-right as the right knee bends and releases. The left hand drops left into a fold as the left knee softens, then both hands sweep right with the left arm opening upward while the right arm tucks farther down. Both arms lengthen downward as the left knee straightens, then the hands reverse left before lifting into bent elbows, the right hand returning right as the left hand dips. The right arm opens and folds again while the left knee bends, then both rise, the right elbow releasing before both hands descend and the left knee sinks further. Both hands climb and separate sideways, the left arm folding and dropping as the left knee straightens and the right arm extends, then curls upward while the right knee releases and the left knee bends again. The right hand rises farther and sweeps left as the right knee softens and the left arm unfolds.

The arms exchange height: the right hand rises as the right knee straightens, while the left hand drops, curls and sweeps left; the raised right arm then folds downward and right. The lowered left arm opens down-right before returning left and up into a curl, followed by the right hand rising leftward and both elbows drawing inward. Both hands descend and the knees soften as the hands separate right and left, then the right-moving arm extends upward and reverses left while the left elbow opens and refolds. The folded left arm continues left and lifts as the right hand moves right, then both climb before the lifted left arm reaches right and the right hand lowers into a tucked return left. The right hand climbs farther left and lengthens while the left hand descends right and the left knee bends, ending with the left arm folding back left.

As the right knee straightens, the dancer softens the left knee and lifts both hands into a leftward sweep, then lengthens the left arm while the left knee bends further. The right arm extends downward as the right knee straightens; the left hand curls down and right before both arms tuck and rise, the right hand moving right. Both elbows open and lower, with the left hand sweeping left and curling upward again as the right knee softens. The right knee straightens and bends once more while the right arm extends up-right and the left hand rises left, then both knees straighten and the hands descend with opening elbows. The left hand reaches right as the right arm folds and carries the right hand right, then reverses left into an extension.

As the right hand moves left, the dancer curls the left arm upward and right while the right hand rises, then lowers and continues left into an extension. Both arms fold as the right hand reverses right and climbs, while the left elbow releases; the hands descend together with lengthening arms. The right arm reaches up and right as the left arm curls upward, then both hands lower and sweep left, the right hand lifting again before both elbows tuck. The hands rise together, the right arm extending farther right as the left knee straightens and the left hand drops left. The knees bend in succession beneath a rightward return of the right hand, which then folds and lowers as the left hand rises right and the left knee straightens again.

To begin, the dancer curls the right arm up and right as the left hand lowers, then sends the right hand left while both knees straighten. The left arm folds into a lift and returns down-right with an opening elbow as the right hand reverses right. Both hands climb and spread left and right, the left arm lengthening downward before curling upward again; the right hand descends and folds in as the right knee bends. The right hand rises right and opens while the left knee softens and the left hand drops, then curls back up-left as the left knee extends and the right hand lifts farther right. The dancer reaches the right hand down-right and releases the left knee, then tucks the right elbow and draws the right hand left as both knees bend.

The right arm reaches right and down while the left arm curls up-left, then the right arm reverses left as the right knee straightens. The right hand continues right and rises into a fold while the left arm opens downward and sweeps right; both knees lengthen before the left arm tucks back left and lifts. Both hands descend with the elbows releasing, then rise again as the right knee bends and straightens and the left hand swings right and back left. The left arm curls upward while the right arm extends left, then both arms climb and fold as their knees soften, with the right hand reversing right and the left hand descending toward the right. The left knee straightens as the left arm opens downward, followed by the right knee extending while the right hand reaches left and returns right.

The dancer lifts the right hand rightward and curls the left arm upward. The right knee straightens. The right hand reverses left while the left arm extends down, then both hands lower as the right elbow folds and the right knee softens. The left hand rises into a curl, followed by the right hand as the right knee straightens; both hands sweep left before dropping, with the left arm opening downward and the right arm curling up and right. Both arms tuck again, the left hand lifting as the right knee bends and releases, then both arms descend and lengthen as the right knee sinks once more. The right arm folds and lifts left while the left arm reaches farther left and drops, then both elbows open and the right hand sweeps right as the right knee bends. The left knee straightens before the right hand returns left and curls upward, joined by the rising left hand and the bending of the left knee.

As the right knee straightens, the dancer sends the left hand down-right and lengthens the left arm, then curls the right hand upward to the right while the left knee softens. The raised right hand reverses left as the left leg extends, while the lower left hand moves left and both knees bend; the hands then separate sideways, the left hand climbing before dropping into a shared rightward sweep as the right leg straightens. Both arms fold, then the left hand rises left as the left knee bends and releases beneath an extension of the right arm, which curls back up-left while the left arm tucks further. The right knee softens and straightens as the tucked left arm opens downward and sweeps left, while the right arm folds up-right and the right knee bends again. The right folded arm reaches farther right and down as the right knee extends, then returns left and up with a deeper curl.

The right hand sweeps right and down, then returns left while the left arm curls upward and the right knee straightens. Then both hands lower as the left arm opens. The right hand lifts through a right-to-left sweep while the left arm folds downward and reaches left. Both hands rise, then the left arm tucks back down as the right arm extends and drops. The left arm opens into a lift toward the right while the right arm lengthens leftward and lowers. Then the right hand reverses left and down as the right knee bends and the left knee straightens. Both elbows fold as the right hand moves right and up over a deeper knee bend, while the left arm opens downward. The right hand continues right and descends, followed by the left hand lifting into a shared leftward sweep that tightens the right elbow. The right elbow releases as the left hand drops and the right knee bends further, then both hands return right with the right arm folding again.

An alternating lift-and-fall exchange begins with both hands moving left, the left hand rising while the right elbow folds and the right knee softens. The right arm opens downward as the left hand curls upward, then both knees straighten and the left hand swings right and down. Both arms lengthen toward the right, the right hand lifting before dropping into a tuck as the left hand continues right and lowers; the left knee bends while the right arm reaches farther right and back left. The left bent knee releases as the right hand rises rightward, the right knee extending, before both hands descend and sweep left with the right elbow opening and the left elbow folding. The right hand rebounds up-right against the left hand's downward-left reach, then lowers into a curl as the right knee softens; the left hand follows down-right before both rise and return left, the right elbow tightening further.

Both hands sweep left. The dancer lifts the right hand and extends it rightward, then curls both arms upward as the knees soften in succession, sending the hands down and back left with opening elbows before bending the right knee and raising the right arm again. Both hands rise into folded arms while the left knee straightens, then the right hand lowers and extends right as the left knee bends and releases; the right hand reverses up-left and tucks while the left arm reaches farther right. The right arm opens downward and sweeps left as the right knee lengthens, then returns up-right and curls while the left hand drops rightward and rises into a fold over another bend of the right knee. The hands climb apart toward right and left as the right elbow tightens and the right knee releases, then both descend with the left arm extending and the right curling further. The left hand moves right and folds while the right hand rises and the right knee straightens; both hands sweep left, the right arm opening as the right knee softens, before the left arm extends upward and the right continues rightward and down.

The dancer lowers and lengthens the right arm. The left hand sweeps left and rises, then the right arm curls up to the right while the left arm drops, folds farther inward and lifts left. The right hand continues right as the left hand moves down-left; both arms open, with the right hand curling again as the right knee softens. The right arm reaches down-right while the left hand lifts, and the right knee straightens as both hands rise, the right elbow folding before opening into another drop and a rightward lift. The left arm lengthens downward while the right hand lowers, swings left and returns right as the left hand rises and tucks. The right arm folds upward to the left, then opens back right.

As the right hand drops and the right arm extends, the dancer straightens the right knee, then folds the right arm upward while the left knee softens. The right arm opens right as the left hand reaches left and both knees bend, before the left hand rises with a curling elbow and the left knee lengthens. Both hands lower and sweep left as the right knee straightens further; they reverse right and climb into tucked elbows, then descend again with the left knee bending. The right arm lengthens upward and curls back down and right as the right knee extends, while the left hand rises and moves right before both return left and the right elbow tucks farther. The right hand lowers with an opening arm as the right knee bends, while the left hand lifts and sweeps left with a deeper fold, then returns right and down as both knees soften.

The dancer folds both arms and lifts both hands. Then the right knee straightens, then bends again as the left hand dips left and curls upward while the right arm extends right. The right arm opens down-left, curls back up-right, and releases downward as the left knee softens; that right hand then rises and reaches farther right before lowering and folding back left as the right knee lengthens. Both hands sweep right, the right hand climbing into a tuck while the left hand drops, then both hands reverse left with the right hand opening before both elbows fold and the right hand returns right. The left hand continues right as the right hand curls up-left and both knees bend, then both hands descend and open outward with the right knee straightening. The right arm folds back right while the left arm reaches up-left and the left knee straightens; both hands rise with the left elbow tucking, then separate right and left as the right knee lengthens and the left hand lowers.

A rising-and-falling arm figure begins with the right hand moving left and curling upward as the left knee straightens, then lowers while both hands sweep right. The right hand returns up-left into a fold as the left hand curls higher and drops over a bend of the left knee. Both hands descend, then the right hand rebounds upward to the left with an extending elbow while the left hand travels right and down. The left hand reverses left as the right hand continues down-right; the right arm folds before opening again. The dancer lifts the right hand into a curl while the left hand sweeps right and drops, then both arms tuck as the left hand moves left.

The dancer raises and lowers the right arm. The left hand moves right as the raised right arm curls up, then both hands sweep left with the right arm reaching farther upward. Both elbows fold before the hands separate, the initially lowered left arm extending right while the right arm climbs right and tucks more deeply; the left knee softens as the right-moving left hand reverses left and drops. The left knee straightens beneath a rightward reach of the lower left hand, which then curls upward against the right arm's downward extension. Both hands descend as the right arm folds and sweeps left, followed by a rightward lift of the left arm.

As the right arm curls upward, the dancer extends the left arm down, then sends both hands right with the right hand rising before they fold and descend. The right hand sweeps left while the left knee straightens and the left arm reaches up-right; the right knee softens as the right hand returns left and curls upward over a bend of the right knee. Both knees lengthen as the hands sweep left and the right arm rises into a tighter curl, then the left arm opens right and drops while the right arm lowers and extends right. The right knee bends again as the left hand climbs right, both arms folding before the right hand reverses left and the right knee releases; the left hand follows left as the right arm opens. The right elbow tucks and the right hand lifts toward the right while the left arm lengthens downward, then both hands rise, the right arm opening as the right knee softens. The left hand swings left and back right while the right arm curls upward over another right knee bend, then both lower and extend as the left knee lengthens.

The dancer moves leftward, carrying the left hand while the right hand drops and opens, then both hands rise as the left arm folds. The left hand sweeps right, down, and back left with an unfolding elbow. The right hand climbs and lengthens farther up-left as the left knee straightens, then lowers and tucks in while the right hand curls upward to the left and the right knee sinks. Both arms extend downward, the right hand continuing left before the hands reverse sideways, the left hand rising right as the right knee bends again. The right arm folds and lifts left while the left knee softens and the left hand travels right; both knees release as the right hand returns right and rises into a tighter curl. The left arm folds higher to the right over another left knee bend while the right hand continues right, then reverses left and descends as the left knee straightens and the right hand sweeps left.

A rising fold-and-release pulse begins as the dancer curls the right arm upward, sends the left hand right, and opens both arms before lowering them. The right hand swings left and returns right into a tuck while the left hand rises, then both lift with bent elbows and sweep left. The right arm extends downward as the left arm drops and reaches right, followed by another rise of the left hand and an opening toward the left. The hands exchange height again, the right arm curling upward while the left lowers and unfolds; the right hand then dips and rebounds as the left climbs, folds, and descends to the right. The left hand continues farther right and drops while the right arm curls upward and moves left.

As the right arm folds and the left arm lengthens downward, the dancer sends both hands left and lowers them with a curl of the right arm. Both arms open as the right hand returns right, then lift together before the left elbow tucks and the left hand sweeps left. The left arm extends upward while the right hand drops, then the left arm folds again as both hands move left and the right arm releases; the left hand reverses right. The right arm curls upward to the right as the left arm opens down and left, then both elbows draw in while the right hand lifts and continues left. Both hands rise and separate sideways, the right hand right and the left hand left, before the right arm lengthens and the left arm folds into another shared descent.

As the right arm folds, the dancer lifts both hands, carrying them left and lowering them into an open reach. The left hand returns right with a bent elbow while the right arm curls upward and the right knee softens; the left hand then drops as the right arm sweeps left and back right with an extended arm. Both arms lengthen through a low leftward sweep, then rise as the knees straighten in succession. The hands reverse right and down, the right arm tucking before opening, followed by the left arm curling upward and returning left. The left hand climbs farther as the right hand reaches right and rises, then both hands descend together.

The knees join the arm exchange after the dancer lifts the right hand right and lowers it as the left hand reaches left. The right hand curls up-right while the left hand continues down-left, then both arms descend and reverse sideways. The left arm folds upward as the right knee bends, followed by a lift of the right arm over another bend in the right knee. That raised right hand sweeps left as both arms extend and the right knee straightens, then curls back up-right before dropping over another bend. Both hands rise again, the left hand moving right into a tuck as the left knee softens, while the right arm opens downward.

The right hand rises leftward as the left hand drops, then both hands climb and sweep right. The right arm folds downward while the left arm curls upward, followed by a dip of the right hand. The right hand rises again, reaches right and descends as the right knee straightens, then curls up and left into an extended reach. The left arm lifts and opens right while the right arm continues climbing and lengthening, ending with a drop to the right as the left arm folds down.

The right knee straightens as the dancer lifts the right hand rightward into a fold, then softens the right knee while the left arm curls upward and left. The raised right hand reverses right with an opening elbow as the left arm sweeps down-right and lengthens. The left arm tucks left, opens downward, then rises back right as the right knee beneath it bends and releases. The left hand lowers, folds, and reaches farther left as the right knee sinks again; the right arm lengthens up-left before both hands descend, the right knee straightening while the left hand moves right. The arms curl upward and separate sideways, the right arm continuing rightward as the left knee bends.

As the right arm curls upward, the dancer lengthens the left arm downward and right, then straightens the right knee beneath the rising right hand while that hand reaches farther up and left. The left knee bends as the left arm opens, then both hands drop before the right arm extends right and the right knee releases. The left arm folds as the right hand continues right and climbs, then opens while the left hand rises left; both elbows tuck as the left hand lowers and the right hand moves right. The left arm opens while the right hand descends, then reverses right and folds back down-left as the left hand lifts left into a curl. The left hand sweeps right and rises with a deeper fold, followed by the right hand climbing left as both arms extend and the left knee softens.

The right hand reaches right and rises into a fold while the left arm curls upward; the right hand returns left as the right knee bends, then both hands descend with the left elbow opening. The hands sweep right and climb, the right hand folding before they separate left and right with both arms extending. They reverse inward, the left hand curling up-left and the right hand descending right, before the right hand lengthens down-left and the left hand climbs back right. Both hands rise with folded elbows as the left arm opens downward and the right knee softens, then the right hand lifts into another curl while the left arm extends down-left. The right hand returns right and folds as the left arm lengthens down-right, then both sweep left and rise with the left elbow tucked.

The right hand drops and sweeps left. The left arm reaches down-left as the right knee softens, while the right hand lifts right and curls inward; the left knee straightens as the left hand rises rightward, then both knees bend again and the right hand lowers toward the right. The arms open in opposite directions, the right hand climbing left before folding back right and down while the left arm curls upward, then the hands reverse sideways and descend with the left arm lengthening. Both elbows tuck as the right knee bends and the right arm continues left, then opens while the left knee sinks further; the hands separate left and right, rise with folded elbows, and return toward each other before lowering. The left hand swings left and up-right while the right arm extends, then reverses left as the right elbow folds and the right knee softens; the left hand dips and rebounds rightward into a curl while the right hand climbs right and lowers as the right knee releases. The right hand reaches up-right, the right knee bends, and the arm tucks farther right before dropping and extending through another knee bend; the left hand lifts leftward and falls as the left leg straightens. The right arm gathers inward once more while the left knee softens and the left hand moves right.

To the right, the right arm folds as the dancer raises both hands, then sends the right hand left and down while the left hand climbs. The right arm lengthens farther left before both hands return right, the right arm curling upward as the left knee straightens and the right knee bends. Both arms tuck through a shared downward-left sweep, then the right hand reverses right into an extension while the left arm lifts and opens over another right knee bend. The left hand returns left and curls up as the right knee softens again; the right arm reaches down-right, followed by the left hand descending and opening. The dancer repeats the rising, leftward fold of the left hand with a right knee bend, then extends it back right as the right arm draws in over a straightening leg.

The dancer lengthens the right arm. The left hand drops and sweeps left while the right arm moves right, then the left arm rises into a fold as the right knee bends. Both hands descend with the right arm reaching farther right and the left arm extending, then the hands reverse sideways as the right knee straightens and the right arm curls upward. The right hand travels right and down while the left arm opens and lowers, the left knee softening as the right hand returns left; the left arm folds back right before both hands sweep left. The right knee bends beneath a rightward reach of the right arm, then both hands rise with the right arm curling inward and the left arm opening. The knees straighten together as the right arm extends downward and the left arm reaches higher, ending with the right hand moving right and the left hand returning left.

The right hand rises left while the left hand extends downward. Then the right arm opens and lowers as the right knee softens. The left hand curls up-left over the left bending knee. Then the right arm folds upward to the right. Both hands sweep left and descend. The right hand rebounds up-right and drops again, joined by the left hand's upward reach, while the right knee straightens. The right hand continues down-right as the left hand moves down-left and lengthens. Then the right hand returns up-right as the left knee bends and the left hand sinks farther. Both arms extend downward. The left hand moves left before sweeping up-right alongside the right hand.

The dancer performs a rising, alternating arm exchange: the right hand lifts right and curls back left as the left arm extends, then the right hand climbs farther while the left knee straightens. The left arm folds upward and reaches down as the left knee softens and the right arm lengthens, then the right arm curls up again while the left hand rises and both knees bend further. The left hand continues climbing with an increasingly tucked elbow as the right hand lowers and opens, accompanied by a deeper bend in the right knee. The right hand swings left and back right before lifting into a fold, while the left arm tucks and the left knee straightens; both hands descend and the elbows release. Both arms curl upward and sweep left, the right hand lowering as the left hand rises, before the right knee bends and straightens beneath a rightward extension of the left arm. The right hand continues right and upward as the left knee sinks, while the right arm folds, releases, and moves right once more.

As the right arm folds down and right, the dancer lifts the left hand and extends it left, then lowers both hands while opening the right elbow. Both arms lengthen upward, the left hand continuing left as the right knee softens; the left arm curls back right and down before both hands rise again. The left arm reaches left and drops as the left knee bends and the right hand rises with a fold, then the hands trade height and sweep left together. The right arm opens downward and returns up and right, while the left hand drops left and rebounds up and right over a bend-and-release of the right knee. The right hand climbs farther left and unfolds as the left hand travels left and down over another bend-and-release beneath it, then sweeps right with an extended elbow while the right knee softens.

The right knee straightens as the dancer extends the right arm upward and the left hand lifts leftward, then lowers the right hand into a rightward reach while the left elbow folds. The right arm curls up and returns left as the right knee softens, then drops open and reverses right; the left knee bends while the right hand sweeps down-left and back right. Both hands lower, the right arm extending farther before both elbows tuck and the left knee straightens. The right hand rises leftward as the knees alternate bending and straightening, with the left hand lifting before descending and opening, followed by another bend of the right knee. Both hands rise with tucked elbows as the right knee lengthens again, then sweep left and descend before reversing rightward.

The right knee bends and straightens as the dancer sends the left hand left and down while the right hand rises right, then both hands lift with the right elbow folding before the left lowers and extends. The right arm lengthens downward as the right knee softens, then the left knee straightens beneath a rising rightward right hand while the left hand curls up-right; both knees bend in succession as the right hand continues upward and the left drops. Both arms tuck and sweep left, the left knee extending as the right bends deeper, then the hands separate left and right with opening elbows before reversing inward. The left knee straightening accompanies another lift of the left hand into a fold, followed by the right arm curling upward; the left hand lowers as the right drops and extends. Both hands rise again, the left continuing right and curling while the right returns left and folds, then the right drops as the left sweeps left and opens.

The dancer lowers both hands; the right hand continues down as the right arm lengthens. The left hand sweeps right and climbs while the right hand moves left, then the right hand rises and shifts right with a folding elbow. The left arm extends farther up and right before dropping back left, joined by the right hand moving left and curling upward. Both arms open again as the hands separate horizontally, then descend, the left arm reaching farther right.

A rising arm exchange begins with the right hand curling up-left while the left hand reaches right and rises; both elbows fold before the hands separate right and left, then open as the right hand drops and the left hand lowers into a shared leftward sweep. The right arm curls upward, extends down-right and folds again, while the left elbow tucks and opens; the hands reverse sideways and rise, the right hand drawing inward before both descend and lengthen. The hands separate again, the right hand moving left and both arms folding as they climb, then spread apart and lower, the right elbow opening while the left arm stays bent. Both hands lift and reach right, the right hand extending before both return left as the left arm curls; the right hand follows left and tucks into another rising reach, then sweeps right and falls while the left arm releases downward. The left arm curls up-right as the right hand returns left and lifts, then both hands drop, the right hand continuing right and unfolding while the left hand reverses right.

As the right knee softens, the dancer lowers both hands and sends them right, then lifts the left hand while the right knee straightens. The right hand reverses left as both arms extend, then the left hand drops and sweeps left with a deeper reach. Both hands rise before the left hand continues up and right, curling as the right arm folds and the right knee bends again. The left curled hand dips and rebounds upward, joined by the right arm reaching higher; the left hand then travels left and down.

The right knee straightens as the dancer curls the right arm upward, then lowers both hands and extends the right arm leftward while the left hand moves right. The right hand rises again as the right knee bends and the left leg straightens, before the right hand sweeps right and down with an opening elbow as the right knee lengthens further. The left hand lifts and folds into a leftward sweep, while the right hand swings right and back left; the left arm reaches down and right, then curls upward as the right knee softens. The right knee straightens while the left hand continues left and rises with a bend, then the right arm tucks and releases as the right hand drops and returns left. The left knee bends again while the right arm opens downward, then both legs extend as the hands separate sideways and rise together. The right arm curls right while the left knee softens, and both hands descend with the tucked elbow opening as the left knee straightens.

At the outset, the right arm curls upward and lengthens down to the right while the left hand travels left; both rise with bent elbows, then separate sideways as the hands lower. The right arm folds farther, sweeps up and left into a deeper tuck, then releases downward and returns right. The right hand climbs again and drops while the left arm opens and lowers, before both lift toward the left. The hands descend together, the right arm extending farther as the left arm curls back up to the left. Both arms reach down and right before folding upward, then drop again with the left hand returning left.

As the right arm lengthens downward, the left hand rises left and folds. The right hand curls up-left, then drops while the left arm sweeps right with an opening elbow. Both hands rise and move right, the right arm extending before curling back left and upward as the left arm tucks. The right hand dips right while the left hand continues left; both elbows open and the left hand descends. The right arm reaches farther down-right as the left arm extends left and lifts.

As the right hand rises leftward, the dancer folds both arms and lifts the left hand, then lowers both while the left arm opens. The right arm curls right as the left arm reaches left and drops, then extends down-left against the left hand's rightward sweep. Both hands climb with folded elbows and separate left and right, then descend as the right arm releases and the left knee softens. The hands reverse inward, the right hand moving right and the left hand moving left before they rise together. The left arm unfolds as the hands return apart, the right elbow tucking while the left knee straightens.

The right hand drops as the left hand sweeps right, down and back left with a bent elbow, while the left lower arm curls upward; the right hand follows left. The right knee softens as the left hand moves right and both arms fold downward, then both hands shift left before lifting into extending elbows, the right knee straightening and the left knee bending as the hands separate sideways. The right hand returns right and rises while the right knee lengthens further, the left arm opening rightward, folding and reopening left before curling back up as the left knee bends. Both knees sink in succession beneath an unfolding reach of the left arm, which then folds again as the right knee extends and the right hand climbs farther right; both knees release before the left leg bends and the right arm curls inward. The left hand lowers and reaches left as the left knee straightens, then both arms open downward and the right hand returns left before the left hand lifts and both hands rise together. The right arm curls as the left arm extends left, then both descend with the right hand moving right and its elbow tucking more deeply.

As the right hand rises right and the left hand drops, the dancer lifts the left hand into a fold while the right arm extends. Both hands descend as the left arm opens and the right knee softens, then they rise together with the right elbow drawing in again. The left arm curls inward before reaching down to the right and reopening, while the right hand moves left and climbs through an extension and tuck. The right arm lengthens downward as the left arm folds, sweeps up to the left and reverses right, then both arms gather as the knees bend in succession. The right hand continues down and left while the left knee straightens and the left hand lowers; the right arm releases down-right as the left elbow opens, the left knee bends and the right knee sinks farther.

To begin, the dancer lowers and extends the right arm while the left arm folds left and lifts, then sweeps both hands right with the right hand rising and the left arm opening. The left hand returns left as the right knee softens and the right arm curls upward, then the hands separate left and right before both arms fold and descend into a rightward sweep. Both knees bend as the left hand drops, then the sweeping right arm opens and lifts while the left arm rises left; the right arm curls back down and left as the right knee straightens, followed by the left hand dropping and extending. The right arm reaches right while the left hand moves left and the left knee bends, then both hands rise and return toward each other before descending with the right arm folding and the left arm opening. The hands separate once more, the right arm extending while the left arm curls upward, before the right hand reverses up and right as the left arm lengthens downward.

As the right arm curls upward, the dancer straightens the right knee and sweeps the right hand right, then lowers and lengthens the right arm as both knees soften. The hands separate left and right before both rise with bent elbows, the right hand returning left as the right knee extends and the left hand drops into an opening reach. The left hand swings right and down while the right knee bends deeper, then returns left as the right arm tucks; both knees straighten as the right hand rises, followed by the left arm curling upward. The right hand moves right and opens downward as the left arm continues its rise, then both sweep left and descend with lengthening arms, the left arm lifting again as the right hand reverses right. Both elbows fold through a shared rightward sweep and return left, then the right arm extends upward and reopens as the left elbow releases.

As the right hand moves right and down, the dancer lifts the left hand and lowers it again, extending both arms before curling them upward. The right hand continues right into a deeper fold while the left hand reaches left and rises; the bent left arm then opens downward as the right arm reverses right and curls upward. Both hands sweep left with another fold in the right arm, followed by a rightward extension of the right arm and a lift of the left hand, which then tucks back left. The right arm gathers upward and releases right as the left knee bends and straightens, the left hand lifting farther before dropping and lengthening; the right hand follows down and left, opening its elbow as the right knee softens. Both hands rise, the right arm folding right while the left arm extends left and lowers, then the right hand drops and both arms open before curling upward.

The right knee straightens as the dancer sends the right hand right and curls the left hand upward to the left. The right arm extends down while the left moves farther left, then both hands rise with the left elbow folding. Both arms lengthen downward, the left hand drifting right and returning left as the knees soften in succession; the right hand travels right and drops while the left rises and curls inward. Both hands sweep left with folded elbows before the right arm opens downward and the left returns right and tucks again. The left hand lowers while the right moves right and climbs into a fold, then both return left, the right rising higher as the right knee bends further.

The right arm folds and carries the right hand right. The left hand rises, then both hands sweep left with the left arm curling inward before descending together. Both hands return right as the right arm lowers and extends farther, while the left arm continues down and opens. The left hand sweeps left and up with a bent elbow, then drops into a straighter arm as it reverses right.

At the outset, the dancer lowers both hands and sends them left with lengthening arms. The hands rise together as the right knee straightens, then both elbows fold while the right knee bends again and the left hand sweeps right. Both knees soften as the hands descend and separate into an upward curling lift, the right arm extending right before both lower and tuck inward. The right hand continues down-right with a deeper bend in the right knee while the left elbow opens, then the hands separate sideways as the right knee straightens. The hands reverse their lateral paths and climb, the right hand continuing right with a bent elbow and the left hand moving left as both knees release.

As the right arm curls upward, the dancer lifts and folds the left arm, then sends both hands right with the right hand descending as the right knee straightens. The left arm opens downward while the right arm reaches left and lengthens, before both hands rise into folded elbows, the right arm returning right. The hands descend together, then separate left and right as the left elbow extends and the right elbow tucks farther; both arms curl upward again and the hands sweep left, with the right arm dropping and opening. Both hands lift once more, the left arm reaching right and the right arm folding down to the right, then both return left and climb before the right arm lowers again.
