Both hands continue left, the right elbow opening as the right knee bends, before the right hand rises right and the left hand drops and moves left.

The dancer lowers both hands. The right arm curls upward while the left arm reaches down and right, then reverses left as the right hand drops and extends. Both hands sweep right, the left elbow tucking as the left hand lifts, before the left hand swings left and returns right with an opening elbow. The right hand rises right as the left knee bends, then sweeps left into a fold while the right knee straightens and the left hand moves right. Both hands descend as the left knee lengthens and the right arm opens; the left hand continues right and lowers while the right hand rises and moves right. The left hand curls back up and left as the right arm folds downward, then reaches right while the left arm extends down and left.

The right hand rises and curls left while the left hand extends down-right, then the hands trade height and sideways directions before both arms fold. The left hand reaches up-left as the right hand lifts right and opens, then both elbows tuck while their hands descend, the right hand moving right and the left hand moving left. Both arms lengthen upward and sweep right, then lower and reverse inward toward the left. The left hand climbs left again while the right hand rises, the right knee bending as the right hand returns right; both arms fold as the right leg straightens and the left knee softens. The right hand drops left and extends through a deeper knee bend while the left arm opens right, then the right hand reverses right and curls upward as the left hand moves left and lowers into another fold.

To begin, the dancer folds the right arm upward and sweeps both hands left as the left elbow opens; the left hand rises farther before curling back right while the right arm extends. The left knee bends as the left hand lowers and the left arm tucks, then both hands move right with the left arm lifting while the right knee sinks further beneath a descending hand. The lifted hand drops into an extended reach as the bent left knee straightens, followed by the right knee lengthening; both arms fold as their hands rise, then open with the right hand continuing up and left. The hands reverse right and lower with both elbows drawing inward, then separate left and right before returning together to the right and rising. The left hand sweeps left and down as the right knee softens, then both sweep left, the right knee extending while the lowered left arm curls upward and the right arm reaches farther left. Both hands descend with the left arm opening and the right elbow folding.

Rightward, the right hand sweeps while the left hand travels left and down; the right-moving arm lengthens farther as the left knee straightens. The hands reverse sideways, the right hand rising into a fold and returning left while the left hand curls up to the right. The right hand drops right as the left hand extends downward, then both lift with the left arm folding. That folded left arm opens upward and sweeps left before tucking again as the left knee softens, while the right hand lowers. Both hands descend together, the right hand moving right and the left hand continuing left.

The right knee bends and releases as the dancer lifts the right hand with a folded elbow and carries it right, while the left arm curls upward. The right arm extends down and left as the left knee softens, then both hands rise and sweep right with the left knee straightening before the left hand lowers. Both arms open downward, then fold into another shared lift, the right hand moving left while the left hand travels right. The right hand returns right and rises into a tighter curl as the right knee bends, while the left arm tucks farther and the left knee sinks; the right hand drops and lengthens as the right knee releases. The right knee bends again beneath a renewed leftward lift of the right hand while the left elbow opens, then both knees soften as the right hand reverses right and both arms draw inward.

The right hand drops as the left hand travels right and down, then both hands rise into a shared leftward sweep with the left arm lengthening. The hands separate sideways and descend before reversing inward, the left hand continuing lower and farther in as the right knee softens. Both arms open upward while the left knee bends further; the right hand swings left, right and back left as the left knee straightens, then both arms fold and the hands descend. The right hand continues left as the right knee extends, both elbows release and the hands lift into a shared rightward sweep, the left knee bending before it straightens again. The right arm curls downward and left while the left arm folds more tightly, then opens as the bent knee sinks once more and the right hand rises. The left hand lifts through an extension and a curl, followed by the right arm opening upward and the left elbow releasing downward.

The right arm folds and releases as the dancer lifts both hands, then sweeps them right with the left elbow tucking. The right arm curls higher while the left hand drops left and lengthens, followed by the right hand lowering and opening. The right hand rebounds up and left with a tighter fold while the left knee bends and straightens beneath a rising elbow. Both hands reverse right and lower as the bent left knee deepens, the right arm extending before the left knee straightens and both hands return left. The right hand rises again as the left knee softens, then the left arm reaches right while the left knee extends and the raised right hand descends.

The dancer curls the right arm. The right hand rises rightward while the left arm extends down and left, then the right elbow opens as the right knee straightens and both hands move left. The left arm folds upward while the right arm continues left with a bent elbow; the right hand lowers right and reverses left as the left hand lifts, then returns right and drops while the right arm travels left. Both arms curl upward and sweep right before the left arm opens downward and the right hand sinks. The left arm lengthens farther down, while the right arm tucks and rises as the right knee bends. The left hand moves right and curls up through a bend and release of the left knee.

A rising, folding arm exchange begins with the left hand lifting left and the right hand curling upward to the right, then both arms lengthen as the left hand reverses right. The hands lower in succession, the right hand tucking farther while the left hand continues down and reaches right. Both hands rise again, the right hand moving right and opening before returning left and descending into a fold, while the left arm curls up toward the right. The right hand rises and extends as the left hand reaches left, then both sweep left and descend with opening elbows. The right arm folds once more while the left arm lengthens.

The right knee softens as the dancer lifts both hands, then the left hand swings right and back left while the right knee straightens. The left knee bends as the right arm curls upward to the left; both knees lengthen before the hands sweep right and the right knee bends again. Both arms open downward, the right hand returning left as the right knee straightens, then both elbows fold and the hands rise toward the right. The right hand dips and rebounds upward with a tighter curl while the left arm extends down and left; the bent knee releases as both hands descend, the right hand moving right and the left hand reversing right. Both hands lift with tucked elbows as the right knee softens, then the right hand drops and both arms lengthen while the left knee bends. The right arm curls up and left as the left knee straightens and its elbow opens, then the raised arm reaches farther left and down while the right knee releases.

The arms separate, the right hand dropping while the left hand rises and lengthens over a softening knee. The right arm extends down and left as the left hand continues climbing right, then curls upward toward the right while the right hand drops farther left and opens. The left arm releases downward as the right hand lifts into a fold, then both rise before the right hand reaches down and left and returns up and right with an opening elbow. The left hand sweeps left and down as both knees bend, then the hands climb and separate left and right before descending together. Both elbows tuck through another shared lift, the left hand swinging left and returning right against the right hand's leftward sweep, ending with the right arm folding as the left arm extends.

The dancer alternates arm curls with knee bends: the right hand drops and rises as the left arm extends right, then both arms sweep left with the left arm folding while the left knee softens. The right knee bends as the left hand returns right and tucks, then both hands rise, the left knee straightens and the right knee softens before both arms curl downward and lengthen. The right knee releases again as the right hand climbs right against the left arm's leftward reach and fold; the right arm tucks down and sweeps left while the left arm opens upward. The right knee bends farther as the hands reverse sideways, the left elbow gathering inward and the left hand lowering. The left hand continues down-left while the right hand moves right and lifts with an extending arm, then reverses left as the left arm curls and lifts over a straightening right knee.

The knees join the arm exchange: the right knee softens as the right hand drops and curls right, while the left knee bends beneath a descending leftward sweep that folds inward. The dancer straightens both knees as the hands rise, then lengthens the right arm over the initially bent right knee into a shared rightward reach. The right arm curls down and left while the left knee bends and the left hand lowers; the right arm extends farther left before folding again as the left knee releases. Both arms open downward with an opposing hand sweep to the right and left, then fold upward as the right knee bends and straightens. The hands separate sideways and descend into another shared rightward sweep, then reverse their sideways paths.

The right knee softens as the dancer curls the left arm upward, then both hands sweep right with the left hand continuing higher before the right hand drops. The left hand lowers into a lengthening reach and returns left while the right hand moves right; the right knee straightens, then bends again as the left hand reverses left and the left knee releases. The left hand sweeps up-right and back down-left while the right hand folds downward, the right knee bending and releasing as it continues down-right. Both arms extend through another rising-and-falling gesture on the opposite side, then the left hand lifts left with a deeper curl while the right knee bends and the right arm tucks left. The right hand rises as the right knee straightens, then the left arm opens downward while the lifted right arm extends farther left and down.

Leftward and upward, the left hand curls as the right arm folds, then the left hand returns right while the right knee straightens. The right arm opens down and left, followed by the left hand's descent and another release of the right knee. The left hand continues left while the right hand moves right and rises into a bend; the left arm extends down, then curls back up to the left as the right knee lengthens further. The right hand sweeps right and lowers as both arms fold, before both hands shift left.

A rising arm exchange begins with the dancer folding the right arm while the left hand moves right, then lowering both hands and opening the right arm as the left knee softens. The initially raised left hand lifts and extends farther left as the bent left leg straightens and the left arm curls upward; the left hand continues left before dropping and reopening as the left knee bends again. The right arm folds up-right while the left hand returns right, then rises as the bent left knee releases; the right hand sweeps down-left and back right while the left arm opens downward, followed by a curling lift of the right hand and another drop of the left. Both arms lengthen downward, then the left hand sweeps left while the right knee bends and the right arm tucks upward. The right hand descends and reaches right as the right knee straightens and the left hand follows right, then both elbows open as the right hand lowers and the left hand reverses left. The right hand rises while the left arm folds and drops, ending with the knees straightening in succession.

At the outset, the right arm folds while the left arm reaches down-left, then both hands rise as the left arm curls and the left knee bends. The right hand moves right as the left knee straightens, while the left arm opens downward; both elbows then tuck as the right hand drops and sweeps left. Both arms lengthen downward with the right knee softening, before the hands reverse right and the right elbow bends again. The left knee straightens as the right arm extends left and the left arm curls upward and right, followed by another bend of the left knee as the right elbow folds and the right hand rises. The left arm opens left and lowers as the knees alternate their bends and straighten, then the right knee bends while the left hand returns up-right and the right arm reaches right.

As the right arm curls upward, the dancer folds the left arm and lowers the left hand left. The right hand moves right while the left arm opens, then both hands sweep left as the left arm tucks again. The hands return right, the right arm lifting before extending downward while the left knee bends and straightens. The left hand reverses left with a lengthening arm and continues down, joined by the right hand moving left.

A low, sweeping arm figure begins with the left hand reaching left as the right hand rises and moves right. The left hand climbs while the right knee bends and straightens; the right arm folds down-left before both hands sweep right, the left hand continuing down-right and curling back up-left as the right knee softens. Both arms open and the knees lengthen, then the hands separate left and right before descending into another fold and reversal of sideways directions. The hands rise with bent elbows as the right knee extends and the left leg straightens, then the left hand returns left and opens downward while the right hand continues right. Both hands sweep left and descend as the left knee sinks, followed by a rightward return with the right arm extending.

The dancer lifts the left hand leftward. The right arm folds and releases downward as the raised left hand drops, then the right knee softens while both hands move right and the right arm curls upward. The right hand rises leftward with a lengthening elbow as the right knee straightens, followed by the left knee extending; both arms fold before the left hand lowers and the right hand reaches farther left and down. The right hand swings right and back left into an upward curl as the left knee bends, then returns right and tucks higher as the left knee straightens. The right knee softens and releases beneath a rising rightward reach, then both hands lift with the right arm folding and opening; the left knee extends further as the right hand moves left and lowers with a deeper elbow bend. Both knees bend as the hands descend, then straighten in succession, ending with the left hand moving right and the right knee bending again.

The knees eventually straighten as the dancer sends the left hand left and curls it upward while the right arm folds down and right, then both arms lengthen. The right hand rises into a curl as the left lowers and opens, before the right reaches farther right and down while the left lifts and tucks; their directions reverse and the left knee bends. The left arm extends down and left as its knee straightens, while the right curls upward to the right and opens back down, then repeats a rising rightward fold and lowered release. Both hands move left, the right arm opening downward and sweeping right as the left curls upward, before they return left and rise with the right elbow folding. The right arm releases and tucks again as the left hand drops and its knee bends, then the right hand sweeps right and up before returning left and descending.

To begin, the dancer lowers the right hand and sweeps both hands right with a folding right elbow, then lifts them left into an opening left arm as the left knee straightens. The right hand reverses down to the right while the left arm tucks and the right knee bends, then the right arm curls upward before both hands sweep left and the left arm rises. Both knees lengthen as the hands continue left and lower, the right hand reversing right before the left knee softens and the right hand drops farther. The right arm extends right while the right leg straightens and the left knee follows; the left hand travels right and folds as the right hand returns left and the legs exchange their bend and extension twice. The right knee bends again as the left hand rises and the left knee sinks, then both hands move left with the right elbow curling inward.

The dancer lifts the right hand. Both hands rise, the left arm curling left and back right as the right knee straightens; both arms lengthen downward before the right hand reverses right and the left hand climbs. The right arm folds down-right while the left hand reaches left and drops, then they exchange directions and rise with opening elbows as the right knee softens. Both arms gather inward, the right hand moving left as the right knee bends farther; the left hand follows left and lowers into a tuck, then rises alongside the descending right arm as the right knee releases. The hands sweep right together, then the right hand returns left with an unfolding elbow while the left knee straightens and the lower arm curls upward to the right. The right hand moves right as the left hand lowers and extends, then reverses left and folds while the left arm curls up-right.

The arms move in opposition as the dancer straightens the right knee and lowers the right hand left, then lifts the right hand while the left hand rises right with a bent elbow. The right arm curls up-left, reverses down-right, and drops into an open reach as the left knee lengthens; both hands sweep right and climb, the right elbow folding before both hands descend and the right hand returns left with the right knee softening. The right hand curls upward while the left hand extends down-left and the left knee straightens, then both hands rise with the left arm tucking as the right knee bends again. The right hand drops left as the left hand sweeps right, then both lift with the elbows drawing inward. The right knee extends while the left arm opens left and the left knee bends, then the right hand swings right and back left as the left hand lowers and the left knee straightens. The right arm lengthens downward while the left arm curls up-right, then the left hand moves right and folds back left as both knees soften.

As the right hand rises, the dancer lengthens the left arm and lowers it. The right hand moves right while the left arm curls up-left, then both arms descend with folding elbows as the left hand sweeps right and reverses left. Both arms open again, the right hand lifting and traveling left before curling back down-right, joined by the left hand's descent. The left hand continues down-left as the right arm extends farther down-right, then both hands rise with bent elbows before the right hand drops left and opens into a shared lift. The hands separate left and right and reverse inward, the right arm folding while the left elbow tucks; the left arm then releases and rises.

The right hand curls upward and right. The left hand rises leftward, then both hands descend as the right arm opens and the right knee softens. The right arm folds back up toward the right while the right knee straightens and the left leg lengthens; the left hand reverses left and extends down as the left knee bends again. The right hand sweeps right and back left with a bent elbow while the left knee releases, then returns right and tucks as the left hand drops and the left knee bends once more. The left side lifts its hand left into a fold as the right hand descends, before the left arm opens downward and sweeps right and the right hand continues down-right.

The right hand moves right and down. The left arm extends left as the right arm folds upward, then both hands sweep left and the right arm reaches back right while the left arm curls up toward the right and lowers into a longer reach. Both hands rise with bent elbows before the left hand dips and returns up-right, joined by the right hand's lift; the left elbow opens as its hand reverses left and the right hand descends. The left arm gathers upward while the right hand shifts right and rises, then both lower with the right elbow folding and the left arm extending. The right hand sweeps left as the left arm rises, then the right hand returns right and lifts against the left arm's descent to the right, ending with an open elbow.

An opposing lateral arm exchange begins as the dancer sends the right hand right and the left hand left, then raises both hands with the left hand folding inward. The rightward-moving right arm lengthens downward while the left arm curls higher, before both hands sweep left and the lowered right arm folds upward. The lifted left hand swings right and returns left into a tuck as the right knee bends, then extends down-right while the left arm reaches left and down over a straightening right leg. Both arms curl upward, the left hand moving right and opening as the right knee softens, before the left hand drops and the right elbow tightens farther. The lower right arm gathers upward again as the left knee bends, releases and bends once more beneath a rising, tucked left hand.

The right arm folds upward and left as the left knee straightens, then the right hand drops and opens while the left arm reaches right and down. The left arm curls up and left over a softening left knee, followed by the right hand lifting into another fold. Both hands rise with the right arm lengthening before both elbows tuck and the hands descend. The left arm opens and lowers farther as the left knee bends deeper, while the right arm continues extending downward.

The right knee softens as the dancer curls both arms upward and carries the hands left, then extends the right arm right while the left arm reaches up-left. The right hand returns left and folds as the right knee straightens, followed by the left knee; the right arm opens downward before both knees bend and the hands sweep right with the left arm curling up-left and the right arm extending down-right. Both knees lengthen as the hands climb, the left hand continuing left while the right hand moves right and tucks; the right knee bends again beneath an upward reach that reverses left and extends. The right knee bends as the right hand dips right and rises with a tighter fold, then the left knee deepens while the right knee straightens and the right hand lowers into a release. Both knees soften as the right hand moves left and the left hand drops, then the right leg lengthens while the left knee bends further and releases; the right hand continues left and curls upward as the left hand lifts and the left knee straightens.

To begin, the dancer folds the right arm down-left as the right knee straightens and the left hand sweeps left; the right knee then softens while the folded right arm lifts right and lengthens. Both knees extend as the hands separate left and right, then bend in succession beneath a shared upward curl. The arms open downward before the right arm reverses right, bends again, and lifts into a longer reach as the left hand rises rightward. The left arm folds back left while the right elbow tucks farther, then both hands descend with the right hand extending left and the left hand continuing right. The right hand curls up-right as the left arm lengthens downward.

A knee straightens midway through the opening phrase: the left arm folds and lifts left, followed by the right hand rising as the right arm tucks, then both hands descend with the elbows opening. The left hand moves right and curls upward while the right arm lengthens down, and the knees bend in succession beneath a shared rise of the hands into folded arms. Both hands sweep left as the left elbow opens and the right knee softens further; the left arm then folds and releases downward before lifting again. The left hand travels right as the right elbow bends and the left knee straightens, then lowers while the right hand swings left and back right, the right arm opening and refolding. The right hand climbs left and reverses right as the left arm extends higher, finishes with another lift of the right hand, and finishes with a leftward reach on the left side.

The right hand drops. The dancer sweeps the left hand left and down with a folding elbow, then lifts both hands toward the right as the right arm opens, the left knee straightens, and the left hand curls inward. Both hands reverse left with the left arm lengthening downward, while the right knee softens; the right arm folds and rises as the right knee straightens. The left hand returns up-right and tucks in farther as the right knee bends again, then both arms open and lower before lifting together. Both elbows curl through another descent, then separate right and left as the right hand climbs and the knees exchange bends, ending with the left hand continuing left and the right hand moving right.

A rising, leftward sweep begins as the dancer sends both hands left, lifts the left hand higher with an unfolding arm and carries it farther left. The right hand drops while the raised left arm tucks into a lower rightward sweep, then both rise again before the rightward-moving right hand reverses left. Both arms curl as the left hand climbs, then descend with lengthening elbows. The right arm opens upward while the left hand returns right and curls upward; both elbows draw in as their heights separate, then the hands drop and the right arm reaches right. The initially raised left arm folds downward to the left as its knee softens, then both hands reverse right with the left arm extending and lifting while the right elbow draws inward.

The dancer lowers and lengthens the right arm while the left hand travels right, then brings both hands left. The right hand rises as the left arm curls inward. The left hand drops and extends right, joined by the right hand moving right.

The right hand travels right as the dancer lowers it and folds both arms, then carries the right hand back left while the left arm climbs. The left arm lengthens upward and reaches farther right before returning down and curling inward, while the right elbow also folds. Both hands rise with a brief opening of the lower arm, then descend as the left arm curls in and the right knee bends. The right arm lifts again, opens toward the right, and lowers into another fold as the right knee straightens and the left hand drops.

The right arm curls upward and right. The dancer bends the left knee while the right hand drops left and opens, then the left hand rises left as the right knee straightens and both knees soften. Both hands sweep right with the right arm tucked, then descend and separate, the left hand moving left and the right hand returning right as both elbows extend. The knees deepen their bend beneath a shared leftward reach that reverses right, with the right elbow folding before the hands drop and reopen. The right knee straightens as the right hand returns left and curls up, joined by the left arm's lift; the left knee lengthens as the right hand reverses right and descends into an extension.

The right knee softens as the dancer lowers the left hand, then curls the right arm upward while the right knee straightens. The left hand sweeps left and down into a fold, followed by the right hand dropping farther as the right arm lengthens; the hands then reverse right and left, with the right hand rising. The left arm opens downward before curling back up toward the right, then reaches out and drops again as the right knee bends and releases and the right hand lifts leftward. Both hands climb, the left arm continuing right before lowering and opening while the right arm extends left. The right hand rises again as the left knee softens, then both arms gather inward and lift, ending with the right hand sweeping right.

The dancer folds both arms inward. The right knee softens as the hands separate right and left, then straighten into a rising exchange that reverses sideways with the right arm curling higher before the right hand returns left and down. The left hand dips and rises while the right knee bends farther; the left hand moves right as the left arm curls upward and both knees lengthen, after which the right hand lifts and the right knee sinks again. Both arms open downward as the left knee bends, then the right hand curls up while the left hand drops and the left knee extends. The left arm reaches right and lowers through an opening and renewed tuck, accompanied by another bend of the right knee, before both hands rise and the arms unfold.

The arms oppose each other: the right hand moves right and both arms rise, then the left arm folds left while the raised right arm curls farther up and right. The curled right arm opens downward as the right knee softens, then reaches left and lifts with its elbow bending. That right arm unfolds into a descending sweep to the right, then tucks upward and releases back down. The right knee bends again as the right hand sweeps left and rises, followed by another bend of the right leg and a release.

The right knee softens as the dancer lowers both hands, then the right leg straightens and the right arm opens while the left hand drops farther. The left hand sweeps left with its elbow folding, then reverses right and rises as the right arm extends down toward the right. Both arms lengthen, the left hand moving right before curling upward again; the right arm follows up and folds inward. The left hand continues right, then falls as both elbows release.

At the outset, the right hand lowers as the right arm folds and the left knee softens, then the right hand rises into an extended leftward reach while the left knee straightens and the left hand moves right. The right hand returns right with a bent elbow as the left hand lifts and opens, then both hands sweep left and descend, the right hand curling upward while the left hand tucks and drops again. Both knees bend in succession as the right hand reaches up-right and the left hand curls up-left, followed by another deepening of those knees and a shared leftward return. The left hand lifts farther left against the right hand's downward extension, then both lower and fold as their knees soften once more. The right hand sweeps right and rises with an opening elbow while the left hand continues left, then the arms reverse sideways, the right hand lengthening down-left and the left hand curling up-right before both hands drop. The right knee bends further and the left knee straightens as both hands rise, the left arm extending right and the right arm folding left.

In opposition, the right hand curls up and right while the left arm extends downward, then the right arm opens down-left as the left arm folds upward. Both hands climb with the arms lengthening, the left hand sweeping left before both return right; the right hand drops and reaches farther right against the left hand's upward curl. The left hand reverses left and rises as the right knee softens, while the right hand lowers into a rightward extension over a bending left knee, then lifts back left as the left leg straightens. The left arm tucks and sweeps right before both hands descend, the left hand reaching left with an opening elbow as the right hand moves right. The left knee bends again as both hands rise, and the right arm draws inward before both hands move left.

A descending reach opens the phrase: the right arm lengthens downward as the right knee straightens, then both hands sweep left before the left hand rises and returns right. The right hand curls up and left while the left knee softens; both hands descend, then reverse right with the left arm folding into a lift as the left knee bends further. Both arms tuck as both knees deepen, then the right hand lowers and extends left while the left hand moves right and rises over a softened left knee; the right hand reverses right and up as the left knee straightens. The left arm folds farther upward and left while the left knee extends, then the right arm reaches down and right before curling back up and left. The right hand descends again as the left knee beneath it bends and the left hand sweeps left.

A shared lateral sweep begins with the right hand moving right and the left hand moving left, then both return left as the right arm folds and the right knee bends; the left knee also softens before the hands exchange directions again. The right hand continues left while the left hand drops and curls upward, then both rise as the right hand reverses right and the knees straighten. Both hands climb farther, the right hand continuing right and opening, before they descend together and the left hand sweeps left into a fold. The right arm reaches up to the right as the left arm curls higher, then both lower and separate sideways. The right knee lengthens as the right hand drops left and opens; both arms tuck and lift before the left hand returns right and both elbows release. The hands sink in succession, the right hand reaching right and the left hand curling up to the left as the left knee bends and straightens.

To begin, the dancer lifts both hands and carries them left, folding the left arm while the right arm lengthens; the left arm then opens as the left knee bends and straightens. The right hand above the left knee continues left into a curl while the left hand drops right and extends, followed by the right hand sweeping right and lowering as the left knee softens again. The left hand returns left and rises with a fold while the right arm moves down-right and reaches farther, accompanied by another bend of the left knee. The right arm tucks as the left knee releases, then both hands sweep left with the right arm opening, before the left hand reverses right and curls upward. Both arms draw inward and lift, the left hand continuing its rise as the right elbow tightens further.

As the right knee straightens, the dancer sends both hands right, the left arm curling upward and then opening down as the right knee softens. The right hand climbs while the left arm folds left and rises, followed by another lift of the right hand as the right knee extends and bends again. Both arms tuck inward with the left hand continuing left, then the right knee lengthens as the right hand lowers and the right elbow opens; the left arm reaches up-right before folding back down-left. The lowered right hand reverses right and curls upward against the left hand's continued descent, then returns left and drops as the right knee straightens. Both hands move right and rise in succession, the right hand curling higher while the left arm extends down-right.

To begin, the dancer lowers the right hand as the right knee bends and the left arm extends right, then opens the right knee while the right hand rises. The left arm curls upward toward the left and folds further as the left knee softens, followed by a bend of the right knee and a descent of the left curled arm. Both hands sweep left as the right knee straightens and the right arm lengthens downward; the left knee releases while the left hand lifts right, then both knees soften and the right arm tucks up and left. The left hand dips and rebounds into a rising curl over a deeper bend of the left knee, while the right knee extends and the right hand moves right before both arms fold higher and the right knee softens again. Both hands reverse left with extending elbows, then descend as the knees lengthen in succession; the right hand returns right and rises against the left hand's continued drop, and the right knee bends once more as the left arm reaches farther down.

The right knee bends as the dancer raises and folds both arms, then lowers them with lengthening elbows. The left hand drops farther while the right knee straightens, and the hands separate right and left before returning left together. The right hand curls upward as the right knee extends, then opens down to the right; both knees soften in succession as the right hand rises again. The left arm reaches up and left with an extended elbow while the right knee bends farther, then returns right and curls downward. The left hand drops as both knees straighten, and the right arm opens into a lift.

In opposition, the dancer lengthens the right arm while folding the left arm, then lowers both hands as the right arm reaches farther left. The left arm curls up and right while the right hand moves right, then both elbows open before the left hand drops. Both arms tuck again as the hands separate left and right, with the right hand climbing; the left-moving arm opens into a higher lift while the right knee straightens and the right hand continues right. The arms reverse their inward sweeps, the right hand rising as the left elbow folds and the left knee bends, then both hands sweep left and descend into open arms. The right arm curls upward and sweeps right as the right knee extends, then returns left while the left arm rises and folds. The left hand swings right and down before both hands climb left, the right arm opening and sweeping back right.

As the right hand moves right and both arms rise, the dancer curls the right arm upward while the left arm lengthens down and left. The right arm lowers into an extension, then folds again as the right hand sweeps left; both hands descend before the left arm reaches up and right and both arms open. The right arm lifts right as the right knee softens, then drops and lengthens farther right while the left arm folds and carries the left hand up to the left. Both hands move left, the right hand lifting and curling against the left hand's descent, then reverse apart with the left hand dropping farther left and the right arm opening downward. The right hand continues left as the left knee bends and straightens, then the left hand rises right while the right arm tucks.

To begin, the dancer raises both hands with folded elbows and carries them right. The right arm lengthens downward while the left arm lifts farther left; the right hand rises again as the left knee straightens, then the left hand moves left and drops as the left knee bends and releases. The right hand sweeps down and right while the left arm curls upward to the left over a softening left knee, then returns down and left through another bend of the left knee. Both arms open as the right hand climbs right and the left knee straightens; the right hand reverses left and descends before lifting back right into a fold. The left hand reaches up and right with an extending elbow, then both arms tuck and lower as the knees soften in succession.

The dancer moves leftward, carrying the left hand while the right hand moves right and rises into a fold; the left arm then curls upward as the right knee straightens. The left hand lowers and reaches left while the right hand sweeps up-left and opens, followed by a bend of the right knee and another extension of the right arm. The right knee releases as both hands descend and the right arm folds inward, then the left knee softens while the hands separate left and right and rise with opening elbows. Both arms lengthen downward before curling upward, the left hand moving right and the right hand left; the hands lower again as the knees soften in succession. The left elbow tucks farther while the left knee straightens, then both hands sweep left, the right arm folding as the right knee releases. The hands reverse right together, the left arm extending downward and opening before returning left as the left knee bends.

A reaching-and-lowering arm exchange begins with the right hand traveling left, then both hands sweep right as the left hand curls upward and the right arm folds and rises. Both hands return left and descend into extending elbows, then climb again before the right hand drops and reaches farther left while the left hand continues upward and right. The right arm lengthens downward and swings right as the left hand returns left and tucks, followed by another lift of the right hand with a bent elbow. The hands separate right and left, the left hand curling up and down through an extension while the right hand reaches left, folds and rebounds upward. The right hand drops again as the left hand moves left and the right knee softens; both arms open before the right elbow bends and the left hand rises into a tighter curl.

The right arm reaches right and upward. The left hand moves left as the right hand reverses left, then both arms fold and the left hand continues left while the right elbow releases. Both hands descend, with the right arm curling farther before extending down and right against the left hand's leftward reach. The hands rise together, the right arm folding through its lift while the left lengthens; both then lower and sweep right, the right elbow opening as the left arm tucks. They separate again, the left hand returning left and the right hand continuing right, then both elbows bend before the right hand reverses toward the left.

The arms exchange height: the right arm reaches up and right as the left hand rises, then the right arm drops left while the left elbow folds and both hands move left. The left arm lengthens downward before curling back upward toward the right, joined by the right hand's rightward lift and extension; both arms open again as their hands separate sideways. The left hand swings down-left and returns up-right with a tuck while the right arm drops into an opening reach. The right arm curls upward toward the left, then opens and lowers as the left arm extends and its knee straightens, followed by another fold and rise of the right arm. Both hands descend, the right hand moving right and the left hand moving left, before the right elbow bends more deeply and lifts alongside the left hand.

As the right hand moves right and down, the dancer lengthens both arms and straightens the right knee. The left arm folds as the right knee softens and the right hand returns left; the left leg then bends while the left elbow opens and the left hand sweeps up-right, followed by a lift of the right hand. Both hands descend with folding elbows and reverse their lateral directions, the right knee bending as the left leg straightens. The right hand rises with an extended arm as the left hand travels right, then lowers and curls inward while the right knee releases and the left hand lifts farther right. The right arm opens downward and returns right before folding again as the left hand drops, then both hands move left with the right elbow drawing in more deeply.

The right knee straightens as the dancer curls the right arm upward and opens it back down while the left hand rises into a fold, then both hands sweep right and descend. The left hand returns left and rises with a deeper bend as the right arm tucks, then both elbows open before the right arm curls up again. Both hands move left and climb, the right arm lengthening and the left folding; they separate right and left as the left elbow extends. The right arm reaches farther right and drops while the left curls upward, then both sweep left, the right hand rising into a tighter bend as the right knee softens. The right knee straightens while the left arm opens, and both hands descend as the left knee bends. The hands continue left and rise together, the right elbow extending as the left knee deepens its bend.

The dancer curls both arms upward. The right hand moves left and rises farther, then both elbows open as the left arm lengthens downward; the hands sweep right and the right arm tucks back down to the left while the left elbow folds. Both arms extend as the hands rise and separate sideways, then lower with the right knee softening before the left hand reaches up and left and the left knee straightens. The right hand sweeps right and down while the left arm curls upward again, then the right hand returns left as the left elbow opens and the left hand drops left, followed by a fold of the right arm. The leftward-moving right hand lifts into an extended reach as the left knee bends, then both hands descend and sweep right with the left knee straightening and the right elbow opening.

A repeating arm exchange begins with the right hand sweeping left and down, then curling up as the left knee softens. The right arm opens right while the left hand lowers, then both rise, the right arm moving left as the left knee straightens and the left arm lengthens downward. The hands separate sideways and descend, with the right arm extending before both fold upward and sweep right. Both arms open and lower again, then curl into a shared leftward reach as the right knee bends and the left hand rises. The right side reverses right with an unfolding arm while the left arm extends down; both knees soften as the right hand lifts left, drops, and curls upward again.

In opposition, the right hand drops and sweeps right while the left hand moves left, then both hands climb as the right arm folds. The right arm opens right while the left knee straightens, and the right arm curls down-left before extending upward as the left knee bends again. Both knees soften in succession as the left hand reaches higher to the left and the right hand rises into a tighter fold. The left hand travels left and down through an extension, then returns right with another bend of the left knee.

The right hand dips and rises as the dancer curls it rightward, then sends both hands left, the left arm folding before opening upward. The right arm tucks again and both hands climb, the right knee straightening as the left hand drops and sweeps left into a lengthened reach. Both arms extend downward, the right knee softens beneath a shared rightward sweep, and the hands rise with the right knee straightening before the left knee bends and releases as the left hand lowers. The left hand returns up and left while the left knee sinks, then the right hand travels left into an extended descent. The left arm reaches down-right, folds back left, and opens farther left while the bent right leg straightens and the left knee bends again.

A rising-and-falling arm exchange begins with the right hand lifting left and curling, while the left knee softens and straightens beneath a rightward extension of the left arm. The left hand returns right as both knees bend, then lowers into an opening reach that reverses left as the right knee straightens; the hands climb together before the right arm folds and sweeps right, joined by the left elbow's tuck. Both hands drop and sweep left as the knees lengthen in succession, then the right hand reverses right while the left hand curls upward and back left. The right arm opens and rises as the right knee bends, then drops and extends farther left as the right knee straightens again. The right hand climbs once more while the left hand continues left and the left knee softens.

The dancer lengthens the right arm right. The right hand rises and reverses left as the left knee bends, then drops into a shared curl while the left leg straightens; the left hand lifts right before both descend and the left elbow opens. The left arm curls upward again while the right knee softens, the left hand rising and folding inward. Both hands sweep left with the right arm tucking farther in, then return right as the right arm releases downward and the left knee bends. The left hand continues down and right as the left knee straightens, then folds back left while the right arm lengthens downward. The left hand climbs farther left and opens, followed by the right hand lifting right.

The dancer lengthens the right arm. The left hand drops and sweeps right while the right hand rises, then both arms fold as the right hand reverses left; the hands descend together before separating again, with the right hand moving right. Both arms open as the left knee bends, then the right arm curls upward and extends left against the left hand's rightward reach. The right knee softens while the left hand lowers and the left arm folds; the right hand moves left and rises into a tuck, followed by the left hand curling up and right. The right hand lifts farther right as the left arm opens, then falls while the right elbow releases and the left hand drops left.

As the right arm folds and the left arm lengthens, both hands lower left and reverse right, with the right arm opening before the left hand rises and falls. The dancer repeats this exchange, lifting the left hand again as the left knee straightens, then curls the left arm upward while the right arm reaches down-left and extends. Both hands move right as the raised left elbow opens and tucks, followed by a lift of the right hand and a drop of the left hand, whose left knee bends before straightening beneath another rising fold. The hands separate left and right with the left arm extending, then descend as the right hand moves right and the left hand sweeps left into a curl; the left knee softens as the right knee rises and drops. The right arm lengthens right while the left arm curls up-left, then the right arm folds downward and the left arm opens as the left knee bends.

A leftward arm sweep begins as the left hand rises and the right hand extends down to the right, while both knees bend in succession. The left hand drops as the left knee straightens, then both arms gather inward before the left hand rebounds upward and the right hand travels right. The dancer repeats a descending-and-raising pulse with the left hand, opening it downward as the right knee bends and releases beneath a further extension of the right arm. The left arm curls up and reaches right as the right hand rises left, then lowers into another fold while the right knee softens. Both hands move right with the right arm extending, the left knee bending and releasing before the hands descend and separate sideways.

The right knee straightens as the dancer lowers the left hand left and opens both elbows, then softens the right knee while the right arm curls up-right. The hands reverse sideways with the raised right elbow tucking further, then separate again before the initially lowered left hand returns right and both arms lengthen downward. The left hand sweeps left and rises into a curl as the right arm lifts leftward and folds; both descend before the right arm extends upward and the left hand continues left. The right hand dips and rebounds while the left hand swings right, left and right again, then rises as the rebounding right arm lengthens down-right and curls back up-left. Both hands move left, the right hand descending and extending before rising into a fold as the left knee bends, then opening back down-right.

The arms move in opposition: the right hand sweeps left and down as the left knee bends, then both hands descend before the right hand returns right and curls upward while the left hand reaches farther right. The right arm lengthens downward and folds back up, followed by the left hand rising and tucking into a low rightward sweep. The left hand continues down and right as the right hand lowers and extends, then both lift with the left arm opening. The hands separate left and right, the right-moving arm curling down before reaching left alongside the left hand; the left knee softens as the left hand reverses right and rises into another fold. The left hand dips and climbs again, while the right hand drops, swings left and returns right as the left knee straightens.

Rightward, the dancer carries the right hand as the right arm lengthens and the left elbow folds, then lowers both hands while the right knee softens. Both hands rise, the left arm opening before curling again; the right hand drops rightward as the left hand moves left and the right knee bends further. The right arm unfolds downward and sweeps left, followed by the left arm reaching up-left, while the right knee straightens and the left leg softens. The right hand rises and falls rightward as the right knee extends, while the left arm curls upward to the left and the left knee straightens. Both arms open into a lift with the right hand moving left, then descend as the knees soften in succession and the left hand returns right. The right knee straightens before bending again, accompanied by a rising curl of the right arm and a further extension of the left knee.

The right arm lowers while the left arm curls upward and left, then both arms rise with the left arm extending. The right arm moves right as the right knee bends and releases; both hands descend before lifting again, with the left arm folding through a rightward sweep and the right arm curling higher. Both elbows open as the left hand drops left and the right hand moves up-right, then their paths reverse into a shared descent and the right knee softens. The left arm reaches up-left while the right arm folds right, and the left knee straightens before bending again beneath another lift of the left hand. The right arm extends left as the left arm lengthens downward, then both hands sweep right, the left rising with a folded elbow while the right hand falls.

The arms oppose each other: the right hand drops as the right knee bends and the left hand curls upward; both hands then rise before separating right and left with an opening elbow. The right-moving arm folds down, swings back left and rises into a curl while the left knee softens beneath its descending hand. The right hand continues left and lengthens over a deeper bend of the right knee, then reverses right as the left knee straightens and the right knee bends further. Both knees soften in succession as the hands separate again, the left hand lifting left and the right hand continuing right, before the right hand lowers and opens while the left hand returns right and the left knee extends. The right arm curls up and left as the right knee straightens, then reaches farther left while the left knee softens and the left hand drops right over a bending right knee; both elbows draw inward as the right knee releases and the left hand rises left.

The arms oppose each other laterally: the dancer sends the right hand right and down while the left hand travels left, then lifts both hands with the right arm folding inward. Both hands move left as the right knee straightens, then the left arm reaches up-right before returning left and curling downward as the right hand rises. The left arm sweeps right and folds again while the right hand drops, then both sweep left with the right elbow drawing in farther. The left hand lowers as the left knee softens, and both hands move right, the left arm extending before the right knee straightens and the left arm curls upward.

The knees soften in succession as the right hand reaches right and the left hand lifts left, then the right arm folds upward while the left hand drops. Both hands move right with the right elbow opening, followed by a rising curl on the right side; the left knee bends and releases as the right hand lowers left and the left arm extends down to the left. The left arm lengthens before both elbows tuck, the left hand returning right and down as the left knee softens, while the right hand sweeps left and rises. The right hand reverses right with a deeper fold, then both hands descend and return left as the right knee straightens and the left arm curls upward. The hands separate sideways, the right arm extending downward while the left knee straightens beneath its rising, folded hand; both arms draw inward as the right hand continues down.

To begin, the dancer raises the right hand and curls it rightward as the left arm extends upward; both hands sweep left and descend. The right hand reverses right while the left arm continues right with a lengthening elbow, then both arms fold into another shared leftward reach. The left hand drops and opens as both elbows release, followed by the right hand sinking and the right knee softening. Both hands climb leftward with bent elbows and the right knee straightens, then the left arm releases downward while the right arm folds rightward. The left arm tucks and sweeps up-right, and the right hand follows rightward before the left arm extends down-left.

The arms move in opposition: the left hand rises left while the right hand curls up-right, then the left arm drops and folds right as the right hand reverses left. Both elbows open before the left hand lifts left again; the left knee bends and straightens as the left arm tucks down-left and both hands descend, the right hand curling upward to the right over a deeper left knee bend. The right arm reaches right while the left arm opens left and down, then both hands rise and reverse sideways as the left knee releases and both arms lengthen downward. The left hand moves right while the right elbow folds, and both knees soften as the arms curl upward. The left arm extends down-left through another left knee bend and release, while the right arm gathers higher and shifts right. The left knee bends again beneath a rising, folding left arm, then straightens as the right hand lowers.

The dancer sends the right hand right and down. The left hand follows right as both knees straighten, then the right arm folds upward while the left elbow tucks and lowers. The left hand rises and opens left as the left knee softens; the right arm curls left and up before both arms unfold, with the right knee straightening. Both hands descend toward the left as the right knee bends again, then the arms lengthen apart, the right hand returning right while the left hand drops and the bent right knee extends. The left arm folds upward and releases downward, joined by a lift of the right hand as the right knee straightens further.

The right knee straightens as the dancer extends the right arm downward and sweeps both hands left, then curls the right hand upward while the left hand rises. The right hand drops right as the right arm opens, then returns left and folds back up; the left hand lowers into an extension before rising again. Both arms gather inward and carry their hands higher, then the right hand reaches right and both descend with lengthening elbows. The right hand lifts again and tucks, accompanied by a curling rise of the left arm. The hands separate right and left as the right elbow releases, then both arms fold and lower before the right hand moves left and the left arm climbs right.

The right knee softens as the dancer curls the right hand upward and opens the right arm right, then raises the left hand while the right elbow folds again. The left arm lengthens left and descends as both knees bend in succession; the right hand drops into an extension before both arms tuck and the hands rise apart, right to the left and left to the right. The right hand sweeps down and back up to the left as the right knee straightens, while the left arm reaches right and lowers over a deeper bend of the right knee. Both hands move left, the right climbing into a fold while the left rises and extends; the knee beneath the raised left arm bends further as that arm opens downward and reverses right. The left arm curls upward toward the left while the right knee straightens and the right arm tucks down, then the hands separate right and left as the right knee extends and its arm releases downward. The hands return left together with the left hand rising, then shift right as the right arm curls upward and the left folds downward.

The right knee straightens as the dancer folds both arms upward and separates the hands left and right, then lowers them with a deeper bend of the left elbow. The left hand sweeps left while the right arm opens, and the right knee lengthens further before both knees soften. The left-moving hand returns right as the right elbow tucks, both hands rise with the right arm curling higher, then separate again as the left hand drops and the left knee bends further. Both arms extend downward, the left hand continuing down-right while the right knee straightens and the right hand moves left. The lower hand reverses up-left as the right knee bends and the left arm curls upward; both hands lift farther, the left arm releasing before the hands sweep right together.

A rising arm sweep begins with the right hand moving left and both arms extending upward, the left hand following left before both return right. The hands descend, the right arm folding as the right knee straightens; both hands shift left while the left arm lengthens and lifts, then the left arm tucks and lowers again as the left knee softens. The right hand moves right and rises into a curl while the left hand sweeps left and down, the left knee bending further as the right arm extends and falls. Both hands continue downward and left before reversing right, with the left arm curling up and back left and the right arm opening. The left arm folds farther as the right hand continues right, then reaches down and left while the right arm lengthens more and the left hand returns right.

At the outset, the right arm reaches right and drops as the left knee straightens, then the right hand returns left and curls upward while the left knee bends. The left hand rises into a fold and moves right before descending as both arms lengthen and the right hand drops left; both knees soften in succession while the hands sweep left and climb with tightening elbows. The right arm extends farther left as the left leg straightens, and both hands descend, the left hand curling up-left before dropping right with an opening elbow. The right knee bends again as the right hand lifts and folds inward, then both arms reach right and lower, the right arm opening as the left hand sweeps left and the right knee sinks further. Both elbows tuck as the hands rise, the right hand moving left while the left hand swings right and back left. The right hand drops right and opens as the left arm curls up-right, then the right arm folds upward again while the left arm continues rising and reaches right.

To begin, the dancer folds the right arm upward as the right knee softens and the left hand lowers right. The right leg straightens while both hands sweep left and rise, the right arm extending as the left knee bends and releases. The left knee sinks again beneath a downward reach of the right arm while the left hand continues right; the left hand then sweeps left as both elbows tuck and the left knee softens once more. The right arm opens down toward the right before folding back up to the left, while the left knee straightens and the left hand rises rightward. The right hand drops into another inward curl as the right knee bends and the left hand continues right, then both arms lengthen with the right hand lowering further.

The right knee softens as the dancer curls the left hand upward and sends the right hand left, then straightens the right leg while the raised left arm opens down to the right. The right arm folds upward and left before both hands descend, the right elbow releasing and reopening as the left arm reaches farther right and the right hand moves right. Both elbows draw inward, the left hand rising while the right hand drops, then the right arm extends left and curls back up-right as the right knee lengthens. The right hand continues up-left with a tightening elbow and a deeper bend of the left knee, then lowers and releases while the left arm opens left and the right knee straightens. The right arm curls upward again as the left hand rises and the right knee bends, followed by the right hand moving right and the left knee sinking; the left hand drops right as the right arm opens downward. The right knee extends while the left knee bends further and the right arm tucks, then the right knee softens again as the tucked right arm releases and the left arm draws in once more.

A rising, opposing arm sweep begins with the dancer lowering the right hand and drawing both arms inward; the left hand rises as the right knee bends, then the right hand climbs left while the left arm opens. The right knee releases as the hands separate right and left, the right arm curling upward and the left knee softening before both knees straighten and the right arm extends down-left. Both knees bend again as the hands rise, the left elbow tucking and opening while the right hand drops right; the left knee releases and both hands sweep right with the right arm folding downward. The right hand returns left and curls upward over a deepening right knee bend, while the left arm extends right and lowers into another fold; the right arm reaches down-right as the left knee straightens. The right arm curls up-left over an extending right knee while the left hand moves right, then the hands descend and the right knee bends again. Both elbows open as the left knee lengthens farther, then the arms gather upward with the left hand moving right while the right knee sinks deeper and the right hand returns left.

As the right knee softens and the left hand rises, the dancer extends both arms downward, lengthening the right leg as the right arm curls upward. The hands separate left and right before descending and reversing inward, with the left knee bending as the left hand climbs into a fold. Both knees straighten as the right hand moves right and the left hand reaches left, then the right knee bends again while the left arm tucks and lowers. The right hand lifts right as the left hand sweeps left and up, then returns right and down while the left knee straightens and the left arm folds; the right knee also releases before the left hand drops and rebounds. The right arm reaches right as the left hand climbs left, then both descend with lengthening elbows and the right knee straightens. The right knee bends again beneath a leftward curl of the right arm, which continues lowering and extending as the left hand rises.

As the right arm folds, the dancer sweeps both hands right, then lowers and extends them left, curling the right hand upward while the left hand follows up and left. The right arm opens downward and lengthens farther as the left hand continues left; the left hand reverses right before both sweep down and left, with the left elbow bending and opening again. Both hands rise into a fold and return right, then descend as the knees soften in succession and the arms release. The elbows tuck once more as the hands climb left, then the right arm reaches down and right against the left arm's rising leftward reach. The right hand curls upward and left while the left arm folds and lifts, before both hands drop and the right arm lengthens downward.

A side-to-side hand sweep begins with the right arm curling upward as the left knee bends, then both hands descend and the right arm opens before the right hand sweeps right and folds back left. The left arm curls up and right while the right arm reaches farther left, both elbows drawing inward as the right hand rises and the left knee softens again. Both arms open downward, the right hand returning left as the left knee bends and straightens; the right knee also lengthens before the left knee sinks once more. The right arm reaches down and right as the left knee extends, then tucks and lifts left while the left hand rises leftward, and both knees bend in succession. Both hands descend, the left arm opening as the right knee straightens, then both lift and fold inward while the right knee releases again. The hands lower together and separate right and left, with the left-moving arm opening and its knee extending further.

The right hand rises into a curl, then lowers and extends right while the left arm folds and carries the left hand left. The dancer lengthens the right arm downward while the left knee softens and straightens; both hands sweep left, the right hand rising before dropping farther left. The right hand reverses right and curls upward while the left knee bends again and the left hand continues left, then the right arm opens down and left while the left hand returns right. Both arms tuck as the right hand lifts, the left hand drops, and the right knee straightens before the hands reverse sideways together.

The right hand rises. The dancer curls the left arm upward and carries both hands right, then lowers them before extending the right arm left while the left knee softens. The lowered left hand reverses right as the left knee straightens; both arms lengthen downward, the right hand moving left while the left knee bends again. Both hands rise, the right arm folding as the left opens and the bent left knee releases, then the left knee softens beneath a continuing lift. Both hands descend with extended elbows and separate sideways, the right hand reaching right as the left knee bends and the left hand sweeps left.

As the right knee bends and releases, the dancer lowers both hands with the right arm folding, then sends them right and down while the right knee softens again. The left hand curls up and left as the right knee straightens, then returns down and right against the right hand's leftward sweep. Both knees lengthen in succession beneath a shared leftward reach, then the elbows open and the hands lower and separate into another shared rightward sweep as the right knee extends farther. The left arm folds upward and carries the left hand left, while the right elbow opens, tucks again, and releases downward as the left hand rises higher and the right knee bends. The right knee straightens and softens once more beneath the left hand's rightward descent, while the right hand lifts left and the right knee deepens before releasing.

A knee bend enters as the dancer folds the left arm and sweeps both hands left, then sends them right into a curling lift. The right hand drops, opens, and returns up to the left before both arms lengthen downward. Both hands rise again with folded elbows, then lower and open as the knees straighten in succession; the arms tuck once more while the hands separate left and right. The rightward-moving arm extends as its knee softens, then both hands descend with that knee straightening and the other arm opening. The opposite hand curls upward to the left and reverses right into a down-and-up reach, while the first hand rises and falls before lifting back left. The other arm folds and carries its hand left as the first hand continues lowering.

The right arm and left arm move in opposition: the right hand rises leftward into a curl as the left hand lifts, then the right hand lowers and opens right while the left arm lengthens downward. The right knee bends as the right hand sweeps left and back right with an extending elbow, then both hands rise and separate sideways as the right knee straightens and the left arm curls upward. The right hand drops and tucks farther inward while the left hand reaches up-left and folds, followed by the right arm opening downward as the left hand reverses right; both elbows then draw tighter as their hands climb and separate again. The right arm extends down-right as the left arm curls higher, then both sweep left with the right arm folding and the left arm descending. Both knees soften as the hands return right, the right arm lengthening before the right hand drops and curls upward while the left hand lowers and extends, ending with the right knee bending more deeply.

The right hand drops and folds while the left hand travels right and down into a curl. The right arm opens left as both hands rise, then the hands separate sideways and descend with both arms lengthening. They sweep left together, the right hand returning right before both elbows tuck and the hands climb. The right hand sweeps farther right and lowers as the right knee straightens, then reverses left and curls upward while the left hand continues right. The left knee softens and straightens as the hands move apart, the right hand dropping and extending right while the left hand returns left and rises. Both knees bend as the right hand curls up and moves left, then both knees release and the hands descend, with the right arm opening before both elbows fold again.

The right knee softens as the left hand moves right and both hands descend, the right arm extending. The dancer straightens the right knee while both arms curl upward, then sends the left hand left as the right leg bends again and the left hand drops. The right hand lifts, folds and sweeps down-left, followed by the left arm lowering; the knees straighten in succession before the left-moving hand reverses right and rises alongside the left hand. Both hands descend and the elbows open, then the left arm curls up-right and lengthens downward as the right knee straightens, while the right arm tucks up-left. The left hand continues down-right as the right elbow releases, then the hands separate left and right with the right arm folding and the left hand reaching farther outward.

As the right hand rises right and the left hand curls up-left, the dancer lowers the right hand into a fold while the left arm opens down-right. The right hand sweeps left and descends as the right knee softens; both hands continue downward before the arms lengthen apart, then rise together. The hands separate again, the right hand moving left and the left hand moving right, then descend as their elbows extend. Both arms curl upward toward each other, then the right hand returns left while the left hand reaches down-right and opens. The right elbow folds again as the left hand rises, followed by the right hand lifting with an extending arm.

The knees join a later bend after the right hand sweeps left and down, then both hands rise with the left arm curling inward as the right knee softens. The right arm lengthens downward while the left hand reaches right and drops into an opening elbow, and the right knee releases before both legs extend. The left hand lifts as the right knee bends again, while the right arm curls up-left and the left arm opens; the knees straighten and the leftward-reaching arm folds back toward the right. Both arms tuck, their hands climbing and separating sideways before the right hand descends and both elbows release. The right hand moves right as the left hand rises, dips and curls upward again, then the right hand continues right and lifts into a fold while the left knee bends beneath another rising curl. The right knee sinks farther as the right hand drops, while the left arm extends and lowers.

At the opening, the right hand rises while the left arm curls right and lowers; both knees straighten as the right hand drops and the right knee softens. The right arm extends down-left while the left hand moves left and climbs with a bent elbow, then the left hand reaches right and lifts before returning left. Both hands descend, the left hand sweeping right as the right knee bends farther and both arms lengthen, followed by the left knee softening. The right hand rises and falls through a right-to-left sweep as the right knee releases, while the left hand sweeps up-right and back down-left over a bend and release of the left knee. The right arm curls upward toward the right as the left arm continues left and down, then both hands rise with the right arm extending and the left arm folding. The right knee straightens and the right hand lowers leftward while the left knee softens and the left arm opens; the right hand returns right and rises into a tighter curl as the left knee releases.

The dancer reaches left and down with the left hand. The right arm follows left, then folds upward as the left hand curls right and rises; both arms extend before the right hand drops and the left arm tucks again. Both hands sweep right and climb, with the right elbow opening, then reverse left into deeper folds. The left hand returns right while the right hand dips and rises, after which both lower, the right hand moving left. The left arm lengthens as the right arm opens farther down and sweeps right, then curls up to the left while the right hand continues right and folds back left.

As the dancer folds the right arm, the left hand sweeps right and curls upward, then both hands rise. The right arm releases downward while the left arm extends left, and the right knee softens as the right hand travels right. The left hand lifts farther left into a curl, then reverses right as the right arm tucks and rises. Both arms open again, with the right arm sweeping left before returning right and extending.

The right knee softens as the dancer extends the left arm right and curls the right arm upward left, then lengthens the right hand down-right. The left arm folds up-left while the right hand returns left and the right knee bends further; both hands rise before the right hand tucks left and the left hand reaches right. The right hand dips rightward, then reverses left as both arms unfold, with the left hand lowering. Both hands descend and sweep right, the left arm curling upward while the right arm opens and lifts toward the left. The left hand swings right, returns left and rises again as the right hand drops.

The dancer curls the right arm upward. Both hands rise, then separate left and right with the left arm opening as the right hand returns left; the left hand lowers while the right knee straightens and the right arm extends farther left. The left hand swings right and up, folds back left and descends as the right arm tucks rightward; both elbows open before the right hand reaches down-left and the left hand rises rightward. The right hand lifts into a curl as the left hand drops, then moves right while the left knee bends and the left hand rises. The left knee releases beneath a further lift of the right hand, which then folds downward as the left arm opens and sweeps right.

The right arm lengthens downward. The left hand lowers and curls left as the right arm reaches farther down, then both arms open while the left knee straightens and the left hand rises left; the left arm folds as the left knee bends again. Both hands descend, the right arm extending while the left hand reaches right, and the right knee softens before both knees bend and release. The left hand sweeps right and down as the right arm curls up and left, then both hands rise with the left elbow folding and the left knee sinking while the right arm opens downward. The left hand drops as the left knee releases, then extends right while the right arm draws inward toward the right; the left knee bends as the left hand returns left and the right arm unfolds. The left hand reverses right and tucks while the right knee bends and the left arm curls upward to the left, followed by a lift of the right hand and a deeper bend in the right knee.

The dancer lifts and lengthens the right arm. The left hand travels right as the raised right hand drops left, then both hands sweep down and right before reversing left, with the left knee softening.
