Both knees straighten as the arms curl upward, the right hand continuing left while the left hand lowers and opens; the right hand reverses right and rises farther into a tighter fold. The left hand curls up-left as the left knee bends, then extends downward while the right arm tucks left and rises. The left knee releases as the left hand moves right and back left, then the right hand descends into an opening reach.

The right hand sweeps left, then right and down as both arms lengthen. The left hand follows left while the right arm curls upward. The right arm tucks further as the right knee bends, then releases into a rising reach to the right while the left knee straightens and the left arm folds up-left. The left knee softens again as the right hand lowers and extends farther right, then reverses left while the left leg lengthens. The left hand continues climbing before dropping and opening right, joined by the right arm's extension as the right knee straightens once more. Both hands lift and sweep left, the left hand reversing right as the left knee softens and the right arm curls inward.

The knees bend in succession. The dancer sends the right hand right and down, folds the left arm upward toward the left, then lengthens both elbows as the right hand rises and the left knee straightens. The left arm curls farther up and right while the right arm opens downward; the hands trade height as the right arm extends down, the left knee softening and the left hand moves right. The left arm reaches higher to the left as the left knee bends again, while the right hand climbs rightward and drops back left with a deeper knee bend. The right hand rises into an extension as the left arm tucks downward and the left knee releases, then both hands descend before the left hand sweeps right and the right hand returns left. The left hand lifts and curls inward as the right knee straightens, then the left hand continues right and down while the right arm draws closer and the right knee softens again.

The right knee softens as the dancer lifts the right hand and lowers it with an extending arm, then bends the left elbow while the left knee straightens and the right arm curls upward. The right knee bends again beneath a downward reach that lengthens into a rightward return, while the left hand rises left and the left arm folds. The left arm opens as both hands climb, then the left hand swings down-left and back up-right before tucking again; the right hand drops left while the left hand rises farther right. The right arm curls higher and sweeps right as the left hand climbs and reverses left, then both descend, the left hand returning right while the right hand moves left. Both hands lift and sweep left together, then the left hand drops right as the right knee bends and the right hand returns right. The left arm curls upward to the left while the right hand lowers, ending with the raised hand continuing left.

To begin, the dancer curls the right arm upward while the left arm folds down and left. The right hand lowers as the right knee bends, then both arms lengthen downward before the right hand reverses right and lifts into a fold over another bend of the right knee. Both hands rise with tucked elbows as the right leg straightens; they descend together and extend, the left hand sweeping left while the right hand moves right. Both arms curl upward and sweep left, the right arm opening briefly before folding again as the left leg straightens. The left hand returns right and rises with a longer reach while the right arm extends downward, then curls upward over a softening right knee.

The left hand dips left as the right hand moves right, both arms opening and then folding before the right hand returns left. The hands rise with the left arm curling inward, descend together, and sweep left with the left arm lengthening. They climb again, the left hand reaching farther left while the right hand travels right and drops with a deeper elbow bend. The right arm extends upward to the right, then curls down and left as the left hand rises and shifts right; both elbows open before the right hand returns up and left. The left hand climbs left, folds in, and releases into a downward reach while the right hand moves right and down.

The right knee bends as the dancer extends the right arm and carries the right hand right, then opens the left arm left while the right knee straightens. The right hand lowers and reverses left against the left arm's rightward sweep, with the right knee softening again before both arms lengthen downward. Both hands move left and rise as the right knee extends, then the left hand sweeps right and returns left while the right arm curls upward. The right arm reaches farther up and right, then drops left into a fold as the left hand lifts left and the right knee bends again.

As the right hand lowers and sweeps left, the dancer straightens both knees before lifting the right hand and extending the right arm. The left knee softens as the left hand rises right, then both hands descend with the right arm lengthening. The right knee bends further while the left hand lifts right, followed by a bend of the right knee and another rise of the right hand. The right hand drops as the right knee extends, then curls upward again; the left knee bends as the left arm opens and both hands lower. The left hand rises right while the right knee softens, then reverses left and down with an extended arm as the right knee straightens and the left knee deepens.

The right hand sweeps right and rises into a fold, then lowers as the left arm lengthens downward. The right arm reaches left and extends down while the left knee softens, then curls upward as the left knee straightens and the right knee bends. The right raised arm opens toward the right as the right knee releases, while the left hand lifts and tucks left; both hands descend with the left arm extending. The rightward-moving right hand climbs into a curl as the left knee bends, then drops left against the left arm's rising reach to the right. Both knees straighten as the hands reverse right, then the right knee bends while the right arm draws farther inward and lifts.

In opposition, the dancer sends the left hand left and the right hand right as both knees soften in succession. The right arm curls upward while the left hand reaches farther, then both hands descend with a release of the right knee; the right hand swings left and back right before rising with an unfolding elbow. Both hands lower and sweep left, the left arm lengthening as the left knee straightens, before the left hand drops again and both arms fold. The right knee bends and releases beneath a lift of the left hand to the right, which then lowers into a reach as the right arm opens downward and the right knee softens. The left hand sweeps left while the right arm rises with a tucked elbow and the right knee straightens, then the left arm extends up and right as the right hand moves right and the left knee bends.

The right hand rises and moves right. The dancer extends the left arm leftward, then folds both arms as the right hand lowers and sweeps left. The right hand reverses right with a tighter elbow while the left arm opens down and left; the left arm curls upward and returns left as the right knee softens. Both hands sweep right and descend, the right arm lengthening before they reverse left together, then rise with bent elbows. The right hand dips and rebounds right as the left hand follows right and lowers, then lifts again while the right arm extends downward and folds once more.

As the right hand rises and the left hand drops, both arms fold and the left hand returns up-left before opening into a rightward sweep. The right arm curls upward and left while the sweeping left hand lowers, then the left knee straightens as the curled right arm extends right. The left knee softens beneath a right elbow tuck and a rising right hand that reaches right, then the left knee bends again as the left arm lengthens downward and folds back up-right. The left arm opens down-left and reverses right as the right arm draws inward, then lifts into another curl while the left arm continues right and rises. Both hands sweep left and descend with the elbows folding, then reverse right as the knees bend and straighten in succession; the final phrase ends with both arms extending downward.

The right hand moves left and curls upward as the left arm extends down, then both hands sweep right with the right arm opening. The left hand rises while the right hand tucks farther in, dips left, and returns right into a curl; the left hand follows right before reversing left and extending. Both arms lengthen downward, then the right hand reverses right and folds up while the left hand rises into a tighter curl. The left hand travels left and opens as the right elbow draws in farther.

To begin, the dancer folds the right arm as the left knee straightens and the left hand rises; the left knee bends while the right hand lowers. The left hand sweeps left and curls upward as the left knee lengthens, then drops and opens right while the right elbow tucks. The left knee softens again as the hands separate left and right, with the right hand lifting into a fold over a straightening leg before reaching down-left and extending farther. The left hand climbs right as the right hand reverses right and curls upward, followed by a rise of the left hand and another bend of the right knee. Both hands descend with opening elbows as the right knee straightens, then sweep left together, the left arm folding higher before both arms extend downward.

The arms oppose each other: the dancer sends the left hand left and down while the right hand sweeps right, then curls upward and reverses left as the left arm folds and the left knee bends. The right hand continues up-left into a tighter tuck before both hands descend and the left hand reaches right. The left knee straightens as the right arm lengthens down-right, then both elbows fold while the left hand rises and the right hand lowers farther. The right arm opens left and lifts as the left hand returns right and curls upward; the right elbow then folds and releases downward while the left hand drops. The right hand moves right and rises with another bend of its elbow, and the left arm opens as the right hand returns left.

The right hand drops. The dancer folds the left arm rightward while the right arm lengthens, then lowers and extends the right knee as the left arm opens leftward and the left knee bends. The right leg straightens while the right arm curls up-right, then releases downward as both knees soften; the left arm draws inward and lifts leftward over a deeper bend of the left knee. The left hand continues rising with a tighter fold while the right hand moves right and climbs, then the arms open into a shared descent before reversing sideways and rising together. Both hands sweep down-left with bent elbows, the right hand returning rightward as the left hand lowers farther and extends; the right knee softens while the left leg straightens. The left hand reverses rightward and rises with an opening elbow as the left knee bends, then both legs lengthen in succession while the right arm tucks and continues rightward.

To begin, the dancer straightens the right knee while the left arm folds and lifts left, then releases downward as the right knee bends. The left hand continues left and drops into a tighter curl as the right knee extends again, while the right hand rises right and the left arm opens before folding back down-right. Both hands descend, the right arm tucking left as the right knee softens, then both elbows gather inward with the left hand moving right and the right hand rising. The left hand drops farther right and opens as the right knee lengthens; the right hand curls higher left while the left elbow tightens, then the hands trade height and spread right and left respectively as the right arm extends. The right knee bends beneath another fold of the left arm, then straightens as the hands reverse sideways and climb, the right elbow drawing in.

An alternating arm figure begins with both arms extending downward, the right hand sweeping left while the left hand curls upward and right. The right arm folds as the left arm reaches farther up and right, then the right hand returns up and right into a tuck while the left knee bends. The left hand drops left as the bent leg straightens, then curls upward and shifts right while the right hand sweeps down and left. Both hands climb with the left arm reaching out, then the right hand dips and rebounds before the left arm folds and releases downward. The right hand moves right and rises as the left hand sweeps left, then they trade height in an extension of the left arm, ending with the left hand lowering while the right hand climbs again.

The right knee straightens as the dancer folds both arms, lifts and lowers them together, then opens both elbows while the left hand moves right and the right arm curls upward. The hands reverse inward before separating again, the right hand descending as the left hand rises into a deeper fold; the right hand continues down-left while the left hand sweeps left and back right over a bend of the left knee. The right hand lifts as the left knee releases, then both arms lengthen downward, the left hand moving left while the right hand curls up-right. Both hands climb, the right arm opening and folding again as the left knee softens and the right hand returns left; the left elbow tucks, then the left arm extends as the right knee straightens and the left elbow opens. The left arm draws in toward the right while the right hand rises and moves right, then both hands descend and separate, the right hand returning left as the left knee bends.

As the right knee bends and straightens, the dancer curls the left arm upward while the right arm reaches down, then extends the left arm left as the left knee softens. The hands reverse right with the right arm folding, then the knees trade their bend and release before the left hand drops left into an extension and both knees sink again. The right hand rises right against a leftward sweep of the left hand, which reverses right as the left knee bends and the right arm curls upward; the left knee releases while the left hand continues right and the right arm sweeps down-left. Both knees soften as the hands separate right and left, the left arm extending before curling upward and reversing left against the right hand's descent. The right knee straightens while the left arm opens, then folds again as the right hand rises and both knees lengthen beneath a shared leftward reach. The left arm tightens and lifts while the right hand returns right, ending with the left knee bending and releasing and the right knee sinking further.

A low, rising arm sweep begins as the dancer sends the right hand right and down while the left hand curls upward, then lowers the left hand into a leftward extension. The right hand lifts right as both arms fold, the right knee straightens, and the left hand drops before the left arm opens. Both hands sweep left and climb with folding elbows, then descend and separate right and left, opening their arms as the right hand rises again. The left hand climbs right while the right arm extends left, dips and rises back right; the left arm tucks left and lifts alongside it, then releases downward as the right arm folds and drops. The right arm curls upward to the left, followed by the left hand lifting and reaching right while the right arm extends and the right knee bends.

As the right hand drops and the left hand moves right, the dancer straightens the right knee beneath the descending right arm. The left arm curls upward while the left knee bends and releases, then the lowered right hand sweeps left and rises as the left knee softens again. Both hands descend with folding elbows, and the right knee lengthens before both knees bend. The initially raised left arm tucks farther and sweeps up-right while the right arm extends downward; the left knee straightens as the right arm curls and lifts. That lifted right hand continues right and down, opens, and rises again.

The right hand rises, then lowers as the dancer folds both arms and lifts the left hand leftward. The right hand curls right while the left knee straightens, and the right elbow opens before both hands descend with the right arm lengthening further. Both hands lift and separate, the left arm tucking rightward as the right arm extends right, then the elbows reverse inward and the right hand drops while the left hand moves left. The right knee softens as the right hand sweeps down-left and rises into a fold, while the left arm reaches up-right; the right knee bends farther as the left knee straightens. The right arm unfolds downward and left while the left elbow opens, then both hands lower, with the left arm curling as the left knee softens. The hands continue to descend, the right arm extending farther left while the left elbow opens.

At the outset, the right hand drops and sweeps right as the right knee straightens and the left arm folds downward. The right hand rises while the left knee bends, then both hands climb and separate left and right as the left knee releases. Both arms lengthen down, the right hand returning right before they rise together and curl inward. The left knee softens as both elbows open, then the left knee straightens again. Both arms gather inward and descend into folded elbows.

The right knee softens as the dancer lifts the right hand right and folds the right arm, then straightens the right knee while both hands rise. The left arm curls left and releases downward as the right arm lengthens down and right; the left hand reverses up-right with a bend in the left elbow. Both hands descend, the right hand moving left as the left hand tucks, then both lift before the right arm opens left and the left arm folds farther left. The left hand rises again with an extending left elbow while the right arm curls upward to the right.

The left hand sweeps left and down while the right hand rises, with the left arm lengthening and the right hand dropping. The left hand reverses right while the right hand curls upward, then both hands descend, the right hand moving right and its elbow folding further. Both arms open into a shared lift, the right hand reversing left before they sweep together to the right and drop. They rise again, the left hand curling inward as the right hand reaches farther right, then lower with the right arm opening. The left arm lifts and extends left while the right hand travels right and folds inward.

The right knee softens beneath a curling rightward right arm sweep, then straightens as the left hand rises and both arms open. The right hand lowers with the right knee bending further, while the left hand reaches left; the right arm curls upward as the right knee extends and the left knee bends. The raised left hand drops into an opening reach, followed by the right hand descending left, before both arms tuck and their hands climb. Both arms lengthen downward, then fold again as the right hand sweeps right and down, followed by a leftward descent of the left hand. The right arm opens while the left hand lifts left, then folds back down as the left knee softens.

An alternating lift-and-drop begins with the dancer lowering both hands, then raising the left hand leftward and folding it as the right hand follows left. The left arm drops while the right elbow opens, then curls upward into a rightward sweep as the right knee straightens; the right hand lowers and lengthens down to the right before both elbows tuck. Both hands rise and separate left and right as the arms extend, then descend and reverse inward toward each other. The left arm folds leftward and lifts over a bending left knee while the right hand rises rightward and tucks; the left arm continues left and opens as the right elbow extends and the right knee softens. The right hand sweeps left and descends as the left hand lowers and the left knee bends further, then the left hand moves right while the right hand reverses right and rises into a curl.

The right knee straightens as the dancer folds the right arm downward and sweeps both hands right, then lifts the right hand while the left arm curls up and left. The raised left arm opens right before returning down-left into a fold, then extends farther left as the right hand moves right and the left knee lengthens. Both arms gather inward and lift, with the right hand continuing right and curling higher; the left hand then rises right as the right hand reaches left. The left arm tucks down-left while the right hand drops, then unfolds right and returns up-left through another bend and release. The left hand swings down-right, curls upward, and falls again as the right arm gathers in.

As the right hand moves right, the dancer straightens the right knee while the left arm curls up and left. The right arm lengthens as the right knee softens and the left knee bends, then both hands rise with the left arm opening before the knees straighten and the right hand returns left. The left hand follows left into a fold as the right elbow tucks, then both arms extend down and the hands separate sideways before curling upward again. The right hand continues left and opens while the left hand travels right and drops, both elbows extending before the left arm folds back up to the left as the right arm reaches farther left. The hands reverse sideways and descend together, the right arm lengthening as the left arm curls up and right, then both rise with the right hand moving left.

In opposition, the dancer sends the right hand right and the left hand left, extending both arms as the right knee bends. The hands reverse directions, with the left arm curling upward while the right hand rises farther and the left knee softens; the curled left hand then returns right as the left knee straightens. Both knees extend before the right hand drops into a fold and the right knee bends again, followed by the left hand descending. The left arm opens rightward as the bent right knee releases, then both arms lengthen, the right hand traveling right while the left hand moves left. The right knee straightens farther as the right arm folds left and lifts against the left hand's descent, before both hands rise and the left arm reaches out to the right.

As the dancer folds the right arm, both knees straighten in succession and the left hand rises right, then the right elbow releases while the left knee bends and the left hand drops. The right knee softens as the left hand continues down-right and curls upward; the right hand rises left and the left knee straightens before the right hand returns right. Both arms lengthen downward, the right hand moving left as the left knee bends and the left hand sweeps right, then reverses left. The right arm tucks while the left hand lowers and the left knee straightens, followed by another bend of the right knee as the tucked hand rises left. The right knee releases and bends again as the raised hand descends, then both hands sweep right and the right elbow folds farther inward.

The right knee softens as the dancer sweeps both hands left, then sends them right with the right arm lengthening while the right knee straightens. Both arms fold and lower, the left hand reversing left as the left knee bends; the right arm opens upward while the left arm tucks farther. The hands sweep right, the right hand dropping as the right arm curls, before the hands reverse left and rise together, the left arm extending. They separate again, the right arm reaching down-right while the left hand continues left, then returns right as the left knee bends. Both knees sink in succession, the right knee releasing first and the left following as the hands descend and their respective arms lengthen.

The dancer raises both hands and lengthens the right arm. Then the dancer lowers both hands while the left elbow folds. The right hand curls upward again as the left arm reaches right, drops, and returns left with a bent elbow. The left hand rises into a fold while the right arm extends downward. Then the right hand swings right and back left through a bend and release before curling up toward the right. The left hand moves left as both elbows tuck. Then the right hand reverses left and unfolds. Both arms lengthen, the left hand drifting right and dropping as the right hand lifts again.

The right knee softens as the dancer curls both arms upward, then the right knee straightens while the left arm extends down and left. The right hand lowers and swings right, left and right again as its elbow folds and the left knee bends deeper; the right hand rises into a tighter curl before dropping right against the left hand's upward lift. Both hands sweep left as the right arm opens downward, followed by the left hand moving right and rising with a folded elbow while the right hand returns right. The right arm lengthens down as the left lifts left and tucks farther, then both hands climb, the right one sweeping left and returning right. The left hand follows right and drops with an opening arm as the right hand descends, then the right elbow folds and both hands move left.

The dancer lowers both hands. The left hand curls rightward while the right arm folds left, then opens down as the left hand continues left and tucks in; the right elbow releases farther left before curling upward against the left arm's rising rightward reach. Both arms open and descend, the left arm moving left as the right arm folds up-right and reverses left, with the left elbow tightening. The right hand drops right as the left arm rises left and extends, then sweeps up-left and back right while the right knee bends, the left arm folding as the right knee straightens. The left knee softens as the left arm opens down-left and lengthens, then returns right while the right arm reaches down-left and the left hand lifts.

A low lateral sweep begins the phrase: the dancer extends the left arm left and lowers it as both hands move right, then curls the left arm upward. The right hand rises and tucks while the raised left arm opens right and descends, the left knee softening before the right knee bends and the tucked right hand drops. Both hands sweep left, the initially lowered left arm folding higher before opening down again. The left arm gathers up to the right as the right knee straightens and the right hand rises; the bent right knee releases while the left arm lengthens downward. The dancer carries the raised right hand farther right and lifts it into a tighter curl, then sends both hands down with the left arm extending and the curled right hand reaching left.

As the right hand rises, the dancer sends the left hand left and down with the left arm opening, then lifts the left hand against the right hand's descent. The left hand returns right and curls upward as the right arm extends downward; both hands sweep left before the left arm opens and drops while the right arm folds upward again. The left hand travels right and up into a tuck, then lowers as the right hand reaches right and down. The left arm reverses left and lengthens upward while the right elbow bends and the right hand rises, then both hands move right before the right hand descends and the left hand curls higher. Both arms draw inward as the left hand climbs, then the right hand reaches farther right and upward while the left hand moves left and down.

At the outset, the right hand curls up and right as the left hand reaches left, then both hands descend and reverse sideways with folded elbows. The left arm opens upward while the right hand returns right, dips and rises into a tighter fold. Both arms extend downward before curling upward again, then the left elbow tucks and the left hand drops through an opening reach and another lift. The left hand returns left and down, lengthens farther, then folds upward to finish.

A side-to-side arm exchange begins as the dancer curls the left hand left, opens and lowers it while the right arm folds upward, then reverses the hands left and right with a tightening of the left arm. Both hands rise, the left elbow curling farther inward before the left hand sweeps left and drops into an extension, while the right hand moves right and the right knee straightens. The left hand continues left and curls upward as the right hand reaches left; both elbows fold and the right hand climbs, followed by the left hand lifting into a longer reach. The left hand swings right and back left as the right hand lowers, then the left arm extends right and up while the right elbow tucks and releases; the left hand returns left and falls as the left knee softens. Both hands move right, the left arm lengthening and lowering while the right arm opens, then the hands reverse sideways as the bent knee straightens and the right elbow folds.

The right hand travels right as the dancer bends the left knee and opens the right arm farther, then curls it upward and left before releasing downward. The left arm folds left while the left knee straightens, then both hands climb with lengthening elbows as the left knee softens again. The right arm tucks higher while the left arm reaches down and right, followed by a lift of the right hand. The left arm curls up and left as the left knee straightens and the right knee bends, then the right hand rises farther left into an extension. Both hands descend with opening arms, the left hand continuing left while the right hand sweeps right and returns left, ending with both knees lengthening.

As the right arm curls upward and left, the dancer straightens the left knee while the left hand drops left. The left elbow opens as the right knee bends, then both hands rise with the left arm folding; the left knee softens as the left hand moves right and the arms lengthen downward. Both knees straighten as the left hand reverses left and the left arm tucks, then extends while the right knee deepens and the right arm reaches down and left. The right knee releases as the left arm folds upward and sweeps right, followed by a bend of the right knee and an extension of the left knee as the hands separate sideways. The left hand continues right and rises into a fold while the right arm extends down and left over another bend of the left knee, then lowers with the left hand before the hands trade height and reverse directions. The left arm curls upward again as the right hand rises, the right knee straightens, and the left knee bends further.

At the opening, the right arm curls upward and right as both knees soften, then the left hand rises and folds left while the right knee straightens. The left arm opens downward and the left knee bends again as the raised left hand drops left and lengthens over a deeper bend of the left knee; both hands sweep left and rise with the left elbow tucked, before the right arm reaches down-right and the left arm returns right and curls higher. Both arms fold as the right hand lifts right and the left hand lowers, then they open with the right hand dropping left and the left hand rising into a shared curl. The left hand sweeps down-left as the left knee softens, then climbs right and tucks further while the right hand continues left and folds inward. The right hand reverses right as the left hand moves left, both elbows drawing tighter before the left hand descends.

The right knee softens as the dancer sends both hands right, then lifts the right hand into a fold while the left arm opens. The right arm continues upward and lengthens before both hands descend and sweep left. The right knee bends further as the left arm tucks and the right hand rises with its elbow folding inward. Both hands drop and the left arm extends, then they lift again as the right knee releases.

A shared downward reach opens the phrase, with the right arm folding and both hands moving right while the left knee bends. The right hand lifts left as the left knee straightens, then drops farther left into a longer reach while the left hand moves left and rises. Both knees bend in succession beneath the rising right arm, which continues climbing as the left hand sweeps right, both arms lengthen, and the right hand reverses left. The hands separate again, the left-moving arm curling upward while the right arm reaches down to the right. The right arm opens into another lift as the left hand returns left, and both hands rise together.

The right knee bends and straightens as the dancer lifts both hands, sending the right hand right while the left arm curls upward. The right hand continues right as the left knee softens and the left arm lengthens downward; the left hand follows right before curling up again. The left arm folds left while the left knee straightens, then both hands descend and the left arm opens farther left. The left knee bends and releases beneath another upward reach of the left arm, which then tucks down and right as the right arm extends upward and the right knee straightens. Both hands rise with the elbows tucked, then sweep left together before the right hand drops and the left arm curls higher.

The right arm sweeps up and left into a curl while the left arm travels right and down. Then the right arm extends downward as the left knee softens. The left hand lifts into a fold while the right arm sweeps left and rises. Both arms lengthen before the hands separate, the left hand continuing upward and left. Both elbows tuck as the left hand descends, then the right hand lowers and the right arm opens before both hands climb again. The right arm reaches farther up and right, then drops left and unfolds as the left arm also opens. The left hand swings right, left and right once more while the right hand lowers into another extension.

As the right knee straightens, the dancer lowers and extends both arms, then curls the right hand upward while the left arm lengthens. The raised right hand drops into an open reach left as the right knee bends and the left arm tucks right; both knees soften before the left arm folds up and the right hand rises leftward. The folded left arm lowers left as the left knee straightens and the right hand drops right, then both elbows open with another softening of the left knee. The right knee straightens as the hands separate, the lower right hand sweeping right and rising against the left hand's downward-left extension. The left knee bends beneath a curling lift, then releases as the right hand continues right and down while the raised left hand reverses left.

At the outset, the dancer folds the right arm downward and reaches it left, while the left hand rises right; both elbows open as the right hand returns up-right. The left hand drops left with a curling elbow and reverses right as the left knee straightens, while the right arm tucks farther down-left and the right knee bends then releases. The right hand continues down-left with an opening elbow, followed by the left hand moving left, before the right arm curls upward again. The left hand swings right and down as the right arm lowers into an extension, then both hands shift left with the left hand rising and the right arm folding upward. Both arms draw inward toward the right, the right hand dropping as the right knee softens and the left elbow opens. The left arm curls up-left while the right arm reaches down-right, then both rise and sweep left, the right arm bending as the left arm lengthens.

In opposition, the dancer lowers the right hand while the left arm curls up and left; the right hand swings right and rises into a fold. The left hand climbs farther as the right knee straightens, then both arms open downward before the left hand returns right. Both hands sweep left with the left arm folding inward, then rise as the left arm releases; the left hand drops again while the right hand moves right and lengthens. The left hand arcs up-left into a tuck while the right hand descends, then both sweep right as the left arm opens and the right arm bends. The hands reverse left together, the left arm curling upward and returning right while the right arm extends down-left.

The right knee straightens as the left hand reaches right and the right hand curls upward, then both knees soften while the raised right hand drops left into an extended reach. The reaching left arm folds back up to the right over a deeper bend of the right knee, then opens downward as the right leg straightens and the right hand rises left; the lower right hand lifts through another knee bend and release while the left arm lengthens down to the right. Both hands descend, the left continuing left before lifting back right with a bent elbow as the right knee softens, while the right hand curls upward and the left knee straightens. The hands separate right and left, the left lowering and extending over a bending right knee as the right rises farther right, then they trade directions and height again, with the left elbow tucking and the right knee releasing while the right extends down to the left and both knees soften. The left arm reaches right and opens over another knee bend, while the right hand curls up and right; both knees straighten as the lifted right hand returns left and the left arm folds down.

The arms move in opposition: the left hand rises left while the right hand curls up and right, then the left arm folds and sweeps right as the right knee straightens. The right arm opens down and left before both hands descend, the right hand reversing right into a curl as the left knee bends and the left elbow releases. Both hands lift with the right arm drawing inward, then lower as the left arm extends; the right hand returns right and drops farther while the left hand curls upward. The left arm tucks more deeply and moves left as the right hand lifts, then both sweep right and the left arm reverses left. Both hands descend with lengthening elbows, the left hand continuing left while the right hand swings right and back left.

The right arm sweeps left and down while the left arm rises right, then both hands reverse sideways and descend into lengthened reaches. The left arm curls upward, followed by the right arm curling up-right before dropping and opening as the left arm reaches farther up-right. Both elbows fold again, the right hand lifting left while the left hand lowers and extends; the raised right hand drops and tucks further left as the lower left arm gathers back up-left. The dancer opens the lower left arm, folds the higher right arm, and carries the higher right hand left with a renewed curl, finishing with another extension of the lower left arm.

As the right arm reaches left and down, the dancer raises the left hand rightward, then lowers it with an extending elbow while the right hand curls upward. The left hand returns left into a bend as the right arm lengthens downward; both hands climb, the right hand moving right, before the right knee softens and the right hand drops while the left hand continues upward and left. Both arms open as the right knee straightens and the right hand moves left, then the left arm folds down-right while the right arm extends farther left and lowers; the bent elbow opens as the left hand rises, followed by the right hand lifting and the left arm curling upward again. The right arm tucks while the left hand drops and reaches left, then reverses right and lifts with a folded elbow as the right hand lowers into an extension. Both hands sweep left, the right arm curling up while the left hand rises rightward into a bend, then the right hand falls right as the left hand descends left. The left arm lengthens while the right elbow draws inward, then both hands rise and separate into opposing left-right directions as the right knee bends and the left knee straightens.

The dancer lengthens the right arm downward. The left hand rises as the right arm folds and lifts, then both arms sweep right with opening elbows before the left hand drops left into a curl; the right hand follows left and lowers. Both arms extend, the right hand reversing right and climbing while the left hand curls upward and reverses left. The right arm gathers in and carries the right hand left and down as the left elbow opens and tucks again. The left hand returns right into a fold while the right arm reaches up-left, then both arms lengthen as the right hand climbs farther and both hands reverse right.

Upward, the dancer lifts the right hand while the left hand reaches left and folds back right, then lowers both hands as the right knee bends. The right arm curls upward again while the left hand sweeps right and rises; the right knee straightens before both arms lengthen down, with the left hand moving left and the left knee softening. Both hands sweep right and curl upward as the left knee releases, then reverse left and descend into extensions while the right knee bends and straightens. The left arm tucks up and opens downward as both knees soften, then the right arm folds and carries its hand left against a rightward reach of the left hand. The knees straighten in succession while the right arm extends farther left, the left arm curls up and left, and both knees bend again beneath a final lowering of the right hand.

The right arm curls upward. The dancer sends the left hand left, then opens both elbows as the right arm lowers and the left hand reverses right; both hands rise before the right arm drops and the left hand moves left, with the left knee softening as the right arm folds. Both arms tuck as the right knee bends further and the right hand sweeps down-left, then both hands lift while the knees straighten and the right hand returns right into a deeper fold. The left arm extends downward through another bend of the right knee, then curls up and left while the right hand swings right and back left. The right arm lengthens down-right as the left elbow opens, followed by a leftward return and renewed tuck of the right hand while the left arm reaches farther down. Both hands descend, the right arm opening and then curling again as the right knee softens, before both sweep right and rise with folding elbows.

The right knee straightens as the dancer lowers and lengthens both arms, then lifts the left hand leftward while the right arm curls upward. Both hands descend, with the right arm releasing and moving right before folding again; the left hand rises and falls into an extended reach as the right elbow opens. The right hand drops and rises into a tuck while the left sweeps up-left and back down-right, then reaches higher to the right as the right arm lengthens downward. Both hands lift together before separating left and right, the left hand lowering and opening as the right returns left, then both drop and reverse sideways. The right knee softens beneath a shared rise, followed by another descent and renewed upward sweep of both hands.

To begin, the dancer sends the right hand right and lowers it as the right knee straightens; the left arm reaches left, then both hands rise with the right hand curling inward. The right hand drops toward the right while the left arm opens upward, then returns left as the right knee bends and the left knee softens. The right arm extends down-left while the left arm curls up-right, then lengthens downward and folds again as the bent right knee releases. Both knees bend in succession beneath a shared leftward sweep, followed by another release of each leg as the right arm opens and the left arm tucks farther left. The right knee softens once more as the tucked left arm reaches up-right, while the right hand moves right and rises before returning left with a deeper bend.

The arms join in a shared lift. The right hand sweeps right and down, then returns left as both hands descend and the right arm lengthens. The left arm curls upward and reaches right while the right hand moves right and rises into a fold, then both elbows open as their heights reverse. Both hands continue right with bent elbows before the right arm tucks farther inward.

In unison, the dancer lifts and folds both arms, carrying the right hand left while the left hand moves right. The right arm lengthens upward as the right knee straightens, then curls back down toward the left while the left knee bends; the left arm opens through a rightward sweep before folding again as the left knee releases. Both hands rise with extending elbows, the right hand continuing left while the left arm tucks and the left knee softens. The hands descend together and separate sideways, the left hand moving right as the left knee bends deeper and the right hand shifts right. The left knee releases while the left arm reaches farther right, then the right hand returns left and rises into a fold as the right knee extends and the left arm curls upward.

A rising, sweeping arm exchange begins as the dancer folds the left arm and lifts the left hand left while the right arm extends right, then opens the left arm. The hands trade height, the left hand dropping into a rightward curl as the right hand rises and folds; the left elbow opens again before both arms tuck and the left hand moves left. Both hands descend, the right arm extending left and back right as the left hand rises and curls inward. The left arm continues lengthening upward while the right arm reaches higher to the left, then both arms sweep right and lower. The left hand returns left as the right hand drops farther, and the right arm unfolds into a final rightward reach.

The arms lengthen in opposition: the right hand moves right as the left hand reaches left, then both rise while the left knee bends and straightens. The right arm folds leftward and reverses right, opening as the left elbow tucks; the left knee softens again before the right arm extends down-left and the left hand lowers leftward. Both hands sweep right with folding elbows, then the right hand drops and opens while the left hand returns left and curls upward. The right hand traces left-right-left as the left arm unfolds, then both lift and extend rightward while the right knee bends and straightens. The right hand continues right and rises into a curl as the left knee softens, while the left hand travels left and drops.

The dancer folds the right arm. The right hand drops, sweeps left, and rises into a curl while the left hand moves right; the right arm then opens downward while the left knee softens and the left arm lengthens down to the left. The right arm curls upward toward the right while the left arm folds left, then both elbows draw inward as the left knee bends further and the left hand reverses right and up. The right hand climbs farther right and extends while the left arm opens downward, followed by another rightward reach from the right elbow as the left hand moves left. Both hands descend with opening arms, then the right hand swings left and rises as both elbows fold and the left knee straightens. The right knee bends while the right hand lowers, and the left arm curls left before both hands drop.

A knee bend accompanies the dancer's opening lift: the right arm curls up and left as both legs lengthen, then the right hand drops right while the left hand moves down-left and the left leg bends. The hands separate sideways and rise with folding elbows, the right arm extending before both descend and sweep apart again, the right hand right and the left hand left. Both arms tuck into a shared leftward lift, the left hand returning right as the right knee straightens; the right hand reverses right while the left knee softens beneath a further reach of the left arm. The right arm lengthens down-left as the bent knee releases, while the left hand rises left, folds and descends right over another knee bend. The right knee extends and re-bends as the right arm reaches farther down-left and the left arm curls upward; both hands return right with the right arm drawing inward, then both hands lower as the left knee straightens and the left arm opens.

In opposition, the dancer lifts the right hand right while the left arm folds left and drops, then extends downward as the left knee straightens. The right arm curls upward to the right, then releases down and left before both hands sweep left and rise with folded elbows. The right arm opens into a rightward lift while the left arm tucks further and the left knee softens; the right hand returns left as the left arm lengthens downward and the right knee bends. Both knees sink in succession while the left hand continues down, and the right knee straightens as the right hand rises right into an extension. The right hand lowers as the right knee bends again and the left knee softens, then both hands move left while the right elbow folds and the left hand rises with an opening arm.

As the right hand rises and the left hand curls upward, the dancer folds the right arm left and releases it down while the left hand lifts. The right hand reverses right with a bend and release of its elbow as the left hand lowers and opens; both hands then sweep left, the left hand rising before returning right as the right hand drops. Both arms extend and lift together, then the right hand reaches left and the left hand curls downward, finishing with the right hand dropping and the left hand sweeping left. The right arm folds upward toward the right as the left knee softens, then extends back left while the left leg straightens. The hands reverse sideways together, the right hand curling up and the left hand tucking left and lowering. The right knee bends and releases beneath another upward reach of the right arm, ending with the left hand moving right and up.

The right knee softens as the dancer sends the right hand right and lowers the left hand, then opens both arms before lifting the hands apart, left and right. The left hand swings left and back right as the left arm curls, while the right hand drops; the knees exchange their bend and release as the right hand moves right and rises with a fold, then the left arm tucks left and both hands climb. The right hand continues right and down while the left hand travels left and curls higher, then both sweep left and descend into lengthened arms as the right knee straightens. Both elbows fold and the hands reverse right, followed by an upward curl of the left arm and a lift of the right hand. The left elbow releases downward as the right arm extends down and left, then folds again and moves right while the left hand climbs.

At the outset, the right arm curls upward and right while the left hand rises and the right knee bends; the right arm then opens downward as both hands sweep left. The left knee straightens as the left hand lifts, then both hands climb with the right arm extending farther right while the knees soften in succession. The right hand reverses left and down as the right knee lengthens and the left knee bends, followed by another leftward extension of the left arm. Both hands rise and sweep right before the right hand returns left and drops with a folding elbow. The right hand reverses right as the left arm gathers up-left and the left knee straightens, then the left knee softens again while the right hand lowers and the left arm opens.

The dancer lowers and lengthens the right arm. The left hand rises, then drops while the right hand moves right. The left arm curls upward and left as the right knee bends; the right hand continues down-right before lifting. The right hand reverses left and falls again as the bent leg straightens, then returns right and up while the left hand sweeps left and descends.

In opposition, the right hand sweeps left and curls upward while the left hand rises rightward into a fold; both elbows then release as the hands descend. The right arm reaches right while the left arm moves left, opens downward, and curls back up to the right. Both arms lengthen as their hands rise, with the right hand continuing right and the left hand returning left. The left hand drops as the right hand climbs farther right and the left arm folds leftward, then reverses right while the lower hand returns left and both elbows tighten. The right hand lowers through a deeper curl as the left arm extends downward, then both hands sweep left, the right arm opening before the left arm curls upward and carries its hand right.

The right arm and left arm separate. The right hand curls upward, swings left and back right into a fold while the left arm rises and reaches left, then both hands descend with opening elbows and the left hand sweeps down-right. The right arm gathers up-left while the left arm reaches farther right, before they exchange height in folded extensions; the lower hand returns right as the opposite hand rises left and tucks. Both hands lift and sweep left, the left elbow tightening as the right hand lowers, then the hands reverse right and the left hand climbs with a deepening curl. The left arm drops left as the right arm folds down-left, and the descending hand continues left while its counterpart lifts right and opens. The left arm lengthens downward and returns right while the raised hand lowers.

The dancer folds the right arm while the left hand moves right and down, then reverses left as the right elbow opens. The right arm lowers and extends toward the right while the left hand continues left and the right knee bends. The left hand rises into a curl as the right knee softens further, then both hands descend with the left moving right and the right returning left. The arms lengthen apart before the right hand lifts, curls and drops again.

At the outset, the right arm curls up and left while the left hand lowers and the left knee bends. The right hand drops as the left leg straightens, then rises again into a deeper fold while the left arm reaches right and upward. Both hands descend as the left arm lengthens farther right, and the right arm tucks in; the left hand then reverses left and rises with an extended elbow. The left arm folds downward before opening and lifting again toward the right, while the right arm draws inward and lifts alongside it.

The right hand sweeps left. The left hand curls upward and moves right as the right arm extends, then both hands rise with the right arm folding inward while the left arm lengthens and lifts. Both arms tuck, the right hand descending farther left while the left hand reaches down and right, before the left arm opens. The left arm folds back up and left as the right hand drops, then both curl into a shared lift with the left hand continuing left. The right hand descends as the right knee bends, while the left elbow releases and the right knee straightens; both hands lower and move right before the right hand reverses left. The right knee softens again beneath an upward reach of the right arm as the left hand continues right.

The right knee softens as the dancer lowers and extends both arms, then lifts them into folded elbows. The left hand sweeps left and down while the right hand travels right, before both hands return rightward with the right arm lengthening and the right knee bending further. The left hand dips left and curls upward as the right elbow opens, then they separate left and right, the left hand continuing upward while the right hand folds back left. Both arms tuck and descend, then the left hand swings right and rises with a deeper fold as the right knee bends and releases; the right arm opens left and drops while the left hand returns left. The right arm curls up toward the right as the left hand moves right, then extends downward and sweeps left while the right hand rises and falls. The right knee bends again beneath another upward curl of the left arm, followed by a lift and descent of the right hand.

The knees soften in succession as the dancer folds the left arm, then extends it upward and left while the right hand rises rightward. The left arm curls down and right as the left knee straightens, then opens and lifts left against the right hand's descent. Both arms gather upward before the hands separate right and left, with the left arm reaching up-left; the left knee bends and releases as the left hand drops and the right hand returns left. The right hand moves right while the left arm curls higher, then both sweep left as the right arm lengthens downward and the left arm tucks farther. Both hands rise and separate again, the right hand moving right, before the right arm folds through a leftward lift and a rightward drop.

The right arm and left arm oppose each other laterally as the right knee bends and straightens, with the left hand dropping into a fold before both hands rise and the right knee softens again. The left arm curls rightward over another bend of the right knee while the right arm opens downward, then both knees straighten as the hands sweep left and lower. The right elbow tucks and opens into an upward reach toward the right, joined by the left hand moving right; both elbows fold and release as the left knee lengthens, before the right arm curls up to the left and the left hand rises with a tucked elbow. The hands separate left and right, then descend together as the right arm extends and the left knee bends. The right hand rebounds upward to the left with the right knee lengthening, then drops while the left hand sweeps left and lowers into a deeper fold. The right arm reaches down and right as the bent right knee straightens, while the left arm lifts leftward and the right hand continues right and higher.

The right knee straightens as the dancer curls the left arm upward, then extends the left arm while the right hand drops and moves right; the left hand continues up-right before both arms fold, the left lifting farther while the right opens downward. The hands sweep left with the right arm lengthening, then return right as the right hand rises and both elbows tuck, followed by another dip and lift of the right hand into a deeper curl. Both hands move left as the left arm releases down-left, then the left hand reverses right and rises into another bend while the right arm folds and its hand climbs. The right hand returns left and drops as the left arm opens, then the left hand lifts right while the right arm travels left. The dancer extends the left-moving arm and repeats a rightward lift with its elbow folding, then lowers both hands, the left moving left and the right moving right.

The right knee straightens as the left hand sweeps left and down into a fold, then returns right while the right hand lowers and the right arm extends; both hands climb and the left hand moves left before the right elbow curls. The hands reverse sideways, the right hand descending while the left hand rises and opens, then sweep right together with the right arm lengthening and the left elbow folding inward. Both hands return left as the knees bend in succession and the left hand lifts with an extending arm, followed by the right hand climbing right and curling inward. The arms exchange height, the left arm dropping into a fold while the right arm climbs farther left, then both lift with the right elbow tucking as the right knee softens. The hands separate left and right before returning toward each other, the left arm opening downward while the right arm folds upward, and the knee beneath the rising hand straightens. The right hand continues up and left into a deeper curl as the left knee bends and the left arm extends downward.

The right hand sweeps left and down. The dancer sends the left hand right and lifts both hands, then carries the right hand back right as the right knee softens; the left arm curls upward while the right hand lowers again. Both knees straighten in succession as the left hand drops and reaches right, then both arms tuck while the right hand moves left and rises. The hands sweep right and climb together with folded elbows, then descend as the right hand opens and the left hand reverses left. The right arm gathers inward while the left hand extends, then lifts left into another curl as the right arm folds more tightly. The leftward-moving arm releases downward before rising again.

Rightward, the dancer sends the right hand while the left arm curls upward and moves left. The rising right hand climbs farther before both arms open downward and the hands sweep apart, then the right hand reverses right as the right knee bends and straightens and the left hand returns right. The right arm folds down-left and reaches back up-right as the right knee softens again, then both arms tuck and rise with another bend of the right knee before the right hand lowers and extends left. Both arms lengthen downward, then curl upward as the knees release; the hands separate sideways and descend, with the right arm opening again. The right arm folds up-left and opens again, followed by a lift and extension of the left arm.

The right hand curls upward and right as the left arm folds down-left, then both descend with the right extending left while the left opens and reverses right. The left hand rises into a curl as the right continues left and lengthens, then lowers with the left elbow opening before both arms gather inward and lift together. The left arm extends downward as the right curls higher and drops left, followed by the left hand dropping left and folding. The right hand swings right and climbs into a tighter tuck as its knee straightens, then returns left and down with an opening elbow. Both hands rise again, the right curling farther as its knee bends, before it lowers left and extends and the left arm opens downward.

The dancer lifts the left hand. Both hands descend as the right arm lengthens, then the right hand rises and folds back down while the left hand climbs and extends right. The right hand curls up toward the left, followed by the left rising into a bend as the right opens downward; both lower, with the left sweeping left and the right extending right. The hands reverse sideways as the left arm unfolds upward, then the right reaches left while the left folds again. The right hand rises into a curl as the left drops rightward, then both sweep left before the right lowers and its arm lengthens.

While the right hand drops, the dancer lowers and extends the left arm, then curls both arms upward, sweeping the right arm left as the right knee bends and the left knee straightens. The hands separate right and left, then descend together with folded elbows before the right hand reverses right and the left hand climbs back left into an extension. The right hand rises as the right knee softens, then both arms lengthen downward while the right leg straightens; the left hand sweeps right and lifts as the right hand returns left. The left hand drops left and curls up again while the right hand continues down and left, followed by a shared rise and rightward sweep. Both arms open as the knees bend and release in succession, then the left hand returns left and down while the right hand curls upward and right. The left arm folds higher and opens as the right hand tucks left, ending with the left hand lowering.

The right hand drops as the left knee bends. Both hands sweep left. The right arm lengthens and the left knee straightens. The left arm curls up and right as the right arm continues down. The left arm returns left with a fold while the left knee softens. Both hands rise and the right arm opens. The right arm descends as the left elbow tucks. Both hands shift left as the left knee bends again. The hands separate sideways and reverse inward as the left leg extends and the right knee straightens. The right hand rises while the left hand drops, both arms curling as both knees soften. The hands continue separating and climbing. The left arm opens as the left knee lengthens and the right knee bends farther. The hands sweep left together before reversing right and descending. The right knee straightens and the right hand returns left. The hands rise again. The left arm sweeps right and lowers as the right arm folds. Both hands descend left while the left elbow tightens further and the left knee bends. The right hand lifts as the left arm reaches upward and the left knee straightens. The right hand descends and the right leg extends.

The dancer alternates arm reversals with knee bends: the right arm curls upward while the left hand drops left and the right knee softens, then both hands rise as the right knee straightens. The right hand continues right and down through another bend of the right knee while the left elbow folds; the left arm opens into a lift as the knees exchange their bend and release. The right arm reaches left and lengthens downward as the right knee straightens, then curls up while the left arm tucks right and the right knee softens again. The left hand rises farther as the right knee extends and the right arm folds left, then both arms open before the left hand descends and the right hand returns right and down. The hands separate right and left as the left knee bends, then both curl upward with the right knee bending and releasing, finishing with the right arm extending left.

A rising curl and drop begins the phrase, with the right arm drawing up and inward while the left hand lifts right; the right arm then opens downward as the left arm folds. The left arm reaches left and rises again while the right arm curls up-right, then both hands climb before the right arm drops right into an extension and the left arm folds upward-left. Both arms open and tuck through another lift, the left hand moving right and down before returning left as the right arm reaches right and lowers. The left hand rises into a fold while the right arm curls farther up-right, continuing that sweep as the left arm lengthens. The hands separate left and right and rise together, the left arm opening, before descending and reversing sideways.

To begin, the dancer lifts the right hand while the left arm extends down and right. The right hand moves right as the left arm folds back left. The left arm lengthens again before both hands descend, then both sweep right and rise with the left elbow drawing inward. Both arms curl further upward, carrying their hands leftward as the right knee straightens.

The right hand drops and sweeps left. The dancer folds the left arm, then lowers and extends the right hand as the left hand reaches right and upward. Both hands continue right before the left arm curls back left. The right arm folds down and opens while the left hand climbs and tucks further inward.

At the outset, the dancer lowers and lengthens the right arm while the left arm curls upward, then sends the right hand right as both hands rise. The left arm reaches down-right before both elbows tuck and the hands separate left and right. Both arms unfold downward as the right knee straightens, then the right hand returns right while the left arm folds back up-left and the left knee bends. The right hand lifts into a reach as the right knee straightens again, followed by another lift of the left hand. The left arm draws in and drops toward the right while the right arm extends higher; the left knee softens as the right hand curls up-left and the left hand opens downward. The right arm lengthens down-right and sweeps left as the right knee bends farther, while the left hand moves right and rises.

As the right hand rises, the dancer straightens the right knee and lifts the left hand rightward into a fold, then lowers both hands before extending the left arm left. The right hand climbs left while the left arm swings right and back left, both arms lengthening as the left knee bends and releases; the right hand drops right, sweeps up-left, and returns down-right with a bend of the right knee. Both knees soften as the right hand curls upward and the left arm moves right, then the right leg straightens while the left arm reaches left and the right arm opens downward. The hands sweep left together as the left arm folds and the left knee bends further, then both reverse right and rise with opening elbows before descending and returning left. The left knee softens again while the right arm reaches up-right and the left arm tucks farther in; the left hand follows right and curls inward as the right arm extends down-left, ending with both hands lowering and the left knee releasing.

As the right arm folds, the dancer sends its hand left and down, then opens that elbow while the left arm reaches up and right. The right hand reverses right as both elbows tuck and the left hand drops. Both arms extend before the left arm curls upward again, joined by the right hand rising into a fold. The hands separate left and right, then descend with opening elbows and a deeper fold of the left arm. Both hands rise again as the elbows lengthen.

In opposition, the right arm curls upward as the left arm folds down and left, then the right hand moves right while the left hand drops into a lengthening reach. Both hands descend with the left elbow opening farther, before the right arm extends right and the left arm rises. The right hand sweeps left, tucks, and returns right while the left elbow folds and opens; both arms gather inward as their hands lower and separate sideways. The hands lift together, then separate again, the right hand moving left and extending downward while the left hand curls up and left. The left hand falls and swings right, opening as the right hand returns right, before the left elbow bends and the right hand reaches left.

In opposition, the right arm curls upward as the left arm reaches left and lengthens down. The right hand travels right and opens downward while the left arm lifts leftward and folds back right; both hands then descend as their elbows extend. Both arms curl upward and sweep left before the right arm drops with a deeper fold, and the left arm extends as its hand returns right and up. The left hand lowers again while the right arm rises and lengthens farther right, followed by a lift of the right hand. Both arms tuck through a shared leftward sweep, then open as the right hand descends and the left arm moves right. The right arm folds into another lift to the left, while the left elbow draws in.

To begin, the dancer extends the right arm down-right while the left arm curls upward and moves left. The right hand folds back up-left as the right knee straightens and the left elbow opens; both hands then descend, the right knee softening again before the hands separate right and left and the elbows tuck. Both knees lengthen as the left-moving hand lifts rightward and the right arm rises with a deeper curl, then the hands exchange height and reverse sideways. The right arm unfolds as the left knee bends and releases, followed by the raised left knee sinking and extending; both hands lower as the left arm reaches out and the right knee straightens. The right knee bends again beneath a lift of the left hand, which then drops as the bent right knee releases and the right hand travels right.

The right hand rises as the left hand sweeps left and down, then both arms lengthen before the right hand lowers right into a fold while the left arm curls upward. The left hand returns left and drops farther as the right knee bends, then the right leg straightens beneath an extending reach to the right. The left arm tucks and lifts toward the right as the reaching arm folds back left, with the right knee bending again while the left hand drops. Both hands descend and sweep right, the left arm opening while the right hand draws inward, then reverses left and lengthens as the bent knee releases. The right hand climbs left into a tighter curl while the left hand continues down and left, finishing with the lifted hand dropping right as the opposite knee softens.

The right hand rises into a curl. The dancer extends the left arm down-left, then folds it upward as the right hand travels right and descends. The left arm releases downward while the right arm curls up-right; the right hand follows up-right and lengthens, then both arms descend with the right elbow opening. Both arms gather back toward the left, the right hand climbing before the left lifts, then the hands separate sideways and reverse their directions. The right hand dips, returns up-left and continues leftward as the left arm folds right, then drops and reaches farther left while the right hand lowers and extends.

The arms work in opposition: the right hand travels left as the right knee straightens and the left arm lengthens upward, then the right arm folds while the left arm curls down. The left hand continues down-left and opens as the right arm rises and extends, followed by a lift of the right hand and a curling return of the left hand toward the right. Both hands climb and separate sideways before descending into bent elbows, with the right arm reaching left and opening again as the left hand sweeps right and back left. The right hand rises and drops farther left while the left elbow tightens and releases, then both arms extend downward and sweep right. The left arm gathers upward as the right hand lifts and folds, and both hands climb with the left hand continuing left.

The right arm curls upward as the left arm lengthens. The right hand moves right while the left knee straightens, then both hands descend and the right arm opens. Both hands sweep left, the right hand rising as the right knee bends and releases; the left hand lifts and folds before moving right and down against the right hand's continued rise. The right hand drops as both arms extend, then curls upward again while the left arm sweeps left and rises.

The right knee softens as the dancer sends both hands right, then the left knee bends and both arms fold. Both hands rise as the bent knees straighten in succession, before the right arm extends down-left while the left hand continues right. Both hands climb as the right arm curls upward and the left arm opens, then descend with the right hand returning right while the left elbow gathers inward. The right arm lengthens downward as the right knee bends and releases, then folds again while the left arm tucks and the left knee softens. Both hands lift with the elbows drawing inward, the left hand moving left and the right hand continuing right.

An alternating arm sweep begins with both hands rising as the right knee straightens and the left knee softens; the left hand drops right while the right hand travels left, then curls upward and returns right. The left knee lengthens as the left hand lowers and folds inward, while the right arm extends downward. Both knees soften in succession, the right arm opening left as the right knee straightens, then curling back up and right while the left hand rises and the left knee bends deeper. The right arm folds into a drop and reaches right again as the left elbow tucks, then both hands lift with the left arm extending farther. The right hand continues right before returning down and left into a bend, while the left arm draws inward.

To begin, the dancer lowers and extends the right arm as the left knee softens and the left hand rises leftward, then opens the left hand right while the right hand curls up-right. The left arm folds back down-left as the raised right hand descends left over a straightening left knee, then both hands sweep right with the right arm extending before the lowered left hand returns left and the right arm lifts into a fold. Both arms curl upward and release downward, the right hand moving right while the left hand travels left; the right-moving arm then folds up-right as the left arm lengthens farther left and rises, followed by the left hand climbing and tucking. The left hand continues right and unfolds as the right hand sweeps left and down, then reverses right while the left arm curls again. The right knee bends further as the left hand drops, then both knees soften and the arms open; the lower left hand climbs while the right hand moves left and folds back right. Both hands descend with the right elbow opening, then rise together as the left arm gathers inward and the right arm continues right.

The dancer raises the right hand. Both arms fold and lower, then the left hand sweeps left as both elbows open and the right hand rises again. The left arm curls upward while the right hand moves right and down, followed by a lift of the left hand and an extension of its elbow. The left arm tucks into a downward sweep to the right before opening back up. It folds once more and lowers.

The right knee softens as the dancer lifts the right hand and carries it right, while the left arm curls upward; both hands descend before the right hand returns left. The left arm extends down-left as the right arm folds up-right, then rises into a curl while the left elbow opens and the knees straighten in succession. The hands sweep left together as the right knee bends and releases and the right arm lengthens downward, while the left knee straightens and the left arm reaches down-right. Both arms fold upward toward the right, with the right hand climbing farther as the left knee softens beneath a continuing rightward reach. The left leg straightens as the right knee also extends and the right arm opens down-left; the left hand sweeps left and rises, followed by the right hand lifting right as the left hand drops. The left knee bends again as the left hand reverses right, and the right hand lowers while the left hand continues rising.

The right arm curls up and left as the left hand drops, then the right arm opens down while the left arm rises right. The right hand returns right and folds upward against the left hand's descending leftward reach, then both hands sweep left before the right arm releases downward. Both hands lift with bent elbows, the left hand moving right, then the right hand tucks into a shared rightward sweep that ends with both arms opening. The left hand dips and rebounds into an upward curl while the right hand moves left and down, then extends right as the left hand continues rising and reaches farther right. The dancer reverses the right hand left, right and back left as the left hand lowers and opens, before lifting both hands with another fold of the left arm.

The right hand rises rightward as the left knee bends, then both hands lower and the right arm curls left before extending back right. The left arm folds upward, opens, and lowers while the right hand continues right, then returns up-left as the left knee straightens and the right knee softens. The right knee releases again as both hands sweep left, the right arm lengthening downward while the left arm tucks higher, then both knees bend and the left hand drops before both hands return right with the elbows drawing inward. The right knee straightens as the right hand rises and reaches farther right, while the left arm extends down-left; both knees bend in succession, then the right knee straightens as the left hand lifts and sweeps right. Both arms fold into a rising reach rightward, the right hand climbing higher as the left elbow tightens and the left knee releases.

To begin, the dancer sends the right hand right and down while the left hand rises left over a straightening right knee; both hands return left as the right knee bends, then climb, with the right arm curling. The right arm folds and opens again before both hands sweep right and lower, the left arm lengthening. They reverse left with the right arm tucked, then rise together, the left hand continuing upward and folding inward.
