Both hands fall and separate left and right, then lift into opposing reaches as the left knee straightens and the right arm extends. The right hand descends right over another bend of the left knee, then curls up and left as the knee releases and both arms draw inward.

As the right hand drops, the dancer lifts the left hand leftward, then lowers and extends the right hand right while the left arm folds back down. The hands trade height twice, each returning in opposite directions with a curling fold of the rising arm, before both arms lengthen downward. The right hand continues right as the left hand curls upward, then reverses left and rises while the left elbow opens; both hands climb, the right hand continuing left before dropping and extending right into a shared descent. Both arms tuck as their hands sweep left, the right hand climbing again while the left hand sinks farther. The left hand reaches right and up as its knee straightens, then lowers while the right arm curls upward and extends left.

The right knee softens as the dancer lifts the left hand and sweeps both hands right, the left arm curling upward before extending down. The right arm folds leftward and opens downward as the bent right knee straightens; the right elbow tucks and releases while the right knee bends again. The left hand rises with a deeper fold and moves right as the right knee lengthens further, then drops while the right hand climbs into another inward reach. Both arms unfold and sweep left, the left hand descending and the right hand rising, before the left hand curls up and returns right. The right hand follows right and lowers as the right arm extends, while the left arm opens and continues rightward.

The right knee straightens as the left arm folds upward and right, then lowers into an extension. The right hand rises left while the left hand continues down-left, and both arms lengthen before the hands reverse sideways. The right knee bends and straightens again as the hands separate, the left hand descending while the right hand curls up-right. The left arm opens farther downward and extends left as the right knee softens, then lifts while the right arm reaches down-left; the hands trade height twice more with the right knee deepening and releasing and the left arm folding inward. Both knees bend as the repeatedly trading hands descend, then the right knee straightens while the right arm reaches down-right and the left knee sinks further beneath a lowering arm that curls in. The left knee releases and the left arm lengthens downward as the right hand moves left, then both hands rise, the right hand curling left and the left hand moving right.

The right hand moves right and rises. The left hand sweeps left, folds inward, then lowers as the right hand returns left. Both hands descend before the left hand reaches right and the right arm opens farther right; both elbows then tuck as the right hand continues rightward. The dancer repeats the descent and lift, curling each arm inward before releasing them into a shared leftward sweep, with the right hand lengthening downward. The left elbow bends again as the left hand lifts and travels right, while the right hand follows right, folds inward and rises. The right hand reverses left as the left hand descends and extends, then returns right while the left arm curls back up.

Leftward, the left hand rises and curls as the dancer folds the right arm upward, then sends the right hand right while the left hand drops. Both arms open as the hands separate left and right, the right hand returning left before both lift into tighter bends and sweep left together. The left hand lowers with a deeper curl as the right arm extends and the right knee softens; the left hand continues down-left before both rise, the right arm folding back right and the left arm lengthening. The hands separate again, the left hand dropping left and the right hand right, then both climb into bent elbows before descending and separating once more. The left arm curls upward and carries the left hand right while both knees bend in succession, the right knee straightening first before both bend again beneath another rise of the left hand. The left hand reverses left and lowers as the right knee sinks farther and the right hand follows left, finishing with an extension of the left arm.

The knees soften in succession. The dancer bends the right knee while the left arm curls upward, then straightens the right knee as the left arm opens left and down. The right arm folds right and lowers, followed by the left hand dropping left and extending; the hands separate horizontally, the right arm lengthening farther while the left arm rises and reaches left. Both arms tuck as the left hand climbs and the right knee deepens, then the hands sweep right with opening elbows before folding again and reversing left. The hands descend and separate right and left as the knee beneath the right-moving hand straightens, then rise together into a shared leftward reach. The arm above the straightened knee extends downward while the opposite hand lowers and opens, finishing with that knee softening further.

The knees join a later bend as the dancer lifts the left hand leftward and folds the left arm, then lowers both hands into a rightward sweep with the right elbow opening. The left arm extends upward while the right hand drops, curls up to the left and opens again, followed by the left hand moving right. The left hand descends and tucks through another left-to-right sweep before reaching upward and extending, joined by the right hand climbing and folding. The right knee straightens as the left hand continues right and down with an open elbow; the right hand rises while the right knee bends again. The right hand sweeps left and back right as the left arm lengthens, then both hands descend, the right hand continuing downward with an extended elbow.

The right knee softens and straightens as the dancer lifts the left hand leftward and extends the left arm, then the left knee bends while the left hand drops right and both elbows fold. The right hand rises rightward with an opening elbow as the knees exchange bends, followed by the left hand dropping left while the right knee lengthens. The left hand curls upward as the right hand moves left and down with a bent knee, then both arms extend into another lift, the hands separating right and left before returning left together. The right knee straightens as both hands descend and sweep right, then the left knee bends while the left arm folds upward and opens downward again, ending with the right hand rising.

The dancer bends the right knee while reaching the right arm rightward; simultaneously, the left hand rises and folds inward. Both hands reverse left before the right hand dips and curls up again. The left hand climbs farther as the left knee softens and the right knee straightens, then the left hand sweeps right and down while the right arm tucks higher and both knees lengthen. Both hands swing left with a shared fold, then the left hand reverses right and drops as the right hand moves right, opens, and lifts; the left knee bends and releases beneath a renewed leftward sweep that continues as the right hand descends. The right arm curls upward while the left arm lowers, then both arms extend into a rightward sweep as the right knee bends. Both arms lift together and reverse left before the right knee straightens and the right hand drops. The left arm reaches down-right and lengthens as the left knee extends, while the right hand swings right and back left, the right knee softening before both knees straighten and the right arm folds downward. The right hand returns right as the left knee bends, then both knees lengthen again to accompany the left arm's rightward extension and rising curl.

As the right arm reaches left and folds, the dancer lifts both hands with a deeper curl on the right side, then sends both hands right and down while the left knee softens. The right hand climbs farther as the right leg straightens and the left arm tucks higher, then the hands reverse apart and lower. Both knees bend as the right hand swings right and rises into a fold while the left hand drops left; both legs straighten in succession as the right arm opens downward. The hands sweep left together before the left arm curls upward and returns right with a lengthening elbow, followed by the right hand rising right and opening. Both hands descend as the right knee bends, then the arms separate left and right and lift again with renewed tucks.

As the right hand rises, the dancer folds both arms and carries the right hand left and up, then reverses it right. The left arm curls upward as the right arm opens, followed by a deeper fold of the left elbow and a lift of the left hand. The left hand drops, sweeps right and returns left into an extension while the right arm draws inward and the lower knee straightens. Both hands rise and sweep right with lengthening arms, then the left hand descends as the right hand dips left and rebounds upward. The hands separate left and right before returning together to the right, with the right hand lowering and the left arm extending.

An alternating arm lift begins as the dancer lengthens the right arm upward, folds it, and reaches left while the left hand rises; the folded right arm then opens right as the left hand returns left. The left hand curls upward and both arms tuck into a shared descent, before the right arm extends down-left and the left hand follows left with its elbow opening. That extended right arm lifts right as the right knee beneath it bends, then reverses left and lowers while the left arm curls up-right and the right knee straightens. Both hands sweep right with the right arm folding downward, then reverse left, the left hand rising through an extension and a renewed curl as the right knee softens again. The right hand dips left with a deeper fold, rebounds up-right, and both arms lengthen as the left knee releases.

As the right hand curls up and left, the dancer extends the left arm downward, then draws it up-right into a fold while the right hand drops right. The left elbow opens as both hands climb, then the right hand curls left and down while the left hand moves right and lowers; the right arm lengthens again before its hand rises right against the left hand's leftward sweep. Both arms tuck as their hands descend, the left hand continuing left and then curling upward to the right while the right hand reaches right and lifts. The right hand reverses left and folds down as the left arm opens and lowers, then the left hand returns left and both elbows draw inward. The left hand climbs right with an extending elbow while the right hand moves right, then the raised hand sweeps left and curls higher.

A repeating figure begins with the right hand moving left and the left hand moving right, both arms lengthening before reversing sideways and folding inward. The right arm reaches up-right as the left hand rises and travels right, then opens downward while the left hand curls left and descends. The left hand returns right with an extension, followed by the right hand curling up-left. Both hands drop and move left, the left elbow tucking more deeply as it lifts alongside the right. The right hand reverses right and folds while the left hand continues left and down, then opens into a low leftward sweep.

The right hand reaches right and curls upward as the left arm folds, then both hands climb before the right hand returns left. Both arms extend downward and sweep right with bent elbows, then curl upward and reverse left; the right hand opens down and right while the left hand tucks higher and drops. The left knee bends as the right arm lengthens leftward, then the left leg straightens while the right hand curls up and right. Both hands rise with folding elbows, the left arm opening downward and sweeping left as the right hand climbs right and extends. The right hand continues down and left, curls back up and right, then reverses left again.

The right knee softens as the dancer sends both hands left, then curls the right arm upward and reverses the left hand right before lowering both. The right arm opens down-left while the left knee bends, straightens, and bends again beneath a lift of the left hand; the left hand drops as the left leg lengthens and the right knee releases. Both hands rise, the right arm curling right before returning down-left and opening as the left arm extends down-right, then lifts while the left knee bends and straightens and the right knee also lengthens. The right hand reaches up-right against the left hand's downward-left sweep, then curls down-right over another bend-and-release of the left knee; both hands lower as the left knee softens and the arms extend, then lift together with the left knee straightening. Both hands descend as the right knee bends, the left arm folds down-right and the left knee sinks further, followed by the right arm tucking down-left.

The dancer straightens the right knee. Both hands rise and separate right and left, then descend as the arms lengthen and sweep apart again, with the left hand continuing left before returning right. The right arm folds while the left knee bends, then the folded right arm lowers and extends as the left knee releases; the left hand rises into a curl while the right hand moves right. The left knee softens and the left arm opens down and left as the right knee bends, and both knees straighten in succession. The right hand lifts and reaches right against the left hand's descending leftward reach, then drops as the left hand returns up and right, both elbows folding. The right knee bends beneath a further rightward extension of the left arm, which then curls upward as the right leg releases.

The left hand travels left. The right arm reaches up and right, then both hands lower as the left arm folds and both elbows open; the right hand returns left while the left knee straightens. The left hand curls upward and right as the left knee bends and releases, then sweeps down-left into a deeper fold while the right knee softens and straightens again. Both arms lengthen downward as the left leg extends, then rise together with the left elbow tucking; the hands sweep right and descend before reversing left with the right arm drawing in. The left arm reaches up-right as the left knee lengthens further, then folds back left while the right hand rises and moves right over a bending knee. The right knee straightens as both hands climb, the right arm extending before curling inward again.

The right hand rises and curls inward. The dancer lowers the right hand while the left arm reaches right, then carries the left hand right as both hands climb, folding in before descending together. Both arms lengthen as the right knee softens and the left knee bends; the hands sweep left, the left hand rising into a fold while the right hand drops and extends. The left arm continues upward as the right arm lifts, then the hands trade height and reverse sideways with the left arm opening and closing again. Both elbows tuck, the right hand continuing down and left as the left hand moves right, then both arms open and the right hand climbs.

In unison, the dancer lowers both hands, one arm extending left while the other folds and moves right. Both arms lengthen downward, with the leading hand continuing left and its knee straightening before it lifts again. That arm curls inward as the opposite hand rises, then opens left while the raised hand shifts left; the newly extended arm drops and refolds as the other continues climbing. The lower arm stretches farther down and left while the higher hand descends, then reverses up and right into a tighter tuck. The rising arm lengthens upward and returns left, joined by the other hand moving left before the first arm folds downward.

At the outset, the right arm curls upward and left while the left hand moves right and drops; the raised right hand reverses down-right as both elbows open. The hands separate sideways, then fold upward and exchange directions before descending together. Both arms lengthen, with the initially curled right arm reaching left and the left arm following as it opens farther. The right hand lifts and sweeps right while the left hand travels left and lowers, its knee straightening as the higher right arm extends. That lower left hand continues left and up with a tucked elbow while the right arm reaches right, then returns left and rises through an opening and closing of its elbow.

The dancer lifts the right hand upward and right as the left arm extends downward, then both hands sweep left with the right hand continuing higher while the right knee straightens. The right arm folds back down and right into a longer reach as the left elbow curls, then both knees soften before the left hand rises and the left knee straightens. Both hands descend and separate left and right as the left knee bends again; the left-moving arm tucks and the right knee lengthens before the hands reverse inward and rise with bent elbows, the right knee softening once more. The hands sweep left and drop as both knees sink, then the left arm opens downward while the right knee straightens and the right arm reaches up-right. The right arm curls and lowers as the left hand rises left and the left knee bends, then the left hand moves right while the right hand continues climbing and the right knee lengthens.

The right hand moves right. The left arm curls upward and left, then the right arm folds higher toward the left as both hands descend, the left hand opening right before returning left and curling upward. Both arms lengthen downward, sweep right and rise again, with the right hand returning left. They lower together, the left arm tucking in before the hands reverse left and both elbows fold; the left hand rises while the right hand sweeps right and drops into an extension. The left hand dips left, curls up to the right and opens down as the right arm reaches farther right. The hands separate, the right one lifting while the left hand moves left, before they return together toward the right.

As both hands sweep right, the dancer straightens the right knee while the left arm folds left; the right hand returns left and climbs with a lengthening elbow as the left arm reaches up and right. The left arm tucks farther and continues upward while the right hand drops left and the left knee bends. The left knee straightens as the right arm curls downward, then the left hand rises and sweeps right over another right knee bend while the right hand moves right and curls back up-left. The left hand lowers and extends left as the right hand drops left, then reverses right into a rising fold while the left arm opens farther left. Both hands continue climbing before the right arm releases down-left and the left arm curls higher to the right.

The right knee straightens as the dancer lifts both hands, folding the left arm and extending the right arm. Both arms open while the right hand moves left, then the hands rise again with the left elbow curling inward. The left arm lengthens as the right knee bends, and the right hand drops before both sweep right, the left arm extending farther. The right hand returns left and curls upward while the left arm folds left, and the right knee straightens. The right hand continues left and lowers as the left arm opens, while the left hand reverses right; the left arm gathers in once more and the right arm extends.

An alternating arm sweep begins with the dancer lifting the left hand left, then lowering it while the right arm extends left and curls upward; the left hand reverses right as both arms lengthen. Both hands descend into folds, then rise again as the left arm opens, the right hand moving right and back left before descending. The right hand curls up-left while the left arm reaches right and drops, followed by the right arm reaching down-right. Both elbows draw inward as the left hand rises and the right arm lowers farther, then they open and exchange height, with the left hand climbing farther before both hands sink and the left hand swings right. The right arm tucks up-left and returns down-right, while the left hand lifts left and both arms lengthen; the right hand rises before curling back left as the left elbow folds.

In opposition, the dancer sends the right hand right and lowers it into a fold while the left hand moves left. The right arm lengthens downward as the left knee straightens, then both hands sweep left before the right arm curls upward. The left arm opens right while the right hand reaches farther left, the right knee softening, and both hands descend with the right elbow folding. The right arm lifts right as the right knee extends, then reverses left and drops into another tuck; the left hand continues right and down as the left knee bends and releases. The right hand sweeps right and rises with an opening elbow while the left knee softens again, then the arms exchange height and direction: the left arm folds left as the right arm extends downward.

As the right hand moves right and the left hand rises, the dancer folds both arms and lowers them, then lifts the left hand leftward into an extension while the right arm curls upward. The hands separate sideways as the right elbow opens and the left elbow tucks; both lower and lengthen, with the right hand moving right. Both hands rise again, the right hand folding inward before they descend together, and the left arm reaches out as its hand sweeps left. The right hand follows left while the left arm folds and lifts, then opens downward as the right arm extends farther. The left hand continues left and rises while the right hand moves right, and both elbows curl inward.

The right hand drops while the left hand reaches right. The dancer sends the right hand left, then lifts it as both elbows fold and the right hand returns right, before opening both arms downward. The left arm curls up-left and lengthens down-left, joined by the right hand's leftward reach. Both hands rise as the left arm folds, then descend with a shared tuck of the right elbow. The left hand climbs right into an extension while the right hand lowers and sweeps left.

At the outset, the left arm folds while the right hand travels right and down. The left hand rises left as the right knee bends, then both hands descend with lengthening elbows and the right knee straightens. The right arm curls up to the left before releasing down as the right knee softens again; both knees then extend beneath a shared lift of the arms, the left arm continuing left while the right arm tucks and drops. The right hand rebounds upward as the right knee bends, while the left arm opens down to the right and the left knee straightens; the right arm lowers into an extension as the left hand reverses left. The left hand sweeps right with a bent elbow and straightening knee while the right arm rises and falls to the left. Both arms curl upward, the left arm sweeping left and the right arm following right.

In opposition, the right arm reaches right and curls upward as the left hand travels left, then both hands lower and spread sideways while the left elbow opens. The right arm extends up-left before folding down-right, followed by the left arm curling upward as the left knee straightens. The right hand sweeps left with a deeper tuck, then rises right and lengthens while the left hand drops. Both hands descend, the left arm extending farther before curling back up-right as the right knee bends.

In unison, the arms lengthen downward as the right knee softens and straightens. The dancer sweeps both hands left while the right knee bends again, then opens the left arm as the right knee straightens once more. Both hands continue left with the left arm folding, before the right hand rises right and the left hand curls upward and right. The right arm tucks as the right hand lowers, while the left hand moves left and the left arm extends.

The right knee softens as the dancer curls the right hand upward and right, then straightens the right leg while the left arm folds left and rises; the raised left arm opens down-left before both hands climb again. The hands sweep right, the right arm extending farther as the right knee bends, then both reverse left with the right hand dropping while the left arm curls up-right. Both hands lift again, the right hand moving right as the left arm opens downward, then the right arm lengthens into a descending rightward reach. The left hand moves left while the right arm folds upward, dips right and rebounds higher as the left elbow tucks. The left hand continues left and drops with an opening arm, while the right hand sweeps left and returns right.

The right hand sweeps right while the left hand reaches left and rises. Then the right hand reverses its reach left and down while both arms lengthen. The hands exchange directions again: the right hand returns right as the left hand drops left, before both lift and reverse their sideways paths. The left arm tucks left while the right arm curls up to the right, then extends downward. The right hand rises through a bend and release as the left elbow folds; it returns down and left while the left arm opens upward. The left hand lifts into a fold as the right hand drops and its elbow opens, then both descend.

In opposition, the dancer raises the right hand while the left arm folds and the right knee bends. The raised right arm curls inward as the bent right leg straightens, then both hands descend with the left elbow drawing tighter. The right hand lifts and lengthens leftward as the left hand continues down and right; the left knee softens again before the left hand reverses left and the right hand rises. Both elbows fold as the hands separate sideways and the right knee extends, then the right hand returns right and drops while the left hand climbs.

To begin, the dancer folds the right arm and carries the right hand left as the left knee bends, then lifts the right hand into an extending rightward sweep while the left knee straightens. The left hand continues right as both knees soften in succession, then rises with a tucked elbow before returning left and down; the left knee straightens as the right arm reaches right and upward, followed by the left arm curling up toward the right. The right hand sweeps left and drops while the left hand continues right, opens and lowers, then both hands descend and reverse sideways. The right arm extends right as the left arm tucks, and both hands rise before the left arm travels left and lengthens downward. Both arms fold as the right hand moves left and the left hand lifts right, then they release and sweep right together.

The right knee straightens while the left arm reaches right and drops, then both hands sweep left as the left hand climbs; the left knee bends and releases as the left hand lifts and returns down-right. The right hand continues right and lowers while the left arm folds upward, then the left hand sweeps left and down as the right knee softens and the descending right hand curls up-left. The hands separate left and right, then the right knee bends and straightens as the left arm extends downward and the right hand rises; the arms reverse their lateral paths, the left arm curling upward and opening downward, with the right hand continuing up-left. Both knees lengthen as the hands lower, then the left knee bends while the right arm opens down-left and the left arm tucks upward. The left knee straightens as both hands rise and the left arm extends right, then the left knee softens again beneath a folded return left while the right knee lengthens. The left arm releases downward and the right hand climbs left before both descend, the left knee bending once more as the right hand reverses right.

An alternating arm weave begins as the dancer lowers the left hand and curls it left, while the right hand reaches right; both arms rise before the right arm folds down and opens again. The hands separate sideways, then exchange height twice with a bend in the left arm, before the left arm releases upward and the right arm curls lower. Both arms extend as the hands sweep right, then fold back left, with the left arm lengthening once more. The left hand rises into a tuck while the right hand lifts and opens, then the left hand drops and extends as the right hand moves left and curls inward.

The right knee softens as the left hand drops left and the left arm extends, while the right hand travels right and down; the left knee straightens before both knees bend. The hands reverse sideways, the left hand lifting left and the right hand lowering right, then the left arm folds downward as the right knee lengthens. Both knees soften in succession while the arms open and the hands separate right and left, then the right hand lifts left as both elbows tuck and the hands descend. The hands continue separating with the right hand rising farther, before both sweep left and rise into a shared rightward return. They reverse apart again, the right hand dropping as the left arm curls up-left, then the right elbow bends and the right hand lifts alongside the left hand.

The right hand travels left and down as the dancer straightens the right knee, then curls upward while the left arm folds right; both hands sweep left before reversing right with the right elbow opening. The hands lower, the right knee softening as the arms gather inward, then rise and separate left and right with a deeper bend of the right knee. Both arms extend downward and curl upward again, the left hand moving right as the right knee lengthens; the right hand drops and reaches farther left. The right hand rebounds up and right while the left hand sweeps left, rises and returns right into an extended reach, joined by the right hand's outward lift. The left arm folds back left and lowers as the right hand descends, then both move left before the right arm opens and both hands climb and return right. The left elbow tucks and the left hand dips left and lifts right again, while the right arm curls upward to the right and the right knee bends.

A lateral opposition begins with the dancer sending the right hand right while the left arm folds and lifts, then both hands lower as the left knee straightens and the left arm opens left. The left hand reaches up-right as both elbows curl, then returns left and lowers against the continuing rightward sweep of the right hand. Both arms lengthen downward before folding again, the hands separating sideways and reversing their paths through another extension. The left arm curls upward as the left knee softens, then reaches down-left while the right knee bends and straightens beneath a shared rightward lift. The left knee releases farther and the right hand continues right and drops as the left arm extends.

The dancer makes a rising arm exchange, sending the right hand left and the left hand right before both sweep left and climb with lengthening elbows. The hands reverse outward, then descend as the right knee bends; the right arm curls upward while the left opens, and the right leg straightens as the right hand drops farther left. Both arms reach down and spread apart, then tuck into an upward sweep toward the opposite sides and open again, ending with the right knee extending further and the right hand dropping rightward. The left arm curls up-right as the right lifts left, followed by another curling rise of the left hand while the right lowers and lengthens. Both hands continue moving left, the left descending as the left knee softens and its elbow opens, before the right arm folds up-right and the left curls upward.

In opposition, the dancer curls the right arm upward and right while the left hand drops left; the right hand reverses down-left as the right knee softens. The left knee bends and releases as the left hand rises, then both arms open downward before the right elbow folds again. Both hands sweep right with the left arm curling upward and the right lengthening, then the left hand returns left and down into an extension while the right climbs farther left and opens. The right arm lifts as both knees soften, then the right hand falls and the left curls right and up through another bend of the left knee. The right arm extends down-left and rebounds higher as the left hand drops and the left knee straightens. The left arm tucks while the right knee lengthens and the right arm folds more deeply, finishing with a rise of the left hand as the right knee bends again.

To begin, the dancer folds the right arm upward and carries both hands left, extending the right arm before it curls back right. The left hand rises as the right hand drops, then they separate left and right with the right arm opening, followed by another fold and release of the left arm. Both hands lift, the right hand moving right while the left hand shifts left, then descend into lengthened arms and sweep right together. The right arm reaches up and left against the left hand's rightward motion, then reverses right as the left knee straightens; both hands lower, the left elbow tucks, and the right hand returns left. The right hand rises with a bend in the right knee while the left hand moves right, then extends down and left as the bent right knee releases and the left hand lifts with the left knee straightening.

A rising arm exchange begins as the dancer curls the right hand up and right while the left hand reaches left, then the left hand opens downward. The right hand continues upward and right with a lengthening elbow before lowering as both hands move left and the left knee straightens. The left knee bends again while the right hand returns right, dips, and lifts into an extension as the right knee softens. Both arms tuck and rise, the right hand moving right before both descend; the left arm opens while the right hand curls higher and sweeps left. The left arm folds, lowers, and extends back up and right as the right arm opens and the right knee straightens, then both hands lift farther.

The right knee softens as the dancer lowers and extends the left arm leftward, then straightens the right leg while both hands sweep right. The left hand above the bent right knee rises and falls into a curl as the right leg lengthens farther; the right hand drops and moves left while the curled left arm lifts, opens, and dips again. Both arms fold through another shared descent, then the left arm reaches upward while the right hand moves left and down into an extension, followed by the raised left hand dropping as the right knee bends and releases. The right arm curls up and right before opening downward as the left hand continues right and the right knee sinks again. The right knee straightens beneath a rising leftward left hand while the right arm folds and climbs, then sweeps right and down as the left elbow tucks.

The right hand sweeps left and curls upward. The left hand rises as the left knee straightens, then both hands move right and descend. The right arm extends before curling again as the right knee softens. The left knee bends while the right arm opens downward and folds once more. Both knees lengthen as the left hand lifts and reaches right, then returns left and down. The right hand rises into a tighter fold, dips farther left, and rebounds upward while the left knee bends and straightens beneath a leftward sweep of the left hand. The left hand drops as the left knee deepens and the left arm extends, then reverses right while the right hand climbs and the right knee softens. Both knees straighten in succession as the right hand moves left and lowers with an opening elbow.

As the right hand sweeps left and down, the dancer lengthens the left arm and then folds it as the lowered right hand rebounds upward. The rebounding right arm opens right while the left arm curls downward and follows right, then both hands descend and reverse left into bent arms before rising again. Both arms tuck further and sweep right, with the right hand dropping and opening; the left hand returns left and climbs through a release as the right hand lifts and extends. The right hand drops left and rises again, its elbow folding and releasing, while the left arm lowers and lengthens, then folds up to the right as the right arm reaches farther left. The left hand reverses left and curls higher while the right hand continues left and down.

As the right hand rises, the dancer carries both hands right and lowers them, then lifts them again before reversing left. The right arm curls higher as the left hand sweeps down to the right and opens; the right hand follows right while the left knee straightens. Both hands descend, the right arm extending and sweeping left as the left knee bends, while the left hand rises and folds left with a deeper bend in the right knee. The hands separate sideways as the right knee releases and the left hand drops right, then the right hand lowers farther left with the right knee softening. The right knee straightens beneath another upward curl of the right arm, then bends again as the left knee sinks and the left arm extends down to the left.

A rightward arm sweep begins as the dancer sends the right hand down and left, the right knee softening before both knees straighten. The right arm curls upward, then opens while the left hand lifts left; the newly raised left hand drops as the left knee bends and the right arm folds down-left. The lower right hand reverses up-right while the right knee straightens, then both hands sweep left and descend into extended arms. Both hands rise and return right with bent elbows, then the right elbow lengthens as the right knee softens again. The left hand drops as the hands separate left and right, the leftward arm curling upward while the right knee straightens and bends beneath its descending hand.

The dancer lifts the left hand left and curls it upward as the right arm folds and both hands descend, then sends the left hand right while the right knee softens and the right hand rises. The left arm lengthens up-left over a bend and release of the right knee, then curls down-right as the right knee straightens again and the right arm extends. Both hands lower and separate, the left hand moving left and the right hand moving right, before the right hand rises into a fold and drops back down. The right hand travels left and rises with an extension as the left arm tucks upward, then the left hand swings right and falls while the right hand continues left.

The dancer bends the right knee later while lowering and folding both arms, lifting the left hand while the right hand reaches right. The raised left arm opens downward and lengthens to the left as the right arm curls upward, then the left arm reverses right and folds again while the right arm extends down. The folded left hand drops and opens left with a deeper bend of the right knee, while the right arm tucks up and right; the lower right hand lifts and returns right as the left arm falls into a longer reach. The hands separate right and left, the left hand descending before curling upward and sweeping right, while the right hand rises and folds into a shared leftward sweep. Both arms open as the higher left hand climbs farther and the right elbow tucks, then the hands reverse sideways and descend.

The right knee straightens as the dancer extends the right arm right, then lifts and curls it left while the left hand rises left and folds. The right arm opens downward as the left arm curls up-right, then both hands sweep left before the right arm tucks upward and the left arm lowers into an extension. Both hands climb, the right arm reaching out while the left arm curls inward and drops. The left hand returns up-right with a deeper fold as the right hand lowers, then both sweep left and descend, the left arm opening and sweeping right while the right arm gathers upward.

As the right knee softens, the dancer folds the left arm and lowers the left hand left while the right hand moves right. The left arm opens as the right knee straightens, then both hands sweep left before reversing right with the left hand dropping. Both arms lengthen downward, the right hand returning left while the left hand moves right and curls upward; the right elbow also tucks as the knees exchange bends and straighten. The left arm reaches down to the left while the right arm extends farther down and right, then the elbows fold as the left hand reverses right and the right hand returns left. The right hand rises with a bent elbow while the left arm continues opening right and lowers, ending with the right hand sweeping left and the left hand moving right.

The right knee softens as the dancer lifts and extends the left arm, then lengthens the right knee while the left hand drops and the right arm folds upward. The left arm curls right as the right elbow opens, then both hands lower, the right hand moving left before the right arm tucks again. Both arms lift with bent elbows, the left hand drifting left and lowering as the right hand sweeps right and down; the left arm then reaches up and right against the right arm's leftward extension. The hands separate right and left as the left arm folds downward, then the right arm reverses right and rises with a tucked elbow before opening. Both hands descend and sweep left, the right arm lengthening through the reversal as the knees straighten in succession.

The right arm reaches left and folds. The left hand lowers right, then the right arm curls upward as the right knee straightens; both hands move right before the right arm opens down and both knees lengthen. Both hands rise with folded arms as the left knee bends, then descend, the right arm curling in while the left hand extends right and down. The right arm opens downward, sweeps up-right, and tucks again as the right knee softens; the left hand rises left and folds over a bending left knee, then falls right as the left knee releases. The right hand climbs right while the left hand moves left and opens, then drops as the right knee bends and the right hand returns left. The left knee sinks beneath its rising, curled left hand, followed by the right knee's bend and release as the right hand reverses right and the left arm opens.

Both hands sweep left. The right arm curls upward and continues left while the left hand reverses right, then both arms lengthen while the left knee bends and straightens; the right hand rises farther left and folds in. Both knees soften as the hands lower and the right hand returns right, while the left arm extends downward and curls back up as the left knee releases. The left hand sweeps down-left while the right hand moves right, then the left hand rises and the left knee straightens before the right arm tucks downward. The left arm lengthens into a sustained lift while the right arm reaches up-right, then folds back down-left.

The dancer raises the right hand. The left arm extends left and lowers as the raised right hand sweeps right and down, then curls upward while the left arm folds left. Both hands move left and drop with lengthening arms before rising again, the initially raised right arm tucking farther as the left arm opens. The tucked right arm reaches right and descends into an extension, then returns left and up as the left hand continues left and rises. The left hand reverses right while both elbows bend and lower, finishing with a leftward sweep of the initially raised right hand.

The dancer performs alternating arm lifts and drops: the right hand rises while the left hand travels right, then both descend, the right hand moving left. The arms lengthen as the left hand continues right and the right knee bends; the left hand then curls upward and sweeps left before lowering and opening again. Both hands rise with tucked elbows, the right knee softening further as the right hand moves right and the left arm extends downward. The right knee straightens beneath a lift of the left arm, which folds left and lowers while the right hand rises and falls; both elbows open as the left hand returns right. The left hand climbs farther, curls inward and drops through another right knee bend and release, ending with an extended reach.

As the right arm folds and its hand rises right, the dancer curls the left arm upward to the left, then releases both elbows while lowering and sweeping the hands apart. The right hand climbs farther left as both arms lengthen, then drops into a tighter fold before lifting again and continuing left. Both hands descend with extending elbows, the right hand shifting right while the left arm opens further. The left arm bends inward as the right hand lifts left, then reverses right and lowers through an unfolding elbow.

As the right arm folds upward, the dancer lengthens the left arm toward the right, then sends both hands left and down while the right elbow opens. The left hand reverses right as the right knee straightens and the right hand rises with a tucked elbow; the right knee softens again beneath another upward curl, while the left arm reaches farther right. The right arm sweeps down-left, extends and lifts alongside the left hand before both descend and separate sideways, the right arm opening through a brief lift. Both arms lengthen downward, the left hand returning right as the right arm curls up-right, then both elbows fold as the hands reverse inward. The right arm releases down-right while the left hand drops and the left knee bends; both knees soften as the left hand continues down-left and the left knee straightens.

The dancer lowers the left hand while the right hand curls up-left, then both arms fold as the right hand reaches down-right and both hands descend. Both hands sweep left with extending elbows before the left hand reverses right and rises into a tuck; the right hand follows right and curls upward as the right knee straightens, then the right hand returns left and drops as the left knee bends and releases beneath a deeper extension of the right arm. The left hand lifts into a folded reach right while the right hand moves left and curls higher, then both descend with lengthening elbows as the right hand continues outward and the left hand shifts right. The right knee softens again beneath another shared lift, followed by a leftward curl of the right hand and a rightward extension of the left hand; the left hand then dips and rebounds into a tighter fold as the left knee bends further and the left arm sweeps left and down. The left hand rebounds right while the right knee straightens and the right hand climbs left, then both knees soften as the right hand reverses down-right and the left hand descends into a longer reach. The hands separate left and right, the right arm folding before sweeping down-left against the left hand's continued descent, ending with the right arm opening into a final downward reach.

The right knee softens as the dancer sends the left hand left and down with a lengthening arm, then folds the left arm upward before lowering it farther left. The right arm reaches right and opens, followed by the left arm extending downward. Both hands sweep left and rise, the left hand curling inward while the right hand folds; they reverse right together as the left arm lengthens. The arms descend and open again, then the right hand climbs left into a bend as the left hand lifts and reaches right. The right arm extends higher and farther left, then both hands fall as the left elbow draws in.

To begin, the dancer extends the right arm right while the left arm folds and lifts left, then sends both hands back left with the left arm opening and the right arm curling upward. The left hand rises farther as the right hand lowers into a longer reach, followed by the left arm extending right and folding downward while the right arm continues left and down. Both arms lengthen again as the hands reverse right, then climb together before the right arm drops and tucks; the left hand follows downward and curls left. The right hand rises into an extension as the right knee straightens, while the left hand sweeps left and up, then right and down as the left knee bends. The right arm reaches higher to the right, and the left hand moves left.

The dancer straightens the right knee and lengthens the right arm, then lifts both hands as the left knee bends and releases and the right arm folds. The left hand dips right with an extending elbow while the right arm curls down, then rises and opens into a leftward sweep. Both arms tuck and lower, then the right hand climbs right into another fold as the left arm reaches down and right; the right hand continues upward and left while the left arm returns left. The right arm lowers and opens as the left arm extends down to the right, then both hands rise with the left elbow folding and the right hand sweeping left. The left elbow releases as the hands separate right and left, the right hand lowering and curling back in while the left arm lengthens downward. The right hand finishes by rising and returning left as the left arm sweeps up to the right.

An alternating arm figure begins with both hands moving right, the right arm extending and returning left as the left knee straightens. The right hand drops while the left hand rises into a curl, then lowers and opens; the right knee softens as the right arm reaches down and right before folding back left. Both arms lengthen downward as the left leg bends and releases, followed by the right hand rising and sweeping left and back right. The left arm curls upward while the right arm extends farther right and drops, then both hands descend with the right arm tucking in. The left knee bends as the right hand returns left and both arms open downward, finishing with another bend and release of the left knee.

The right arm reaches left while the left arm folds right, and the right hand reverses up-right as both elbows open. The left arm curls upward to the right before extending down-left as the right elbow tucks and the right hand drops; both then rise with bent elbows, the left hand moving right while the right hand returns left. Both hands descend, the left arm lengthening before folding into a lift as the right hand moves right and the right knee softens. The left hand continues up-right while the right hand travels left and down, then the left arm opens downward as the right hand rises and extends left. The right hand sweeps right and curls upward as the right knee bends and straightens beneath a further extension of the left arm, whose hand then returns left.

To begin, the dancer curls the right arm up and left while the right knee straightens and the left hand drops right; the right arm reverses right and opens downward as both hands continue right. Both knees soften in succession beneath a rising fold of the left arm, then both knees extend as the right arm reaches down and left and the left arm curls upward. The left arm unfolds and lowers through another bend of the right knee before both arms tuck into a shared rise, the right knee straightening again. The hands separate right and left with both elbows opening, then descend and sweep back toward each other as the right knee bends; the left knee softens while the right arm folds upward and both hands move right. The right arm releases down-right as the right knee extends, then rises and curls left over another right knee bend while the left arm lengthens downward. The right knee straightens as the raised hand dips, rebounds upward and returns left with an opening elbow, ending on a softened right knee while the left hand continues lowering.

The right knee bends as the left hand rises and curls inward, then lowers with its elbow folding further while the right arm extends downward. The right knee releases as both hands rise, then softens again beneath a rightward lift of the left hand joined by an upward curl on the right side. The right knee straightens as the left arm reaches left and the right arm folds downward; the hands sweep right together before the right-knee side reverses left and lifts into an extension. The right knee lengthens as the left hand returns left and the raised hand drops right, then both knees soften in succession. The left hand sweeps right, rises into a fold, and moves left again before dropping open over a bend and release of the right knee, ending with another rightward reach.

The right arm lengthens downward. The left hand sweeps left and rises into a fold as the right knee straightens, then both hands climb right with the right knee softening while the right elbow tucks. The left arm extends down and left, followed by the right hand lowering toward the left; both knees bend as the right hand reverses right and curls upward. Both arms reach right before the right hand drops and the left knee straightens. The right hand continues down and right as the left hand moves left, then lifts and returns right while the left knee bends and releases beneath an extending elbow.

The right hand reaches right and rises. The left hand sweeps left and down, then folds upward as the right arm curls higher; both hands reverse inward, the left hand dropping while the right hand continues up and left. The left knee softens as the right arm opens downward and right, followed by the left arm extending down and left before returning right. The left hand continues down and right as the left knee bends further, while the right arm lengthens and lowers. The left knee straightens and the right arm extends farther down and right.

The right knee softens as the dancer sends the left hand left and lowers it, then curls the right arm up and right. The left hand reverses right and rises into a fold while the right arm extends downward; both knees bend as the hands separate left and right and descend, then straighten in succession. Both arms open through another left-right sweep, the left arm rising before folding back left and down. The right knee lengthens as the hands exchange directions and the left hand drops farther, while the right arm curls upward and sweeps right. The knee beneath the rising hand bends as its arm tucks and lifts farther right, followed by a deeper bend of the other knee and an extension of the first. The first hand lowers while the opposite arm draws inward and its hand continues right.

The right hand reaches left and rises while the left hand moves right, both elbows folding. Then the right hand reverses right and the left knee straightens. The right hand curls up-left while the left hand extends down-left, then both hands climb into a tuck as the left knee lengthens. The hands separate right and left and descend, the left knee softening as the left arm opens and refolds upward-right. The left hand rises left and drops through an extension and curl while the right hand lifts and folds farther, then sweeps down-left and opens as the right knee bends. Both arms gather upward, the left hand moving right before they release into opposing left and right reaches and lower. The left hand swings back left and curls upward as the right knee bends and the right arm folds down-left, followed by a lift of the left arm and another bend of the right knee. The hands reverse sideways, the left arm extending downward as the right knee straightens, while the right arm tucks further right and lowers.

The right hand travels right and drops as the dancer lengthens both arms, then the right hand lifts left while the left arm curls upward. The right arm opens downward before folding back up toward the right, with the right knee straightening; the left arm extends down to the right and reverses left as the left knee softens. Both hands rise with the right elbow tucked, then descend into a deeper fold on the left side before the right hand swings left and curls up again. The right hand returns right and lowers as the right knee bends, then sweeps left and rises while the left hand drops and the left knee straightens. The right arm opens downward and tucks again as the right knee sinks further, then carries the right hand right while the left arm reaches left and rises.

The right arm folds right as the left arm drops left, then both arms rise while the left arm curls and the right knee softens and the right hand continues right. The right knee straightens beneath a downward reach of the left hand, which returns up-left while the right arm curls right and lifts over another bend-and-release of the right knee. The hands separate left and right, then descend together as the knees lengthen and the right elbow extends; they rise again, the right hand moving right before both lower into a shared leftward sweep. Both arms tuck and lift through another bend of the right leg, then the right hand swings right and back left as the right knee releases and the left hand moves left. With the right knee bending once more, both hands fall and sweep left before the left hand reverses right and rises alongside the right hand's upward lift.

The dancer sends the left hand left. The right arm folds and lowers as the left hand curls upward, then both sweep right with the left elbow opening before reversing left and tucking again. Both hands rise, the right moving right while the left arm lengthens down and left, then folds higher as the right hand continues right and descends. The left hand drops and reaches farther left while the right arm opens into a rising leftward sweep, the right knee softening as the left arm extends downward; the left hand follows down and right before curling back up and left as the right knee bends further. The hands separate sideways with the right arm folding, then descend together as the left knee straightens and both elbows open. The right hand rises and sweeps left while the left hand moves right, and both arms tuck into a shared lift as the knees bend.

The dancer raises the right hand. The left hand travels left, then both hands descend and reverse sideways as the right arm folds, the left arm opens, and the left knee softens before straightening. Both arms lengthen downward, then the right hand reaches right while the left hand sweeps up-left; the left knee bends again as the left arm curls upward and drops into an extension, while the right hand moves right. The right hand lifts through a fold and release as the left arm tucks and rises, then lowers with another curl while the left knee bends and the left arm extends. The right arm opens farther down as the left hand reverses left and the left knee straightens, then the hands trade height twice, finishing with the right arm reaching up-right and the left arm lifting into a bend. The right elbow draws inward as the right hand descends and moves right, while the left arm extends and both knees soften.

The right knee softens as the dancer sends both hands left, then straightens the right knee while the right arm curls upward and the left arm lengthens down. Both arms fold and sweep right as the left leg bends, then the right hand lowers and opens while the bent left leg straightens and the right knee follows. The right hand climbs into a curl as the left arm tucks leftward, then both lower and extend before the right hand sweeps right and rises against the left arm's downward-left reach. The raised right arm folds again as the left elbow draws inward and the right knee bends, then both hands reverse right with the right arm opening and the left arm extending. The right knee releases as the right hand drops and both elbows tighten, then the left hand swings left and returns right with a longer arm while the right hand continues downward.

The right arm folds left and up. The left hand rises as both arms open, then the right hand drops and reverses right while the left arm curls upward. Both hands climb, the right hand tucking farther as the left hand reaches down, before the left arm lifts left and lengthens again. The hands sweep right, the right hand descending into a deeper fold, then reverse left as the left hand lowers and opens. The left arm extends farther left before curling upward alongside the rising right hand.

At the outset, the dancer curls the right arm upward and right, then lowers and lengthens it while the left hand drops left. Both hands rise with a bend in the right elbow, then sweep left as the right knee straightens; the left hand descends while the right climbs farther right and tucks inward. The left hand rises, folds left and returns right as its knee softens, then both arms lengthen downward before the left hand swings left and back right with another knee bend. The hands separate left and right as the left knee releases, then climb together with the right arm extending right and the left curling upward. The right hand sweeps down-left, reverses right and lifts as the left arm opens downward, followed by the right knee bending and straightening. The left hand continues right and up while the right moves left, ending with both arms reaching out.

The right knee softens as the dancer sends the left hand left and down while the right arm folds, then lowers the right hand and opens the left elbow. The right knee straightens as both hands sweep right, the left hand rising with a tighter curl while the right hand climbs and tucks; both elbows draw in before the left hand returns left and drops with an opening arm. Both knees bend in succession as the right hand reaches left and down, then lengthens upward to the right while the left hand rises rightward. The left arm extends as the right knee bends farther, while the right hand dips and curls up-right over a straightening knee; both hands continue right before separating, the left hand lowering into a fold while the right hand rises and reaches left. The left arm lifts left as the right knee bends and the right hand reverses right, then the left arm tucks higher and sweeps right.

In opposition, the dancer raises the right hand and lengthens the right arm while the left hand sweeps left and down with an unfolding elbow. The right hand continues upward as both hands shift right, then the left hand returns left and curls back up-right. The left hand drops and opens into a rightward sweep while the right hand moves left. Both hands rise again, the right arm extending farther.

The dancer lengthens the left arm left. Both hands sweep right, the right hand rising and folding as the right knee bends, then both arms curl downward before opening into a shared rightward reach. The left hand dips farther down and sweeps left against the right hand's rightward motion; the right knee straightens as the left hand folds upward and returns right while the right hand lowers and the left knee softens. The left hand drops again, curls up and right, then releases downward while the right hand moves left and rises with an extending elbow. Both knees bend as the left hand lifts and the right hand sweeps left and back right, then both elbows tuck and lower as the legs straighten in succession. The left hand travels right and rises with its arm folding, while the right hand extends downward and sweeps left.

The dancer folds the left arm upward and left while the right hand rises right. Then both arms extend downward as the knees soften. The hands sweep apart to the left and right before reversing sideways. The right arm curls upward as the right knee straightens and the left arm opens. The right knee bends again while both hands descend and the right arm tucks left. Both arms lengthen into another shared rise, with the right hand moving right and the left hand following right before returning left as the right knee softens. The left arm curls up-left over a deeper bend of the left knee while the right hand rises right and the right knee straightens. Then both knees release as the right arm folds down-left. The right hand lifts farther left, followed by the left hand reaching right and dropping. Then both knees bend and the left hand returns left. The left knee straightens as the right arm tucks upward and the right knee releases. Then the left knee softens while both hands sweep left and the right knee bends again beneath a descending right hand.

A shared upward reach begins with the left hand rising left, then both hands climb as the left arm lengthens and the right hand curls in. The left hand swings right while the left knee straightens and the right arm opens, then the left hand returns left as the right hand folds down-left and the right knee bends. The right hand rises through a tuck and release as the left hand continues right, then the right hand sweeps down-right with the left hand before curling up-left as the right knee extends. Both arms open into opposing sideways reaches, then the left hand reverses right while the right hand drops and sweeps left with a bent elbow. The right hand returns right and rises into a fold as the left hand moves left and the left arm tightens.

The right knee straightens as the dancer lowers and extends the right hand, then the right knee bends while the left arm curls up and right. The right hand continues upward and left before both hands descend, with the right knee straightening again. The hands separate sideways as the left knee softens, then the lower hand sweeps right and rises through a fold and release while the left knee lengthens and the left arm tucks. The right hand returns left and down into an extension as the left arm folds and drops, then opens while the leftward-moving arm curls back right and rises. The left hand lifts into a bend as the raised arm reaches farther right and down, then both elbows open.

To begin, the dancer sends both hands right as one knee straightens, then lowers them and sweeps left with that arm folding while the other hand rises and both knees bend. The raised arm opens down and curls up again as its knee straightens and the opposite knee softens, then reaches left and lifts into a fold over another bend of that knee. Both knees extend before the same knee bends again, and the hands separate left and right as that knee straightens once more. The opposite hand returns left and drops while the other arm lengthens downward; the returning hand continues down-left, then reverses right as both elbows tuck and the same knee straightens. The hands climb toward each other and exchange their outward directions, the other arm extending as its knee bends and the opposite hand moves right.

The right knee softens as the dancer lowers and extends the left arm left, then curls it up and right while the right hand moves left. The left hand dips into a fold and rises again, accompanied by the right hand lifting leftward; the right knee straightens as both hands climb and sweep right. Both arms open downward before the left hand returns left, followed by the right hand, then the left hand folds upward as the right hand sweeps down and left with an extending elbow. The right arm lifts left, drops and curls back right, joined by the left hand rising into a tuck. The left hand returns left as the right knee bends, then both hands lower and sweep left with opening elbows before reversing right and climbing with folded arms.

The right arm rises, then the left arm rises while curling. The right arm lengthens downward and reaches left while the left arm folds higher. The right hand reverses right and climbs into a tuck while the left elbow also bends. The hands separate sideways, the right hand continuing left while the left arm opens down to the right. Both arms extend farther, the left arm returning right.

To begin, the dancer lengthens the right arm right while the left arm reaches left and down. The left hand reverses right as both arms fold, then the left hand returns left. Both hands lower, the right arm opening and curling again before moving right. The right arm reaches farther right and rises.

The right arm lengthens downward as the left hand drops. The left hand sweeps left and curls upward while the right hand rises, then both arms fold and the hands descend in succession. Both elbows open as the right hand returns right and the left hand moves left, then the rightward-moving arm curls up toward the left while the left arm continues left and extends down. The right arm opens and lowers, then folds again as the left hand climbs left; both arms lengthen as the left hand returns right. The left hand travels left with an unfolding elbow, followed by the right arm opening into a lift.

In unison, both arms lengthen and lower, then rise with the right elbow folding before the hands separate left and right and descend again. The right arm curls upward and returns down toward the left, while the left hand swings right and back left as both knees soften in succession. The left knee bends further beneath a rising fold of the right arm, which then opens downward as the left leg straightens; the left hand continues left while the right knee sinks again beneath another curl. Both hands lift and sweep left, the right arm drawing inward as the left knee bends and releases, then the hands return right with the right elbow extending and the left knee softening. The left hand drops as both arms lengthen, then the right hand lowers and the right knee straightens while the left arm folds up-right over another bend of the right knee. The left hand reverses left as the right knee straightening accompanies the left hand's descent, followed by an upward extension of the right arm and another bend-and-release of the right knee.

The arms move in opposition: the right hand lowers and lengthens while the left hand reaches right, then both hands sweep left with the right hand curling upward and the left hand folding down. The left arm extends farther as the right knee softens, then the hands reverse right and left with the right elbow opening; the right hand drops and both hands rise as the right knee straightens. Both hands sweep right and descend into folded elbows as the right knee bends again, then return left while the left leg lengthens. The right arm opens and curls upward as the right knee releases, then extends right while the left elbow tucks and the left knee straightens; the right knee bends as both hands lower and the right arm folds. The right knee straightens as the right hand rises and reaches right against the left hand's leftward sweep, then the right knee softening and the left leg extending. The right hand falls and rebounds up-right as the left hand continues left, with another bend of the right knee before the left arm curls downward.

The dancer lowers both hands. The right arm extends downward and right as the left arm curls upward, then the right hand rises left while the left arm opens down and right, its knee softening. The rising right hand sweeps right and drops, joined by the left hand moving right and lowering into a longer reach as that knee bends further. Both arms lengthen before the right hand reverses left and both lift with bent elbows, then descend as that knee straightens and the left arm folds farther inward. The right-moving hand returns right and up while the left elbow tucks more tightly; the left hand follows right as its knee bends again, then both hands sweep left and rise with the right arm opening. The hands return right as the left knee releases and the right arm folds; both knees soften before the left hand reverses up-left and its knee straightens.

The arms oppose each other: the right hand moves left as the left knee straightens, then both hands descend and the right arm folds. The left hand curls up while the right arm rises and reaches left, with the left elbow opening before the left hand returns down and right. Both hands climb again, the left arm folding into a tighter curl as the right arm lengthens upward; the dancer then sends the left arm left and lifts it farther. The left hand reverses right as the right arm lowers and tucks in, and the right arm draws inward once more.

To begin, the dancer lowers and extends the right arm while the left hand rises, then reverses their paths with the right arm reaching right as the left hand drops left. Both hands sweep left, the right arm curling upward before opening downward and continuing left while the left hand returns right. The right arm lifts farther and extends as the left hand moves right and folds inward, then both arms lengthen downward before the hands separate left and right. They reverse again, the right hand moving right and rising while the left arm curls up to the left; the left arm opens and sweeps left before folding back right and lifting. The right arm releases down and left, then curls upward as the left arm lowers and extends.

To begin, the dancer curls the right arm upward and left while the left hand rises, then carries both hands right with lengthening elbows. The right hand returns left as the right knee softens, while the left hand reaches farther right and climbs; both arms fold and lower before the right hand reverses right. The left knee bends as the left hand curls up and left, then both hands rise, the right arm opening left while the left arm tucks into a rightward sweep. The right arm folds down and left over another right knee bend, then releases as the left arm extends down-right and the left leg straightens. Both hands lift, the right hand moving right while the left hand shifts left and drops, then the right hand lowers left with an unfolding elbow.

The right knee straightens as the dancer curls the right arm upward and left, then lowers it into a rightward reach while the left hand rises and falls. The right hand climbs farther left and folds in, joined by the left arm curling up and left before both hands descend; the knees soften in succession, with the left knee releasing as its arm tucks more tightly. Both hands rise again, the right hand moving right while the left sweeps left, then both arms open and lower. The hands separate right and left with another inward fold of the right arm, then return toward each other as that arm extends. The hands climb together, the left arm reaching farther right and opening, before both lower and lengthen once more.

The dancer alternates arm folds and releases: the right knee straightens as the left hand curls up-left and the right arm extends down-right, then the right knee bends while the left arm reaches right and lowers. The right leg lengthens again as both hands rise, the left arm curling left while the right arm opens; the right knee softens once more before the left hand drops right into a fold and the left knee straightens. The hands separate left and right as the left knee bends and the left hand rises into an extension, then both arms tuck while the right hand lowers and returns right over a bend and release of the right knee. Both hands climb with the right arm opening left and the left arm folding inward, then descend as the left elbow releases and the right hand reverses right with another right knee bend. The left arm curls upward and left while the right knee lengthens, then both elbows draw in and the hands fall toward the right, the left knee softening as its hand rises left into another fold.

The dancer folds the right arm into a rising rightward sweep. The right hand reverses left as both arms lengthen and the left hand drops, then curls upward while the right hand descends and the right knee softens. The hands separate sideways and reverse inward with both elbows tucking, then lift together before extending apart again. Both arms curl downward as the knees straighten, then the right arm opens and both hands rise, the left elbow folding before the hands descend with another tuck. The right hand returns right while the left arm draws farther inward, then the knees soften in succession and the hands climb into renewed folds.

As the right arm folds down, the dancer lowers the left hand and straightens the left knee. The right hand sweeps left while the left knee softens, then both hands rise with the left arm tucking inward before it opens and carries the left hand right as the left knee lengthens. Both arms fold downward, the right hand moving right and the left hand continuing down-left. The right hand returns left while the left hand reaches up-right and curls in, then the right arm extends upward as the left arm lifts farther and opens. The left hand dips and rises again, curling inward while the right hand moves right, then drops as the left arm opens and sweeps right.

As the right arm curls up-left, the dancer lengthens and lowers the left hand leftward, then extends the left arm right while the right arm opens downward. Both hands sweep down-left before reversing right, with the right arm folding as the left knee softens; both elbows tuck into a shared lift toward the left. The right hand drops as the left knee bends deeper, then returns right with a curling extension and another bend of the left knee. The right hand rises as the left elbow opens, then dips and rebounds into a fold while the left knee sinks further. The right arm reaches down-right against the left arm's upward-left curl, then lengthens again as the left knee straightens. The left hand reverses right and down while the right hand lifts, ending with a tucked return left.

As the left arm folds left and the right arm reaches right, the dancer opens both elbows, then lowers both hands with the left hand continuing left. The arms lengthen again as the right knee softens, the left hand dropping before both arms curl upward. The left hand sweeps left and down while the right arm tucks farther right; the left arm opens as the right elbow releases, then both fold into a shared lift. The hands descend together, their arms unfold and sweep right, and both knees soften in succession. Both elbows gather inward as the hands rise, then open downward and return left, ending with the left hand lifting and folding again.

A repeated folding arm figure begins with the right hand dropping right as the left knee straightens, then both arms curl upward and reverse sideways. The right hand swings left and down while the left hand travels right, the left knee bending as the left elbow opens; both hands rise, the right arm extending farther before the left arm folds and lowers. The left hand sweeps left and up as the right knee softens and the right arm curls higher, then both hands descend with lengthening elbows and the right hand moves right. Both arms tuck into another shared lift, with the right hand continuing right as the left knee bends, before the hands separate sideways and the right arm extends downward. Both hands rise again with folded elbows, the right hand sweeping left as the left arm opens, then drops and reverses right while the right knee bends and the right arm lengthens downward.

Upward, the dancer raises the right hand and lowers the left hand. The left arm folds as the right hand continues upward and left, then both hands descend, the left hand reaching left before the left arm opens into a rightward sweep. The right hand curls higher while the left elbow tucks, and the right knee softens beneath an unfolding arm that lifts rightward. Both hands climb farther, the right hand continuing right and the left hand moving left as both elbows draw inward.

As the right knee straightens, the dancer lifts the right hand rightward and lowers it into an extended reach, then curls upward as the left arm folds. The right hand sweeps left while the left knee bends, and both hands rise before the left hand moves left and the knees lengthen in succession.
