The right arm reaches down-right as the right knee softens, then rises with a deeper tuck while the left hand climbs left and the bent leg straightens. Both hands descend, the right hand moving right as the left hand reverses right and curls upward; the right knee then bends and releases while the left hand drops and extends left. The right knee bends again as the left hand lifts right, then both arms draw inward and the hands lower, the right hand sweeping left. The left knee softens beneath a further rightward extension of the left arm, while the right hand continues left and the right knee straightens before both knees bend together.

The right knee softens as the dancer sends the right hand right and the left hand left, then lowers both hands with lengthening arms. The knees straighten as the hands reverse sideways and rise into folded elbows, then both descend and open. The hands sweep right together, the right arm curling before both lift again; the left hand moves left while the curled right arm extends down and left. Both hands continue left, the extended left arm gathering upward and returning right into a bend as the right elbow opens. The raised right arm curls farther inward while the left hand continues extending left, finishing with a tighter fold.

A side-to-side arm exchange begins as the dancer straightens the right knee, then bends and releases it again while the left arm reaches right. The left hand returns left and curls upward as the right knee softens, followed by the raised left hand moving right with a folded elbow and the bent right leg lengthening. The left hand reverses down-left into an extension as the right knee bends again, then both arms fold while the right hand moves right. The left hand lifts toward the right, opens and lowers, and the right hand follows right before reversing left. Both hands rise as the left arm folds farther, then they sweep right and descend with the left elbow releasing.

The right hand travels left and down. The dancer raises the left hand, folds both arms, then lowers them as the hands separate left and right and the right arm lengthens. Both hands rise with a tighter fold in the right arm, then descend as the elbows open; the right knee softens while the left hand continues right and both arms curl again. The right knee straightens as the right hand lifts, then extends farther left and drops into another tuck. The left arm reaches up-left, opens into a descending reach rightward, and curls back left as the right knee bends. The right hand rises, sweeps left and folds downward while the left hand lowers farther left and the bent leg straightens.

The dancer lowers both hands. The right hand continues down and right while the left arm folds, then lifts left as the right knee straightens; the right arm curls upward before releasing back down to the right. The left arm tucks again as the left knee bends, then both hands sweep left and climb with lengthening elbows, the right hand reversing right before returning left and folding downward. The right arm opens and sweeps right while the left knee releases and bends again, then the hands separate left and right before the right elbow draws inward and both hands lower, the left knee extending farther. Both arms unfold into a rising sweep left as the left hand reverses right and the right knee softens; the hands fall and separate again, with the right hand moving left.

An alternating arm figure begins with the right hand rising right and the left hand moving left, both arms extending as the knees soften in succession. The right hand reverses left while the right knee straightens; the left hand reaches up-right as the left knee bends again and releases. Both hands sweep left, then the left arm curls upward to the right while the right arm folds down-left, the left knee lengthening before both knees bend again. The right arm extends down-right as the left arm curls higher, then returns left while the left hand drops right and the left knee straightens; both arms gather inward, the left hand lifting as the right knee softens. The right knee releases as the left arm unfolds downward and the right hand lifts left, followed by the left knee straightening. The right elbow opens farther left while the left hand rises into a fold and moves right, ending with the right hand also curling inward.

To begin, the dancer extends the left arm down and left while folding the right arm inward. The left hand reverses right as the right arm rises, then both arms lengthen downward before the right hand curls up to the left. The right hand continues climbing left with a deeper fold, while the left knee bends and releases beneath its descending left arm; the right hand reaches right and upward. The left hand lifts into a tuck as the knees soften together, then both hands sweep left and drop with the elbows opening. The left knee straightens as the right arm curls higher, then both knees bend and the hands rise again, the left hand returning left and the right hand moving right.

A shared rightward sweep begins with the right arm curling upward while the left arm folds, then both lengthen as the left hand rises and the right hand continues right. Both hands descend and reverse left before lifting, with the right elbow tucking and the right hand continuing upward as the left hand dips and returns up-right. The right hand climbs farther right while the left hand drops left, then they exchange height again, the right hand lowering into a tighter fold as the left arm extends. Both hands rise toward the right, the right elbow opening and folding once more while the left arm curls inward. The right arm reaches higher and opens again as the left hand lowers, then reverses left and down into a bend.

The right knee straightens as the dancer sends the left hand left and down with an extending arm, then curls it upward before reversing right while the left knee lengthens. The curled left hand continues right and rises into a deeper fold as the right knee bends, while the right hand climbs right with a tucking elbow and the right knee straightens again. The raised right arm opens down and left as both knees soften, then folds upward while the left knee extends; both hands climb, the left moving right and the right continuing up and left. The left arm reaches down and left over a deeper bend of the right knee as the right hand sweeps right and drops with an opening elbow, then returns left and curls upward. Both hands rise, the left sweeping right and opening while the right arm extends left and the left knee lengthens further; the right hand joins the rightward sweep and both arms fold.

The dancer sends the right hand left and lowers both hands. Then the right knee straightens. The dancer lifts both hands as the right knee softens and the left knee bends. The hands separate right and left with both elbows tucked, then rise together before descending into extended arms. Both knees lengthen as the hands sweep right, then soften again while the right hand climbs left and curls inward. The left hand follows up and left, its elbow folding, while the right arm extends right and the left arm releases downward. The hands reverse toward each other, the right arm curling upward and the left hand sinking farther down.

A paired leftward sweep carries the left hand down and the right hand right, with both arms folding as the left knee beneath the descending left hand softens. The hands reverse outward, the left knee straightening while the right arm tucks farther; the newly lowered left arm opens before both elbows curl again. Both hands rise, the left hand moving right and then left into a tighter fold as the left knee bends deeper, while the right arm extends upward over a lengthening right leg. The left hand dips and rebounds as the knees trade bend and release, followed by another drop and lift on the left side. Both hands climb with folded arms, the right hand continuing left and higher while the left hand sweeps right, then returns left.

At the outset, the dancer raises the right hand and folds the right arm as the left hand lifts leftward. The right arm opens right while the left hand tucks into a continued leftward sweep, then both hands rise before the left arm releases downward to the right. Both arms lengthen and lower, with the right hand continuing right. The left arm curls upward and reaches farther right as the right hand rises; they then separate left and right, the left arm descending before both hands lift again. The right arm extends down and left while the left arm folds right, then opens into a shared upward reach that softens at the knee beneath the right hand. The right hand continues left and down as the left hand moves right, with the knee beneath the left hand bending and straightening.

A lifting, alternating arm figure begins with the right hand rising while the left arm folds and the left knee bends, then both hands climb as the left knee releases. The right hand drops and sweeps left while the left arm curls upward, followed by another bend of the left knee and an extension of the right arm. The left side lowers its hand, swings right and up before returning left as the left knee straightens, then drops again while the right arm reaches down to the right and curls back left. The left arm opens downward toward the right as the right knee softens and the right arm tucks; the left knee bends and releases beneath a rise of the right hand, which then lowers and moves right. Both knees soften in succession as the right hand drops, the left arm extends left and the left knee straightens. The left hand rises again while the right hand continues downward.

The dancer lengthens the left arm down and left. The right hand rises right, folds inward, then drops as the left arm curls upward and both sweep right. The right arm tucks farther while the left elbow opens, then both hands descend and reverse left with a deeper curl of the right arm. Both elbows open again before the left hand lifts right into a fold and returns left; the right hand follows left and curls upward. The right arm releases downward as the left hand swings right and the right hand rises left, ending with another rightward reach from the right arm.

The knees soften in succession beneath a rising arm, with the right hand moving right and the left hand moving left. The left knee bends farther as both hands climb and separate sideways, then straighten while the arms unfold and the right knee extends. The left arm curls up-right and drops as the left knee lengthens further; both hands sweep left, the right hand folding downward and the left hand rising into a tuck before opening. Both hands return right and rise, then descend toward the left as the left arm folds again. The right hand lifts and reaches right, while the left arm returns right and rises, then lowers and reverses left as the right hand dips and rebounds upward.

The arms begin in opposition: the right hand rises while the left hand extends left, then the right arm folds and lowers toward the right. The left arm curls upward and releases down, followed by the right arm lengthening farther downward. The right arm lifts again, reaches right, and returns left as the right knee softens; the left hand moves right with a fold. The left hand reverses right while the right arm opens left and drops. The left arm tucks into a final lift to the right.

As the right hand drops, the dancer lifts the left hand toward the right, folds the left arm in, and lowers the left arm while the right arm opens downward. The left arm curls up and left as the right arm extends upward; the hands separate sideways, with the rising right hand continuing left, then both hands drop. The left hand reaches right while the right arm lengthens down and right, before the right hand rises again. The right arm tucks farther right and lowers as the left hand climbs, then the right arm opens upward and the raised left hand reverses left and down. Both hands descend together, with the lower arm extending farther.

The dancer lifts both hands, folding the right arm as the left knee bends and straightens beneath an opening left hand, then lowers the folded right hand while the left knee softens again. The left hand rises rightward as the lowered right arm extends left, the right hand drops and opens, and the left knee releases before bending once more. Both hands sweep left, the left arm curling upward while the right arm folds and rises; they then separate right and left with a shared lift, followed by another leftward sweep and descent of the right hand. The right hand reverses right as the left arm tucks upward, then both rise before the tucked left arm opens and sweeps left while the right arm curls down and returns right. The hands separate again, the curled right arm lifting and extending left as the left hand lowers, then both move right while the higher right arm folds downward.

The right knee bends as the dancer folds the left arm leftward, then the right knee straightens and releases the left hand down-right while the right arm reaches right and lengthens. The right hand lowers and sweeps left as the left knee softens and both arms fold; the left hand rises left before returning down-right into an extension as the right knee deepens. Both hands climb toward the right with the left arm curling, then lower as the right knee straightens and the right elbow opens. The left hand moves left and tucks again while the right arm curls upward and continues right; the left arm lifts and extends through a right-left reversal as the right hand falls. Both hands descend and separate, the left arm folding and then opening into another down-left sweep.

The right hand moves right. The left arm folds and carries the left hand right as the right knee beneath it straightens, then both hands rise while the right hand reverses left and the right leg lengthens further. Both arms open, the right hand descending before the left drops, and they sweep left with the left elbow drawing in. The left arm tucks farther as the right hand returns right, then lifts and curls inward while the left hand reaches right and down. The right arm extends again as the left hand returns left and rises.

The right hand lowers and lengthens while the left arm folds down-right, then both hands rise as the right knee straightens. The left arm opens left before curling upward again, with the right hand continuing right; its elbow releases downward as the left hand moves left and the bent knee softens. Both arms fold through a lift and drop, the right hand traveling left while the left sweeps right and up, then the knees exchange bends and releases in succession. The left hand drops right and rises into an extension as the right travels left, both elbows opening before the right hand descends and the left curls upward. The descending hand continues left while the raised hand lowers and extends, ending with both hands moving right.

A rising, alternating arm weave begins as the dancer folds the left hand up-left while the right hand lowers left and opens, then curls upward before releasing right. The left arm tucks down-right as the right arm folds up-left, then both lengthen with the left hand continuing right and higher before dropping into a bend. The left hand rebounds upward and opens as the left knee straightens and the right hand rises; it returns down-left with another bend while the right arm extends downward. Both hands climb and spread apart, then descend as the arms fold in succession. The hands separate again, rise with the left hand moving left, and lower through opening elbows, finishing with both hands sweeping right.

The dancer lengthens the right arm and sweeps the left hand right, then lifts both hands into folded arms. The right hand returns left while the left elbow opens; both arms lower and extend before the left hand rises and reaches farther left. The left hand reverses right and curls upward as the right hand drops and the right knee softens. The left hand descends while the right hand moves right and the right knee straightens, then the right arm folds up and right against the left arm's downward reach to the left. The hands exchange height once more, with the right hand lifting right and opening as the left hand tucks down and left, before the right hand lowers and both elbows release.

The right hand moves right. The dancer softens the right knee, then bends the left knee as both hands sweep left and rise into tucked elbows. The knees straighten in succession while the arms open and the right hand drops, followed by the left hand. The right arm curls upward as the right knee bends again, while the left hand rises, folds inward, and sweeps left over a straightening left knee before returning right as the left knee softens. Both hands descend with opening elbows, then lift together as the right knee extends and the left hand continues left over a bend of the left knee. The left knee releases while the right hand lowers and the left hand sweeps up-left into a fold. The right arm reaches right as the left knee straightens, then reverses left with an extension. Both hands rise through further bends of their respective knees, the right arm folding while the left arm opens.

As the right hand drops, the dancer sends the left hand right and curls it upward, then lowers the left arm while the right hand rises. The left arm lengthens as both hands sweep left, with the right hand continuing downward before they reverse right together. The right hand climbs again, and both arms fold inward. The left hand continues left and rises as its elbow releases, while the right arm curls higher.

A shared leftward sweep begins as the left arm folds and the right hand lifts; both hands rise, the left arm opening before curling back in as the left knee bends and releases. The right arm lengthens down while the curled left arm reaches right and lowers, then both hands sweep left with the right elbow bending and the left knee straightening. The bent left arm opens upward as the right hand rises and curls right, the raised right hand dropping and reaching farther right while the left knee extends. Both arms fold, then open as the right knee softens and the right hand moves right over a bend of the left knee. The right hand reverses left into a tuck while the left arm lengthens and sweeps left, followed by a rightward extension of the tucked right hand.

The right hand drops as the right knee straightens, then both hands sweep right while the left arm folds and the left knee bends. The left arm lengthens as the left knee releases, then both arms curl inward and rise leftward before the left arm opens downward and the left knee softens again. The right hand lowers into a deeper fold as the right knee extends, then both elbows tuck while the right hand moves right and the left hand rises. Both hands descend with the left elbow opening farther, then the right hand reaches up-right while the left hand curls upward and shifts left; the right knee straightens as the left arm extends down and returns right. The right arm folds lower and continues right while the left hand lifts, the left knee bending and straightening beneath an opening elbow.

The right hand rises and falls. The left arm curls upward, then both hands climb as the knees soften in succession; the right knee straightens while the left arm extends downward. The right hand reaches right and lowers as the right knee bends again, while the left arm curls up to the left and releases down to the right. Both arms fold into a rising sweep right, then open with the left hand dropping left and the right knee bending farther before both hands descend and separate sideways. The right arm tucks through another lift and release, then lengthens as the left hand moves right and lowers.

The knees bend in succession as the dancer lowers and folds the right arm, then opens it right while the left hand sweeps left and both legs straighten. The hands exchange lateral directions, rise with bent elbows, and return toward each other as the initial knee softens; the right hand then drops left while the left elbow tucks and the left knee bends. The lowered right arm curls upward to the right as the left leg lengthens and the left hand lifts, then extends down-left before returning up-right and folding again. Both hands descend with opening elbows, the right arm reaching farther right, then both curl upward as the left hand continues right and the left knee straightens. The hands reverse sideways with deeper folds and descending arms, then lift together as the right hand returns left and both elbows release.

The right arm reaches left and folds back right. The left hand follows right while the right hand rises, then both hands drop as the right arm opens and the right knee softens. Both arms curl upward with a lift of the left knee, then the right arm lengthens down while the left arm tucks further and lowers. The right hand curls up-left as the right knee straightens, followed by the left arm rising left before descending into an extension. The right elbow opens, and the left hand moves right while the left arm continues lifting.

As the right arm reaches down-left, the left hand drops and sweeps right, then rises while the right arm curls up-right. The right arm folds left as the left hand opens downward; both hands descend before the left hand curls up-right and the right elbow releases. The hands separate left and right, then lower into a shared upward reach as the arms unfold, followed by another descent and renewed extension of both elbows. The right hand moves right while the left hand shifts left, then both rise and reverse sideways before dropping again. They climb together, with the right hand sweeping left and the left hand moving right, before lowering once more.

The dancer performs a repeating arm exchange, sending the right hand right and down as the left knee softens, then curls the right hand upward while the left hand rises. The left hand swings left and descends into an extension as the right arm lengthens downward and both hands return right. Both arms fold again as the knees bend, the hands separating left and right before rising in opposite directions and opening. The right knee straightens beneath a shared leftward sweep of the arms, which then curl downward and reverse right; the left knee bends as both hands lift, descend into extended arms, and rise once more. The hands separate left and right with folded elbows, lower together, then reverse sideways and climb again. They finish by separating again, the right hand dropping as the left hand rises.

The right arm curls upward. The dancer folds the left arm as the rising right hand reaches farther right, then lengthens both arms while the left knee softens and the right hand drops left. The right hand lowers and moves left as the left knee straightens, followed by a downward reach of the left arm; the right hand reverses right before curling up again as the left leg bends and releases. The raised left arm extends down-left while the right arm opens, then folds up-right as the knees exchange softening and straightening twice. The hands separate left and right and descend with bent elbows, then reverse their lateral paths as both knees extend. The right arm unfolds and rises into another tuck while the left hand sweeps left and lifts, its knee bending as the right hand continues left.

The right knee softens as the dancer lowers the right hand and sweeps both hands right with folded arms, then lifts them as the left arm opens and the bent leg straightens. The right hand reverses left while the left hand reaches right and drops; both elbows open before the right arm curls upward and the left hand returns left and folds. The curled right hand dips left and rises again as the left elbow extends and re-softens, then reaches up-right while the left hand moves left. Both hands descend as the right arm lengthens, and the left hand continues left before curling upward alongside the right hand's lift.

As the right hand travels right, the dancer lifts the left hand left and folds both arms into a leftward sweep, then reverses them right. The left arm opens downward while the right arm tucks upward and returns left, followed by the left hand sweeping left and folding as the right arm extends down-right. Both hands rise with the left hand curling inward, then descend as the left elbow releases; the hands separate left and right before returning left together. The right arm reaches down-right while the left arm curls upward, and the right hand reverses left before both elbows fold and the right knee softens. Both hands climb farther as the left arm opens, then descend toward the right and lengthen before the right knee straightens and the hands lift again. The right hand sweeps left while the left hand moves right, then lowers and curls as the left hand rises and returns left.

The right hand moves right as the dancer curls both arms, then lowers and extends the left arm while the right arm folds farther; the left hand travels left as both elbows open. The hands reverse inward, the right hand dropping and its elbow lengthening before both arms tuck again. The right hand sweeps right and rises into another fold while the left knee bends and straightens and the left arm opens, followed by a curl on the left side. The right hand lowers and reaches right as the left arm drops, then the hands separate left and right with the left hand rising and folding. The hands exchange directions twice more, the right arm opening and closing while the left elbow tucks and releases, before the right hand returns left into an extended reach.

The right hand sweeps right while the left knee lengthens and the right arm descends, at the same time the left arm extends down and right. The right hand continues right as the left knee straightens farther; both hands climb before the left hand drops, sweeps left and returns right while the right hand lowers. The returning left hand reverses left as the right arm curls up and moves right. The left arm lifts through a right-left-right sweep, then drops and rises again with another rightward reach. The right arm opens downward, folds upward to the left and releases back down.

To begin, the dancer lowers the right hand and sends it left as both knees straighten, then bends the right knee while lifting the left hand and opening the left elbow. The left knee lengthens again as the raised left hand moves right and down and the right knee softens further, followed by a bend of the left knee and an extension of the right. The hands separate sideways with the right arm opening downward, then both elbows fold and the hands reverse inward before the right hand rises and the right knee extends. The right knee bends again as the left arm reaches upward, while the right hand climbs into a curl; both knees lengthen as the curled right hand descends and the right arm opens. The descending right arm folds as the right knee bends, then both knees straighten and the left hand rises left and curls in as the left knee sinks.

The right hand sweeps left. The left arm folds and opens as the right hand rises and reverses right, then both hands climb with the left elbow tucked. The right hand dips rightward while the right knee straightens, then both rise into folded arms before the left hand drops. The right arm reaches down-left as the left elbow releases, then curls upward while the left hand lowers and both sweep right. Both hands descend, the left arm opening as the right folds farther; the right hand continues left while the left knee softens and the left hand rises. The right elbow extends as the left hand falls rightward and both knees bend, then the right hand lifts left with a curling elbow before returning rightward alongside the left hand.

At the outset, the right arm folds down and left while the left hand travels right. The right arm extends downward as both hands sweep left, then rises and lengthens farther. Both hands reverse right with the left arm curling upward and the right hand dropping. The left arm opens, sweeps left and returns right, while the right hand lifts and moves right with a brief extension before folding back left. The right hand reverses right as the left arm tucks inward.

The right arm reaches left and down. The left hand moves right as the right hand returns up and right, then drops again with the right arm opening farther. The right arm folds back upward while the left knee straightens and the left hand lowers; the left hand continues climbing before sweeping down to the left as the right knee extends. Both arms curl into a shared lift toward the right, then the right hand descends left as both elbows open and the left hand rises. The right arm folds upward once more while the left hand travels left, then both sweep right and descend.

The right knee straightens as the dancer sends the right hand right, then lowers and extends both arms while the right hand returns left. Both hands rise with folded elbows, the left arm opening, before the right hand sweeps right and down. The left hand curls upward to the right as the right knee lengthens, then both hands descend into tucked arms. The left hand moves left and rises as the right knee bends and releases; the left knee softens while the right hand travels right and both elbows open, then the right knee sinks again as the left hand drops. The left hand rebounds up and left with a deeper right knee bend while the right arm folds downward and reaches right. The left hand continues left and lifts as the right knee straightens, while the right hand descends farther right.

As the right arm curls upward and the right knee bends, the left hand sweeps left and down before both arms lengthen. The right hand drops, then rises with a tighter fold as the left knee straightens; both hands continue right while the left knee softens again and the right arm tucks further. Both knees deepen their bend beneath another rising curl of the right arm, followed by the left arm folding and lifting through a shared rightward sweep. The left hand lowers as the left knee straightens, then both arms open downward and the left arm reaches right. The left knee bends and releases as the right hand swings left, then both elbows draw inward and the hands rise, the right hand continuing left.

A leftward arm sweep begins as the dancer curls the right hand up and right, then drops it back left while the left hand rises. The right arm opens downward and curls upward again before both hands move left, the left arm lengthening down as the right knee bends and straightens. The right knee softens once more beneath a rising, tucking left arm whose hand swings right, then returns left against the right hand's descent. The right hand continues left and lowers as the right knee extends, while the left arm folds and lifts; the left arm then opens upward as the right arm reverses right. The right hand dips and curls back up, followed by another drop and rise of the left hand.

The dancer reaches left with the left arm. The left hand returns right and curls upward as the right arm folds, then both arms sweep left before the left arm lowers and opens while the right arm lifts. The right arm lengthens downward, both hands rise, and the right arm tucks again as the left arm travels left; the right arm extends down-right, curls back up-left and releases into a descent. Both arms fold and lift toward the right, the left hand continuing in that direction before reversing left as its elbow tightens and the right hand drops, then opens right as the left arm lowers. The left arm curls upward and sweeps right alongside the right hand's rising reach, then both arms descend and spread apart, the left arm folding into a final lift.

The arms rise together. The right hand swings right and back left as the left hand moves right, then both descend with the right arm lengthening; the left hand returns left while the right knee softens and the right arm curls up-left. The left knee bends as the right curled arm opens downward, and both hands sweep right before the right knee straightens and the right hand rises into a fold while the left elbow tucks. Both knees soften in succession as the left hand lowers, then the right knee releases and the right arm folds upward toward the right while the left knee extends beneath a rising hand. The left arm reaches right and down as the right hand drops, then reverses left and lifts into a curl while the lower arm unfolds; the left hand continues left and rises again.

The right knee straightens as the left arm curls upward, then the left hand drops while the right hand moves right and the right knee bends. The right hand reverses left with an opening elbow, climbs into a fold, and returns right as the right knee lengthens; the left hand lifts left and tucks farther inward while the right knee bends again. The dancer continues lowering the left hand toward the right and extends the left arm as the right knee straightens, then draws the left arm up and left into a curl while the right arm opens downward and the right knee softens. The right hand rises as the left hand drops right and the right knee releases, then both hands sweep left, the right arm folding before returning right and down as the left hand lifts and extends. The right hand travels left again as the left knee lengthens and the left arm tucks, then the left hand lowers and reaches right while the right hand rises left. The left hand rebounds upward and curls in as the right arm folds and the right hand drops right, then both hands descend, the left hand continuing right and extending.

The right hand travels left and down as the left hand rises, both arms lengthening before the right hand curls upward and the left hand drops. The left hand returns right as the right knee bends, then the hands reverse sideways with the right arm folding, followed by a bend of the left knee and another lift of the left hand into an extension. Both knees soften while the extended arm lowers and opens, then both hands rise and separate right and left as the right knee straightens; the left arm folds back down to the left, opens and lifts again as the right knee releases farther. Both hands descend, the right arm reaching right while the left hand curls rightward, then the left hand rises and folds over a bending right knee while the right elbow tucks. The left arm extends upward, the right knee straightening, while the right hand dips and rebounds into a tighter curl as the right knee softens; both hands sweep left, the left arm opening downward while the right hand reaches up and right. The descending right hand reverses right and rises alongside the left hand, which folds rightward as the right knee beneath it bends, then lengthens again while the right knee straightens and the left hand continues right.

In opposition, the right hand curls up-right while the left hand reaches right and lowers, then both hands descend. The left arm folds upward as the left knee bends and releases, before the left hand sweeps left and down into an extension. The left hand returns right with a lengthening elbow as the right knee softens, then reverses left and drops while the right knee straightens and the right arm curls upward. Both knees bend in succession beneath a shared rightward reach, the right arm opening and folding again before the left knee releases. The right knee bends once more as both arms draw inward and their hands sweep left.

The right hand reaches right. The left hand moves left and lowers into a fold while the right arm curls upward, then both hands sweep right as the right knee straightens and the right arm opens downward. The right hand returns left with a bend of the right knee, while the left arm lengthens down to the right and the left knee softens; both hands rise before the left arm folds leftward and the right hand descends right as the right knee bends farther. Both arms extend, the left hand sweeping up-left as the left knee releases, then the right hand rises while the right knee sinks again. The hands separate sideways, the left hand moving left and the right hand moving right, with the left elbow tucking and the right elbow opening as both knees soften; the left arm lowers and unfolds, and the right knee straightens. Both hands lift and the arms lengthen, then the right hand dips left and rebounds right with an extension, while the left hand travels right and lowers into a fold as the left knee straightens.

At the outset, the dancer straightens the right knee while the left arm folds and lifts right, then sends the right hand right as the left knee bends. The left arm lengthens downward and sweeps left, followed by the right hand moving left; the left arm curls upward and continues left. Both hands rise with the left arm folding farther, then descend as it opens, both knees bend in succession, and the right hand returns right. The left hand drops while the right hand travels left and rises, then the left arm extends up-left before curling back down-right and reopening as the right hand lowers. Both arms gather inward and lift again, the right hand shifting right as its elbow tightens.

Downward, the dancer lowers the right hand as the left arm folds and sweeps left, then both hands rise, the left arm opening before curling back in. Both arms lengthen downward, the right hand moving right as the right knee softens; the right hand reverses left while the left hand continues down and extends farther right. The right hand rises into a fold as the left knee bends, then drops with an opening elbow while the left hand curls upward. The right arm lifts again, opens, and descends as the left arm reaches farther up and left over a bending knee. The left hand returns right and lowers while the right arm tucks, then both sweep left, the left arm extending as the right arm opens. The right knee straightens while the left knee softens, and the hands separate right and left before the left hand reverses right and the right side returns left.

The right knee bends and releases as the left arm curls upward. The left hand lowers and extends left while the right hand climbs right, then both descend with the left arm folding into a rising rightward reach. Both hands lift again and sweep left as the right knee softens, then lower while the left arm lengthens and the left knee straightens. The left hand continues down-left, then rebounds up-right with a tighter elbow fold as the right knee deepens and releases; the right hand rises through a leftward curl and rightward extension before dropping. The left hand lifts once more as the right hand travels left, and the right knee bends again while the raised hand shifts right.

The knees join the arm movements later: the right knee straightens as the dancer curls both arms upward, then lowers them with a fold and release of the right arm. The left hand rises while the right hand continues down and opens, followed by the left hand lowering and lengthening as the right knee bends and releases. The hands separate left and right before the right hand returns right and curls up; both hands sweep left, the left arm tucking as the left knee softens. The right hand drops, folds, and moves right while the left hand climbs and reaches out, the left knee extending. The left hand dips, rises again, and swings right as the right hand lifts, then they separate left and down, with the left elbow opening.

At the outset, the dancer raises and lowers the right hand over a bending right knee, then lifts the right hand again as the right knee straightens. The left arm reaches left while the left knee softens, and both hands descend with the right arm extending right. The right knee lengthens further as the left hand continues left, then the right arm curls upward and carries the right hand right before releasing down and farther right. The left hand drops and returns left as the left knee bends, then the hands separate left and right with the left arm opening, followed by the right arm curling up and left while the left arm folds downward. Both knees soften in succession, the right hand rises into an extension, and the left knee releases as the left hand moves right.

While the left arm folds left and the right arm curls up-right, the dancer straightens the right knee. The left hand rises as the left knee softens, then both hands sweep right with the right elbow tucking, before the right arm opens down-left while the left hand drops and extends. The left hand reverses right as the right knee bends and the right hand lifts; both hands climb, the right knee lengthening before it and the left knee bend in succession. Both elbows fold, the hands move left and descend, and the left knee softens further as the left hand reaches right. The left hand returns left and climbs with a tighter curl, while the right elbow opens and the right hand drops.

As the right arm lengthens down and left, the dancer folds both arms and lifts the hands rightward, then reverses their lateral directions while lowering them. The right knee softens as the right hand sweeps right and curls upward again, joined by the left hand rising through a left-to-right sweep. Both elbows tuck as the hands climb and separate sideways, then the left hand drops left and opens while the left knee bends; the right hand lowers and extends farther left before reversing right as the right knee releases. The left arm folds left while the right knee deepens its bend and the left hand rises, then the hands reverse laterally with the left arm opening and the right arm curling up and left over a deeper right knee bend. The left hand drops and returns right as the right knee straightens and the right hand climbs right, then the left hand curls up and left while the right hand continues right and the right knee sinks.

The knees join a later bend after the dancer curls the right arm upward and sweeps both hands left, lowering them as the left knee softens. Both arms lengthen rightward before the hands return left with rising elbows and the bent left knee straightens. The right arm folds farther up-left while the left arm extends downward, then both sweep right with the right hand dropping and opening; the left arm tucks back left as the left knee bends and straightens again. The right hand rises into a curl and swings right, drops into an extension, then returns left and lifts as the left knee sinks deeper. The left arm opens rightward as the left knee straightens, while the right elbow folds and both hands descend.

The dancer raises the right hand. The left arm curls upward, followed by the right hand folding and descending as the right knee straightens; both arms then open, with the left hand sweeping left before returning right and rising into a tighter curl. Both hands move left, the right arm extending downward while the left knee bends, then both elbows draw inward as the left knee releases and the lower hand reverses right. The left hand drops and reaches left while the right hand climbs farther right with a deeper tuck, then both hands shift right as the right arm lengthens downward and the left arm folds back left. The knees soften in succession beneath another extension of the right arm to the right and a lowering of the left hand, then the right leg straightens and the right hand returns left as the left knee releases. The left hand sweeps up and left with an opening elbow, while the right knee bends and the right hand continues down and left; both knees then extend together as the right hand rises.

To begin, the dancer sends the right hand right and lowers both hands, extending the right arm before lifting the right hand left. The left hand follows left as both elbows fold and the right hand returns right, then the hands sweep down-left together and rise with the right elbow opening while the left elbow curls inward. Both hands reverse right and descend, the right arm lengthening further as the left knee straightens, before they return left and the right elbow tucks. The left arm reaches up-right while the right hand drops right, and the knees soften in succession beneath a shared upward lift of the hands, followed by another bend of the right knee. The left knee releases as both hands lower and the arms open; the right hand travels left and rises while the left hand shifts right. The hands exchange height twice more, ending with the right hand dropping and curling back right.

A low, sweeping arm figure begins with the left hand moving left and the right hand moving right as both knees soften. Then the hands reverse horizontally, and the knee beneath the right-moving arm (the right knee) straightens. The right arm reaches higher left before both hands rise and the right knee bends again. The left hand continues left while the right arm curls downward. The left hand lifts through an unfolding reach and drops back down, while the right arm rises left and opens, the right knee extending as the left hand sweeps right and curls upward. The right arm folds farther left and drops as the right knee lengthens, then both hands climb and sweep left together. The right arm opens into a shared downward curl, followed by a renewed lift of the right hand while the left hand extends down and right. Both arms tuck as their respective knees bend, and the left hand moves left.

The dancer lifts and extends the right arm rightward as the left hand rises left, then reverses the hands in opposite directions with the right arm curling upward. The left hand descends while the curled right arm reaches right, folds down and opens again. Both arms lengthen before the right hand curls upward; it then sweeps left and lowers into an extension. The right hand returns right and curls up, followed by the left hand rising as both elbows tuck. The hands separate left and right, then the right arm opens downward while the left arm lifts and continues right.

The right knee straightens as the dancer lifts the right hand into a fold, while the left arm extends down. The right hand lowers and opens left as the right knee bends and releases again; the left hand curls up-right while the right hand rises and folds. The right hand swings right then returns left as both arms tuck and descend, the left knee softening before both hands lift, the right hand moving right and extending downward as the bent leg straightens. Both hands sweep left with folding elbows, then the right hand rises and drops as the right knee lengthens further. The left hand moves right while the right hand curls upward and opens, and the left arm also reaches out.

The right knee softens as the dancer lowers and extends the right arm, while the left hand sweeps left, folds up and right, and drops. The left arm reaches down-left before both hands rise and the right hand curls right over a bent right knee; both arms then lengthen downward and sweep left, the left knee straightening as the left arm folds upward. Both hands lift into a tuck, then lower with the right hand moving right and the right knee bending, before the left arm opens and both rise again. The right hand drops and moves right while the left arm curls upward, then both hands descend with the left knee bending as the right arm extends. The right knee straightens as the right hand rises and curls right, then both arms lengthen upward, the left hand sweeping left before dropping and folding back right over a left knee bend. The right arm gathers down-right and opens into a final lift as the left knee releases.

The right hand curls upward and right. The left hand follows up, then both hands descend as the right arm lengthens; they sweep left before the right arm reverses right with a bend of its elbow. The left arm reaches down-left while the right hand lifts leftward and returns right, then folds downward as the left arm extends farther down-left. Both hands rise, the left hand continuing left while the right hand moves right, before the right hand drops into an extension. The hands separate left and right again as the right arm tucks and lifts, while the left arm continues left.

The dancer performs a descending arm sweep: the right hand lowers while the left hand reaches right and down, then both hands rise and separate sideways as the left hand folds. Both hands drop with the left hand opening and the right hand curling upward, then the right hand reverses up-right into another fold as the left hand extends left. The left hand returns down-left, opens and curls back up-right while the right hand continues downward. The left hand drops and reaches left as the right knee softens, then rises while the right knee straightens; the right hand follows upward to the right and folds in, joined by a lengthening of the left hand. Both hands descend again, the left hand curling higher before both elbows open and the knees soften in succession.

The right knee straightens as the dancer folds both arms downward, sending the right hand left and the left hand right before reversing their directions. The hands rise together with opening elbows and separate sideways again, then descend into tighter folds while the right knee extends farther. The right knee softens as both hands climb and the left arm reaches up-right; the right hand sweeps left while the left hand lowers, then they trade height twice through a shared leftward sweep. Both hands continue left with the left arm lengthening and the right knee bending, before the right hand reverses right and drops and the left hand moves left and upward. The left hand arcs left, up-right, and down-left against the rising right hand, then repeats the lift to the right and descent. The right hand lifts again while the left hand continues upward.

To begin, the dancer lifts the right hand right while the left arm lengthens down and left; the raised right hand reverses left as the right knee straightens and the right elbow folds. The right hand returns right and drops into an extension as the left knee bends and the left hand climbs right with a tucked elbow, then the bent left leg releases and the left hand descends left while the right hand lowers and opens. The descending right hand sweeps right and curls upward as the left hand reaches right and folds down, before both hands return left with the left hand rising and the right hand dropping. Both arms open downward as the left hand swings right and back left and the left knee softens, then the right hand curls up to the right and the left arm extends right before both elbows fold. The left hand rises as the right arm opens, then that rising left hand dips and rebounds upward while the right hand moves left, both elbows tucking.

The dancer lengthens the right arm. The left hand curls upward as the right hand rises, then both arms sweep right and descend with opening elbows before lifting again and returning left, the left arm tucking as the hands climb higher. Both arms reach out, the right hand dropping while the left elbow folds and the left hand returns left; the right arm extends farther down as the left knee straightens. The hands reverse in their sideways directions and rise with bent elbows, then lower and open as the left knee softens again. The left hand sweeps left while the right hand moves right, both arms curling upward before the right arm releases down and right; the left hand drops left into an extension as the knees trade bend and straighten. The hands separate right and left, then reverse sideways with the right elbow drawing inward, while the left knee bends and the left hand lifts and falls.

The right knee straightens as the dancer folds both arms, then lifts and opens the right hand while the left hand curls left; the raised right arm tucks farther right before both hands descend. The curled left arm lengthens downward and returns right as the right knee softens, then reverses left and rises into a fold while the right arm extends down and the left knee bends deeper. That lower right hand climbs with a bent elbow as the left hand sweeps left, then drops and reaches right while the right hand travels left and curls upward. Both hands rise and shift right, the right hand folding before the left hand lowers and the right knee straightens. The hands separate left and right with the right hand curling higher, then reverse sideways as the right arm opens and drops; the left hand continues left and curls up while the lowered right arm extends. The right hand returns left and folds again as the left hand lifts, then moves right and rises with an opening elbow while the lifted left hand dips and climbs once more.

In unison, the arms lengthen and lower, the right hand sweeping left before both rise, fold inward and descend again. The left arm reaches right as the right knee straightens, then both hands curl upward while the left knee extends farther; the right hand swings left and back right as both knees soften. Both arms open downward with the right hand moving left, then sweep right and rise into folded elbows as the knees straighten in succession. The hands separate sideways and drop, the right arm extending while the left arm bends and sweeps left; both knees bend again as the arms reopen and lift. The left hand travels right and rises with a deeper tuck while the right elbow folds, then both knees extend as the left tucked arm opens and the right arm curls inward. The hands reverse their sideways directions, the right hand lowering and the right knee bending, then both arms lengthen upward as the left knee softens.

As the right arm folds, the dancer lowers the left hand left and lengthens it, then extends both arms downward. The right hand moves right while the left hand rises, curls inward, and sweeps right. Both hands climb with further extension, then descend as the right arm tucks again and the right knee softens. The right arm opens down-right while the left arm drops left, followed by a lift of the right hand into another fold as the left elbow also bends. The left hand returns left and reaches upward as the right arm unfolds, then the right hand lifts left before both hands drop.

As the right hand rises, the dancer sends the left hand left and down with an opening elbow, then lifts that descending left hand as the right arm folds and both hands sweep right. The right arm curls upward while the left hand continues downward and the left knee bends; the right arm opens left as the left hand returns right and the left knee straightens. Both hands climb and move left, the left hand folding before extending back right, while the right knee softens and the left knee lengthens. The right arm reaches up-left as the left knee bends, then both hands lower and sweep right, the right hand lifting again while the left knee straightens and the left arm tucks. The tucked left hand drops left as the right knee sinks farther, and the right arm opens upward into a final rightward reach.

As the right hand moves right and the left hand moves left, the dancer lowers both hands, then lifts the right hand while the left arm opens. The right arm folds and releases as the left arm curls upward, before the right hand drops into another tuck and both arms lengthen again. The left hand sweeps down-right while the right hand rises with a bend, then extends as the left hand climbs left. Both arms curl upward, the right hand continuing left while the left hand swings right and returns left. The hands descend, the right arm opening as the left arm draws tighter.

At the outset, the right arm folds downward and right as the left hand travels left, then both hands rise with the right arm opening. The left hand continues up-right while the right arm drops left, curls, and lifts again; the right elbow releases before both arms fold and descend. The hands sweep left together, then reverse right with both elbows tucking, before the left hand climbs and returns left. Both hands sink, the right arm continuing left as its elbow bends, then rise with the right arm extending right. The left arm lengthens down-right and folds back toward the left as the right hand descends farther left.

A rising arm sweep begins with the left hand climbing left and curling in as the right hand lifts right, then both hands descend toward the right while the left knee bends and straightens. The hands separate sideways, the right hand returning left as the right knee softens, then both hands rise before the left hand drops left and the right hand moves right over a deeper bend of the right knee. Both arms fold into another lift, with the left hand continuing left and the right hand shifting right; the left knee lengthens as the hands lower, the left arm opens, and the right knee straightens beneath an upward curl. The left hand reaches down-right against the right hand's leftward sweep, then both hands climb, the right elbow tucking farther as the right knee extends; the left arm folds downward and opens again. The right hand drops right while the left hand continues down-left, then reverses right as the left knee lengthens and the left arm curls up-left.

The arms trade height as the left hand lowers and lengthens while the right hand rises, then the left arm curls upward and sweeps right. The right arm folds down-left as the right knee straightens, followed by a bend and release of the right knee beneath the rising left hand, which moves left with an opening elbow before returning right as the right knee softens again. The right hand swings right and back left as the left knee extends; both hands lower, then the right-moving hand reverses right and up as the right knee bends. Both knees deepen their bends while the hands climb, the left arm tucking as the right knee releases and the left knee straightens. The left hand reaches right while the right hand continues rising and opens, the right knee bending further before both legs lengthen.

A rising, alternating hand sweep begins with the right arm folding down-right as the left arm extends, then both hands rise and reverse right with the left arm curling while the right knee straightens. The left hand drops as the left knee bends, then both arms gather inward and the right knee softens while the left arm opens and both hands move left. The left knee releases as the right hand sweeps up-left and the right knee lengthens again; the left hand follows left and curls upward while the right hand reaches right and down. The hands continue right with the right arm tucking and the right knee bending, then the left arm lowers into a deeper fold before both return left, the right hand reaching up-right and the right knee extending. Both knees soften as the left hand rises and moves right with an opening elbow, while the right arm folds down-right and both knees release. The left knee bends again as the right arm opens higher, then the left knee straightens while the right hand lifts and the right hand returns down-left into a curl.

The right knee softens as the dancer sends the left hand left and down with an extending arm, then bends the right elbow while the right hand drops right. The right knee straightens as the left hand continues left and the right elbow opens; both hands rise before the right hand returns left, folds, and lifts again. Both arms lengthen downward and sweep right, the left hand rising as the right knee bends then releases. The left hand swings left and back right over a deeper bend of the right knee while the right arm curls upward and left, then reverses right and down as the right knee sinks further. The left hand lowers and tucks farther inward as the right knee extends, then both arms unfold into a shared lift that ends with the left hand moving left.

An alternating arm sweep begins as the right hand sweeps left and down, the left hand rising right while the right arm curls up-right; both hands descend with opening elbows. The right side repeats a curl-up-left-and-down release, then lifts right into another tuck as the left hand moves left. Both arms fold and lower, the right hand sweeping left before extending right while the left hand returns right and opens downward. The hands separate sideways, then exchange height twice as the right arm lengthens and curls upward, followed by a lift of the left hand. Both hands reverse sideways, the left hand descending into an extension as the right hand rises.

The right hand sweeps left and down. The left arm folds and carries its hand right, then opens as the right hand rises; both hands move right while the left arm curls inward and climbs again. The left hand lowers and extends left before both arms gather upward, the right elbow opening as its hand reaches right. Both hands descend into folded arms, then rise with lengthening elbows and sweep left together. The dancer repeats a descending curl followed by an upward extension in alternating arms, finishing with the right arm reaching farther left.

The dancer straightens the right knee. The left hand drops and swings right, left, and right as the right knee extends further; the descending left arm folds and lengthens again while the right hand moves right and up with a bent elbow. Both hands rise and separate right and left as the knees soften, then the left hand sweeps back right and down before both arms curl upward and the knees straighten. The hands sweep left and lower with opening elbows, then rise apart as the knees bend and release beneath another leftward reach of the right hand. The right hand drops right and curls up as the right knee softens, then both hands climb into folded arms, the left hand sweeping left and down as the right arm opens and lowers.

As the right arm lengthens, the dancer lowers both hands and sends them left, then curls the right hand upward while the left hand extends down. The right hand reverses right and opens into a drop as the left hand moves right, then rises with a fold while the left hand continues down and left. Both arms tuck through another downward reach and rise, the left hand shifting right before both elbows release; the hands then descend with bent arms, the right hand moving left and the left hand moving right. The left hand lifts into a curl and returns left as the right elbow opens, then reaches farther left and drops while the right arm folds and rises. The right hand follows left with an extended arm as the left hand curls upward, then sweeps right and descends while the left arm opens downward and both hands reverse left.

The arms rise together. The dancer straightens the right knee and carries the left hand left, then curls both hands upward while the right knee softens and lengthens again; the right arm opens and drops as the left hand shifts right. The right arm folds into a rightward sweep while the right knee bends deeper and the left leg extends, then both hands descend and separate left and right before the right hand returns left and both elbows tuck. The right hand rises through a fold and release as the left knee straightens, then lowers and opens farther right while the left hand moves left and the left knee softens. Both knees bend in succession as the hands lift and the left elbow draws inward; the right hand sweeps left and down while the left knee extends beneath a further rightward reach of the left arm. The right knee lengthens as the right hand reverses right and curls up, while the left arm opens downward and both knees soften in succession.

The right hand moves left as the dancer curls both arms upward, then sends the left hand right and down while the right arm opens. The right hand reverses right and folds back in, followed by the left hand rising into a curl and sweeping left. Both hands descend, the right arm extending as the left arm continues left; they rise together with bent elbows before the right hand drops farther. The left hand sweeps right and down as its arm lengthens, then the right hand reaches right and lifts while the left elbow tucks.

The right hand sweeps right and down. The left hand moves left and down as the right arm curls upward, then both hands rise, the right hand reversing left before curling back right and descending as the left hand continues right. The left arm folds downward while the right hand returns left and lifts; both elbows open, the right hand drops and rises again, then tucks as the left hand lowers. The right arm lengthens through a rightward sweep, reverses left and rises while the left elbow bends and opens over a knee bend and release. Both arms draw inward and lower, then the left hand climbs into another fold as the right hand extends left and drops. The left hand reaches farther right and down before folding back left alongside the right arm's descent.

The right hand moves right and rises. The left hand follows right as the right arm folds, then both hands descend and the left hand reaches left before returning right and climbing alongside the right hand. Both arms lengthen downward, then curl upward with the right hand drifting left while the left knee softens. The dancer straightens the left knee as the right hand drops and extends again.

To begin, the dancer lifts the right hand and sweeps it left with a folding arm. The left hand drops while the right arm extends right, then both hands move right as the left hand rises into a curl. The hands reverse left, the left hand climbing farther while the right elbow tucks. The left hand continues left with its arm lengthening, then returns right as the right arm opens. The left hand rises and moves left while the right hand descends.

As the right knee straightens and the left knee softens, the dancer lifts both hands with bent elbows. The right hand over the bending left knee sweeps left while the left arm opens right; the bending left knee lengthens as the right hand drops left and the left hand continues right. The descending right arm folds and lifts again, then reaches down-right as the left knee straightens farther, while the left hand rises rightward into a curl. The curled left hand moves left and lowers as the left knee bends, followed by the right hand dropping left as the right knee softens. The lower right hand reverses right and lifts into a fold while the left knee straightens, then the left arm extends down-left as the left knee lengthens further.

The knees straighten as the dancer sends the right hand down-left and the left hand right, then lowers both hands while folding the right arm. Both arms open into a lift, the left hand moving left before curling rightward again. The right hand rises right and returns left, lengthening as the right knee softens; the right hand reverses right while the left hand descends and the left knee bends further. The left hand continues downward and curls left as the right knee straightens, then both hands rise with the right arm opening. The left hand swings right and back left while the right hand lifts and folds, and both descend as their elbows release.

As the right hand moves right, the dancer lifts and folds both arms, lowers them together, then raises them again with both elbows curling inward. The right arm opens and sweeps left while the left arm curls farther, then returns right as the left hand drops and extends down. Both hands descend and sweep left, the right arm lengthening before folding upward and continuing left, followed by the left arm lifting into a tighter tuck. The hands separate right and left as the right elbow opens and both lower, then return toward each other with the left arm reaching out and the right arm curling upward. The right hand continues up and right against the left hand's downward-left sweep; the left knee bends as that arm reaches farther left and curls back up, then the right arm draws in.

The dancer raises the right hand. The left arm lengthens upward, then curls down and right as the right hand drops left; both arms extend, with the right hand continuing left before curling up again. The right hand reverses right while the left arm reaches up and right, folds back down and left, and lifts into a longer reach as the right arm tucks downward. The right hand rises and extends right against the left hand's descending leftward sweep, then reverses down-left as the right knee straightens; both hands return right with the left arm opening. Both arms fold upward and separate sideways, the right hand moving left as the right knee bends and the left arm reaches down-right; the right hand lowers and opens while the right knee releases, and both hands rise as the left elbow curls in. The right arm folds farther and returns right while the left hand dips and lifts into an extension, then the right hand moves left and both descend.

The right knee softens as the dancer curls the right arm upward and left, then lowers it into a fold while the left hand lifts right. The right arm extends down to the left and curls back up to the right, then opens downward as the right knee straightens. Both hands move right before the right hand reverses left, tucks and lifts again. The right hand sweeps down to the right with an opening elbow, then folds upward and reaches farther right as the left knee bends. The right hand drops right and returns left, extending through a rightward reversal, while the left hand curls upward and both knees straighten.

The right knee softens as the dancer lowers and lengthens both arms, then curls them upward and left while the right knee straightens. The hands separate right and left before dropping and folding again, with the right leg extending farther as the hands sweep back toward each other. The left hand moves right while the right arm reaches up and left, and the legs exchange bends in succession: the right leg straightens as the left knee sinks, then the right knee deepens while the right arm folds downward and the left leg extends. The right arm opens down-right as the left knee releases, followed by a leftward curl of the left arm and another bend in the right knee. Both arms draw inward as the right hand rises, then separate with the left hand moving left and down; the right hand sweeps right and falls as the right knee bends further. The hands reverse left together, the right arm lengthening before both descend.

The right knee straightens as the dancer lifts and extends the right arm, then lowers and folds it while the left hand reaches right. The right hand sweeps left as the right arm opens and curls back in, followed by a bend of the left knee and an upward tuck on the left side. The left bent leg releases while the right arm reaches farther up-left and lengthens, joined by another lift on the left side; both hands descend as the left knee bends again. The right arm curls upward-right while the left arm draws left and climbs, with the left knee extending, bending, and releasing through another rise and fall of the left arm. Both knees soften as the right hand drops and opens into a rightward reach, while the left arm curls upward and moves right before dropping left and extending.

The right hand moves left. The dancer curls the left arm upward and right, then opens it into a descending reach while the right hand continues left and its elbow tightens. The right arm lowers and lengthens as the left knee softens, then the right hand sweeps right and the left knee straightens. The right hand reverses left with an extending elbow before returning right and down as the left hand rises and its arm folds. Both hands lift, the left arm curling farther inward as the right hand reaches left and opens. The left arm lowers and releases while the right arm tucks into another upward lift, finishing with the hands traveling left together.

Upward, the dancer raises the right hand while the left hand curls left and down. The right arm folds back left as the right knee straightens, then both hands descend with opening elbows before the right-moving arm lengthens upward. The right hand dips right and rebounds higher, followed by the left hand rising into a curl. Both arms reach down and left, then the right arm reverses right as both knees bend; the left elbow tucks and the left knee sinks further before both hands lift and the left arm opens. The hands sweep right together, the right arm folding as the right knee softens again, then return left with the left hand descending and the bent knee releasing.

The right hand travels left. The dancer lowers and extends both arms, then raises the hands as the right knee straightens; the left arm folds while the right hand drops right, bends, and returns left as the right knee softens. Both hands descend and sweep right, the right arm lengthening before curling upward as the right knee straightens again and the left hand rises leftward. The right arm opens down-right and tucks back up-left while the left hand climbs, the right knee bending and extending twice beneath a leftward reach. The right knee bends again beneath another lift of the left hand, which then curls left as the right hand continues left and falls with a deeper fold. The right hand reverses right while the left hand descends and extends, then both sweep left as the right knee releases and the right arm reaches higher.

The arms trade height: the right hand rises and folds as the left hand lowers, then they exchange height again while the right arm lengthens. The left arm curls upward and reaches left before both hands sweep right, the right hand lifting into a fold as the left hand extends downward. Both arms open as the left hand returns up and left, then the right hand curls upward to the right while the left hand tucks and rises. They reverse sideways, the right hand lowering through an extension and folding back up while the left hand opens and drops; the right hand sweeps left as the left hand moves right and both elbows draw inward. The left hand climbs farther right, the right knee bends, and both hands rise with the left elbow opening before the left hand continues left and the right knee straightens.

As the right knee straightens, the dancer curls both arms upward and separates the hands left and right. The right hand rises farther while the left arm opens downward and folds again; both hands descend and sweep left with an extending elbow before reversing outward as the left knee softens. The right hand continues left, then tucks into a rising rightward reach while the left arm curls upward and moves left. Both hands climb with tucked elbows, then lower as the knees bend in succession and the arms lengthen apart. The knees straighten together as the hands reverse inward, the left arm folding and lifting left while the right hand climbs right. Both arms open and their hands separate again, finishing with the left hand lowering and the right arm curling back toward the right.

The dancer curls the right arm upward. The left hand sweeps left and rises as the right hand drops, then both arms extend while the hands reverse right and the left knee straightens. The right hand returns left into a fold as the right knee bends and releases, while the left elbow tucks farther; both hands rise before the right hand opens right and the left hand curls downward. Both knees soften as the hands lower and separate, the right arm lengthening down-right and the left arm folding down-left. The right knee straightens while the left arm reaches up-right, then both hands rise as the left knee extends and the right arm opens. The hands sweep left together, the right elbow drawing in before both arms lengthen downward.

The right hand reaches left and up. The left hand follows right, then folds back toward the left as the right arm lengthens farther left and both hands descend; the right knee softens while the right arm opens upward and the left hand curls higher before both sweep right with the right hand dropping. The right arm folds down and rebounds up-right as the left hand drops, then extends downward while the left arm opens and tucks again. The left hand travels left as the right hand rises and sweeps left, both arms lengthening before the left hand returns right and curls upward. The left hand drops and unfolds into another rightward reach while the right elbow bends, then opens as the right hand lifts.

At the opening, both arms fold as the left hand moves left and the left knee softens, then the left arm opens while the right arm reaches down-right; the left hand rises right as the bent leg straightens and the right elbow tucks. The hands separate sideways, the left hand climbing farther before both sweep left and drop into extending elbows. They reverse right with a rising curl on the left side, then return left as the right arm folds higher and both legs lengthen. The left hand reverses right as the right elbow releases, dips left and curls back up, while the left arm lowers and opens over a softened knee. The right arm lifts and extends left as the left hand sweeps right and both rise with folding elbows; the left knee straightens while the right hand drops right and the right knee bends. The left arm opens downward and the right hand returns left as the bent knee releases, ending with the left hand moving left.

The right hand lowers and curls right while the left hand rises leftward. The right arm opens as the left arm folds down-right. The right hand reverses left and tucks while the left hand curls upward to the left. Then both arms sweep right and lengthen before reversing left with the left hand dropping. Both arms fold and lift back toward the right, then open as the right hand drops left and the left hand lowers into a tighter curl. The left hand climbs leftward, unfolds and returns right while the right arm draws inward. The right knee bends beneath the left hand's continued rise, then straightens as the left hand lowers and extends farther right.

A sweeping lateral exchange begins with the right arm reaching left and down while the left hand lowers right, then the left arm curls upward as the right knee straightens. The left arm opens right and drops while the right arm extends left; the right arm folds back up toward the right as the left elbow tucks. Both hands descend, the right arm lengthening rightward before curling up-left against the left hand's continuing descent. The left arm reaches farther down-right and folds as its knee softens, then both elbows open while the right hand rises left. The left arm curls upward and releases down-right, ending with both arms extending.

The dancer sends the right hand left. The left arm curls upward while the right arm opens, then the right hand rises as the left arm extends right and down. Both arms lengthen downward before the right hand reaches up-right; the left hand follows right with a folded elbow as the right knee straightens. The hands separate left and right, then reverse sideways as the left knee bends and releases and both elbows tuck. With the right hand lifting right, the bent knee softens again and the left arm folds into another upward reach.

The dancer moves leftward, carrying both hands into folded arms and lowering them as the left knee straightens. The right hand reverses right and rises while the left arm opens down and left; the left knee softens again before the right leg lengthens as both hands climb. The left hand continues left and down with a deeper fold while the right arm sweeps left, then returns right and tucks in. The left knee bends farther as the left arm reaches right and upward, then drops with a tighter curl while the right arm extends down and left.
