The left knee releases as both hands rise, and the right knee softens beneath a folding return to the right; the left arm lengthens downward while the right hand lowers and sweeps left.

The right knee straightens as the dancer sends the right hand right and folds the right arm, then lifts both hands into another curl while the left knee lengthens. The right hand returns left and descends as both elbows open and the right knee bends, followed by a bend in the left knee and a lift of the left hand. The right hand swings right and drops into an extension while the left knee softens; the hands reverse sideways, the left hand rising into a fold as the right hand continues down and the right knee straightens. The right knee bends again beneath a further descent of the left arm while the right hand sweeps left and rises into a tuck; the left knee extends before the hands trade height and the left elbow opens. Both arms gather inward as the left knee bends and the right hand lowers farther, then both hands rise with the elbows drawing tighter before the right hand swings left. The left hand drops into a longer reach while the right arm opens downward and the right knee bends.

At the outset, the right arm curls upward and right while the left hand rises left, then both descend as the left elbow opens. The right hand swings left and back right into a fold while the left hand continues down and reaches right. The right arm releases downward and sweeps left with the left arm as the left knee bends, then both hands rise and sweep right with another bend in the left knee. Both arms lengthen downward as the left knee straightens and softens again; the right hand moves left and folds up while the left hand travels left and tucks inward. The right arm extends farther left before returning right and curling higher, while the left hand drops and the left knee bends deeper.

The right hand rises and falls. The dancer lowers the left hand and extends both arms, then sweeps the right hand right and down before lifting it left with a curling elbow while the left hand moves left and folds inward. The raised right hand continues left as the right knee straightens, then reverses right and drops into a deeper tuck while the left arm opens downward. The left hand returns left and up as the right hand curls higher to the right, and the right knee beneath the right hand softens. Both hands sweep left, the right hand descending with an opening elbow while the left hand climbs, then the right hand rises again as the left arm lengthens.

One knee straightens as the dancer lowers and lengthens one arm, then sends both hands right and lifts them. The opposite hand follows upward while the first drops into a fold; the raised hand moves left as its elbow opens and the other curls farther inward. Both hands climb again, with the opening arm reaching farther right before lowering and extending, and the opposite hand continuing upward. The lowered hand sweeps left as the raised arm folds and carries its hand right. That raised hand dips while the leftward-moving arm lengthens farther left.

The right arm and left arm oppose each other: the right hand drops while the left hand moves right, then both rise and reverse sideways as the left arm extends left. The right knee softens as the right hand climbs farther and the left arm curls right, then opens down-right; the right arm tucks down-left before reversing right and opening again as the left hand lowers. Both hands descend with lengthening arms and a deeper bend in the right knee, then sweep left together before the right arm curls up-right and the left arm lifts into a fold. The left arm continues upward with an opening elbow and a straightening right knee, then reverses down-left as the right knee bends and releases beneath another shared lift and fall. The right hand traces right-left-right while the left arm folds upward, then returns left as the right knee bends and the left hand rises into a curl.

The dancer sends the right hand right and down. The right arm lengthens as the left arm curls upward, then the right hand rises into a fold while the left hand sweeps left and descends. The right arm continues up and right as the left arm opens downward to the left; both hands then rise with the left arm curling inward. The left hand reverses left and drops through an extension while the right arm folds and lifts, before both hands climb together. The dancer lowers the right hand and releases the right arm as the left hand sweeps right, then brings the right hand right too.

As the right hand rises, the dancer lengthens the left arm leftward and folds the rising right arm, then sweeps both hands right with the right elbow opening. The left knee bends as the right arm curls upward and the left arm reaches down-left; the left knee straightens while the right hand drops and the left arm tucks, followed by a lift and release of the left hand. Both arms gather inward and rise before the right hand travels left, the left elbow releasing as the left hand lowers and the left knee softens. The hands separate left and right with folding elbows, then exchange directions again, the right hand rising while the left arm extends down-left. The knees bend in succession beneath a curling rightward sweep and a dip of the right hand, then both legs straighten as the right hand returns left and lifts into an extension.

The dancer performs a descending arm sweep: the right hand drops left and curls upward as the left knee straightens, then the left hand lowers right while both elbows open. Both hands reverse inward with the left hand rising, and the right knee softens as the left bends; the right arm folds left while the left lifts farther right. The right arm lengthens down-left as the left elbow tucks and its knee straightens again. Both hands rise into folded arms, the left moving left, before the right drops right and extends and the left lowers left. Both knees bend as the right hand rises into a curl, then the left knee straightens and its hand lifts left while the right continues up-right.

To begin, the dancer folds the right arm and straightens the right knee as the left hand drops right and both elbows tuck inward. The right leg releases while the right hand rises left over a bending knee and the left arm reaches right; the left hand then lifts left as the right hand curls downward. Both hands sweep right with the left arm opening, then reverse left as the left hand sinks and the right arm lengthens upward. The right arm gathers up-right and the left hand follows right, before both descend and separate sideways with the left elbow folding. The arms extend farther apart and finish lowering together.

A rising arm exchange begins with the dancer bending the right knee and lifting the right hand, then straightening the right leg as both hands climb. The left arm curls left while the right hand moves right; the left hand lowers and opens, followed by the right hand descending. The left arm extends farther left before both hands rise, the right hand sweeping left and down as the right knee softens. The right hand returns right into a fold while the left arm lengthens downward and sweeps right. Both hands finish dropping, the right arm extending.

A rising-and-falling arm weave begins as the dancer folds the right arm and lifts both hands, then opens the right arm left while the left arm curls upward. The left hand drops as the right knee straightens and the right arm extends down-left; both arms tuck and lift again, with the right arm reaching farther right before lowering into a longer reach. The right knee lengthens as both hands descend, then the right arm curls up-right and both elbows fold before opening downward. Both knees bend and release in succession while the arms gather inward, then sweep left and rise as the elbows extend. The knees soften once more beneath another shared upward reach, with the right hand continuing higher while the left hand lowers and moves right.

The right knee bends as the dancer lowers and lengthens the left arm, then opens the right arm into a leftward sweep while the right leg straightens and the right arm reaches down. The right hand returns right as both knees soften, then rises through a left-right-left reversal while the left knee releases and the left arm folds down; the raised arm extends and drops as the right knee straightens, and the hands continue apart before both elbows tuck. Both hands sweep left, the right hand rising and opening as the left hand curls higher, then descend with the right elbow folding and the left arm extending. The hands separate again, the left arm lifting left and curling downward as the left knee softens, while the right arm sweeps up and right with an opening elbow. The left hand climbs left and curls inward as the right hand continues upward and right, then both hands fall, the left arm reaching farther left while the right knee bends and the right hand sweeps left.

In opposition, the dancer curls the right arm upward while the left arm extends down and right, then raises the left hand as the left knee straightens. The right arm reaches farther up and left before lowering and opening while the left arm folds back toward the left. Both hands sweep right with lengthening elbows, then climb into a shared curl as the knees soften in succession. The arms open downward and sweep left, the right hand rising again while the left hand lowers and its elbow tucks. The left hand rises as the right arm continues left, both arms extending before the right arm curls up and right over a bend of the right knee.

The right hand drops left as the left hand moves right, then the right lower arm folds upward before both hands descend and the right arm opens. The left hand reaches right while the right hand curls up-right and extends down-left over a bending right knee; the left hand tucks into a lift as the knees straighten in succession. Both elbows open before the right hand lowers and the left hand curls upward to the left, the right arm folding as its hand rises and returns left. The left arm lengthens down-left while the right hand reaches right and dips, then both hands sweep left and rise with the right elbow opening. The hands separate right and left and climb together, the right hand curling inward before both arms extend downward.

A rising lateral sweep carries the left hand left and the right hand right, both arms lengthening as the knees straighten in succession. The hands reverse inward, the right knee bending before the left arm folds down and left; the right hand lifts and follows left while the bent leg straightens. Both knees soften again beneath a shared rightward reach, then the left knee releases as the left hand rises and both legs extend through another bend of the left leg. The left hand descends with a folding elbow while the right hand curls up-right, followed by the left hand moving right as the right arm opens downward. The left arm extends and lowers while the right arm folds upward to the left.

The right arm reaches left as the left arm extends right, then both arms sweep left and fold inward while the right hand lowers. The left hand rises as the left knee straightens, followed by the right hand lifting into a deeper curl; the left knee softens before both hands descend. The right arm opens downward and folds back up, then releases farther down as the left arm lengthens upward and right. Both elbows tuck as the left hand drops left and the right hand follows down-left, with the right knee bending before straightening beneath a rising left hand. The left elbow opens and curls again as the left knee bends, while the right hand lowers and moves right.

The dancer lowers the right hand. Both arms lengthen as the left hand rises, then both hands sweep left and climb with bent elbows before returning right and dropping, the right arm opening farther while the left knee softens. The hands rise again, the right hand moving left and curling inward as the left arm folds; the left knee bends further while the right hand swings right and down, then reverses left and lifts into a tighter tuck as the left knee straightens. The right hand continues upward and right with a deeper fold while the left hand reaches left, drops and curls back up toward the right. Both hands descend, the right hand sweeping left as the left knee extends and the right elbow releases, while the left arm opens and the left knee straightens; the hands then move right together before the right arm folds downward.

As the right knee bends, the dancer lowers the right hand and extends the right arm while the left hand drops. The extended right arm curls upward as the bent right knee straightens, then reaches down and left while the left hand rises right. The left hand climbs right with a tighter fold, then reverses left and descends as both arms lengthen; it lifts again against the right hand's drop, then returns left. Both hands sweep right and rise into folded elbows before the right hand dips and rebounds left, joined by the left hand climbing left and curling inward. The left hand continues left and drops as the right hand moves right, then reverses back left while the lowered left hand lifts and both arms lengthen out.

An alternating arm sweep begins with the right hand lowering while the left hand rises and sweeps left, then both hands descend as the right knee bends. The hands separate right and left, the right knee straightening as the right-moving arm curls upward, then opens down while the left knee softens and the left arm tucks into a rising rightward reach. The left hand lifts left over a bending left knee, both arms lengthen downward, and the left hand returns right as the left knee straightens and the right knee softens. Both elbows fold while the right hand drops farther right; the left hand climbs left over another bend of the left knee before reversing right and opening downward as the left leg straightens. The right hand lowers and reaches left through a lengthening elbow, then both arms curl upward as the knees soften in succession.

The right knee straightens as the dancer folds the right arm and lifts the right hand left, then lowers it while the left hand rises left and both elbows tuck. The right hand reaches right as the left hand moves down-left, with the knees softening in succession beneath a further extension of the right arm. Both hands sweep up-right and open, the left knee lengthening before both hands return left; the left elbow folds as the left knee bends, then the right knee straightens and the right arm curls upward while the left arm opens downward. The left hand sweeps left and rises into another tuck as the right knee bends, the right hand dropping and the right knee extending before both arms lengthen and the left knee releases. The hands reverse sideways with the left arm opening and the left knee bending, then lift and fold together as the left knee straightens, the right arm reaching right and both hands descend while the left knee softens again.

A rising-and-falling arm exchange begins with both hands lifting. The right arm curls before the right hand drops left and the left arm extends. The dancer folds the right arm upward while the left knee straightens, then opens the right arm as the left hand continues down-left and the left knee softens. The right arm tucks again, lowers, and lengthens toward the right as the left arm curls up-right. Both knees bend in succession, then release as the right hand rises and the left hand moves left. The right hand returns left and the arms trade height again, the right arm folding downward while the left arm extends. Both hands climb and separate left and right, then lower as the left arm lengthens farther and the right arm draws inward.

A rising and folding arm exchange begins as the right hand curls upward while the left hand drops, then sweeps left and up into a tuck. The hands separate right and left with the right arm opening and lowering, before both sweep right and climb into folded arms. Both elbows release as the hands descend, the left hand returning left. The left arm gathers up and opens again while the right arm folds higher, then the left hand returns right and down and the right hand follows that direction. Both arms lengthen as the left hand lowers farther and moves left.

To begin, the dancer lowers both hands. The right hand sweeps left and rises with an extending elbow as the right knee straightens, then folds back right while the right leg lengthens further. The left hand follows right and climbs into a tuck as the right arm curls upward again. Both hands descend, the left elbow opening before they sweep left together. The right arm reaches farther left and lifts as the right knee bends; both hands climb, the left hand moving right and folding inward while the bent knee releases.

The right hand rises and folds left while the left hand curls up, then both descend with the left arm lengthening. The right hand curls up again as the left hand drops and sweeps right, then opens down and left. The left hand lifts left and falls right into a fold as the right hand continues left, then extends upward to the right. The raised arm tucks farther before opening downward and sweeping left. Both hands lower, the left hand curling in as the right hand returns right and rises into a bend.

The dancer lifts both hands. The right arm curls left and rises as the right knee bends, then the left hand sweeps left and back right while the right knee straightens; the right arm opens down-left before the knees trade softness and the right hand rebounds upward. Both hands climb with folded elbows, then separate right and left as the left arm releases downward and the right curls higher over a bending knee; the left hand reverses up-right while the right returns left and drops into an extended reach. The hands rise again as their arms lengthen, then the left moves left and lowers over a bent knee while the right reaches right and dips; both elbows tuck as the right hand climbs and the left follows right. The right hand returns left and opens downward while the left knee straightens, then both hands lift and sweep right with the right elbow folding and the left arm releasing. The hands descend in succession, the right moving left and rising as the right knee softens, while the left elbow curls, then both arms extend through another drop and renewed lift.

As the right arm curls upward, the dancer sends both hands left and lifts the left hand before lowering it into a fold. The raised left hand drops right with an opening elbow as the right hand continues left, then rises while the right knee straightens and the left hand sweeps right and down. Both hands sweep left, the right hand rising into a tighter curl while the left hand lowers and opens; they reverse right and back left, the left arm tucking as the right knee softens. The tucked left hand lifts and extends over a bending right knee, then drops as the left knee bends and straightens; the right knee releases before the left hand rises again. Both knees soften in succession, the right arm lengthening downward as the left arm curls upward, then the knees straighten together and the lower left arm folds back up. The left knee bends beneath another rightward extension of the right arm, then straightens as both hands rise, the left arm reaching farther right.

As the right arm folds and the left arm lengthens, the dancer lowers both hands, then lifts the right hand left while the left knee straightens. The right arm extends down and right as the left knee bends, then curls upward while the left leg releases; the left hand rises and sweeps left before dropping into a fold as the left knee softens again. Both knees straighten in succession as the hands descend, then the right hand rises into a curl while the left arm reaches farther left and up. The right arm extends downward as the left arm tucks, the left knee bends, and the hands sweep left together with both elbows drawing inward. The left hand lifts right as the right hand drops, then the hands separate left and right before both return left, the right arm folding and rising as the left arm curls higher.

As the right hand drops, the dancer raises the left hand rightward and curls it in while the right arm lengthens left. The left hand returns left as the right arm climbs, then both descend with the right arm opening before they separate again, the left moving right and the right moving left. Both hands rise, the right arm curling inward as the right knee softens, then the hands exchange sideways directions and lower with the left elbow extending. The left knee bends further as the right hand rises and folds back down; the left side opens into a rightward lift while the right arm curls higher and sweeps left. The arms trade height again, the left rising right as the right lowers and reaches right, then both sweep left and descend with the left elbow tucking and the left knee bending.

As the right hand lowers, the dancer lifts and folds the left arm left while the right hand continues down; the left hand then drops as the right knee straightens. The right hand travels right and curls upward as the left knee bends and releases, then both hands climb with the left arm tightening further. Both hands sweep left, the left arm opening downward while the right arm folds up-right; the right arm tucks as the left knee softens, and the hands separate again before the left arm rises and extends. The left arm lengthens down-left while the right hand returns right, then curls up-left over a bending left knee as the left hand climbs and both knees bend in succession. The right curled hand falls right and unfolds while the left arm opens downward, then the left hand rises right and reverses left as the right knee sinks further. The left knee straightens beneath a rightward extension of the rising left hand, which then descends while the right hand moves right and the right knee releases.

The dancer sends both hands right. The left hand rises and curls back left as the right arm folds, then the left hand reverses right into an extension while the right elbow opens and the left knee straightens; the hands sweep left together before the right hand returns right. Both arms gather inward as the right hand climbs, then separate again with the left hand moving left and the right hand curling down toward the right. The right knee bends as the left leg extends left and lowers, followed by a bend of the left knee while the right hand lifts and the left hand reaches up-right. The right leg straightens as the left hand drops left, then the right knee softens while the left arm curls upward and both hands sweep right. The raised hand swings left, reverses right with an opening elbow, then continues right into another fold.

The right knee softens as the dancer lowers both hands, lengthening the arms and opening the right knee while the left hand moves left. The right arm folds downward before extending right and rising into a curl, then both hands sweep left as the elbows tuck and the right knee straightens. The right hand climbs and returns right with an unfolding elbow as the left knee bends and the left hand rises; the right knee also softens before both knees extend in succession. Both arms gather upward, the left hand moving left as the right knee bends again, and the hands separate right and left before the right hand drops into a tighter fold and the left knee sinks. The hands reverse inward, the right elbow opening as the right knee extends, then both rise and sweep left with the left arm curling higher; the right hand continues upward and right as the left knee bends again.

The knees straighten in succession. The dancer lifts the left hand left while the right arm folds and lowers right, then extends both arms as the left hand reverses right and both descend. Both hands sweep left with bent elbows before rising into opposing reaches, the left moving right and the right returning left. The left hand dips rightward as the right knee softens, then rises left while the left knee bends; the right hand lifts and follows left with a deeper elbow fold as the right knee sinks further. Both hands reverse right, the left lowering as the right climbs, then the left knee straightens while the raised arm tucks and drops left. The right arm curls upward and opens back down as the right knee extends, followed by the left hand lifting left and folding inward.

The right knee straightens as the dancer curls both arms upward, the right hand moving left and the left hand moving right before reversing. The right arm extends down and folds again while the left arm reaches farther right. The left hand lowers and lengthens as the left knee softens; the right hand sweeps left and rises with an opening elbow. Both hands descend, the right arm curling as the left knee bends more deeply, then the right arm releases down and right. The left hand lifts into a fold while the left knee beneath the descending right arm bends further.

As the right knee softens, the dancer lowers and folds both arms, then sends the left hand left while the right hand curls upward; the right knee straightens as the hands reverse sideways. Both arms open downward, then sweep right with the left arm curling up while the right arm lengthens into a shared lift and the left knee bends. The left hand drops left with an extending elbow as the left knee releases, then rises and moves right alongside the right arm before both descend and the elbows fold. The left knee bends again as the right arm reaches up-right and the left hand lifts left, then opens down-right while the right arm tucks and lowers left and the left knee deepens. The left arm curls upward as the right arm extends and sweeps left, then both descend with the right elbow folding and opening; the left hand returns right while the left knee straightens.

The dancer raises both hands. The right arm folds and returns down-right while the left arm opens, then curls upward as the left knee softens and the right hand swings left and back right. The left arm lengthens downward over a bending right knee while the right hand rises and the right knee straightens, then the right arm reaches up-left as the left elbow tucks and both knees extend. Both arms fold with the right hand climbing right before opening down-left, then the left arm curls up-right over another bend of the left knee; the right hand continues left and rises into a tighter fold as the left knee releases. The left arm extends down-right while the left knee bends and the right hand drops, then both elbows gather inward as the right knee straightens again and the right hand rises left. With another left knee bend beneath the right hand's lift, the right hand reverses right and curls higher while the left arm opens farther up-right.

The right hand sweeps left. The dancer lowers and extends the left arm, then lifts both hands before reversing their sideways paths and lowering them together. Both arms lengthen, with the right hand continuing down-left while the left arm reaches farther right; the left arm folds as the right hand rises and returns left. The right hand moves right and curls upward as the left hand climbs left, then opens back left and descends while the left hand drops and folds. The right arm tucks farther left and lifts, followed by the left hand reaching up-left and lengthening as the right arm unfolds. The hands separate in opposite directions, the right hand dropping right while the left hand continues up-left, then reverses right and curls inward.

The right hand rises and moves left. The left hand sweeps right, lowers into a curl, then follows left as the right hand reaches farther left and both hands descend with opening elbows. Both arms fold again and lift, the right hand continuing left before the left elbow releases; the hands separate sideways and lower as that release lengthens. The right arm curls upward while the left extends downward and swings right, then the left elbow opens as the right hand climbs and the right hand drops. The left elbow folds and both hands move left before the right hand lifts and reverses right, joined by the left moving right. The left arm gathers inward and dips, then extends as the right hand rises and the right knee straightens.

The dancer lifts and lengthens the right arm while the left arm curls up-left, then both hands descend as the right hand sweeps left and back right with a bend of the right knee. The left hand continues left and rises before returning right over a left knee bend, while the right hand moves left and the left hand drops, opens, and curls upward again. The right arm folds down-right and both hands sweep left, the left arm extending downward as the left knee softens and the right knee bends; the left hand then reverses right as the left knee straightens. Both knees soften as the right arm reaches left and the left hand lowers right, then the right knee extends and the right arm folds up-left before dropping as the left knee straightens and the left arm lengthens. The right knee bends again beneath an upward curl of the right arm as the left hand travels left, then the right leg releases while the left hand shifts right and both arms tuck.

As the left arm folds and the right hand drops left, both hands sweep right with the left arm rising. The left hand returns left while the right hand curls upward, then the right hand descends as the left knee bends. Both arms lengthen downward, the left hand sweeping left while the right hand moves right over a softened knee, before they reverse sideways and fold back toward their original directions. The right hand climbs and extends right as the left knee straightens, then falls with another bend of the left knee; the left hand lifts and reaches farther right as the bent leg releases. The left hand continues right and down while the right hand lowers left and curls into a tighter fold.

As the right hand drops and the left knee softens, the dancer carries the right hand left while the left arm lengthens downward; both knees straighten in succession as the hands rise and the hands exchange lateral directions. The left arm that began moving right curls down toward the right as the left knee bends again, then extends upward to the left over a right knee bend while the right leg straightens and the right hand reaches down. Both arms gather inward as their respective legs lengthen, then separate into a rising leftward reach and a descending rightward sweep, with the right knee bending before the reaching arm releases farther left. The bent right leg straightens as the right hand climbs and the left arm tucks right, then the raised right hand reverses right and folds inward as the left knee bends again. That folded left arm opens left and lowers while the right leg straightens; the right hand continues left and rises as the right knee lengthens, and the left hand swings right and down before curling upward.

The dancer extends the right arm downward. The left hand travels left and down as the right hand reverses right, then both elbows open into a shared upward reach before the hands return left with the right arm curling inward. The left knee softens as the right arm lowers and lengthens, while the left hand drops and the right knee bends further; both arms fold, the left hand moving right as the knees straighten. The right arm reaches up-left over another bend and release of the right knee, while the left elbow opens and closes again; the right hand returns right as the left hand sweeps left. The right arm tucks farther and carries the right hand down-left, then unfolds into an upward lift as the left hand follows up-right and the left knee softens.

The dancer folds the right arm upward. The left hand sweeps right and down as the right arm lowers, then the hands reverse inward with the left arm lifting back left. Both arms lengthen into a shared downward reach before the right arm curls up to the right and the left hand moves right too. The right arm releases downward while the left arm tucks left, then both rise as the left hand reverses right. The right hand extends right and down while the left arm opens, and the right knee bends as the left knee straightens beneath a further rightward reach of the left hand.

In opposition, the right hand drops and the left hand rises while the right knee beneath the lowering arm straightens. The rising left hand curls right as the left knee softens and the right arm folds down-right, then both hands sweep left and descend with the left arm opening. Both arms tuck upward as the right knee extends, then their hands separate left and right before reversing inward and dropping into lengthened reaches. The initially lowered right hand lifts left while the left hand moves right and curls upward; the hands continue separating, the lifted right arm opening right and the left hand dipping before returning up-left. The raised left hand dips right and rebounds upward as the right hand sweeps left and down, then returns right while the left arm folds and climbs right.

As the right hand moves right and the left hand climbs, the dancer straightens both knees, then sends the hands in opposite directions with the left arm curling inward. The arms exchange height, the newly lifted left elbow folding as the right knee softens and both hands descend. The right hand swings left while the left hand reverses right and rises, then the lower right arm curls up to the right and opens into a shared descent. Both arms lengthen as the initially rising left hand moves left and the right hand reaches higher; the left arm tucks back toward the right and returns left, then both elbows bend and their hands sink together. The hands reverse sideways, the initially raised left arm opening into a lift and drop while the right arm folds upward, before both elbows release and the right hand sweeps right and down.

The right knee straightens as the dancer lifts and lengthens both arms, then the right knee bends again while the right arm folds downward and the left arm rises. The left arm tucks rightward as the right knee softens further, then opens left before curling back right and up with a deeper right knee bend. Both hands sweep left, the left hand rising while the right hand drops and extends; the knees straighten in succession as the left arm reaches down and both hands return right, the right elbow folding. Both elbows open as the knees soften again, followed by another straightening of the left leg. The hands lower, the right hand continuing left while the left hand moves right, then the left arm curls upward and sweeps left as the right knee bends farther. The left arm releases downward, the right hand follows down and right, and the right knee straightens.

A rightward sweep with rising hands begins as the right arm lengthens, folds and opens again while the left hand lifts left; both arms tuck as the right hand returns left. The left hand lowers right, then rises and falls while the left knee straightens and bends, followed by a dip and lift of the right hand as the left knee softens again. Both hands descend and separate sideways, the right arm opening before curling up and right as the left knee extends and the left arm reaches down and left. The right hand drops and swings left, curls upward then right and returns down-left as the left hand rises right and folds in. Both hands climb into bent elbows, the left arm extending right before reversing left as the right arm opens downward and both knees soften. The right arm curls up-right while the left arm sweeps right and down; the right knee straightens beneath an extension of the right arm as the left knee bends deeper.

As the right hand drops, the dancer sends the left hand left and down, then raises both hands with an opening right elbow while the right knee straightens. The left hand continues left and curls upward as the right knee softens, then returns right and lowers through a deeper bend before the right knee straightens again. The left arm opens up and left while the right hand rises and travels left, the right knee bending as the left arm tucks and the left knee extends. Both arms lengthen downward, the right hand returning right before curling up and left; the left arm reaches farther left and up, followed by the right hand lifting and folding into a rightward sweep. The right knee bends as the left hand drops and the raised arm extends farther right, then the right knee releases and the left knee softens beneath another upward curl.

Rightward, the right hand sweeps as both knees straighten and the left hand follows right; the right arm folds while the right knee softens, then both hands descend and sweep left before the arms open. Both knees lengthen as the right hand rises right and curls inward, then drops into a fold against the left hand's upward reach left. The right hand continues down-right and extends as the right knee bends, while the left arm reaches farther up-left; the left knee releases as the right arm tucks and rises, followed by the left hand climbing right. The right arm opens through a left-to-right sweep and descends, then both arms curl upward and the hands separate left and right with the left arm lengthening. The hands fall and sweep left as the right elbow extends, then lift together into folded elbows, the right hand reversing right. The left hand returns right and down with an opening arm, followed by a downward left-right sweep of the right hand as both knees bend and the left arm reaches farther right.

At the outset, the right arm folds as the right hand lowers and moves right while the left arm reaches left. The left arm curls upward, then opens down toward the right before lifting back left into a tighter fold. The left hand drops as the right knee bends, then both hands sweep right with the right arm lengthening downward. Both arms tuck again and lift, the right hand moving left before both elbows open. The left hand returns left as the right arm curls upward and the right knee softens.

The right hand moves right and down. The left hand sweeps left before returning right, while the right arm lengthens downward and the left arm curls upward; both hands then rise as the right knee softens. The left arm opens and lowers with a deeper knee bend, while the right hand drops and the right leg straightens. Both arms extend as the left hand climbs left, then the right hand follows left into another fold as the right knee bends again. The right arm releases down while the left arm reaches right and rises.

The right hand sweeps right and down. The dancer bends both knees, then folds the right arm as the right knee straightens and the left hand drops left; the right knee softens again while the left arm lengthens downward. Both hands sweep left with bent elbows, the right hand climbing and opening before the left hand follows upward. The right arm tucks right as the left hand lowers, then both descend, the right arm extending farther. The left hand rises with a curling elbow as the right hand reaches up and right, before the left hand drops left.

To begin, the dancer folds the right arm right and lifts both hands as the left knee softens, then lowers the right hand while the left knee straightens. The right hand rises left with an extended elbow as the left hand moves right, then drops and curls back right while the left arm tucks and the left knee bends. The left leg releases as the right arm reaches up-right and lengthens, followed by the left hand moving right; both knees soften before the right arm folds downward and the left knee straightens. Both arms open as the right hand swings left and climbs into a tighter fold, then reverses right and down with another bend of the left knee while the left arm gathers upward. The right hand continues right and curls higher as the left knee straightens, while the left hand descends left with a deeper bend in the left knee.

A repeated arm exchange begins with the right hand dropping and the left hand moving left as the dancer straightens the right knee beneath the lower arm. The hands separate, the left arm lengthening rightward while the right hand swings left and curls upward; both then sweep right and rise, the left elbow folding before opening again. The right hand returns left as the left knee softens and the left arm tucks, then the right arm draws inward before reversing right into a lift. Both knees bend and release in succession as the right hand sweeps left and drops, the left arm reaching down-right, folding upward and returning left. The right arm curls higher, opens, and folds again as the left hand rises leftward. The left hand returns right and descends while the right hand moves left, ending with a deeper fold.

To begin, the dancer folds both arms upward and left, then lowers the right hand while the left hand curls higher. The right hand continues down-left as the left arm opens downward, followed by another drop of the right hand into an extension. Both hands climb again, the left hand moving right before both return left; the left arm lengthens farther left while the right arm tucks. The left hand reverses right as the right arm rises and extends, then drops alongside it as the left hand returns left. The right arm folds and lifts right while the left hand travels right and up with a curling elbow.

The right hand rises with a curling arm. The dancer lifts the left hand and folds the left arm, then lowers both hands as the right elbow opens; the left knee bends while the hands sweep left together. Both arms lengthen and rise, the right hand moving right before the left hand returns left and drops with its elbow tucked. The knees straighten in succession as the left-moving hand climbs farther left, then both hands descend and shift right with the elbows opening. Both hands lift again, the left arm curling as the knees soften, then drop into an extension of the right arm. The left hand reverses left while the right hand sweeps right, both hands lowering as the right knee straightens.

The dancer lifts both hands. The right arm folds and then unfolds while the left hand drops and the left knee softens. The right hand travels left while the left arm curls up and right. Then both elbows open as the left hand returns down-left over a lengthening left knee. Both arms tuck and sweep right. The right arm opens before curling again as the left knee bends; the left elbow follows with a deeper fold. The folded arms rise toward the left. The right arm releases downward and sweeps right as the left elbow opens. The left hand swings left. Then both arms curl upward and separate sideways, with the right hand moving left and the left arm extending right.

The right arm folds left. The dancer opens the right arm right while the left hand rises, then lowers and curls as the right knee straightens; both hands descend before the right hand reaches farther right and the left hand lifts into an extension. The right hand reverses left as the right knee softens and the left arm folds, then drops with a tighter elbow while the right knee straightens again. The left hand climbs right and tucks as the right hand continues downward and extends, followed by the left hand reaching down-left as the left knee bends. Both arms lengthen and the knees straighten, then the left hand curls upward and returns left while the right hand sweeps up-right and folds; the right knee sinks again as the right hand lowers and both arms open.

As the right arm folds upward, the dancer carries both hands right and lifts the left hand while the right arm lengthens. The left hand returns left as the right knee bends, then sweeps right and down while the right hand lowers toward the right; the right leg straightens before the left arm curls upward and reverses left. Both knees soften as the right hand rises, then the legs lengthen in succession while the left arm extends downward. The right knee bends again beneath a curling hand rising left, followed by the left hand lifting through an extension. The left hand drops as the right knee bends further, then both arms unfold before the right hand moves left and the left knee sinks deeper beneath another rightward reach.

The dancer folds the right arm upward as the left hand moves right, then opens the right arm while the left arm curls and lowers left. The right hand swings left, right, and back left as the left arm lengthens downward. The left arm tucks upward to the right before both hands descend, the right arm extending and the left arm folding inward. The left arm reaches right and rises into a deeper curl while the right hand moves left.

At the opening, the dancer straightens the right knee and lowers both hands into lengthened arms, then sends them right with the right arm folding before reversing left as the left knee bends and the elbows open. The bent left leg releases while the right arm curls upward and right, the left arm tucking left; the hands exchange height as the knees soften in succession, then the raised right hand drops and returns right while the left hand lifts and extends over a deepening bend of the right knee. Both hands sweep left and rise as the bent right knee straightens, then reverse right with the right elbow folding and both knees softening, followed by another leftward return and renewed extension of the legs. The hands separate sideways again as the right knee bends and releases beneath a downward curling motion, then both hands lift left with the right arm lengthening while the left knee softens and the left hand reverses right. The right knee straightens as the left leg lengthens, and both hands lower, the right arm extending farther right while the left arm folds.

The knees soften in succession as the right arm curls up-left and the left hand rises right. The dancer straightens the right knee while both hands sweep left, then bends it again as the left knee releases; the arms trade height with the raised arm opening and folding downward and the lower hand lifting into a longer reach before both descend. The knees continue to lengthen as the hands reverse sideways, the left hand rising right over its softening knee while the right travels left and down, then returns right with another knee bend and release. Both hands climb as the knees straighten further, the right arm extending left and the left curling upward-right; they then separate and lower, the right knee bending while the left hand returns left and the right moves right, ending with both hands rising as that knee releases. The right hand continues right and the left lifts farther before dropping into a fold as its knee bends, then both hands rise again with the right arm tucked and the left extending left. Both hands lower as the right knee straightens and the left arm opens, then the right reaches right while the opposite hand moves left and folds inward.

In opposition, the dancer sends the right hand right and the left hand left as the right arm folds upward, then reverses the right hand left into a curl while the left arm reaches down and right. The right hand lowers and opens rightward as both arms lengthen, then returns left with another fold; the left hand rises and drops before the right hand lifts again. The left arm tucks farther while the right arm extends downward, then both elbows open as the hands separate left and right and rise together. The hands reverse inward toward each other, then descend and sweep outward, the right elbow folding as the left hand continues left. Both arms lengthen once more as the left knee bends, straightens and bends again beneath an upward lift of the left hand.

To begin, the dancer folds the left arm while lowering the right hand rightward, then opens the right arm and carries the right hand left. Both hands rise as the left arm releases left, before the right elbow bends and the right hand dips, then extends upward to the right. The left arm curls higher as the right hand drops right and lengthens; the right hand continues climbing, opens rightward, and lowers. The right hand returns left as both elbows tuck, then both hands sweep right with the left arm opening downward and the right arm releasing. The right hand moves left as the left hand rises rightward and the left elbow draws inward again.

Upward, the right hand lifts with a curled elbow as the left hand rises and folds, then both lower into open arms. The right arm lengthens left while the left arm curls up-right, followed by the right knee softening. Both hands descend as the right knee straightens, then sweep right before the left arm reaches down-left and the left knee bends again. The right hand continues right and rises, then drops while the left hand moves up-right. The dancer brings the right hand back up-left, extending the right arm as the left hand travels left and down; both hands reverse right before the right hand descends and the left hand lifts.

At the outset, the right hand moves right as the right knee straightens and both hands rise, then the left arm curls upward before both arms extend. The right hand reverses left and drops while the left knee bends, followed by a dip of the right knee; both hands sweep right and lift into folded elbows as the left knee straightens again. Both knees soften in succession beneath another leftward reach of the right hand, which then returns right while the left arm lengthens down and the right knee releases. The left hand travels left as the right arm folds downward, then lifts with an opening elbow while the right arm reaches right and both knees bend further. The left arm tucks and rises as the right hand climbs left, then the hands reverse directions with the left elbow extending and the left knee straightening; both knees continue to lengthen as the left hand descends and the right hand curls left.

To begin, the dancer folds the right arm as the right knee straightens, then sweeps both hands right and down before the left hand curls upward over a bending left knee and returns left. The right arm opens downward while the left arm lengthens down to the right, then the right arm folds as the left knee releases; the right hand rises left into a tuck and drops as the right knee softens. Both hands descend with opening arms, then the right hand curls up and right as the right knee extends and the left knee bends and releases; the hands sweep left, the right arm lengthening while the left arm folds downward. The left hand swings right and back left as the right knee bends and the right arm draws in and down, then both knees release as the right hand reaches right and both elbows open. The right knee bends again beneath a rising, folded right arm that moves left and lowers as the left knee straightens; the left arm extends upward, then the left knee releases while the right hand curls up and moves right.

The right arm reaches left and rises, then folds as the left hand moves right. The right arm opens downward while the left arm curls upward and both hands sweep left; the right arm lengthens again before the left hand drops and returns right as the right knee straightens. Both arms tuck as their hands rise and move right, then the left arm opens and lowers while the right knee bends and straightens and the right hand climbs farther right. The left hand lifts and curls left as the right knee softens, while the right arm extends down and right, followed by a leftward return of the left hand as the right knee releases. The hands reverse apart with the right hand rising and opening, the left hand curling up and left, then descend and exchange directions, the left arm unfolding as the right knee bends again.

The dancer lifts the right hand into an extension, then lowers it and carries it left as the left knee bends and straightens. The left arm folds upward while the right hand curls right and drops over a softening knee, then both hands sweep left and the right elbow releases as the knees lengthen. Both arms tuck upward, the right hand reversing right before the left hand follows right and its arm opens; the right arm unfolds and lowers as its knee bends again. The hands separate left and right, the left arm curling higher as its knee extends, before that hand returns left and both elbows fold. The right arm reaches down-right while the left hand dips and rises, then the right hand reverses left with a deeper bend of its knee.

At the outset, the right hand rises rightward and curls inward while the left arm folds left; the right hand then lowers into an extension as the left hand sweeps right. The right knee softens as the right hand reverses left and both arms draw in, then straightens while the right hand lifts back right and opens. The left arm lengthens left, drops and folds upward, followed by the right hand climbing left and tucking in. Both hands rise with folded elbows before the right arm extends downward and the left arm sweeps down-left and opens. The right arm curls upward again, while the right hand reaches left and rises into a fold as the left knee bends.

At the outset, the dancer straightens the right knee while the left arm curls up and right, then folds the raised left arm into a leftward sweep as the right hand drops right. The right knee softens beneath the descending right hand while that right hand returns up and left into a tuck; the left knee bends as the right knee straightens, and both hands climb before separating left and right with lengthening arms. Both knees deepen their bend as the right-moving arm extends farther right and down, then releases while the left hand dips and rebounds upward. The rebounding left arm gathers left and lifts again as the right arm curls up and left, then both open into a shared rightward sweep and descend, the right arm folding before reaching out. The right hand rises with an extending elbow as the left knee straightens and the left hand moves left; both hands climb while the right knee bends and the right hand reverses right. The right knee releases as the right hand lowers, then the left arm reaches left and down while the left knee softens.

As the right arm folds and the left arm opens, both hands sweep right while the right arm lowers and lengthens. The hands reverse left; the right arm curls upward while the left hand rises and the left knee softens. The right arm then extends down as the left knee straightens. Both hands return right and rise with a tighter fold on the right side before descending together; the right arm opens as the left arm curls upward. The left hand drops, reaches up and down again, and the right arm lifts into a tuck before both elbows open and the left hand returns right. The left hand sweeps left and climbs as the right arm curls upward, then both descend; the left hand returns right and rises while the right elbow releases. The hands separate sideways; the right hand continues left and down as the left arm extends.

The right hand sweeps right and down while the left hand travels left and rises into a fold. The right hand returns left and curls upward, then both arms lengthen. The right hand continues left and lowers while the left hand drops and opens right, then reverses left with another bend of the right arm. The right arm tucks farther left and lifts as the left elbow draws in, before the hands separate right and left and descend. The left hand reverses right and folds upward while the right hand returns left, finishing with a deeper curl.

Upward, the right hand curls left while the left hand rises right, then both arms sweep down and right as they lengthen. The right hand reverses left into a fold as the left knee softens, then the right hand climbs while the left knee straightens. The hands trade sideways directions twice, the left arm opening upward before both arms sweep left and lower, the left knee bending again. The left hand returns right with an extension as the right arm folds upward and carries the right hand left; both knees straighten before the right knee bends again and the right hand drops. Both hands continue left, the right hand curling upward while the left hand lowers and reaches right, then the left hand opens farther right as the right arm unfolds and the left knee straightens once more.

Leftward and upward, the dancer carries the left hand while the right hand rises rightward with a folding elbow; both hands descend as the right knee softens. The left arm reaches left and up before curling right and down against the right hand's rightward lift, then returns left and folds as the right knee straightens. Both hands rise and sweep right as the left knee bends, then the left hand drops into an extended reach while the right knee releases. The hands separate left and right as the right arm lengthens downward, then reverse sideways while the left arm folds and lowers; the right hand continues left as the left hand lifts and opens. Both arms extend and lower, with the left hand moving right and the right knee bending again before straightening beneath another lift of the left hand.

A rising leftward reach begins the phrase: the left arm extends as both knees straighten, then both hands move right and lower with folding elbows. The left hand returns left and curls upward as the right arm lifts into a tuck and follows left; both arms open, reverse right, and rise before the left elbow folds again. Both hands sweep left as the left arm lengthens and the left knee softens, then both hands climb farther left while the right knee bends and straightens beneath a further lift. The left arm reaches down-right as the right knee bends, then both hands descend and separate left and right with opening elbows before lifting back together and extending downward. The left elbow folds as both hands rise, then the right hand sweeps right and drops with a curling elbow while the left hand lowers into an extended reach.

The right hand sweeps right and down while the left knee softens and the left arm folds upward. The right arm curls left as the left knee straightens, then both hands descend with the left arm opening. The right hand reverses right as the left hand rises into a tuck and the left knee bends again; the left hand then drops and reaches farther right. The right elbow opens while the left knee extends and the left arm lengthens leftward, before both hands lower and sweep right together. The right knee softens as the left hand returns left and the left knee straightens.

The right arm curls up-left as the left hand rises, then both arms sweep right and descend. The left arm folds down-right while the right arm lengthens down-left, followed by another curling lift of the left hand toward the left. The right hand lowers into a deeper tuck as the left hand continues upward and the left knee softens; the right arm extends farther left before both hands fall and the elbows release. The right knee bends as the right hand lifts right with a folding elbow, then both arms reach left and descend. Both knees straighten and soften in succession as the right arm curls upward again, followed by the left arm gathering upward before they separate sideways, the right arm continuing up-left.

The arms oppose each other as the dancer lengthens the left arm down-left and curls the right arm up-right, then lifts and folds the left arm while the right hand continues right and lowers. The left arm reaches left and upward, followed by the right hand climbing left; both elbows tuck before the right arm opens downward and the hands move right. Both arms curl upward again, the left arm moving left and the right arm right, then extend down as the knees soften in succession and the hands separate left and right with a renewed bend in the left knee. The left hand rises through a longer reach and folds back down-right while the right elbow releases, then both hands lift into tighter bends as the left knee straightens and the right hand sweeps left and drops. The left arm opens downward, then both climb and fold as the hands reverse sideways, with the left knee bending farther and its hand lowering before the hands separate once more.

At the opening, the dancer lowers both hands and sends them right, the right arm folding as the left knee softens; the right hand returns left and rises while the left knee straightens, then both knees bend before the left hand drops right and the right knee lengthens. The right arm reaches up-left over a deeper bend of the left knee, then folds as both arms descend and both knees straighten, before both elbows curl upward with another bend of the left knee. The right hand continues rising right and opens downward as the left hand moves right and tucks, then the left arm curls up-left over another left knee bend while the right arm extends down-left and the right knee straightens. Both hands sweep right as the left knee bends again and the right arm folds farther; the right hand lifts over a release of the left knee while the left hand sweeps left and climbs. The right arm opens right and drops as the left knee bends again, then folds into a lift while the right knee lengthens; the left hand moves right and rises with an elbow tuck as the right hand descends, then both return left with the left arm extending and the left knee straightening.

The dancer opens the right arm and folds it again. The left hand travels right, then both hands lower while the right arm continues its inward reach. Both arms lengthen as the left hand sweeps left and down and the right hand follows left. The right hand returns right while the left arm tucks and releases downward, then the hands separate sideways before reversing their directions and rising together into bent elbows. The right arm opens right as the left arm curls farther in, then drops toward the left.

The right hand rises, then both hands descend while the left arm curls inward. The right hand moves right as the left arm opens downward and left, while the left knee straightens; both hands lift with folded elbows before the right hand drops and the left hand sweeps left. Both arms lengthen, the right hand continuing down-right, then the left hand reaches up-right and back left as the right elbow folds. The hands separate horizontally, the right hand moving right while the left hand lowers and tucks into a tighter bend. The left hand climbs left with its arm opening and returns right as the right arm extends farther left.

As the right knee straightens, the dancer lowers both hands and extends the left arm leftward. The right hand above the straightened right knee curls upward, then sweeps right as the right leg lengthens farther; the left hand continues left before returning right. The left arm folds down-left while the right hand rises, then lifts and opens toward the right as the left hand drops and both arms curl inward. Both hands descend and spread left and right, the right hand reversing right as the left hand returns left and the right arm extends upward. The right arm tucks into a rise, then opens again.

A rising, folding arm exchange begins with the dancer lifting the right hand as the left hand rises right and the right knee softens. The left hand drops left while the right arm curls up-left and both knees bend further, then the left arm opens downward. Both arms lengthen as their hands separate left and right, the knee beneath the left-moving hand straightening before the right arm folds back down-right and the right knee sinks again. The arms extend farther apart, the rightward hand dropping as the right knee releases and the left hand sweeps left; the lower arm tucks in while the right hand returns right over a bending knee. The tucked left arm lifts right and unfolds, followed by the right arm curling upward and reaching left as the bent knee straightens.

The right hand travels right and curls upward as the left knee softens, then both arms lengthen downward while the left knee straightens. The left hand reaches right with a deeper tuck, while the right arm folds up and left, the left knee bending and releasing before both hands sweep right and the elbows open. The right hand drops through a leftward reach, then reverses right and rises into another curl as the left hand moves left; both knees soften while the right elbow extends farther. The left knee straightens as the right arm releases down and right, and both legs lengthen again beneath a rising leftward reach of the left hand. The left knee bends as the right arm opens downward, then straightens while both hands climb, the right hand moving right before reversing left as the left knee bends and the right arm curls upward.

The right knee straightens as the dancer sends the right hand right and the left hand left, then lowers both hands with folded elbows while the left knee softens. Both hands sweep left and rise into a tighter curl as the left knee extends and the right knee bends, before the right arm opens down to the right and the left hand climbs. The right arm folds upward while the left arm lengthens down to the left; both hands descend and separate, the left hand rising again as the right arm extends. The left hand reverses right and drops, accompanied by a bend of the right knee, then curls back up to the left as the right arm tucks and the left knee sinks farther. Both arms open downward, then the right hand sweeps right and rises as the right knee straightens.

The right knee softens as the dancer folds both arms and lowers the hands, then straightens the right leg while the left hand moves right. The left hand continues right as the right arm extends left and drops, followed by the left hand's descent; both hands sweep right, the left one rising before the right curls up-left. Both hands reverse left and down with lengthening arms, then return right and rise into folded elbows. The hands sweep left again and descend as their arms open, then separate right and left with a renewed tuck of the right arm. Both hands lift and reverse sideways as the right arm reaches farther out and the right knee bends, then the right hand returns right and both lower with an extension of the right leg.

The arms rise together. The right hand curls left and down as the right knee straightens, while the left arm folds right; the right hand then opens right over a softening right knee before curling up again as the right leg extends. The left hand reaches right with an opening elbow, then both hands drop, the right hand moving left as the left hand returns right and the right knee lengthens farther. Both hands sweep left and descend, the right arm tucking before reopening, then both lift as the left knee bends and releases; the right hand reverses right while the left hand continues right and rises. The right arm folds downward as the right knee softens, while both hands swing left and the left arm lengthens down before curling back right. The left hand drops and opens as the right knee bends further, then moves left and lifts into a tighter fold while the left knee straightens and the right arm extends downward.

The right knee straightens as the dancer folds both arms and lowers the hands, sending them right and left in succession before raising them with the elbows opening. The left hand reverses right while the right arm curls upward to the left, then extends downward as the left arm lengthens; the right knee bends as the right hand drops and returns right, followed by a fold and lift of the right arm as the knee straightens. Both knees soften as the hands rise and the right arm reaches right, then the knees extend while the left hand moves right and both lower with bent elbows. The knees sink again beneath another lift of both hands, the right hand traveling left as the right knee straightens, before the hands descend and separate sideways. The right arm folds down-left as the right knee releases, while the left arm opens upward and the left knee bends and straightens; the lowered hand sweeps right and back left as its elbow tucks, and the right knee softens.

As the right hand reaches right and the left hand moves left, the dancer curls the right arm upward while the left knee straightens and the right elbow opens. The hands reverse sideways as the right arm extends down, then both lift with bent elbows before the left knee softens beneath a shared leftward sweep. The left knee straightens as the right hand climbs and the left arm curls up to the right, followed by the right arm's bend and an extension of the left arm. The left arm folds as the left knee bends and releases, then lowers and lengthens while the right hand descends; the left hand sweeps left and back right, ending with both arms tucked.

As the right arm folds inward, the dancer lowers and extends the right hand left while the left hand drops right. The right arm opens farther left as the right knee bends, then both arms curl upward; the left knee softens before both hands sweep down and right, the right elbow opening while the left knee straightens and bends again. Both arms gather into rising folds, the left hand moving right as the left knee lengthens and the right hand continues right with a deeper tuck. The left knee releases while the right hand dips, rises and returns left into another fold; the right hand reverses right and curls up as the left hand drops and opens. The right knee bends while the left arm lifts and extends, followed by the right arm reaching right as the right leg straightens.

The dancer raises both hands. The right arm curls left and upward while the left arm extends down, then the right hand returns right as the left knee bends and straightens and the left hand climbs farther left. The right hand drops into a fold while the left hand moves right, and the right arm tucks as the left knee releases; both hands reverse left and climb, the right hand curling more tightly before reaching back right. Both knees soften as the left hand lowers and the right hand continues right, then the left knee straightens while the left hand rises right and the right arm opens downward. The left arm folds down-left and lengthens again as the right hand reaches right, with the left knee extending once more. The left hand continues down-left while the right arm curls upward.

The right knee straightens as the dancer sends the left hand left and lowers it while the right hand travels right. The hands reverse inward, the descending left arm curling upward before both sweep left; the right hand follows up-left and folds, then returns down-right as the right knee softens. The right knee releases beneath a rising, tucking left hand that moves left, while the right arm curls upward and swings right. The left hand climbs farther as the right hand continues right, then the raised left hand drops left into an extension. Both knees bend in succession beneath another rightward reach of the left hand, followed by the right hand's lift and descent as the right knee straightens.

As the right hand moves right, the dancer lengthens both arms, raises the left arm toward the left and drops the right arm into a fold while the right knee straightens. The left arm opens, then curls upward as the right knee bends; the hands sweep left before the left arm tucks down and releases back to the right. The left hand continues right with a deeper fold as the right knee softens further, then both hands lower and sweep left, the right arm extending before folding again. The knees trade bend and release twice in succession while the hands rise, the left arm opening as the right arm reaches left and lifts, followed by the left hand moving left. Both hands descend and sweep right, the right elbow curling inward as the left knee bends.

The dancer sends the right hand right. The right arm curls upward and left, then both hands descend while the left arm folds as the right knee straightens. The right hand sweeps down-right while the left arm opens and lifts, then drops left as the right elbow releases and both knees soften. The hands separate sideways and rise as the knees lengthen, then the left hand swings right while the right hand moves left. Both arms curl downward, the left hand returning left and the right hand continuing left before reversing right as the left knee bends again.

To begin, the dancer lifts both hands with bent elbows, then lowers them and extends the right arm leftward as the right knee straightens. The left hand sweeps right while the right elbow folds, and both hands rise before the right arm lengthens downward to the right and the left arm curls left. Both hands descend as the knees soften in succession, then the arms open and sweep left together before curling upward. The left arm tucks farther while the right hand drops right, then rises again as both elbows gather inward. The hands continue climbing, the right arm extending farther upward before both lower into a deeper fold.

The dancer sends the left hand left and the right hand right, both arms lengthening before the right arm folds down and back left. Both hands rise with the right arm opening, then sweep right as the left arm curls upward and the left knee bends; both hands descend, the left arm tucking further while the right knee sinks and straightens. The left arm opens through a low reach right and lifts again as the right arm extends downward and the right knee softens, followed by another bend and release of the right knee. The right arm curls up and reaches right while the left arm lengthens down-left, then both hands drop and separate left and right as their elbows unfold. The left hand rises into a fold while the right hand continues left and drops, ending with both arms extending and the right knee bending.

The dancer moves leftward, extending the left arm while lowering and opening the right arm. Both hands sweep right; the left hand drops as the left knee softens. The right knee bends farther while the left hand rises left and curls back right, then lowers with a deeper fold as the right hand climbs. Both knees straighten in succession as the hands descend, the left arm reaching down-left while the right arm folds upward. The hands reverse sideways and rise together, then sweep right and lower with the elbows drawing inward. A left-to-right exchange brings the left hand up-left and the right hand down-right, followed by a shared lift and a drop as both arms lengthen. The left hand returns right while the right hand travels left, then they separate again and the right hand rises as the left arm extends left and drops. Both hands move left before reversing right.

The right knee straightens beneath the rising left hand that moves left, while the right arm folds down and right as the right knee softens. The raised left hand curls higher, swings right and drops into an open reach, then returns left and rises again. The left arm tucks through another leftward sweep before both hands descend and separate sideways, with the right arm lengthening downward. Both arms unfold as the knees bend in succession, then the lower left hand continues down and left while the right hand rises.

The right knee straightens as the dancer lowers and extends the right arm left, then curls it upward while the left hand moves right and its elbow opens. The raised right arm folds farther up-left and releases downward before both hands reverse left and rise, the left arm lengthening as the right knee softens. Both elbows tuck as the left knee bends deeper and its hand drops right, then that arm reaches up-left against the right arm's rightward curl. The knees exchange their bend and straighten in succession while the arms separate left and right; the right arm rises with a tucked elbow as the left arm opens, then returns left and down as the left knee bends. The right arm curls higher while the left arm lengthens downward, and the bent right knee straightens again as the higher hand descends.

At the outset, the dancer lowers the right hand and lengthens both arms before raising the right hand and curling it left, then sending it right with an opening elbow as the left hand rises. The hands exchange directions, the right hand moving left and higher while the left hand reaches up-left, before both return right; the left arm folds and drops, followed by the right arm. The right hand climbs and returns left as the right knee softens, then reverses right and down while the left hand curls upward; the right arm tucks through a left-right sweep and the right knee straightens as both hands rise. The left hand continues left and extends down while the right hand moves right and opens, then they reverse sideways and climb together into bent elbows. Both hands descend as the arms unfold, then the left hand swings right and lifts with a tighter curl while the right hand follows right and rises.

The left hand dips left and reverses right while the right hand lifts and lowers. The left arm curls upward, then the right hand rises while the left hand drops. The left hand extends left and rises again. The left hand swings right and down with a lengthening elbow, then returns left and climbs into a fold, while the right arm reaches right and opens downward. Both hands sweep left, the right hand descending with an extending elbow, then both hands reverse right as the right arm curls upward and both hands rise. The right hand continues right and folds downward while the left arm curls farther up and right.

The dancer lowers both hands. The right hand sweeps right and folds back left, then rises as the left knee bends; the right arm opens while the left arm reaches up-right and both knees straighten. The left hand drops as the left knee softens and the right arm curls upward, then the right hand lifts while the left knee lengthens. Both arms tuck inward as the right knee bends again and the left arm releases down-left, then both hands sweep right with another bend of the right knee before the left arm curls upward and the left knee straightens. The left knee sinks once more as the left hand lowers and extends right, then both knees release while the right arm lengthens downward and the right arm folds back up. The right hand moves left and rises as the left arm opens down-left, followed by a lift of the left hand and a bend of the left knee.

As the right arm folds and the left arm lengthens, the dancer lifts both hands, carrying them rightward with the right arm curling more deeply before both descend. The arms open into a leftward sweep, then rise together as the right hand curls farther in and the right knee softens; the left hand drops and returns right while the right hand lowers. Both arms extend downward, then sweep left as the left knee bends and straightens; the left hand lifts and tucks inward while the right hand reaches right. The left hand swings right and back left as the left arm opens, then rises into another fold while the right hand sweeps right and down. The left arm releases as the right hand continues right, then reverses left with an elbow bend and a lift of the right hand; finally, the right hand moves right as the left arm lengthens.

The right arm moves right and down while the left arm rises. Then the right arm lengthens farther down as the left hand drops. The left arm reaches left before both hands lift, with the right arm folding inward and the right knee straightening. The right arm carries its hand right as the left knee softens, then both knees bend deeper while the left hand continues right and the right arm tucks further.
