Both hands rise, the right arm opening into a leftward sweep as the right knee extends, while the left elbow draws inward. The right hand lowers and reverses right, both arms lengthen, and the left hand drops farther before returning left as the left knee straightens.

The arms join in a shared rightward sweep. The dancer folds the right elbow as the left knee softens and the left hand drops. The left knee straightens before the right arm opens and the right knee bends. The left hand curls upward and left while the right arm lengthens right. Then both hands descend; the left hand continues left and extends before reversing right as the right knee releases. Both knees bend again and the hands rise with tucked elbows as the right knee straightens. They lower into another shared rightward reach. The left elbow opens as the left knee sinks and the right knee extends. The right arm curls up and left, then lowers with an opening elbow while the left arm folds down and left. Both hands move right and the right hand rises through another curl. The hands separate right and left as the left arm tightens and the right arm lengthens. Then they reverse directions with the left hand lifting left while the right hand descends. The left knee straightens beneath a deeper fold of the left arm, which then extends left as the right hand continues downward.

The right hand drops and curls as the dancer lowers the left hand, then lifts the right hand with a deeper fold while the left arm opens left. The right arm lengthens down-right as the left hand returns right; both rise, the right elbow tucking before both hands sweep left and descend. The right arm reverses right while the left opens downward, then reaches farther down-right as the left arm folds left and rises. Both hands lift, the right hand moving right while the left hand returns left and curls higher. The right hand climbs with an extending elbow as the left hand drops, then sweeps left and down while the left hand moves right.

The dancer begins an alternating arm figure by extending the right arm right, folding and releasing it downward before reaching up again. While the right arm raises, the left hand drops, the right arm tucks, and the right knee softens. Then, both hands move left, the right arm lengthens, and the left knee bends. Both knees straighten in succession as the right hand lowers. Then the left hand lifts and curls inward while the right arm extends farther down. The left arm opens left and down as the right arm folds upward, then the left arm returns right and rises into a tighter bend while the right hand descends and sweeps left. The left hand continues upward and left before lowering into a longer reach, ending with both arms extended and the knees softened.

The right hand sweeps left as the left knee straightens, then both hands lower and reverse sideways while the left arm curls. The right arm extends down while the left arm tucks farther right, followed by a bend of the left knee and another downward reach. Both hands rise, the left hand continuing upward and left while the right hand folds and the left knee bends; the left arm lengthens before the hands descend together. The right hand returns left and curls upward against the left hand's rightward lift, then both lower as the left knee softens further and the left elbow opens. Both arms fold again as the knees straighten in succession, with the left hand moving left and both hands rising.

The arms work in opposition: the right arm lengthens upward while the left arm curls down-left, then the right hand sweeps right and drops as the left arm opens. The left hand continues left before both hands rise, the right hand moving left as the left arm folds downward, then extends down-right. The right hand reverses left and rises into a curl while the left hand reaches right and lifts, both elbows folding as their hands climb. The right hand drops and sweeps right while the left hand lowers and opens; both arms then tuck as the right hand lifts and the left hand moves left, followed by the right hand reversing left and extending. Both hands descend as the left arm lengthens, then the right arm folds and carries its hand right while the left elbow draws inward.

A leftward hand sweep begins the phrase: the left arm reaches down and left while the right arm curls up and right, then both arms fold as the left hand rises. The hands separate sideways, the left hand continuing left before curling upward against the right hand's descending rightward reach, which opens as the lifted left hand reverses right. Both arms lengthen through another shared leftward sweep, then the right hand climbs while the left arm tucks and drops. The rising right hand sweeps left and lowers as the tucked left arm extends, and the right hand moves right while that same left hand swings left and back right. The dancer finishes with a curl of the right arm and an extension of the swinging left arm.

In unison, the dancer lowers and lengthens both arms as the right knee straightens, then raises both hands with folding elbows. The left hand travels left while the right arm opens down-left; the left knee bends and its hand rises right into a curl before returning left as that leg extends and the right knee softens. Both knees bend and release in succession while the hands sweep left and rise, the right arm drawing inward. The hands reverse right, the left hand lowering as its knee sinks and straightens again, then the right hand lifts into a fold while the lower hand drops left. The right hand continues left and up as the left arm tucks and climbs right, ending with a deeper extension of the right knee and another upward reach of the left hand.

The right knee straightens as the dancer lowers and extends the right arm, then bends the right arm while the left hand sweeps right and drops; the right knee lengthens again as the hands separate left and right and both arms curl upward. The right hand returns down-left as the right knee softens and the left arm opens, then reverses up-right while the right knee straightens and the left arm folds downward. Both knees bend in succession beneath a rightward sweep of the right hand and a leftward reach of the left hand, then the left hand rises and curls back right as both knees extend. The right arm folds right while the left elbow tucks further; the right hand lowers as the right knee bends, then both hands descend with the right arm opening before lifting together as the knees straighten. The hands separate sideways and lower into extended arms, the right hand returning left before both rise with bent elbows. They sweep right and drop again as both knees soften, then the right hand rebounds up-left while the left arm unfolds and the left knee straightens.

As the left hand drops left, the dancer lifts the right hand rightward and curls it inward while the left arm folds. The left hand sweeps down-left and opens as the right hand rises right with a deeper tuck, then both hands sweep left before reversing right; the left arm lengthens downward while the right arm folds up-left and the right knee bends. Both arms curl upward again as the right knee straightens and the left leg softens, then the left hand returns left with an extension while the right hand drops and opens. The left arm gathers into a rising leftward reach over a bending knee, then the right hand follows left and down-right with a curling lift before both descend as the knees straighten. Both hands rebound upward, the right arm folding while the left opens, then the right arm reverses right as the right knee bends and the left hand moves right over a bent knee. The left hand dips left while the right hand continues right and lowers, then both rise as the right elbow draws in and the left knee extends.

A rising rightward arm sweep begins with the right knee bending, the right hand climbing left and then right while the left hand curls upward; both knees soften before the hands reverse left. The left arm extends down as the right arm folds and the right knee straightens, then the left hand climbs right into a tuck while the right knee bends again. Both arms lengthen downward as the right knee releases, the right hand drifting right before curling up-left over another bend of the right knee. The left hand reaches up-right and returns left as the right hand rises, then drops and extends farther left while the left arm folds higher and opens right. That final reach lifts and tucks again as the right knee bends and releases beneath a descending leftward sweep, ending with the left arm extending down and left.

An alternating arm sweep begins with the dancer opening the right arm right and lowering it, then curling it up and left as the left knee bends and the left hand reaches right. The right hand reverses right while the left leg straightens, then both hands descend and move left before the right arm opens and lifts again. The right hand swings down-right and back left as the left hand travels right and rises, then the right arm lengthens higher while the left arm folds and lowers. Both knees soften in succession as the left hand sweeps left and climbs into a tuck, followed by another bend of the right knee and a rise of the right hand. The arms draw inward together, the right hand moving right as the left knee releases, then the left hand descends into an extension while the right knee bends again.

The right hand sweeps right and down while the left hand rises left, then both hands descend with bent elbows. The left hand curls upward again as the right hand extends left, then folds down toward the right before both hands lift; the left hand drops and returns left as the right knee bends and releases. The left arm tucks higher while the right elbow opens and closes, the right hand climbing as the left hand swings right and back left with a tighter fold. The right arm reaches right and down as the right knee straightens, then both arms lengthen into opposing lateral movements, the left hand moving left and the right hand moving right. Both hands rise and the elbows curl as the knees bend and release together.

The right hand rises into a curl while the left hand drops and extends. Then the right knee straightens as both arms fold and the right hand moves right. The hands descend and lengthen before lifting apart, the right arm opening farther as the right knee softens; the left arm folds leftward, then both arms rise again as the right knee straightens and the right elbow tightens. The hands lower with the right arm extending while the left knee bends, then the right hand climbs into a tuck as the right leg straightens and the left hand reaches down and left. Both knees bend as the hands separate sideways, then the knees extend in succession while the right hand curls upward and the left hand rises with a deeper bend. The right arm opens downward through a renewed knee bend and release, while the left hand sweeps right, lowers and extends as the left knee straightens.

An alternating arm sweep begins with the right hand moving right while the left hand lowers and extends left, then both hands rise as the left arm curls and the left knee bends. The right arm reaches farther right and lengthens downward while the left arm lifts, opens and falls; the right knee softens before the hands reverse sideways and the right knee straightens. The right hand drops into a leftward reach as the right knee bends again and both arms fold, then both elbows open while the right hand sweeps up-right and the left hand moves down-left. Both knees straighten in succession as the right arm curls upward and the left arm folds further left, followed by the left knee bending beneath another rising extension of the right arm. The right knee bends as the right arm tucks down-right and the left hand moves up-left, then straightens while the right arm unfolds left and the left elbow releases. The right leg lengthens through a final downward curl of the right arm and a bend and release of the left knee, while the left hand continues left.

To begin, the dancer folds both arms toward the right as the right knee softens and straightens, then lowers the hands with a deepening bend of the right knee. The right arm opens into a rising leftward sweep while the left hand moves right; the right elbow tucks, the left arm curls upward, and the knees exchange their bend-and-straighten pulse twice before the left hand reverses right. The right arm continues climbing while the left arm extends downward, and the right hand moves left through a fold and release. Both hands rise with lengthening elbows as the right knee bends, and the right hand reaches farther right before curling back left over another right knee bend and release. The left hand lifts right as the right elbow folds and the right hand drops, then both arms open downward while the right knee bends again.

A leftward arm sweep accompanies a rightward knee bend and release: the dancer sends the left hand left as the right knee softens, then curls the left arm upward while the right hand rises right; both hands reverse outward before the left arm drops and extends as the right hand returns down-left. The left arm folds into another rightward lift while the right knee bends and straightens, followed by a leftward reach that lengthens as the right arm tucks. Both arms curl inward, the right hand lowering right before returning left as the left hand climbs right and opens, then descends with the right knee bending. The left arm gathers left and releases downward while the right hand continues rising right and tucks, accompanied by another bend of the left knee and a return of the right hand left. The left arm extends farther left and dips as the left knee softens again, then both knees straighten while the right arm reaches right and the left hand lifts with an extending elbow.

The right knee bends and releases as the dancer lowers the right hand into a leftward curl, then carries both hands right with the left arm folding before opening. The right hand rises into another tuck while the left knee straightens and the left hand drops; the right hand continues up-left as the right knee lengthens and the left hand lifts right. Both arms reach upward, the right hand moving right, then both elbows draw in as the left hand returns left and the knees bend and release together. The right arm curls higher and reaches down-right, joined by the left hand moving right as the right knee softens again. The right knee straightens beneath a rising leftward sweep of the right arm, which then opens downward while the left hand climbs farther left, and both arms lengthen into opposing directions.

The right arm lifts left and the left arm rises right, then the right arm folds down and both hands sweep left. The left knee straightens while the left arm curls up-left and lowers farther left; the right hand reaches up-right and back down-left as the left leg lengthens further. Both knees soften in succession beneath another lift of the left arm, whose hand drops left before curling upward again, while the right hand rises right and reverses left. The left arm opens downward as the right knee bends more deeply, then both hands rise with a tighter fold on the left side before their paths reverse sideways and the left knee sinks further. The left arm tucks farther and descends as both knees bend deeper, while the right hand moves right and lowers.

The right hand drops and sweeps right. The dancer raises the left hand while the right arm folds, then extends the left hand as the right knee straightens and the right hand reverses left. The left arm reaches down to the right as the right elbow opens, then curls upward and returns left while the right hand continues down to the left. Both arms lengthen and separate horizontally before the hands rise, the right arm folding through a rightward lift and leftward return. The right arm opens downward and moves right as the left hand climbs farther right, ending with both hands rising in succession.

The right knee straightens as the dancer lifts and extends the left arm leftward while the right hand climbs right, then both hands rise before the arms fold and sweep left. The left hand drops through an opening-and-closing elbow action as the right knee bends and releases, then curls upward while the right hand reaches down and right with a lengthening arm. Both hands descend and reverse inward, the left hand folding again as the right knee softens; the left hand rises and opens while the right hand tucks left, followed by a release of the bent right knee and another lift of the left hand. The right hand lowers as the right knee straightens, then both sweep right and climb with folded elbows before the left arm opens downward. The right arm curls up and down twice, then the left hand lifts through a deeper bend and release of the right knee, followed by the right arm rising and extending. The left arm lengthens as both hands lower, ending with the right hand moving left.

A repeated lateral exchange begins as the dancer sends the right hand left and lowers it into a fold while the left arm lengthens downward, then reverses right with both hands climbing. The hands separate left and right again, then descend as the right knee softens; the left arm curls upward while the right hand sweeps right and drops. Both arms open and lower, the left hand moving left before curling up and returning right as the left knee straightens and the right arm folds. The left arm reaches down and left while the right arm lifts right and tucks, then the right hand rises as the left arm sweeps down and left. Both hands climb, the right arm extending right while the left arm opens downward.

A shared leftward sweep opens the phrase: the left arm folds and lengthens as both hands descend, then they separate right and left with the right arm curling upward. The left hand climbs right while the raised right arm lowers toward the left, followed by another leftward lift from the left arm. That lifted left hand swings right and back left as the right arm rises and reaches farther left; both descend before the right arm curls upward again. Both hands move right, the right arm opening and the left arm folding into a final drop.

At the outset, the right hand reaches right and curls upward as the right knee straightens, then both knees soften in succession. The left arm extends left while the right hand drops into a tighter fold, then lifts again as the left knee bends deeper. The right hand continues right with an opening elbow as the right leg releases, then returns left and down while the left arm folds and carries the left hand leftward. The left hand rises, curls right and tucks further as the right knee lengthens and the right hand descends; the right knee bends and straightens before the arms separate, the right arm lowering as the right knee softens again. The left hand sweeps left while the right knee extends, and the right hand continues left before rising into a reach.

The dancer folds the right arm upward. The right hand drops left as the left knee softens and the right elbow tucks, then both hands rise with the left arm lengthening before they descend toward the right. The knees straighten in succession as the right hand curls up-left and the left hand lowers into a bend; both arms unfold and the left knee softens while the left hand rises and swings right. Both elbows fold as the right knee bends and straightens and the left hand moves left, then the right knee releases while the right hand lowers and reaches right. The left arm opens and lifts, followed by the right hand rising and curling inward.

The dancer straightens the right knee as the left hand lowers and lengthens, then sweeps both hands left with the left arm folding while the right hand rises. The left arm releases downward and opens right as the right knee softens; the right knee bends again while the right hand curls up-right against a drop of the left hand. Both knees sink beneath another curling lift of the right hand, followed by a deeper bend of the left knee and an extension of the raised arm as the left knee straightens. The right hand drops into a fold as the right knee bends further, then reverses left while the left hand lifts and curls right, the left knee extending before the right hand continues upward. Both hands rise, the left arm drawing inward as the left knee straightens, then the right hand moves right while the right knee extends and the left knee bends again.

At the outset, the dancer curls the right arm upward and extends it left as the right knee bends, then lowers the right hand while the left arm reaches right and down. The right leg straightens beneath a rising left hand that folds farther left before both hands descend and the left arm opens right. The right knee softens again as the right arm lengthens right and lifts, joined by the left hand; both elbows tuck, the right arm drops, and the knees exchange bend and release. The right hand rises right and opens as the left hand lowers and extends, with the right knee repeatedly bending and straightening. The right arm curls up and down while the left hand sweeps left and back right into a fold, then the right hand rises through an opening and renewed curl as the left hand continues right. The right knee bends while the left arm lowers, then straightens as the right hand returns left and drops; the left elbow opens and re-curls as the right knee sinks further.

A paired arm lift begins with the dancer bending the right knee and lifting both hands, then straightening the right leg as the left hand reaches right. The right hand drops left while the left arm folds down, followed by a descent of the right hand and a tuck of the right elbow. Both hands sweep right as the right knee bends again, then rise before the hands return left with lengthening arms. The right arm curls upward while the left hand lowers into a fold, then the raised right hand drops left and the right knee softens further. Both hands reverse right, the right arm rising with a tighter elbow as the left arm opens downward, then the knees straighten in succession while the left hand returns left.

The right knee straightens as the dancer folds the right arm and carries the right hand left, then lengthens the right arm while both hands descend and separate sideways. The left arm curls upward before both hands rise with elbows tightening; the right hand sweeps right and down into a deeper fold while the left hand reaches farther right. Both arms open downward, then the left arm tucks and carries its descending hand right as the right knee bends and releases. The hands move apart again, the right elbow drawing in before the left hand climbs left into another curl; both arms lengthen downward and sweep right as the left knee softens. The left arm reaches up and left while the right hand lifts right and drops back left, then both hands lower, the right hand moving right as the knees straighten in succession. The right arm curls upward to the right as the left knee bends, then extends left over a straightening knee and returns right while the left knee deepens.

To begin, the dancer lowers and folds the right arm while the left hand sweeps left and rises. The right hand reverses right as the right arm opens, then both hands descend and the left arm curls upward to the left. The right hand continues right with a lengthening elbow before both arms tuck and lift into another leftward reach of the left hand. The left hand returns right as the right hand moves left and down, and both arms extend downward, ending with the left hand shifting left.

As the right arm folds, the dancer lowers both hands and sends them right, then opens the right arm into a leftward lift while the left elbow draws in. Both arms lengthen as the hands descend and separate sideways, the right hand moving right and the left hand moving left; the right hand rises with another curl before both hands sweep back toward their original directions and lower again. The left arm reaches down-right as its knee straightens, then both hands rise and reverse outward, folding inward and dropping together before extending farther apart. The right hand lifts right as the left hand climbs left, both elbows tucking while the knees soften, then the right hand reverses left and drops as the left hand rises farther right. The left hand descends left and curls upward while the right hand continues left, then the right arm extends down-right and sweeps left before both hands climb and the right hand reaches right.

The right hand moves right. The left arm folds left, then opens as the right hand reverses left and rises into a curl; the left arm follows left and upward with its elbow tucking, while the right arm returns right and lowers. The right arm lengthens and sweeps up-right, joined by the left hand rising right, before both elbows fold. Both hands descend toward the left, the right arm extending then folding again as the left arm opens, before they reverse right and climb. The left hand dips and rebounds upward while the right arm continues right, then both descend and the right arm curls left. The left elbow tucks and both hands rise, the right arm continuing left and higher as it lengthens; the left hand drops, then lifts into another fold before sweeping right.

At the opening, the dancer raises and folds the right arm while the left hand moves right and lowers with a bent elbow; the raised right hand drops as both arms tuck, then the hands separate left and right before reversing inward. Both arms lengthen downward and sweep outward again, then curl upward as the right knee straightens, followed by another outward reach and shared descent. The right knee softens beneath the left hand that rises into a fold, while the right hand reaches right and down, then curls upward as the right knee straightens and the left hand lifts right. The right knee bends again as the right hand descends and opens, then both hands move right while the left arm curls upward and the left knee extends. The left arm unfolds left, dips and lifts back right as the right knee straightens; both hands descend and the left hand travels left.

As the right knee straightens, the dancer curls both arms upward and carries both hands left, then opens both hands. The right hand drops into a fold while the left hand continues left and down, before both knees soften and the right hand returns right with an unfolding arm. The right hand rises as the right knee extends, while the left knee lengthens and the left hand lifts left; the left hand continues up-left, then drops into another curl. The left hand sweeps right and down as the right knee bends and releases beneath a shared leftward reach, followed by the right knee's softening and the left knee straightening as the hands reverse apart. The left hand lowers and reaches right while the right hand folds higher to the left, then both hands move left as the left knee bends and the right arm tucks. The right hand reverses right and rises while the left elbow opens, the right knee extending before bending again and the right hand lifting.

The right knee straightens as the dancer lowers and lengthens both arms, then the right hand lifts into a curl while the left hand reaches left. The right arm opens down to the right as the left knee bends and the left arm folds downward, followed by a bend in the right knee. Both knees straighten while the left hand rises and both arms tuck; the left hand sweeps left as the right knee softens again. The hands separate right and left before the right arm curls upward and shifts left over another deepening bend of the right knee, then drops as the left arm extends down. Both hands rise with folded elbows, then sweep left as the knees soften and release together, ending with the right arm reaching farther up-left and the left hand descending right.

The right hand sweeps left and down. The left arm folds downward as the right hand reverses right, then both climb with the left elbow opening. The hands separate left and right while the right knee bends and straightens; the left hand rises and moves left against a further descent of the right hand. The right knee softens again as the right hand lifts left and the left hand curls upward, then extends left before the left knee bends and releases beneath a descending reach. The right hand swings right and returns left as the left knee sinks deeper and the left hand rises.

To begin, the dancer lowers and extends the right arm while the left arm folds left, then reverses the right hand right as the right knee straightens and the left arm reaches down and left. The hands reverse their lateral paths, with the right arm curling upward while the left arm lengthens; both descend, the right arm continuing left and folding before lifting again. The right hand sweeps right into a deepening tuck as the left arm curls up and right, then returns left through an opening and closing of the elbow while the left arm extends downward. The raised right hand dips left and rises into another fold, then moves right and drops as the left knee softens and the left hand curls back left. The knees exchange bends and releases beneath a final lift and drop of the right arm, which then opens and rises once more.

The right hand rises rightward and curls inward while the left knee softens. Then both hands lower and separate left and right while the left knee straightens. The right arm curls upward against a rightward sweep of the left hand, then the right hand drops left as the left knee bends again and the right elbow opens. Both knees extend before the hands reverse sideways and descend. The right arm folds up-right while the left hand reaches down-left and the left knee lengthens further. Then the right arm returns up-left into a tuck as the left hand rises right and the left knee beneath the right arm bends. Both elbows draw inward and the hands rise, the left hand moving left while the left knee straightens. The right arm releases downward as the right knee softens and the right hand sweeps down-right. The right knee extends while the right hand moves right and both elbows fold. Then the left hand climbs left and opens as the left knee lengthens further. The right hand continues right and rises into a tighter curl while the left knee bends and the left hand descends.

To begin, the dancer lowers the left hand leftward and lengthens the left arm while the right hand reaches right. Both hands rise as the right arm folds, then descend with a deeper curl on the right side. The left hand swings right and back left while the right hand continues down-right, followed by another lift of the left hand as both arms extend. The left arm tucks, sweeps right and returns left, joined by the right hand as it curls inward. The left elbow releases into a longer reach while the right arm opens farther right.

The right knee softens as the dancer lifts both hands leftward, folding the right arm while the left arm opens and the left knee straightens. The right arm releases downward alongside the left hand, then curls back up as the left knee bends again and the right knee extends. Both hands sweep right with the right arm drawing inward and the left elbow tucking; they reverse left and descend, the right arm opening before curling upward and sweeping right as the right knee lengthens. The left hand continues down and right with a deeper bend of the left knee, then rises into a fold while the right hand lowers and extends farther right. Both hands climb, the left arm opening and the right arm folding through a leftward reversal and another rise.

The right knee bends and releases as the dancer curls the right arm up toward the right, while the left hand rises left. The right arm drops as the left elbow opens, then both hands sweep right with the right arm lengthening and the right knee straightening; the left hand lifts and both return left before the left hand lowers and the arms fold. The right arm extends down and right while the left arm tucks upward, then both open and rise before curling inward, the left hand moving right and dropping as the right arm reaches right and both elbows release. Both hands sweep left and descend, the right arm extending farther before reversing right and folding while the left arm curls up and right. The left hand returns down and left, then both arms lengthen and sweep right. The right arm folds as its hand dips and rebounds upward, while the left arm continues reaching right.

The dancer sends the right hand left. The left arm reaches up and right as the right knee softens, then both hands descend with the right arm extending left while the left knee straightens. Both arms curl upward and sweep right, the left hand dropping as the left knee bends; the right hand reverses left into a deeper fold before both arms open downward. The right hand rises again while the left arm tucks left, then drops and returns right as the left knee extends and the right elbow releases. The right arm lengthens down-left, then folds as both hands move right and the right knee straightens, finishing with an upward curl of the left arm.

As the right arm folds and the left hand moves right, the dancer lowers both hands into a leftward sweep. The right arm lengthens while the right knee softens, then curls upward as the left hand reverses right; the knees trade bend and release before the curled right arm opens down and right. The left hand sweeps up-left with another fold as the right knee straightens, then drops into an extension while the right arm reaches right and upward. Both arms tuck as the hands rise, the right hand continuing right while the left hand shifts left, then both lower and open as their knees straighten in succession. The right hand rebounds up-left and the left arm folds farther left as the right knee bends, then both hands descend and separate right and left before the right knee releases.

Both hands move right. The dancer folds the right arm as the right knee straightens and the left hand lowers. The right arm opens while the left hand swings left, then returns right as both knees soften and the left elbow tucks; the right arm curls upward to finish. The hands reverse in opposite directions, the left hand dropping left and the right hand rising right before reversing left as the right knee bends. Both arms lengthen downward as the right knee straightens, then the hands sweep right, the left arm curling upward while the right hand returns left. The left arm continues climbing leftward as the right knee bends, then releases and sweeps down toward the right while the right leg straightens.

The right hand sweeps left and down as the dancer lengthens both arms, then the right arm folds while the left arm reaches right. The right arm opens and curls again as the right hand rises and the left hand drops, before the right hand lowers with a further release of the elbow. Both hands sweep right and climb into bent arms, then the right arm unfolds and reverses left while the left arm continues upward, tucking farther. The left hand moves right and drops through an open elbow as the right hand returns right and up; the left arm extends higher before both hands descend and the elbows fold inward. The right hand lifts left and opens while the left hand rises and lengthens, ending with the right hand continuing left and climbing.

The dancer sweeps the left hand leftward while curling the right arm upward and right, then extends both arms as the right hand climbs higher. The left hand continues left and rises with a tucked elbow before opening downward and sweeping right, while the right knee bends; the hands reverse inward and the right hand lifts again. Both knees soften as the left hand moves left and the right hand curls up-right, then the hands descend with extended arms and the left knee straightens. The left knee bends again beneath another leftward sweep of the left hand and a rising curl on the right side, then releases as both hands climb and the right knee lengthens; the hands exchange sideways directions and descend together. Both arms fold through a shared leftward reach, then open as the left knee bends and the left hand returns right; the right hand dips and rebounds upward while the left arm curls and lifts left, followed by the right arm reaching left and down as the right knee bends. The hands rise toward the right, the left arm folding and returning left before extending farther left as the right arm opens and the right knee straightens; the left hand lowers while the right hand climbs, then they separate right and left with both elbows tucked.

The dancer begins an alternating arm lift by folding the left arm and extending the right arm, then carries both hands left while the left arm opens. The right hand lowers, curls upward to the right, and releases down-right as the left hand climbs right and the right knee bends; the right arm tucks again before both hands sweep left and the left hand rises with a further extension of the right knee. Both arms fold into another shared rightward sweep, the left arm opening as the right hand drops, then reversing left with both hands lifting and the right elbow bending. The left arm lengthens downward as the right arm continues left, then returns right against the right arm's leftward curl and release; the left hand drops while the right arm opens and sweeps up-left. The right arm folds back right as the left elbow bends, followed by an opening rightward reach of the left arm and a renewed inward tuck.

The arms move in opposition: the left hand drops left while the right hand sweeps right and down, then the left hand rises as the right arm folds upward. Both hands descend with lengthening elbows, the left hand reversing left before both lift again, the right hand continuing up-right as its elbow opens. The left arm extends farther left while the right elbow tucks; the left hand rises into a curl as the right hand lowers and reaches right. Both hands fall, the left arm opening left and folding back up-right as the right hand lifts left. The right elbow curls inward while the left hand continues right and climbs, then the left arm reaches farther outward and up.

A rising arm weave begins with the right hand lifting and curling right as the left hand reaches left, then both hands descend with opening elbows while the right knee straightens. The hands sweep left, the left arm folding before both lift and lengthen, the right hand continuing left. Both arms tuck into a descending rightward reach that softens both knees, then reverse left as the left elbow opens; the right knee bends farther and releases while the left hand continues down-right and the left knee straightens again. The right hand curls up-left against the left hand's upward-left reach, then folds back right as the left knee sinks and both hands lower with the right arm opening. The hands separate right and left, the left hand dropping while the right hand lifts with an extending elbow and reverses right. The right hand returns left as the left hand descends, then rises farther left with a tighter fold before both arms open.

The right hand lifts left while the left hand rises right and curls, then both arms descend and lengthen before reversing sideways. The right arm folds upward as the left arm extends left and lowers, then both arms sweep right with the right arm opening. Both arms curl upward, the left hand continuing right while the right hand moves left and opens; the left hand releases downward as the right hand tucks again and drops. The left hand rises left with a bend, then returns down-right while the right hand curls up and reaches right. The left arm folds higher as the right arm extends left, then opens down-left and gathers upward again, followed by a further lift of the right hand.

The right knee straightens as the left hand drops and both hands sweep left, with the right knee softening before both arms curl upward. The right hand returns right while the left arm opens downward; the right arm extends down and folds again as the left hand rises. Both hands lift with bent elbows, then the right hand drops left and lengthens while the left lowers right. The left hand reverses left and curls up alongside the right hand's upward reach, then swings right as the right knee bends and the left hand moves right and down. The right knee releases while the left leg bends farther, and both hands drop before the right hand sweeps left and the left rises rightward as the right knee straightens.

The right knee straightens as the dancer folds both arms, lifts and extends them left, then opens the left arm downward while the right knee softens and the right hand curls up-right. The hands trade height with the right elbow folding and the left elbow opening, then both elbows tuck as the right hand moves right and drops; the left arm releases down-left as the left knee bends and the right knee sinks further. Both knees lengthen as the hands rise and separate left and right, the left hand curling upward before the hands descend with the right arm reaching out. The right hand swings left and back right while the left hand continues right and rises, followed by a lift of the right hand; both knees bend and release as the left arm folds down-left and the right arm opens left. The left hand sweeps right and rises into an extension while the right hand lowers and the right arm lengthens, ending with the left knee straightening.

A lifting arm exchange begins as the dancer curls the right hand upward, then sweeps both hands right and down while the right arm opens, before raising both arms into folds. The left knee bends and straightens beneath a leftward curling lift, followed by another bend of the left knee as the right arm tucks higher and both hands descend. The left knee lengthens again while the left arm reaches up and left with an opening elbow; the left knee softens once more as the right hand curls upward and both arms fold. The left hand rises right with an extension, then drops left and curls back up as the right arm opens and lowers. Both hands sweep left with tucked elbows, then separate as the right hand lifts right and the left hand moves right and up.

The arms work in opposition: the right arm folds downward and right as the left arm extends left, then the right hand rises while the left arm curls upward. The right arm opens farther right and drops as the left arm reaches down-left, before both arms lengthen and the left hand sweeps up-right. Both hands descend, the left hand continuing right with an opening elbow, then rise as the right arm tucks and moves left; the right arm releases while the left arm curls again and carries its hand right. The right hand lifts as the left knee straightens and the left arm opens downward, then both elbows fold while the right hand lowers and the left arm swings left. The right elbow opens as the left hand returns right, followed by a curl on the right side and another reach from the left, which then bends while the right arm lifts.

The right knee softens as the dancer sends the left hand left and lowers it with a lengthening arm, then extends the right arm leftward while the left knee straightens. The left arm folds upward and right as the right hand rises and reverses right, both elbows drawing in before the left arm opens down and right and the right arm tucks lower. Both hands sweep left, the left hand curling up while the right hand reaches farther downward; the left hand then drops and stretches out as the right elbow releases. The right hand curls up-right while the left hand moves right and both knees soften, then the right arm opens down-left as the left knee straightens and the right knee bends further. That lowered hand rises into a fold while the opposite arm extends and lifts, followed by the other hand rising right and both arms lengthening.

At the outset, the dancer folds the left arm leftward while the right hand rises rightward, then reverses both hands and lengthens the arms as the left knee bends. The left knee straightens as the left arm curls upward and moves right, followed by the right knee softening and the right arm reaching up-right. The left hand sweeps down-left and rises with a fold, while the right elbow tucks, both hands descend, and the right hand sweeps left before both lift into extension. Both elbows draw in again as the left hand travels right and the right hand follows left, then the left knee bends and releases while the left arm opens downward and the right knee sinks further; the hands sweep left and rise as the right knee straightens. The right hand returns right and drops with an extended arm while the left hand lowers leftward, then the right arm curls upward as the left knee softens and the left hand lifts right.

The arms move apart and up, the right hand traveling right while the left hand goes left. The right arm reaches farther right and curls back left as the left knee straightens, then both hands descend with the left arm folding. Both knees soften as the hands sweep right, the right elbow opening before the right knee straightens and the left arm lengthens downward. The left knee bends again beneath a rising leftward reach, while the right hand moves right and both elbows fold; the raised hand then lowers as the right knee extends. The lower hand shifts left and rises into a curl while the left arm opens, and both hands climb with another bend in the right knee.

To begin, the dancer folds the right arm as the right hand moves left and the left arm lifts right, then lowers both hands. The right arm opens as the right hand rises, followed by the left hand lifting left and curling inward. The left arm releases down while the right knee straightens, then the right hand climbs into a deeper tuck before both descend and the right hand returns right. The right arm lengthens upward while the left arm extends right, dips, and curls back up toward the left. Both arms fold as the hands rise, then sweep left together.

The right hand sweeps left and down, followed by the left hand, before both climb into folded elbows. The left arm opens as the right lowers farther, then both hands move right. Both elbows tuck while the left hand rises, then the right follows upward. The left hand swings left and drops into a release as the right lifts and lengthens its arm; both hands return right before the left climbs again. The right hand descends as the left continues rising and sweeping left.

The dancer lowers the right hand. The left arm extends down and left as the left knee bends, then both hands rise with the left hand moving right while the left leg straightens. The right hand sweeps left and down before returning right as the right knee softens, while the left hand drops into an extended reach to the left; the right hand rises again as the right leg lengthens and the left knee bends. Both arms fold as the right hand moves left, then the left arm opens downward and the right hand reverses right while the left arm curls upward. The right hand returns left and down into a tuck, followed by the left hand dropping left as the left knee bends and the right knee straightens. The right knee releases farther while the left leg sinks deeper, the left hand continuing left and down, and the right arm reaches farther right before both knees soften.

The dancer straightens the right knee. The left hand sweeps left and down, then curls upward as the right hand rises and folds; both knees bend in succession while the left arm reaches farther left and the right knee releases. Both arms open downward, then curl upward as the right knee softens again and the left hand moves right. The right knee extends before bending once more beneath a descending rightward reach of the left arm, while the right arm lengthens up and left and the left knee straightens. The hands separate horizontally with the left arm folding, then the left hand reverses left as the right arm tucks upward; the left knee bends and straightens while the left arm opens, and the right elbow releases. The right hand returns left and drops into a fold as the left knee softens and the right knee straightens, then the right knee bends again while the left arm extends left and lifts.

The right hand sweeps right and rises. The dancer lowers the left hand left as the right arm folds, then both arms lengthen and descend before the left hand returns right and curls upward while the right arm tucks into a rising leftward sweep. Both hands climb with the right arm continuing left, then the left hand swings right and back left as the right elbow releases and the hands separate again, the left hand moving right and the right hand moving left. The right hand drops as its arm folds, while the left hand reaches down-left; the right arm opens through another lift and fall, then extends farther downward. The left hand rises left with an unfolding elbow as the right hand moves right, then both hands sweep left and the left hand drops.

The right hand sweeps left and down. The left hand curls upward, then drops while the right arm folds upward and returns right. Both hands descend as the right elbow opens, followed by a lift of both arms with the left hand curling inward. The hands lower again, the right hand reaching left before reversing right as the right knee softens. The right arm lengthens downward and moves left while the left arm tucks into a rising lift, ending with both hands higher.

A repeated lateral figure begins with both hands moving right; the right arm folds while the left arm extends and lowers. The right arm reaches left as the left arm returns right, then the right arm reverses back toward the right with an opening elbow. The right arm curls upward again and sweeps left before extending down. Both hands continue left; the left arm folds and lifts once more while the right hand drops.

At the outset, the dancer folds the right arm while the left hand moves right and both knees soften. The right arm extends left as the right knee straightens, then rises and curls back right while the left hand sweeps left and down into a fold; the left knee bends again before both hands drop and the right arm opens right. Both arms tuck as the left knee lengthens, then sweep left with the right elbow drawing in farther, before the hands rise and separate sideways and the left knee releases. The hands descend into an opening reach, reverse their directions, and climb together as the left knee sinks again; the right arm curls upward to the right while the left draws inward and lifts. The hands reverse apart once more, the right arm extending left and then curling up and right as the right knee bends, while the left lowers left and lengthens before returning right. Both hands lift, the right elbow folding and reopening as the left knee softens and straightens beneath its descending arm, which then tucks.

The dancer sends the right hand right and down as the left knee bends, then carries the right hand left into a fold while the left arm lengthens upward. The right arm opens downward and both hands sweep right before the left hand drops and returns left. The left hand curls up toward the right, with the right knee softening, then lowers while the right hand rises and the left knee straightens. Both hands move left as the right knee bends again, then the left arm tucks downward and both elbows release. The right hand lifts right against the left hand's continued descent.

The right hand sweeps left and down, curls upward, then drops farther left as the left arm folds; both rise with the left arm curling tighter before they separate sideways, the right hand moving right. The right arm extends down while the left arm gathers upward to the left and the left knee softens, then both hands descend as the left knee straightens and the arms open. Both knees bend beneath a shared rightward sweep, the left arm folding as the right hand rises and the knees release in succession. The left hand reaches up and left while the right hand lowers, then reverses right and curls downward as the right knee bends and the left knee straightens. The right hand sweeps left into an extension as the right knee releases, followed by a rise of the left hand while the right hand moves right and back left.

The right knee softens as the dancer lowers and folds both arms, carrying the left hand left while the right knee straightens. The left arm lengthens downward as the left knee bends and releases; the lower hand moves right with a deeper tuck before rising as the bent knee opens again. Both hands sweep left and descend, then reverse right, the right arm curling upward while the left arm extends downward. The lifted hand continues up and right with a tighter fold before reversing left, joined by the other hand moving left. Both knees bend in succession beneath a shared leftward sweep, then release as the initially raised arm curls farther and the opposite hand rises.

As the right hand moves right, the dancer straightens the left knee and sends the left hand left, then reverses both hands outward before both rise. The right arm folds inward and drops as the right knee bends; both hands sweep left, the left elbow opening before both arms curl upward. The knees alternate softening and straightening while the hands separate sideways, with the right hand returning left. Both hands climb again as the knees continue to exchange bend and extension, then the hands drop and separate once more, the left arm folding through a brief lift and descent while the right arm lengthens downward. The right hand swings right and back left, then rises into a curl as the left knee bends and releases; it repeats its sideways sweep twice more, alternating open-and-folded pulses while the left knee softens and straightens again.

As the right arm folds and the left knee softens, the dancer sends both hands right, then lowers them into a curling rise with the left hand moving left. The right knee bends further while the left leg straightens; the hands reverse left as the right leg releases and the right arm tucks more deeply. The right leg lengthens again beneath a descending fold of the left arm, whose hand continues left before both arms open and the left hand returns right. Both hands sweep left with the left arm extending, then reverse right as the right arm opens and both elbows bend; the left hand rises while the right hand drops. The left hand sweeps left and climbs, followed by the right hand lifting leftward into a tighter fold, and both descend as the right knee bends.

The right knee softens as the dancer lowers and lengthens both arms, then extends the right hand right while the left hand curls upward. Both hands rise with folded elbows and sweep left, the right arm opening before both lower and tuck again. The right hand rises left and opens into a rightward lift, then returns left and down as the right knee straightens; the left hand travels right and curls upward while the bent knee sinks farther. The right arm folds higher and shifts right as the right knee releases, then both hands descend with the left elbow opening. The hands reverse sideways, the right hand lifting through an extension before both drop, then rise together as the left knee bends and the right arm gathers inward. The left hand continues right with a curling fold, and both knees soften in succession.

The dancer lowers and lengthens the right arm as the left hand sweeps left, then opens both arms and raises the hands in succession. The right hand reverses right and drops while the left hand curls upward; they trade height twice, with the left arm tucking farther as its hand moves left and the right arm folds. The left hand continues left before both lower and open, then the left hand returns right and curls upward as the right hand rises left. Both hands descend again, the right hand moving right while the left hand tucks and lifts, before the right arm extends down and left into a shared reversal of direction. The left arm opens downward as the right hand sweeps right and both rise, then the left arm curls leftward while the right hand continues right.

At the outset, the dancer extends the right arm left and lowers it while the left hand moves right, then folds the right arm upward as the right knee bends. The left hand rises and both sweep left before the left arm opens downward; the right arm tucks farther left and lifts while the right knee straightens and the left hand rebounds up-right. Both hands descend with lengthening elbows, the right hand moving right as the right knee softens and the left arm curls upward, then the right hand reverses left while the left arm reaches farther right. The left knee bends as the hands separate left and right, then the left arm unfolds downward and both knees sink before the hands rise and the left elbow folds. The hands continue separating sideways, the right hand dropping as the right knee deepens, then both climb and reverse their lateral paths into bent arms. The right hand returns right and down while the left hand travels left, finishing with both arms extending.

To begin, the dancer curls the right arm upward and right while lowering the left hand left; both hands move left as the raised right elbow opens. The left arm gathers inward while the right knee bends, then both hands reverse right, the right arm extending downward as the right knee straightens. The right leg lengthens further as the left hand sweeps down-left and back right with a folded elbow, then the left arm tucks left and rises before opening right. The right hand moves left as the left knee softens, while the right arm reaches up-left and the left arm extends down-right; the left arm folds left and returns right, accompanied by another bend of the left knee. The right arm curls higher to the left as the left arm lengthens upward, then the left knee releases and the hands trade height, ending with the right hand lifting farther left and the right knee bending again.

The right hand sweeps left and rises. The dancer softens the left knee, then folds both arms as the left knee straightens; the right hand returns right while the left hand drops leftward and curls inward. Both hands lower with extended elbows before the right arm tucks right, then reverses up-left as the left knee bends and the left arm opens. The left knee lengthens as the hands separate left and right and climb, the left arm folding before it reaches right and down against the continuing leftward sweep of the right hand. The right hand continues left and curls upward as the left hand lowers, then both descend, the left arm opening rightward while the right elbow releases.

At the outset, the dancer curls the right arm upward while the left hand drops and the right knee softens. The right hand returns down and left as the left arm lengthens rightward, then both hands sweep right and rise with folding elbows before reversing left together. Both arms extend downward and separate sideways, the right hand moving right and the left hand moving left, then curl up toward each other as the knees straighten in succession. The hands reverse again, the left arm opening rightward while the right arm folds farther, and both descend before the right hand swings right and both lift with bent elbows. The right hand moves left as the left arm dips rightward and rises into a longer reach, followed by another leftward descent of the right hand and an extension of the right arm.

The knees soften in succession as the dancer lifts the left hand leftward and lowers the right hand, then straightens both legs while the right hand rises and the left arm extends right. The hands reverse sideways, the right arm curling up-left while the left hand drops left, before the right arm opens downward and the left arm folds right and down. Both hands rise with lengthening elbows, then sweep left as the left knee bends and releases; the right knee softens while the right hand curls upward and rebounds higher. The left hand continues left and rises with a bent elbow as the right knee straightens, then the hands separate left and right before descending together, the left arm opening as the left knee bends again. The hands climb back toward each other, the left hand moving right and the right hand moving left, then descend with the left arm extending farther.

The dancer lengthens the right arm downward. The left hand follows down and right as the right arm rises and folds, then both sweep left with the left elbow curling before the right hand drops and the right knee softens. Both hands climb as the right knee straightens and the left elbow opens, then they reverse sideways with the right arm tucking and descending while the left curls upward. The left hand dips right and rises again, joined by the right hand moving up and left; the right hand then lowers and extends right as the left continues upward and right. The right hand reverses left and down while the left arm curls higher and moves left, then both hands rise and separate left and right as their elbows open.

As the right hand moves right and down, the dancer lifts the left hand leftward and curls it in, then reverses both hands left with the lower arm lengthening before folding again. The rising left hand continues upward and right while the right knee straightens, then drops as the right knee bends and the right hand returns right and climbs. The descending right hand sweeps left and down into a deeper fold while the left arm extends, then both sweep right as the right hand rises; the left knee softens and the left arm tucks inward. The tucked left hand dips and rises again while the right arm opens downward and the bent right knee releases, followed by another curl of the raised left hand. Both hands lower, the left arm lengthening as the right knee bends and straightens again, while the curled left hand continues down and right.

As the right hand rises, both arms curl and the left hand moves right; the hands climb farther before the right arm opens downward. The left hand reverses left as the left knee straightens, then both hands lower and sweep left, with the right arm lengthening and the left arm folding. Both hands rise and separate into a rightward and leftward motion, the right elbow tucked as the left arm opens, before the right hand dips and rebounds upward while the left hand continues left and down. The left arm curls up and right as the right hand reaches left and lowers, then both descend, the right arm extending left while the left arm folds further. The right hand lifts through a curl and release and returns left as the left elbow tucks and the left hand drops.

The right knee bends as the dancer curls the right hand up and left, then releases it down while the left hand rises and tucks. The right hand moves right as both arms lengthen downward, with the left knee softening; the hands sweep left and rise into bent elbows before the right hand returns right. The right knee straightens as the left arm extends upward and the right hand dips, then opens farther right and lifts again while the left knee bends and releases. The left hand reaches down and right as the right hand continues right and curls in, the left knee sinking further while the right arm folds upward and the hands reverse sideways. Both knees soften as the left elbow tightens and the left hand drops, then both legs extend while the right knee bends once more and the hands sweep right, the right arm curling upward. The right hand returns left as the left knee straightens and the left arm opens downward, followed by the right arm extending down and right.

At the outset, the right knee softens as the left hand rises and the right hand drops, then the right knee straightens while the right arm curls upward. The left arm folds down-left as the left knee bends and releases, while the right hand sweeps right and back left with an opening elbow. Both hands climb before the right arm tucks and lowers rightward over a deeper bend of the right knee, while the left arm reaches up-left and both knees lengthen. The right hand lifts right and drops as the right knee sinks again; the left hand lowers and returns right, followed by another dip and lift of the right hand over a renewed right knee bend. The left hand continues right and rises as the left knee releases, then the right arm extends down-right and curls upward while the left arm opens.

In unison, the dancer raises both hands and carries them right, then lowers the right hand before lifting it again. The left hand continues right with a deeper curl as the left knee bends, while the right arm folds farther and lowers into an opening reach. The left arm extends downward as the right hand sweeps left, then curls upward while the right knee straightens; the left knee softens in response to that rise and release. Both knees bend further as the right arm reaches up-left, then releases down-right against the left arm's upward curl. The right hand reverses left while the left hand sweeps right and drops, both arms opening as the knees lengthen.

The dancer begins with the right hand rising as the right arm curls inward, while the left hand lifts leftward and extends. The right knee softens as the hands descend and the right knee straightens; the left knee bends as the right arm opens down and right and the left arm folds upward. Both knees release and the elbows tuck in as the left hand rises farther left, then the knees bend again while the right hand sweeps left. The hands lower as the right knee extends, followed by the left knee straightening; both arms lengthen before the right hand moves right. The left arm reaches down and right as the right hand lifts and drops, then reverses left while the left hand returns right.

At the outset, the dancer lowers the right hand while the left hand curls upward and left, then extends right as both hands rise and the right arm opens left. The left hand drops with a folding elbow as the right hand lifts left and returns right, before both descend and lengthen into a shared leftward sweep. Both arms tuck as the left hand rises, then the right hand climbs farther while the left knee softens and the left arm opens downward; the raised left hand continues up-right as the bent leg straightens. The left arm curls higher to the left while the right arm reaches down-left and folds, then both lift, the right arm opening right as the left elbow tightens further. That tighter left arm reaches right and down, followed by the right hand dropping right, before the lower left arm draws back left and upward as the right knee bends. The right arm curls upward and right while the left hand falls and the bending knee releases, then the raised right arm extends down-left as the left knee sinks again and the lowered left hand moves right.

The right hand rises and sweeps left while the left hand climbs right, then both lower with the left arm lengthening. The hands reverse sideways, the left lifting while the right curls upward and moves right, then the left drops and its knee softens as both arms fold and the left hand rises again. Both knees bend and straighten in succession while the left arm extends downward; the right hand reaches down-right as the left knee bends again and the left lifts left. That knee straightens beneath a curling rise of the left hand, then both hands descend with the left elbow opening and both knees bending. The right hand swings left and back right as its knee releases, while the left rises into a tighter fold; the knees alternate bending and straightening before the left knee softens and its arm opens downward. The left hand sweeps left as the right knee straightens, then returns right while the other knee bends and its arm tucks upward.

The right knee bends as the left arm folds and lowers left, then both hands sweep right with the left arm reaching open. The right leg straightens while the right arm curls upward, and the left hand lifts into a fold before dropping as the right knee softens again. The right arm reaches down-left, then extends up-right as the left hand moves left and rises; the hands trade sideways directions twice more, both lowering and tucking inward before the left hand opens. Both knees bend as the left hand returns left and drops, joined by the right hand moving left; the right arm curls up-right while the left arm extends downward, and the knees release in succession. The left arm folds back right as the right arm lengthens down-left, and both knees soften before the right hand reaches farther right and the right knee straightens.

The right hand rises and curls rightward while the left arm lengthens; the right hand returns left as both knees straighten, then both arms fold and lower. The hands reverse outward, the right hand lifting with a tighter tuck and the left hand curling upward and leftward before both descend. Both elbows open and the hands sweep right as the right knee bends, then the right hand reverses left while the left hand lifts leftward with a deeper fold. The left hand drops left and the right knee softens again before both arms extend and the right knee straightens. Both hands climb and separate, the right hand moving right and the left hand continuing left, then descend together into a shared leftward sweep.

The arms move in succession: the right hand sweeps left and down as the right knee straightens, while the left hand rises right; both hands reverse inward, then descend with the left arm lengthening. The right knee softens as the right hand returns right and curls upward, followed by the left hand rising into a fold and shifting right before lowering again. Both arms open downward, then the right arm reaches up-right and folds as the right knee bends further, while the left hand swings left and back right. The left hand climbs left with an extending elbow as the right hand moves right and lowers; the left knee straightens before the raised hand drops, both arms unfold, and the left hand reverses right as the right knee softens. The right arm curls upward as the left hand continues right and the left knee straightens, then the hands separate sideways and descend with both elbows opening, the right hand returning left. The left hand rises into a tuck and shifts left as the right arm extends, then the tucked hand dips and rises again while the right hand sweeps right and curls inward.

The right knee straightens as the dancer lifts and folds the right arm while the left hand rises, then lowers both hands into a deeper fold. The left knee bends as the left hand drops farther left and curls upward; the right knee softens beneath the rising left arm before the knees exchange bend and release. The left knee lengthens as both arms unfold and the hands sweep right, then the right hand returns left with an opening elbow and a straightening knee. The right hand continues left as the left knee bends and releases again, the left arm extending and lifting while the right hand drops. The left arm tucks and lowers alongside the descending right hand, then sweeps right and opens as the left knee bends and the right leg extends further.

The arms trade height: the right hand rises as the right knee straightens, then the left hand climbs while the right knee bends and both hands move right. The right arm extends down as the left hand reverses left, then both knees soften while the hands lift in opposite directions and the left arm curls inward. Both hands fall, the right hand reaching right as the left knee bends farther; the left arm folds, then both sweep left and descend before the right hand returns right with a lengthening elbow. The knees straighten in succession as the hands reverse left, the left arm opening into another shared rightward reach. The right hand lifts again and moves left while the left knee softens and the left arm tucks toward the right.

The dancer lowers the left hand leftward. The right arm reaches right and down, then folds back left as the left hand reverses right and rises; both hands climb before the right arm opens downward toward the right. The right knee softens as the right arm lengthens up-left, followed by a bend in the right knee while the left hand curls upward and moves left. Both knees straighten as the left arm extends and the right knee bends again, then the right arm tucks right and down while the left arm gathers upward. The left hand reaches right as the right knee bends and the right arm opens down-left, then the hands separate left and right with the right arm folding and lifting into an extension. The left knee sinks while the left hand curls up-right, and the right hand rises farther left as the right knee releases and the right arm lengthens.

As the right hand moves left, the dancer folds that arm and lowers both hands. The left hand rises into a curl while the right hand continues left and down, then both elbows open as the hands separate left and right. The right hand lifts with its arm lengthening before descending as both hands return left and the left elbow folds; the right hand reverses right and curls upward against the left hand's rightward sweep. Both arms extend downward and spread apart, then rise with bent elbows, the left hand moving left as the right arm tucks farther. That tucked arm sweeps left and drops, followed by the left hand lowering as both elbows open.

The dancer lengthens the right arm. The left hand rises as both knees soften, then the right hand swings left and back right while the left knee bends deeper; the left hand drops into an extended reach as the left leg straightens. Both hands climb with folded elbows as the right knee continues to extend, then descend, the right elbow opening before both arms curl upward again. The right hand dips and rises into a tighter fold as the left knee lengthens, then lowers and opens while the left hand climbs left and the left knee bends. The right arm tucks up-right as the left leg straightens and the left arm reaches down-left, then both hands rise with a deeper fold on the right side and a return of the left leg's bend. The hands sweep left together, then the right arm opens downward while the left arm curls higher and swings right.

The right hand sweeps left and down. The left arm extends as the right arm folds, then reaches farther left while the right knee softens; both hands descend, the left hand returning right and up. The right knee straightens as the left arm curls upward and sweeps left, then opens into a descent while the right arm lengthens downward and the right knee bends again. The right arm tucks and rises, followed by the left hand lifting as the right knee releases, with both arms extending before the left hand drops. The left hand reverses right and climbs as the left knee bends and the right knee straightens, then both hands rise and separate sideways.

The right hand drops and extends left, joined by the left hand moving left; both rise as the arms curl and the right arm opens farther. The hands separate right and left before the right arm folds down-right, then sweeps back left and lifts into a tuck. Both hands sweep right with lengthening arms, the left arm curling upward as its knee softens, before the right hand descends and returns left while the left hand reaches right. The left hand continues right as the right arm curls up-left, followed by another lift of the left hand that moves left. The right hand lowers and extends left while the left arm folds, then both hands rise and move right, the left arm opening as the right elbow bends. The hands climb farther and separate left and right, the right arm reaching out as the left hand reverses left.

As the right hand sweeps left, the dancer curls the left arm upward and right while the right hand rises and the right knee straightens. The left arm continues climbing into a deeper fold as the right hand lowers, then both hands shift right with the left arm descending and the right arm lengthening downward. The right hand returns left and climbs into a tuck while the left arm extends down and right; the right hand drops before both arms open, the left hand reversing left and rising through an extension and curl. The left arm lifts farther right as the right elbow folds, then the left hand dips and rebounds while the right arm curls upward and moves right. Both hands descend as the right arm unfolds, then the right hand rises again with the right arm lengthening before it reverses left.

At the outset, the dancer extends the left arm left and up while the right hand rises right; both elbows fold as the left hand drops. The hands exchange directions and descend, with the right arm lengthening downward. Both arms curl upward again, then separate left and right before opening down, followed by a renewed tuck as the left arm lifts left and the right arm reaches up to the right. The right hand climbs farther while the left hand continues right and drops, then reverses left and rises into a fold as the left arm extends up-right. Both hands sweep left and descend, the right elbow opening while the left arm curls upward, before the left hand returns right.

The right knee softens as the dancer lowers and lengthens both arms, then lifts the right hand while the left hand curls upward. The hands trade height twice: the left arm extends down and folds back up as the right hand drops and opens, then the hands reverse their rise and fall with the left arm opening and the right elbow drawing in. Both knees bend as the right hand sweeps left and curls upward, followed by a rightward extension of the left hand. The left knee sinks farther beneath another rightward reach and curl, then the left knee bends again as the left hand returns left; the right hand rises right while the left hand lowers and the right knee straightens. The left hand continues left and rises as the left knee deepens its bend, while the right hand moves right and the right knee releases.

The arms trade height and reach: the right hand moves right as the left hand lifts left, then the left arm folds while the right hand drops left. Both hands sweep right, with the right arm curling upward before the left arm opens up and left. The right hand reverses left and descends into a longer reach as the left knee straightens, then both arms tuck and lift toward the right while the left knee bends again. The right hand dips and rises again as the left knee softens and straightens once more, accompanied by a brief extension of the left arm. The right knee continues to bend as the left hand lowers and the right arm lengthens downward, ending with the left knee releasing.

The dancer lifts and folds the right arm. The right knee softens as the left hand rises left and curls inward, then both hands descend while the right arm reaches right and the right knee straightens. The right arm tucks as the left lengthens downward, and both sweep left before the left arm opens upward again. The right arm curls up-left as the right knee bends and the left hand lowers, then extends down-right; the right knee straightens as both hands return left and rise, the left arm folding inward. Both arms open and lower, the left hand sweeping right while the right continues left.

A leftward arm sweep begins as the left knee straightens and the right hand lifts left, followed by the left hand moving left; both hands rise with bent elbows before the hands separate right and left.
