The left arm reaches up-right while the right arm extends downward, then both arms curl upward and sweep left before lowering and opening into another shared rightward reach. Both knees soften in succession as the hands return left and the arms fold down, then the left elbow opens and the left knee straightens while the right hand rises. The left hand curls higher to the right as the right knee bends and releases beneath a leftward arm extension that folds and rebounds, then both hands descend and lengthen. The right knee sinks again while the left hand sweeps left and climbs into a bend, then lowers as the right hand rises right and the right knee releases. The left knee bends while the right knee straightens further, and the left arm tucks higher to the left before both hands drop with the right elbow drawing inward.

Both hands descend. The right arm folds before the left arm reaches right and curls upward as the right knee straightens. The left hand returns left into an opening reach while the right elbow tucks, then both hands lower and sweep right with extending elbows. The dancer folds the right arm as the right knee softens, lifts the right hand leftward, and repeats a right knee bend and release while the left arm lengthens downward. Both arms gather inward as the hands rise and move left, then the right arm drops into an extension while the left arm curls higher. The right hand swings right and rebounds up-left into another fold as the left arm opens down-right.

A rising-and-falling arm exchange begins as the dancer lifts the left hand left while the right arm folds and lowers, then both hands descend. The left arm opens right as the right knee softens, then curls upward to the right before dropping into an extension. Both arms gather inward as the right hand rises, then sweep left and release, with the left hand continuing downward. The knees bend in succession beneath another shared leftward reach, then the right knee straightens and the right arm lengthens down. The right hand rebounds upward into a fold while the left hand lowers and the left knee softens; the raised right hand sweeps right and descends as the left knee straightens. The right arm tucks farther and drops, and the left hand rises into a curl.

The right knee softens after the dancer sends the left hand left and down while the right hand reaches right and rises, then the right knee straightens as both arms fold inward. The hands separate left and right before reversing their lateral directions, with the left hand opening downward and the right hand curling higher; the left hand sweeps left and returns right as the right hand extends down and left. Both hands drop and rebound upward in a shared reach, then descend again, the left hand sweeping left before both reverse right as the left hand climbs and the right knee bends. The left arm opens left and folds back right while the right elbow tucks, then both hands rise with the left arm lengthening farther. Both knees bend as the right hand lowers and its arm extends, then the bent knees straighten and soften together while the right hand curls upward and moves left. The left hand lifts right into an extension as the right knee straightens, then both arms gather inward while the right hand drops.

An alternating arm sweep begins with both hands moving left as the dancer lowers them, then the right arm opens into a shared rightward return while the left arm curls upward. The right hand climbs farther and returns left as the left elbow tucks, then the right arm extends right while the left hand lifts and folds in. Both arms draw inward as the left hand drops; the right hand reaches down and right before curling back up and left. The left arm lengthens down and left as the right hand rises and shifts right, then the right hand descends and continues left while the left arm folds upward.

To begin, the dancer folds the right arm and lowers the right hand left, then sends both hands right with the right arm opening. The left hand returns left and curls upward as the right arm extends downward, then reverses left and rises into a tighter fold. Both arms lengthen down and right, the left hand returning left as the right hand curls up; the left hand continues left while the right arm reaches farther down and right. The right hand swings right and returns left into an upward lift, while the left arm opens and drops, then lifts through a bend and release. The left arm curls back down and left before extending right as the right hand climbs and tucks; the right hand moves left while the left arm draws inward.

Upward and right, the dancer carries the right hand while the left hand moves left, then lowers both hands as the right knee softens. The right arm curls up-right while the left arm rises and folds; the right knee straightens as both hands descend and the left hand continues right. Both arms tuck and lift, the right hand sweeping left before returning right against the left hand's leftward sweep. The left hand reverses right and drops as the right hand lowers and extends, then returns left while the left arm folds down-right. The left arm lengthens farther down-left as the right knee bends and the right hand climbs right.

In opposition, the dancer curls the right arm upward as the left arm folds down and left, then lifts both hands with lengthening arms. The right hand drops right while the left arm opens and lowers, followed by a leftward extension of the right elbow. Both hands rise before the right hand returns right and folds downward, joined by the left arm curling inward and moving left. The left hand sweeps left, rises with an opening elbow, and returns right into a tight fold as the right arm tucks farther.

The right knee softens as the dancer raises and folds both arms, then straightens the right knee while the left arm reaches right and drops; the right hand moves left and rises into a curl as the left hand returns left. Both hands descend with opening elbows, the right hand sweeping right and lifting again as the left arm lengthens down and left. The hands climb together, the right arm folding while the left hand continues left, before the right arm lowers and extends right over another bend of the right knee. The right hand lifts right as the left hand rises left, then sweeps left and down as the knees straighten in succession and the left arm tucks. The right hand returns right while the left arm opens downward, then both hands descend, the right hand continuing right and extending as the left arm curls upward.

As the right arm curls up and right, the dancer sends the left hand left and down with a bent elbow before both hands lower. The right hand reverses left while the left hand reaches right and rises, then the hands separate again, the right hand moving right as the left hand folds downward. Both arms lengthen into another descent, then curl upward as the right hand sweeps left and returns right. The elbows open to lower the hands once more, with the right arm folding before extending through a lift; both hands then reverse sideways, the right hand reaching left and the left hand right. The right arm tucks as its hand drops, while the left hand moves left and down, followed by a lowered rightward sweep of the right hand.

The right hand dips left and rises. Both arms lengthen as the left hand moves right, then the left arm folds upward while the right hand lowers and curls inward. The right hand sweeps down-left and opens into a shared climb, followed by the left arm extending higher before both descend, the right arm folding as the left arm continues down-right. The right hand lifts with a longer reach while the left hand tucks, then the hands separate sideways as the right hand drops and extends; both arms curl upward, the right arm returning left before opening downward. The left arm reaches up-right and folds back toward the left, joined by the right hand moving right and rising as it tucks, while the left hand climbs farther left.

The right knee softens as the dancer curls the right arm upward, then extends it left and lowers both hands while the left elbow folds. The right arm reaches right and rises as the left hand lifts and the left knee straightens; the right arm tucks while the left arm opens down and left. Both arms lengthen, the left hand moving left as the right knee bends and releases beneath another fold of the left arm. The right knee bends again while the left leg straightens and the hands reverse sideways, then both knees soften before the hands sweep back together. The left knee straightens as the left arm folds and the right arm extends up and right, then the left arm opens down and right while the right hand drops. The left arm curls upward to the left as the right hand sweeps right, and the right hand returns up and left while the left hand continues right.

The right arm curls upward and reaches right while the left hand moves left, then both hands sweep down and reverse sideways, with the left elbow folding before the left hand lifts. The hands exchange height again, the right arm extending while the left tucks and sweeps right, then drops into an opening reach. Both hands descend and separate laterally, the left curling upward as the right lengthens farther down; they trade height once more, the left hand dropping into a fold. The left hand rebounds up and opens before lowering and sweeping left, joined by the right hand in a shared descent that ends with the right hand moving right. Both arms gather inward and rise, the right hand continuing right as the left knee straightens; the hands then separate sideways, the right returning left and the left right, before both lower.

In unison, the dancer folds and lifts both arms, then sends the right hand right as the right knee bends and releases; the left hand lowers while the folded right arm extends down-left. The left hand rises and sweeps left as the right arm curls upward, then returns right and drops into a deeper fold. Both hands climb before separating left and right, with the left arm lengthening and the right hand descending through an extension and bend. The right bent elbow opens again as the right knee straightens and softens, while the left knee bends and the left arm tucks; the hands separate again, the left hand rising left and the right hand lowering right. The right hand reverses left as the right knee beneath it bends further and the left knee releases, then the left hand travels right and descends into a fold while the right hand continues left.

To begin, the dancer raises the right hand while the left arm folds left and the right hand sweeps right. Both hands descend as the left arm extends, then they reverse sideways with the left arm lengthening; the right hand lifts left into a curl while the left hand drops right. The right hand lowers and opens left as the left hand rises, then both sweep right and fold inward before lifting apart. The right arm releases upward to the left while the left arm curls down and left, then returns right and rises into an extension as the left elbow opens. The right knee bends as the right arm folds down, followed by the left knee softening beneath a lowering reach left; the right arm then lengthens down and right while the left hand lifts.

The dancer sends the right hand left. The left arm curls upward, then the right hand rises and folds as the right knee bends and straightens; the left hand drops before both sweep right with the right elbow opening and the left arm lengthening. Both arms tuck as the hands descend, then the right lifts into an extension while the left curls up and opens, both hands moving left. The hands lower and rise again, the right continuing left and folding as the left reaches right; they reverse sideways and separate farther apart, then descend together with the right arm opening. The left hand moves left as the right curls up and right, then the left rises and both sweep right, the right extending downward and the left curling upward. With the right knee bending, the hands return left, the right arm folding higher before opening back down.

A rising, separating hand phrase begins with the right arm extending right and the left arm reaching left, then both hands descend before the right hand curls up to the left. The left arm tucks as the left knee bends, and both hands rise with the right elbow opening while the right knee straightens; the right hand sweeps right and down into a fold as the left hand lifts and lengthens over another left knee bend. Both hands reverse inward as the left knee releases, the left arm curling downward and left while the right hand lowers with a deeper tuck. The right hand returns right and rises, then drops farther as the left hand reaches left and down, followed by a renewed lift of the right hand. The left elbow folds and opens again as the right hand swings left and back right, both arms drawing inward before the right hand extends downward and the left arm gathers upward.

As the right arm folds upward, the dancer carries the left hand right and down on a lengthening arm, then lifts it into a curl while the right hand drops. The right arm opens left and returns up-right as the left hand rises, before both descend with the left elbow folding. The hands sweep left together, then the right hand curls upward again. Both arms extend downward as the right hand sweeps right, followed by another lift of the right arm. The left hand rises with its elbow tucked, then both hands lower and reach right as the elbows open.

At the outset, the right arm reaches right and folds back left as both knees soften, then the left knee straightens while the right hand returns down-right. The left arm curls up-right over its bending knee, followed by a lift of the right hand and another bend in the left knee; both hands sweep left as the right knee extends and the left arm opens downward. The left hand continues left with a deeper fold, then rises and sweeps right as the right arm tucks left and its knee softens, before both hands descend and reverse their sideways directions. The left knee lengthens again as the left hand climbs and both arms curl, then the right hand lifts farther left while the left arm reaches right and drops. Both hands lower as the right elbow opens and its knee bends, then they rise together with the left elbow drawing inward.

As the right hand rises rightward, the dancer folds the right arm and lowers it while the left hand drops left. The right arm opens and tucks again as the left hand reaches up and right, then both hands sweep left before the left hand curls upward and the right hand reverses right. The left hand returns down and right while the right arm extends farther right and the right knee softens. Both hands move left, the right arm lengthening downward as the right knee bends more deeply, then the left hand lifts into a rightward reach while the left knee straightens and the right hand continues left.

The dancer lifts the right hand rightward. The left arm curls up-left as the right arm folds down-left, then both arms open and descend before the left hand returns right into a renewed tuck. Both hands rise with lengthening arms, the right hand moving left while the left hand travels right and opens; they separate farther apart as the right elbow bends and the right hand drops. The right hand sweeps right, then reverses left as both arms extend downward and the left hand follows left. The hands separate again, the right hand rising into a fold while the left hand continues left and lowers.

The dancer performs an alternating arm exchange: the right arm curls up and right as the left arm folds upward, then the right arm opens down and left before rising again. The right hand lowers and extends left while the left hand drops, sweeps right and returns left with a deeper tuck; both hands climb, the right hand continuing left. Both arms lengthen downward as the right knee bends, then the hands sweep right and rise, the right elbow folding as the right knee straightens. The hands descend together, the left arm opening while the right arm reaches left and curls upward, then the right arm lowers as the left hand rises. The right arm extends right while the left hand drops and opens left, followed by another bend of the right knee.

As the right hand rises right and the left hand curls upward, the dancer lowers the right hand while the left hand moves left and opens. The right arm extends down-left as the left arm folds higher and the left knee bends, then the hands separate right and left with the left arm lengthening before both elbows tuck. Both hands sweep left, then reverse right as the left arm opens; the right hand curls up-right and drops through a tighter fold while the left hand reaches left. The left hand rises and falls through an opening-and-closing motion, then climbs again as the left knee straightens. The right hand lifts right and reverses left while the left elbow folds farther.

As the right arm extends, the dancer curls the left arm upward and left, then opens the left hand down and right while the right arm rises. The descending right arm folds back up to the left as the left hand drops, then both arms lengthen before the right hand lowers and the right knee straightens; the left hand lifts rightward and tucks in while the right elbow folds. The tucked left arm rises and opens as the right arm reaches farther down and right, then curls back up and left against the left hand's downward sweep to the right. Both elbows draw inward as the hands move left, with the left hand lifting before the right hand lowers and extends rightward. The left arm opens into a shared rightward reach, then folds back up and toward the left.

The dancer sends the right hand right and down. Both arms open, the left hand rising before the right arm folds and the right knee bends; the raised left hand then drops left as the right knee releases and both elbows tuck. The hands climb and sweep right with opening elbows, descend into folds, and separate left and right as the knees soften in succession. The initially raised left hand rises while the right knee straightens, then both arms lengthen downward and sweep left as the left knee bends again. Both hands reverse right, the left hand lifting over a deeper right knee bend while the right elbow curls inward. The lifted left hand lowers and extends farther right as the right knee sinks further, then returns left and up while the right arm opens and lifts.

As the right arm folds and the left arm extends, the dancer lifts both hands and carries them right. The left arm curls upward and returns left as the right hand drops, then rises again while the left arm lowers and opens. The left arm tucks through another rise and fall while the right arm sweeps up and left into a bend; both hands descend before the left arm reaches right and reverses left as the right hand climbs. The left arm lengthens farther left while the right hand continues upward, then both sweep right and descend with the left elbow folding.

The right hand sweeps left and down. The left hand follows left, curls upward as the right knee straightens, then both hands rise with the left arm lengthening while the right knee bends and releases. Both hands descend and separate sideways, the right arm extending and the left hand curling higher before opening downward; the left knee softens as both arms fold, then the left knee straightens while the hands lift apart again. The right hand reverses right as the left arm extends, and the knees exchange their bend and release while the hands climb and sweep in opposite directions. Both arms tuck and lower as the right knee sinks farther, then the left hand rises right over a deeper bend of the left knee while the right arm opens and the left arm folds back down. The hands separate again, the right hand rising as the right knee softens, and the left arm curls up to the right before reaching downward and continuing right.

In opposition, the dancer sends the left hand left while the right hand rises right, then lowers both hands with the left arm folding and the right arm opening. The left hand swings right and back left as its elbow tightens further; the right arm curls upward to the left and extends down, before the left hand lifts right. The arms trade height again, the left arm dropping and curling as the right arm climbs, then both fold and descend before lifting in succession. Both elbows open as the hands separate left and right, and the right hand returns left into a tuck while the left hand reaches farther right. The tucked right arm releases downward and sweeps right, then folds again as the left hand drops left.

In unison, the dancer lifts both hands as the left arm curls left and the right arm reaches right. The left hand drops and opens into a rightward sweep while the right arm climbs left; both arms fold as the left hand rises again. The left hand continues left with a deeper curl while the right knee bends and the right arm lengthens downward. The right leg straightens as the right hand moves right, then the left knee softens and releases beneath a rising leftward reach that folds back down-right. Both knees extend as the right hand reverses left and climbs with a tighter elbow bend.

A side-to-side hand exchange begins as the dancer opens the right arm down-right, then folds it upward while the left arm reaches left and down; both hands rise, separate left and right, and descend into bent elbows. The arms reverse inward, lengthening before curling upward again, with the right hand returning right and the left hand continuing left. Both elbows release into a descending reach, then fold back up toward opposite sides as the left knee softens and the left elbow tucks farther. The right hand reverses right as the left knee straightens, while the left hand drops, curls inward, and rises into another extension. Both hands lower, the left hand continuing right, before the right elbow folds and both hands lift, the left hand returning left as the left knee bends and releases. The hands descend with the left arm opening, then sweep right and rise together as the right elbow extends.

The knees join later in the phrase, after the right hand curls upward and sweeps left while the left hand travels right. The right hand continues climbing and returns right as both arms fold and the left hand lowers. The dancer lifts the right arm farther and carries it left into an extension, then repeats that reach left and back right with a tuck before lengthening again. The right hand dips, rebounds higher and falls once more as the left hand rises and the left knee straightens. Both hands descend, the left hand sweeping left as the left knee bends; the right hand follows left and lowers farther before the bent knee releases.

In opposition, the right hand reaches right and rises as the left arm folds and lifts left, then the hands exchange height while the right elbow opens. The left hand curls higher to the right, then both sweep left before the right hand drops and the left hand descends with a deeper tuck. Both arms extend into another rising reach to the right; the right hand lowers and returns left as the left hand reverses left, both elbows bending before the left hand drops. The right hand travels down-right while the left hand continues left and down, then rises and reverses right as the right knee bends and releases. The right arm curls upward and sweeps left while the left arm extends down-left; the raised hand reverses right and lengthens as the left knee softens again.

In unison, the dancer lifts and lengthens both arms, sending the right hand left while the left hand moves right, then reverses their sideways paths. The hands descend and sweep right together before the right arm curls upward over a softened left knee; the right hand returns left as the left knee bends and straightens beneath an opening left elbow. Both knees soften again as the right hand rises and falls, the right arm extending while the left arm tucks and lifts. The left knee releases as the left arm opens downward, and the right hand lowers with the left knee bending; the left hand then sweeps left and curls upward as the left knee extends. The right hand continues up and right as the left knee softens, then reverses its path left and down, finishing with another left knee bend and release.

As the right hand moves right, the dancer curls the right arm upward while the left knee bends and straightens beneath a lowering left hand. The raised right hand drops as the left knee softens, then both arms fold and sweep left before opening; the left hand rises while the right arm extends down. Both hands continue left with the rising right elbow drawing inward, then the left hand descends and both arms lengthen before reversing right, the right arm folding as the knees straighten in succession. The initially rising right arm reaches up and left while the left arm folds downward, then the left hand lifts as the left knee bends again and the right arm curls higher to the right. The lifted left hand reverses left and drops into an extension while the right hand continues upward and the left knee straightens; the lower right hand then returns right as the left hand climbs farther.

The right knee softens as the dancer lifts both hands, then the right leg straightens while the left arm folds and sweeps right; the right hand follows right as its elbow curls inward. The left hand lowers with an opening elbow, then both arms lengthen upward before the right hand drops and the left arm moves left. Both hands rise again, the left arm folding as the right arm extends and the knees soften in succession. The left arm opens downward while the right hand lifts farther, then both elbows tuck as the left hand climbs and the right arm reaches down-right. The left knee bends deeper as the left hand rises left, then both hands sweep right and descend, the right elbow releasing before the left hand returns left.

The right knee softens as the dancer curls the right arm upward and right, then extends it down while the left hand rises into a fold. The hands sweep left together, the left arm opening and curling again as the right hand lowers and the right knee bends. Both arms lengthen downward, then the right hand rises with an extended elbow before both hands descend and the right knee straightens. The right hand lifts and curls farther left while the left arm reaches left, then both lower and open before the right hand reverses right with another lift. The hands separate left and right, the right-moving arm folding as both drop, then rise again.

The dancer curls the right arm upward. The left hand rises and opens as the right knee beneath the curled arm straightens, then both hands descend while the right arm lengthens and the left knee bends. The left arm folds back up and down as the bent left leg extends, followed by a curl of the right arm and another bend and release of the right knee. Both arms unfold, the left hand moving right as the left knee softens again, before the right arm tucks and lifts left while the left arm curls upward. The right hand drops and sweeps right with an opening elbow as the left knee bends further, then the right arm reaches upward and back left while the left arm extends downward.

The dancer lowers the right hand. The left arm curls upward, then both hands sweep right as the right arm folds and rises; the left elbow tucks further while the left arm opens left. Both elbows lengthen and lower, then the right hand climbs into a curl while the left hand reaches farther right. The left hand drops as the right knee softens, then lifts into a fold while the right hand continues rising and extends. The right hand sweeps left and down, followed by the left hand dropping before they separate horizontally, with the left hand returning left.

The dancer begins an alternating arm figure by lowering the right hand while folding the left arm, then lifting and lengthening the left arm as the right knee straightens. The right hand continues down as the right knee softens, then both hands rise with the left arm reaching farther left before curling back right; the right hand descends while the left arm opens downward and folds again. Both knees bend beneath a lift of the left hand, which then drops and tucks into an opening reach as the right knee straightens and the left knee deepens its bend. The right hand sweeps right, lowers and curls upward as the right knee releases, while the left hand rises left and falls over another left knee bend and release. The left hand reverses right and up with a deeper left knee bend as the right hand lifts and returns right, ending with both hands moving right and the left arm folding.

To begin, the dancer raises the right hand and extends it right while the left arm reaches left, then lifts the right hand back left as the right knee softens. The left hand continues left while the right arm lengthens farther, the right knee straightens, and both hands rise before the right arm curls back right. Both hands descend with an opening of the right elbow, then lift again as the right knee bends and releases; the right hand dips and rebounds into a fold while the left hand continues rising. The right arm opens downward and tucks once more as the left arm draws in, then they trade height and elbow position before both hands sweep right and lower, the right hand curling upward while the left hand opens. The right arm folds and drops, followed by the left hand sinking as the left knee bends and straightens beneath a renewed curl; the right arm then extends left and rises.

The arms alternate their height: the right arm folds downward and left as the left arm reaches down-right, then the right arm extends up-right while the left hand lifts right and the left knee softens. Both hands sweep left, the left arm lengthening before curling back right over a bending left knee, while the right hand reverses right with a tucked elbow. The left hand drops as the right hand rises, then both move left with the right arm opening; the left hand returns right as the knees straighten and the left arm folds upward. The right arm curls higher, reaches right and falls left over a bend of the left knee, then both elbows tuck as the left knee straightens. Both arms extend upward and separate into left and right, then the rightward-reaching arm lowers with an opening elbow.

As the right knee softens, the dancer lowers and lengthens the right arm left while the left hand rises right. The right leg straightens as the right hand returns right, then both knees soften in succession; the left hand drops while the right arm curls up-left over the bending right knee. The left arm opens downward as the left knee straightens, then folds back up-right before reaching down-left against the right hand's rising curl. Both arms gather upward toward the right as the right leg bends again, then open downward with the right hand moving left. The left hand lifts and falls into a tuck as the left arm extends left, both hands lowering before the left arm reaches left and up and the right hand curls higher to the right.

The right hand rises and curls rightward. The left arm folds as the right knee straightens, then both hands lower with the elbows opening before the left arm tucks again and the right hand moves left. Both arms lengthen downward, sweep right together, and lift into a shared fold; the right hand continues right while the left hand dips and rebounds. The right arm extends down-left and back up-right as the left knee bends, then the right hand returns left and drops while the bent knee straightens and the left hand lowers. The right elbow folds and opens twice as the left hand reaches right, then the right arm gathers inward to finish.

At the outset, the right hand travels left and down as the left hand curls upward, then the right arm folds right while the left arm lowers and opens. The left arm reaches farther up and right before both hands drop, with the right knee softening and the left arm extending. The right hand continues right and rises into a fold as the left elbow tucks, then returns left while the right knee bends and straightens beneath a further lift of the left arm. The dancer lengthens the right arm downward and right against the left hand's leftward descent, then folds the right arm as both knees soften; the left hand lifts and extends while the right hand moves left and both elbows draw inward. Both arms open, the right hand rising and the left hand sweeping left as the right knee releases, then both hands descend and sweep right before the right elbow bends again.

The dancer begins with the right arm extending down and left, then curls upward as the left hand rises right. The hands separate left and right while the left arm opens downward, folds again, and continues descending. Both hands sweep left, the right arm curling up before reversing right into an extension. The left hand rises right with a bent elbow and returns left, joined by the right arm as both arms tuck. The left elbow releases while the right hand lifts left, and the left arm follows left with its own rising fold.

In unison, the dancer raises both hands as the right arm folds inward. Both arms lengthen and lower, with the right hand sweeping right while the left hand moves left. The left hand curls upward as the right arm extends farther down, then the right hand reverses right and rises into a tighter fold. The right hand drops again as the left arm reaches left and opens downward, followed by another lift of the right hand and a further descent of the left arm.

The right arm curls upward. The dancer extends the left hand right, then raises both hands as the right arm opens and the left arm folds left. The right hand continues right while the left elbow tucks farther and lowers; the right arm reaches down-left before curling up-right as the left hand rises and the right knee softens. Both arms lengthen downward as the right knee straightens and the left knee bends, then the hands sweep left with the right elbow drawing in and the right knee extending further. The left arm reaches right and curls upward as the right hand climbs left and folds, then the right knee bends while the left arm opens downward.

To the left, the right hand lowers while the left hand rises, then the right arm extends farther as both hands descend and separate sideways. The right hand swings right while the left knee bends, and the left hand returns left with a lengthening arm. The left hand reverses right and curls upward, while the right arm folds and the right hand travels right before lifting again. Both arms tuck more deeply, the right hand climbing as the left hand sweeps left, and they continue rising toward each other before separating once more.

Leftward, the right hand sweeps as the dancer lengthens both arms and lowers both hands. The left hand joins the leftward sweep while the right hand rises, then reverses right as the left arm curls upward; the right hand dips before climbing into a fold and dropping again. Both hands continue down-left, the right arm extending and the left opening, before the right elbow tucks and the hands separate right and left. The left arm reaches up-right, then folds downward as the right hand lifts rightward and the right knee bends. The left arm lifts left while the right arm extends lower, and both hands rise before the right arm curls back down.

As the right arm folds, the dancer lowers and straightens the right knee, then sends both hands right with the right elbow opening. The left hand curls upward while the right arm reaches down-left and lengthens; the left hand reverses left as the right arm lifts and tucks in. The right hand drops right while the left arm extends left, then rises and sweeps right against the left arm's leftward reach. Both arms fold as the left hand returns up-right, and the right knee softens beneath another left-to-right sweep of the left hand. The right knee bends further as the left hand continues right and opens downward, then straightens while the right arm curls up-left.

In unison, the arms rise and separate left and right, with the right elbow folding as the left hand climbs. The right arm curls higher while the left hand swings down-left and back up-right; the left arm lengthens downward before its hand travels right and both hands descend. The left hand reverses left and curls upward as the right hand lifts and folds, then drops again. Both hands sweep left and rise, the right arm opening through a dip and lift while the left arm continues upward and extends. The hands return right, the right elbow tucking as the left arm lowers and its knee softens.

As the right knee bends and straightens, the dancer curls the left arm up-left while the right hand moves right, then opens the left arm downward as the right knee softens again. The right arm folds down-left while the left hand rises and tucks, then both sweep left before reversing right with lengthening elbows. The right hand lifts back left into a curl as the left arm reaches up-right, then both descend and separate sideways; the left arm folds back left as the right knee bends and the right hand rises right. The hands exchange directions once more, both arms opening as the right knee straightens and the left hand drops right. Both knees soften in succession, then the left knee releases as the left hand curls upward and both arms extend, the right hand rising and folding while the left sweeps left and the right knee bends. The right knee straightens as both hands lower, the right arm opening left and the left tucking right before both hands rise and the right knee bends again.

The dancer performs a rising, leftward arm sweep: the left hand curls up and left as the left knee softens, then the right hand lifts right with both elbows folding before the left hand returns right and down. The right hand continues upward while the left arm lengthens farther right, and the knees exchange bends, with the right knee straightening as the left knee sinks again. Both hands descend and spread sideways, the left arm curling into a lift and the right arm extending downward. They reverse their sideways paths, the left arm moving left and lowering through an opening elbow while the right arm rises, and both arms fold. The left hand reverses right as both knees bend, then both hands sink with the right arm lengthening before the left knee straightens.

The arms exchange height after the dancer lifts both hands, the right hand moving right and both lowering as the left knee straightens; the right hand returns left while the left knee bends again and the right arm folds down. The left hand curls upward, then both sweep right with the right arm reaching out before reversing left and rising into a fold while the left arm lengthens downward. Both elbows tuck as the left hand continues down-right, then open in succession while the left hand reverses left and climbs. The right arm extends left as the left arm reaches right and lowers, then the right elbow folds while the left arm rises and the left knee softens. The right hand lifts and falls rightward into an extension as the left knee straightens, then the left hand curls up-left and opens right while the right elbow gathers inward.

As the right arm lengthens and the right hand drops, the dancer lowers the left hand before lifting both, curling the left arm as the right reaches farther down. The hands reverse right, the right rising into a fold while the left returns left; the left hand then lifts through an opening and tucking elbow as the right arm opens downward. Both hands climb again, the left moving right with a lengthening arm before they descend together and separate sideways, the left sweeping left as the right reverses right. The left hand rises and falls twice while the right folds upward and drops into an extension; their lateral directions exchange once more before the left curls up and left and the right sinks farther. The left arm releases downward as the right continues to lengthen, then the left hand lifts and both sweep right, ending with the left curling back left.

As the right hand rises and the left hand drops, both elbows open, then the right arm curls right while the left arm reaches left. The left hand climbs as the right elbow folds, before both hands move left with the right arm opening. The right hand continues up-left and tucks while the left arm extends farther left; both hands descend, then reverse toward each other with the left arm curling upward. The arms lengthen apart again, the right hand dropping right as the left hand climbs and opens, then folds back down-left. The right arm lowers, sweeps left and extends right while the left hand rises into a tighter fold. The dancer finishes by lowering the right hand leftward and extending the right arm.

The right hand sweeps left. The left arm curls upward and moves right as the right hand rises, then opens downward while the left arm folds farther up and right. Both hands descend and sweep left, the right arm lengthening before the left tucks inward and both elbows bend again. The left arm opens into a rising reach to the right, joined by the right hand lifting and curling rightward; the right arm folds higher, then both open before their hands reverse left. The hands separate again, the right hand moving right while the left drops and curls back left.

A side-to-side arm exchange begins with the right hand moving right and the left hand moving left, both arms lengthening before the right hand returns left. The hands reverse again, the left hand rising and curling inward as the left knee bends and releases; both hands then descend and sweep left, the right arm folding as the knees soften in succession. Both elbows open and the hands climb, the left arm curling into a rightward sweep while the knees straighten in sequence. The hands lower and separate left and right, then rise and fold inward, with the left knee bending and releasing beneath its leftward return. The left hand descends and reaches right as the right knee straightens, then sweeps left and rises into another tuck while the right elbow extends. The left knee softens again beneath a leftward reach that opens into a descent.

The arms exchange height: the right arm reaches down and right, then folds upward as the left arm extends left; both lower and lengthen before the right hand curls up and right while the left arm tucks and rises. The hands separate left and right, the left hand descending, then rise together with the right arm opening before the right hand reverses left and the left knee softens. Both knees bend in succession as the hands descend, then the right hand sweeps right and curls upward while the left hand moves left and up with a deeper fold. The right arm opens and lowers as the right knee straightens, while the left hand drops and extends and the right hand continues right. Both knees soften again as the right arm folds upward and the left hand returns left with another curl, finishing with a lift of the right hand.

The right knee softens as the dancer lowers and extends the left arm left, then both hands rise with the left hand continuing left. The left arm curls right while the right arm folds down-left; the left knee bends as the curled left hand reverses left and both hands lower into open arms. The left knee straightens as the hands sweep right, then the left knee bends again while the hands separate left and right. The right knee releases as both arms curl upward, the right hand moving left before returning right against the left hand's leftward reach. Both elbows open and the hands descend, finishing with the left hand drifting farther left.

The dancer lengthens the right arm. The left hand rises as the right arm sweeps left and curls upward, then both hands descend while the left knee softens and the right arm folds into a rightward lift. Both arms open and sweep left, the left hand lowering before both reverse right; the left hand drops and tucks as the right arm reaches farther right, then the left hand returns left and both rise with elbows folding. The hands separate right and left before descending together and opening, the right arm extending as both knees bend. The left knee releases as the right knee bends deeper, then straightens again beneath an exchange of rising and falling hands. The right hand curls up and right as the left arm folds left, followed by the right hand's descent and another bend of the right knee.

The arms move in opposition: the right hand travels right while the left hand lowers left, then the left hand reverses right as the right arm curls upward and extends back down-left. The left knee softens as the left hand rises and reaches farther right, followed by the right knee bending beneath a rightward sweep of the left arm. That raised left arm folds downward, opens and tucks again as the left knee straightens; both knees extend before the right knee bends and the left knee lengthens further. Both hands climb with folding elbows, then separate right and left as the right knee releases and the left knee bends, before they descend and open outward. The right hand lifts right against the left hand's leftward reach, then drops as both arms curl inward and the right knee sinks again.

The right arm folds as the dancer softens the right knee, then the right hand lowers and opens while the left arm lifts rightward. The right arm curls upward and sweeps left as both knees bend, then lengthens into a rightward return while the left knee straightens and the left hand drops. The right hand rises through an extension and tuck as the left knee bends, then both hands sweep left with the left elbow folding before the right arm opens downward and both knees soften. The hands reverse right as the right knee straightens, then climb together while the left leg extends and re-bends; the right hand moves left and the left hand reaches farther right. Both arms lengthen as the right hand continues left and the left knee deepens, ending with the left hand dropping rightward.

The arms move in opposition: the dancer curls the right hand up-right while the left hand folds down-left, then the right hand opens downward as the left arm tucks further. The hands exchange height twice; the lower hand rises and falls before reaching right against the other hand's leftward sweep. Both elbows open as the left hand lifts, then the left arm curls back right with the right hand continuing right; both descend before the right hand reverses left and its elbow extends again. The hands rise together with folded elbows, then separate sideways—the left arm opening left while the right hand reaches right—before lowering together and returning left as the right elbow lengthens.

Both hands rise. The dancer sends the right hand right and lowers it as the left arm folds left, then reverses the hands' directions while the right knee bends and straightens beneath its descending hand; the left knee softens as the left arm tucks farther. The right hand lifts and returns left while the left hand curls up-right, then both sweep left with the right elbow opening and the left arm folding back down-left before both knees soften. The right knee releases as the left hand rises and both arms gather inward, then the right arm extends right while the left hand dips and swings up-left, followed by a release of the right knee and another tucked lift of the left arm. The right arm reaches right as the left hand drops and lengthens, then the hands separate sideways and fold together before reversing their directions with renewed elbow extension. The left hand climbs and moves right while the right hand drops, both knees bend, and the left arm tucks and sweeps left.

The dancer sends both hands left, then folds the right arm as the left hand drops and curls upward. The right hand reverses right and rises while the left arm opens downward, then the right knee softens as the right hand lowers into a longer reach. The right knee straightens as the right hand lifts, bends again, and releases once more beneath another rising curl. The left arm draws inward while the right arm extends right and drops, followed by a rightward sweep of the bent right arm. Both hands rise as the right arm unfolds, then descend together before lifting once more.

In unison, the dancer lifts both hands, extending the right arm before curling it upward as the left hand rises leftward. The right arm opens down and right while the left hand continues its leftward climb. The left hand returns left as the right arm folds downward and the left knee bends; the hands then separate right and left, with the right arm opening and the left arm extending farther down. Both arms lengthen as the right hand reverses right and the left hand moves left, ending with a shared lift.

The arms move in opposition: the left hand sweeps left and down as the right hand reaches right, then both curl upward before the left arm opens back right. The right hand drops left and rises into a tighter fold as the right knee bends, while the left arm tucks farther right. Both hands lower and sweep left with the right elbow opening, then lift and return right, the left hand drawing inward before dropping again. The right arm lengthens downward as the left knee softens, then both elbows fold and the left knee straightens while the left hand travels left and the right hand lifts right. The left arm opens into another leftward rise as the right knee bends and releases, and both hands descend toward the right.

A rising-and-falling arm exchange begins as the dancer curls the right hand up-right and lowers it, then raises both hands while the right arm opens. The left hand moves left and tucks inward as the right arm folds higher, before the raised left hand drops left into a deeper curl. The right hand rises with a bent elbow and sweeps right while the left hand descends, then the left arm reaches down-left. The hands separate horizontally, the right hand moving right as the left hand climbs and extends farther left; both then return right and rise together, the right arm opening outward.

The dancer lifts and lowers the right hand as the left arm curls upward, then both hands rise with lengthening arms. The right hand sweeps left and drops while the left hand continues up-right and folds; the right hand reverses right and rises alongside the curled left arm, which then opens downward. The right hand returns left and climbs through a tuck-and-release, joined by the left arm folding into another rising reach, before the left knee bends and straightens beneath its own bend and release. Both hands descend as the knees soften in succession, then the right arm curls upward to the left while the left knee straightens and the right knee bends again; the hands separate left and right and climb together. The right arm reaches farther left and down as both knees deepen their bends, then the left arm extends right and its knee releases while the right hand returns right.

The dancer performs alternating knee bends as the right hand drops and curls, then rises into an extended reach. The left hand sweeps up and left, lengthening before descending, while the right arm folds downward and opens back up. Both hands shift right, the left arm tucking as the right lowers and the right knee straightens; the left hand dips, returns up and left into a longer reach while the right hand climbs farther right. The left knee bends as the left hand drops and rebounds upward with a tighter fold, then the hands separate right and left before reversing sideways again. The left arm opens downward while the right reaches down and right, then lifts into a curl as the left hand moves right and returns left.

Upward, the dancer lifts both hands. The right arm folds and then extends as the right knee softens; the left hand lowers while the right knee straightens and the right arm reaches right. The left hand rises and returns left as the left knee bends and releases and the right arm folds back down to the right. Both knees lengthen in succession before the right hand curls upward and the left hand travels left and up, the left arm opening as the left knee bends and straightens again. The left arm tucks into a rightward sweep as the left knee continues to extend and the right leg softens. The left arm reverses left and opens while the right arm rises, with the right knee straightening once more.

In opposition, the dancer sends the right hand right while the left arm curls upward and sweeps left, then both hands descend with the right arm extending. The right hand reverses left as the left knee straightens, then both arms lengthen downward before the right hand returns right and rises with a fold while the left arm moves left and up into a tuck. Both knees soften as the right hand drops left and the left arm opens, then both knees straighten and the hands rise with folded elbows. The left hand sweeps right and down as the left knee bends again, then the right hand climbs left into a deeper curl while the left knee releases and the left hand lifts left. The right elbow opens as the right knee softens, and the left knee bends and straightens beneath an upward sweep of the left hand toward the right.

As the right hand moves right and the left hand moves left, both arms fold and lower with the right hand continuing down-right. The right arm opens upward while the left knee straightens and the left hand rises; the right arm curls in as the left knee bends and releases. The hands trade height twice: the right hand lifts, drops, and curls inward while the left hand climbs, folds, and drops again. The dancer lengthens the right arm upward, then tucks it downward alongside the left hand as the left knee softens and the right hand returns right. Both hands lift and sweep left as the right arm opens, then descend together, the left arm extending farther before curling back up toward the right.

In unison, the dancer lowers both hands and carries them left, then raises the right hand while the left hand extends farther left. The right arm curls higher as the left arm continues its leftward sweep and folds inward; both hands drop before the left hand lifts again and lengthens. The left hand travels right and down with a bent elbow while the right arm reaches up-left, then both return left and curl upward. Both hands descend, the right arm opening to the right while the left arm tightens further, then both arms tuck again as the hands climb together.

The arms move in opposition: the dancer lowers the left hand left and extends the left arm while the right hand curls upward, then the right hand lifts and opens as the left arm tucks. The right arm folds back down-left while the left hand reaches right and rises, both elbows lengthening before the left hand drops and curls inward. Both hands lift toward the right, the left arm opening while the right arm tucks, then both descend into folded arms as the right knee softens; the hands sweep left with the left hand rising and the right knee straightening. The left arm opens and curls again while the right hand travels right and returns left, the right knee bending farther as both hands climb, followed by a bend of the left knee. The left knee releases as the right hand drops and the left arm folds right, then the knees exchange bends and releases twice while the hands reverse sideways and rise together, the right elbow tightening through the final release.

The right hand sweeps left. The dancer softens the left knee, then bends both knees as the right arm curls right and lifts into an extension; the left hand rises while the right hand drops and opens, then climbs with a folded elbow as the left hand reaches farther left. Both hands descend, the left arm lengthening and returning up to the right before curling down again, while the right hand lowers and the left knee straightens. The left arm tucks through a leftward lift and a rightward drop, then opens and returns left as the right knee bends. Both hands rise with folding elbows, the left hand moving right as the right knee extends and the right hand follows right. The left elbow releases as the right hand lowers and the right arm unfolds, ending with the left arm tucked again.

In unison, the hands rise and separate left and right as the right arm folds and the left arm extends, then both lower while the right hand returns right and the right knee bends. The right hand lifts left with a deeper curl before dropping as the left arm lengthens upward; both hands sweep right and descend, the right arm opening through a bend and release of the right knee while the left arm tucks. The left hand rises as the left knee softens, then drops and opens into a shared leftward sweep that reverses right as both arms fold and lift. Both hands climb again, the right elbow drawing in farther as the right knee bends and releases, before the hands separate left and down and return right. The left knee bends as the left hand lowers and curls right, then straightens while both hands move left and the left hand lifts.

The right knee bends as the dancer extends the right arm down, then lengthens both arms while the left hand sweeps left and drops. The hands reverse right and rise into folds, the right arm opening before curling again as the left arm lifts farther left and tucks. The right hand continues right with a deeper bend, while the left hand lowers, opens, and moves right. The left hand curls upward and left as the right knee straightens, then returns right and drops while the left elbow folds more deeply.

The right knee straightens as the dancer curls the right hand upward and the left hand reaches right, then both hands descend with the right hand moving left. The hands sweep up and right together, the left arm folding while the right arm opens, before both lower and the left arm lengthens downward. The right hand rises and folds left while the left hand lifts into a tuck, then both arms extend down and right; the left hand sweeps left and back right as the left knee softens. Both elbows draw inward and the hands lift, the right hand continuing left and extending downward while the left hand reverses right and falls. The right arm folds again as the right knee bends, then both knees soften and the hands descend with further elbow tucks.

At the outset, the right arm folds right and drops, while the left hand rises and sweeps left, lengthening as the right hand lifts right. The right hand reverses left as both arms curl and their hands climb, then the left arm extends down and right while the right hand lowers. Both hands sweep left, the lower arm opening, before the left hand returns right and curls upward over a bend of its knee; the right hand rises as the opposite knee straightens and the raised arm unfolds. The right elbow tucks farther while the left arm reaches down and left, then the tucked hand descends left with an opening elbow and both hands reverse right, the left arm folding downward as its knee bends. The descending hand continues down-right while the bent knee straightens, then curls up and left as the other hand moves left and rises into a fold. The latter arm opens down-left while the opposite hand drops, and the knees soften in succession beneath another rightward sweep of that dropping hand.

Lowering the right hand, the dancer folds both arms and lifts them as the left knee bends; the right hand sweeps left while the left arm extends. Both hands continue down with the elbows opening, then rise and curl inward as the left knee straightens and the right hand moves right. The left hand travels right and lowers through a deeper fold, followed by the right hand dropping and tucking; both knees soften before they separate right and left and their elbows open again. The hands reverse sideways and rise, the right hand moving right as the left knee bends and releases, then both descend into folded arms with the left knee sinking further. The left knee straightens as the right elbow opens, then both hands sweep left and rise, with the left arm curling upward while the right arm reaches down and right. The hands lower together, the right arm folding as the left hand returns right, before the right hand reverses left.

Upward, the dancer lifts both hands with the right arm folding, then carries them right as the left hand rises and its elbow tucks. The tucked left hand returns left while the right knee bends and straightens beneath a downward curl of the right arm; both hands lower before that curled right arm opens and lifts again. Both arms gather inward and sweep left, the leading right hand climbing while the left hand drops, then the leading right elbow releases as the left arm extends upward. The leading right hand reverses right into a fold while the left hand continues up-left and curls tighter. The left hand descends and swings right as the leading right hand lowers, then both rise and reverse sideways, the leading right arm opening while the left arm tightens into a shared leftward reach. The leading right arm folds once more as the left hand moves down-right and the leading right hand returns right, finishing with another extension.

The right hand sweeps left and down. The left hand travels left, rises into a fold, then returns right and descends as the right arm lengthens downward. Both hands continue left with the left arm opening, before both elbows tuck and the hands lift apart, the right hand moving right and the left hand moving left. The left hand reverses right as the right hand moves left, and both arms extend downward. The hands separate once more, the left hand moving left while the right hand returns right.

The right knee softens as the left arm extends right and down, then curls upward while the right hand rises left. The left arm continues up and right before dropping with an opening elbow, then folds back left as the right hand lifts and sweeps right over a deepening bend of the right knee. The right leg releases while the left arm reaches right, and the right hand dips right and returns left as the right leg lengthens farther; both hands climb, the right hand continuing right while the left hand reverses left and curls inward. Both arms tuck into opposing sideways sweeps, the right hand returning left before they trade height and reverse directions, ending with the left hand descending left and the right hand lifting right. The right hand dips and climbs again to finish, while the left hand lowers and moves left.

The dancer makes a shared leftward sweep, the left hand curling upward while the right arm lengthens and rises. The left arm releases downward as both hands move right, then the left arm folds back up-left with the right knee straightening before the left hand descends. Both arms open and sweep left again, the right arm tucking as the left knee bends and the left arm reaches down-right; the left knee straightens while the right hand returns up-left. The left arm curls upward toward the right and releases as the right knee softens, then the hands separate left and right and rise together before the right arm folds. Both elbows draw inward as the left knee bends, then the left hand lowers and opens into another left-to-right sweep while the right hand lifts and extends. The left hand drops and continues right as the right elbow draws tighter.

As the right hand moves left and down, the dancer lifts the left hand rightward with a bent elbow, then lowers the right hand as its arm lengthens. The left arm extends downward while the right hand continues left and rises with an opening elbow. The left knee straightens as the right hand curls upward to the right, while the left hand drops and reaches farther left. The left knee softens again as the hands exchange height, the higher arm folding down and reaching right before lifting once more. Both arms curl upward, the right hand moving left as the left hand sweeps right and descends into an extension.

As the right arm folds and lowers, the dancer carries the left hand right with a curling elbow, then sends both hands left. The left arm extends down while the right rises into a deeper tuck, before both hands sweep right and climb with bent elbows. Both arms open downward, then the right curls upward again as the left folds left and lifts; the right follows left with an extended arm and returns right while the left arm opens down. The right hand drops and lengthens farther right as its knee straightens, then sweeps left and rises against the left hand's continuing descent. That rising hand reverses right as the opposite knee bends and its hand lifts right, while the right arm draws inward.

The dancer lifts the left hand leftward as the right arm folds, then lowers and extends the left hand right while the right knee straightens. The right arm curls upward again as the right knee bends and releases, and both arms open into a rising reach before the hands separate left and right. Both elbows tuck and sweep down-left, with the right knee softening, before the left arm lengthens downward and the right knee extends. The hands reverse sideways, the left hand climbing left as the right leg straightens and the right arm reaches higher; they continue apart, the left arm folding down-right while the right arm drops, opens and curls back up-right. Both knees bend in succession as the right hand rises left and the right knee releases, then the left hand lifts right while the right arm extends down-left.

As the right hand sweeps left, the dancer lowers it while the left arm folds and extends into a rightward reach. The right hand rises and curls back left as the left arm continues reaching right and lifts with a lengthening elbow. The left arm draws inward and reverses left before both hands descend, then opens downward again. Both arms tuck, and the right hand rises through a brief rightward extension and a renewed leftward fold.

The right knee straightens as the dancer lowers and lengthens the left arm, then curls the left arm upward while the right hand drops and the right arm folds. Both hands sweep left before the right arm reaches down and extends right; the left arm opens downward, reverses up and left, and returns down and right with a fold. The right hand curls upward to the right, drops open, and rises again as both knees soften, then the arms exchange height with the left arm extending downward. The hands separate left and right as the right knee straightens, then climb together while the left knee bends and releases beneath an extension of the right arm. Both hands descend and the left arm lengthens further, ending with the right knee bending and the left knee straightening.

A rising arm exchange begins as the dancer lifts the left hand left and folds the left arm, while the right arm curls up-right. The curled hands climb farther before the right arm reverses down-left and extends, then the left arm follows with a downward reach. Both arms lengthen and lift into opposing sideways sweeps, the left hand moving right and the right hand moving left. The right hand drops into an open reach and returns right as the left hand rises, both elbows folding inward. The right hand continues right and down with a deeper curl, while the left hand lowers into a tighter tuck.

The arms move in opposition: the dancer sends the right hand right while the left hand rises left, then lowers the left hand into a deeper fold as the right arm curls upward. Both hands reverse sideways and descend, the right hand continuing left with an opening elbow before lifting again, while the left hand reverses left and curls upward as the left knee straightens. The right hand sweeps right and drops as the left knee softens and the left arm extends downward; both elbows then tuck as the right hand rises, the left knee bends further and the left hand moves right. The hands separate sideways and lower, the left knee straightening as the left arm unfolds, before the hands reverse inward and rise, the right elbow folding through its lift. Both hands sweep right and descend with extending arms, then the right hand returns left as the left arm curls upward and the right knee lengthens. The left hand travels left and down while the right arm opens and lifts, finishing with the left hand returning right and the left knee bending.

The dancer makes a repeated exchange between folded and extended arms: the right hand sweeps left as the left knee bends, then both hands rise with the right arm curling in; the left knee straightens while the left hand climbs farther left and folds. The right arm lengthens down-left as the left hand descends right, then curls upward before both arms open and lower, the right hand sweeping right. The left knee softens as the left arm tucks up-right and both hands climb, then the left knee releases beneath another leftward reach of the left hand; the right arm extends down-left and returns up-right as the right knee bends and straightens. Both arms fold as their hands sweep right, the right knee bending again before releasing and the right hand continuing right while the left knee sinks once more. The right hand drops left and reverses right as the right knee straightens, then rises into an extension as the left arm curls up-left and the left knee releases.

The right hand rises and sweeps right. The left hand joins the rightward sweep, then both arms fold as the right hand dips and rebounds upward; the right arm lengthens down and left while the left arm curls higher to the right. The right hand lifts again as both knees soften, then both hands descend before the right arm reaches left and extends upward while the left knee straightens. The right arm opens down toward the right as the left hand curls up and moves left, then returns right and rises through a fold and release. Both hands sweep left as the right knee bends and the right arm tucks upward, followed by the left hand rising through an extension and a curl as the left knee softens. The left hand descends with an open elbow while the right arm folds farther and lowers.

A leftward sweep begins as the dancer extends the right arm right while the left hand lowers, then sends both hands left with the left elbow folding. The right arm tucks and drops toward the right as the left arm reaches farther left, then opens downward before sweeping up and left; the left hand climbs right while the right hand curls higher and the right knee straightens. Both hands rise, the right hand moving right as the left elbow bends, then descend together before the right hand lifts into a fold and the left hand extends down. The hands separate left and right, the right elbow opening as the left knee softens and both arms lengthen downward. The left arm curls up and right while the right hand continues right and rises with a bend in the right knee, then the raised arm extends farther upward and left.

At the outset, the right arm folds right and down while the left arm extends left. The right hand reverses left as the left knee straightens, then both hands climb, the right hand curling farther inward before the right hand returns right and both elbows tuck. The right hand drops and rises again into another fold as the left arm opens downward, then the right arm reaches left and lengthens downward while the left arm curls upward. Both hands rise with the left arm extending, then separate left and right before the left hand lowers into a bend; the right hand climbs farther left as the bent arm opens downward. The lower hand moves right and rises into an extension, then sweeps left as the right elbow tucks and both hands descend.

The dancer curls the right hand upward. Both hands move right, then descend and sweep left as the elbows open. The left hand rises while the right hand lowers farther left; both arms tuck again as the left hand continues up and left. The left hand swings right and drops, followed by the right hand descending and folding into a rightward sweep, with the left knee bending. The right arm opens as the left knee straightens and the right leg extends, before the right hand returns left and down.

As the right hand curls upward, the dancer sweeps both hands left and lengthens both arms, lowering them before lifting the left hand right. The right arm folds again as its hand reverses right, while the left hand reaches farther right and lowers; the right hand then opens down and left and tucks once more. The right hand rises through a tighter curl and drops back toward the right as the left arm extends up and left, followed by a fold in the rising left arm. The raised left hand moves right and descends while the right arm curls up and left and the right knee softens. Both hands sweep left with the lower arm opening, then rise into folded elbows and reverse right as the softened right knee straightens.

To begin, the dancer sends the right hand right and down while the left arm extends left, then folds both arms upward as the knees straighten. The hands sweep in opposite directions, the right hand dropping left before curling up and right against the left hand's leftward rise. The right knee softens as the left arm reaches down and right and the left knee bends; both elbows tuck while the right hand lowers and sweeps left. The hands reverse sideways with lengthening arms and straightening knees, then separate again as the right hand drops farther and curls up, followed by the left hand lifting into a bend. The right hand reverses right and descends as the left knee bends and the right elbow opens, then both hands rise and sweep left before the right arm releases downward.

An alternating arm figure begins with the right hand moving right and both arms extending, then the right arm curls upward as the left arm folds. The rising right hand sweeps left while the left arm reaches right and down, before both arms return right and the left arm curls upward. Both hands climb again, the right hand moving left as it lengthens, while the left arm tucks further and sweeps left, up, and back right. The right arm folds into a higher reach toward the right as the left hand drops, then opens downward while the left hand continues down and left. The left hand returns right as the right arm curls upward, dips, and extends back to the right.

An alternating arm sweep begins with the right hand rising and falling while the left arm curls up, then both hands climb as the left arm lengthens. The hands exchange height twice, the initially lower left hand dipping farther before curling upward, then extending down and right while the right hand rises into a fold. Both arms open and close again as the rightward-moving left hand climbs left, then drops through a reach and tuck while the right elbow releases and refolds. The right hand sweeps right and rises as the left arm extends downward, then both arms gather inward and the raised right hand continues right. The right hand lowers and lengthens once more as the left elbow opens and the right knee bends.

As the right knee softens, the dancer lifts and extends the left arm rightward, then lowers it left while the right hand drops toward the right. The left arm curls up-left as the right knee straightens, followed by a lift of the right hand and another bend of the right knee; both hands move right before the left arm opens down-left and the right hand drops, with the knees exchanging bends and extensions in succession. Both arms lengthen as the left knee deepens, then the left hand rises right while the right hand reaches left and the left leg straightens. The right hand returns right as the left arm folds upward and the left knee bends, then the left arm opens downward while the right elbow tucks and the right knee releases. The right hand moves left as the left arm sweeps right, both arms drawing inward before the right hand reverses right and rises into an extension over a further left knee bend. The left hand climbs, then both sweep left as the right knee straightens and the left arm unfolds.

In opposition, the right hand rises while the left hand lowers and lengthens; the right arm opens down to the right as the right knee bends, then both hands climb while the right knee straightens. The left hand sweeps left and drops into a fold as the right arm extends farther right and up, followed by the left arm opening down to the left. The right hand reverses left and curls upward while the left knee softens beneath the left descending, reaching hand, which then returns right as the right arm unfolds down to the same side. The right leg straightens while the left hand lifts, folds and falls, and both knees soften as the left arm reaches right. Both hands sweep left with the left arm extending, then the right hand climbs into a curl while the left hand sinks farther.

The right hand rises and sweeps left, followed by the left hand curling up toward the left; the right arm folds while the left arm opens. The left hand drops as both hands sweep right and rise, then the left hand returns left and curls higher before the right arm tucks in. Both arms lengthen downward and reverse sideways, the right arm moving right while the left arm goes left and curls upward. The hands return left and climb together, the left arm extending before folding again.

In unison, the dancer lowers and extends both arms as the right knee softens, then sends the right hand right while the left hand reaches left. The left arm curls upward toward the right as the right hand lifts farther right and the right knee bends deeper. Both hands descend with lengthening arms before the right hand rises again, tucks inward and sweeps left as the right knee straightens. The right hand drops once more while the left hand continues climbing, then moves right into an extension as the left knee straightens further.

The right knee softens as the dancer lifts and extends the left arm left, then raises the right hand and straightens the right knee while the left arm folds down-right. The right hand sweeps right, curls upward and returns left as both knees bend; the left hand climbs left, followed by the right hand lifting as the right knee releases. Both hands sweep right and descend with the arms lengthening, then the left arm curls up-left and drops while the right arm tucks upward to the right and opens downward as the left hand continues down. The left arm reaches farther down-left and lengthens before folding back right as the right knee bends, while the right hand rises into a tighter curl and moves left over a deeper bend of the right knee. The left hand lowers with an extended elbow as the right knee straightens, while the right hand curls higher to the right.

The right knee bends and releases as the dancer lifts the right hand rightward into a fold while the left arm curls up, then both hands sweep left and descend with lengthening arms. The hands reverse right, the left knee softens and the left hand drops farther before both arms gather upward and the right knee straightens. Both knees bend in succession as the hands lower and separate left and right, then the knees release while the arms open and the left hand returns left into another bend and extension. The left arm folds down-right as the right hand lifts, dips and rises again; the right knee sinks farther while the raised arm opens, folds back down-left and extends once more. The right arm tucks downward and reaches right, then sweeps left and rises as the left knee bends and the right hand travels right.
