The dancer folds the right arm into a rising rightward sweep as the left hand lifts left, then opens the right arm while the left knee bends and releases beneath its descent. The right knee softens as the right hand drops left with an unfolding elbow, while the left hand rises right into a curl; the lowered right hand then reaches right as both knees straighten and the tucked right arm extends downward. Both hands swing left before the left hand returns right and the left knee bends, accompanied by the right hand lifting right and tucking as the right knee sinks further. The left knee releases while the right hand lowers and opens, then the right leg lengthens again as the left knee bends and straightens and the left arm curls upward toward the right. The right hand continues right and down while the left arm extends left, and the left hand follows left as the right knee bends and the right hand rebounds up-left, folding into a tighter curl.

The right hand rises into a fold. The left arm extends right and climbs while the right hand drops and opens, then both sweep left with the higher elbow tucking. The hands reverse right and descend, the right elbow folding before the left curls upward; they return left and rise with both arms opening. Both elbows draw inward as the hands climb again, then the right hand lowers and extends right while the left moves up-left and releases. The left hand returns up-left and folds while the right hand drops and its elbow tightens.

A low reach to the left opens the phrase: the left arm lengthens downward, then curls upward and continues left as the right hand lowers and both knees soften. The left hand drops again while the right hand reaches right, and the right knee straightens before the right arm folds up-left. Both hands sweep left, the right arm opening down as the left knee bends and releases; the left hand reverses right while the right arm curls upward and both knees deepen in succession. The right arm extends down-right as the right knee straightens, then curls up-left against the left hand's descent. The right knee sinks again as the hands separate left and right, then straightens beneath another lift of the left-moving arm.

The dancer folds the right arm upward. The left hand rises right as the right knee softens, then both hands descend with the right arm opening left and the left arm curling right before the right hand reverses right. The left hand climbs left while the right arm lengthens downward; both knees bend as the left hand returns right and the left arm opens left, then lifts and tucks while the right knee straightens. Both arms fold and descend with another deepening bend of the left knee, then rise apart toward left and right as the knees release. The right arm extends down-left while the left hand lowers right, followed by a shared leftward sweep that reverses right as the left knee bends and the right arm curls upward. The left arm tucks farther right and drops into an extension while the right hand lowers right over a softened knee, ending with the left hand moving left.

A rising-and-falling arm exchange begins with the right hand lifting as the left knee straightens, then both hands sweep left and lower. The left hand rises right and curls back down-left while the right hand folds up-right, followed by another rightward extension of the left hand and a bend of the left knee. Both elbows draw inward as the right knee bends and releases, then the left knee softens before both knees lengthen and the hands move right together. The left elbow opens and both arms tuck as the knees bend again, then the right hand drops right while the left hand rises left and the right knee extends. Both elbows unfold, the right hand lifts and its knee straightens further, before the right hand moves left and the left hand curls upward to the right.

As the right arm curls up and right, the dancer lowers and folds the left arm before both hands sweep left. The right hand drops and extends while the left knee straightens, then both hands rise as the left knee bends and releases; the left arm tucks and opens into a shared leftward sweep before the right hand climbs and the left hand sinks with a further fold. Both hands return right, the right arm lengthening downward as the left arm rises, then the hands reverse left and climb together with the right elbow curling inward. The right hand reverses right as the left knee softens, then returns left and lifts while the left arm folds left and drops. The right hand dips again before rising once more as the left hand moves right and both knees bend.

The right hand rises as the left arm lengthens and lowers. The right hand curls left while the left hand swings right, then both arms unfold into a rising sweep to the right, with the right hand dropping and the left hand lifting higher. The left hand returns left and folds inward as the left knee straightens, then the hands separate again and the right arm tucks left. Both knees soften as the left arm reaches down to the left; the right hand follows left and curls upward before the left knee straightens. The right hand drops farther left while the left arm sweeps up-right, and the right knee bends again.

At the outset, the dancer lowers the right hand into a rightward reach and curls it back up left while the left arm folds upward; both hands climb as the right knee straightens. The right hand continues left and extends down with the right knee softening, then sweeps right while the left arm reaches right and rises. Both arms tuck as the right hand lifts and the right knee straightens, followed by the left hand lowering and lengthening right while the right arm opens downward. The hands separate sideways, the right hand moving left as the left elbow bends, before they exchange directions again and the left elbow releases. The right arm folds upward and drops with a deeper bend of the right knee, while the left hand rises and falls into an extension. The right knee straightening accompanies a final curling lift of the right hand, ending with both arms opening downward.

The right knee softens as the dancer curls the right arm up and right, then both hands rise with the left elbow folding and the left hand moving left. The right arm extends down while the left arm continues left and opens downward; the right knee releases as both arms tuck and lift again. The right hand reaches farther right and drops into an opening, followed by the left hand descending and lengthening. Both elbows fold and the hands sweep left before the right arm extends upward and the left arm rises with a deeper curl. The right elbow tightens as both hands lower, then the right arm moves right and the left arm folds farther inward.

The dancer extends the left arm left. The right hand curls upward as both knees bend, then the left arm opens and lowers with a straightening knee while the right arm tucks left; the left hand rises as the left knee softens again. The left elbow lengthens downward and the hands sweep right, then the right arm folds down and both arms open as the knees straighten in succession. The hands reverse left and rise with bent elbows, the left returning right before the right drops and both arms extend as the right knee bends and releases. The left hand climbs left over another bend of the left knee, then both hands sweep right and descend as the right knee sinks and rebounds. The left arm reaches up and left while the right folds right, then both lift with the elbows opening and the left hand returns right as the left knee straightens.

The dancer sends the right hand right while the left hand lowers left, then folds both arms as the right hand returns left and drops; the right knee bends and straightens beneath a rising curl before the left arm extends downward. Both hands sweep left with lengthening elbows, reverse right into folded arms, then descend as the knees soften in succession and the hands return left. The left knee straightens as the left hand rises right and tucks; the right hand lifts left while the left hand dips right and curls upward again. The hands separate sideways, then lower together with opening elbows before the right hand climbs right and the left hand moves left. Both arms fold through a final rise and fall, the right hand ending left and the left hand continuing down and left.

The right hand dips and sweeps left. The left arm extends down and right, then curls upward as the right hand rises and folds; both hands sweep right before the left arm opens and lowers. The hands descend together, the left arm lengthening while the right elbow bends and releases, then the hands shift left. The left hand curls up to the right against the right hand's downward leftward reach, and the left knee softens as the left arm tucks further. The left hand drops as the left knee straightens, while the right hand lifts into a fold; the left arm opens and descends, the left knee bending again as the right arm reaches left and down. The left arm curls upward with another bend of the left knee, then extends right while the right arm lengthens farther.

In opposition, the dancer raises the right hand rightward while the left arm folds and lowers leftward. The right hand drops as the right elbow opens, then both hands sweep left with the left arm curling upward. Both arms extend downward and carry their hands right before folding up again, the left hand moving left as it rises. The left hand returns right and drops as both elbows open, then lifts leftward while the right knee straightens and bends in succession. The right hand continues right and down, then both hands descend, the right hand reversing left as both arms lengthen.

In opposition, the dancer lowers the right hand while the left hand curls up and right, then lifts the right hand as the right knee straightens. The hands exchange height with a bend and release of the right knee, then separate left and right before reversing sideways and folding upward. Both arms open downward, the right hand moving right while the left hand moves left, before they rise together; the left arm extends farther and the right elbow tucks as both hands sweep right. Both hands descend, the right arm opening and returning left against the left hand's continued rightward reach, then the right arm curls upward while the left arm folds down. The right hand drops right as the left arm lengthens left, then both lift and fold again, with the left elbow releasing and the left hand dropping as the right hand returns left.

The right hand sweeps left and down. The dancer sends both hands right, lifts the right hand, then lowers it while the left arm extends; the right hand returns left as the left knee softens and straightens. Both hands climb and sweep left before the right hand drops, curls up and opens into a rightward lift over another bend of the left knee, then reverses left as the left arm folds downward. The knees exchange bends twice while the left arm rises and the left knee straightens, then both arms lengthen and lower with the right knee bending again. The right knee straightens as both hands rise, the left arm curling left while the right hand moves right; the left arm reaches right and down as the right hand lifts and the left knee lengthens. The right arm tucks and continues right over a softening left knee while the left hand lowers farther left, then returns right as the bent left knee straightens and the right knee bends.

A rising-and-falling arm exchange begins with both hands moving right, the right hand curling upward before the left hand drops and folds into a leftward sweep. The right hand returns down-left as the right knee softens, then reverses right while the left arm opens downward; both knees straighten as the left hand lifts and curls back left. Both hands climb with lengthening arms, the right hand continuing right as the left hand reverses left and lowers; the left knee bends while the right leg extends and the right hand drops. The left hand rises left as the left knee releases and the left arm tucks, while the right hand moves right and lifts with a fold. Both hands return left as the right arm opens and drops, and the left elbow tightens further.

At the outset, the right arm reaches left and down as the left arm folds, then the right arm reverses right and curls upward. The left hand lowers and lengthens while the raised right arm opens left and drops, both hands continuing left before the left hand lifts and the right arm curls up-right. The curled right arm releases downward as the right knee straightens, then both hands sweep right and the newly lowered right arm tucks upward. The arms separate left and right with another lift of the tucked right hand, then return toward each other before both descend and lengthen, the right-moving hand ending left. The left arm curls upward as the left knee bends, then extends down while the left knee straightens and the right knee softens.

As the right arm extends down and right, the dancer bends both knees and sends the left hand left, then lowers and lengthens the left hand as the right knee straightens. The hands reverse sideways with another bend of the right knee, then climb together before the right hand sweeps right and drops while the right knee straightens and the left arm curls inward. The right knee softens again as the right hand rises, then both knees extend and the left knee bends once more; the hands separate left and right before the right arm folds downward and the left arm curls up. The left knee straightens as the left hand lowers and tucks, followed by a descent of the right hand and an extension of the right knee, which bends again beneath a renewed upward reach. The hands sweep left and rise as the left knee extends, then the right arm opens while the left hand returns right and both elbows draw inward.

The right knee softens as the dancer curls the right hand upward and sweeps both hands right, then lowers them before raising the right hand again while the left arm opens. The right knee bends farther as the hands separate left and right and descend, followed by a deeper bend of the left knee; both hands then rise, the right arm extending while the left arm tucks inward. The hands sweep left together and lower, with the left arm opening and the right arm folding, before the right arm lifts and reaches right as the left arm curls back up and right. Both hands descend and return left, the left arm lengthening while the right arm curls upward; the knees straighten in succession, and the raised arm extends downward as the left arm folds and rebounds higher. The right arm reaches down and right while the left hand moves left, then both lift as the left arm tucks and the right arm opens, ending with a further leftward reach of the folded arm.

In opposition, the dancer sends the right hand right and down while the left hand rises left, then lowers the left hand as the left knee straightens. The right hand drops farther right with a curling arm before both hands rise, the left hand moving right and tucking in as the left knee bends; the right arm opens upward while the left hand sweeps left and down, then returns right and curls upward as the left leg straightens. Both hands descend toward the left, the left elbow folding, then the right hand lifts with a tucked arm while the left hand extends downward. The right arm opens and folds again as the left hand moves right, then both sweep left with the right elbow drawing tighter. The hands reverse right as the left arm lengthens and the right hand rises into an extension. The right knee softens and straightens while the left hand drops and returns left, finishing with both hands lowering.

The right knee softens as the dancer folds both arms inward, carrying the left hand left and down before both hands rise. The right leg straightens as the hands separate right and left with elbows opening, then the right arm curls back right while the left arm extends farther left. The right arm lifts into a deeper tuck as the left hand rises and its elbow bends, followed by an opening of the left arm. Both hands descend, the left arm reaching left before both curl upward and sweep right, then drop with extending elbows. The left arm folds again and sweeps left as the left knee bends, its hand continuing downward.

As the right hand rises, the dancer lengthens the right arm and sends both hands right, then lowers them. The left knee softens as the left arm curls upward and left while the right knee bends; the right hand lifts and extends right over a deeper bend of the right knee. Both knees straighten as the left arm opens down and right, then the right knee bends again while the left hand curls up-left and the left knee sinks farther. The left hand drops and sweeps right with an opening elbow, followed by the right hand lowering and extending right. Both hands return left, the left arm folding downward before both elbows tuck and the hands rise together.

The right hand rises left while the left hand sweeps right. The right arm folds and continues upward as the right knee straightens, then opens into a descent to the right while the left hand lifts. The right hand curls up again as the left arm reaches left and lengthens. The left arm lifts, folds, and drops while the right hand moves left and rises with an extending elbow. The right arm tucks more deeply as both hands return right and climb, then the elbows open before the right arm folds again and the left hand drops.

The right hand rises and sweeps left while the left arm folds, then both hands descend as the right arm lengthens. The left hand lifts into a curl as the left knee bends, then reverses right and opens downward; the left leg straightens while the right knee softens beneath a shared rightward sweep. The right arm tucks as the left arm curls up and left, then both reach down and left with bent elbows before reversing right as their knees extend and the left arm unfolds. Both hands climb into tighter folds, the right hand moving left while the left hand sweeps right, then drops as its elbow releases and the knees bend in succession. The left hand continues right and upward against the right hand's leftward descent as the right knee straightens and the left knee softens; the right hand rises once more as the right leg extends.

As the right knee straightens, the dancer curls the right hand up and left, then extends it down while the left arm folds and the left hand sweeps right. The right hand rises rightward with a tighter curl as the left hand reaches left and drops, then both hands sweep left before the left arm opens upward and the right hand descends toward the right. Both hands continue rightward with folding elbows and descending paths, the left hand leading farther right as the knees lengthen. The left hand returns left into an extension and climbs while the right elbow tucks, then both hands rise with the left arm drawing in and the right arm reaching out. The left arm opens downward and curls upward again as the right hand continues right and rises.

The knees soften in succession as the right arm reaches right and lengthens, then folds upward while the left hand rises left and the right knee bends. The right arm opens down and left as the left hand curls higher; the right arm tucks farther before both hands sweep right and climb, with the left elbow drawing tighter. The left elbow releases as the right hand drops and both hands return left, the right knee bending while the left knee straightens. The right arm extends down and left, followed by the left hand lowering, after which the right arm curls upward and carries the right hand right. The left hand lifts into a fold as the right arm reaches left and down, then both hands rise and sweep left with the elbows opening. The right hand lowers and swings right while the left hand continues left, and the right knee bends and releases beneath another lift of the left hand.

The right knee softens beneath the right arm that lowers into an extended reach right, then rises and curls back left as the left hand lifts right. The hands reverse sideways, the left hand dipping before returning up-right while the right hand folds down-left and the left knee bends. Both hands sweep left as the right knee straightens, then the hands exchange direction with the right arm extending downward and the left arm curling upward. The right hand sweeps right while the left arm opens and drops; both return left, the right arm lengthening farther as the left knee straightens. The left hand curls up-right as the right hand continues left and rises, then the left knee bends and releases before the hands separate again.

In opposition, the dancer lowers and lengthens the right arm while the left arm curls up-left, then opens the left knee as the raised left hand reverses right. The right knee straightens while the right arm folds upward and moves left, followed by a lift of the left arm and another bend in the right knee. Both arms extend downward as the right knee releases and the left knee softens, then both hands rise with the right arm curling and the left arm reaching farther left. The right arm opens down-right and returns up-left while the left hand sweeps right, drops and rises again; both knees straighten as the right hand lowers and the left hand continues right. The hands separate left and right before reversing inward, with the right hand rising into a fold while the left elbow tucks. Both hands descend, the right hand continuing left, and finish with the left arm extending left.

At the outset, the dancer sends the right hand left and curls it upward while the left arm reaches right, then lowers the right hand as both elbows open. The hands exchange sideways directions, the right hand dipping before both rise with bent elbows; the right hand returns right as the left arm extends down and left, then reverses right with a deeper fold while the left elbow tucks. Both hands climb and sweep left, the left arm lengthening downward as the right knee bends, then the left hand drops while the right leg straightens and the left knee softens beneath an extending arm. The left arm curls upward as the right hand rises, and the left arm continues climbing through a rightward reach while the right hand sweeps down-left. The right hand lowers as the left elbow opens and the left hand moves right, then both arms extend into a shared leftward sweep.

The dancer moves leftward. The left arm extends while the right hand rises and moves right. The left hand drops and curls in as the right knee bends. Both hands then lift with the right elbow opening. Then the right knee straightens and the right hand returns left. Both arms fold and lower. Then the left hand lifts farther left as the right arm opens downward. The left hand reverses right and tucks again while the right elbow draws inward. With the right knee softening, the left arm continues to lengthen.

An alternating arm sweep begins as the dancer lifts the right hand, opens both arms, then curls the right arm right while the left hand drops and moves left. The right arm extends downward as the right knee bends and straightens, then both hands climb with the right arm folding before it reaches right and the left elbow tucks. The right hand returns left and lowers into a deeper curl as the right knee softens, while the left arm lengthens down and left; the right knee releases and the left arm opens right. The left hand rises and falls through another right knee bend and release as the left elbow folds and the right hand climbs, then drops left with an extending arm. Both knees sink together while the left arm curls upward and the right arm reaches farther left. The left hand continues left and descends as the right arm opens right, ending with both knees releasing.

As the left hand moves left and the right hand rises right, both arms lengthen before the left hand reverses right. The right hand lowers as the left arm folds downward, then the hands separate left and right with the right arm opening and lifting. Both arms curl as the right hand continues upward and returns left. The right arm extends farther left and drops while the left hand reaches right, opens, and descends; both hands sweep left before the right hand curls upward to the right and both rise. The right arm releases down and left as the left knee bends, then the right hand rises into a tighter fold while the left hand lifts and shifts right.

In opposition, the dancer folds the right arm upward and opens it while the left hand drops, then lifts the descending left hand left into a curl as the right knee softens. The curled left hand rises right before both hands descend and the left arm lengthens, then the right knee straightens and the left hand sweeps left into another lift as the right elbow tucks. Both knees bend in succession as the lifted left arm reaches up-right and the right hand travels down-left; the hands reverse their sideways paths with the left elbow folding and the right extending, then both rise as the knees straighten. The arms gather inward and lower, the elbows opening before the hands separate left and right and the knee beneath the rightward-moving arm bends again. That same right hand returns left and curls upward while the left hand reaches up-right, then the raised left arm extends left as the right hand falls and its knee straightens. The hands reverse sideways once more, the left arm lengthening while the right tucks, before the right hand drops and both sweep right.

As the right hand moves left, the left hand drops and follows left with an extending arm, then both hands reverse right while the right hand lowers. Both arms fold as the left knee bends, then the left hand lifts into a shared leftward sweep, followed by the right hand reaching up-right. The left arm curls upward again while the right knee softens; the left hand sweeps down-left and returns up-right over another bend of the right knee. Both hands rise as the knees straighten, then the elbows tuck before the hands descend, the left arm opening farther right. The left knee bends once more beneath its continuing rightward reach.

In unison, the dancer lifts both hands; the left arm curls and moves left while the right arm reaches right, then the right arm reverses upward to the left as the left arm opens. Both arms lengthen and descend; the left hand continues left before sweeping up toward the right, while the right arm rises and folds. The right hand drops as the left hand tucks farther, then moves right and curls back up to the left; both arms open into a shared descent with the left elbow bending again. The left hand sweeps left and rises while the right arm continues down and right, then the left arm extends farther left and lowers as the right knee softens. The right hand swings left and curls upward while the left knee bends, then the left knee straightens as the raised right arm releases downward and both hands move right.

As the right arm lengthens, the dancer lowers and extends the left arm, then curls the right arm upward to the right while the left arm folds and rises left. The right hand climbs farther as both arms open and their hands sweep right, with the left hand descending before the right arm tucks and drops. Both hands move left into deeper bends, then the right arm reverses right while the left arm lifts and reaches right with a release of its elbow. The raised left hand returns left and down as the right knee softens; the lower right hand continues left and curls upward while the left arm rises right and folds inward. The rising left arm extends higher and left, followed by the right hand lifting left, before the right hand returns right and down as its knee straightens.

The dancer moves leftward, sending the left hand while the right arm folds down and right. Then both hands reverse sideways as the right arm opens. Both arms lengthen into a shared leftward sweep before the left hand drops right and curls upward; the right hand follows left with a bent elbow. The left hand continues up and right as the right knee straightens, then the right knee softens again while the hands exchange directions, the left arm extending down and right and the right arm rising leftward. The right knee straightening accompanies another curl of the left arm, whose hand climbs left against the right hand's downward rightward sweep; the right arm opens before both elbows tuck and the right hand returns left. Both knees soften as the left hand reaches left and rises, followed by the right hand lifting leftward.

The dancer extends the right arm down and right as the left hand drops, then curls the right arm upward while the right knee straightens. The left hand reaches left and lengthens down as the right arm opens downward, then lifts again with a bend of the right knee before both hands sweep right and descend. The left arm curls up as the right knee softens, while the left hand continues right; the left arm reverses left and rises alongside the right hand, then lowers into an extension as the right knee straightens. Both arms gather inward as the knees bend and release in succession, followed by the left knee, before the right hand reaches right and down and both elbows open. The left hand climbs and folds while the right arm tucks, then sweeps left and rises as the right hand moves right; both lower and extend, then lift again with the right arm curling left.

The dancer lifts the right hand. Both hands descend, the left arm curling inward as both knees soften and the right hand sweeps right. The left hand rises while the right hand continues downward and extends, then both elbows open. The right hand lowers with a deeper fold, followed by the left elbow drawing in; the hands separate right and left as the right knee straightens and the left arm lengthens again. The left hand climbs while the right hand moves right and drops into an extension, ending with both arms opening and the left hand returning left.

The right hand sweeps right and rises into a fold as the left arm extends downward; the right arm opens before curling back up and left, while the left hand climbs right. The right knee bends as the right arm tucks farther left and down, then straightens with both hands continuing left. Both elbows draw in as the hands rise and reverse right, the right elbow opening then folding again before the left hand lifts and reaches right. The dancer repeats the opening and tucked descent with alternating elbows, ending with the left hand moving left.

The right knee straightens as the dancer lowers the left hand left and folds the left arm while the right hand reaches right and rises. The left hand lifts and curls right, then drops back left as both arms lengthen. The right hand reverses right into a bend while the left arm folds upward and moves right. The right arm opens downward as the left arm tucks and releases down and left; the left hand continues left before both hands rise and sweep right, the right elbow folding. Both arms extend downward, then curl upward together.

The dancer lifts and folds the left arm leftward. The right hand drops as the left arm releases downward, then both hands rise again with the right elbow drawing inward. The left hand sweeps right while the right hand continues climbing, then returns left as both arms lengthen; the right knee bends and straightens beneath a descending hand. That hand reaches farther down and right, followed by the left hand moving right, before the lower arm curls upward and carries both hands left with another bend of the right knee. Both elbows fold as the right knee extends, then release into a rising sweep right and back left, ending with the left hand lowering and the right knee bending again.

The dancer raises both hands. The left arm extends left as the right arm curls upward, then the left hand sweeps down and right while the right hand reaches up and right. Both arms fold before the left hand lifts right, reverses left, and drops into an extension. The right hand climbs as the left hand moves right again, then lowers with a bent elbow while the right arm tucks further. The lowered left hand rises and lengthens toward the left, accompanied by another lift of the right hand.

The right hand moves right and curls upward. The left hand follows right as the right arm opens, then both hands descend with the left arm folding and the left knee bending before straightening. Both arms lengthen downward as the right hand swings left and back right; the left hand reverses left while the right hand sweeps right, lowers and rises again. The left arm tucks and extends down-left as the right hand lifts and falls, then both sweep left with the left arm curling upward before the hands separate right and left. Both elbows fold as the left hand rises, and both hands climb farther with the right arm drawing inward. The hands reverse sideways and descend, the right arm opening through the exchange before both curl upward again.

The right hand rises right and curls inward while the left knee softens, then the right hand lowers. The right arm opens downward while the left elbow folds; both hands move left. Then the right arm curls upward and the left knee straightens. The right hand drops into an extension as the left knee bends again, then the right hand rises and sweeps left while the left arm lengthens down to the right and the right knee releases. The left hand climbs leftward with a deeper tuck as the right arm reaches up-right, then the left hand reverses left and folds against the continuing rightward reach of the right hand. Both knees soften in succession beneath that final reach, which tightens farther right.

An alternating lift-and-fall begins as the dancer lowers the right hand, then lifts both hands and extends the right arm left while the left knee straightens. The raised right arm folds back right as the left knee bends, and the left hand reaches left into a curl; the right knee softens as the hands separate sideways, then the right knee releases. Both arms tuck and lift with the right hand moving right, then lengthen as the left knee bends and the right knee softens. The hands descend in opposition before the right hand curls up to the left, followed by the left hand rising and returning left. The right knee straightens as the left hand lowers and the left knee bends again.

At the outset, the dancer folds the left arm down and left while the right hand moves right, then lifts the left arm. The right arm curls upward before both hands sweep right, the left arm tucking farther as the right knee straightens; the right arm then opens downward. Both arms reach up and left, the left elbow folding and reopening, before the right hand returns right and drops with a lengthening arm. The right hand continues right and rises into a curl as the left arm folds, then the left hand reverses left and descends while the right arm opens downward. The descending left hand returns right as the right elbow draws inward and the right knee softens.

A rising arm sweep begins with the right hand lifting left as the left knee bends, then both knees soften while the right hand swings right and back left and the left arm curls upward. The bent knees straighten in succession as the hands separate left and right, then the left hand lowers through a dip and renewed rise while the left knee lengthens further. Both knees bend again as the right arm folds and drops left, followed by the left hand sinking right; the right arm reaches up and right as both knees extend. Another shared bend and release accompanies an upward lift of the left arm and a downward curl of the right hand, which then rises left as the left knee softens and the right knee straightens. Both arms fold and the hands descend as the right knee releases, then sweep right before the left hand returns left. The right knee lengthens once more as the left hand drops farther and the left knee bends.

The right hand rises left as the left arm lengthens upward, then both hands descend and separate left and right. The dancer lifts the right hand while the left elbow curls inward, then carries the right hand left with a deeper fold before returning it right as the left arm reaches up and right. Both arms open, then the left hand drops into a bend while the right arm tucks farther left; the left hand sweeps left and returns right as the right arm climbs rightward. The right hand swings left and down, while the left hand rises, opens, and lowers to the right. The left arm folds back up toward the right and releases downward as the right hand continues rightward.

The right knee softens as the dancer lifts and curls the right arm rightward, then both hands rise with the right arm lengthening while the left hand moves left. The right hand reverses left as the right arm folds and the left knee bends; the hands continue downward with the right hand moving right and both arms extending. Both knees straighten as the hands sweep left and climb, the right arm curling before opening again. The right arm tucks and drops into a leftward reach while the left arm extends down to the right. The right arm unfolds as the left hand rises, and the left hand returns right.

At the outset, the dancer raises the right hand rightward as the right knee straightens and the left arm folds, then lowers the right hand while the left elbow releases. The left arm tucks left and rises as the left knee lengthens, before the right hand sweeps left and down with a bent elbow while the raised left hand reverses right and climbs again. Both hands descend into extended arms, then separate right and left as the knees soften in succession; the hands rise together before the right-moving arm curls downward and the left arm drops farther. The right arm opens into a lift to the right and returns left against the left hand's rightward sweep, folding as both knees bend further and the left hand lifts. The hands climb apart once more, the right arm lengthening before gathering upward and rightward while the left hand swings left and back right; the right knee bends deeper as both hands descend.

The dancer folds the right arm and raises the right hand left while the left hand moves right, then lowers both hands as the right arm opens. The hands separate left and right with the right arm curling upward again, followed by a rise of the left hand and another opening of the right arm. The hands reverse their lateral paths, the right hand sweeping right and down while the left hand rises left; the left arm then extends downward before reaching up and right. Both arms tuck as the right hand curls higher and the left hand moves left, then they lengthen and descend together. The right hand returns right with a deeper fold while the left hand reaches farther right and lifts, ending with an extension of the right arm.

A knee bend punctuates the opening arm exchange: the right hand drops and rises into a rightward reach while the left hand climbs left, the right leg straightening as both hands descend. The hands separate left and right before lifting together with folding elbows, then reverse their sideways paths as the right leg bends again. Both arms lengthen downward and sweep left, then curl upward and return right as the right knee straightens and the right elbow opens; the left hand rises while the right hand dips left and back right. The right hand lifts into another fold and falls farther right as the left hand lowers, then both climb apart with the right hand moving left and the left hand continuing down-right. The left hand reverses left as the right knee bends and straightens, while the right hand curls higher, sweeps left and returns right.

The right hand moves right. The dancer softens the left knee, lengthens the right arm downward while the left hand drops left and its elbow opens, then straightens the left leg as both hands rise. The right hand sweeps left and back right while the left hand travels right, and both lower as the right arm extends; the knees soften in succession, then straighten. Both hands climb again, the left arm curling before opening as the left knee bends, while the right hand drops left into a fold. The left knee straightens beneath a rising right hand, which then shifts right as the left arm tucks down and the left knee softens. The right arm lengthens farther upward to the right while the left arm continues down and opens, ending with another bend of the right knee.

To begin, the dancer lifts both hands into bent arms and sweeps them right, then lowers and lengthens the right arm while the left arm curls left before reaching down and right. The right hand rises as the right knee bends, then drops again and extends while the right knee straightens; the left hand curls up to the right and continues upward. The left hand reverses left as the left knee softens, while the right arm folds left and descends, with the right hand continuing downward. The right arm opens and the right knee bends farther, then both hands move left and rise, the left hand tucking while the right hand extends. The left arm opens into a sustained lift as the right hand travels right and down.

The dancer lowers and lengthens both arms, then curls the right arm rightward as the left arm reaches left and the right knee bends; both hands rise before the right arm opens downward and the left hand returns right. The right knee straightens beneath a shared lift and drop, then the right arm folds upward again while the left hand sweeps left and climbs with the left elbow tucked. Both elbows draw inward as the hands sweep right, the left hand rising before both descend into an opening reach. The right arm curls up and right while the left arm continues down and right, then they separate left and right with both elbows folding; the right hand dips and rebounds as the left hand rises and the right elbow extends. The right hand moves right and back left while the left arm tucks farther, then the left hand drops into a fold as the right arm opens.

To begin, the dancer folds the right arm as both hands rise and separate left and right, then lowers them with the right elbow opening. Both arms lengthen farther down, sweep left together, and curl upward before reaching out again. The right hand drops into a fold while the left hand climbs right, then both descend and open with the right arm sweeping left. The right elbow tucks again as the right hand lifts, followed by the left hand rising and folding; the right hand drops while the left hand continues right, then returns left and opens. The right arm curls upward toward the right as the left hand lowers and reaches left, finishing with a shared lift of both hands.

A rising, contrasting arm exchange begins as the dancer lifts the right hand rightward with an extending elbow while the left arm curls upward, then both hands climb before the left hand lowers and folds. The right hand reaches right as the left knee straightens, and the right arm tucks leftward while the left knee bends and releases beneath a rightward sweep of the left hand. The right hand rises again as the left knee softens, while the left arm lengthens down and left; the right hand continues left and drops into a fold as the right knee bends, then both knees extend while the left arm opens and lifts rightward. Both arms curl inward as the left hand sweeps left and up and the right hand returns left, then they rise farther before separating right and left and lowering with opening elbows. The right hand reverses rightward while the left hand moves left, both arms tucking inward once more.

A rising leftward sweep begins as the left arm folds and the right hand moves right, then both hands descend before the left arm extends upward. The right hand reverses left as the raised left arm curls down and reaches back up. Both arms lengthen downward, then fold inward as their hands separate left and right; the leftward-reaching hand returns right while the right elbow tucks further. The right hand climbs as the left arm opens, then curls upward again with the left arm continuing to extend. Both hands rise, the rightward-moving arm drawing in while the left arm reaches farther right.

At the opening, the dancer lowers and extends the right arm while the left hand moves right; both hands rise and sweep left, the right arm curling upward as the left elbow folds. The left hand continues left before reversing right and dropping, joined by the right hand moving right and down into a deeper tuck. Both hands climb again with lengthening elbows, then lower and open farther apart as the right knee straightens and the right hand sweeps left. The right hand reverses right and rises while the left hand drops and extends left, then both arms fold downward as the knees soften in succession. The hands separate left and right and lift together, the right arm opening before the left arm curls up and left against it.

To begin, the dancer straightens the right knee as both hands descend and sweep left. The left hand rises right while the right arm folds and lifts rightward, then the left hand dips before the arms reverse sideways, tucking into a shared rise. Both elbows draw in farther as the knees bend, then the right hand reaches up-left while the left hand travels right and down with an extended elbow. The right knee straightens as the right arm curls upward and right; the right knee bends again while the left hand lowers left and the right arm lengthens. The left hand reverses right and rises through another knee bend and release, joined by the right hand lifting leftward and extending as the right knee softens.

The right knee softens as the dancer lifts the right hand and carries it right, then lowers it while the left hand rises left. The right arm extends farther right and curls upward before releasing down, while the left hand returns right. Both hands sweep left, the right knee bending deeper as the right arm folds and both hands rise. The right arm opens while the left arm tucks, then the right hand drops right and the right knee straightens before the left elbow releases. The right hand climbs left as the left knee bends, then both arms lengthen downward.

In opposition, the right arm curls upward and moves right while the left hand lifts left, then both descend with the right elbow opening and the left folding. The left hand reverses right as its knee bends, while the right arm curls up-left and the left lengthens down-left; the knees exchange their bend and release before the hands reverse sideways again. Both arms fold downward as the right knee softens, then the right arm opens and rises into a curl while the left hand sweeps right and down with an extended elbow. The right knee straightens as its hand drops and the left climbs left, then the bent arm reaches right while the right knee bends and releases beneath another curling lift of that hand. The raised hand continues left as the other drops and extends, then both move right before the right lowers and the left curls upward. The right hand returns left and folds higher while the left arm tucks farther in, finishing with both hands rising and the right knee bending.

In opposition, the dancer sends the right hand right and lowers it while the left arm curls upward toward the left; the right hand then rises as the right arm folds. The hands reverse sideways, the right hand moving left into a tuck as the left hand drops and opens. Both arms lengthen downward before the right hand returns right and the left hand lifts, bends, and sweeps left. The left arm opens downward as both hands descend, with the right hand continuing left.

The right knee softens as the left arm curls upward and the right hand rises right, then both arms fold and lower while the right knee straightens. The left arm opens down-left and tucks again as the right hand lifts right, with the right knee bending and releasing while the hands separate left and right. Both elbows extend and the hands rise, the right hand sweeping left before returning right as the right knee bends; the left arm folds downward and the right hand drops. The right hand climbs right against the left arm's leftward descent, both arms lengthen, and the right knee extends while the left elbow curls. The right arm folds and lowers as the left arm sweeps right, then opens back left while the right knee bends and straightens and the left hand returns left. The right knee softens again beneath a rising curl, while the left arm reaches farther left and the left knee bends.

In opposition, the dancer lifts the right hand while the left hand curls up and right, then lowers both hands with a bend in the right knee beneath the right arm. The right hand moves left as the right knee straightens and the right elbow tucks, while the left knee softens and the left arm extends down; the right arm opens downward as the left arm rises and folds back down. Both knees lengthen as the right arm curls up and left and the left hand reaches right, then the left hand drops and returns left before the right arm gathers upward. The left hand rises right as the right knee bends, then the right knee straightens while the left arm folds and lowers; the right hand moves right into a curl as the right knee continues to extend. The right arm opens left while the left hand travels right and climbs into a fold, followed by a leftward sweep of the right hand.

The left hand sweeps left and down. The right hand travels right and rises, curls back left, then drops as the left arm folds upward toward the right; the right arm opens while the left arm tucks farther before both descend and lengthen. The right hand swings left, reverses right and up into a curl, then lowers with its arm extended as the left hand reaches left. The left arm lifts and folds while the right arm rises, then both sweep right with the left elbow opening and closing again. Both hands drop, the left arm extending as the right arm curls higher, and the left hand continues left while the right hand returns right and down.

The right hand sweeps right and curls upward, while the left knee bends and the left hand moves right. The right hand returns left with a deeper fold. Both hands descend and lengthen toward the left before separating again. The right arm curls upward while the left arm reaches higher and farther left. The right arm opens into a rising leftward reach, then folds back right against the left hand's descent. The left hand sweeps up-right, extends down-left, and rises again as the right arm lengthens downward. Both arms open, the right hand lifting while the left hand moves right, then the right hand continues upward as the left arm tucks inward.

Both hands sweep left. The right arm folds as the right knee bends and straightens. The left hand drops and extends right while the right arm rises, then lowers with a deeper tuck before both elbows open. Both knees soften as the hands separate left and right. Then the right arm curls upward against the left arm's lengthening descent. The right hand reverses left while the left arm folds higher. The left knee softens and straightens beneath another leftward reach that opens into a rightward return. The left hand climbs right with a bend in its elbow, then sweeps down-left and extends as the right hand rises.

The dancer lowers both hands. The right hand sweeps left and curls upward as the left arm extends, then rises farther left with a lengthening elbow while the left hand drops. Both arms fold and climb; the right arm moves right and down before reversing left, while the left arm opens downward and the right arm tucks higher. The left hand rises with a bend, then sweeps left and descends into an extension while the right arm folds farther inward. The left arm curls up to the right and releases downward as the right hand reaches left and down with a deepening elbow bend, then the left arm tightens and lifts.

The right hand sweeps left and rises as the left knee bends, then both hands descend while the left knee straightens; the right arm folds right and lifts again as the left knee softens. The left hand moves left and down, then curls upward as the left knee extends, before both hands sweep left with lengthening arms and the right hand drops. Both hands rise and reverse right as the left arm tucks, then separate left and right with the right arm folding downward and the left arm opening as the left knee bends. The hands lower together, the right arm extending and returning right while the left arm curls upward over a deeper bend of the left knee. The left hand swings left and back right as the left knee releases, then climbs farther left while the right knee sinks and the right arm opens; both hands continue left before reversing right, the right arm lifting into a fold and the left arm dropping.

Leftward, the left hand sweeps as the right hand rises and the right knee straightens. The left hand reverses right and climbs while both knees bend, then drops left as the right arm folds inward. The right arm curls upward to the right while the left knee extends, then opens down to the left before folding back up and right. Both arms draw in toward each other as both knees soften further and the hands descend; the left hand travels right before reversing left. The right arm lengthens downward while the left arm curls higher and sweeps right, finishing with a deeper fold.

The arms work in opposition as the dancer extends the right elbow and curls the left arm upward, then lowers the left hand left while the right arm opens right. The left arm rises again and reaches farther up and right as the right knee straightens, while the right hand drops right and lengthens into a lift that returns down-left. The left arm folds down-right, then reverses left as both knees soften; the right hand descends while the left arm reaches back right and upward. The left hand dips and rebounds with a tighter curl before dropping left as the right knee bends further, while the right hand lifts and the left knee straightens. The right arm tucks farther downward and continues left, then lengthens as the left knee softens and releases; the left arm draws inward and carries its hand left and down.

The left knee softens as the dancer lowers and extends the left hand left, then opens the right arm down-left while the left knee straightens. The right hand rises into a curl, followed by the left arm reaching up-right before both hands descend and separate left and right. The right arm tucks higher, while the left arm curls upward again; the right hand moves left, both knees bend, and the left arm folds farther left. Both hands lower, the left arm lengthening as the left knee releases, then the hands rise with opposing reaches left and right and the right knee bends deeper. The left arm folds down-left and reopens as the right knee straightens, then both hands lift and sweep right with the right arm curling inward.

The dancer straightens the right knee and then softens it as the left leg lengthens, with the right arm curling upward. The right knee bends again as the left hand lowers, then both legs straighten while the right hand travels left and down into an extension and the left elbow opens. The right hand curls upward as the right knee bends, then reaches right while the left hand moves left; the left knee straightens before the hands separate again, the left elbow folding. Both arms tuck as the knees bend in succession, then both hands sweep left and rise, the right knee straightening as the right arm lengthens. The left arm extends while the right hand returns right, then both elbows fold as the right hand drops and the left hand sweeps right and down. The right knee bends again beneath its descending hand, which then curls upward to the left as the left knee softens.

An alternating arm sweep begins as the dancer curls the right arm up and right, then lowers it left while the left hand rises and falls, both elbows opening. The left hand returns upward and right into a fold, joined by the right hand's lift and curl; the left hand dips before both rise again. The hands separate sideways, the right hand moving right, then descend together as the left elbow tucks. Both arms lengthen before the right hand sweeps left and the left arm lifts through a bend and release of the left knee. The left arm folds down and left, then opens as the knees soften in succession, ending with the right hand rising and falling.

A rising arm exchange begins with the right hand lifting rightward into a curl while the left hand reaches down and left. The right hand returns left as the right knee bends, then both arms open upward before the left hand curls down to the right and the left elbow folds downward. The left curled arm rises again as the left knee extends, while the right hand climbs left and tucks in; the right hand then drops as the right knee straightens further. Both hands sweep right, the left arm reaching upward, before the right hand reverses left and curls down. The right hand follows left and lowers as the right knee softens, then swings right and up into a fold while the left hand lifts farther right.

As the left arm folds and the right hand rises, the dancer sends the left hand right and up before both elbows open, then lowers the left hand left while the right hand sweeps down-right and curls upward. The left hand reverses right as the right hand extends farther right, then both arms fold and lift before the left hand drops left into an opening reach. Both hands descend with a deeper bend in the right elbow, then separate sideways as the right hand rises and lengthens; the left arm also reaches upward before curling back down and right. The right hand drops, swings left and returns right with an extending elbow as the left hand rises and falls, then the left hand tucks and lifts again while the right hand opens down-left and folds back up-right. The right hand continues right as the left arm curls higher, then both sweep left with the left hand dropping and the right elbow opening. The left arm lengthens downward while the right hand moves right, ending with the left knee straightening and the left hand returning right.

The arms exchange height: the right hand rises while the left hand drops, and the dancer folds both elbows as the right arm continues upward. The hands reverse sideways, with the right hand moving right and the left hand moving left, before both descend. Both arms lengthen, then sweep left together as the right knee straightens. The right hand curls up and returns right while the left elbow tucks; both hands lower and open, followed by a lift of the right hand. The left arm reaches left and down as the left knee bends, while the right knee softens and releases; the left hand sweeps right, dips farther, then rises as the left knee bends again. The right hand extends right and lowers while the right knee lengthens, then returns left into a fold as the left knee straightens and the right hand climbs.

The right hand sweeps right and down as the left knee softens, then both hands rise with the right arm folding inward. The left hand returns left while the right arm lengthens upward, the left knee straightening before bending again as the left hand continues left. The left arm curls higher as the left leg extends, then reverses right into a deeper fold while the right hand climbs farther left and the left arm tucks in. The right elbow opens as the right hand rises and sweeps right, followed by the left hand lifting left and curling inward; both arms gather closer before the left hand lowers right over a softening left knee and the right hand rises left into a deeper bend. Both hands descend, the left arm extending left and opening as the right arm unfolds.

One knee straightens as the dancer opens the opposite arm and sweeps its hand right, then lowers both hands while that knee softens and the other extends. The lower hand reverses left as the bent knee straightens and the opening elbow folds; the same knee bends again as the opposite hand lifts left and tucks in, followed by a lift of the other hand into a curl. The lifted hand returns down to the right with a release of its knee while the other arm reaches left and rises; both hands sweep right and fold inward before the other hand drops, and the original knee bends as its hand lifts and curls farther right. The opposite knee lengthens beneath another rightward sweep of the raised hand, which then lowers as that knee softening, while the other hand continues right and its knee straightens. Both hands reverse left and descend, the original knee extending as the other arm opens and the original hand moves farther left.

As the right arm folds and the left arm extends, the dancer carries both hands right, then lowers them before lifting the right hand into a deeper curl. The left hand dips left as the right knee bends, while the raised right hand continues climbing toward the left; the bent right leg straightens as both hands descend. The left hand sweeps right and curls upward, followed by the right hand rising rightward with a fold. The right arm opens down to the left while the left elbow releases downward and the left knee softens; the lowered right arm tucks back up to the right as the left hand rises. Both hands climb, the right hand moving left as the left arm lengthens.

The arms move in opposition: the right hand drops and extends right as the left hand curls upward, then the right arm folds left while the raised left hand swings right. The right knee softens as the right hand lifts left into a tighter curl and returns right, while the left knee bends and releases beneath an opening fold of the left arm. Both knees deepen their bends before straightening as the hands separate left and right, then the elbows tuck and the knees soften again with another lateral reversal. The left arm opens and rises as the right knee lengthens; the raised left hand sweeps left while the right arm curls up and left, and both knees bend as the right hand continues left. The left knee straightens as the left arm unfolds downward and moves right, then both knees sink before the left hand lifts and the right knee releases.

The right knee bends and releases as the dancer folds both arms, then raises the left hand while the right arm curls upward toward the right. The left arm opens and lowers left, followed by the right hand dropping and folding left; both elbows tuck as the hands reverse right and rise, then sweep left and descend with the left elbow opening. Both hands rebound upward, the right arm curling before they separate right and left and lower into extended reaches. They reverse sideways again, the left hand climbing left as the right knee softens beneath a lift of the right hand that drops right, then rises farther as the left elbow folds and opens. The knees straighten in succession while the right hand climbs left and the left hand moves right and down. The left arm lengthens further downward as the left knee bends and straightens, while the right knee also releases beneath another rightward hand movement and both arms extend.

The right hand sweeps left and up. The dancer raises the left hand, then folds both arms as the left hand moves right and the right hand drops; the folded right arm reverses left while the left arm opens downward, and the left hand curls back up to the right before both descend. The right hand returns left as the left knee straightens, then both hands rise with the right elbow tucking and the left hand moving right; the right knee softens as the left arm extends down and the left knee lengthens again. Both hands climb, the right elbow opening as the left hand lowers and the right knee bends further, then both sweep left and descend with the right elbow folding before returning right. The right arm curls upward and opens again as the right knee straightens and the left hand lifts with a bent elbow, then the left hand drops while the right hand reaches farther right and rises with a tucked elbow. Both hands move right, the right hand lowering and extending before curling back up and left as the left arm folds; the right hand dips and rises once more while the left knee bends and the left arm opens.

A side-to-side hand sweep begins as the dancer raises both hands and extends the right arm, then lowers and folds the right elbow while the left hand moves right. The right arm reaches up-left and opens again as the left hand rises leftward and tucks; the right hand reverses down-right, then curls upward and returns left. Both arms lengthen downward before the right hand sweeps right and folds back up-left, followed by the left hand rising leftward and curling in. The left arm reaches right and lowers into an extension while the right hand continues left and climbs with its elbow tucked. The left hand lifts leftward as the right arm opens upward, then drops farther left while the left hand reverses right.

The right hand drops and extends while the left hand curls up and left. Then the right hand rises while the right knee straightens. The left arm lengthens down and right, followed by the right hand moving right as the right knee bends again. Both hands descend, the left hand returning left. Both arms curl upward, then separate left and right before descending together. The right arm opens as the right knee softens and the left hand returns left. The left hand lifts back right while the right hand rises left, both elbows tucking as the right knee and then the left knee bend in succession and the right hand drops. The hands reverse sideways and rise again, with the left elbow drawing inward and the left knee sinking further.

Upward, the dancer lifts the right hand into a fold and carries it right while the left arm curls up to the left. The right hand drops and extends left as the right knee bends and straightens, then both hands sweep right with the left arm reaching higher. The right hand returns left as the right leg lengthens and the left arm opens down to the right; the right leg softens again while the hands reverse toward each other, the right hand moving right and the left hand left. Both arms tuck upward before separating sideways, then descend with the left elbow opening and the right hand returning right as the right knee straightens. The right arm folds more tightly while the left hand travels left and rises, ending with both hands lifting farther apart.

The right hand moves right. The dancer straightens the right knee and lowers the left hand, then extends both arms downward as the right knee softens again; the left hand continues down and left while the right arm curls up and right. The hands separate sideways, with the right hand lifting farther right, before returning inward as the right knee bends deeper and the left arm folds. The right hand climbs left as the right knee releases, then both hands descend while the right knee sinks farther and the left hand reverses right; the right hand reaches right as both knees straighten and the left elbow tucks in. The right arm folds upward while the left knee softens and the left arm opens and lifts left, then the right knee lengthens as the right hand rises and falls and the left knee straightens beneath a curling left hand. The right knee bends as the right arm opens higher and both hands sweep left, then both elbows draw in and the hands rise with another bend of the right knee before the left arm reaches back down and right.

The right knee softens as the dancer sends the left hand right and upward into a fold, then bends both elbows and lowers the left hand. The right arm opens while the right knee straightens, then folds again as the left hand rises and the right knee lengthens further; the left knee bends before the raised left hand descends and both arms tuck inward. That descending left hand travels left through an extension and renewed curl, while the right arm lifts, reaches farther right, and returns down with a bend in its elbow as the left knee softens. Both hands move left and rise, the left arm opening as the right knee bends and releases; the right hand drops rightward as the right knee sinks and straightens. The left hand continues left and higher as the right hand moves right and up, then both descend and sweep right together.

The right knee softens as the dancer extends both arms upward, then the right leg straightens while the left arm curls and the left hand lowers. The right hand sweeps right and climbs with a fold before opening down and left, followed by the left hand rising into a tighter curl and moving left. The hands separate again, the right hand lifting right while the left hand drops and opens, then rises and tucks back toward the left. Both hands descend, the right hand extending farther left while the left hand moves right, then reverse sideways as the right hand lifts and folds and the left elbow draws in. The left hand returns left and rises with an opening elbow as the right arm lengthens downward.

The right arm reaches right and curls upward, then drops as the left hand follows down and right with a folding elbow. The left hand reverses left into an extension while the right hand sweeps left and back right; both elbows tuck and release as the right hand rises. Both hands descend and sweep left, the left hand curling upward before opening again. The hands separate sideways—the right hand right and the left hand left—then reverse inward as the left arm folds and lifts farther left while the right arm extends down and left. The dancer repeats the sideways exchange, bending the left arm on its return right and releasing it alongside the right hand's rightward reach.

As the right hand rises, the dancer curls the left arm upward and left before both hands descend. The right arm extends down-left while the left reaches up-right, then both reverse sideways as the right elbow folds. Both hands rise into bent arms, the right hand sweeping right and curling higher while the left drops. The left hand moves right and tucks farther inward as the right arm lengthens downward. The tucked left hand sweeps left and opens while the right hand lifts right, then the raised right arm gathers in as its hand reverses left.

As the right arm folds inward, the dancer lifts both hands, then lowers and lengthens the right arm while the left arm curls upward. The left hand swings right and back left as the right hand moves right and tucks, before the right arm opens downward and both hands rise again. The arms exchange height, with the right arm lowering and extending leftward while the left arm rises rightward and folds; they trade another lift and descent before both elbows open and the left hand drops farther left. Both hands climb again, the left arm gathering inward as the right arm reaches higher and the left arm continues leftward. The right hand dips, rebounds up-right, and falls again while the left arm extends downward to the right.

A paired lift and drop begins with the right arm curling upward while the left hand lowers and the right knee straightens. The right hand moves left and descends as both arms lengthen, then the left hand curls up-right while the right hand continues left and folds back right. The right hand sweeps left and drops as its elbow releases, followed by a deeper descent of the left hand before the left arm curls upward and extends again. Both hands rise, the right continuing left as the left moves right and down; the right arm tucks and lifts farther while the left curls up-right and opens. The right hand returns down-left into a fold, while the left hand climbs, swings left and curls downward as its knee bends.

The right knee softens as the dancer folds the left arm and lowers the left hand right, then the right hand drops left. The left arm opens down and left before both hands sweep right and rise, the left hand curling inward as the bent right knee straightens. The left arm continues right and upward while the right arm extends down and left, then both reverse left with the raised left elbow opening; the right hand climbs as the left hand tucks and lifts again. The hands separate right and left, descend, and reverse sideways as the right knee bends and the left arm lengthens downward. The right hand swings right and back left while the left hand rises and returns right into a fold, then both hands drop as the right arm opens. The left hand continues right and curls upward through a bend of the left knee, followed by the right hand rising right and the left hand sweeping left.

The right knee softens beneath the rising right hand that curls inward, while the left arm reaches left and lengthens. The raised right hand swings right as the right knee bends farther and both arms fold; the left elbow releases, then both hands descend with bent elbows before lifting into opposing sweeps—right hand left, left hand right—and curling inward again. Both arms open, the initially raised right hand lowering while the left arm travels right, then folds and rises as the right hand moves right and extends upward. The higher left hand reverses left and opens while the right arm continues down-right and curls inward, then both rise and sweep left, the left arm releasing as the left knee straightens and the left hand drops. The left hand lifts and tucks once more while the right elbow bends, and both hands move right as the right knee extends further.

As the left hand drops left, the dancer straightens the right knee and lengthens the left arm down-right, then folds both arms while lifting the right hand. The rightward-moving left arm opens farther as the right arm curls higher and sweeps left, both hands rising before the left arm extends downward and the right hand lowers. The right hand climbs again as the left arm sweeps right with a tuck, then reverses left and descends while the right arm releases. Both hands shift right, the descending left arm curling upward as the right elbow bends, before the curled left hand returns left and the right hand lifts right.

A rising and falling arm figure begins with the right hand reaching right and up as the left hand lowers, then both arms climb, the left arm curling left before dropping as the left knee straightens. The right hand moves down-left while the left hand sweeps right and rises into a fold, then both arms descend and reverse sideways as the bent knee softens again. Both arms lengthen upward, the right hand continuing right before lowering with a curl, while the left hand travels left and down. The right arm extends farther left as the left knee bends deeper, then folds back toward the right while the left knee releases; the left arm also tucks and carries its hand left. Both hands rise as the knees straighten, then the left hand descends leftward while the right hand reaches right, curls back left and drops.

At the outset, the dancer sweeps the right hand right and back left as both arms lengthen. The left hand joins that leftward sweep before both descend and separate again, the right hand moving right while the left hand reverses right and down. Both hands climb with folding elbows, then the right hand reaches left as the left arm opens downward. The right hand rises into a curl, then both lower and extend; the left hand lifts through a tuck and release before descending farther right.

The dancer lowers the left hand leftward. The right arm lengthens right and upward, then folds back left as the left arm curls up and right; both hands rise before the left hand descends into a longer reach. The right hand sweeps down-left and opens while the left arm tucks upward, then returns right as the right knee straightens and the left arm extends down-right. Both arms curl upward with a bend of the left knee, then the left hand drops right as that knee releases. The right knee bends and straightens while the left hand rises left, then both knees soften in succession as that hand climbs farther left. The left knee releases as both elbows fold, then the right knee straightens while both hands lower and the left arm opens.

In unison, the right arm and left arm reach right and fold back left as the right knee straightens, then the right arm opens downward while the left hand drops right; both knees soften before the hands rise and exchange their lateral paths. The dancer reverses the exchange as the right knee bends and straightens again, then lifts and extends the left arm into a leftward descent while the right arm folds right, dips and rises. Both hands sweep left with lengthening elbows, then the left arm curls upward as the right knee bends and releases; the right arm opens down and left while the raised hand climbs right and tucks further. The right hand lowers and rebounds up as the left knee softens and the left hand moves right, then both arms curl and lower with the right hand sweeping right. The left arm reaches left and lengthens while the right hand rises, and the right knee bends again as the right hand continues right.

A folding-and-releasing arm phrase begins with the right hand rising as the left knee bends, then the right arm tucks while the right hand moves left and the left hand curls upward. The left side drops the left hand farther left and lengthens the left arm as the right hand lowers, then both hands sweep right, with the left hand lifting before they separate again. Both arms fold downward, then reverse sideways and rise into extending elbows. The right hand continues up-left over a softened left knee while the left hand sweeps down-right and opens; both hands descend and move right, with the right elbow curling inward.

While the right hand moves right and the left hand curls up-left, the dancer lowers both hands and reverses their directions. The right hand sweeps left as both arms extend, then both rise with bent elbows before dropping and lengthening apart again. The left hand lifts into a curl while the right arm folds upward, then both sweep right and lower, opening their elbows. Both hands climb once more, the right arm reaching farther right as the left hand swings left and returns right.

As the right hand rises, the dancer folds both arms and carries the right hand right while the left hand lowers. The right hand drops left and lengthens as the right knee straightens; the left arm curls upward to the left before the right hand lifts again. The hands separate sideways, then the right hand reverses down-right and curls back up-left as the left arm extends downward. The right hand drops again, while the left hand continues lowering with a folded elbow.

To begin, the dancer folds the right arm while the left hand drops and opens, then extends the left arm left as both hands rise. The right arm curls upward toward the right while the left hand continues left, then lowers into a deeper tuck. Both arms lengthen as the right hand lifts and sweeps left; the right knee softens while the left arm reaches down and right. The left arm folds as the right knee straightens, then releases back to the left as the left knee bends and the right knee extends farther. The hands separate, the right hand rising left and the left hand descending right before both return left with the left arm lengthening.

The right knee softens as the dancer extends the left arm left and lowers it while the right hand moves right, then lifts the left hand into a fold. The left arm curls upward and left, followed by the right hand moving left as the right arm lengthens. Both arms open and descend, then the right hand returns right and rises with a bend in its elbow.
