The right arm reaches down and left as the left knee bends, and the hands separate again, the left arm curling upward. The right hand drops with an extending elbow as the left hand reverses right, then both arms gather inward.

The right hand travels left. The dancer lifts the left hand right and curls it inward, then carries the left arm down-right as the right hand drops left and the left knee softens. Both hands rise before the right hand lowers again; the left arm opens while the left knee bends further, then both elbows fold and the left hand sinks right as the left leg straightens. The right hand climbs and moves right while the left hand rises left and lengthens, then both descend and the left arm tucks in. The left hand reverses right with a bent elbow while the right hand lifts and folds, then the left hand returns left as the right hand reaches farther right and rises.

As the right knee straightens, the dancer folds both arms and lowers the hands toward the left, then lifts them together. The left knee bends as the right arm curls up and right while the left arm extends downward and left; the left knee releases as the left arm reaches upward, followed by a fold on the left side. Both arms open and lower, then the right hand sweeps left and rises into a tuck as the left elbow curls up and left; both hands descend before the right hand moves right and both arms lengthen. The right hand continues right and down, the left arm rising into a curl, then reverses left and drops as the right hand climbs into a fold. The left arm opens downward while the right hand moves right, then both elbows bend as the right hand lifts again.

The dancer lifts and lengthens the right arm while the left hand moves right, then lowers both hands as the right arm folds inward. The left hand returns left and both rise with bent elbows, before the right hand sweeps right and down as the right knee softens and the left arm extends downward. Both arms open as the right knee straightens and the right hand climbs, followed by the left hand lifting left into a curl; the right hand drops right as the right knee bends again, then both arms fold higher before extending apart toward opposite sides. Both hands descend and reverse outward as the right leg straightens, then rise together, the left elbow drawing in while the right hand continues right. The left arm tucks farther as the right arm curls up-left and both hands lift, then the hands separate sideways and lower with the left arm opening. Both hands return right and climb, the right arm reaching out while the left folds inward, before the hands descend together and finish with the right arm folding back in.

The right hand rises left and the left hand rises right. Then both hands reverse sideways before the right hand drops. The left hand descends and sweeps left while the right arm curls upward, the right knee straightening as the right hand reaches down and right. The right hand swings up-left and back down-right, joined by the left hand rising rightward and folding inward. Both arms lengthen downward, with the right hand continuing right and the left hand moving left; the left elbow tucks again as both hands lower.

In opposition, the dancer sends the right hand left and the left hand right, then lowers both with a bend of the left knee beneath the leftward arm. The left knee straightens as the hands reverse sideways and rise, the left knee softening again while the right arm folds. The right arm opens downward as the left knee lengthens, then sweeps up-left into a curl while the left hand travels left. The right arm extends down-right as the left knee bends, then lifts back toward the left while the left knee straightens and the left hand continues left. Both arms fold and descend together, the lower hand continuing left before both sweep right and climb.

The right arm rises and falls while the left hand sweeps left, up-right, down-left, and back up-right. The right arm curls upward as both hands move right, then the left arm lowers and lengthens into a shared descent before the right knee straightens. The left arm folds left while the right hand continues right; both knees soften, then the left-moving hand rises into an extension and both hands sweep right. The right arm tucks, lifts farther, and opens again as the left hand drops and moves right. Both knees bend more deeply beneath a shared rightward reach, then the right knee straightens as the right arm curls upward and the left hand sinks farther.

The right hand drops as the right arm folds, while the left hand reaches right; the right arm then opens left and down. The hands trade directions and rise together, the right hand curling before both sweep right and descend into lengthened arms. They separate again, the left hand dropping left as the right knee softens, then both elbows bend and their hands return right. Both hands lift with the left arm opening, then the left hand falls left and both arms fold inward. The left hand rises farther as the right knee bends and straightens beneath a leftward arm extension, then curls upward while the right hand continues left.

The right knee softens as the dancer curls the right arm upward, then both hands rise with the right elbow tightening and the left hand moving right. The left arm lengthens downward while the right hand continues up-right, followed by the left hand lifting leftward into a fold. Both hands descend, the right arm extending before curling up-left against the left's rightward sweep; the left knee bends as its hand rises, then both knees soften while the right arm opens down-right and the left folds back left. The left knee straightens as both arms gather upward, then the right hand drops left and its knee extends while the left arm reaches farther left. The right arm curls up-right and the left hand lowers as its knee bends again, then the hands separate horizontally with the right arm opening and descending while the left draws inward.

The right knee straightens. The left hand curls up and left while the right arm folds downward, then both hands sweep right as the left arm opens and the left knee softens. The hands separate left and right with the right hand lowering into a tighter fold, then reverse sideways and rise as the right arm extends, its corresponding right knee bending further before releasing. The right knee repeats its bend and release beneath another lift of the left arm, which then lengthens downward and swings left as the raised left arm opens down and right. Both hands lower and sweep left as the right knee bends again, then the right arm tucks upward while the left hand rises and reverses right.

The right knee straightens as the dancer lifts the right hand, then bends the right knee while both hands sweep left and the left arm extends downward. The left hand rises, sweeps right with a tucked elbow, and drops again as the right knee softens; the right hand follows down and right before curling upward while the right knee lengthens. Both arms open into a descending reach to the right, the right hand returning left as the right knee bends, then straightens beneath another shared lift and extension. The hands separate right and left as the right knee bends and releases, followed by the left knee, while both elbows fold and the right hand dips farther left. The left hand continues left and tucks higher as the right knee bends and the right hand rises, then lowers while the right knee straightens and the left hand returns right with an extending elbow. The right hand climbs leftward and curls inward over a deepening bend of the right knee, while the left arm reaches farther right and down, then folds back toward the left as the bent right knee straightens.

The right hand reaches left and lowers as the left arm curls upward, then both sweep right with the right elbow folding. The left hand drops while the right rises, opens and returns left; the left follows left as the right knee softens. Both hands climb with bent elbows before the right sweeps right and lowers into a fold, joined by the left reaching up-right. The right hand reverses left as the left knee straightens and the left arm opens downward, then both hands rise and separate right and left with curling elbows. The right arm extends down-right while the left lowers and opens, and the right hand continues descending.

The dancer raises the right hand. The right arm folds and drops while the left arm reaches right and down, then curls upward as the right arm opens left and down; both arms lengthen before the right hand returns left and both elbows bend. The hands sweep right and descend into bent arms, then rise with opening elbows as the right hand reverses left and both knees soften in succession. Both arms curl higher and separate sideways before dropping, the left knee straightening as the right hand moves right and both elbows open. The left knee bends again beneath a leftward reach of the left hand, which lifts while the right arm extends right and curls upward, then returns left as the right knee softens. Both hands lower, the right arm folding as the left hand rises left, and finish with the left arm opening and the right knee extending.

The right hand travels left and down. The left hand curls up and right as the right knee beneath it bends, then both arms lengthen while the right knee straightens and the left hand lowers. Both hands sweep left, the left arm folding upward and continuing left before releasing downward; the right arm rises and tucks, then extends as the right knee softens. The right knee deepens its bend as the left hand drops, then releases while both hands rise with folded elbows and the right hand moves right. The left hand dips and rebounds into an extended lift to the left as the left knee bends, then returns right and down with a lengthening arm while the left knee straightens. The right arm reaches higher as the left hand continues right and climbs, followed by the right hand lifting farther right and folding inward.

The right hand sweeps left. The left arm reaches down and right, then both hands climb with the left arm curling inward as the left knee straightens; the left hand reverses left while the right hand drops and both arms open. Both knees soften in succession as the left-moving hand rises and returns right against the right hand's leftward sweep, which lowers before both elbows fold and the right hand lifts. The right hand moves right and drops as the right knee bends further and the right elbow releases, while the left hand climbs and both knees straighten. The left arm extends farther upward and right, followed by the right hand moving up and right, both knees bending again before the right hand descends and the right knee lengthens. The left knee softens once more beneath a downward reach of the right hand, which continues lowering as both arms unfold.

A rising-and-falling arm exchange begins with the dancer curling the right hand up and left, then opening it right before both hands descend and the left hand moves right. Both arms fold as the right hand continues right and rises, then the hands climb farther with another lengthening of the right arm before reversing left and down. The left arm curls upward as the left knee bends, while the right arm extends into a leftward lift; both hands then drop and sweep right as the left knee straightens. Another shared lift carries the hands left and back right with the left arm folding, then both lower as the right elbow tucks and the right knee softens. The hands continue right and rise together, the left arm drawing in as the right knee bends farther; they reverse left and descend, the left hand dropping more deeply before both sweep right again. The right arm curls upward to finish.

As the right knee straightens, the dancer sends both hands left and lowers them, then curls the right hand upward before opening it back down. The right hand rises again while the left arm folds left and drops, followed by the right arm tucking downward as the left knee softens and the left hand climbs. The right knee bends further as the right hand reaches right, then opens and sinks; both knees extend before the right knee bends again and the hands move right and up. Both elbows draw inward as the left knee lengthens, and the right knee releases while the right hand sweeps left and down. The right hand continues left as the right knee bends and the left arm folds downward.

To begin, the dancer folds the right arm while the right knee softens, then straightens both knees as the right hand rises and curls further. The left arm reaches right and down before both hands descend, with the right hand continuing left and curling upward again. The right hand moves right as the left knee bends and the left arm lengthens downward, then returns left and up while the left hand lifts. Both hands sweep right and lower with extended arms, followed by a shared rise and another descent as the elbows tuck. The hands return left together, the right arm opening while the left arm curls farther inward.

The right hand rises. The dancer lowers the left hand and opens both arms, then raises the right hand while the left knee straightens and the left arm curls upward. The left arm sweeps left and extends down as the left knee bends, then the hands separate sideways and reverse their lateral paths with the right arm folding upward. Both hands climb before the right hand drops right and the left hand reaches left, the left knee softening as the right arm lengthens up-left. The left hand lowers and curls right while the right hand continues left, and the bent left knee straightens as the right leg bends. The right hand reverses right while the left arm opens downward and the left knee straightens, then both arms gather inward as the left knee bends again and the left hand lifts.

A rising, folding arm exchange begins as the dancer lifts the right hand right and curls it left, then drops both hands while the left hand extends right; the right hand folds up-right again and lengthens downward. The hands separate right and left with the left arm tucking inward before both rise and move left, the right elbow opening as the left hand lowers. That lowered left hand sweeps right and up-left into a fold while the right arm extends down-right, then reverses upward toward the right as the folded left arm opens and the right arm rises. Both arms curl and descend, with the left hand moving right, before the right hand reaches left and the left hand follows left and down; they climb together, the left arm extending through another drop and lift. The hands sweep right with the left knee softening, then reverse left and lower as the left knee straightens and both elbows tuck, finishing with the left elbow releasing.

At the outset, the right arm reaches right and rises as the right knee bends, then folds back left while the left hand lowers and extends right. The right knee straightens and softens again beneath a further lift of the right arm, while the left elbow curls inward. The right arm lengthens as the right knee releases, then both hands sweep right with the right lowering and opening; the left arm reaches farther right before both arms tuck into a shared upward lift. The right hand returns left as the right knee straightens, then both elbows extend and the hands descend, the left sweeping right while the right knee bends. The left hand swings left and rises into a curl as the left knee sinks farther, then both arms open downward and the knees soften in succession before the hands move right together.

To begin, the dancer sends the right hand left and down while the left hand moves right and rises, then reverses the left arm left as the right arm extends farther down. The left hand continues upward and right, folding inward while the right hand reaches left and curls back up. Both hands sweep right with the left arm opening, then return left as the right arm lengthens downward and both knees soften in succession. The right hand lifts and travels right before returning left, joined by the left hand moving left as the left knee bends more deeply. The right arm folds into a rightward lift while the left arm curls upward, then the right knee straightens and the right hand drops as the left arm opens left.

To the right, the right hand drops as the left hand curls upward, then the right hand reverses left while the left arm extends. The left hand opens downward and sweeps left before both hands climb and the right hand returns right. Both elbows draw inward, the right hand continuing that sweep, then both hands descend with the left arm opening. The right hand moves left and tucks in again while the left arm folds back toward the right.

To begin, the dancer folds the right arm and raises the right hand while the left elbow bends and the left knee softens; the right hand moves left and both arms open before the right hand drops right. The left hand curls upward as the right arm lengthens downward and sweeps left, then the right hand descends into an extension while the left arm gathers up and right. Both hands lift with the right arm folding inward, then the left hand drops and reaches left as the knees straighten in succession; the right hand returns right and lowers while the left hand reverses right and rises into a curl. The left hand continues right as the right hand lifts and tucks, then both elbows draw inward and their hands rise together. The right hand swings left and back right through an unfolding elbow, followed by the left hand's leftward reach.

The arms alternate folding and opening in opposition to the dancer's knee bends and releases, with the right hand sweeping right and down while the left hand rises and drops. The right arm curls upward as the right knee straightens, then opens left into a descent while the left elbow folds; both knees soften as the hands separate left and right. The right hand lifts through an extension and a curl, then lowers and tucks farther as the right knee lengthens, while the left arm reaches up and right before lowering and unfolding. Both elbows draw inward as the left hand returns left and both knees bend, then the hands rise in succession and sweep right with the left arm extending. The hands lower together, the left arm bending before reaching left, then both lift and fold as the right knee softens. They descend with opening elbows, the left hand returning right and rising again.

The right arm reaches right and folds inward. The left hand follows right, then rises while the right arm curls farther in. Both arms open, the right arm dropping before both elbows tuck again and the hands rise. The left arm lengthens left as the right hand lowers, then extends downward to the right.

As the right arm curls upward, the dancer straightens the right knee and carries the right hand right, then lifts and folds the left arm as the bent left leg releases. The right arm opens down-left while the left knee softens and the left hand rises right; the left leg extends as both arms gather inward. Both hands sweep left with the right hand climbing, then drop as the left elbow lengthens and the right hand reverses right. The left hand continues right while the right hand rises again, then both move left with the left hand lowering as the right knee bends and the left hand dips and rebounds. The right hand sweeps up-right while the left hand travels left and curls upward, then both descend into extending arms before the right hand returns left.

The dancer makes a rising rightward sweep with the right arm, folding it before opening as the left knee softens and the left hand rises left. The left hand joins the upward reach right and curls in while the right elbow extends, then both arms descend, the left arm lengthening farther. The left hand sweeps right and folds back left against the right arm's leftward reach, then lifts into an extension as the knees straighten in succession. The right hand climbs right, drops and rises again as the left arm tucks left, then reaches down-right while the bent arm opens downward; the right hand reverses left as the left arm curls upward. Both hands rise and separate right and left, the right elbow extending before the hands drop and the left arm lengthens downward. The right arm continues left and unfolds as the left hand moves right and rises.

The knees soften in succession as the dancer alternates arm reaches: the right hand rises and falls, the left hand curls upward before both arms extend and the right hand lowers right. Both hands sweep left with lengthening arms, then reverse right and rise into folds, the right knee sinking again before the left hand drops and opens left while the right arm tucks higher. The right knee bends further as the left hand climbs right and the right hand follows, then straightens while the left arm unfolds left and down; the right hand dips left before rising into a curl over another bend of the right knee, joined by the left hand climbing right as the bent leg releases. The right hand continues right and down through an extension and renewed fold, then sweeps left as the left arm curls up-left and both legs lengthen. The left hand rises farther and drops over a softening knee while the right hand curls up-right, then extends down-left and returns up-right as the opposite knee straightens and its hand lifts right.

The right hand sweeps right and rises as the left arm curls upward, then both arms open into a drop and a renewed lift with the right hand moving left. The left hand follows left and climbs while the right arm folds down toward the right, both hands returning right before the right elbow opens and the right hand lowers. The left hand drops, swings left, then rises with a tuck as the right hand moves right and up; both elbows draw inward, the right hand climbing again before the arms release. The hands separate sideways and descend, the left elbow folding as the right arm reaches farther right, then reverses left and curls upward against the left hand's rising reach to the right. The left arm opens downward while the right hand continues its lift and leftward sweep, then returns right and folds as the left hand lowers. Both hands climb with lengthening arms, finish in the same direction, and lower together.

The dancer begins with the right arm curling up and left while the left arm extends down, then both hands sweep right as the right arm drops and opens. The left arm curls upward before reversing left, while the right arm gathers higher and returns left; the left arm then lowers into an extension as the right hand falls. Both hands move left, the right arm rising while the left arm folds back down, then they climb together with the right elbow tucked and the right knee softening. The left arm opens downward as the right arm reaches right and rises, then both elbows draw inward while the left hand lifts again and the right arm moves left and up. The left elbow releases as the right arm tucks farther, and the knees bend in succession before the left knee straightens.

To begin, the dancer lengthens the left arm left while the right hand moves right and down, then raises the right hand as the right arm opens farther. The hands separate horizontally, the left hand curling upward while the right hand drops and folds. Both arms descend and release, the right hand sweeping left before the left hand reaches right and both lift with the elbows tucked. The right hand returns right and down as the left hand sweeps left, then the right hand curls up and left while the left hand extends down and right. Both arms open as the right hand climbs farther right and the left hand rises.

The right hand dips and sweeps left. The left hand follows, then the right forearm reaches right while the left hand drops left; both return right and curl upward, the left hand reversing left as the right hand lifts farther. Both hands sweep left with folded arms before descending, then climb again, the right hand returning right and both arms opening. The left hand continues right as the right hand reaches down and left, followed by a downward curl of the left arm. The right hand rises left and unfolds while the left hand moves right into a tighter fold, then returns left.

A rising, leftward arm sweep begins with both arms lengthening as the dancer straightens the right knee and lifts the left hand, then curls the right arm upward. The right arm folds farther right while the left hand drops and opens; the left knee softens as the right arm extends down-left and reverses up-right. Both hands climb again, the right arm folding while the left opens, before the right elbow releases and the left hand sweeps right, tucks, and descends. The left arm reaches back up-left as the left knee bends and the right hand lowers, then curls right over a deeper left knee bend while the left hand continues left. The right hand rises into a tighter fold as the right knee straightens, while the left arm opens downward and the left knee bends further. The right elbow releases, the right hand moves left, and both hands descend as the knees soften.

As the right hand sweeps right and down, the dancer lifts the left hand leftward with a bent elbow while the left lower arm lengthens. The left hand continues upward as the right knee straightens, then both hands descend with the right hand returning left and the right arm folding. The right arm reaches right before curling back toward the left, while the left hand rises into a fold and drops farther left. Both arms open, the right hand sweeping right and rising into another tuck, before the left hand returns up and right and the right hand descends again.

The right hand sweeps right while the left hand rises and curls left, then both lower as the right arm lengthens. The right hand swings left and returns right into a fold while the left arm opens downward and curls upward to the right; both hands climb before the right hand reverses left and drops into an extension against the left hand's continued rise. The left hand moves left and down as its arm opens, while the right hand curls upward and sweeps left, then returns right. The right hand lowers through a lengthening arm and reaches farther right, while the left hand lifts into a tuck and follows right. Both arms draw inward as their hands descend.

At the outset, the right hand rises rightward as the right knee straightens and both arms fold, then the right hand returns left while the left arm extends down and left. The hands reverse sideways, the right arm lengthening downward before curling up to the right as the right knee softens; the left hand follows right, then descends with an opening elbow. Both knees bend further as the right hand curls up-left and the left knee sinks farther, then the right knee straightens while the left arm reaches down-right and the right hand lowers rightward. The hands separate left and right, the left arm extending upward, then return toward each other as the right knee bends and releases and the left hand drops leftward. The left hand reverses right as both arms open, then curls up-left while the right knee softens and the left arm folds down-right; both hands descend before the right arm tucks leftward and the left elbow opens again.

At the outset, the right arm reaches right and down while the left hand drops left, then both lift as the knees soften in succession and the elbows fold. The hands sweep apart with the left knee bending farther, then reverse inward and lower together before rising again as the left knee straightens and the right bends deeper. Both arms lengthen downward, the right hand moving left while its knee extends, then the left curls up-right as the right knee softens; both hands climb and the right travels left. The left arm opens and lowers as its knee bends, then both hands descend into folded arms before the right rises and the left sweeps left. The right hand climbs farther while the left knee sinks and straightens, then the right knee bends and its hand returns right and down as the left arm tucks more tightly.

In opposition, the dancer curls the right arm upward and opens it down-left while the left arm lowers left with an extending elbow; the right hand then rises right as the left knee softens and the right knee straightens. The right arm tucks into a leftward sweep while the left arm extends downward, then both arms lengthen before the hands return right and the right arm folds down-left over a bend of the right knee. Both hands rise as the right knee straightens, followed by a curling lift of the left hand and another bend of the right knee; the left arm reaches up-right as the right arm opens and lowers over a deeper right knee bend, then both knees straighten while the right hand sweeps left and up-right. The left hand climbs right and drops as the left knee bends, while the right arm folds and lifts farther right over a deeper bend of the left knee, then extends downward as the left knee releases. The right hand curls up-right against the left arm's leftward extension, then drops and reaches back left as the left knee softens; the left hand swings right and down while the right knee straightens and the right arm folds upward, ending with the left hand moving left.

The dancer straightens the right knee as the left hand reaches right and folds upward, then lowers the left hand while both arms lengthen and the right hand sweeps left. The hands rise with a curl of the left arm, then fall as both knees bend and the sweeping right hand returns right. Both arms open downward before the left hand rises, and the knees straighten in succession as the hands climb apart; the sweeping right arm curls right while the left arm extends up-left, then drops. The knees soften again as the curled right arm lifts left and opens down, followed by the left arm folding upward. The hands reverse outward as the left knee straightens, then the sweeping right arm tucks and lowers toward the right over another bend of the right knee, ending with both hands descending.

As the right hand moves left, the dancer straightens the left knee and lowers both hands, then reverses the right hand right while folding the left arm. The right hand dips farther down-left with its elbow opening before curling upward, while the left hand rises left as the left knee bends; the right arm tucks and drops again as the left knee straightens. Both hands sweep right and rise, the right arm extending downward while the left lengthens, then they separate left and right, the left arm curling up-left as the right opens into a shared leftward reach. The left hand descends and folds farther as the right hand lifts, then both move right with the lower hand dipping before rising into a deeper tuck. The left hand sweeps left and down, then returns right and curls higher as the right arm reaches right.

The knees join the arm sweep: the dancer sends the right hand right and the left hand left, then lifts both with a fold, lowering them as the right knee bends. The left arm curls up-left while the right arm extends downward, then the hands reverse sideways before the right knee straightens and the right arm folds upward into another bend. Both arms open and lower as the right knee softens again, then the right hand moves right and rises while the left arm tucks left. The left hand returns right as the left knee straightens, followed by the right hand moving right and the left arm curling upward.

The dancer begins with the right arm curling upward and right while the left arm folds, then both hands sweep left as the right arm drops and the left knee straightens. The right hand returns up and right into a tighter tuck while the left hand continues left and curls upward. Both hands descend, the left hand moving right as the right knee softens; the right arm reaches down and left before both elbows open. The left arm sweeps left and rises while the right arm curls upward, then the hands reverse sideways as the bent left knee extends and both arms lengthen downward. The left hand continues left, opens higher, and falls again as the left knee bends and straightens once more.

An alternating arm weave begins with the right hand rising into a curl while the left hand lowers, then both hands sweep left and descend as the right arm releases. The left arm folds upward to the right while the right knee straightens, followed by another lift of the left hand and an extension of the right knee. Both arms gather inward, the right hand climbing and shifting left as the right knee lengthens; the left hand continues left before both descend and open into a shared rightward sweep. The right hand curls upward again while the left hand sweeps left and rises, then both knees soften as the right arm tucks and the right hand moves right. Both hands lower and separate sideways, the right hand returning left, before the left arm folds and lifts through a right-to-left sweep while the right hand descends farther left. The left arm extends as the right hand rises again, then the left hand drops and returns left.

As the right hand sweeps left, the dancer lifts both hands with folded arms and lowers them together, then extends the left arm while the right hand reaches right and curls upward. The left hand rises, swings left and drops as the right knee straightens; both elbows open before the left hand lifts and folds back down to the right. The left hand reverses left as the right arm curls up-right and the left arm opens downward, then the raised elbow releases while the lower hand returns right and tucks upward. The right hand drops through a left-to-right sweep and continues right as the left arm lengthens downward. The dancer sends both hands left and raises them, one elbow folding and reopening while the other stays extended.

As the right hand moves left, the dancer opens the right arm and lowers it while the left knee bends, then extends the left arm down to the right. The right knee softens as both hands rise with folded elbows, the left hand sweeping left before returning right. Both arms lengthen downward, then the right hand shifts right while the left hand reaches farther right and rises into a fold. The left folded arm lowers and sweeps left, opening back right as the left knee straightens and the right hand drops. The right arm reaches down to the left, then curls upward as the left hand returns left and folds.

The right knee softens beneath the right hand that rises and moves right, followed by the left arm lifting left as the left knee bends. The right arm folds down-left while the left arm reaches right and both knees straighten, then the right hand curls upward as the right knee sinks again. Both hands descend, the left arm lengthening before the right arm reaches right and reverses left as the right knee extends. The right arm tucks into a rising lift, then sweeps down-right with the left hand moving right and curling upward; the left knee bends as the sweeping arm opens. The left arm folds down-right while the right arm curls higher and shifts left, then the right knee straightens and the right hand rises into a tighter fold.

The left knee softens beneath the right hand that rises left, then the left knee straightens as the left arm folds and lifts. The right arm opens and lowers while the left elbow tucks further. Both hands sweep right and climb as the left knee releases, then the arms unfold into a drop. The right hand returns left and curls upward, joined by the left hand reaching left and rising. The right hand continues up and left while the left arm extends.

As the right arm lengthens downward and the left hand drops, the dancer lowers both hands farther with bent elbows. The left arm reaches left as the right knee straightens, then lifts right while the right leg extends further; the left knee bends and releases as the left hand moves right and back left. Both arms fold upward, the initially lower left hand continuing left before reversing right as the right knee softens and the left leg straightens, followed by another bend of the left knee. The left hand rises left as the left leg extends, while the right arm curls up-left and opens right before both knees lengthen. The right hand drops and rebounds into a fold as the left arm tucks and lowers, then both knees bend again. The left knee releases while the right knee softens once more beneath an extending arm that sweeps left and down.

To begin, the dancer extends the right arm downward while the left hand rises and curls right, then both hands sweep left with the right arm folding. The left hand continues upward as the right hand drops and both arms lengthen before reversing right; the right hand rises again and tucks as the left hand descends into a bend. The right hand sweeps down-left and opens while the left hand reaches up-right, then returns down-right and folds as the left arm draws inward and its hand dips. Both hands climb, the right hand continuing upward while the left hand moves left, before they separate sideways and descend. The right arm curls farther up-right as the left hand lifts left, then opens downward with its knee straightening.

To begin, the dancer lengthens the right arm downward while the left hand drops and folds; both hands then sweep left as the right arm tucks farther and the left knee softens. The right arm lifts right into a fold and returns down-left as the left knee straightens, then reaches right and rises again while the right knee bends and releases. The right arm curls down-right as the right knee sinks, while the left arm extends upward and both knees soften in succession. The left hand sweeps left with a bend of the left knee and an opening elbow, then reverses right as both knees straighten and the right arm folds downward. The left arm curls higher and moves left before dropping right with an unfolding elbow, while the right hand continues right and the right arm opens down-left. Both hands shift left and rise, the left arm curling inward before returning right as the right arm lowers into a reach.

A knee bend and release accompanies the dancer's opening hand sweep: the left arm lengthens down-left while the right arm curls up-right, then the left arm rises as the left knee straightens. The hands separate left and right, both elbows tucking before the hands drop and the right arm reaches out; the right hand reverses left as the left arm folds and lifts back right. The right hand climbs farther while the left arm continues down-left, then both sweep right with the right arm curling upward and the left hand lifting in an extension. Both arms open downward, the left knee bending as the left hand moves left and the right knee softens beneath a rightward sweep of the left arm. The left hand returns left and curls upward while the right arm drops and extends, then both hands descend as the knees straighten and the left arm opens into another lift toward the right. The right hand follows right as both elbows draw inward, then the right hand sweeps left and down while the left knee bends and straightens beneath a further extension.

As the right hand rises, the dancer curls the right arm leftward and releases it down while the left hand drops right. The right hand continues left as both hands descend, then the arms lengthen in succession. Both hands sweep up and left with the left arm extending farther, before the left hand reverses right and curls upward alongside the right hand's lift. The right arm opens and the right hand returns left, joined by the left hand as the left knee straightens. The hands continue rising and separating, the right arm extending farther left.

The right hand rises left. The left arm extends down and right as the right arm lengthens, then both hands lower with the left hand curling inward before separating sideways. The right hand reaches up and right while the left hand sweeps left and drops; the hands trade directions, the left hand rising left as the right hand returns right. Both arms fold into a shared upward lift toward the right, then open into a descending sweep left, with the left hand lifting again. The hands separate right and left before both elbows draw in and the hands rise together.

As the right hand rises, the dancer lifts the left hand and straightens the right knee, then lowers both hands while the right knee bends before sweeping right and reopening. Both hands climb as the right knee extends farther, then the hands separate left and right, the left arm curling upward while the right arm drops. The left arm sweeps down and right into a longer reach as the right knee softens, then returns left and folds upward again while the right knee bends deeper. The right hand continues left and curls higher over another bend of the right knee, while the left arm tucks further, moves right, and opens downward. The left arm lengthens left as the right knee releases, then reverses right and folds upward.

To begin, the dancer lengthens the right arm down and left as both hands lower, then curls the right arm upward while the left hand moves right. The right arm opens into a rising rightward sweep as the left knee softens, then drops back left with its elbow drawing in. The left hand continues left and folds upward as the bent leg straightens; the right hand returns right, lifts, and curls back left before extending downward. Both hands sweep left and rise into folded arms, then the right hand reverses right with an opening elbow as the left arm extends downward. The right knee bends again while the right hand climbs and reaches farther right.

Upward, the dancer curls the right arm as the right knee softens, then sends both hands right and down before lifting them again with the right arm lengthening. The left hand drops and moves left while the raised right arm tucks, then sweeps right as the left knee bends further. The tucked left hand continues right and lowers while the right hand rises and folds into a rightward sweep; the lower left hand returns left as the raised right hand dips and climbs, and both elbows open. The higher right hand reverses left and descends, joined by the lower left hand moving left, before both lift as the knees straighten in succession. Both arms gather inward, the previously higher right hand dropping and extending farther left while the left hand reaches right and lowers.

As the right knee softens, the dancer curls both arms upward and carries them right, then extends the left arm while the right hand climbs left into a deeper fold. The left hand reverses right and lowers as the right arm opens down to the right, then returns left with a curl while the knees straighten in succession. The right arm reaches up and right as the right knee bends, then folds back left before opening downward while the left hand lifts and tucks. Both hands sweep left and descend as the right arm lengthens farther, followed by another rightward extension of the right hand with the left knee bending and the left arm folding. The left hand drops and opens as the right hand moves left and rises with an increasingly curled elbow, while the right knee straightens and the left leg softens again.

The dancer sweeps the right hand right. The right arm curls upward as the left hand moves left, then both hands sweep left and rise, the right arm opening before both hands descend into a fold on the left side. The right arm tucks again while the left arm extends downward, then both arms open as the left knee straightens; the left hand climbs through an inward-and-outward curl while the right hand drops and the right knee bends. Both hands sweep left, the right arm lengthening downward and the left arm folding higher, before they separate right and left with the left arm extending. The right arm curls up and left while the left knee softens and the left hand rises farther left, then reaches down and right as the left knee straightens and the right knee also releases.

The right hand sweeps left and down. The left arm folds and lowers toward the left, then extends as both hands rise and the right hand continues left; both arms curl downward before reopening, with the right hand reversing right and lifting alongside the left. Both hands climb again, the left arm lengthening into a rightward reach while the right elbow bends. The right hand moves right and drops into an extension as the left hand continues right, then returns left and curls upward while the left knee softens. The left raised arm reaches farther right and opens into a descent, followed by the right hand lowering and tucking inward.

In unison, the dancer raises both hands. The right arm curls left while the left arm reaches right, then the right arm reverses left as the right knee bends and the right hand returns right. The left arm folds up-right and releases downward while the right knee straightens and the right hand lowers into a longer reach. Both elbows tuck, the left hand lifting and sweeping left as the right arm rises and the knees soften in succession. The arms open apart, the right hand moving right and the left hand moving left, before both arms climb and the right knee straightens.

A knee bend accompanies the dancer's initial arm exchange: the right hand sweeps left as the left hand rises, then both descend and the right arm curls upward while the left arm reaches down. The right hand drops right and folds into a lift again, with the left elbow tucking as the left hand moves left. Both hands climb, the right arm opening before curling again and carrying the right hand right over another knee bend, while the left hand follows right and lowers into an extension. The knees straighten in succession as the left hand continues down and left; the right hand reverses right and falls while the left hand lifts and returns right. The left hand drops again as the right arm extends farther right and the right knee straightens once more.

The dancer lowers and lengthens both arms, then folds the left hand left as the right hand curls upward and right. The left arm opens while the right hand climbs farther, then drops into a tighter curl as the left arm lifts again. Both hands descend, the right hand sweeping left while the left elbow tucks. The hands rise in succession, the left hand moving right and opening as the right hand reverses left and lengthens.

The right knee straightens as the dancer extends both arms upward, the right hand moving left and the left hand moving right before reversing directions. The hands separate again, the right arm curling up while the left arm reaches higher to the left; the left arm then folds back down and right as the right arm lengthens downward. Both hands lift with folded elbows, then the right hand drops into a deeper tuck as the left hand moves right and lowers. The left hand returns left while the right elbow opens, then both arms reach right and climb, the right arm folding and the left arm extending further. The right hand continues upward before descending, opening its elbow as the left hand lifts farther right.

As both arms lengthen, the right hand travels right and the left hand travels left, then the right hand reverses right while the right knee softens; the left arm folds down-left as the right knee straightens. The left knee bends beneath a further extension of the left arm while the right knee sinks, then both hands rise and separate sideways before descending and drawing inward. The left hand sweeps left and rises into a curl as the right knee bends and releases, the left knee sinking in succession; both arms open downward, with the right hand returning right and the left hand moving left. Both elbows tuck and the knees deepen their bend as the left hand climbs, then the right arm extends upward and left while the left arm reaches right and up. The right hand falls as the left hand curls left and drops, then the arms fold together before the left hand lifts again.

To begin, the dancer curls the right hand up and right as the left arm folds upward, then lowers both hands while the left elbow opens. Both arms lengthen downward and sweep left, with the left hand climbing before the right reaches right and rises again. The left arm tucks down and extends farther left as the right hand drops, then both sweep right with the right folding upward and the left reaching higher. The left hand swings left and returns right while the right dips and rises into a tighter curl; the left then lifts, folds, and drops as the right extends down to the left. The left knee bends and straightens beneath another rising-and-falling reach of the left arm, which continues left as the right hand lifts, curls, and returns down to the right.

The dancer folds both arms. The left hand rises left while the right hand moves right and down, then the left arm opens as the right knee straightens and the right arm curls upward; both hands sweep right before the right hand lowers with an opening elbow and the left hand returns left as the left knee bends. The right arm lengthens farther down while the left hand travels right and drops, and the left knee softens further. Both hands reverse inward toward the right as the left knee extends, then the left hand lifts through a fold and opens while the right arm draws in, before both elbows release and the left hand reverses left. The right arm curls up to the right as the left knee bends, then reaches back left and down while the right knee sinks deeper beneath a rising hand that folds again. Both knees straighten as the right hand returns right and opens downward, followed by the left hand lowering with its arm extended.

The right hand sweeps left and down. The left arm folds as the right knee softens, then both hands rise before the right hand drops right and the left arm lengthens downward. Both arms curl upward, the right hand opening into a rightward reach while the left hand reaches left; both elbows then extend as the hands descend. The right arm folds upward to the left, then releases into another rising leftward sweep, followed by an upward-rightward return and a descent with a tighter bend. The right hand moves right as the left hand rises left, then curls back left and up before releasing downward. The left hand travels right and down, followed by the right hand swinging left and rising.

The right hand rises rightward as the left knee softens and straightens, then both hands lower while the left knee bends again. The left arm curls upward as the left knee extends once more, and the right hand sweeps left and down before reversing right with an opening elbow. The left arm folds upward and reaches left while the right hand continues right and drops into a tighter curl, then the left arm releases downward. Both hands climb through another shared bend of the left knee, the right hand sweeping left and tucking before returning right and lowering; the left arm gathers up-right as the left leg lengthens and the right hand rises. The left arm opens downward while the right arm lowers, then reverses up-left into a fold as the right hand drops farther and the left knee bends. The left knee straightens as the left arm releases, and the right arm extends farther down-right before the left hand also lowers.

A low sweep left and right begins the phrase: the left arm folds as both hands move left, then both rise with the right elbow drawing in. The left arm lowers and extends while the right hand climbs left, and the left arm continues down-left before curling upward as the right hand reaches higher right. Both hands drop with the elbows opening, then the left arm moves right into a fold as the right hand returns left and curls up; their heights reverse and the hands separate left and right before lowering together. The right knee bends as the left hand sweeps left and rises against a rightward reach of the right arm, then the right leg straightens and the left hand drops left as the right arm continues right and curls upward. The right arm tucks farther while the left hand moves left and opens, then reverses right as the right arm lifts left and lengthens.

The knees join a rising arm exchange: the right knee bends and releases as the right hand lifts right, while the left hand moves left and curls upward; both arms lengthen downward as the left knee softens. The right hand reverses left with an extended reach, then both arms rise and fold as the left knee straightens and the left hand continues left, before the hands sweep down-right and the right arm opens again. Both arms curl upward, then the right hand reaches left as the right knee bends and the left hand folds higher; the right hand returns right and drops while the left knee releases beneath a lowering leftward reach. The right arm extends through a left-right-left sweep as the left hand climbs right, then lowers and tucks while the left hand descends left and the right knee bends. The tucked right arm reaches up-right as the left hand sweeps right and rises into a fold over a bending knee, then both hands descend and the elbows open. The right knee straightens as the right hand moves left, followed by the left knee extending and the right hand returning right.

The right hand rises. The dancer carries both hands left, lengthening the left arm while the right hand climbs farther; the right knee straightens as both hands descend and the right arm folds. Both arms open, then the right hand curls upward again as the right knee softens and the left knee bends. The right hand drops into a deeper tuck while the left arm extends right and rises, then both knees release as the left arm lengthens downward and the right hand moves left. The right hand returns up-right with a bend in the right knee, then opens farther right and down as the left hand lifts into an extension and the right knee straightens. The dancer curls the left hand back left, opens it farther, and lowers it with another knee bend.

The right knee straightens as the dancer raises the right hand, then both hands descend and sweep right with the left elbow folding. The right arm opens down while the left hand rises and curls left, then both arms lengthen and the hands drop. Both hands reverse right as the right knee softens, then the left arm folds into a leftward lift while the right hand rises. The right knee bends further as the right arm reaches right and lowers; both elbows open before the left arm curls upward and both hands move left. The right hand continues left with an extending elbow while the left hand descends, then they separate again with the left hand moving right and the right hand returning left.

At the outset, the right hand drops and curls up to the right while the left hand moves left, then both hands rise and reverse sideways as the right arm lengthens. The hands separate again with the left arm opening and the right arm folding downward before both hands descend, the right arm reaching right and back up-left as the right knee softens. Both arms curl upward and sweep right, then lower and extend as the left knee bends and straightens; they lift again into a leftward return with the left elbow tucking. The right hand drops left as the left hand climbs right, then both hands move right with the left hand lowering while the knees soften in succession. The left hand rises again through an inward curl as the right leg lengthens, then sweeps left and down while the right knee straightens further.

As the right knee straightens, the dancer lowers and lengthens the right arm left while the left hand moves right and curls upward. The right arm folds upward and left as the left arm opens down-left, then both hands descend into longer reaches before the left arm lifts right. Both arms curl upward again, the right hand moving right as the left elbow extends, and finish by dropping apart with bent elbows. The left knee bends and releases beneath a shared leftward sweep that curls upward; the right knee softens while the right hand reverses right and the left hand rises farther. The right arm extends downward as the right knee straightens and the left hand sweeps left and drops, followed by a rightward reach from the right hand.

The arms move in opposition: the right hand sweeps left as the right knee bends, then rises while the left hand moves right and down. The raised right arm folds into a farther-left lift before both hands descend and separate, the right hand moving right while the left knee straightens. The left arm curls upward to the right as the right hand continues right and lowers; the left arm then opens downward and right while the right arm lengthens. The right hand lifts as the right knee softens, followed by the left hand rising leftward with a bend in the left knee, then dropping as the left knee straightens and the right knee also extends. The dancer sends the right hand left and up with a bent elbow, then repeats a rightward lift and leftward descent on the right side, finishing with both knees bending again.

As the right arm lengthens downward, the dancer curls the left arm upward and left, then lowers the left arm before lifting both hands again. The right hand sweeps right while the left arm extends down-left; the right hand continues right as the left arm rises rightward with a fold, then both hands descend and separate sideways. Both arms gather in as the right knee bends, then the right hand lifts into an extension while the left arm curls farther up-right and drops. The left arm folds left as the right knee straightens, then the left arm opens rightward while the right arm tucks and releases. The left hand climbs and folds again as the right hand moves left and the right knee softens.

The dancer raises the right hand. Both arms fold as the left hand sweeps left and back right, then the raised right hand descends and lengthens through a rightward reach while the left knee softens and the right elbow opens before both hands climb. The left arm curls down-left and returns right into an upward extension as the right knee bends; the right knee straightens while the extended left arm tucks left and the right hand drops right with the right knee deepening. Both hands rise as the bent right knee releases and the left arm reaches right, then lowers into a shared leftward sweep while the right arm folds and the right knee softens again. The lowered right hand continues left as the left knee straightens and the left arm extends downward, then both knees bend while the lower left arm draws inward and both hands move right.

The right knee bends and straightens as the dancer lifts the left hand leftward, then lowers it while both hands sweep right. The right arm folds down-right and releases back left, joined by the left hand moving left before both rise; the left arm curls right and opens down-left as the right arm tucks rightward. Both arms lengthen downward, the right hand returning left while the left hand continues left, then the elbows draw in toward each other. The right hand rises rightward as the right knee straightens, followed by the left arm curling up-right; the right hand then lowers while the left arm sweeps left and drops with an extending elbow. The left knee bends as the right hand moves right and rises, and both knees soften in succession beneath a further lift of the right hand. The left hand follows rightward and upward while the right arm dips and returns up-left, ending with both arms lengthening into a higher reach.

The dancer folds the right arm inward. The left hand lowers left, then rises and reverses right as the bent elbow opens; both hands climb before the newly active right arm curls down and left while the left knee softens. The left hand reaches right and back up-left as the left knee bends further and the right hand moves right, then both arms tuck into a shared leftward sweep before the raised right arm lengthens downward. Both knees straighten in succession as the right hand sweeps right and curls upward against the left hand's leftward motion, then drops and extends farther left while the left hand rises right and returns left. The descending right hand rebounds up-right with a bend of the left knee, then lowers into an extension as the left hand lifts and the moving left knee straightens.

The arms move in opposition: the right hand sweeps left as the right knee bends and the left hand drops right, then the right arm folds down and left while the left arm curls up-left and releases. Both hands rise with folded elbows, the right hand moving right as the left knee straightens, then the left arm opens downward. The right hand lowers and lengthens into a leftward sweep while the left hand rises rightward and tucks; both knees bend before the right hand reverses up-right and the left hand climbs left. As the right knee extends, the right hand dips and rebounds left, then moves right against the left hand's leftward sweep, which continues upward.

An alternating arm weave begins with the dancer curling the right hand upward and right, lowering it as the left hand moves left, before both arms open. The left arm folds and rises while the right hand sweeps left and up, then returns right as the left knee bends and the right knee softens; the raised left arm extends right and drops before both hands descend, the right moving left and the left folding. The right arm reaches right again as both knees straighten, followed by a lift of that hand and another bend and release beneath the left knee. The lifted right arm curls down and right while the left lengthens left and rises, then both elbows draw in as their hands sweep right, with the left arm lifting and dropping into an extension. The right hand continues down-right and opens while the left moves left, then both climb as the left arm folds back right. Both hands lower, the right arm reaching farther right and lengthening before the left elbow tucks.

As the right hand rises, the dancer sweeps both hands right and lowers them before curling the left arm upward and sending its hand left. The right hand lifts and extends while the left hand drops, then curls back up to the right as the left elbow opens. Both hands climb and sweep left, the left arm drawing in again before the right hand descends; the left arm reaches down and right, followed by the right hand lowering into an extension. Both arms tuck as their hands rise and move right, then lengthen downward together. The left hand swings left and returns right with a bend, while the right arm folds farther down; the hands continue apart, the left hand reversing left as the right hand lifts.

The dancer begins with the right arm curling upward and right, then lowering as the left hand rises; both elbows draw inward while the left hand swings left and up and the right hand extends down and right. The hands reverse sideways and descend, the left arm opening as the right arm tucks and rises again. Both hands sweep right and climb, the left elbow folding before the arms lengthen and separate left and right as the knees bend. The hands continue apart and drop, the right knee straightening while the left knee bends deeper; both elbows gather inward as the hands reverse toward each other and rise, with the right knee extending farther. The left knee softens further beneath another shared lift, then both hands move right as the left arm opens and the left knee straightens, followed by the right hand rising and sweeping left with a bent elbow.

The right arm lengthens down and right while the left arm curls upward, then both arms sweep left as the right arm folds back up and reaches right. The left hand rises into a deeper fold and moves right, joined by the right hand before it reverses left. Both hands climb, the left hand curling inward and returning left as the right hand tucks farther and follows left. They descend with the left arm opening, then rise together as the right hand swings right and returns left; the left hand continues left while the right hand drops into an extension. The hands separate left and right, then reverse their sideways paths and lift together as the left arm folds.

The right knee straightens as the dancer lowers and lengthens both arms, then lifts them toward opposite sides with the left hand moving right. The hands reverse sideways while the knees bend and the right arm curls upward; both knees straighten as the right arm opens and the left arm folds. The right hand lowers and extends left while the left hand continues right and rises, the left knee softening as both elbows tuck. The right knee bends beneath another leftward reach, and both hands climb before the right hand reverses right; the left elbow opens as the right knee releases and the right hand drops, then both hands move left while the left knee straightens. Both arms curl upward and sweep right, then descend together as the right arm opens and the left arm tucks further. The right arm reaches up and left while the left knee bends and the left hand rises into a tighter fold, ending with the left knee releasing.

The dancer extends the right arm right. The left hand moves left as both hands rise, the right arm folding in and reversing its direction while the left elbow opens. The right hand drops into a longer reach as the left knee straightens, then curls upward to the left while the left arm tucks and the right knee bends. The left arm extends down and sweeps left before rising with a deeper fold, while the right hand drops farther left and lengthens. The right bent knee releases as the left hand continues left and down; both arms open, the right hand rises, and the left arm sweeps up-right before returning left.

The right hand rises. The dancer sends the left hand right and up as both elbows fold, then lowers the right arm while the left knee softens; the left knee bends farther as the left hand dips left and returns right. The left hand lifts with a deeper curl while the left knee straightens and the right arm reaches right, then folds back down-left as the left arm lengthens downward and the bent left knee releases. The left hand reverses right as the right elbow tucks, and both hands rise before separating right and left, the left arm extending into an upward reach. Both hands climb again, the rightward-reaching hand shifting left as it lifts and the left arm curls inward. The left hand descends left while the right arm opens and its hand moves right, ending with another rising lift on the leftward side.

The right knee softens as the dancer curls the right arm upward and sweeps the right hand right, then straightens the right knee while both hands lower with the left elbow folding. The left arm reaches down and right as the right arm opens left, the right knee bending again before the left hand reverses left; the right knee extends and the left arm tucks while the right hand rises. The right hand continues left as the right knee lengthens and the left hand drops, then both elbows fold and the left hand shifts right while the right arm opens upward. Both arms extend downward and sweep right, the left knee softening before the left arm curls up-left over a straightening knee. The right hand returns left as the left arm opens and lifts, followed by the left hand rising and returning left.

A folding arm sweep accompanies a knee bend: the right hand moves right and down, then the left hand follows left as both arms lengthen. The left hand reverses right while the right knee softens further, and the right hand climbs right with a tighter elbow fold. Both hands drop, the right hand continuing right before they reverse sideways; the left arm curls upward and opens again. The right hand rises with a tucked elbow as the left hand travels right and up, then returns left while the right hand sweeps left. The left arm extends downward, followed by the right hand descending as the right knee bends more deeply.

To begin, the dancer lowers the right hand while the left arm folds and the left hand drops left, then lifts as the right arm curls upward. The right hand sweeps right and descends with an extending elbow while the left hand continues left. Both hands rise into folded arms before separating sideways again—the right hand moving left and the left hand right—and both lower. The left arm opens farther to the right as the right hand swings left and rises, then returns right while the left hand drops and extends down. The right arm lengthens further downward and carries the right hand left as the left arm tucks and the left hand moves right.

The right hand rises and lengthens leftward. The left arm folds, then both hands descend with the left elbow opening before the right hand curls upward; the left knee bends as the left arm reaches down and left and the right hand drops right. Both knees soften while the arms gather into rising folds, then straighten as the right hand moves left and the left hand rises right, extending downward before curling up again. The right arm opens down and left while the left arm sweeps down and left, both elbows folding before the left hand lifts right and the right hand returns right. The rightward-reaching right hand curls higher as the left knee straightens and the left hand continues right with a bent elbow, then the raised right hand falls left and extends while the left hand lowers. The right knee lengthens as the lower left arm tucks, then both knees bend and release beneath a leftward reach of the right hand and an upward curl of the left hand.

The right arm curls upward. The left hand rises as the right arm lowers, then the left arm extends right while the right arm opens left and folds back toward the right. Both arms lengthen downward, with the left hand returning left; the right knee straightens as the right hand lifts, followed by the left hand rising rightward before the right hand drops and both arms tuck. The hands sweep left and descend, the right hand curling farther before the left elbow draws in. They separate, the right hand moving right and the left hand continuing left, then reverse inward as the left arm opens and the right arm folds again.

To begin, the dancer lowers the right hand while extending the right arm left and opening the left knee, then sweeps the right hand right and upward into a fold as the left arm tucks. The hands descend with both elbows drawing in, then rise together before the right arm opens down-left and the left arm curls higher; the right hand continues left as the left hand travels right and folds. Both arms lengthen downward, the left hand returning left as the knees soften, then reverse sideways with the right hand lifting and the left elbow curling. The right arm extends farther left and drops as both knees straighten, then the left arm opens left and the right hand follows left before rising. The right arm reaches out and descends alongside the left hand, which then moves right and curls upward.

The right hand moves right and curls upward. The dancer folds the left arm as the raised right hand returns left, then lowers both hands with the curled right arm opening before the right hand rises right again. Both hands sweep left, the right arm extending while the left arm tucks downward; they return right and rise together into folds, then descend as the left arm lengthens. The right arm reaches up-left against the left arm's rightward lift, drops and curls back up-right while the left arm lowers into a fold. Both hands climb, the right hand moving right as the left arm opens, then the right elbow bends farther.

The right hand sweeps left and curls upward as the left arm reaches down and right, then the hands separate right and left with the left hand rising. The right hand dips and lifts back left into a fold while the left arm extends farther right, then drops as the bent right arm releases and both hands sweep left before the left hand returns right. Both arms gather inward as the left hand rises and moves right, then opens downward while the right hand curls up and left. The hands exchange height, the right hand lowering through an opening and folding motion as the left hand rises; they reverse sideways again, the left hand lifting and extending while the right hand tucks in and continues right. The raised left hand lowers and swings left as the right knee straightens and bends, then returns right and climbs while the left arm folds and the right knee softens further. The climbing left hand reverses left and curls higher as the right hand drops.

At the outset, the dancer lengthens the right arm upward and left while the left hand rises right, then folds both arms inward. The hands descend as the right arm reverses right and opens into a lift, followed by the left hand rising and tucking. The right arm extends lower to the right and curls back up-left while the left arm reaches down-right. Both hands sweep right and rise, the left arm folding before opening downward again. The right hand lowers and travels left as the left hand continues right, then returns right and curls upward.

At the outset, the right arm extends left as the right knee straightens and the left hand drops right. The right arm folds upward while the left arm curls up-left, then the hands separate right and left before both arms lengthen downward. Both elbows tuck and the hands reverse inward, with the right hand lifting farther right; the right arm opens again as the left hand moves right and lowers. The left hand continues climbing toward the left while the right arm extends down-right, then the left hand descends and reaches farther left.

As the right knee straightens, the dancer curls the right arm up-right and lengthens the left arm downward. The right hand drops left and extends while the left hand sweeps left and rises into a fold; both hands reverse right as the left knee softens, then the right knee bends and releases beneath the right hand's upward-left return. The left arm reaches up-right as the right knee bends again, then both knees sink while the right hand falls left and the left arm opens upward to join it. Both knees straighten as the hands separate right and left, the left arm curling down and reopening while the right arm reaches farther right. The left hand reverses left and rises as the right elbow folds, then both hands sweep left and the elbows open before they descend with the right arm extending further.

A rising, folding arm sweep begins as the dancer raises the left hand leftward and tucks the left arm, then curls the right hand upward while the raised left hand climbs farther right. The right hand drops and lengthens toward the right as the left hand descends into an open reach. Both hands rise again, with the left hand continuing right while the right hand moves left; they descend together as both arms fold. The left hand swings left and back right before the right hand curls upward, then both lift with bent elbows. The right arm opens down and left while the left arm folds farther inward.

The right hand rises and sweeps left. The left arm folds upward as the right hand climbs higher, then both arms lengthen before the right hand drops right and the left arm curls down and left. The hands reverse sideways and rise with folded elbows, then separate again, the right arm extending downward while the left arm reaches left and opens into a descending rightward sweep. Both hands lower with bent elbows and return left, the left arm tucking farther inward as the right arm lengthens. The left arm reaches up and right while the right hand lifts left, and they exchange height twice more as the right hand continues right and the left arm falls; the right arm opens while the left elbow draws in.

The dancer raises the right hand rightward. The right arm folds while the left arm opens and the right knee bends, then both hands sweep left before the right arm extends down and curls back up as the right knee straightens and the left knee softens. The right arm lengthens downward while the left arm reaches right, dips and rises again; the right arm tucks as the right knee bends and straightens, followed by the left knee extending. Both knees soften as the hands descend, the left hand moving right and the right arm opening down-left. The arms curl upward, sweep right together, and extend downward with the right hand continuing right. The right arm bends as the left hand moves left and both knees sink further, finishing with a rise of the right arm.

A rising, folding right arm reaches right. The dancer lowers the left hand into a curl and lifts it again as the right elbow opens; both hands sweep left and rise with folded arms, then the left hand moves right while the right hand returns left and the right knee straightens. Both hands descend, the right hand continuing left before reversing right as the left hand lifts leftward with an extending elbow, then both lower as the left knee softens. The left hand rises right with a tucked elbow and drops left as the right hand curls upward and the right knee bends, followed by another bend of the left knee and a shared rightward sweep of the hands. The left knee straightens as the right hand drops left and unfolds, while the left hand curls up to the right; the right knee extends further and the left leg lengthens before the left hand drops left. The left arm opens downward as the right hand reaches right, then curls upward and sweeps left while the left knee bends and straightens beneath a folding descent of the left arm. The right hand lowers and opens as the bent left knee releases farther, ending with the left hand dropping.

The dancer lowers the right hand as the left arm folds, then lifts both hands and carries them left. Both arms open downward, with the right hand continuing left before curling back up and right while the left elbow tucks and the left hand rises. The right hand drops farther left as the left hand sweeps right and down, then reverses left and curls upward while the left knee bends. The left arm extends through a rightward sweep, followed by the right hand; both descend into lengthened arms as the left knee straightens.

As the dancer raises and folds the right arm, the right hand drops while the left hand curls up-left; the right hand then sweeps left as both arms open. The hands rise in succession, the left hand moving right before the right hand folds down-left, then reverses right with a further tuck. Both arms lengthen and descend, then curl upward again, the left hand sweeping left. The hands separate right and left as they descend and the right arm extends, followed by a shared lift into opposing arm bends. The right arm opens downward while the left arm reaches higher and farther left.
